source_text: the sons of aram: uz, hul, gether, and mash.
target_text: ana-èpu aram ka: dhèu us, dhèu hul, dhèu geter, dènge dhèu mas.

source_text: arphaxad was the father of shelah. shelah was the father of eber.
target_text: ana arpaksad ka, sela. ana sela ka, eber.

source_text: eber had two sons. one was named peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; the name of his brother was joktan.
target_text: ana eber, mone dhèu dua. ana uuru, ngara na pelek dhu sasoa na ‘palème era', lula taa èèna dhèu pea palème ètu rai-haha ne. ngara ari na, yoktan.

source_text: joktan was the father of almodad, sheleph, hazarmaveth, jerah,
target_text: ana-èpu yoktan, ka: almodad, selef, hasar-mawet, yera,

source_text: hadoram, uzal, diklah,
target_text: hadoram, usal, dikla,

source_text: obal, abimael, sheba,
target_text: obal, abimael, syeba,

source_text: ophir, havilah, and jobab. these were all sons of joktan.
target_text: ofir, hawila, dènge yobab. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu yoktan.

source_text: they lived in the land lying between mesha to sephar, in the hill country to the east.
target_text: era pea rèngu, mulai nèti mesa, taruu d'ai sefar, nuka era dhu kabhuku re sebhe dhimu.

source_text: these were the sons of shem, according to their tribes, languages, lands, and nations.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu sem. èci-èci ka dènge lii, suku, aa dènge rai ra.

source_text: these were all the tribes descended from noah's sons, according to their genealogies and national groups. from these ancestors the different nations of the earth spread around the world after the flood.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu noh, èci-èci ka dènge suku ra. ropa èi aae lala èle, rèngu se'e ka pea papènu lème rai-haha ne.

source_text: at that time the whole world spoke just one language and used words with the same meaning.
target_text: uru-uru tèka na, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka lii èci di.

source_text: as they moved east they discovered a plain in the land of shinar so they settled there.
target_text: lod'o rèngu cahag'e lasi asa ca bèka dhimu, ra d'ai era mera ètu sinear, ka ra pea ètu èèna.

source_text: they said to one another, come on, let's make some bricks and bake them with fire. they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of cement. then they said, now let's build a city for ourselves with a tower whose top reaches the heavens. that way we'll gain a great reputation and we won't end up being scattered all over the world.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i rare lii èci, aku rèngu na, a'ari, ee! mai ta patitu kota kapai aae cue. ti tao hadhu bata; ti tunu pa'adhu. èèna na, èdhi pudhi sa dedha, ho ti tape dènge èi dama. ho èèna na, ti patitu manara dedha aae èci, dhu kolo nèngu na d'ai dedha-liru, sèna ka èdhi abhu kolongara kapai. ho sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i ca kabarai aae, dhu pahag'a ia ka.

source_text: but the lord came down to take a look at the city and the tower that the people were building.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru mai laladhe kota dènge manara dhu ra patitu èèna.

source_text: the lord said, look! these people are united and they all speak one language. if this is what they can do now when they're just getting started, nothing will be impossible for them when they all put their minds to it!
target_text: ka na peka na, dhèu rai-haha se, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kabarai, dènge lii èci di. ngaa dhu rèngu tao ne, heka mulai kèna. bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i mi èci sèmi ne'e, èèna na, ngaa dhu rèngu neo tao, j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: we need to go down and mix up their language and make it confused so they won't be able to understand what they're saying to one other.
target_text: de be'a risi, èdhi puru lati ho tao lii si baka-leo, ho sèna ka èci ne'a boe lii èci.

source_text: the lord sent them away from there and scattered them all over the world, and they gave up building the city.
target_text: hèia lamatua puru, ka kakeho lii ra. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, na pacèri si palème rai-haha ne. ka ra pakèd'i taruu heka kota deo na.

source_text: that's why it was called babel, because the lord made the language of the world confused.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra pangare kota na, babel dhu sasoa na ‘pab'ingu', lula lamatua kakeho lii ra, aa pacèri eele si palème rai-haha ne.

source_text: the following is the genealogy of shem. when shem was 100, he had arphaxad. this was two years after the flood.
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu sem. ropa èle èi aae lala dua tèu sa, sem mamuri cangasu tèu kèna, ka na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na arpaksad.

source_text: shem lived another 500 years after arphaxad was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sem mamuri hari d'ai lèmi ngasu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when arphaxad was 35, he had shelah.
target_text: lod'o umur arpaksad d'ai tèlu nguru lèmi tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na sela.

source_text: arphaxad lived another 403 years after shelah was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka arpaksad mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when shelah was 30, he had eber.
target_text: lod'o umur sela d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na eber.

source_text: shelah lived another 403 years after eber was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka sela mamuri hari d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when eber was 34, he had peleg.
target_text: lod'o umur eber d'ai tèlu nguru èpa tèu, na abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na pelek.

source_text: eber lived another 430 years after peleg was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka eber mamuri era d'ai èpa ngasu tèlu nguru tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when peleg was 30, he had reu.
target_text: lod'o umur pelek d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehu.

source_text: peleg lived another 209 years after reu was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka pelek mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu ceo tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when reu was 32, he had serug.
target_text: lod'o umur rehu d'ai tèlu nguru dua tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na seruk.

source_text: reu lived another 207 years after serug was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka rehu mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu pidhu tèu, na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when serug was 30, he had nahor.
target_text: lod'o umur seruk d'ai tèlu nguru tèu, na matana ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na nahor.

source_text: serug lived another 200 years after nahor was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka seruk mamuri era d'ai dua ngasu tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when nahor was 29, he had terah.
target_text: lod'o umur nahor d'ai dua nguru ceo tèu, na abhu ana mone èci, ngara na tera.

source_text: nahor lived another 119 years after terah was born and had other sons and daughters.
target_text: ka nahor mamuri era d'ai cangasu canguru ceo tèu, ka na abhu hari ana mone dènge ana bhèni.

source_text: when terah was 70, he had abram, nahor, and haran.
target_text: lod'o umur tera d'ai pidhu nguru tèu risi, na abhu ana mone, dhèu tèlu: abram, nahor, dènge haran.

source_text: the following is the genealogy of terah. terah was the father of abram, nahor, and haran. haran was the father of lot.
target_text: ana-èpu tera, sèmi ne'e: ana mone na, ka: abram, nahor, dènge haran. haran abhu ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na lot.

source_text: however, haran died while his father, terah, was still alive, in ur of the chaldeans, the land of his birth.
target_text: haran madhe ètu rae èta-èsu na, ngara na ur, rai dhèu kasdim. lod'o èèna, ama na tera mamuri era.

source_text: abram and nahor both got married. abram's wife was named sarai, and nahor's wife was named milcah. she was the daughter of haran, who was the father of both milcah and iscah.
target_text: abram madhèdi dènge sarai. nahor leo dènge ana bhèni haran, ngara na milka. haran abhu ana mone èci kahèi, ngara na yiska.

source_text: sarai wasn't able to become pregnant and so had no children.
target_text: te ngaa sarai dènge boe ana.

source_text: terah took his son abram, his grandson lot who was the son of haran, his daughter-in-law sarai the wife of his son abram, and left ur of the chaldeans to move to the land of canaan. they got as far as haran and settled there.
target_text: ca tèka, tera nèti ana na abram, dènge sarai dhèu èmu abram, dènge èpu na lot, lasi tèke eele rae ur, neo lasi asa rai kana'an. te ngaa lasi d'ai rae haran, rèngu pea ka ètu èèna.

source_text: terah lived for 205 years and died in haran.
target_text: tera madhe ètu èèna, dènge umur na dua ngasu lèmi tèu.

source_text: the lord told abram, leave your country, your relatives, your family home, and travel to the land i'm going to show you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua peka le dènge abram, peka na, abram! èu pakèd'i nèti era èu ne, tèke eele ina-ama èu, èmu ina-ama mu, dènge rae-lesa èu. lamu asa era èci, dhu pe ja'a peka dènge èu.

source_text: i will make you the ancestor of a great nation and i will bless you. i will make sure you have a great reputation and that you are a blessing to others.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi èu. aa ana-èpu èu, èèna na, bèba-kacanga, j'aj'i suku dhu kapai, toke dhèu tadhe kolongara èu. ho bèli-camèd'a, èu j'aj'i berkat hia dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: i will bless those who bless you; i will curse those who curse you. everyone on earth will be blessed through you.
target_text: èèna na, ja'a hia berkat mi dhèu dhu hia berkat mi èu. te ngaa ja'a huku dhèu cee dhu dhoo èu. nanene paie! pe èèna na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne abhu berkat lula èu.

source_text: so abram left following the lord's instructions, and lot went with him. abram was 75 when he left haran. with him went his wife sarai, his nephew lot, together with all the possessions they had collected and the people that had joined them in haran. they left for the land of canaan. when they arrived there,
target_text: lod'o èèna, umur abram pidhu nguru lèmi tèu. na nèti dhèu èmu na sarai, aa dènge ana ari na, lot, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na aa'i-aa'i dhu na abhu ètu kota haran. hèia abram si lasi ka, tèke eele kota haran, asa era dhu lamatua peka le dènge ne. ka ra kako taruu, d'ai rai èci, ngara na kana'an.

source_text: abram traveled on through the land as far as a place called shechem, stopping at the oak tree of moreh. at that time the land was occupied by canaanites.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, abram kako palème rai ne, toke d'ai padètu dènge rae èci, ngara na sikem. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna, padètu dènge aj'u aae ca kapua ètu more. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: the lord appeared to abram and said, i'm going to give this land to your descendants. so abram built an altar to the lord there because that was where the lord appeared to him.
target_text: ètu era èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne. ka abram pudhi hadhu tao mei korban hia lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi na dènge nèngu ètu era èèna.

source_text: then he moved on to the hill country east of bethel and set up camp there. bethel was to the west and ai to the east. he built an altar to the lord there and worshiped him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abram si pidha hari asa ledhe re balèu. ka ra pea taha ètu talora rae betel dènge rae ai. ètu èèna, na patitu mei korban èci ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua.

source_text: after that he went on his way, heading towards the negev.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na pidha-pidha era, d'ai rai negeb re ca bèka balèu nèti rai kana'an.

source_text: but the land had been hit by famine. so abram continued on to egypt, planning to live there because the famine was so bad.
target_text: ca tèka, rai kana'an lèke manganga aae. nèti èèna ka, abram si lasi asa bèka balèu, ka ra d'ai rai masir. ka ra manubha taha ètu nèi.

source_text: as he approached egypt and was about to cross the border, he said to his wife sarai, look, i know what a beautiful woman you are.
target_text: ropa oe d'ai masir, abram peka dènge dhèu èmu na, sarai, aku nèngu na, sarai, èu bhèni iia, nia boe.

source_text: when the egyptians see you, they'll say, ‘she's his wife, ' and they'll kill me but not you!
target_text: de ladhe dhèu masir rèdhi èu bhèni iia sèmi ne'e, mage dhoka ra pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a dhèu èmu-kamali èu. dènge sèmi èèna, ra parame rare èu.

source_text: tell them you're my sister so i'll be treated well because of you, and my life will be spared for your sake.
target_text: de be'a risi, èu peka dènge ra, na ja'a ne, ana mone èu. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu pamadhe boe ja'a, aa ra be'a-be'a dènge ja'a, lula èu ne.

source_text: when abram arrived in egypt, the people there saw how beautiful sarai was.
target_text: ropa abram si d'ai masir, dhèu ètu èèna, ladhe laa na, sarai ne bhèni iia titu kèna.

source_text: pharaoh's officials also noticed and spoke positively about her to pharaoh. so sarai was taken to his palace to become one of his wives.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a dhèu aae sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, aa ra koa bhabhèni iia na ètu madha dhèu aae. ka rèti bhèni ne, asa èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: pharaoh treated abram well because of her, giving him sheep and cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae be'a-be'a ka dènge abram, lula sarai. ka na parasee abram mèdha rupa-rupa. nuka badha sèmi: kahib'i-kalèbho, kahib'i-ka'ia, sapi, keled'ei, dènge onta. na parasee kahèi, ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: but the lord caused pharaoh and the people in his palace to suffer from terrible diseases because of sarai, abram's wife.
target_text: lula na nare dhèu èmu dhèu asa d'ara èmu na, nèti èèna ka, lamatua hia huku rupa-rupa mi dhèu aae dènge isi èmu na.

source_text: so pharaoh ordered abram brought to him and said, what have you done to me? why didn't you tell me that she was your wife?
target_text: hèia dhèu aae masir paroa abram, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne tao tasamia mi ja'a ne? nga tao ka èu peka boe na, bhèni ne dhèu èmu èu?

source_text: why did you say, ‘she's my sister, ' and let me take her to become one of my wives? so here's your wife! take her and leave!
target_text: te ngaa aku èu na, nèngu ne ana hèni èu! nèti èèna ka, ja'a oe kore ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu ja'a! dhèu èmu èu ka ne'e! more hari ka, aa pakaj'èu ka nèti madha ja'a!

source_text: pharaoh ordered his guards to expel him and his wife from the country, along with everyone with them and all their possessions.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae paredha dhèu sab'a na sèra, babège eele abram, dhèu èmu na, rèti dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra, kalua nèti rai èèna.

source_text: so abram left egypt and went back into the negev along with sarai, lot, and everyone with them, as well as all their possessions.
target_text: ka abram si tèke eele masir, lasi asa rai negeb. la'e dènge dhèu èmu na, aa dènge dhèu aa mèdha-panyau aa'i-aa'i ra. ana ari na lot madhutu ra kahèi.

source_text: abram was very rich, having many herds of livestock and a great deal of silver and gold.
target_text: abram èèna, kaja ae titu kèna. badha-manu na, mèdha hualaa dènge mèdha hualaa-pudhi na, ae titu kèna.

source_text: he left the negev and traveled in stages to bethel, back to the place where he'd camped before, between bethel and ai.
target_text: nèti negeb, ra pidha-pidha era, ka d'ai hari talora rae betel dènge rae ai. dhu uru èèna, ra pea rèdhi le ètu era èèna.

source_text: this was where he'd first built an altar. he worshiped the lord there as he had done previously.
target_text: aa dhu abram patitu le kahèi mei korban, ho na mangaj'i mi lamatua ètu era èèna.

source_text: lot, who was traveling with abram, also had many flocks, herds, and tents,
target_text: lot dhu madhutu abram èèna, unu badha-manu dènge dhèu sab'a ae kahèi.

source_text: so much so that the available land couldn't support both of them-they had so much livestock they couldn't stay together anymore. abram's and lot's herdsmen were arguing, and in addition the canaanites and perizzites were also living in the land at that time.
target_text: te ngaa era èèna taleo boe, ho abram dènge lot aa dènge kakaja ra bisa pea pa'èci. nèti èèna ka, ana madhenge badha abram dènge lot sèra j'aj'i patao-palaha, lula j'u'u ètu era èèna d'ai boe hia badha rèngu. lod'o èèna, dhèu kana'an dènge dhèu feris, dhu pea ètu èèna era.

source_text: so abram said to lot, please don't let's have arguments between us, or between our herdsmen, because we're family.
target_text: ka abram peka dènge lot, aku nèngu na, èdhi se, pa'a'ari. mage dhoka èdhi, èci dènge èci be'a boe, lula dhèu sab'a èdhi se patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: you see all this land that's available right in front of you? we have to split up. if you choose to go to the left, i'll go to the right. if you choose to go to the right, i'll go to the left.
target_text: de hua iia dua ti pahag'a ka laa. rai ne, taleo. de ladhe èu d'èi rai ca bèka kariu na, ja'a abhu re ca bèka g'ana. te ngaa ladhe èu d'èi re ca bèka g'ana, na ja'a re ca bèka kariu.

source_text: lot looked over the whole jordan valley towards zoar, and saw that it was well-watered, looking like the garden of eden, like the land of egypt. this was before the lord destroyed sodom and gomorrah.
target_text: hèia lot ladhe palème. ka na ladhe nèdhi rai taleo ètu sebhe loko yarden dhu madha èi ae, toke d'ai rae soar. era ne, rai hèu mèngi sama sèmi oka lamatua, dènge rai masir kahèi. lod'o èèna, lamatua dhae huku mèka kota sodom dènge kota gomora. de rai èèna, be'a era.

source_text: so lot chose the whole jordan valley and went east, and the two separated from each other.
target_text: hèia lot pili nare era sebhe loko yarden èèna. ka dua ra pahag'e ka. de lot la'e sa ca bèka dhimu.

source_text: abram went to live in the land of canaan, while lot settled down among the towns in the valley, setting up his tents near sodom.
target_text: te ngaa abram pea taruu ètu rai kana'an. aa lot la'e pea ètu rae-rae dhu padètu dènge kota sodom ètu sebhe loko yarden.

source_text: the people of sodom were very wicked, committing terrible sins that offended the lord.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu-dhèu sodom sèra bhelu-katub'a titu kèna. rèngu ro'o boe nanene lamatua.

source_text: after separating from lot, the lord told abram, look around you from where you're standing, to the north, south, east, and west.
target_text: ropa lot pacèri dènge abram, ka lamatua padhai lii dènge abram, peka na, èu ladhe palème aa'i ku, rai aa'i-aa'i nèti era titu èu èèna. ladhe paie re madha, re kabodho, re ca bèka g'ana, dènge ca bèka kariu mu.

source_text: i'm giving all this land you see to you and your descendants forever.
target_text: rai aa'i-aa'i dhu èu ladhe mèdhi sèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu, dènge ana-èpu èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka ra, toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: you will have so many descendants that they'll be like the dust of the earth. if anyone could count dust then they could count the number of your descendants!
target_text: èèna na ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu èu ae sama sèmi salae dhasi, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: go and walk through the whole land in all directions because i'm giving it to you.
target_text: de lamu kako palème madhutu madhera dènge bhabhèla na. te rai se aa'i-aa'i ra, ja'a hia mi èu.

source_text: so abram went to live at hebron, setting up his tents among the oaks at mamre, where he built an altar to the lord.
target_text: hèia abram si lèpa hari asa era pea ra, dhu dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae ètu mamre, dhu padètu dènge hebron. èle èèna ka, na pudhi hadhu tao mei korban ho na mangaj'i lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: at that time amraphel was king of shinar, and he allied himself with arioch, king of ellasar, chedorlaomer, king of elam, and tidal, king of goiim.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae èpa dhu pa'èci. rèngu se ka: amrafel, dhèu aae rai sinear. ariok, dhèu aae rai elasar, kedarlaomer, dhèu aae rai elam. dènge tideal, dhèu aae rai goyim.

source_text: they attacked bera, king of sodom, birsha, king of gomorrah, shinab, king of admah, shemeber, king of zeboiim, and the king of bela otherwise known as zoar.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae leo dhèu lèmi, pa'èci kahèi. nuka: bera, dhèu aae rai sodom. birsa, dhèu aae rai gomora. sinab, dhèu aae rai adema. semeber, dhèu aae rai seboim. dènge bela, dhèu aae rai soar. ka èpa dhèu aae se, lasi pamusu dènge lèmi dhèu aae sèra.

source_text: all these in the second group joined forces in the valley of siddim the dead sea valley.
target_text: dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi sèra pakaboko dènge sordad'u ra, ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, dhu limuri ne, ngara na dhasi madhe.

source_text: they had been under the rule of chedorlaomer for twelve years, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled against him.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i pamusu na, sèmi ne'e ka: uru èèna, dhèu aae, dhèu lèmi se dhu ta'alo mi dhèu aae kedarlaomer, canguru dua tèu kèna. te d'ai tèu ka canguru tèlu, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lab'a ne.

source_text: in the fourteenth year chedorlaomer invaded, along with the kings in his alliance. they defeated the rephaites in ashteroth-karnaim, the zuzites in ham, the emites in shaveh-kiriathaim,
target_text: ka maso tèu ka canguru èpa, kedarlaomer dènge angalai na dhèu aae dhèu tèlu sera, mai dènge sordad'u ra. hèia ra pamusu ka, ka ra segi pèri-pèri rai. nuka: dhèu refaim ètu rai asterot-karnaim; dhèu susim ètu rai ham; dhèu emim ètu rai sawe-kiryataim,

source_text: and the horites in their hill country of seir, all the way to el-paran, near the desert.
target_text: dènge dhèu hori dhu ètu ledhe seir, d'ai sebhe mamoo el paran.

source_text: then they swung back through and attacked en-mishpat otherwise known as kadesh and conquered the whole country belonging to the amalekites, as well as the amorites who lived in hazazon-tamar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa en mispat dhu limuri ne ngara na kades. ka ra segi rai dhèu amalek, dènge dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rae haseson-tamar.

source_text: then the king of sodom, the king of gomorrah, the king of admah, the king of zeboiim, and the king of bela otherwise known as zoar marched out and prepared for battle in the valley of siddim. they fought chedorlaomer, king of elam, tidal, king of goiim, amraphel, king of shinar, and arioch, king of ellasar-four kings on one side against five on the other.
target_text: hèia, lèmi dhèu aae se ator sordad'u ra ètu d'ara mamoo sidim, ka lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae dhèu èpa sèra.

source_text: there were many tar pits in the valley of siddim, and as the defeated kings of sodom and gomorrah ran away, some of their men fell into them while the rest ran to the hills.
target_text: ètu d'ara mamoo èèna, dhu abhu mananga èi dama pèri-pèri. ropa ra pamusu, dhèu aae sodom dènge dhèu aae gomora dènge sordad'u ra, rai. ka cahag'e manahu asa d'ara mananga èi dama se. aa cahag'e hari rai asa ledhe lasi.

source_text: the invaders took from sodom and gomorrah all their possessions and food and left.
target_text: ka èpa dhèu aae dhu segi se, lasi parame rèti mèdha-panyau dènge nganga'a-nginu nèti sodom dènge gomora. èèna ka, ra lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: they also captured lot, abram's nephew, and his possessions, because he was living in sodom.
target_text: te ngaa lot, ana ari abram, dhu pea ètu sodom. ka èpa dhèu aae sèra, ère rèti lot si, dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but one of those captured escaped and went and told abram the hebrew what had happened. abram was living by the oaks of mamre the amorite, whose brothers were eshcol and aner. all of them were abram's allies.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci rai nèti era èèna. ka la'e lolo dènge abram, dhèu ibrani èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu amori èci, ngara na mamre. aa abram pea dètu dènge aj'u-aj'u aae unu mamre. a'ari mamre dhèu dua, ngara na eskol dènge aner. rèngu se dhu pa'anga dènge abram.

source_text: when abram found out that his nephew had been captured, he called together 318 fighting men who had been born in his household and chased after them all the way to dan.
target_text: ropa abram tadèngi na dhèu kèpe rèti le lot, ana ari na, ka abram pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu sab'a na dhu re'a pamusu. aa'i-aa'i ra tèlu ngasu canguru aru dhèu. ka lasi magèla èpa dhèu aae sèra, asa badae aae lasi d'ai rae dan.

source_text: there he divided his men into groups and attacked at night, defeating the enemy and chasing them as far as hobah, north of damascus.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abram hag'e dhèu na sèra, mi pèri-pèri kaboko. d'ara mèda èèna kahèi, lasi age si, dènge j'ara pa'oke. ka abram si lasi bate dhèu se d'ai rae hoba, ètu bèka badae kota damsik.

source_text: abram recovered all that had been taken, including lot and his possessions, and also brought back the women and others who had been captured.
target_text: hèia abram abhu hari lot, dènge dhèu-dhèu nèngu, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra aa'i-aa'i. na abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo.

source_text: when abram returned after defeating chedorlaomer and his allies, the king of sodom came out to meet him at the valley of shaveh or valley of the king.
target_text: ropa abram segi nare dhèu aae èpa sèra, ka na lèpa. hèia dhèu aae sodom mai soru ne ètu d'ara mamoo sawe dhu dhèu biasa peka na, mamoo dhèu aae.

source_text: melchizedek, king of salem, brought out bread and wine. he was a priest of the most high god.
target_text: tèu èèna, melkisedek, j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. aa nèngu ne j'aj'i kahèi ama agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. na mai soru abram, nèti roti dènge èi hua anggor.

source_text: he blessed abram, telling him, may abram be blessed by the most high god, creator of heaven and earth. may the most high god be praised, who handed your enemies over to you. then abram gave melchizedek one tenth of everything.
target_text: ka na padhai lii ho hia berkat mi abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua, dhu dedha risi eele èèna, dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, hia mèngi-nale mi dedha èu. koa-kio ama lamatua dhu hia le èu segi musu. èle èèna ka, abram bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala mèdha-panyau dhu na abhu hari sèra.

source_text: the king of sodom told abram, let me have the people back, and you can keep everything else for yourself.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae sodom èèna pahaha iisi na mi abram, peka na, ama. mèdha-panyau dhu èu abhu hari nèti musu ja'a sèra, hud'i laa ama ku abhu aa'i si. te ngaa dhu ja'a manèngi hari, dhoka dhèu-dhèu ja'a sèra.

source_text: but abram replied to the king of sodom, i raise my hand, making a solemn promise to the lord, the most high god, creator of heaven and earth,
target_text: hèia abram b'ala ne, peka na, ja'a subha ètu madha ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, dhu tao dedha-liru dènge rai-haha,

source_text: that i refuse to take anything belonging to you, not a single thread or a sandal strap. otherwise you might claim, ‘it was me who made abram rich! '
target_text: na, ja'a kore boe mèdha-panyau èu, masi ka ciki èèna ka. masi ka loa hèngu ca'èta sa, ja'a kore boe. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èu baku peka na, ‘kakaja abram sèra mai nèti ja'a. '

source_text: i won't take anything except what my men have eaten, and the share for those who accompanied me-aner, eshcol, and mamre. let them have their share.
target_text: ja'a parluu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka mia dhu dhèu ja'a se pake le, sèra èle le, ale ia ka. aa hud'i laa, angalai ja'a dhèu tèlu se: aner, eskol dènge mamre, hag'e rare unu rèngu di.

source_text: after all this had happened, god spoke to abram in a vision, telling him, don't be afraid, abram! i am your protector, and your truly great reward!
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua pad'elo iisi na mi abram. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, abram! èu baku madha'u. lula ja'a ka dhu j'aj'i mi tami ho bhiri èu nèti musu. aa ja'a hia a'oto mi dedha èu.

source_text: but abram replied, lord god, what good is whatever you give me? i don't have any children, and the heir to all that i have is eliezer of damascus. abram went on to complain, look! you haven't given me any children, so a servant from my household has to be my heir!
target_text: te ngaa, aku abram na, masi ka ama lamatua hia ae-ae èèna ka, j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci. lula ja'a ne dènge boe ana matana, ho hia ja'a ana-èpu. de dhu neo unu ae-ae sèmi èèna, tao mi ngaa? neu-neu ka, noto mi ènu ja'a elieser, dhèu damsik èèna. nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but then the lord told him, this man won't be your heir. your heir will be your very own son.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa na, j'ara na sèmi boe èèna! ana d'èlu èu ku, dhu unu pusaka sèra. ènu èu abhu boe.

source_text: the lord took abram outside and said to him, look up at the sky. see if you can count the stars! that's how many descendants you will have!
target_text: hèia nèti abram asa li'u, ka na peka, èu ladhe ku asa dedha-liru nèi. ladhe paie ku hua-hètu sèi. bisa iga more, do aad'o? bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu èu sama sèmi hua-hètu sèi!

source_text: abram trusted what the lord said, and so the lord counted abram as being in a right relationship with him.
target_text: ka abram sèmi nare lii padhai lamatua. aa lamatua tadhe ne, dhèu mola, lula abram lèka ne.

source_text: the lord also told him, i am the lord, who led you from ur of the chaldeans to give you this land for you to own.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua tuhu hari lii na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua. ja'a ka dhu lere kèti èu nèti rae ur, ètu rai dhèu kasdim sèra. aa rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu, sèna ka j'aj'i pusaka mu.

source_text: but lord god, how can i be certain that i will own it? abram asked.
target_text: te ngaa abram karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, lamatua? dènge j'ara sa mia ka ho ja'a ke'a na, rai ne j'aj'i pusaka ja'a?

source_text: the lord told him, bring me a cow, a goat, and a ram, all of them three years old, together with a dove and a young pigeon.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! mai ti tao madha j'ara èci, dhu pa'èki lii padhai lii ja'a deo na. de lamu more sapi rena ci'u, kahib'i rena ci'u, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho mone ci'u. aa'i-aa'i sèra hud'i dhu umur tèlu tèu. aa mèti kahèi koro iia ci'u, dènge koro j'aha ci'u.

source_text: so abram took and killed the three animals. then he cut them in half, and placed each half opposite the other. however, he didn't cut the birds in half.
target_text: ka abram la'e nare badha sèra. hèia na kacèb'e bagi mi dua, sapi, kahib'i, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra. ka na pale sisi se mi rai, dhu èci patangara dènge èci, j'aj'i mi dua b'aris. te ngaa na kacèb'e boe manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: when vultures flew down on the carcasses, abram frightened them off.
target_text: ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi sèra, mai ho neo ra'a sisi se'e. te ngaa abram bhabhoo eele si.

source_text: as the sun went down, a deep sleep came over abram, and at the same time a dense and terrifying darkness fell on him.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, abram bhèj'i luu. na nii, kuri na maroga mai sarimu nare nèngu, ka na madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: the lord explained to abram, you can be absolutely sure that your descendants will be strangers in a foreign land, where they will be slaves and mistreated for 400 years. however, i will punish the nation that makes them slaves, and later on they will leave, taking many valuable possessions with them. but as for you, you will die in peace and be buried, having lived a good long life.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, abram! èèna na èu mamuri toke heka bhoro, aa madhe dènge be'a, ka ra padhane èu dènge be'a. te ngaa ana-èpu èu, èèna na j'aj'i dhèu tao mai ètu kabarai dhèu. ho èèna na, dhèu isi rai sèra, tao si sèmi ènu sa, ka ra ènyi aa paj'èra si, toke èpa ngasu tèu. te, ladhe èèna na, ja'a huku si. ho èèna na, ja'a kèti hari ana-èpu èu nèti era èèna, aa dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae-ae.

source_text: four generations later your descendants will come back here to live, because right now the sins of the amorites have not reached their full extent.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a ator ho ana-èpu èu dhu ka lèmi kèti hari si asa ne'e mai. limuri ne, dhèu amori dhu pea ètu rai ne'e. dhèu se'e dhèu bhelu, te ngaa dhae bhelu iia mèka. ladhe ana-èpu èu sèra lèpa hari asa era ne'e, ja'a neo pake si ho huku palaho dhèu amori sèra. lula d'ai taa èèna, bhabhelu ra asa hino.

source_text: after the sun set and it grew dark, suddenly a smoking furnace and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the animal carcasses.
target_text: ropa d'ai mèda sa, cag'ag'a laa ètu era èèna, abhu èru rai èci dhu sèb'u poka-poka, dènge badhu ai èci dhu heo, kako re sasanga sisi dua baris se.

source_text: this is how the lord made an agreement with abram that day and promised him, i'm giving this land to your descendants. it extends from the wadi of egypt to the great euphrates river,
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge abram. na peka na, ja'a jaji mema èu kèna, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pangèd'u mi ana-èpu èu rai ne'e ne, mulai nèti loko masir, d'ai loko efrat,

source_text: and includes the territory of the kenites, kenizzites, kadmonites,
target_text: dènge rai dhèu keni, dhèu kenas, dhèu kadmon,

source_text: hittites, perizzites, rephaites,
target_text: dhèu het, dhèu feris, dhèu refaim,

source_text: amorites, canaanites, girgashites, and jebusites.
target_text: dhèu amori, dhèu kana'an, dhèu girgasi, dènge dhèu yebus.

source_text: sarai, abram's wife, hadn't been able to have any children for him. however, she owned a female egyptian slave named hagar, so sarai said to abram, please listen to me. the lord hasn't let me have any children. so please go and sleep with my slave. maybe i can have a family through her. abram agreed to what sarai had suggested. so sarai, abram's wife took her egyptian slave hagar and gave her to her husband as his wife. abram had been living in the land of canaan for ten years when this happened.
target_text: tèu èèna, abram lèpa hari le nèti masir, ka na pea le canguru tèu ètu kana'an. dhèu èmu na sarai abhu mèka kolo. sarai dènge ènu bhèni ca dhèu nèti masir, ngara na hagar. ca lod'o, sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, a'a. lamatua hia boe ja'a ana. de hua iia, lamu j'unu dènge ènu ja'a, hagar, sèna ka na hia ja'a ana. ka abram madhutu lii dhèu èmu na. ka sarai hia hagar j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua abram.

source_text: abram slept with hagar and she became pregnant. when she realized she was pregnant, she treated her mistress with contempt.
target_text: hèia abram j'unu dènge hagar, ka na dènge babia. ropa hagar ne'a nèngu dènge babia le, ka na padedha iisi na, aa na pahae heka sarai.

source_text: then sarai complained to abram, what i'm suffering is all your doing! i gave you my servant to sleep with, and now that she knows she's pregnant, she treats me with contempt. may the lord decide who's at fault-you or me!
target_text: ka sarai peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu hia nèngu mi èu j'aj'i dhèu èmu ka dua. te ngaa ropa na dènge babia, na pusi pahae heka ja'a! ne'e ne, sala èu! de hud'i laa, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu pama'ète lii èdhi dua ti! heka èu me'a kèna!

source_text: listen, she's your slave! abram replied. you can do whatever you want to her. sarai treated hagar so badly that she ran away.
target_text: ka abram dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e, wee! èu ne, dhèu èmu uru. aa nèngu, dhèu èmu limuri. de èu ne dhu mèd'u paredha. de èu neo tao ne tasamia, èèna ètu èu na! ka sarai mulai tao sakaa hua dènge hagar, hèia na rai.

source_text: the angel of the lord met hagar at a spring in the desert-the spring on the road to shur.
target_text: na rai d'ai d'ara mamoo. hèia ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga ca dhèu, rage ne dètu dènge madha èi, ètu j'ara la'e asa sur.

source_text: he asked her, hagar, sarai's slave-where have you come from, and where are you going? i'm running away from my mistress sarai, she replied.
target_text: ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne hagar, ènu sarai. nga tao ka èu ètu ne'e? èu mai nèti mia, aa lamu mia? hèia hagar dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a rai nèti d'ara èmu lamatua ja'a.

source_text: go back to your mistress and do what she tells you, the angel of the lord told her.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pamako ne, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! be'a risi, èu lèpa hari asa adhe-aai sarai, lamatua èu. masi ka na tao èu tasamia èèna ka, sèmi la.

source_text: then he continued, i will give you many, many descendants-in fact they'll be so many they can't be counted.
target_text: baku madha'u. bèli-camèd'a, ja'a pabèba ana-èpu èu pa'ae-ae, toke dhèu ige rare boe.

source_text: the angel of the lord went on to tell her: listen! you're pregnant, and you will have a son. you are to name him ishmael, for the lord has heard how you've suffered.
target_text: èu dhu dènge babia. nèbhu heka, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èèna na mu pangare ne ismael dhu sasoa na ‘lamatua tadèngi', lula lamatua tadèngi le lii roma iisi èu.

source_text: he'll be a wild donkey kind of man-he will fight with everyone, and everyone will fight with him. he will forever be fighting with his relatives.
target_text: ropa ana ne kapai, na mamuri pakaj'èu nèti a'ari na. lula nèngu ne, sama sèmi jara hui dhu d'èi boe nanene lii paredha. sad'i dhèu cee èèna ka, na sisu. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i lab'a ne kahèi.

source_text: from then on hagar called the lord who spoke to her, you are the god who sees me, because she said, here i saw the one who sees me.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hagar ngee ka ètu d'ara na, aku nèngu na, ja'a kèdhi le lamatua, dhu ladhe-leru aa madhenge ja'a. hèia na hia ngara mi lamatua, lamatua dhu ladhe-leru ja'a.

source_text: that's why the well is called the well of the living one who sees me. it's still there, between kadesh and bered.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu pangare madha èi na, beer lahai roi, dhu sasoa na madha èi nèti nèngu dhu mamuri, dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. era na, ètu talora aae nèti rae kades dènge rae beret. madha èi ne, abhu era toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: hagar gave birth to a son for abram. abram named his son ishmael.
target_text: èle èèna ka, hagar lèpa hari. hèia nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. abram pangare ne ismael.

source_text: abram was 86 when hagar had ishmael.
target_text: lod'o hagar nare iisi ismael, umur abram aru nguru èna tèu kèna.

source_text: when abram was 99, the lord appeared to him and told him, i am god almighty. live in my presence and don't do wrong.
target_text: ropa umur abram d'ai ceo nguru ceo tèu, lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne. ka na peka dènge abram, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. èu hud'i madhutu taruu dad'èi ja'a, dènge j'ara mamuri èu hud'i mola.

source_text: i will make my agreement between me and you, and i will give you many, many descendants.
target_text: ja'a neo pa'èki lii pajaji dènge èu. aa ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu.

source_text: abram bowed down with his face to the ground, and god told him,
target_text: hèia abram patitu kètu urutuu, ka na pacud'u kètu d'ai rai. ka ama lamatua tuhu hari lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: listen! this is the agreement i'm making with you. you will be the father of many nations, so your name won't be abram any longer. instead, your name will be abraham because i'm going to make you the father of many nations.
target_text: lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu sèmi ne'e ka: èèna na, èu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. nèti èèna ka, èu pake ia ka ngara èu abram dhu sasoa na ‘ama dhu dhèu tadhe', te ngaa abraham dhu sasoa na ‘bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae'.

source_text: i will make sure you have a large number of descendants. they will become many nations, and some of their kings will also come from your line.
target_text: ja'a neo pabèba kacanga ana-èpu èu ae-ae. ja'a paj'aj'i si suku ae-ae. aa ja'a ded'e dhèu aae ae nèti rèngu sèra.

source_text: i promise to continue my agreement with you, and with your descendants who come after you, for generations to come. this is an eternal agreement. i will always be your god, and the god of your descendants.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji ja'a dènge èu, aa dènge ana-èpu èu sèra. lii pajaji ne ma'ète boe toke taa-taa, lula ja'a ne'e ka ama lamatua nèti èu dènge ana-èpu mu.

source_text: i will give you and your descendants the whole country of canaan-where you've been living as a foreigner-as land to own forever, and i will be their god.
target_text: rai kana'an ne aa'i-aa'i, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mi èu dènge ana-èpu èu. ne'e ne, èu dhoka pea manubha di ètu ne'e. te ngaa èèna na, j'aj'i mi unu ana-èpu èu toke taa-taa. aa ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua rèngu sèra kahèi.

source_text: then god told abraham, your part is to keep my agreement-you and your descendants for generations to come. this is my agreement with you and your descendants who come after you, the agreement you are to keep: every male among you shall be circumcised.
target_text: te ngaa èu dènge ana-èpu èu sèra, hud'i kèpe pa'èra lii pajaji ne, dènge d'ara kateme ku. dhèu mone aa'i-aa'i ra, hud'i suna ku.

source_text: you are to circumcise your foreskin, and this will be the sign of the agreement between me and you. from now and for all generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised. this includes not only your sons but also those born in your household or bought from foreigners. you must circumcise those born in your household or bought from foreigners as a sign in your bodies of my eternal agreement.

target_text: cag'ag'a laa, lamatua sadutu ai dènge èi nasu nèti dedha-liru asa sodom dènge gomora.

source_text: he completely destroyed the towns and all their inhabitants, the whole valley and everything growing there.
target_text: lamatua pakèpu-ladhu ai kota dènge rae aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara rai èèna, dènge ngaa-ngaa dhu mamuri ètu èèna, nuka: dhèu, badha-manu, dènge ana aaj'u.

source_text: but lot's wife, who was lagging behind, looked back, and she turned into a pillar of salt.
target_text: lod'o rèngu rai, dhèu èmu lot kabib'a kabodho. cag'ag'a laa, na j'aj'i agarii masi.

source_text: abraham got up early the next morning and went back to where he had stood before the lord.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhu mad'ae aae era, abraham la'e asa era dhu med'a na, na pamako lamatua.

source_text: he looked down at sodom and gomorrah and the whole valley floor, and saw the land burning, sending up smoke like from a furnace.
target_text: hèia na ladhe sa haha asa sodom dènge gomora, aa asa d'ara mamoo èèna. na ladhe la'a na, sèb'u poka-poka sèna, dhu ca'e asa dedha-liru. aa ai na'e aa'i le ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: when god destroyed the towns of the valley he didn't forget the promise he made abraham, and he saved lot from the destruction of the towns where lot was living.
target_text: ama lamatua patalale lot si nèti hahuku èèna, ropa na pakèpu-ladhu ai kota-kota sèra, lula na ngee nèdhi lii pajaji na dènge abraham.

source_text: lot was afraid to stay in zoar, so he left town and went to live in a cave in the mountains with his two daughters.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lot madha'u pea taruu ètu rae soar. nèti èèna ka, nèngu dènge ana bhèni na dhèu dua sèra, lasi asa ledhe ka ra pea ètu d'ara loe cue.

source_text: sometime later the older daughter said to the younger one, our father is growing old, and there's no men left to give us children like everyone does.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana bhèni uru èèna, peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, ètu era ne'e ne, abhu boe dhèu mone ca dhèu sa, dhu bisa leo dènge èdhi se. aa ama èdhi asa heka, de ladhe èèna na, na bisa heka abhu ana.

source_text: come on, let's get our father drunk with wine and sleep with him so we can keep his family line going.
target_text: de be'a risi, ti hia ne ninu mahu, sèna ka èdhi dua ti j'unu dènge ne, ho ti abhu kolo hia ama èdhi.

source_text: so they got their father drunk with wine that night. the older daughter went and slept with him, and he didn't notice when she lay down or when she got up.
target_text: ka ropa d'ai mèda, dua ra hia ama ra ninu èi anggor toke mahu. hèia ana bhèni uru èèna, la'e j'unu dènge ama na. lula ama na dhu mahu ae, ka ne'a boe nèngu dhu j'unu dènge ana na.

source_text: the next day the older daughter said to the younger one, last night i slept with our father. let's get him drunk with wine again tonight and you can go and sleep with him so we can keep his family line going.
target_text: hèia asa bèli èèna, a'a na peka dènge ari na, aku nèngu na, mèda deo na, ja'a j'unu le dènge ama èdhi. de mèda ne'e, èu kèna. èdhi hia ne hari ninu mahu, ho lamu j'unu dènge ne. sèna ka èdhi dua ti abhu ana, ho hia ana-èpu mi ama èdhi.

source_text: so once again that night they got their father drunk with wine and the younger daughter went and slept with him, and he didn't notice when she lay down or when she got up.
target_text: ka d'ara mèda na, dua ra hia hari ama ra ninu mahu. ka ana bhèni limuri ne, la'e ka j'unu dènge ama na. te ngaa, lula ama ra dhu mahu titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ne'a boe ngaa dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ana bhèni na.

source_text: this is how both lot's daughters became pregnant by their father.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e ne ka, dua ra dènge babia nèti ama d'èlu rèngu.

source_text: the older daughter had a son, and she called him moab. he is the ancestor of the moabites of today.
target_text: hèia ana bhèni uru èèna nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka na pangare na moab dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti ama'. ana ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu moab.

source_text: the younger daughter had a son too, and she called him ben-ammi. he is the ancestor of the ammonites of today.
target_text: ka ana bhèni limuri ne, nara iisi ana mone èci kahèi. na pangare na ben ami dhu sasoa na ‘mai nèti dhèu ja'a'. ana ne ka dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu amon.

source_text: abraham traveled towards the negev, staying between kadesh and shur. after that he moved on to live in gerar.
target_text: èle èèna, ka abraham nèti mamre, pidha asa rai negeb, dhu ètu re balèu, ka na pea ètu talora rae kades, dènge rae syur. te ngaa na pea nèbhu boe, ka pidha hari asa rae gerar.

source_text: during his time there, when abraham told people about his wife sarah, he said, she's my sister. so abimelech, king of gerar, sent for sarah and took her to become one of his wives.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, sara ne, ana hèni ja'a. nèti èèna ka, abimelek dhèu aae gerar, pua dhèu lasi lii d'ai sara. ka nèti ne mai asa d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: but god appeared to abimelech in a dream and told him, listen! you're going to die because the woman you've taken is already married-she has a husband.
target_text: d'ara ca mèda sa, ama lamatua pad'elo iisi na dènge dhèu aae ètu d'ara nii. na peka, mamadhe èu ne dètu kèna! lula èu more dhèu èmu dhèu.

source_text: abimelech hadn't touched sarah, and he asked, lord, do you kill good people? didn't abraham tell me himself, ‘she's my sister, ' and didn't sarah also say, ‘he's my brother'? i did this in all innocence-my conscience is clear!
target_text: hèia abimelek dhaa, peka na, lamatua! ja'a dhae pa'èci mèka dènge bhèni na. aa ja'a sasala aad'o. abraham unu na ka dhu peka, bhèni na, ana hèni nèngu! aa bhèni na dhaa sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a hia dhèu lasi lii d'ai ne, dènge d'ara mola. de lamatua baku pad'ui ja'a sasala!

source_text: god told him in the dream, yes, i know you did this in all innocence, so i prevented you from sinning against me. that's why i didn't let you touch her.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, tare'a. mema ja'a ke'a d'ara èu mola. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ka dhu taha èu, ho baku pa'èci dènge ne. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èu tao boe sala mi ja'a hèi.

source_text: send the man's wife back to him. he's a prophet. he will pray for you, and you will live. but if you don't send her back to him, you should know for sure that you and all your family will die.
target_text: de èu mèti hari ka bhèni ne, lèpa sa dhèu èmu na. mone na ka dhu nèti lii padhue-padhai ja'a. de lamu manèngi ne, sèna ka na sabaj'a hia èu, ho èu baku madhe. sanèd'e paie! ladhe èu hia boe bhèni na lèpa, èu dènge kabarai èu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: abimelech got up early in the morning and called all his servants together. he explained everything that had happened, and they were all terrified.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, dhèu aae pakaboko nare dhèu-dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i, ka na lolo lii nii na. hèia aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u.

source_text: then abimelech summoned abraham and asked him what have you done to us? how have i wronged you that you should treat me like this, bringing this terrible sin on me and my kingdom? you've done things to me that no one should ever do!
target_text: ka dhèu aae paroa abraham. na karèi, aku nèngu na, ja'a tao sala ngaa mi èu, ka èu neo paj'èra ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a? èu ne ele-ho'a ka dènge tao madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne.

source_text: then abimelech asked abraham what were you thinking when you did this?
target_text: ngangee èu tasamia ka, mu tao sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: well, i thought to myself, ‘nobody respects god in this place. they'll kill me just to get my wife, ' abraham replied.
target_text: ka abraham dhaa, peka na, ama dhèu aae! ja'a pangee na, miu aa'i-aa'i mi, kabarai ne dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. de ele boe cahag'e neo pamadhe ja'a, sèna ka parame rare dhèu èmu ja'a.

source_text: anyway, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father but not my mother, and i married her.
target_text: mema ja'a dhu peka tare'a, nèngu ne, ana hèni ja'a. lula ji'i dua mi ca ama, te ngaa ina baka-leo. nèti èèna ka, ji'i dua mi paleo.

source_text: since my god made me move far away from my family home, i told her, ‘if you really love me, then wherever you go with me you must tell people: he's my brother. '
target_text: ka ropa ama lamatua pua ji'i ho tèke eele era paleo-palu'u ji'i, lod'o èèna ja'a peka dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, aku ja'a na, ‘ladhe èdhi lati asa era leo, ho dhèu karèi èu, dhu èdhi se dhèu èmu-kamali, ladhe èu dhu sue ja'a, na dhaa la, peka na èdhi se, dua ti pa'a'ari. '

source_text: then abimelech gave abraham gifts of sheep, cattle, and male and female slaves, and returned his wife sarah to him. abimelech told him, look over my land. you can choose to live anywhere you like. abimelech also told sarah, notice that i'm giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. this is to compensate you for the wrong done to you in the eyes of everyone with you, and to make sure that your name is publicly cleared.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae abimelek pangèd'u hari sara la'e asa abraham. ka na peka dènge sara, èèna na, ja'a hia ana mone mu doi iia ca riho, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha ja'a tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa mi èu. ho hud'i sène, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a! hèia dhèu aae peka dènge abraham, aku nèngu na, kabarai ja'a ne, dhu bhoke tèke hia èu. èu neo pea mi era mia èèna ka, ja'a hia èu. ka abimelek hia abraham sapi, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. na hia kahèi ènu dhèu mone dènge dhèu bhèni.

source_text: then abraham prayed to god, and god healed abimelech, his wife, and his female slaves, so that they could have children again. for the lord had made all the women unable to have children because abraham's wife, sarah, had been taken.
target_text: uru èèna, lula abimelek nare dhèu èmu abraham, ka lamatua hutu eele era ana nèti bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu aae èèna. te ngaa ropa abimelek hia sara lèpa hari sa dhèu èmu na, ka abraham sabaj'a ho lamatua bhoke hari era ana nèti bhèni se. ka ra abhu hari ana.

source_text: the lord came to help sarah as he'd said he would. the lord did for sarah what he'd promised. she became pregnant and had a son for abraham when he was old, at the exact time god said she would. abraham named their son isaac. abraham circumcised him when isaac was eight days old, following god's command. abraham was 100 when isaac was born. sarah declared, god has made me laugh, and all those who hear about this will laugh with me. she also said, would anyone have announced to abraham that sarah was going to have children to nurse? but now i have had a son for abraham even when he was old!
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua hia sara mèngi-nale madhutu lii pajaji na. lod'o sara dènge babia, abraham dhu heka le. ropa sara nara iisi, umur abraham d'ai cangasu tèu kèna. lod'o sara d'ai hèru, ka nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka abraham pangare ne, isak dhu sasoa na ‘na mari'. sara peka hèi, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua tao ja'a mari, lula ja'a karej'e. dhèu ae ka dhu pangee na, ja'a ètu d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne, abhu heka ana. masi ka dhèu èmu ja'a heka bhoro le, te ja'a bisa kora iisi ana hia ne. èèna na, ladhe dhèu tadèngi j'ara ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mari kahèi dènge ja'a ne. ropa isak d'ai aru lod'o, abraham suna ne, madhutu paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: the baby grew up, and on the day isaac was weaned abraham held a large feast.
target_text: isak kapai ka noo-noo. ropa oe d'ai lod'o luri susu, abraham tao tatao aae.

source_text: but sarah noticed that ishmael, hagar the egyptian's son she'd had for abraham, was making fun of isaac. so she went to abraham and told him, you have to get rid of this slave woman and this son of hers! a slave woman's son is not going to be one of your heirs and inherit together with my son isaac!
target_text: ca tèke, sara ladhe nèdhi ismael, ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri abraham, padadisi dènge isak. ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, sara peka dènge dhèu èmu na, bège eele ènu masir nèi dènge ana na! te, ja'a ko'o boe ana ènu èèna unu pusaka, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka. dhoka ana ja'a isak di, dhu abhu sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: abraham felt very bad about it because ishmael was his son.
target_text: ropa abraham tadèngi lii padhai sara ne, ka d'ara na ako be'a boe, lula ismael ne, ana d'èlu na kahèi.

source_text: but god told abraham, don't feel bad about the boy and the slave woman. do whatever sarah tells you, because it's through isaac that your descendants will be counted.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua lii dènge abraham, peka na, abraham! èu baku ngee pa'ae dhèu èmu limuri èu, dènge ana na. madhutu la dad'èi sara ne, lula bèli-camèd'a, èu abhu ana-èpu dhu ja'a moa tèke èèna, nèti isak ne'e ka.

source_text: don't worry-i will also make the son of the slave woman into a nation because he's your son.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a hia kahèi mèngi-nale mi ana nèti dhèu èmu limuri mu, lula nèngu ne, ana d'èlu èu kahèi. bèli-camèd'a, ana-èpu na j'aj'i suku èci kahèi.

source_text: abraham got up early the next morning. he packed up some food and a skin of water which he gave to hagar, putting them on her shoulder. then he sent her and the boy away. she left and wandered through the desert of beersheba.
target_text: bèli mad'ae aae èèna, abraham tao gee j'ara hia hagar, aa na kadhoe èi d'ara babo'i cue mi kabela-kao na. hèia na patabuli ka bhèni ne dènge ana na ismael, ho lasi. ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo dhu dètu dènge beer-syeba.

source_text: when the water ran out, she left the boy under one of the bushes.
target_text: ropa èle èi rinu ra, hagar tèke eele ana na ètu d'ara mamaho aj'u iiki ca kapua.

source_text: she went and sat down some way off, a few hundred yards away, saying, i can't bear to watch my son die! as she sat down she burst into tears.
target_text: ka na pangee ètu d'ara na, d'ara ja'a la'e boe, ladhe ja'a kèdhi mamadhe ana ja'a. ka na madhèdi ako kaj'èu nèti ana na, pe d'ai lèmi nguru meter sa. ka na tangi dènge lii roma iisi.

source_text: god heard the boy's cries, and the angel of god called to hagar from heaven and asked her, what's the matter, hagar? don't be afraid! god has heard the boy crying from where he is.
target_text: lula ama lamatua dhu tadèngi lii tangi ismael, ka ana pajuu na mai nèti sorga, ka paroa hagar, aku nèngu na, hagar! nga tao ka, èu j'èra ae sèmi ne'e ne? baku madha'u ia ka, te lamatua tadèngi le lii tangi ana èu.

source_text: get up, go over and help the boy up, and encourage him, for i will make him into a great nation.
target_text: de kèd'i lamu more ana nèi. pa'èra d'ara na, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'aj'i ana-èpu na, suku èci dhu kapai.

source_text: god opened her eyes and she saw a well nearby. she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
target_text: ka ama lamatua pasaraa musi madha na. cag'ag'a laa nèdhi dènge, èi ca madha ètu era èèna. hèia la'e soli èi asa d'ara babo'i, ka na panginu ana na ismael.

source_text: god blessed ishmael and he grew up, living in the desert. he became a skilled archer. he lived in the desert of paran. his mother chose a wife for him from the land of egypt.
target_text: ka ismael dènge ina na hagar pea dènge ka ètu d'ara mamoo paran. ismael asa na kapai, aa ne'a mèu kataki. ka ina na paleo ne dènge ana bhèni masir ca dhèu. se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua bera-bera dènge ismael.

source_text: around this time abimelech came with phicol, the commander of his army, to see abraham. god blesses you in everything you do, abimelech said.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae abimelek dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na, fikol, mai pangad'o dènge abraham. hèia dhèu aae padhai lii, ka na peka, abraham! ji'i se nge'a ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èu. nèti èèna ka, sad'i èu ad'u ngaa sa èci, j'aj'i dènge be'a.

source_text: so swear to me right here and now that you won't betray me, my children, or my descendants. in the same way i've proved i'm trustworthy to you, do the same to me and my country where you're currently living.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka èu subha ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, dhu peka na, èu bisa boe kapod'e-kabèli ja'a, dènge ana-èpu ja'a aa'i-aa'i ra. sèmi dhu ja'a tao le be'a mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao be'a kahèi mi ja'a dènge kabarai ja'a.

source_text: i so swear, abraham replied.
target_text: ka aku abraham na, ooo! ja'a subha.

source_text: then abraham raised an issue with abimelech of a well that abimelech's servants had taken by force.
target_text: te ngaa èle èèna ka, abraham lapor dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu ama dhèu aae parame rare èi ja'a ca madha.

source_text: i don't know who did this, and you didn't mention it before. i haven't heard anything about it until today, abimelech responded.
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia na peka, waa! ja'a heka tadèngi kèna j'ara ne'e ne. tasamia ka karèi nèti ca hari ni, èu peka boe dènge ja'a? ja'a dhae ke'a mèka, ne'e ne tatao cee ka ne.

source_text: then abraham gave abimelech some of his sheep and cattle, and the two of them made an agreement. abraham also separated out seven female lambs from the flock.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham dènge abimelek pa'èki lii pajaji. ka abraham hia abimelek sapi dènge kahib'i-kalèbho. èle èèna ka, abraham hag'e nare hari kahib'i-kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u.

source_text: what are these seven female lambs for that you've separated from the flock? abimelech asked.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tao sèmi èèna?

source_text: i'm giving you these seven female lambs in return for your admission that i dug this well, abraham replied.
target_text: ka abraham peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. sèmi la kalèbho èni pidhu ngi'u se, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha dhu ama peka le na, ja'a ka dhu kèi èi na.

source_text: that's why he called the place beersheba, because the two of them swore an oath to each other.
target_text: lula dua ra dhu pa'èki le soo-subha ètu èèna, ka era na ra pangare na beer-syeba dhu sasoa na, ‘madha èi soo-subha'.

source_text: after making the agreement at beersheba, abimelech and phicol the commander of his army left and went home to the country of the philistines.
target_text: ropa pasubha èle, ka dhèu aae dènge kètu kapai sordad'u na lèpa ka, asa era rèngu, rai dhèu pilistin.

source_text: abraham planted a tamarisk tree in beersheba and there he worshiped the lord, the eternal god.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abraham sèle aj'u tamareska ca kapua ètu beer syeba. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, aj'u ne pasanèd'e abraham, lula ètu era èèna ka, nèngu mangaj'i lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: abraham lived in the country of the philistines for a long time.
target_text: ka abraham pea dènge ka ètu talora dhèu pilistin sèmi dhèu tao mai.

source_text: sometime later god tested abraham. he called out to him, abraham! i'm here, abraham replied.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia lamatua sèku neo ne'a d'ara abraham. neo ne'a abraham madhutu lamatua, do aad'o. ka lamatua paroa ne, aku nèngu na, abraham! hèia na dhaa, peka na, ooo, lamatua.

source_text: god told him, go with your son, your only son, the one you love, to the land of moriah and sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains that i'll tell you about.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, mu nanene paie-iie! more ana pasue èu mone mesa na. mèti ne asa rai moria, ho tao ne j'aj'i korban tunu hia ja'a. pe d'ai nèi, ja'a heka paj'uj'u era dhu ètu ledhe èci.

source_text: abraham got up early in the morning and saddled up his donkey. he took two servants and isaac with him and went to cut firewood for the burnt offering. then he left with them to go to the place god had told him about.
target_text: d'ai bèli mad'ae aae na, abraham sèg'i aj'u sèna ka tao kadhèna. na èki, ka na hue asa dedha keled'ei. ka dua ra dènge isak, aa dènge dhèu sab'a na dhèu dua, pakèd'i asa era dhu lamatua peka dènge ne.

source_text: after traveling for three days abraham could see the place in the distance.
target_text: ra kako taruu, ka d'ai camèd'a èèna, abraham nèdhi le era èèna nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: he told his servants, wait here with the donkey while i go with the boy and worship god. then we'll return.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge dhèu dua sèra, aku nèngu na, dua mi mate taha mi ne'e dènge keled'ei ne. ja'a dènge ana ja'a la'a asa dedha nèi, ho mangaj'i ama lamatua. ladhe èle na, ji'i lèpa hari mai.

source_text: abraham had isaac carry the wood for the burnt offering, while he carried the fire and the knife, and they walked up together.

source_text: so the man went home with him. laban unloaded the camels and gave them straw and food to eat. he also provided water for the man to wash his feet, as well as for the men who were with him.
target_text: hèia dhèu sab'a abraham ne, madhutu dènge ka laban, lasi èmu betuel. ka laban si papuru mèdha-panyau nèti dedha onta se. èle èèna ka, ra panga'a onta se. rèti èi, hia dhèu sab'a dènge anga na se, ho rase haga.

source_text: then laban had food brought in. but the man told him, i'm not going to eat until i've explained why i'm here. please explain, laban replied.
target_text: ropa lalau rare nganga'a-nginu ètu dedha mei, dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ji'i neo nga'a ne, te ngaa ja'a lole uuru ku, mamai ja'a ne. ka laban dhaa, peka na, ama, mu padhai lii ngaa, na peka ka laa.

source_text: i'm abraham's servant, the man began.
target_text: hèia dhèu èèna peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu sab'a nèti baki miu abraham.

source_text: the lord has blessed my master so much, and now he is a wealthy and powerful man. the lord has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
target_text: lamatua hia abraham, lamatua ja'a èèna, mèngi-nale ae titu kèna, ka na kaja-su'i. lamatua pala-bagi ne doi hualaa pudhi dènge hualaa iia; ènu dhèu bhèni dènge dhèu mone, dènge badha-manu ae-ae, sèmi: sapi, onta, keled'ei, kahib'i-ka'ia, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: his wife sarah has had a son for my master even in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.
target_text: lod'o lamatua ja'a se, bhèni-mone d'ai heka ku, ka sara nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu aa'i pusaka ama na.

source_text: my master made me swear an oath, saying, ‘you must not arrange for my son to marry any daughter of the canaanite people in whose land i'm living.
target_text: ka abraham pua ja'a subha, peka na, ‘mage èu more ana bhèni kana'an kahèi, ho paleo dènge ana ja'a, isak.

source_text: instead, go to my family home where my relatives live, and find a wife there for my son isaac. '
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i more ana bhèni nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. '

source_text: i said to my master, ‘what if the woman refuses to come back with me? '
target_text: hèia ja'a karèi ne, aku ja'a na, ‘tasamia, ladhe ana bhèni ne, no'o boe madhutu ja'a mai sa ne'e? '

source_text: he told me, ‘the lord, in whose presence i have lived my life, will send his angel with you, and he will make your journey successful-you will find a wife for my son from my relatives, from my father's family.
target_text: ka na peka, ‘lamatua dhu ja'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na paleha ana pajuu na nèti sorga, mai bhoke j'ara hia èu, sèna ka èu abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu nèti a'ari ja'a unu ku, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana ja'a.

source_text: you will be released from the oath you swear to me if, when you go to my family, they refuse to let her return with you. '
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'ari ja'a se'e ro'o boe ana bhèni na mai asa ne'e, lii subha na lèke boe mi dedha èu ne. '

source_text: today when i arrived at the spring, i prayed, lord, god of my master abraham, please let the journey i have taken be successful.
target_text: ka deo na, ropa ja'a d'ai madha èi èèna, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara, peka na, ‘lamatua nèti lamatua ja'a abraham. bhoke ku j'ara hia ja'a, sèna ka mamai ja'a ne dènge kab'ua. ho sèna ka ja'a abhu ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak.

source_text: look, i'm standing here beside this spring. may it happen like this. if a young woman comes to get water, and i say, ‘please give me a few sips of water to drink, '
target_text: lamatua, ja'a titu ètu sebhe madha èi ne. aa ana bhèni-ana bhèni nèti d'ara kota ne mai rara èi ètu ne'e. de ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a peka dènge ana bhèni èci, aku ja'a na, ana, ee! papuru ku èru èi èu, ho ja'a kinu èi ciki.

source_text: and she says to me, ‘please drink, and i'll get water for your camels too' -may she be the one you've chosen as a wife for your servant isaac.
target_text: ho ladhe na dhaa na, oo. minu! aa èle na, ja'a panginu badha ama se kahèi! ladhe j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii ja'a ne, na èèna ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, ana bhèni ne ka dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nare hia ana lamatua ja'a. '

source_text: i hadn't even finished praying silently when i saw rebekah coming to get water, carrying her water jar on her shoulder. she went down to the spring to get water, and i said to her, ‘please give me a drink. '
target_text: ja'a dhu dhae èle mèka manèngi-mangaj'i, te ribka dhu nare le era èèna nèti dènge èru èi na. ropa na ca'e mai nèti d'ara èi, ja'a lii dènge ne, aku ja'a na, ‘ana, ee! hia ku ja'a kinu èi ciki. '

source_text: she quickly lifted the jar down from her shoulder and she said, ‘please drink, and i'll get water for your camels too. ' so i drank, and she got water for the camels.
target_text: ka na papuru dènge ka èru èi na, ka na peka, ‘oo. minu! aa pe ja'a panginu onta ama se kahèi. ' hèia ja'a kinu, aa onta ja'a se oo rinu kahèi.

source_text: i asked her, ‘whose daughter are you? ' she replied, ‘i'm the daughter of bethuel, the son of milcah and nahor. ' so i put the ring in her nose, and the bracelets on her wrists.
target_text: ka ja'a karèi ne, ‘ama mu, ngara na cee? ' ka na dhaa, peka na, ‘ama ku, ngara na betuel. aa baki ku, ngara na nahor. dènge ngara bèi ku, milka. ' hèia ja'a papake ne kadheli mi sahènga na, dènge pasaluu kanau hualaa ca pasa mi ai kariu dènge ai g'ana na.

source_text: then i kneeled down and bowed in worship to the lord. i thanked the lord, the god of my master abraham, for he led me directly to find my master's niece for his son.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a pacud'u kètu ho mangaj'i mi lamatua, ka ja'a peka na, ‘koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a paraga le dènge a'ari lamatua ja'a abraham ètu era ne'e ne. aa paraga le kahèi dènge ana bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak! '

source_text: so please tell me now, will you show commitment and faithfulness to my master? please tell me yes or no so i can decide what to do next.
target_text: de ne'e ne, ladhe ama si neo pad'elo sasue mi lamatua ja'a abraham, na mi peka pamèu dènge ja'a. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, peka la mola-mola dènge ja'a. ho ja'a ke'a, sèna ka tao hari ngaa.

source_text: laban and bethuel replied, clearly all this is from the lord, so we can't argue one way or the other.
target_text: ropa dhèu sab'a ne padhai lii nare, ka laban dènge betuel dhaa, aku rèngu na, ladhe lamatua dhu ad'u nare le madha j'ara ne, ji'i peka lii ngaa hari.

source_text: rebekah's here, you can take her and leave. she can become the wife of your master's son, as the lord has decided.
target_text: ribka ka ne'e ne. more ho mèti, sèna ka na j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu ana abraham, madhutu sèmi dhu lamatua ator èèna.

source_text: as soon as abraham's servant heard their decision, he bowed down in worship to the lord.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi nare, dhèu sab'a ne pacud'u kètu d'ai rai, ka na manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: then he unpacked silver and gold jewelry and expensive clothes and gave them to rebekah. he also gave valuable presents to her brother and her mother.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nare mèdha nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi sèra, dènge mèdha-papake dhu saraga, ka na hia mi ribka. aa na hia kahèi mi ana mone na dènge ina na, mèdha-mèdha dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: he and the men with him ate and drank, and spent the night there. when they got up in the morning, he said, let me leave now and go home to my master.
target_text: èle aa'i ka, heka dhèu sab'a ne dènge anga na madhèdi ra'a-rinu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra j'unu ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, dhèu sab'a ne palangu lii dènge lamatua èmu se, aku nèngu na, hia ka ja'a ho lèpa la asa lamatua ja'a abraham.

source_text: but her brother and her mother said, let her stay with us for another ten days or so. she can leave after that.
target_text: te ngaa ana mone dènge ina ana bhèni na, peka na, te neo hari lèpa lai-lai, tao ngaa ne? hud'i ribka pea hari ku dènge ji'i d'ai canguru lod'o sa laa ma, heka lami kèna.

source_text: please don't delay me, he told them. the lord has made my journey successful, so let me leave and go back to my master.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a èèna dhaa, peka na, waa! baku kai ja'a! te lamatua sue le ja'a, ka toke ja'a rage le bhèni dhu èèna na j'aj'i dhèu èmu isak. de patabuli ka ji'i se, la'a peka ku dènge lamatua ji'i abraham.

source_text: let's call rebekah and find out what she wants to do, they suggested.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka laa! mai ti karèi ribka, sèna ka te'a dad'èi na tasa mera mia?

source_text: they called rebekah in and asked her, do you want to go with this man now? yes, i'll go, she replied.
target_text: hèia ra paroa ne, aku rèngu na, ribka! di aku èu kèna. èu neo lamu dènge ka dènge dhèu ne'e do, tasamia? ka ribka dhaa, peka na, ja'a ko'o.

source_text: so they let laban's sister rebekah leave with abraham's servant and his men, together with the woman who had nursed her as a child. they asked a blessing on her, saying, our dear sister, may you become the mother to thousands and thousands of descendants, and may they conquer their enemies.
target_text: hèia ra hia ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru ne karèi nèti ana iiki ka, ho lasi palere dènge dhèu sab'a abraham sèra. ka ra hia ribka mèngi-nale, aku rèngu na, ji'i sanao-maena sèna ka ama lamatua hia èu mora iisi ana ae-ae, ho ana-èpu mu d'ai riho-kehi. aa ji'i sanao kahèi, sèna ka ana-èpu èu sèra segi aa'i musu rèngu sèra!

source_text: then rebekah and her servant girls got on the camels. they followed abraham's servant and left.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ribka dènge bhèni dhu leru nèngu na lalau ka mèdha ra, ka ra ca'e onta, pakèd'i dènge ka, madhutu dhèu sab'a abraham sèra.

source_text: meanwhile isaac, who was living in the negev, had just come back from beer-lahai-roi.
target_text: isak pea ètu rai negeb. lod'o èèna, na heka lèpa kèna nèti madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: he went out into the fields one evening to think things over. he looked into the distance and saw camels coming.
target_text: d'ara lod'o nihia ca lod'o, na kalua nèti d'ara paleo na, la'e pasiar ciki. ropa na boti kètu, na ladhe laa na onta-onta kako mai asa era nèngu na.

source_text: rebekah was also keeping a look out. when she saw isaac, she got down from her camel.
target_text: ropa ribka ladhe nèdhi isak, hèia na puru lai-lai nèti dedha onta.

source_text: she asked the servant, who is this walking through the fields to meet us? he's my master, isaac, he replied. so she put on her veil to cover herself.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu sab'a abraham, aku nèngu na, dhèu mone cee ka mai nèi? ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu na, ana lamatua ja'a kèna. hèia ribka nare salalu na, pa'abhe rèhu na.

source_text: the servant told isaac everything he'd done.
target_text: ka dhèu sab'a ne lolo dènge isak, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: isaac took rebekah into his mother sarah's tent, and he married her. he loved her, and she brought him comfort after his grief over his mother's death.
target_text: hèia isak todhe nèti ka ribka lasi asa d'ara paleo ina na, ka dua ra paleo ka èmu. lula isak sue seli eele ribka, ka na susa heka dènge mamadhe ina na.

source_text: abraham married another wife; her name was keturah.
target_text: ka abraham leo hari èmu dènge bhèni èci, ngara na ketura.

source_text: she had the following sons: zimran, jokshan, medan, midian, ishbak, and shuah.
target_text: hèia ketura matana ana hia ne. ana se, ngara ra: simran, yoksan, medan, midian, isbak, dènge sua.

source_text: jokshan was the father of sheba and dedan. the descendants of dedan were the asshurites, the letushites, and the leummites.
target_text: ana yoksan ka: seba dènge dedan. ana-èpu dedan nuka, dhèu asyur, dhèu letus, dènge dhèu leum.

source_text: the sons of midian were ephah, epher, hanoch, abida, and eldaah. these were all descendants of keturah.
target_text: ana midian ka: efa, efer, henok, abida dènge eldaa. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu ketura.

source_text: abraham left everything he owned to isaac. but while he was still alive, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them to live in the east, well away from isaac.
target_text: lod'o dhu abraham mamuri era, na hag'e nare le mèdha-panyau hia ana hagar dènge ana-ana ketura, èci-èci ka dènge unu na. èle èèna ka, abraham pua si lasi pea re bèka dhimu rai kana'an, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti ana na isak. ka pusaka na aa'i-aa'i, na pangèd'u mi ana na isak.

source_text: abraham lived to be 175 when he breathed his last and died at a good old age. he had lived a full life, and now he joined his forefathers in death.
target_text: lod'o umur abraham d'ai ca ngasu pidhu nguru lèmi tèu, na madhe.

source_text: his sons isaac and ishmael buried him in the cave of machpelah near mamre, in the field that had belonged to ephron, son of zohar, the hittite. this was the field abraham had bought from the hittites. abraham was buried there with his wife sarah.
target_text: ka ana na, isak dènge ismael, padhane ne ètu d'ara loe makpela, dhu padètu dènge mamre. rai ne, dhu uru èèna, abraham hèli nare nèti efron, ana sohar, dhèu het. ka dhu uru èèna, ra padhane le sara ètu d'ara loe èèna.

source_text: after abraham's death, god blessed his son isaac, who was living near beer-lahai-roi.
target_text: èle madha abraham, ka ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi isak, ka na mamuri mera-milu. lod'o èèna, isak pea dètu dènge madha èi beer lahai roi.

source_text: this is the genealogy of abraham's son ishmael. his mother hagar was sarah's egyptian slave.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri ismael. nèngu ne, ana abraham dènge dhèu èmu limuri na, hagar, dhu j'aj'i ènu sara nèti masir.

source_text: these were the names of the sons of ishmael according to their family genealogy: nebaioth firstborn, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, mishma, dumah, massa, hadad, tema, jetur, naphish, and kedemah. these were the sons of ishmael, and these became the names of the places where they lived and camped-the twelve family rulers of their tribes.
target_text: ana-ana ismael, mone dhèu canguru dua. ngara ra dhu madhutu nèti dhu uru tèka d'ai ana limuri tèka, nuka: nebayot, kedar, adbeel, mibsam, misma, duma, masa, hadad, tema, yetur, nafis, dènge kedma. ana-ana sèra ka, j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku, dhu èci-èci ka dènge kabarai ra. ra pangare kabarai ra èci-èci, madhutu ngara bèi-baki ra.

source_text: ishmael lived to be 137. then he breathed his last and died, and joined his forefathers in death.
target_text: ropa umur ismael d'ai cangasu tèlu nguru pidhu tèu, ka na madhe.

source_text: ishmael's descendants inhabited the region from havilah to shur, near the border of egypt in the direction of asshur. they were forever fighting with one other.
target_text: te ngaa ana-èpu na sèra, èci pamusu dènge èci. ka ra pea pahag'a, mulai nèti rai hawila d'ai rai syur, dhu palane dènge rai masir, toke d'ai rai asyur.

source_text: the following is the genealogy of abraham's son isaac. abraham was the father of isaac.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo nèti mamuri isak, ana abraham.

source_text: when isaac was 40 he married rebekah, the daughter of bethuel the aramean from paddan-aram and the sister of laban the aramean.
target_text: lod'o isak madhèdi dènge ribka, umur na èpa nguru tèu le. ama ribka, ngara na betuel. ana mone ribka, ngara na laban. rèngu se, dhèu aram, nèti padan aram.

source_text: isaac prayed to the lord for help on behalf of his wife because she couldn't have children. the lord answered his prayer and she became pregnant.
target_text: ribka dhu dènge mèka ana. nèti èèna ka, isak manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, sèna ka na bhoke era ana ribka. hèia lamatua tadèngi lii manèngi isak, ka ribka dènge babia.

source_text: the twin babies inside her struggled with each other. so she asked the lord, why is this happening to me?
target_text: te ngaa ana dhu ribka kad'o ne, dhèu dua. aa ana se paliku taruu ètu d'ara kabake ina ra. ka ribka ngee ka ètu d'ara na, nga tao ka ana dua se, sèmi ne'e? hèia na pakarèi dènge lamatua.

source_text: you have two nations inside you, the lord replied. you're going to give birth to two peoples who will compete against each other. one will be stronger than the other; the older one will be the servant of the younger one.
target_text: ka lamatua dhaa, peka na, ètu d'ara kabake èu na, abhu dua suku, dhu èèna na loe boe dènge pamusu. dhu limuri èra risi nèti dhu uru. ka a'a na, lalau-lalo'o ari na.

source_text: when the time came she gave birth to twins.
target_text: ropa lod'o d'ai, ribka nara iisi ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: the first baby to be born was red, and covered with hair like a coat. so they named him esau.
target_text: dhu a'a, isi na mea, dènge ngi'u na pènu dènge rèu. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, esau dhu sasoa na ‘dènge rèu'.

source_text: then his twin brother was born, holding on to esau's heel. so he was named jacob. isaac was 60 when they were born.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ari na heka kalua kèna. te ngaa dhu na kèpe hui tèdhu a'a na. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare ne, yakob dhu sasoa na ‘hui tèdhu'. lod'o ribka nara iisi ana na se, umur isak èna nguru tèu kèna.

source_text: the boys grew up and esau became a skilled hunter, at home in the countryside. jacob was quiet and liked to stay at home in the tents.
target_text: lod'o ana dua se kapai, esau dhu ne'a mèu kasiro badha hui. ae ka dhu na pea ètu d'ara j'ami. te ngaa yakob dhu mau-mau, dhu d'èi dhoka pea ètu d'ara èmu di.

source_text: isaac loved esau because he brought him tasty wild game to eat, while rebekah loved jacob.
