source_text: oholibamah had jeush, jalam, and korah. these were the sons of esau, who were born to him in canaan.
target_text: aa oholibama matana yeus, yalam dènge kora. ana esau aa'i-aa'i ra sèra rara iisi si ètu rai kana'an.

source_text: esau took his wives, sons and daughters, and everyone in his household, together with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the possessions he had gained while in canaan, and went to live in a country far away from his brother jacob.
target_text: ca tèka, esau pidha asa rai leo cue dhu kaj'èu nèti yakob. la'e nèti aa'i bhèni-ana niki, dhèu-dhèu sab'a, badha-manu, dènge mèdha-panyau na.

source_text: he did this because the land they were living in couldn't support both of them with all their livestock.
target_text: esau pacèri dènge yakob, lula badha-manu ra dènge mèdha-panyau ra ae d'ai seli. nèti èèna ka, era pea rèngu katata ètu rai èèna.

source_text: esau settled down in the hill country of seir.
target_text: hèia esau nuka edom la'e pea ètu ledhe ètu seir.

source_text: the following is the genealogy of esau, father of the edomites, who lived in the hill country of seir:
target_text: se'e se, ana-èpu esau dhu ra peka na ‘dhèu edom'. rèngu pea ètu era ledhe seir.

source_text: these were the names of esau's sons: eliphaz, son of esau's wife adah, and reuel, son of esau's wife basemath. the sons of eliphaz were: teman, omar, zepho, gatam, and kenaz. timna, the concubine of esau's son eliphaz, had amalek for eliphaz. these were the descendants of esau's wife adah. these were the sons of reuel: nahath, zerah, shammah, and mizzah. they were the descendants of esau's wife basemath.
target_text: ada, dhèu èmu esau, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na elifas. elifas ne, ana mone na, dhèu lèmi, nuka: teman, omar, sefo, gatam dènge kenas. dhèu èmu piara elifas, ngara na timna. nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na amalek. dhèu èmu esau, basmat, nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu, ngara na rehuel. rehuel abhu ana mone dhèu èpa, nuka: nahat, sera, syama, dènge misa.

source_text: these were the sons of esau's wife oholibamah, daughter of anah and granddaughter of zibeon, whom she had for esau: jeush, jalam, and korah.
target_text: dhèu èmu esau, oholibama, ana nèti anah, aa èpu nèti sibeon, nara iisi ana mone dhèu tèlu, nuka: yeus, yalam, dènge kora.

source_text: these were the tribal leaders of esau's sons. the tribal leaders of the sons of eliphaz esau's firstborn were teman, omar, zepho, kenaz, korah, gatam, and amalek. they were the tribal leaders of eliphaz in the country of edom, and they were the descendants of adah.
target_text: ana-èpu esau se pahag'a lème, ka j'aj'i mi suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku ra. ana-ana elifas, dhu ana uuru nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku teman, suku omar, suku sefo, suku kenas, suku kora, suku gatam dènge suku amalek. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e, ana-èpu nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na ada.

source_text: these were the sons of esau's son reuel: tribal leaders nahath, zerah, shammah, and mizzah. they were the tribal leaders descended from reuel in the country of edom, and they were the descendants of esau's wife basemath.
target_text: ana-ana rehuel, dhu ana nèti esau, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku nahat, suku sera, suku syama, dènge suku misa. aa'i-aa'i se, ana-èpu esau dènge dhèu èmu na, basmat.

source_text: these were the sons of esau's wife oholibamah: tribal leaders jeush, jalam, and korah. they were the tribal leaders descended from esau's wife oholibamah, daughter of anah.
target_text: ana-ana nèti esau dènge dhèu èmu na, oholibama, j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku yeus, suku yalam, dènge suku kora.

source_text: all these were the sons of esau also called edom, and they were their tribal leaders.
target_text: suku se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti ana-èpu esau.

source_text: these were the sons of seir the horite, who were living in the country: lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer, and dishan. they were the tribal leaders of the horites, the descendants of seir in the land of edom.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu hori èci, ngara na seir. ana-ana na pahag'a palème rai, ka j'aj'i suku ae-ae. èci-èci ka dènge kapala suku na. èle èèna ka, ana-ana na se j'aj'i kapala suku nèti suku lotan, suku sobal, suku sibeon, suku anah, suku dison, suku eser, dènge suku disan.

source_text: the sons of lotan were hori and hemam. timna was lotan's sister.
target_text: ana lotan nuka: hori dènge heman. ana hèni lotan, nuka timna.

source_text: these were the sons of shobal: alvan, manahath, ebal, shepho, and onam.
target_text: ana-ana sobal, nuka: alwan, manahat, ebal, sefo, dènge onam.

source_text: these were the sons of zibeon: aiah and anah. this was the anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was looking after the donkeys of his father zibeon.
target_text: ana-ana nèti sibeon, nuka: aya, dènge anah. anah ne'e ka dhu rage madha èi pana ètu d'ara mamoo, lod'o na madhenga keled'ei ama na.

source_text: these were the children of anah: dishon and oholibamah, daughter of anah. these were the sons of dishon: hemdan, eshban, ithran, and cheran.
target_text: ana bhèni nèti anah, nuka oholibama. aa ana mone na, nuka, dison. ana-ana dison, nuka: hemdan, esban, yitran, dènge keran.

source_text: these were the sons of ezer: bilhan, zaavan, and akan.
target_text: ana-ana eser, nuka: bilhan, saawan, dènge akan.

source_text: these were the sons of dishan: uz and aran.
target_text: ana-ana disan, nuka: us, dènge aran.

source_text: these were the tribal leaders of the horites: tribal leaders lotan, shobal, zibeon, anah, dishon, ezer, and dishan. they were the tribal leaders of the horites listed according to their tribes in the country of seir.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku nèti dhèu hori sèra, nuka: lotan, sobal, sibeon, anah, dison, eser, dènge disan. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se pea ètu rai seir.

source_text: these were the kings who ruled in the land of edom before there was any king who ruled over the israelites:
target_text: lod'o dhu kabarai isra'el dènge mèka dhèu aae, te ngaa ètu rai edom dènge le dhèu aae. ngara dhèu aae se, dhutu-dhutu, nuka:

source_text: bela, son of beor, ruled in edom and the name of his town was dinhabah.
target_text: ra ded'e bela, ana nèti beor, j'aj'i dhèu aae ètu kota dinhaba.

source_text: when bela died, jobab, son of zerah from bozrah, took over as king.
target_text: ropa bela madhe, ra ded'e yobab ho gati ne, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na sera, nèti rae bosra.

source_text: when jobab died, husham from the land of the temanites took over as king.
target_text: ropa yobab madhe, ra ded'e husam ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. husam ne, nèti rai dhèu teman.

source_text: when husham died, hadad, son of bedad, took over as king. he was the one who defeated the midianites in the country of moab, and the name of his town was avith.
target_text: ropa husam madhe, ra ded'e hadad ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na bedad, nèti rae awit. nèngu ka dhu segi dhèu midian, lod'o ra pamusu ètu moab.

source_text: when hadad died, samlah from masrekah took over as king.
target_text: ropa hadad madhe, ra ded'e samla ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. nèngu ne, nèti rae masreka.

source_text: when samlah died, shaul from rehoboth on the euphrates took over as king.
target_text: ropa samla madhe, ra ded'e saul ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. saul èèna, nèti rae rehobot, dhu ètu sebhe loko.

source_text: when shaul died, baal-hanan, son of achbor, took over as king.
target_text: ropa saul madhe, ra ded'e baal-hanan ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. ama na, ngara na akbor.

source_text: when baal-hanan, son of achbor, died, hadad took over as king. the name of his town was pau, and his wife's name was mehetabel, daughter of matred, daughter of me-zahab.
target_text: ropa baal-hanan madhe, ra ded'e hadar ho gati na, j'aj'i dhèu aae. hadar ne, nèti rae pau. aa dhèu èmu na, ngara mehetabel. ama mehetabel, ngara na matret. aa baki na, mesahab.

source_text: these were the names of the tribal leaders descended from esau, according to their families and where they lived, listed by name: tribal leaders timna, alvah, jetheth, oholibamah, elah, pinon, kenaz, teman, mibzar, magdiel, and iram. these were the tribal leaders of edom, listed according to the places where they lived in the country. esau was the ancestor of the edomites.
target_text: de kapala-kapala suku dhu j'aj'i nèti ana-èpu esau, nuka: timna, alwa, yetet, oholibama, ela, pinon, kenas, teman, mibsar, magdiel, dènge iram. rèngu se èci-èci pangare rai ra madhutu ngara rèngu unu ra. de aa'i-aa'i se'e, lii lolo nèti ana-èpu esau, dhèu edom èèna.

source_text: jacob settled down and lived in canaan as his father had done.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lole nèti yakob si. ca tèka ka, yakob la'e pea hari asa rai kana'an. èèna, era pea ama na isak nèti uru ka.

source_text: this is the story of jacob and his family. joseph was seventeen, and helped look after the flock with his brothers, the sons of bilhah and zilpah, his father's wives. joseph told his father about some of the bad things his brothers were doing.
target_text: tèu èèna, ana yakob èci, nèti dhèu èmu na rahel, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne'e, ropa umur na d'ai canguru pidhu tèu, nèngu dènge a'a na si, tema le j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho rèngu. a'a na sèra, ana nèti ina leo hari, ngara na bilha dènge silpa. te ngaa yusuf ne'e tuka tenge lii mi dedha a'a na si, ho la'e pana'e ama na.

source_text: israel loved joseph more than any of his other sons, because joseph had been born to him when he was already old. he made a colorful robe with long sleeves for joseph.
target_text: lod'o dhu rara iisi yusuf na, ama na dhu heka le. nèti èèna ka, na sue yusuf ne risi eele nèti ana-ana na leo sèra. ca lod'o ka, yakob j'au kodho madhera èci dhu saraga bia hia yusuf.

source_text: when his brothers noticed that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and had nothing good to say about him.
target_text: ropa a'a na si ladhe-ladhe la'a na ama na sue risi yusuf, hèia ra mulai tèka d'ara dènge ne, ro'o boe padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: joseph had a dream, and when he told his brothers about it, they hated him even more. listen to this dream i had, he told them. we were tying up bundles of grain out in the fields when all of a sudden my bundle stood up, and your bundles came over and bowed down to it.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka yusuf nii. kèd'i nèti bhèj'i ka, na lolo dènge a'a na si lii nii deo na, aku nèngu na, we! mi nanene ku la! ja'a nii, na èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, èki are ètu d'ara oka. kabèdhi laa, are dhu ja'a èki titu dhoo-dhoo. te ngaa are miu, oke mere are ja'a deo na, ka pacud'u mi unu ja'a. ra nanene rare sèmi èèna, hèia a'a na se'e tabha nasa hari dènge ne.

source_text: do you really think you're going to be our king? they asked. do you honestly believe you're going to rule over us? they hated him even more because of his dream and how he described it.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, we! èu ngee na, èu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai kèna, ho neo paredha ji'i, do? taga na lolo lii nii ne'e, hèia asa ra nasa dènge ne.

source_text: then he had another dream and told his brothers about it. listen, i had another dream, he explained. the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down before me.
target_text: nèbhu boe, yusuf nii hari ca tèka. na lolo hari dènge a'a na si, aku nèngu na, we! ja'a nii hari, sèmi ne'e ka. ja'a kèdhi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu canguru èci. aa'i-aa'i sèra, pahaha iisi mi ja'a.

source_text: he also told his father as well as his brothers, and his father told him off, saying, what's this dream that you've had? are we-i and your mother and brothers-really going to come and bow down to the ground before you?
target_text: hèia yusuf lolo hari lii nii deo na dènge ama na, aa dènge a'a na sèra. ka ama na jèke ne, aku nèngu na, lii nii ngaa, kèna! èu ngee na, ja'a dènge ina mu, dènge a'ari èu sèra, mai uu kabaj'èla èu, do? èu nia ae le èèna, nga!

source_text: joseph's brothers became jealous of him, but his father puzzled over the meaning of the dream.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, a'a na sèra tèka d'ara bia dènge ne. te ngaa ama na pangee taruu lii nii èèna ètu d'ara na.

source_text: one day joseph's brothers took their father's flocks to graze near shechem.
target_text: ca tèka ka, a'a yusuf sèra rèti kahib'i-kalèbho ama na, asa era j'u'u dètu dènge rae sikem.

source_text: israel told joseph, your brothers are looking after the sheep near shechem. get ready because i want you to go and see them. i'll do it, joseph replied.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ama na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, a'a mu si j'aga kahib'i-kalèbho dètu dènge sikem. de èu pa'èra, ho lamu ladhe ku si la. ka yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku, ama.

source_text: so he told him, off you go and see how your brothers and the flocks are doing, and come back and let me know. so he sent him off. joseph set out from the hebron valley,
target_text: hèia ama na peka hari, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ladhe a'a mu si, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho èdhi. ladhe ra samia na, mai peka dènge ja'a. ka yusuf pakèd'i ka nèti d'ara pad'a hebron, la'e taruu d'ai sikem.

source_text: and arrived in shechem. a man there found him wandering about in the field, so he asked him, what are you looking for?
target_text: d'ai nèi, na tenge a'a na si, palème d'ara pad'a èèna. na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ka dhèu èèna karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu tenge ngaa?

source_text: i'm looking for my brothers, joseph replied. can you please tell me where they're looking after the flock?
target_text: yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a tenge a'a ja'a. rèngu eo kahib'i-kalèbho dètu ètu era ne'e. de ama, èu paraga dènge si, do aad'o?

source_text: they've already left, the man replied. i heard them say, ‘let's go to dothan. ' so joseph followed his brothers and caught up with them at dothan.
target_text: hèia, dhèu deo na peka, aku nèngu na, ra aad'o heka ètu ne'e. te ja'a tadèngi, ra peka na lasi padètu dènge rae dotan. hèia yusuf la'e taruu, ka paraga dènge si ètu rae dotan.

source_text: but they saw him coming way off in the distance, and before he got to them, they made plans to kill him.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi yusuf nèti kaj'èu, ra padhue rare lii èci neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: look, here comes the lord of dreams! they said to each other.
target_text: èci peka dènge èci, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku la! mone eele tuka nii na, nuka mai nèi!

source_text: come on, let's kill him and throw him into one of the pits. we'll say that some wild animal has eaten him. then we'll see what happens to his dreams!
target_text: de mai ho ti pamadhe ne. ho èèna na, ti core eele ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna. ladhe d'ai èmu na, ti peka dènge ama peka na, badha hui ra'e ne. ho èèna na, ti ladhe sèku, lii nii na sèra sa mia!

source_text: when reuben heard all this, he tried to save joseph from them.
target_text: ropa nanene èèna, hèia a'a na ruben tenge j'ara ho patabuli eele yusuf. hèia na kai ari na si, aku nèngu na, we! èdhi baku pamadhe ne!

source_text: let's not attack and kill him, he suggested. don't murder him, just throw him into this pit here in the desert. you don't need to be guilty of violence. reuben said this so that he could come back later and rescue joseph from them and take him home to his father.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi kèpe ne, ti tao asa d'ara madha èi madhe nèi. ètu èèna, era dhu dhèu aad'o, de èci sa rèdhi boe ne. sad'i baku pasuti raa na. na peka sèmi èèna, lula na tenge j'ara ho patalale yusuf, ho hia na lèpa hari èmu.

source_text: so when joseph arrived, his brothers ripped off his robe-the colorful long-sleeved robe he was wearing-
target_text: ropa yusuf d'ai madha a'a na si, ra kèpe ne, ka ra rèbhi eele kodho dhu saraga aae ètu ua na.

source_text: grabbed him and threw him into a pit. the pit was empty-it didn't have any water in it.
target_text: ka ra nuni pa'oro ne, hèia ra tule ne asa d'ara madha èi madhe èèna.

source_text: they were just sitting down to have a meal when they saw a caravan of ishmaelites coming from gilead. their camels were carrying aromatic spices, balm, and myrrh to take to egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lèpa, lasi ra'a-rinu. ètu talora ra'a-rinu, kabèdhi la ra ladhe rèdhi dhèu canau mai re èèna. dhèu sèra kako rèti dènge badha onta ra, hue dènge mèdha d'aga, sèmi raa aj'u hèu mèngi, bubhu-bubhu dènge èi na'i rupa-rupa. dhèu sèra sa, dhèu ismael, dhu mai nèti rae gilead neo lasi kaj'èu d'ai masir.

source_text: what's the point of killing our brother? judah asked his brothers. then we'd have to cover up his death!
target_text: èle èèna hèia, yahuda peka dènge a'ari na sèra, aku nèngu na, ee! be'a risi sèmi ne'e. èdhi baku pamadhe ne. a'oto na ngaa? tasa mera mia èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe pahuni raa na.

source_text: instead, why don't we sell him to these ishmaelites? we don't have to kill him. after all he's our brother, our own flesh and blood. his brothers agreed.
target_text: be'a risi èdhi pahie ne dènge dhèu ismael sèi. èdhi tao ne samia èèna ka oo, nèngu ne'e ari d'èlu èdhi. nèti èèna ka, baku èdhi pamadhe ne! aa'i-aa'i ra d'èi kahèi dènge lii yahuda èèna.

source_text: so when the ishmaelites who were traders from midian came by, they pulled joseph out of the pit and sold him to them for twenty pieces of silver. the ishmaelites took him to egypt.
target_text: ropa dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai era èèna, hèia a'a yusuf sèra lasi ère rare ne, nèti d'ara madha èi madhe deo na. ka ra pahie ne mi dhèu ismael sèra dènge kab'ua dua nguru bua doi pudhi. ka dhèu ismael sèra rèti yusuf asa rai masir.

source_text: when reuben came back later and looked into the pit, joseph was gone. he tore his clothes in grief.
target_text: lod'o ra pahie yusuf ne, ruben ne'a boe. ropa na la'e patigi sa d'ara madha èi madhe na, capa na kabèdhi, ladhe la'a na yusuf aad'o heka ètu d'ara. nèti èèna ka, na ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, lula d'ara na pèd'a ae titu kèna.

source_text: he returned to his brothers. the boy's gone! he moaned. what am i going to do now?
target_text: hèia na la'e sa ari na si, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ari èdhi aad'o heka ètu era èèna! ja'a tao samia hari?

source_text: they slaughtered a goat and dipped joseph's robe in the blood.
target_text: hèia ra roro kahib'i ci'u, ka rare kodho yusuf dhu saraga aae èèna, cèb'u sa d'ara raa kahib'i deo na.

source_text: then they sent the colorful robe to their father with the message, we found this. please examine it and see if it's your son's robe or not.
target_text: hèia ra lèpa ka rèti dènge kodho deo na, pad'elo dènge ama na, ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i pili ngare kodho ne'e. ama ku ladhe sèku la. tao-tao ne'e kodho ari ji'i yusuf.

source_text: his father recognized it right away and said, this is my son's robe! some wild animal must have eaten him. poor joseph has been ripped to pieces, no doubt about it!
target_text: ropa nèdhi kodho deo na, yakob tadhe dènge. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ne'e kodho ana ja'a. èle boe badha hui ra'e ana ja'a. ira iiii! ana ja'a madhe le!

source_text: jacob tore his clothes in grief and dressed in sackcloth. he mourned the death of his son for a long time.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yakob ciu pamae kodho ètu ngi'u na, ka na pake karo, taga nèti d'ara na susa titu kèna. na tangi lii ooi-ooi sène nare lod'o nèbhu aae.

source_text: all his sons and daughters tried to console him, but he rejected their attempts. no, he said, i will go down into my grave mourning for my son. so joseph's father went on weeping for him.
target_text: ana na, ana mone dènge ana bhèni sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mai padhai lii pakarej'e d'ara ama ra, te ngaa tao rare boe ne. aku nèngu na, aad'o! sasusa ja'a ne bisa d'ai madhe kèti. te ja'a bisa boe bhèlu ana èci ne'e. mema d'ara yakob j'èra taruu, lula na ngee nèdhi ana na yusuf dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: in the meantime the ishmaelites had arrived in egypt and had sold joseph to potiphar. potiphar was one of pharaoh's officers, the captain of the guard.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu yakob ètu d'ara susa era, dhèu d'aga sèra d'ai le masir. d'ai nèi, ka lasi pahie eele yusuf dènge dhèu kapai èci ètu nèi, ngara na potifar. dhèu ne'e komedhaa j'aga nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: around this time, judah left his brothers and set up his tents at adullam, near to a local man named hirah.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yahuda tèke eele a'ari na, ka la'e pea dènge angalai na èci, ngara na hira, ètu rae adulam.

source_text: there judah happened to see the daughter of a canaanite man named shua and married her. he slept with her,
target_text: ètu èèna, dhèu mone èci, dhèu kana'an, ngara na sua. yahuda d'èi ana bhèni na èci, ka nare j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. dhèu èmu yahuda ne'e nara iisi ana mone pagod'o-pagod'o dhèu pèri-pèri.

source_text: i was cruelly kidnapped from the land of the hebrews, and now i'm here in this pit even though i've done nothing wrong.
target_text: te ja'a ne, madhutu madha j'ara na dhu mola, rèngu se rare ja'a dènge laka-seti, nèti rae dhèu ibrani. d'ai era ne'e, ja'a tao boe sasala ngaa èci sa. te ngaa rèngu pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho ne'e. rèngu tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa.

source_text: when the chief baker saw that the interpretation was positive, he said to joseph, i also had a dream. i had three baskets of cakes on my head.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sasoa nii ne'e be'a mi dedha angalai na, hèia dhèu èci dhu lalau roti na, lolo hari nii nèngu, peka na, ari yusuf. nii ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a tèd'u soe pagod'o-god'o tèlu.

source_text: in the top basket were all the cakes and pastries for pharaoh to eat, and the birds were eating them from the basket on my head.
target_text: ètu d'ara soe re dedha tèka na, pènu dènge koki dhèu aae, dhu rupa ae titu kèna. te ngaa manu-bhui lela mai ka ra'e aa'i koki d'ara soe dhu ètu kètu ja'a na.

source_text: this is the meaning, joseph told him. the three baskets represent three days.
target_text: ropa yusuf tadèngi nare, ka na dhaa, peka na, sasoa lii nii ama, sèmi ne'e ka: soe tèlu sèra, sama kahèi dènge tèlu lod'o.

source_text: in three days' time pharaoh will take you out of prison and hang you on a pole, and birds will eat your flesh.
target_text: d'ara tèlu lod'o ne, mu ladhe, te dhèu aae pua dhèu mai poro rare kètu èu. ho èèna na, ra kadhoe ngi'u aae èu ètu agarii. hèia manu-bhui tutu ra'e aa'i sisi èu.

source_text: three days later it happened to be pharaoh's birthday, and he arranged a banquet for all his officials. he had the chief cupbearer and the chief baker released from prison and brought there before his officials.
target_text: ropa d'ai tèlu lod'o, dhu lèke dènge lod'o hari jadi dhèu aae, na tao tatao dhu kapai hia dhèu kapai na aa'i-aa'i sèra. na paredha ho dhèu lasi kalua eele dhèu dua sèra nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: he gave the chief cupbearer his job back, and he returned to his duties of handing pharaoh his cup.
target_text: ka na hia hari mone dhu lalau dhua èi na, sab'e sasab'a nèngu uru na.

source_text: but he hanged the chief baker just as joseph had said when he interpreted their dreams.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu lalau roti dhèu aae èèna, ra poro eele kètu na, ka ra kadhoe ngi'u na, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yusuf peka dènge rèngu dua ra.

source_text: but the chief cupbearer didn't remember to say anything about joseph-in fact he forgot all about him.
target_text: te ngaa mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae ne, sanèd'e heka yusuf. na bhèlu eele lii moa yusuf.

source_text: a full two years later, pharaoh had a dream that he was standing beside the river nile.
target_text: pe d'ai dua tèu risi sa, hèia dhèu aae masir nii. na nii na, nèngu dhu titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: he saw seven cows coming up from the river. they looked well-fed and healthy as they grazed among the reeds.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, nèngu nèdhi sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia. ka'uri ra kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: then he saw another seven cows that came up behind them. they looked ugly and skinny as they stood beside the other cows on the bank of the nile.
target_text: nèbhu boe, sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo hari, kalua nèti d'ara loko deo na. ngi'u sapi sèra malaka-god'a. ra titu padètu dènge sapi kabèb'u sèra.

source_text: then the ugly, skinny cows ate the well-fed, healthy cows. then pharaoh woke up.
target_text: hèia sapi malaka pidhu ngi'u sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u sèra. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi, ka na marèi dènge.

source_text: pharaoh fell asleep again and had a second dream. seven heads of grain were growing on one stalk, ripe and healthy.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu aae bhèj'i luu hari. ka na nii hari ca tèka. lii nii na sèmi ne'e ka: nèngu ladhe nèdhi are pidhu huri dhu isi pènu, bhodho nèti laa are dhu sub'u.

source_text: then seven heads of grain grew up after them, thin and dried by the east wind.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nèdhi hari are pidhu huri dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae sène, lèke lai ngèlu dhu pana.

source_text: the seven thin and dried heads of grain swallowed up the ripe and healthy ones. then pharaoh woke up and realized he'd been dreaming.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o sèra, dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu deo sa. hèia dhèu aae kabèdhi ka nèti bhèj'i. heka nèngu ne'a kèna, nèngu dhu nii hari di.

source_text: the next morning pharaoh was worried by his dreams, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men in egypt. pharaoh told them about his dreams, but no one could interpret their meaning for him.
target_text: mad'ae aae èèna, d'ara isi na be'a boe. hèia, na paredha dhèu lasi paroa aa'i dhèu ai tadha dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu, ètu rai masir mai paraga dènge ne. ka na lolo lii nii na sèra dènge si. te ngaa dhèu èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii deo sa mi dhèu aae.

source_text: but then the chief cupbearer spoke up. today i've just remembered a bad mistake i've made, he explained.
target_text: ka mone dhu lalau dhua èi dhèu aae èèna, heka sanèd'e nèdhi yusuf kèna. hèia la'e peka dènge dhèu aae, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a mangaku sala.

source_text: your majesty was angry with some of your officials and you imprisoned me in the house of the commander of the guard, along with the chief baker.
target_text: uru èèna, dhu ama ku nasa dènge ja'a, dènge angalai ku èci na, ka pamaso ji'i asa d'ara bèdho,

source_text: we each had a dream. they were different dreams, each with its own meaning.
target_text: mèda ca lod'o ka, ji'i dua mi nii. èci-èci ka dènge nii na. aa sasoa nii se'e, sama boe kahèi.

source_text: a young hebrew was there with us, a slave of the commander of the guard. when we told him our dreams, he interpreted for us the meaning of our different dreams.
target_text: ètu d'ara bèdho na, abhu ana mone ibrani èci. kapala èmu bèdho nedhe ana mone ne, j'aj'i kapala urusan ho lalau ji'i. ji'i lolo lii nii ji'i dènge ne, ka na peka sasoa lii nii sèra dènge ji'i.

source_text: everything happened just as he said it would-i was given back my job and the baker was hanged.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama dhèu aae ded'e hari ja'a. aa angalai ja'a na, abhu huku madhe. se'e se j'aj'i sama sèmi ngaa dhu ana mone ibrani na peka.

source_text: pharaoh summoned joseph, and they quickly brought him from the prison. after he'd shaved and changed his clothes, he was presented to pharaoh.
target_text: nanene nare lii ne'e hèia, dhèu aae pua dhèu lasi lai-lai rare yusuf nèti d'ara bèdho mai. ka yusuf pamèu iisi na, aa na gati mèdha-papake na, ka na la'e paraga dènge dhèu aae.

source_text: pharaoh said to joseph, i had a dream, but no one can interpret its meaning. but i've heard that when someone tells you a dream you know how to interpret it.
target_text: ropa na d'ai madha hèia, dhèu aae peka, ja'a nii, te ngaa dhèu èci sa re'a boe sasoa lii nii sèra. te ngaa dhèu peka na èu me'a.

source_text: it's not me who can do this, joseph replied. but god will explain its meaning to set your majesty's mind at rest.
target_text: hèia yusuf dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae. ja'a èèna ka oo, ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ne'a, ho na peka sasoa lii nii sa, dènge lèke. na neo peka lii dhu be'a mi ama dhèu aae.

source_text: pharaoh explained to joseph, in my dream i was standing on the bank of the nile.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae lolo ka, lii nii sèra dènge ne, aku nèngu na, ètu d'ara nii èèna, ja'a titu ètu sebhe loko nil.

source_text: i saw seven cows coming up from the river. they looked well-fed and healthy as they grazed among the reeds.
target_text: ja'a ladhe la'a na sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu kabèb'u bia, dènge ka'uri dhu kale'e. ra kalua nèti d'ara loko mai, ka ra'a j'u'u ètu sebhe loko èèna.

source_text: then i saw another seven cows that came up behind them. they looked sickly and ugly and skinny-i've never seen such ugly cows in the whole of egypt!
target_text: hèia sapi pidhu ngi'u dhu leo mai hari. rèngu se'e dhu malaka-god'a. ètu rai masir ne'e, ja'a kèdhi mèka sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: these skinny, ugly cows ate the first seven healthy-looking cows.
target_text: dhu pamalaa ja'a, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a sèra, kabèdhi laa dhèle aa'i pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u se.

source_text: but afterwards you couldn't tell they'd eaten them because they looked just as skinny and ugly as before. then i woke up.
target_text: sapi dhu malaka sèra dhèle aa'i, te ngaa ngi'u ra malaka taruu sèmi èèna ka. hèia ja'a kabèdhi dènge ka.

source_text: then i fell asleep again. in my second dream i saw seven heads of grain growing on one stalk, ripe and healthy.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a bhèj'i luu hari, ka nii hari ca tèka. ja'a kèdhi pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu, kalua nèti laa are ca kapua dhu sub'u.

source_text: then seven heads of grain grew up after them, withered and thin and dried by the east wind.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi hari, pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, aa dhu kamale dhae-dhae, lèke lai ngèlu pana.

source_text: the seven thin heads of grain swallowed up the healthy ones. i told all this to the magicians, but none of them could explain its meaning to me.
target_text: ka pidhu huri are dhu bèdhu sèra dhèle aa'i pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka ja'a lolo lii nii se'e mi dhèu d'èlu-mèu se'e, te ngaa èci sa bisa boe peka sasoa lii nii sèra.

source_text: pharaoh's dreams mean the same thing, joseph responded. god is telling pharaoh what he is going to do.
target_text: hèia yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama dhèu aae! lii nii dua sèra, sasoa na dhoka èci di. ama lamatua peka le, mi ama dhèu aae, ngaa dhu na neo tao.

source_text: the seven good cows and the seven good heads of grain represent seven good years of harvest. the dreams mean the same thing.
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: pidhu sapi dhu kabèb'u, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi pènu sèra, sasoa na, tèu dhu bècu-manèsa pidhu tèu. sasoa ra dhoka èci di.

source_text: the seven skinny and ugly cows that came after them and the seven thin heads of grain dried by the east wind represent seven years of famine.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, pidhu sapi dhu malaka-god'a, dènge pidhu huri are dhu isi aad'o, sasoa na, tèu manganga pidhu tèu.

source_text: it's just as i told your majesty-god has shown pharaoh what he is going to do.
target_text: de lamatua dhu peka mema le, ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. èèna sama kahèi, dènge ngaa dhu ja'a peka deo na.

source_text: there are going to be seven years with plenty of food produced throughout the whole country of egypt.
target_text: ladhe bèli-camèd'a, ètu rai masir ne'e, d'ara pidhu tèu, èdhi abhu bècu-manèsa palème rae.

source_text: but after them will come seven years of famine. people will forget the time when there was plenty of food throughout egypt. famine will ruin the country. the time of plenty will be completely forgotten because the famine that follows it will be so terrible.
target_text: èle èèna na, heka èdhi abhu manganga d'ara pidhu tèu. d'ara pidhu tèu na, manganga madèu aae. toke èdhi abhu boe nganga'a calamusi sa, ètu dedha rai masir ne'e. dhèu aa'i-aa'i manganga ae titu kèna, ka ra bhèlu eele uru na dhu rèngu abhu le babècu pidhu tèu.

source_text: the fact that the dream was repeated twice means that it has definitely been decided by god, and that god is going to do this soon.
target_text: de ladhe ama dhèu aae abhu nii dua hari, sasoa na, ama lamatua ka dhu ator tèke. nèbhu heka, ngaa dhu na ator ne, j'aj'i kèna.

source_text: so your majesty should choose a man with insight and wisdom, and put him in charge of the whole country of egypt.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèmi ne'e: be'a risi ama dhèu aae tenge dhèu d'èlu-mèu èci, dhu bisa tao ai-hèb'a la'a dènge be'a. aa ded'e ne, ho ladhe-leru kabarai ne'e dènge be'a.

source_text: your majesty should also appoint officials to be in charge of the land, and have them collect one-fifth of the produce of the country during the seven years of plenty.
target_text: d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu èèna, be'a risi ama dhèu aae ded'e hari dhèu, ho ra oru-pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele. nganga'a dhu risi sèra, bagi mi lèmi ho tèke ca pala.

source_text: they should collect all the food during the good years that are soon coming, and store the grain under pharaoh's authority, keeping it under guard to provide food for the towns.
target_text: ana kabarai ne'e, hud'i madhutu dènge be'a paredha ama dhèu aae, ho pakaboko are-are dhu risi eele, nèti rae-rae ètu rai masir ne'e. aa ra soli sa d'ara soka ho j'aga paie.

source_text: this will be a food reserve for the country during the seven years of famine so that the people won't die of starvation.
target_text: sèna ka pidhu tèu dhu manganga nèi mai te, èdhi dhu sadia le nganga'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èci sa madhe boe manganga.

source_text: pharaoh and all his officials thought joseph's proposal was a good idea.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai lii yusuf ne, dhèu aae dènge dhèu kapai sèra, sèmi ngaa dhu na peka dènge dhèu aae èèna.

source_text: so pharaoh asked them, where can we find a man like this who has the spirit of god in him?
target_text: ka dhèu aae padhai lii, peka na, roh ama lamatua hia le koasa mi yusuf ne'e. nèti èèna ka, èdhi abhu heka dhèu dhu risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: then pharaoh spoke to joseph, telling him, since god has revealed to you all this, and there's no one like you with such insight and wisdom,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ama lamatua peka dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa se'e aa'i-aa'i. nèti sèmi ne'e ka, heka ji'i nge'a kèna èu ne'e tare'a-re'a dhèu mèu. aa mamèu èu ne, risi eele dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: you will be in charge of all my affairs, and all my people will obey your orders. only i with my status as king will be greater than you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo ne'e kahèi ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a. sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu ja'a. aa ana kabarai ja'a nanene lii paredha èu. dhoka ja'a di dhu risi nèti èu.

source_text: then pharaoh said to joseph, look, i'm putting you in charge of the whole country of egypt. pharaoh took off his signet ring from his finger and put it on joseph's finger. he dressed him in fine linen clothes and placed a golden chain around his neck.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae puru eele kadheli dhu dènge cap nèti ai na, ka na pasaluu mi ai yusuf. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, dènge ne'e ne, ja'a ded'e èu, j'aj'i ai g'ana ja'a ètu rai masir. hèia na papake kodho madhera dhu milu èci mi yusuf, aa na pa'inu rate hualaa cakoko mi ladha-goro na.

source_text: he had joseph ride in the chariot designated for his second-in-command while his attendants went ahead, shouting, bow down! this is how pharaoh gave joseph authority over all of egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae hia hari yusuf kareta ka dua nèngu. ka na hia dhèu lasi uuru, ho pa'oo peka na, we! patalele j'ara oo! pahaha iisi mliu! dhèu kapai neo re ne'e! dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu aae ded'e le yusuf, j'aj'i ai g'ana na ètu rai masir.

source_text: then pharaoh told joseph, i am pharaoh, but without your permission nobody will lift a hand or a foot anywhere in the whole country.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, sèmi ne'e. èu dhu me'a le ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ja'a peka le dènge ana kabarai masir aa'i-aa'i, peka na, ladhe èu hia boe ijin, rèngu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa.

source_text: pharaoh gave joseph the name zaphenath-paneah, and arranged for him to marry asenath, the daughter of potiphera, priest of on. this is how joseph rose to power over the whole of egypt.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu aae pangare yusuf madhutu ngara masir, na safnat panea. aa, na hia yusuf madhèdi dènge ana bhèni èci, ngara na asnat. ama dhèu èmu na, ngara na potifera. nèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i ama agama ètu d'ara kota on. dènge j'ara ne'e, yusuf j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir.

source_text: joseph was thirty when he started working for pharaoh, king of egypt. after he had left pharaoh, joseph traveled on an inspection tour throughout egypt.
target_text: lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu rai masir, umur nèngu tèlu nguru tèu le. hèia na kako palème rai masir.

source_text: during the seven years of good harvests, the land produced plenty of food.
target_text: ètu d'ara pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa ne'e, oka-tedhe pènu dènge nganga'a.

source_text: he collected all the food during the seven good years, and he stored the grain produced in the local fields in each town.
target_text: hèia yusuf kaboko nganga'a dhu risi, ka na tèka paia si. ètu era mia dhu na pakaboko nganga'a, ètu èèna kahèi na soli asa d'ara soka.

source_text: joseph piled up so much grain that it was like the sand of the seashore. eventually he stopped keeping records because there was just so much!
target_text: are dhu pakaboko nare, ae titu kèna. èci èèna ka, dènge salae ètu nebhe dhasi, ka dhèu uku rare heka.

source_text: it was during this time, before the years of famine came, that joseph had two sons by asenath, the daughter of potiphera, priest of on.
target_text: d'ai mèka tèu manganga, dhèu èmu yusuf, asnat nara iisi le ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: joseph named his firstborn manasseh, because he said, the lord has made me forget all my troubles and all my father's family.
target_text: ka yusuf padhai lii, peka na, ama lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka pabhèlu ja'a nèti j'aj'èra dhu lod'o ja'a kalua nèti d'ara èmu ama ku. nèti èèna ka, ana uuru, na pangare ne manase dhu sasoa na ele boe ‘bhèlu'.

source_text: his second son he named ephraim, because he said, god has made me fruitful in the country of my misery.
target_text: lod'o na abhu ana ka dua, na padhai lii hari, peka na, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae d'ai seli ètu era ne'e. te ngaa sasue dènge ladhe-leru ama lamatua ka, ja'a abhu ana ètu ne'e. ka na pangare ana ne'e efraim.

source_text: the seven years of plenty in egypt came to an end,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, èle pidhu tèu dhu bècu-manèsa na.

source_text: and the seven years of famine began, just as joseph had said. there was famine in all the other countries but the whole of egypt had food.
target_text: aa pidhu tèu manganga madèu d'ai kèna, sama sèmi dhu uru èèna yusuf peka le. ètu era leo, dhèu manganga le. te ngaa rae-rae ètu masir nganga'a ae era.

source_text: when all of egypt was hungry, the people cried out to pharaoh for food, and he told everyone, go and see joseph and do whatever he tells you.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, kabarai masir manganga kahèi. ka lasi asa dhèu aae ho ra manèngi nganga'a. aa dhèu aae pua si lasi asa yusuf, sèna ka ra madhutu paredha yusuf.

source_text: the famine had spread all over the country so joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the people of egypt. the famine was very bad in egypt,
target_text: te ngaa rai manganga ètu mia-mia asa tabha, toke d'ai rae-rae ètu rai masir. nèti èèna ka, yusuf bhoke aa'i soka nganga'a sèna ka pahie dènge dhèu masir.

source_text: in fact the famine was very bad everywhere, so people from other countries all around came to egypt to buy grain from joseph.
target_text: lula manganga ae titu kèna, ka dhèu nèti mia-mia mai hèli nganga'a ètu yusuf ètu rai masir.

source_text: when jacob found out grain was available in egypt, he asked his sons, why do you keep on looking at each other to do something?
target_text: tèu èèna, yakob tadèngi dhèu palolo na abhu are ètu masir. ka na peka dènge ana na si, aku nèngu na, ana ee! miu nga tao madhèdi mau-mau ka laa?

source_text: i've heard there's grain in egypt. go there and buy some for us so we can stay alive-if not, we're going to die!
target_text: ja'a tadèngi na ètu masir pahia nganga'a. hua iia lami hèli, sèna ka èdhi baku madhe manganga.

source_text: so ten of joseph's brothers went to egypt to buy grain.
target_text: ka a'a yusuf canguru dhèu se'e pa'èra ka, lasi hèli nganga'a asa masir.

source_text: but jacob did not send joseph's brother benjamin with his other brothers, for he said, i'm afraid something bad might happen to him.
target_text: te ngaa yakob hia boe ari yusuf dhu ngara na benyamin, la'e dènge a'a na si. te, na pangee, mage dhoka, ana ne'e abhu hari j'aj'èra ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: so israel's sons went to buy grain along with everyone else, because there was famine in canaan too.
target_text: lula dhèu ae nèti mia-mia tadèngi le abhu nganga'a ètu masir, ka ra lasi hèli asa nèi. manganga ne d'ai le rai kana'an kahèi. ka ana-ana yakob se, lasi hèli kahèi asa masir.

source_text: joseph was the governor of the country and he sold grain to all the people there. so joseph's brothers went to him, and bowed low before him with their faces to the ground.

source_text: sometime after this, joseph was told, your father is sick. so joseph went to see him, taking with him his two sons manasseh and ephraim.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu lasi peka dènge yusuf na, ama na pèd'a aae. hèia la'e nèti dènge ana na, efraim dènge manase, sèna ka lasi ladhe baki ra yakob.

source_text: when jacob was told, your son joseph has come to you, he gathered his strength and sat up in bed.
target_text: ropa yakob tadèngi yusuf si mai le, ka na pakaseti madhèdi.

source_text: jacob said to joseph, god almighty appeared to me at luz in canaan, and he blessed me there.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, ana yusuf, ee! ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa kapai risi na, uru èèna, na pad'elo le iisi na dènge ja'a ètu rae lus, ètu rai kana'an. ètu nèi, na moa tèke mi ja'a.

source_text: he told me, ‘listen! i will make you prosperous and make your descendants so numerous that you will become the ancestor of many nations, and i will give this land to your descendants to own forever. '
target_text: na padhai lii, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ae, ho rèngu j'aj'i suku dhu kapai. rai ne'e ne, ja'a hia j'aj'i unu rèngu, ho j'aj'i pusaka ra toke d'ai rai-haha èle. '

source_text: i am counting as mine your two sons ephraim and manasseh who were born here in egypt before i arrived, just as reuben and simeon are mine.
target_text: aa ana èu efraim dènge manase èèna, hak rèngu sèmi ne'e ka: lod'o dhu ja'a d'ai masir na, mere iisi le rèngu dua ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a tao rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, sama sèmi ruben dènge simeon.

source_text: any other children you have after them will be yours, and will share their inheritance within the land of their older brothers.
target_text: aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a èu abhu hari ana, na èèna di unu èu kèna. ja'a tao boe rèngu sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a. pe pusaka ra, rèngu abhu nèti a'a ra, efraim dènge manase.

source_text: i'm doing this because tragically for me when i was returning from paddan-aram, rachel died in canaan some distance from ephrath. i buried her there on the way to ephrath also known as bethlehem.
target_text: ja'a tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka èdhi sanèd'e ina mu rahel. lod'o ji'i mai nèti mesopotamia asa kana'an, d'ai talora j'ara, ina mu madhe ropa nara iisi aa'i. èèna na, ji'i dètu rae efrata ètu rai kana'an. lod'o èèna, ja'a susa d'ai seli. ka ja'a padhane ne ètu sebhe j'ara la'e asa rae efrata. limuri ne, rae èèna ra gati ngara na betlehem.

source_text: israel saw joseph's sons and said, so these are your sons?
target_text: ropa yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna hèia, na boti kètu na, ladhe nèdhi ana-ana yusuf ètu èèna. hèia na karèi yusuf, aku nèngu na, se'e se, ana cee?

source_text: yes, these are the sons god gave me here, joseph told his father. bring them over here so i can bless them, he said.
target_text: ka yusuf dhaa, se'e, ana dhu ama lamatua hia ja'a ètu masir. yakob peka hari, ladhe sèmi èèna, na hia ra mai padètu dènge ja'a, ho ja'a manèngi ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale.

source_text: israel's eyesight was failing because of his age and he couldn't see well, so joseph brought them close to his father, and he kissed and hugged them.
target_text: yakob heka le, aa musi madha na ahu le. na ladhe nèdhi be'a heka. hèia yusuf nèti ana na sèra padètu asa madha yakob, ka na liku nare si, aa na uu si dua ra.

source_text: israel said to joseph, i never thought i'd see your face again, and now god has even let me see your children!
target_text: ka na peka dènge yusuf, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pangee na, ja'a bisa heka kèdhi rèhu èu. te ngaa ama lamatua, tao risi eele nèti ngaa dhu ja'a ngee, toke ja'a bisa kèdhi ana-ana èu kahèi.

source_text: joseph took his sons from between israel's knees, and bowed low with his face to the ground.
target_text: hèia yusuf hari eele ana na dhèu dua sèra nèti madha yakob, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u rèhu na d'ai rai, ètu madha ama na.

source_text: then joseph placed ephraim on his right so he would be on israel's left, and manasseh on his left so he would be on israel's right, and then brought them over to israel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf kèd'i. na nare ana na dhèu dua sèra, ka na hia ra titu padètu-dètu dènge ama na. na patitu ana uuru na manase, re bèka g'ana yakob. aa ana ka dua, efraim, re bèka kariu yakob.

source_text: but when israel reached out his hands, he crossed them over and placed his right hand on ephraim the younger son, and placed his left on manasseh, the firstborn.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yakob soro ai na neo manèngi mèngi-nale hia ana dua sèra, na soro ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, aa ai kariu mi kètu manase.

source_text: he blessed joseph, saying, may the god my grandfather abraham and my father worshiped-the god who has taken care of me like a shepherd throughout my life until now,
target_text: ka na manèngi ama lamatua hia berkat mi yusuf, peka na, baki mu isak, dènge ama na abraham, dua ra madhutu taruu dad'èi ama lamatua. ama lamatua ladhe-leru ja'a kahèi, nèti ana ngèru toke d'ai deo ne'e ne.

source_text: the angel who has saved me from all kinds of trouble-may he bless these boys. may my name and the names of my grandfather abraham and father isaac continue through them, and may they have many descendants that spread throughout the earth.
target_text: na pakaj'èu ja'a nèti rupa-rupa sasusa. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale mi ana èu se'e, dènge ana-èpu ra. aa ladhe ra manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, ra bhèlu boe ale kolongara baki abraham, kolongara isak, aa kolongara ja'a, sèna ka ana-èpu rèngu asa bèba-kacanga, ho j'aj'i kapai ètu rai-haha ne'e.

source_text: joseph was unhappy when he saw his father had put his right hand on ephraim, so he took his father's hand to try and move it from ephraim's head to manasseh's head.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf ladhe nèdhi ama na tao ai g'ana na mi kètu efraim, hèia kèpe nare ai ama na, ho tao sa kètu a'a na manase.

source_text: not like that, father, this is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head, joseph told him.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ama na, ama, ee! baku tao sèmi èèna. nèngu ne, ari efraim. nèngu ana limuri. de ai g'ana ama hud'i tao sa kètu a'a na manase. lula èèna hak ana uuru.

source_text: but his father refused, saying, i know what i'm doing. manasseh will also become an important people, but his younger brother will be greater than him, and his descendants will become a large nation.
target_text: te ngaa ama na yakob d'èi boe. ka na peka na, ana, ee! ja'a ke'a. ladhe èèna na, manase j'aj'i èra, aa ana-èpu na tabha ae, ho j'aj'i suku kapai. te ngaa ari na efraim èèna, bèli-camèd'a kapai risi hari nèti nèngu. sèmi èèna kahèi ana-èpu na ae risi eele hari, ho ladhe èèna na, rèngu j'aj'i suku-suku dhu kapai aae.

source_text: so israel blessed them that day and said: in the future the people of israel will use your names to give a blessing, saying, ‘may god bless you like he did ephraim and manasseh. ' in saying this he placed ephraim before manasseh.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana se dua ra, ladhe dhèu isra'el manèngi ama lamatua ho hia mamèngi-nale mi dhèu, rèngu ale ngara miu dua mi hèi. ladhe èèna na, ra peka sèmi ne'e: ‘ji'i sanao sèna ka ama lamatua hia mamèngi-nale mi èu, sama sèmi na hia mi efraim dènge manase. ' dènge j'ara ne'e, yakob ale uuru ngara efraim nèti ngara a'a na manase.

source_text: then israel said to joseph, i'm going to die soon, but god will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yakob padhai lii dènge yusuf, peka na, ana, ee! ja'a nèbhu heka madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua dènge miu, ho èèna na nèti hari miu asa era pea-palu'u bèi-baki miu.

source_text: i'm also giving you something in addition to what i'm giving your brothers-the piece of land on the mountain slope of shechem that i took from the amorites with my sword and bow.
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu risi eele nèti a'ari èu. aa ja'a hia tabha èu, ledhe ètu rai kana'an èèna, dhu uru na ja'a kore nèti dhèu amori, lod'o ja'a segi rèngu ètu d'ara pamusu.

source_text: jacob called his sons together, and said, gather round so i can tell you what's going to happen to you in the future.
target_text: hèia yakob pua ana na aa'i-aa'i ra pakaboko. ropa ra kaboko aa'i, na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ana ja'a aa'i-aa'i! mai padètu dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo peka dènge miu j'ara mamuri mi èci-èci lod'o limuri.

source_text: come here, sons of jacob, and listen to israel your father.
target_text: ka na peka mema dènge ana-ana na si, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, ana-ana yakob! mai titu lingu mere ja'a. mi nanene, ama miu isra'el ne, neo padhai lii.

source_text: reuben, you are my firstborn, conceived when i was strong, born when i was vigorous! you were above all others in position, above all others in power.
target_text: ruben! èu ne, ana ja'a dhu uru tèka! èu ne'e tatea ja'a, dènge ai g'ana ja'a. dhèu pakab'ua risi èu.

source_text: but you boil over like water, so you won't be above anyone anymore, because you went and slept with my concubine; you violated my marriage bed.
target_text: te ngaa d'ara èu èra boe, sama sèmi rii dhasi dhu la'e-mai la'e-mai. cag'ag'a laa, èu lamu j'unu dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, ka pakaj'alu era j'unu ama èu. tatao èu èèna ka, pamanahu eele kolongara ca dhèu a'a.

source_text: simeon and levi are two of the same kind-they use their weapons for destructive violence.
target_text: simeon dènge lewi! miu dua mi ca rupa. miu dua mi, malai titu kèna ded'e samala, ho paj'èra dhèu.

source_text: i refuse to be part of their decisions; i refuse to participate in what they do. for they killed men in their anger; they crippled cattle just for fun.
target_text: ladhe miu pare pama'ète kalua haga sapi, ho ra kapod'e reo-reo ètu era, na lèke dad'èi miu kèna. aa bhabhelu miu hari, ladhe miu kadhi ngutu, na mi pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pahae boe lii padhai lii miu. aa ja'a d'èi boe tao madha-dhilu mi lii langu miu.

source_text: i curse their anger because it is too harsh; i curse their fury because it is too cruel! i will separate their descendants throughout jacob; i will scatter them throughout israel.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo bhelu-katub'a miu ne, te seli-kolane nga! dènge nanasa miu dhu dènge boe sasue ciki sa hèi. ladhe èèna na, miu pasae unu mi, bhelu-katub'a miu sèra. ho èèna na, lamatua ceb'e ana-èpu miu, asa g'ana asa kariu. ka ra paceb'a asa mia-mia, ètu dedha rai isra'el.

source_text: judah, your brothers will praise you. you will defeat your enemies. your father's sons shall bow down to you in respect.
target_text: yahuda! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘koa-kio'. a'ari èu èèna na ra koa èu, aa ra pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua èu. èu ne, j'èli musu èu, toke ra bisa heka doa kètu.

source_text: my son judah is a young lion coming back from eating its prey. he crouches and lies down like a lion. like a lion, who would dare to disturb him?
target_text: èu ne, sama sèmi singa ngèru dhu èra, ho tenge nganga'a unu mu. aa èu ne, sama sèmi singa mone, dhu tèku iisi neo bhèj'i; èci sa bani boe pagagai dènge èu. èu kahèi sèmi singa rena, dhu madhenge ana; èci sa bani boe gagu. èci èèna ka dènge èu. dhèu èci sa bani boe padadisi, aa bani boe tao macam-macam mi dedha èu.

source_text: judah will always hold the scepter, and the staff of authority will always be at his feet until shiloh comes; the nations will obey him.
target_text: èèna na èu mèd'u paredha. ana-èpu èu oo rèd'u paredha padhutu-dhutu, toke abhu èci dhu hak nèngu risi eele nèti cahag'e, ho nèd'u paredha na. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne'e, pahaha iisi ho nanene lii paredha nèngu hèi.

source_text: he ties his donkey to the vine, his donkey's colt to the best vine. he washes his clothes in wine, his robes in the red juice of grapes.
target_text: èèna na, èu ne mamuri dènge karej'e-karae. èu neo ngaa, na abhu. èu neo tao ngaa, na j'aj'i! aa ladhe èèna na, badha-manu, dènge isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu, asa ae d'ai ceb'e lebhe eele hèi.

source_text: his eyes sparkle more than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
target_text: nganga'a-nginu èu, dhu be'a hua, aa dhu èle boe.

source_text: zebulun will live on the seashore and provide a harbor for ships; his territory will extend towards sidon.
target_text: sebolon! rai pusaka dhu èu unu, kapai seli, nèti nebhe dhasi toke d'ai too dènge kota sidon. kapa-kapa mai nèti mia-mia ho panahu dènge be'a ètu d'ara hèb'a-namo dhasi èu.

source_text: issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between two saddle bags. he sees that the place where he's resting is good, and the land is lovely, so he's willing to lower his back to accept the burden and to work as a slave.
target_text: isaskar! èu ne, sama sèmi keled'ei dhu èra, te ngaa èu kètu hadhu papake na aad'o. ladhe èu j'unu ètu talora j'ara, dhèu èci sa bisa boe pakèd'i èu ho kako taruu. te ngaa ladhe èu mèdhi rae ètu ca bèka nèi be'a, èci sa dhae pua mèka èèna ka, mu pasae mèti le mèdha-panyau èu ho lamu. tatu èu sama sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of israel.
target_text: dan! ngara èu ne, sasoa na, ‘dhèu pama'ète lii'. aa èu ne, dènge ana-èpu èu, ladhe bèli-camèd'a pama'ète lii nèti dhèu èu isra'el sèra, dènge boe bia ca bèka.

source_text: dan will be as dangerous as a snake beside the road, a viper by the path that bites the horse's heel, throwing its rider off backwards.
target_text: aa èu ne, sama èci èèna ka dènge mege kaisao dhu j'unu ètu sebhe j'ara. dhèu ca'e jara ho èèna na, èu kadhi haga jara èèna nèti kabodho, toke dhèu manahu sa rai.

source_text: i trust in you to save me, lord.
target_text: o lamatua! ja'a ke'a na èu hia mamuri mi ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: raiders will attack gad, but he will attack their heels.
target_text: gad! ngara èu, lii na oe èci èèna ka dènge, ‘age'. ladhe èèna na, dhèu parapo mai age èu, te ngaa èu kabèli hari age si, ka mu segi si.

source_text: asher will have delicious food-he'll produce fancy food for royalty.
target_text: aser! ladhe èèna isi rai nèti oka-tedhe èu be'a risi, d'ai èu tao koki dhu be'a bia, ka dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai hèli ètu èu.

source_text: naphtali is a deer that's free to run; it gives birth to beautiful fawns.
target_text: naftali! èu ne sama sèmi rusa hui, dhu dhèu èci sa ator rare boe èu. ana-ana matana èu, bhèni iia dènge mone iia.

source_text: joseph is a fruitful tree, a fruitful tree beside a spring, whose branches climb over the wall.
target_text: yusuf! èu ne, sama sèmi aj'u loro dhu dètu dènge madha èi. dadana na loro asa tembok dhu dedha aae.

source_text: the archers viciously attacked him; they shot their arrows at him with hate.
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu tèka d'ara dènge èu, sama èci èèna ka, dènge musu dhu neo kataki èu.

source_text: but he held his bow steady, and his arms and hands moved quickly in the strength of the mighty one of jacob, who is called the shepherd, the rock of israel.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ja'a mangaj'i na, bera-bera dènge èu. ho na pa'èra ai èu, ka èu kataki si hari, masi ka nèti kaj'èu èèna ka. èu segi si, lula ama lamatua dhu tolong èu. mema koasa na risi aa'i ngaa-ngaa! nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i era sarai ja'a, lula nèngu na ka dhu madhenge ja'a.

source_text: the god of your father will help you and the almighty will bless you with blessings from the heavens above, with blessings from the depths below, with blessings for many children.
target_text: aa nèngu madhenge èu kahèi. dènge na pala-bagi hia èu mèngi-nale nèti dedha-liru, nèti rai-haha, dènge berkat ho matana ana ae-ae dhu ngi'u èra.

source_text: the blessings your father received were greater than the blessings of his forefathers, more than the blessings of the eternal mountains. may they be upon the head of joseph, on the forehead of the one set apart as a leader from his brothers.
target_text: ledhe-ledhe ra ele boe. aa mamèngi-nale dhu ja'a peka mi èu ne, dedha risi nèti ledhe aa'i-aa'i ra. sèna ka hud'i laa berkat se aa'i-aa'i sabhori asa èu, lula èu ne risi nèti a'ari èu se aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: benjamin is a vicious wolf. in the morning he destroys his enemies, in the evening he divides the loot.
target_text: benyamin! babani èu sama sèmi busa hui dhu manganga. mad'ae aae era, na kèd'i le èèna, ho bata-magèla badha hui, ho j'aj'i mi nganga'a na. aa, ladhe d'ai ka mèda, la'e papala dhu sisa hia mi ana-ana nèngu. babe'a ana-èpu èu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: these are all of the twelve tribes of israel, and this is what their father told them as he blessed them, each according to their respective blessings.
target_text: sange ne'e ka, yakob peka dènge ana-ana na, tasa mera mia mamuri rèngu pala lod'o limuri, èci-èci ka dènge ana-èpu rèngu. rèngu aa'i-aa'i se'e ka, j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: then he gave them the following instructions: i'm going to die soon. bury me with my forefathers in the cave in the field of ephron the hittite. this is the cave in the field of machpelah, near mamre in canaan, that abraham bought together with the field from ephron the hittite to own as a burial site.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yakob manèngi sèna ka ana-ana na pajaji mema, peka na, nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe. ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, na miu hud'i padhane ku ja'a asa d'ara ro'a baki ku abraham. ro'a ne, ètu d'ara loe padètu dènge rae makpela, dènge mamre ètu rai kana'an. uru na baki abraham ka dhu hèli loe dènge oka na, ho j'aj'i mi era ro'a nèngu. na hèli pama'ète nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron.

source_text: abraham and his wife sarah were buried there, isaac and his wife rebekah were buried there, and i buried leah there.
target_text: ètu era èèna, ra padhane baki èdhi abraham dènge bèi èdhi sara; ama ja'a isak dènge ina ku ribka ètu èèna kahèi. de èèna na, miu hud'i padhane ja'a mi era èèna, ètu sebhe ro'a dhèu èmu ja'a lea.

source_text: the field and the cave were bought from the hittites.
target_text: de mage mi bhèlu, padhane ja'a ètu d'ara loe dhu baki abraham ku hèli nare èèna.

source_text: when jacob finished giving these instructions he pulled up his feet into the bed, breathed his last, and joined his forefathers in death.
target_text: yakob padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, na bhèj'i dènge ka ètu dedha koi na, hèia na madhe dènge ka.

source_text: joseph went and hugged his father, weeping over him and kissing him.
target_text: hèia yusuf liku nare ama na, ka na tangi. na uu ama na pèri-pèri hari.

source_text: then joseph instructed the physicians who worked for him to embalm his father's body. so the physicians embalmed israel.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu dhu tuka urus dhèu madhe mai lalau ngi'u aae ama na dènge bubhu-bubhu, sèna ka baku ele iie.

source_text: this took a full 40 days, the normal time for the process, and the egyptians mourned for him for 70 days.
target_text: sasab'a tuka lalau ngi'u aae ama na, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, madhutu j'ara sasab'a rèngu. dhèu masir aa'i-aa'i madhutu tangi kahèi mamadhe yakob ne'e. ra beke pidhu nguru lod'o, tao sèmi dhèu kapai rèngu madhe.

source_text: once the time of mourning was over, joseph said to pharaoh's officials, if you'd be so kind, please speak to pharaoh on my behalf, and explain to him that
target_text: èle beke pidhu nguru lod'o, hèia yusuf peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, mi nanene! mèti ku lii ja'a ne asa dhèu aae, peka sèmi ne'e:

source_text: my father made me swear an oath, telling me, ‘you must bury me in the tomb i've prepared for myself in canaan. please allow me to go and bury my father and then i'll return. '
target_text: ‘lod'o ama ku oe madhe, na moa sèna ka ja'a laku padhane ne asa rai kana'an. de ja'a manèngi ho ama dhèu aae hia ja'a ijin laku padhane ama ku. ladhe èle na, ja'a lèpa hari mai. '

source_text: pharaoh replied, go and bury your father as he made you swear to do.
target_text: ropa tadèngi, hèia dhèu aae dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dhu moa le mi ama mu sèmi èèna na, lamu ho padhane ne ètu nèi.

source_text: joseph went to bury his father, and all pharaoh's officials went with him-all pharaoh's senior advisors and all the leaders of egypt-
target_text: ka yusuf pakèd'i ka, la'e padhane ama na. dhèu ae madhutu lasi dènge ne kahèi. sèmi kapala urusan nèti dhèu aae, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i nèti masir.

source_text: as well as joseph's family, his brothers, and his father's family. they only left the small children and their flocks and herds back in goshen.
target_text: a'ari yusuf dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi padhane yakob. dhu ata ètu gosen dhoka dhèu èmu ra, ana iiki, dènge badha-manu ra di.

source_text: they were accompanied by chariots and horsemen-a really large procession.
target_text: sordad'u ae madhutu kahèi. cahag'e ca'e kareta, aa cahag'e hari ca'e jara. taga dhèu dhu madhutu na, ae d'ai seli, nèti èèna ka, rombongan dhu rèti dhèu madhe ne, madhera titu kèna.

source_text: when they got to the threshing floor of atad, on the other side of the jordan, they wept loudly in sorrow. joseph held a seven-day ceremony of mourning for his father there.
target_text: rèngu lasi, ka ra pège loko yarden ètu era èci, ngara na atad. era ne'e, dhèu biasa mai j'èli are. d'ai era ne'e, yusuf si tangi mamadhe ama na. aa ra beke hari pidhu mèda.

source_text: the canaanites who lived there watched the ceremony of mourning at the threshing floor of atad. they said, this is a very sad time of mourning for the egyptians, so they renamed the place abel-mizraim, which is on the other side of the jordan.
target_text: ropa dhèu kana'an ètu sèra, ladhe na ra j'èra ae titu kèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! miu laladhe ku laa! babeke mamadhe dhèu masir se, ra susa bia nga! j'ara tatangi rèngu sèmi nèi ni ka. nèti èèna ka, ra pangare era èèna, ngara na abel-misraim. sasoa na, ‘sasusa dhèu masir'.

source_text: jacob's sons did what he had instructed them to do.
target_text: hèia ana-ana yakob se, tao madhutu sèmi lii moa rèngu uru na.

source_text: they carried his body to canaan and buried him in the cave at machpelah in the field near mamre, which abraham had bought from ephron the hittite as a burial site.
target_text: ka nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yakob na, lasi padhane asa d'ara loe dhu padètu dènge rae makpela dènge mamre. abraham hèli nare era ne'e nèti dhèu suku het, ngara na efron, ho j'aj'i mi era udhu rui rèngu.

source_text: after they had buried their father, joseph and his brothers returned to egypt along with all those who had gone with them.
target_text: yusuf padhane nare ama na, hèia nèngu dènge a'ari na lèpa hari asa masir. sama-sama dènge dhèu leo dhu madhutu sèra.

source_text: however, now that their father was dead, joseph's brothers became worried, saying, maybe joseph is holding a grudge against us, and he'll pay us back for all the bad things we did to him.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai masir, a'a yusuf se mulai madha'u. lula ama rèngu aad'o heka, ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, we! ta pangee ku la! sèmi yusuf tèka d'ara dènge èdhi era, ho na b'ala tatao karehe èdhi mi nèngu uru èèna, na èdhi tasamia?

source_text: so they sent a message to joseph to tell him, before your father died, he gave this order:
target_text: hèia rare lii èci, ka ra hia lii la'e asa yusuf, peka na, ama wakil. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o ama èdhi mamuri era, na pua ji'i

source_text: ‘this is what you are to tell joseph: forgive your brothers their sins, the bad things they did to you, treating you in such a nasty way. ' now please forgive us our sins, we who are servants of the god of your father. when joseph received their message, he cried.
target_text: ho padhai lii dènge ama wakil, peka na, ‘yusuf hud'i bhabhèlu eele ka sasala a'a na si. lula uru na ra paj'èra ne. ' ji'i nge'a kahèi ama èdhi ne, karèi nèti uru ka mai, na mangaj'i dhoka mi ama lamatua di. ji'i kahèi j'aj'i ana pajuu lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai manèngi abho, lula uru na ji'i paj'èra le, ama wakil. ropa tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia yusuf tangi.

source_text: then his brothers themselves came and fell down before joseph and said, we are your slaves!
target_text: èle èèna ka, a'a na si mai unu ra, ka patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha na. hèia ra padhai lii, peka na, hud'i laa ama tao ji'i j'aj'i ènu ama.

source_text: you don't need to be afraid! he told them. i don't stand in the place of god, do i?
target_text: te ngaa yusuf padhai lii dènge ra, miu se a'a ja'a! miu baku madha'u ia ka! dhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak hia huku mi dhèu. te ja'a ne, aad'o.

source_text: while you planned bad things for me, god planned it for good so that in the end many lives could be saved.
target_text: mema tare'a, uru na miu mere lii èci, ho neo paj'èra ja'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu ub'a eele tatao miu dhu karehe èèna, j'aj'i mi babe'a. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai ètu ne'e, sèna ka dhèu ae abhu mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: so don't worry. i'll go on taking care of you and your children. speaking kindly like this he calmed them down.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! baku madha'u ia ka. ja'a pamoa dènge miu se, èèna na, ladhe-leru miu, dènge ana-èpu miu aa'i-aa'i ra. dènge lii padhai lii sèmi ne'e ne, yusuf pa'èra hari d'ara a'a na si.

source_text: joseph remained in egypt, together with his father's whole family. he lived to be 110,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf pea taruu ètu rai masir, dènge a'ari na si, aa'i-aa'i ra. nèngu mamuri d'ai cangasu canguru tèu.

source_text: and saw three generations of his son ephraim, and the sons of makir, manasseh's son, were placed in his lap when they were born.
target_text: nèngu d'ai hari nèdhi ana-èpu efraim kahèi. aa na leru èpu manase, nuka ana-ana nèti makir.

source_text: i'm going to die soon, joseph told his brothers, but god will be with you, and he will lead you out of this country to the land that he swore to give to abraham, isaac, and jacob.
target_text: yusuf peka mi a'a na si, aku nèngu na, a'a ku si ee! ja'a rasa na mamadhe ja'a dètu le! te ngaa ja'a parcaya, ama lamatua tatu ladhe-leru miu. bèli-camèd'a nèngu ka dhu lere miu kalua nèti rai ne'e. nèngu kahèi dhu nèti hari miu lèpa asa rai dhu na padhadha le pake lii subha, ho hia mi baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge ama èdhi yakob.

source_text: joseph made the sons of israel swear an oath, saying, when god comes to be with you, you must take my bones with you when you leave.
target_text: ka yusuf manèngi mi a'ari na si, sèna ka ra subha, peka na, miu hud'i jaji ku mi dedha ja'a. ladhe lod'o d'ai ama lamatua nèti hari miu asa rai kana'an, miu hud'i mèti ngi'u aae ja'a asa nèi.

source_text: joseph died when he was 110. after his body was embalmed, he was placed in a coffin in egypt.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf madhe ètu masir, dènge umur nèngu cangasu canguru tèu. hèia ra tao bubhu mi ngi'u aae na. ka ra tao asa d'ara kopa.

source_text: this book is the record of jesus the messiah, the son of david, the son of abraham, beginning with the family line: abraham was the father of isaac; and isaac the father of jacob; and jacob the father of judah and his brothers;
target_text: sasuri ne, lole j'ara mamuri nèti yesus kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua padhadha mema ho neo pua mai. yesus ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud dènge abraham. karèi nèti abraham toke dhèu aae daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki. kabhia na sèmi ne'e: abraham matana isak, isak matana yakob, yakob matana yahuda dènge a'ari na,

source_text: and judah the father of perez and zerah their mother was tamar; and perez the father of hezron; and hezron the father of ram;
target_text: yahuda matana peres dènge sera ina ra, ngara na tamar peres matana herson, herson matana ram,

source_text: and ram the father of amminadab; and amminadab the father of nahshon; and nahshon the father of salmon;
target_text: ram matana aminadab, aminadab matana nahason, nahason matana salmon,

source_text: and salmon the father of boaz his mother was rahab; and boaz the father of obed his mother was ruth; and obed the father of jesse;
target_text: salmon matana boas ina na, ngara na rahab boas matana obet ina na, ngara na rut, obet matana isai,

source_text: and jesse the father of king david. david was the father of solomon his mother had been uriah's wife;
target_text: isai matana daud.

source_text: and solomon the father of rehoboam; and rehoboam the father of abijah; and abijah the father of asa; and asa the father of jehoshaphat; and jehoshaphat the father of jehoram; and jehoram the father of uzziah; and uzziah the father of jotham; and jotham the father of ahaz; and ahaz the father of hezekiah; and hezekiah the father of manasseh; and manasseh the father of amon; and amon the father of josiah; and josiah the father of jehoiachin and his brothers, at the time of the exile to babylon.
target_text: nèti daud toke lod'o dhu ra babège suku isra'el asa babel, abhu hari canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: daud matana soleman ina na, uru èèna dhèu èmu uria. soleman matana rehabeam, rehabeam matana abia, abia matana asaf, asaf matana yosafat, yosafat matana yoram, yoram matana usia, usia matana yotam, yotam matana ahas, ahas matana heskia, heskia matana manase, manase matana amos, amos matana yosias, yosias matana yekonya dènge ari na, lod'o babège si asa babel.

source_text: after the exile to babylon, jehoiachin was the father of shealtiel; and shealtiel the father of zerubbabel; and zerubbabel the father of abiud; and abiud the father of eliakim; and eliakim the father of azor; and azor the father of zadok; and zadok the father of akim; and akim the father of eliud; and eliud the father of eleazar; and eleazar the father of matthan; and matthan the father of jacob; and jacob was the father of joseph, who was the husband of mary, to whom jesus was born, the one who is called the messiah.
target_text: lod'o babège si asa babel, toke d'ai rara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki, nuka: yekonya matana saltiel, saltiel matana serubabel, serubabel matana abihut, abihut matana elyakim, elyakim matana asor, asor matana sadok, sadok matana akim, akim matana eliut, eliut matana eliasar, eliasar matana matan, matan matana yakob, yakob matana yusuf, yusuf ne, dhèu èmu maria. maria ne ka dhu nara iisi yesus kristus.

source_text: so all the generations from abraham to david add up to fourteen; from david to the babylonian exile, fourteen; and from the babylonian exile to the messiah, fourteen.
target_text: de karèi nèti abraham toke daud, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; nèti daud toke lod'o ra babège si asa babel abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki; aa nèti lod'o ra babège si asa babel d'ai maria nara iisi yesus, abhu canguru èpa bèi-baki.

source_text: this is how the birth of jesus the messiah happened. his mother, mary, was engaged to joseph, but before they slept together she became pregnant by the holy spirit.
target_text: lii lolo maria nara iisi yesus sèmi ne'e ka: maria dhu tunanga le dènge yusuf. dua ra pa'èci rèdhi mèka sama sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali, te ngaa te'a boe na, maria dhu dènge le babia nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: joseph, her fiancé, was a good man and didn't want to shame her publicly, so he decided to break the engagement discreetly.
target_text: ropa yusuf ne'a, ka na neo pama'ète lii rèngu dua ra. te ngaa na d'èi boe pamakae maria ètu madha dhèu ae, lula nèngu ne ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. nèti èèna ka, na neo pamau eele lii rèngu ne.

source_text: while he was thinking about all of this, an angel of the lord appeared to him in a dream and told him, joseph, son of david, don't be afraid to marry mary because she is pregnant by the holy spirit.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o dhu na pangee era, d'ara ca mèda sa, ka nèngu nii. ètu d'ara nii ne, ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, yusuf! èu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. èu mage makae leo dènge maria. te ana dhu na kad'o èèna, j'aj'i nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: she will give birth to a son and you shall call him jesus, for he will save people from their sins.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a maria nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. aa èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus, te nèngu ka dhu patabuli dhèu unu ama lamatua nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: now this all happened to fulfill what the lord said through the prophet:
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua dhu peka mema nèti uru ka, re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri, peka na,

source_text: a virgin will become pregnant, and will give birth to a son. they will call him immanuel, which means god with us.
target_text: mi nanene! bèli-camèd'a abhu ana bhèni ca dhèu dhu kalora iisi, te'a boe na, nèngu dhu dènge babia le. èèna na nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. ka ra pangare ne, imanuel. lii ibrani, ‘imanuel' sasoa na: ama lamatua bera-bera dènge èdhi.

source_text: joseph woke up and did what the angel of the lord told him to do.
target_text: ropa nii èle, yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i na. ka na madhutu ka lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na tadèngi ètu d'ara nii deo na. ka nare maria j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: joseph married mary, but did not sleep with her until after she had given birth to a son, whom he named jesus.
target_text: te ngaa na j'unu pa'èci boe dènge maria, toke maria nara iisi aa'i. nara iisi nare ka, yusuf pangare ana ne, yesus.

source_text: after jesus was born in bethlehem in judea during the reign of king herod, wise men came from the east to jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o rara iisi yesus ètu rae betlehem, ètu propensi yudea, dhèu aae herodes dhu nèd'u paredha ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri nèti era kaj'èu, mai nèti bèka dhimu asa kota yerusalem. rèngu se, dhu re'a mèu ladhe hua-hètu.

source_text: where is the king of the jews who has been born? they asked. we saw his star in the east and we've come to worship him.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai yerusalem dhèu se pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi, dhu heka rara iisi hiu èèna, era na buli mia, ee? ji'i ngèdhi hua-hètu cue ètu bèka dhimu, dhu j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, rara iisi le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ji'i mai neo pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: when king herod heard about it, he was very disturbed, and the whole of jerusalem with him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia d'ara na susa. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu yerusalem sèra, d'ara ra susa kahèi.

source_text: herod summoned all the chief priests and religious teachers of the people, and asked them where the messiah was supposed to be born.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae herodes paroa nare kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, ka na karèi si, peka na, miu peka sèku dènge ja'a la! kristus, dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke èèna, rara iisi ne ètu mia?

source_text: bethlehem in judea, they told him, for that's what the prophet wrote:
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ètu rae betlehem, propensi yudea. te ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na mika, dhu suri tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na:

source_text: ‘bethlehem in the land of judea, you are certainly not the least important of judah's leading cities, for a leader will come from you who will be the shepherd for my people israel. '
target_text: ‘wee! miu dhèu betlehem ètu propensi yudea sèra. baku pangee na, rae miu ne, ca rae iiki dhu dhèu ige boe. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu kapai ca dhèu cèu mai nèti rae ne'e. èèna na nèngu j'aj'i dhèu madhenga mi dhèu ja'a, dhèu isra'el. '

source_text: then herod called the wise men and met with them in private and found out from them exactly when the star appeared.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae herodes paroa mau-mau dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra. ka na karèi, na, lod'o mia miu ladhe mèdhi hua-hètu ne cèu ètu dedha-liru? hèia ra peka dènge ne.

source_text: he sent them to bethlehem, telling them, when you get there, search for the child. once you find him let me know so that i can come and worship him too.
target_text: èle ka, na hia si lasi asa betlehem. na moa dènge ra, peka na, lami ho tenge palème era, ètu mia ana ne. ladhe miu rage, na, lèpa hari mai sèna ka peka dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo laku pahaha iisi mi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: after they had heard what the king had to say they went on their way, and the star which they had seen in the east led them until it stopped right above the place where the child was.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai dhèu aae, hèia lasi dènge ka. kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi hari hua-hètu dhu uru èèna rèdhi ètu bèka dhimu. hua-hètu ne cèu ètu madha rèngu, na kako uru nèti rèngu, hèia tèja ètu dedha era ana ne pea.

source_text: when they saw the star they couldn't contain their happiness!
target_text: ropa rèdhi, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: they went into the house and saw the child with mary his mother. they bowed and worshiped him. then they opened their bags of treasure and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe rèdhi ana ne dènge ina na maria. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi mi ana ne. ka dhèu se bhoke mèdha dhu kab'ua rèti hia ana ne. ra hia hualaa, kemenyan dènge raa aj'u hèu mèngi.

source_text: warned by a dream not to return to herod, they left for their own country by a different route.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka dhèu se abhu nii nèti ama lamatua, peka na, lami ia ka asa dhèu aae herodes. nèti èèna ka, ra lèpa hari asa rai rèngu re j'ara leo.

source_text: after they'd left, an angel of the lord appeared to joseph in a dream, and told him, get up, and take the child and his mother, and flee to egypt. remain there until i tell you, because herod is going to search for the child to kill him.
target_text: lod'o dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu se lèpa, hèia ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga, mai peka dènge yusuf ètu d'ara nii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! pakèd'i dènge ka d'ara lai-lai ne! mèti ana ne dènge ina na lami asa masir. pea ètu nèi, toke ja'a peka d'ai lod'o mia miu lèpa hari. te dhèu aae herodes tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ana ne!

source_text: so joseph got up and took the boy and his mother, and left during the night for egypt.
target_text: hèia yusuf kèd'i nèti bhèj'i. ka mèda èèna kahèi, nèti dhèu èmu na dènge ana ne, rai lasi asa masir.
