source_text: they stayed there until herod's death. this fulfilled what the lord said through the prophet, i called my son out of egypt.
target_text: ra pea ètu nèi toke dhèu aae herodes madhe. j'ara èèna, nuka sèmi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na hosea, suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka, na, ja'a paroa hari ana ku, ho lèpa ka nèti masir.

source_text: when herod realized he'd been fooled by the wise men, he got very angry. he sent men to kill all the young boys in bethlehem and the regions nearby who were two years old and under. this was based on the time frame he'd discovered from the wise men.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes ne'a nare, na, dhèu d'èlu-mèu ladhe hua-hètu sèra leko-monya ne, hèia na nasa titu kèna. na paredha sordad'u na sèra, aku nèngu na, lami asa rae betlehem nèi, aa asa rae-rae leo dhu padètu ètu èèna. pamadhe aa'i ana mone iiki dhu dua tèu asa haha mai. herodes hia paredha ne, lula na sanèd'e lii lolo nèti dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra. na ige karèi nèti rèngu rèdhi hiu-hiu hua-hètu cèu ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: in this way jeremiah's prophecy was fulfilled:
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yermia, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: the sound of terrible weeping and mourning was heard in rama, rachel crying for her children. they are dead, and she can't be comforted.
target_text: abhu lii tangi dènge lii roma iisi dhèu nèti kota rama. rahel tangi d'ara pèd'a, lula ana-ana na madhe aa'i. na d'èi boe ca dhèu sa mai pamako ne, lula ana-ana na, aad'o heka ca dhèu sa.

source_text: after herod died the angel of the lord appeared in a dream to joseph in egypt, and told him,
target_text: nèbhu-nèbhu ka, dhèu aae herodes madhe. lod'o èèna, yusuf si ètu masir era. hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na ca dhèu mai nèti sorga, pad'elo rèhu na mi nèngu ètu d'ara nii.

source_text: get up! take the child and his mother, and return to the land of israel, because those who were trying to kill the child are dead.
target_text: ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, yusuf! kèd'i ka! mèti ka ana ne dènge ina na asa isra'el. te dhèu dhu neo pamadhe ana ne, madhe le.

source_text: so joseph got up and took the boy and his mother, and returned to the land of israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yusuf kèd'i. èle ka nèti si asa rai isra'el.

source_text: but joseph was afraid to go there after he learned that archelaus had succeeded his father herod as king of judea. warned in a dream, joseph went to the galilee area
target_text: te ngaa ropa yusuf tadèngi na, arkalaus, ana dhèu aae herodes, dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae limuri ne ètu propensi yudea, ka na madha'u la'e asa yudea. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua peka hari dènge ne ètu d'ara nii, na, yusuf, èu baku pea ètu yudea. nèti èèna ka, lasi pea asa propensi galilea,

source_text: and settled down in nazareth. this fulfilled what the prophets had said, he will be called a nazarene.
target_text: ètu rae nasaret. dènge j'ara ne lii padhai ama lamatua lèke tare'a, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri tèke, na bèli-camèd'a dhèu paroa ne, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: some time later john the baptist appeared on the scene, proclaiming in the judean desert,
target_text: lod'o yesus dhu kapai le, hèia yohanis tuka sarani mulai aj'a-nori dhèu ètu era dhu dhèu pea boe ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: repent, for the kingdom of heaven has arrived!
target_text: na aj'a peka na, a'ari pasue! miu hud'i mangaku aa tèke eele ku sasala-sasigo miu, ho lèpa asa ama lamatua. te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: he was the one isaiah spoke about when he said, a voice is heard crying out in the desert, ‘prepare the way of the lord. make the paths straight for him. '
target_text: uru èèna, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri le lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu dhèu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra sèna ka tao pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mamai ama lamatua! tao pamola j'ara hia ne! '

source_text: john had clothes made of camel hair, with a leather belt around his waist. his food was locusts and wild honey.
target_text: j'ara mamuri yohanis ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. mèdha-papake na tao nèti rèu badha onta. dhari hake na nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a na, kabara dènge dhua nasu oni.

source_text: people came to him from jerusalem, all of judea, and the entire jordan region,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai neo paraga dènge yohanis. rèngu mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti kabarai propensi yudea aa'i-aa'i, dènge nèti rae-rae dhu dètu loko yarden.

source_text: and were baptized in the jordan river, publicly admitting their sins.
target_text: ra bhoka d'ara ra, aa mangaku sasala-sasigo aa'i-aa'i, èle ka yohanis sarani si ètu d'ara loko yarden.

source_text: but when john saw many of the pharisees and sadducees coming to be baptized, he said to them, you vipers' brood! who warned you to run away from the coming judgment?
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu partei agama saduki, lasi asa era èèna kahèi, manèngi yohanis sarani si. te ngaa ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi si, hèia na jèke si, peka na, heeh! miu se cakaraa mege dhu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua huku mi, lula tatao miu dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra. mage mi pangee na, miu bisa rai nèti hahuku na.

source_text: show by what you do that you have truly repented,
target_text: de be'a risi miu lèpa sa ama lamatua, aa tèke eele sasala miu sèra. èle na, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sèmi aj'u dhu hua be'a.

source_text: and don't presume to say proudly to yourselves, ‘abraham is our father. ' i tell you that god could make children of abraham from these stones.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, miu se abhu mamuri, lula j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. mi sanèd'e lii ja'a, ee! te ama lamatua bisa tao hadhu se j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham kahèi.

source_text: in fact the ax is ready to chop down the trees. every tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into the fire.
target_text: baku pamud'e! te abhu dhu kèpe mema kataka, pa'èra patue aa'i-aa'i aj'u dhu hua be'a boe, sèna ka core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: yes, i baptize you in water to show repentance, but after me is coming one who is greater than i am. i'm not worthy even to remove his sandals. he will baptize you with the holy spirit and with fire.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a sarani miu pake èi, ho j'aj'i mi tadha dhu peka na, miu se tèke eele sasala-sasala miu. te ngaa pe abhu ca dhèu dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a, bèli-camèd'a mai. masi ka j'aj'i ana pua-paleha na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi. èèna na, nèngu papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèngu tao miu j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, sama sèmi dhèu pake ai ho bhubhu maruru.

source_text: he has his winnowing tool ready in his hand. he will clean up the threshing floor and gather the wheat into the storehouse, but he will burn the chaff with fire that can't be put out.
target_text: te nèngu dhu nèd'u kokotai dènge laludhu ètu d'ara, ho neo tatai eele èto na. èle èèna, na bhori laludhu asa d'ara soka. te ngaa èto sèra, na dutu asa d'ara ai dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu madhe boe.

source_text: then jesus came from galilee to the jordan river to be baptized by john.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus puru mai nèti galilea, la'e asa loko yarden. na mai sèna ka manèngi yohanis sarani ne.

source_text: but john tried to change his mind. he told jesus, i need to be baptized by you, and you come to me to baptize you?
target_text: te ngaa yohanis no'o boe. na pab'ala peka na, tasamia ka ja'a sarani èu? sale ne, sina ma? hud'i èu ku dhu sarani ja'a. te èèna ka dhu ja'a parluu!

source_text: please do so, because it's good for us to do what god says is right, jesus told him. so john agreed to do it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, pangee ia ka. te ngaa doe ne'e, hud'i laa èu di dhu sarani ja'a. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ropa tadèngi nare, ka yohanis b'ala, aku nèngu na, sad'i aku èu hèia yohanis sarani yesus.

source_text: immediately after he was baptized, jesus came out of the water. the heavens were opened, and he saw god's spirit like a dove descending, landing on him.
target_text: ropa sarani èle, ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara loko. cag'ag'a laa, liru bhoke eele. hèia ladhe nèdhi roh ama lamatua puru mai, nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu mai tèka mi nèngu.

source_text: a voice from heaven said, this is my son whom i love, who pleases me.
target_text: hèia ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, nèngu ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: then jesus was led by the spirit into the desert to be tempted by the devil.
target_text: èle ka, roh ama lamatua nèti yesus asa d'ara mamoo, sèna ka dhèu aae nidhu sèku ne.

source_text: after fasting forty days and nights, he was hungry.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, yesus na'a-ninu boe èpa nguru lod'o mèu-mèda. hèia na manganga titu kèna.

source_text: the tempter came and said to him, if you really are the son of god, order these stones to turn into bread.
target_text: ropa na manganga sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai sèku ne, peka na, èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, do? ladhe tare'a, na, paredha hadhu se, ho j'aj'i nganga'a.

source_text: jesus answered, as scripture says, ‘human beings do not live by only eating bread, but by every word that comes from the mouth of god. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, na, dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na: ‘dhèu rai-haha mamuri mesa boe nèti nganga'a di. te ngaa rèngu hud'i nanene ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na kahèi. '

source_text: then the devil took him to the holy city and placed him on the top of the temple.
target_text: ka dhèu aae nidhu nèti yesus asa kota yerusalem, kota lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna. èle ka, na nèti yesus asa era dhu dedha risi ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: if you really are the son of god, then throw yourself off, he told jesus. as scripture says, ‘he will order his angels to save you from harm. they will catch you so that you won't fall by tripping over a stone. '
target_text: hèia nidhu ne, peka, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, èu ridhu sèku asa haha nèi. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘pe ama lamatua pua ana pajuu nèti sorga, sèna ka j'aga èu. ' aa ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri kahèi, ‘pe ra kanata ai ra, ho sibhe èu, sèna ka ngi'u èu pèd'a boe, aa haga èu goi lèke boe hadhu sa hèi. '

source_text: jesus answered, as scripture also says, ‘you shall not tempt the lord your god. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, abhu kahèi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua èu. de èu baku pua ne pake koasa na, sèna ka pad'elo bukti, peka na, nèngu èèna, tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. '

source_text: then the devil took jesus to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in all their glory.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae nidhu ne nèti hari yesus asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae. hèia na pad'elo aa'i saraga dènge babe'a negara aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: he said to jesus, i will give you all these if you fall down on your knees and worship me.
target_text: ropa na pad'elo nare, hèia dhèu aae nidhu ne peka, aku nèngu na, sad'i èu patitu kètu urutuu, sèna ka pahaha iisi mi ja'a, pe ja'a hia aa'i se'e se mi èu.

source_text: go away, satan! said jesus. as scripture says, ‘you shall worship the lord your god and serve him, and him alone. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, he, nidhu! pakaj'èu nèti era ne'e ne! te sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri na, ‘èu hud'i pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, aa èu ne hud'i sab'a ku dhoka hia nèngu di. '

source_text: then the devil left him, and angels came to care for him.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae nidhu tadèngi lii ne, hèia na tèke eele yesus. te ngaa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga mai uri ne.

source_text: when jesus heard that john had been arrested, he returned to galilee.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes pamaso yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara èmu bèdho. ropa yesus tadèngi, hèia na lèpa asa galilea.

source_text: leaving nazareth, he came to stay in capernaum, on the shores of the sea in the regions of zebulun and naphthali.
target_text: la'e asa rae na nasaret, èle ka la'e taruu pea ètu rae kapernaum. rae èèna ètu sebhe dano galilea, ètu rai sebulon dènge naftali.

source_text: this fulfilled what isaiah the prophet said,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, na tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: in the land of zebulun and the land of naphthali, on the road to the sea, across the jordan river, in galilee where the foreigners live:
target_text: rai sebulon dènge rai naftali dhu padètu dènge dano galilea ètu sebhe haa loko yarden. dhèu yahudi boe pea ètu era sèra kahèi.

source_text: the people living in darkness saw a great light; the light of dawn has shined on those living in the land of the shadow of death.
target_text: rèngu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa limuri ne, rèdhi le saraa. aa saraa ne heo le palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe mèka ama lamatua.

source_text: from that time on jesus began declaring his message, saying, repent, for the kingdom of heaven has arrived!
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus mulai aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i soro kabodho aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, ho mamuri ka dènge mola-mèci! te limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa le j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: as he was walking by the sea of galilee jesus saw two brothers. simon, also called peter, and his brother andrew, were casting a net in the sea. they made their living by catching fish.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea. na paraga dènge dhèu dua dhu pa'a'ari. èci ngara na simon, dhu tema paroa ne, petrus. aa ari na, anderias. dua ra dhu pèku i'a ètu dano galilea, lula dua ra dhèu sab'a dhasi.

source_text: come and follow me, and i will teach you how to catch people, he told them.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai ku madhutu ja'a! miu biasa tenge i'a, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo aj'a miu ho j'aj'i tuka tenge dhèu.

source_text: they left their nets immediately and followed him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia dua ra tèke eele dènge ka pèku ra, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: continuing on he saw two other brothers, james and john. they were in a boat with their father zebedee, mending their nets. he called them to follow him.
target_text: èle ka, yesus kako hari ciki, hèia ladhe nèdhi ana sabadeus, dhèu dua. a'a, ngara na yakobis, aa ari na, yohanis. dua ra dhu lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha sama-sama dènge ama ra. hèia yesus paroa dua ra, sèna ka madhutu ne.

source_text: they left the boat and their father immediately, and followed him.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare, hèia ra tèke eele ama dènge koha ra, lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: jesus traveled throughout galilee, teaching in the synagogues, telling the good news of the kingdom, and healing all the diseases and illnesses the people had.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si kako palème propensi galilea, ho na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. na aj'a lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa na peka j'ara-j'ara tasamia, sèna ka dhèu bisa madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti rupa-rupa papèd'a-tarègu.

source_text: news about him spread throughout the province of syria. they brought everyone who was sick to him: people troubled by seizures, the demon-possessed, those who were mentally ill, people who were paralyzed, and he healed all of them.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, tatao yesus ne dhèu lolo palème toke d'ai propensi siria aa'i-aa'i. hèia dhèu rèti dhèu ra dhu lèke rupa-rupa papèd'a asa yesus. dhèu se rèti kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dhu huj'u kahib'i, dènge dhu karuku. ka na puri-pa'èle aa'i si.

source_text: large crowds followed him from galilee, decapolis, jerusalem, judea, and the region beyond jordan.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne. dhèu se mai nèti propensi galilea, aa nèti rai canguru kota, dhu ra peka na, dekapolis. dhèu cahag'e mai nèti kota yerusalem, nèti propensi yudea, aa nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden.

source_text: when jesus saw the crowds following him he went up a mountain. there he sat down together with his disciples.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai madhutu ne, hèia na ca'e la'e asa ledhe iiki cue, ka na madhèdi ètu èèna. ana-ana madhutu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, mai padètu sèna ka nanene ne.

source_text: he began teaching them, saying:
target_text: hèia na aj'a-nori si, peka na,

source_text: blessed are those who recognize they are spiritually poor, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
target_text: dhèu kasia, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, ka dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
target_text: dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, rèngu oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pamaho'o d'ara si.

source_text: blessed are those who are kind for they will own the whole world.
target_text: dhèu haha oto, lula rèngu ka dhu bèli-camèd'a sèmi rare mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua moa tèke.

source_text: blessed are those whose greatest desire is to do what is right, for they will be satisfied.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara kateme dènge ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, nèngu ka dhu hia si ngaa dhu ra neo.

source_text: blessed are those who are merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
target_text: dhèu dhu pad'elo rasa kasia mi dhèu leo, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, ama lamatua kasia rèngu kahèi.

source_text: blessed are those who have pure minds, for they will see god.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu oto, lula èèna na, rèngu unu ra ladhe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: blessed are those who work to bring peace, for they will be called children of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu tema padame dhèu, rèngu oto, lula èèna na ama lamatua ka dhu peka na, ‘rèngu se'e ka, ana ja'a. '

source_text: blessed are those persecuted for what is right, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
target_text: dhèu dhu pasae j'aj'èra, lula ra madhutu ama lamatua, rèngu oto, lula lamatua mesa na ka, dhèu aae rèngu dhu hua iia.

source_text: blessed are you when people insult you and persecute you, and accuse you of all kinds of evil things because of me.
target_text: ladhe dhèu leo paj'èra miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a, miu oto kahèi. ladhe dhèu padhai kaked'u miu, aa lole pa'ele iie kolongara miu, miu oto kahèi.

source_text: be glad, be really glad, for you will receive a great reward in heaven-for they persecuted the prophets who came before you in just the same way.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu hud'i pakasee iisi aa pakarej'e d'ara, lula ama lamatua dhu sadia nare le pala dhu ae hia miu ètu sorga. te ngaa sanèd'e! mesa boe miu di dhu dui j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, te lod'o uru sèra dhèu dhu paj'èra le kahèi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: you are the salt of the earth, but if the salt becomes tasteless, how can you make it salty again? it's good for nothing, so it's thrown out and trodden down.
target_text: ladhe èdhi d'èi sèna ka nganga'a j'aj'i be'a, na, èdhi tao ku masi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, rèngu parluu miu. te ngaa ladhe masi sèro heka, gaguna na, ngaa? dhoka core eele di ètu j'ara, ho dhèu j'èli ne.

source_text: you are the light of the world. a city built on a hill can't be hidden.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi labhu kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa ladhe rèdhi miu dènge be'a. miu hud'i heo lo'a-lo'a ku, nuka sèmi kota ètu kolo ledhe, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi ne.

source_text: no one lights a lamp and then puts it under a bucket. no, it's placed on a lamp-stand and it provides light to everyone in the house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paheo labhu iiki, ra saguru boe ne dènge èru rai, te ngaa ra padhèdi labhu ne ètu era dedha, ho pasaraa aa'i d'ara èmu.

source_text: in the same way you should let your light shine before everyone so they can see the good things you do and praise your heavenly father.
target_text: miu hud'i mamuri ku sèmi èèna. mamuri miu hud'i saraa ku, sèna ka dhèu leo ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu dhu be'a. ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri miu sèmi èèna, ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ‘ira ii! ama miu ètu sorga, kapai titu kèna, nga! '

source_text: don't think i came to abolish the law or the writings of the prophets. i didn't come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
target_text: mage miu pangee na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka tao eele atora ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi musa. aa baku pangee na, ja'a pusi-pahae boe dènge ngaa dhu uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke le. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka pamèci j'ara aa'i-aa'i, nuka sèmi mia dhu ra peka tèke.

source_text: i assure you, until heaven and earth come to an end, not a single letter, not a single dot of the law will come to an end before everything is fulfilled.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, nanene paie-iie! liru dènge rai-haha bisa mèka laho aa'i, ladhe aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mèka madhutu atora ama lamatua. masi ka ca katèd'a èèna ka, bisa boe ele nèti atora se.

source_text: so whoever disregards the least important commandment, and teaches people to do so, will be called the least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches the commandments will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ladhe abhu dhu sisu atora ama lamatua, lula na pangee, na, ‘atora ne, ana iiki-iiki di, de gaguna na aad'o! ' hèia na aj'a sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo, pe ama lamatua ètu sorga, tao ne j'aj'i mi ca dhèu ana iiki. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, hèia na aj'a-nori dhèu leo sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pakab'ua ne.

source_text: i tell you, unless your moral rightness is more than that of the religious teachers and the pharisees, you can never enter the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! miu hud'i mamuri mola, risi nèti mese agama dènge dhèu partei agama parisi sèra. ladhe aad'o, na, miu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: you've heard that the law said to the people of long ago: ‘you shall not murder, and anyone who commits murder will be condemned as guilty. '
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘baku pamadhe dhèu, te dhèu cee dhu pamadhe dhèu nèngu lèke huku. '

source_text: but i tell you, anyone who is angry with his brother will be condemned as guilty. whoever calls his brother an idiot has to answer to the council, but whoever verbally abuses others is liable to the fire of gehenna.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku panasa, te dhèu cee dhu nasa dènge a'ari na, èèna na nèngu lèke huku. dhèu dhu jèke a'ari na, ka peka na, ‘èu bod'o kabao! ' pe nèngu la'e dhaa asa dhèu heka-dhèu heka agama. aa dhèu cee dhu jèke a'ari na, ‘goa, ee! ' nèngu lèke huku ètu ai naraka.

source_text: if you're at the altar making an offering, and remember that your brother has something against you,
target_text: de ladhe èu dhu mèti mèdha persembahan hia ama lamatua, te ngaa èu sanèd'e, na, abhu a'ari dhu nasa era dènge èu,

source_text: leave your offering on the altar and go and make peace with him first, and afterwards come back and make your offering.
target_text: tèke eele uuru ku mèdha persembahan sèra. hèia lamu padame ku dènge a'ari mu, èle, na heka mai hia persembahan se asa ama lamatua kèna.

source_text: while you're on the way to court with your opponent, make sure you settle things quickly. otherwise your opponent might hand you over to the judge, and the judge will hand you over to the court official, and you will be thrown into jail.
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu neo tao lii langu dènge èu, be'a risi lamu lai-lai ho padame dènge ne. ladhe aad'o, dhèu ne nèti èu asa hakim. hèia hakim saraka èu sa polisi, ka ra pamaso èu asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: i tell you the truth: you won't get out of there until you've paid every last penny.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e tare'a-re'a mi èu ne! èèna na èu pea taruu ètu d'ara bèdho, toke b'ae aa'i mèu-mèu kèlu-g'ètu èu sèra.

source_text: you've heard that the law said, ‘don't commit adultery. '
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘baku bersina. '

source_text: but i tell you that everyone who looks lustfully at a woman has already committed adultery with her in his mind.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a neo peka na, sèmi ne'e: dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi dhèu bhèni èci, hèia d'ara na neo j'unu pa'èci dènge ne, na, dhèu mone ne bersina le dènge bhèni ne ètu d'ara na.

source_text: if your right eye leads you to sin, then tear it out and throw it away, because it's better to lose one part of your body than to have your whole body thrown into the fire of gehenna.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sala pake musi madha g'ana èu, na, ed'o eele ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge musi madha cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge musi madha dua-dua.

source_text: if your right hand leads you to sin, then cut it off and throw it away, for it's better for you to lose one of your limbs than for your whole body to go into the fire of gehenna.
target_text: aa ladhe èu tao sala dènge kacui-aai g'ana èu, poro eele kacui-aai ne. te be'a risi èu maso sorga dènge kacui-aai cabèka di, aa baku ra pèci mu asa d'ara ai naraka dènge kacui-aai dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: the law also said, ‘if a man divorces his wife, he should give her a certificate of divorce. '
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, na, ‘dhèu dhu pa'ia dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, nèngu hud'i hia ku sasuri pa'ia mi bhèni èèna. '

source_text: but i tell you that any man who divorces his wife except for sexual immorality causes her to commit adultery, and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ia eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa bhèni ne tao nèdhi boe j'ara makae, hèia bhèni ne leo hari èmu, na, dhèu èmu uuru èèna ka dhu tao nèngu j'aj'i bersina. aa ladhe abhu dhèu mone dhu leo nare bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na ia eele, na, rèngu dua ra bersina kahèi.

source_text: and again, you've heard that the law said to the people of long ago, ‘you shall not perjure yourself. instead make sure you keep the oaths you swear to the lord. '
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa dhu na hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, peka na, ‘ladhe èu pajaji pake lii soo-subha, dhu ale kolongara ama lamatua, na, èu dhu pa'èki le dènge soo-subha èèna. '

source_text: but i tell you, don't swear at all. don't swear by heaven, because it's the throne of god.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe èu neo pajaji, na, mage mu j'oka subha. baku subha dènge ngara sorga, lula sorga èèna era pea ama lamatua.

source_text: don't swear by the earth, because it's god's footstool. don't swear by jerusalem, because it's the city of the great king.
target_text: mage subha pake ngara rai-haha, lula rai-haha ne, era bane haga ama lamatua. aa mage subha pake ngara yerusalem, lula yerusalem èèna, kota nèti dhèu aae kapai.

source_text: don't even swear by your head, because you're not able to make a single hair white or black.
target_text: baku subha pake ngara kab'a kètu miu. te miu dènge boe koasa ho paredha rèu kètu miu, sèna ka ca loa sa j'aj'i mèdhi do j'aj'i pudhi.

source_text: simply say yes or no-more than this comes from the evil one.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo pajaji, dhu peka oo, na, peka la ‘oo' di. te ngaa ladhe aad'o, na, peka la, ‘aad'o' di. ladhe miu peka risi nèti èèna, sèra sa j'aj'aj'i nèti nidhu.

source_text: you've heard that the law said, ‘an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth. '
target_text: miu dhu me'a le atora musa, dhu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu cee dhu pa'ele iie musi madha miu, na, pa'ele iie kahèi musi madha na. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakabhui eele ngutu èu, na, pakabhui eele ngutu na kahèi. '

source_text: but i tell you, don't resist someone who is evil. if someone slaps you on the right cheek, turn the other cheek to them as well.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, na hud'i laa, na tèb'e hari ripi dhu leo.

source_text: if someone wants to sue you in court and takes your shirt, give them your coat too.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo tenge lii langu dènge èu, ho neo nare kodho èu, na, hia ne kodho pana èu kahèi.

source_text: if someone demands that you go one mile, go with them two.
target_text: ladhe sordad'u ca dhèu laka-seti èu ho pasae mèdha na kako d'ai ca kilometer, na, èu pasae mèti kaj'èu na toke dua kilometer.

source_text: give to those who ask you, and don't turn away those who want to borrow from you.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo manèngi nare mèdha èu èci, na, hia la. aa ladhe dhèu neo pija mèdha èu, na, hia la.

source_text: you've heard that the law said, ‘love your neighbor and hate your enemy. '
target_text: miu tadèngi le, dhu peka na, ‘sue la a'ari èu, aa nasa la dènge dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu. '

source_text: but i tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: èu hud'i sue ku dhèu dhu nasa dènge èu, aa manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu.

source_text: so you may become children of your heavenly father. for his sun shines on both the good and the bad; and he makes the rain fall on both those who do right and those who do wrong.
target_text: ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu pad'elo, na, èu ana ama ètu sorga. lula nèngu ka tao madha lod'o hia dhèu dhu be'a, dènge dhèu dhu bhelu. na papuru èj'i hia dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha na, aa mi dhèu dhu lab'a paredha na kahèi.

source_text: for if you only love those who love you, what reward do you have? don't even the tax collectors do that?
target_text: de ladhe èu sue dhoka dhèu dhu sue èu, èu ngee na ama lamatua hud'i b'ala hia èu mèngi-nale, do? aad'o! te dhèu bhelu kahèi ne'a sue angalai na, dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: if you only speak kindly to your family, what more are you doing than anyone else? even the heathen do that!
target_text: de ladhe èu me'a dhoka hia lii maho'o mi angalai èu, na, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, re'a ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: grow up and become completely trustworthy, just as your heavenly father is trustworthy.
target_text: de sanèd'e, ee! ama mu ètu sorga sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. de èu hud'i tao madhutu ku sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: make sure not to do your good deeds in front of people, just so they can be seen. otherwise you won't have any reward from your father in heaven.
target_text: yesus aj'a taruu, peka na, sanèd'e! mage mi madhutu atora agama di, sèna ka dhèu pad'iri miu. te ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga b'ala boe rui-j'aj'èra miu.

source_text: when you give to the poor, don't be like the hypocrites who blow their own trumpets to announce what they're doing in the synagogues and in the streets so that people will praise them. i tell you the truth: they already have their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu kasia, mage lami palolo asa mia-mia. te ladhe miu se tao sèmi èèna, miu ca ropa dènge dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèmi sèra, d'èi lasi karihu asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘ira ii! dhèu ne maj'èni madhutu atora agama, nga! ' ja'a peka mola-mola kèna! dhèu dhu tema sèmi rare lii koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu, rèngu se abhu le pala ra.

source_text: when you give to the poor, don't let your left hand know what your right hand's doing.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, mage mi palolo kahèi!

source_text: that way what you give will be in secret, and your father who sees what happens in secret will reward you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne re'a boe. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a ngaa dhu miu tao pahuni. pe nèngu ka dhu b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: when you pray, don't be like the hypocrites, for they love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners so that people can see them. i promise you, they already have their reward.
target_text: lod'o miu sabaj'a, miu baku tao nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu se d'èi lasi asa j'ara dhu dhèu ae-ae, aa titu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho dhèu koa-kad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa nanene pabe'a-be'a! dènge rèngu abhu koa sèmi èèna, rèngu sèmi rare le pala ra.

source_text: but you, when you pray, go indoors and close the door, and pray to your father in private, and your father who sees what happens in private will reward you.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku sèmi èèna. ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i, lami asa d'ara kama ho bèdho babèdho na. èle èèna, heka mi sabaj'a mau-mau hia ama mi ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu leo rèdhi boe, te ngaa ama miu ladhe nèdhi. bèli-camèd'a na b'ala hia miu berkat ae-ae.

source_text: when you pray, don't babble on meaninglessly like the foreigners do, who think they will be heard because of all the words they repeat.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua sabaj'a sèmi èèna ka. rèngu pangee, na, ama lamatua d'èi nanene lii manèngi ra dhu madhera lola-lola èèna.

source_text: don't be like them, for your father knows what you need even before you ask him.
target_text: mage mi madhutu j'ara rèngu sèra! te masi ka miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa nèti ama mi ètu sorga, te ngaa nèngu dhu ne'a mema le, ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: so pray like this: our heavenly father, may your name be honored.
target_text: de ladhe sabaj'a, na, madhutu la conto sèmi ne'e: ‘ama ètu sorga! kolongara ama dhu mola-mèci. hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama dhu kapai èèna.

source_text: may your kingdom come! may your will be carried out in earth as it is in heaven.
target_text: hud'i laa ama j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i! hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi ana pajuu ama, tao madhutu paredha ama ètu sorga.

source_text: please give to us today the food we need.
target_text: ama, hia la ji'i nganga'a-nganginu dhu d'ai bèli-bèli.

source_text: forgive our sins, just as we have forgiven those who have sinned against us.
target_text: ji'i manèngi, ho ama saku eele aa'i sasala-sasigo ji'i, nuka sèmi ji'i kahèi pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu dhu ra tao mi ji'i.

source_text: please don't let us give in to temptation, and save us from the evil one.
target_text: ama, j'aga la ji'i, sèna ka ji'i baku tao bhabhelu. aa pakaj'èu la ji'i nèti koasa nidhu, te ama ka dhèu aae dhu koasa kapai risi eele. aa ama ka dhu mèd'u paredha, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. sabaj'a ji'i d'ai sange ne'e ka, ama. amin. '

source_text: for if you forgive those who sin against you, your heavenly father will also forgive you.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, èèna na ama mi ètu sorga saku eele sasala-sasigo miu kahèi.

source_text: but if you don't forgive those who sin against you, then your heavenly father won't forgive your sins.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhu dhèu tao mi miu, bèli-camèd'a ama mi bhèlu boe sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: when you fast, don't be like the hypocrites who put on sad faces and make themselves look terrible so that everyone can see they're fasting. i tell you the truth, they already have their reward.
target_text: ladhe miu manèngi-mangaj'i aa puasa, mage mi tao rèhu susa, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo. te ra ad'u-ue j'ara èèna, ho dhèu pad'iri si, peka na, ‘dhèu se'e se, dhèu mola-mèci! ' te ngaa sanèd'e, ee! dènge sèmi rare koa-kad'iri sèmi èèna, na, rèngu abhu le pala ra.

source_text: instead, when you fast, wash your face and look smart,
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu puasa, lèu pamèu-mèu rèhu mi, aa sageri paie kètu miu!

source_text: so that people won't see you're fasting, and your unseen father who sees what happens in private will reward you.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu rèdhi miu, re'a boe na, miu dhu puasa. te ngaa ama miu ne'a. pe na pala hia miu mèngi-nale ae-ae.

source_text: don't pile up wealth here on earth where moths and rust ruin it, and where thieves break in and steal it.
target_text: miu baku sab'a taruu, ho dhodhoka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne di. te hub'u dènge rutu pa'ele iie aa'i si. aa dhèu mana'u mai pa'ele iie era tatèka mèdha-panyau, aa mana'u rèti si.

source_text: instead, you should store up your wealth in heaven, where moths and rust don't ruin it, and where thieves don't break in and steal it.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi miu maj'èni sab'a, sèna ka pakaboko mèdha-panyau ae-ae ètu sorga. te ètu era nèi, abhu boe hub'u dènge rutu dhu pa'ele iie si, aa abhu boe dhèu mana'u, ho mai mana'u rèti.

source_text: for what you value the most shows who you really are.
target_text: te ladhe miu tèka mèdha-panyau miu ètu era mia, na, tatu d'ara miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: the eye is like a lamp that lights the body. so if your eye is healthy, then your whole body will have light.
target_text: musi madha dhèu, nuka sèmi labhu dhu pasaraa d'ara ra. ladhe musi madha na mèu, nèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hua iia, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: but if your eye is evil, then your whole body will be in the dark. if the ‘light' you have is actually darkness, how dark is that!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe musi madha na ahu, nèngu bisa boe kako madhutu madha j'ara mola, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu gogo ai lae-lae ètu d'ara maroga. de ladhe saraa ètu d'ara miu j'aj'i maroga, na miu mamuri d'ara maroga kahèi.

source_text: no one can serve two masters. either you'll hate one and love the other, or you'll be devoted to one and despise the other. you can't serve both god and money.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe sab'a hia dua lamatua, lula èèna na nèngu d'èi risi ca dhèu di. bisa kahèi nèngu madhutu lamatua èci, aa pusi-pahae boe dhu leo. nèti èèna ka, èu bisa boe peka na, ‘ama lamatua èèna, lamatua ja'a, ' ladhe èu tao doi-dhari j'aj'i mi lamatua èu.

source_text: that's why i'm telling you not to worry about your life. don't worry about what to eat, or what to drink, or what clothes to put on. isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: baku bhute pangee, na, ja'a mamuri tasa mera mia, ku'a-kinu ngaa, pake ngaa? miu pangee na, mamuri ne dhoka ta'a-tinu, di? aa ngi'u ne, dhoka pake mèdha-papake, di? aad'o sèmi èèna.

source_text: look at the birds-they don't sow or reap or store food in barns, for your heavenly father feeds them. aren't you worth more than they are?
target_text: ladhe ku manu-bhui dhu lela ètu talora liru. rèngu bhute rèdhi boe sèla hini, dènge puu-g'ètu, ho tèka nganga'a ètu d'ara soka. te ngaa ama miu ètu sorga piara manu-bhui sèra taruu. tatu nèngu kab'oi miu risi eele nèti rèngu. de ngee pabe'a-be'a. te ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti manu-bhui sèra.

source_text: who of you by worrying can add a minute to your life?
target_text: ladhe dhèu titu ètu madha tèru, ho na bhute dènge lalau ngi'u na, nèngu bisa pamadhera hari ngi'u na, do? bisa boe!

source_text: and why are you worried about clothes? look at the beautiful flowers in the field. see how they grow: they don't work hard, they don't spin thread.
target_text: ladhe bisa boe, na, nga tao ka miu bhute dènge pangee hari mèdha-papake? lami ladhe ku hela bunga dhu muri tab'a ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. rèngu manyèru boe hèngu, aa manènu boe sig'i sa hèi.

source_text: but i tell you, not even solomon in all his glory was dressed like one of these flowers.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e ku la! mèdha-papake dhèu aae soleman dhu kab'ua risi, saraga na bisa boe segi saraga hela bunga ne.

source_text: so if god decorates the fields like this, grass which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, won't he do much more for you, you people who trust so little?
target_text: te ama lamatua taru kira mi bunga dhu muri dhoka doe ne'e, aa bèli madhe, ho dhèu core asa d'ara ai. ladhe na tao sèmi èèna, tatu nèngu papake miu risi eele nèti hela bunga sèra. de tasamia ka miu parcaya pa'èra boe mi nèngu?

source_text: so don't worry, saying, ‘what shall we eat? ' or ‘what shall we drink? ' or ‘what shall we wear? '
target_text: de baku mi pangee na, ‘ji'i neo nga'a ngaa? ' do, ‘neo nginu ngaa? ' do, ‘neo pake ngaa? '

source_text: these are all the things that the heathen chase after, but your heavenly father knows everything you need.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua, rèngu sab'a loe boe ho neo abhu aa'i-aa'i se. te ngaa miu baku tao sèmi èèna, te ama miu ètu sorga dhu ne'a aa'i le, ngaa-ngaa dhu miu parluu.

source_text: seek his kingdom first, and his way of living right, and everything will be given to you.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pakako uuru ku sasab'a na, aa hud'i madhutu ku paredha na, heka na hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu.

source_text: so don't worry about tomorrow, because tomorrow can worry about itself. there's already enough evil in every day.
target_text: de baku bhute pangee, na, bèli miu parluu ngaa. te bèli èèna dènge bhabhute unu na. sasusa lod'o doe ne'e, èle ètu doe ne'e kahèi.

source_text: don't judge others, so that you won't be judged.
target_text: miu baku galaa dhèu, sèna ka ama lamatua baku pasala miu kahèi.

source_text: for whatever standard you use to judge others will be used to judge you, and whatever measurement you use to measure others will be used to measure you.
target_text: ladhe miu nile dhèu sèmi mia, pe ama lamatua nile miu sèmi èèna kahèi. ladhe miu ige sasala dhèu sèmi mia, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ige sasala miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: why do you see the speck that's in your brother's eye? don't you notice the plank that's in your own eye?
target_text: masi ka sasala dhèu ciki oo'e èèna ka, èu bhèlu boe. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu pame'a boe ciki sa. èci èèna ka dènge èu ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai èu, te ngaa abhu agarii aae ca laa dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, dhu èu me'a more boe.

source_text: how can you say to your brother, ‘let me take out that speck from your eye' when you have a plank in your own eye?
target_text: nga tao ka èu bani peka na, ‘angalai! mai ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu'. aa te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, lula agarii aae dhu hutu nare musi madha mu.

source_text: you're being hypocritical! first get rid of the plank that's in your own eye. then you'll be able to see clearly to take out the speck from your brother's eye.
target_text: heeh! èu ne, mema dhèu dhu padhai lii leo, tao leo! tao eele uuru ku agarii nèti musi madha èu, heka ladhe mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu d'ara madha angalai mu, sèna ka èu bisa tiu eele ahu ne kèna.

source_text: don't give dogs what's holy. don't throw your pearls to pigs. that way the pigs won't trample them underfoot, and the dogs won't turn and attack you.
target_text: baku aj'a j'ara lamatua dhu mola-mèci mi dhèu dhu d'èi pahahe dhèu. lula dhèu sèra nuka sèmi busa pakadhi, dhu ra kabèli mai kadhi hari miu. rèngu sèra goa sama sèmi hahi kahèi. ladhe dhèu hia ne mutiara dhu kab'ua, na pusi boe! te ne'a dhoka j'èli palaho di.

source_text: ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.
target_text: ladhe miu sabaj'a, baku loe manèngi mi lamatua; te èèna na, na hia. ladhe patangi-tenge; pe na pad'elo j'ara. ladhe kad'eu taruu babèdho; pe na bhoke.

source_text: everyone who asks, receives; everyone who seeks, finds; and everyone who knocks has the door opened for them.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu loe boe manèngi mi lamatua, èèna na ra sèmi rare. dhu patangi-tenge, pe ra abhu. dhu kad'eu taruu, pe na bhoke èmu.

source_text: would any of you give your son a stone if he asked for bread?
target_text: miu pangee sèku! ladhe ana manèngi roti, tatu ama na hia boe ne hadhu, si?

source_text: or if he asked for fish, would you give him a snake?
target_text: do, ladhe ana manèngi i'a, ama na hia boe mege, sina ma?

source_text: so if even you who are evil know to give good things to your children, how much more will your heavenly father give good things to those who ask him.
target_text: ama mi ètu sorga, mema d'ara na hua iia titu kèna! de ladhe dhèu rai-haha dhu bhelu-katub'a sèmi miu, me'a hia mèdha dhu be'a mi ana miu, ngaa hari ama mi! tatu na bagi hia miu ngaa dhu miu manèngi.

source_text: treat others the way you want them to treat you. this sums up the law and the prophets.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu èu neo dhèu leo tao mi èu, na, èu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi hia nèngu. lula ne'e ne ka, j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka-padhai karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: enter by the narrow entrance. for the entrance is wide, and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and many travel that way.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo maso sorga, nèngu hud'i maso ku re hèb'a kota dhu kob'o. te ngaa mage-mage, oo! abhu kahèi j'ara leo dhu mud'a, aa hèb'a dhu taleo, dhu dhèu ae-ae lasi re èèna. te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu lere dhèu asa naraka, ka ra cèri eele nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: but the entrance is narrow, and the way is difficult that leads to life, and only a few find it.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo maso sorga, hud'i madhutu ku j'ara dhu susa, aa maso re hèb'a dhu kob'o. te, masi ka dhèu ciki di dhu kako re j'ara èèna, te ngaa j'ara dhu kob'o èèna ka, dhu nèti dhèu asa lamatua.

source_text: watch out for false prophets who come wearing sheep's clothing, but who on the inside are vicious wolves.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu dhu tema kapod'e-kabèli, dhu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, rèngu se dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. te rèngu tao ngi'u ra be'a nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka dènge busa hui dhu mai kadhi kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: you can recognize them by their fruits. do people harvest grapes from thorn bushes, or figs from thistles?
target_text: tasamia ho miu bisa tadhe dhèu dhu kapod'e sèmi sèra? ladhe la nèti tatao rèngu. èèna sèmi dhèu ladhe rèdhi hua, hèia tadhe dènge ana aaj'u ne. hua dhu be'a, mai boe nèti aj'u dhu karehe.

source_text: so every good tree produces good fruit, while a bad tree produces bad fruit.
target_text: te aj'u dhu be'a ladhe d'ai hua, hua na be'a kahèi. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe ladhe na hua, hua na karehe kahèi.

source_text: a good tree can't produce bad fruit, and a bad tree can't produce good fruit.
target_text: abhu ètu mia, aj'u dhu be'a, hua na karehe, aa aj'u dhu karehe, hua na be'a?

source_text: every tree that doesn't produce good fruit is chopped down and thrown into the fire.
target_text: aj'u dhu hua na karehe, tatu ra patue eele, ho core asa d'ara ai.

source_text: so you'll recognize them by their fruits.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge rèngu dhu rèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli sèra. miu tadhe si nèti tatao ra.

source_text: not everyone who calls me ‘lord, lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven-only those who do the will of my father in heaven.
target_text: èèna na abhu dhèu dhu paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua! ' te ngaa rèngu dhoka ale ètu hèb'a di. bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua ètu sorga tule eele si. te dhodhoka dhèu dhu d'èi tao madhutu dad'èi nèngu di, dhu na sèmi nare rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: many will say to me at the day of judgment, ‘lord, lord, didn't we prophesy in your name and drive out demons in your name, and perform many miracles in your name? '
target_text: pe ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, dhèu ae mangaku, peka na, ja'a ne lamatua rèngu. aa dènge lii solo-mako, ra peka na, ‘lamatua! ji'i se la'a pakako a'aj'a lamatua ètu mia-mia, babège nidhu dènge kolongara lamatua, aa tao tadha-tadha malaa pake koasa nèti lamatua. '

source_text: then i will tell them, ‘i never knew you. leave me, you people who practice wickedness! '
target_text: masi ka rèngu solo-mako ja'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a peka dènge rèngu, na, ‘miu se, cee? ja'a tadhe boe miu, te miu mamuri boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. de mi pakaj'èu ka nèti ne'e! '

source_text: everyone that hears the words i say, and follows them, is like a wise man who built his house on solid rock.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, hèia ra tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a, rèngu se nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu, dhu patitu èmu ra ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: the rain poured down, and the floods rose, and the winds blew hard against the house, but it didn't fall down, because its foundations were on solid rock.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala, aa ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne. te ngaa èmu ne guri boe, lula patitu ètu dedha hadhu kapua.

source_text: everyone that hears the words i say, and doesn't follow them, is like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene ja'a, te ngaa tao boe madhutu lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu goa dhu patitu èmu na ètu dedha salae.

source_text: the rain poured down, and the floods rose, and the winds blew hard against the house, and it fell down-it totally collapsed.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka èj'i aae mai toke èi lala. ngèlu aae lèke èmu ne kahèi. hèia èmu ne guri eele, toke laho teb'o-teb'o.

source_text: when jesus finished explaining these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha, lula nanene a'aj'a na,

source_text: for he taught like someone with authority, and not like their religious teachers.
target_text: te nèngu ne'a mèu isi nèti a'aj'a ne. na aj'a-nori sèmi boe mese agama sèra.

source_text: large crowds followed jesus once he'd come down from the mountain.
target_text: lod'o yesus puru nèti ledhe, hèia dhèu ae-ae lasi madhutu ne.

source_text: a leper approached him and bowed down, worshiping him, and said, lord, if you're willing, please heal me.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ca dhèu dhu pèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge ne. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ho manèngi, aku nèngu na, lamatua! sue ku ja'a la! ladhe mo'o, na, puri ku papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a, aa ja'a bisa hari sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: jesus reached out and touched him with his hand. i am willing, he said. be healed! immediately he was healed from his leprosy.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ka na g'ag'e dhèu ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ko'o! èu èle kèna! kabèdhi la, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: make sure you don't tell anyone, jesus told him. go and show yourself to the priest and give the offering which moses required as public proof.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sanèd'e paie! èu èle le nèti papèd'a-tarègu, te ngaa baku èu lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. aa èu hud'i madhutu ku atora musa. de lamu asa ama agama ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a na èi papèd'a mu ele le, tare'a, do dhae. èle na, èu hia persembahan tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, èu ne èle tare'a-re'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: when jesus entered capernaum, a centurion came up to him, begging for help,
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus maso asa d'ara rae kapernaum. ètu era ne'e, komedhaa sordad'u roma ca dhèu, mai manèngi ho yesus soru-bara ne, aku nèngu na,

source_text: lord, my servant is at home, lying down, unable to move. he's in terrible agony.
target_text: ama! ana sab'a ja'a ca dhèu, pèd'a aae, ka na j'èra titu kèna ètu èmu. na bisa boe puru nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: i will come and heal him, jesus replied.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, oo! pe ja'a dhiu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: the centurion answered, lord, i don't merit a visit to my home. just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! ama roca ia ka mai asa èmu ja'a, lula ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a. sad'i ama ku peka dhoka lii ca hèb'a di nèti ne'e, tatu ana sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: for i am myself under the authority of superiors, while i also have soldiers under my command. i command one, ‘go! ' and he goes. i command another, ‘come! ' and he comes. i tell my servant, ‘do this! ' and he does it.
target_text: ja'a ke'a j'ara ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha sordad'u ja'a sèra. ladhe ja'a pua, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu na la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘mai asa ne'e! ' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a paleha dhèu sab'a ja'a, peka na, ‘sab'a ne'e! ' tatu na tao madhutu. de sad'i ama ku lii di, tatu ana sab'a ja'a èèna, èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: when jesus heard what he said, he was astonished. he told those who were following him, i tell you the truth, i haven't found this kind of trust anywhere in israel.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare, hèia na malaa. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a dhae paraga kèdhi mèka dènge ca dhèu sa nèti dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: i tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and sit down with abraham and isaac and jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu leo rai kara ae-ae, nuka sèmi dhèu roma ne, mai nèti haa, nèti dhimu, ho madhèdi ra'a-rinu mei èci dènge abraham, isak dènge yakob ètu d'ara èmu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but the heirs of the kingdom will be thrown out into utter darkness where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.
target_text: masi ka lamatua dhu hag'e nare le dhèu yahudi, sena ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, te ngaa ae ka dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. èèna na, lamatua tule eele si asa era dhu maroga kiu-kiu. ètu era ne'e, ra tangi roma iisi d'ara pèd'a, aa ra j'èra titu kèna.

source_text: then jesus told the centurion, go home. because you trusted that it would happen, what you asked for has been done. the servant was healed right away.
target_text: padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge komedhaa ne, lèpa ka. te ana sab'a èu èèna èle le, madhutu sèmi parcaya èu ne. ka lod'o dhu na padhai èèna, ana ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: when jesus arrived at peter's house, he saw that peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with a high fever.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e asa èmu petrus. na ladhe nèdhi ina dhèu èmu petrus dhu j'unu ètu dedha koi, dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro.

source_text: he touched her hand and the fever left her. she got up and began making him a meal.
target_text: ka yesus kèpe kacui-aai na, hèia ina ne èle nèti papèd'a na. hèia na kèd'i, ka la'e lalau nganga'a hia yesus si.

source_text: when evening came they brought many who were demon-possessed to jesus. he made the spirits leave at his command, and he healed all those who were sick.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu sèra mai rèti dhèu rèngu dhu nidhu tao. hèia na paredha nidhu se, peka na, eee, nidhu! rai pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! hèia nidhu se kalua dènge ka. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: this fulfilled what the prophet isaiah said: he healed our diseases, and freed us from our illnesses.
target_text: na tao j'ara se, ho pamèci dènge lii dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu èdhi. aa pasae nare j'aj'èra èdhi.

source_text: when jesus saw the crowds around him, he gave instructions that they should go to the other side of the lake.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus nèdhi dhèu ae-ae mai kalibhu rare ne. hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, mai pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: one of the religious teachers approached him and said, teacher, i will follow you wherever you go!
target_text: hèia mese agama ca dhèu mai, padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, ama mese! sad'i ama asa mia èèna ka, ja'a bera-bera dènge ama!

source_text: foxes have their dens, and wild birds have their nests, but the son of man has nowhere he can lie down and rest, jesus told him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, be'a kahèi do! te ngaa sanèd'e. dhèu rai-haha aa badha-manu aa'i-aa'i, dhu dènge era pea-palu'u. busa hui lèpa asa ro'a na. manu-bhui la'e asa rèd'a na. te ngaa ja'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne dènge boe era pea-palu'u. nanèlu ho bane kètu dènge boe kahèi.

source_text: another disciple said to jesus, lord, first let me go and bury my father.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu èci hari mai peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ja'a neo madhutu ama, te ngaa hud'i ja'a ladhe-leru ku ina-ama ja'a. ladhe ama ku madhe, ho padhane kore, heka ja'a madhutu kèna.

source_text: follow me! leave the dead to bury their own dead, jesus replied.
target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! hud'i laa dhèu leo dhu parcaya boe lamatua padhane dhèu madhe. te ladhe èu neo madhutu ja'a, na, madhutu la dènge d'ara kateme!

source_text: then jesus got into a boat and his disciples went with him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha, palere dènge ana-ana madhutu na.

source_text: a violent storm suddenly blew up, and waves crashed over the boat, but jesus went on sleeping.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano era, yesus bhèj'i. kaca'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha aae tèb'e koha ne, toke èi maso asa d'ara.

source_text: the disciples went over to him and woke him up. save us, lord! we're going to drown! they shouted.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se lasi parèi yesus, aku rèngu na, ama! ama! kèd'i ku la! bara ku ji'i, te èdhi molo madhe aa'i ti kèna!

source_text: why are you so afraid? why do you trust so little? he asked them. then he got up, and commanded the winds and the waves to stop. everything became absolutely calm.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, wee! nga tao ka miu se madha'u sèmi ne'e ne? miu parcaya boe ja'a, do? ka na kèd'i. èle ka na kai ngèlu dènge naha ètu d'ara dano ne, peka na, mau ka! hèia naha dènge ngèlu mau dènge ka.

source_text: the disciples were astonished, and said, who is this? even the winds and the waves obey him!
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus se malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, ira ii! cee ka dhèu ne'e ne? tasamia ka na bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka madhutu dad'èi na?

source_text: when he arrived on the other side, in the region of the gadarenes, two demon-possessed men came out of the graveyard to meet him. they were so dangerous that nobody dared to travel that way.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ètu rai gad'ara. ètu era nèi, abhu dhèu dua dhu nidhu tao. rèngu pea ètu era ro'a dhèu madhe. dua ra se'e bhelu titu kèna, toke abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi dhu bani kako re era èèna. ropa rèdhi yesus mai, hèia

source_text: they shouted out, what have you got to do with us, you son of god? have you come to torture us before our time?
target_text: ra pa'oo, peka na, we, ana ama lamatua! nga tao ka èu mai gagu ji'i se? masi ka d'ai mèka lod'o ho hia hahuku mi ji'i, te ngaa èu mai le ho neo paj'èra ji'i!

source_text: in the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
target_text: kaj'èu boe ètu era èèna, abhu hahi canau dhu nyuu rai, tenge nganga'a.

source_text: the demons pleaded with him, if you're going to drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.
target_text: hèia nidhu se manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, ladhe babèga eele ji'i, na, pua la ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèi!

source_text: go! said jesus. the demons left the men and went into the pigs. the whole herd ran down the steep hillside into the sea and drowned.
target_text: hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, peka na, lami ka! hèia nidhu kalua tèke eele dhèu dua se, lasi maso asa d'ara hahi deo sa. ka hahi se rai paceb'a re sebhe ledhe ka manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia ra cèna, ka madhe aa'i si.

source_text: the pig herders ran away. they went to the town and told the people there everything that had taken place, and what had happened to the demon-possessed men.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenga hahi, rai lasi asa d'ara rae, hèia ra lolo ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: the whole town came out to meet jesus. when they found him, they begged him to leave their district.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, dhèu ae lasi asa era èèna. d'ai nèi, ra rèdhi yesus. hèia ra pakaseti yesus, ho pakèd'i nèti rae rèngu ne.

source_text: so jesus took a boat back across the lake to the town where he lived.
target_text: èle èèna, yesus si ca'e hari koha, lèpa asa ca bèka dano. ka rèngu puru ètu kota na.

source_text: there they brought to him a paralyzed man lying on a mat. when jesus saw how they trusted him, he told the paralyzed man, my friend, cheer up! your sins are forgiven.
target_text: ètu era ne'e dhèu j'èru rèti angalai ra dhu karuku asa yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi, yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu parcaya ne, peka na, nèngu bisa puri-pa'èle angalai ra. hèia na peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana! pa'èra d'ara èu! te ja'a saku eele le sasala èu.

source_text: in response some of the religious teachers said to themselves, he's speaking blasphemy!
target_text: te ngaa ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama yahudi dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus èèna. ka ra nasa, hèia ra papeka, na, dhèu ne'e ne bani titu kèna peka sèmi èèna! dhodhoka ama lamatua di dhu bisa abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. te ngaa lii padhai dhèu ne tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua sa. nèngu ne pahaha ama lamatua!

source_text: but jesus knew what they were thinking. he asked them, why are you thinking evil thoughts in your minds?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a d'ara rèngu. nèti èèna ka na lii, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu se pangee, na, ja'a ne pahaha ama lamatua?

source_text: what is easier to say, ‘your sins are forgiven, ' or ‘get up and walk'?
target_text: mia ka dhu mud'a risi? ladhe ja'a peka dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a saku eele le sasala èu, ' do, ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: but to convince you that the son of man does have the authority to forgive sins… he said to the paralyzed man, get up, pick up your mat, and go home!
target_text: ladhe na kèd'i dènge ka, miu heka mèdhi, na, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. te ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala dhèu. hèia yesus paredha dhèu karuku ne, peka na, kèd'i ka! ded'e mèti ka karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: the man got up and went home.
target_text: ka dhèu karuku ne kèd'i, hèia na lèpa dènge ka.

source_text: when the crowds saw what had happened, they were scared. then they praised god that he had given human beings such power.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua, kapai risi eele! na hia koasa kapai sèmi ne'e, hia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: as jesus moved on from there he saw a man called matthew sitting at the tax booth. jesus called to him, follow me! he got up, and followed jesus.
target_text: èle ka yesus la'e nèti era èèna, hèia ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu roro doi bea dhu sab'a ètu kantor bea. ngara dhèu ne, mateos. hèia yesus gale ne, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi nare, hèia mateos kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: while jesus was eating at matthew's home, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down at the table with jesus and his disciples.
target_text: ka mateos nèru yesus si lasi ra'a-rinu asa èmu na. na nèru kahèi mone aanga-angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, aa tamu dhu leo kahèi, ho ra'a-rinu dènge rèngu.

source_text: when the pharisees saw this they asked jesus' disciples, why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?
target_text: te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei parisi, mai ka'ugu ètu madha ana-ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu guna boe se, nuka sèmi dhèu roro bea dènge angalai ra dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra?

source_text: when jesus heard the question, he replied, those who are well don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe parluu boe.

source_text: go and discover what this means: ‘i want mercy, not sacrifice. ' for i didn't come to call those who do what's right-i came to call sinners.
target_text: be'a risi lami parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te uru èèna, na pua hosea, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai na, dhu suri peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a nuka, dhèu-dhèu ja'a hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, aa pad'elo rasa kasia. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu sèmi èèna, na, badha korban rèngu dhu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' ne'e ne ka dhu ama lamatua peka tèke le. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu dhèu mola, te ngaa ja'a mai sèna ka ladhe-leru dhèu dhu laku-laku boe.

source_text: then the disciples of john came and asked, why is that we and the pharisees fast frequently, but your disciples don't?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani sèra, mai sa yesus. dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ji'i dhu madhutu yohanis tema puasa. aa dhèu parisi puasa kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka ana madhutu ama sèra loe boe ra'a-rinu? rèngu re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: do wedding guests mourn while the bridegroom is with them? jesus responded. but the time is coming when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and then they will fast.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa dènge lii pakasame, na, sèmi ne'e: ladhe pesta kab'i, tamu sèra puasa boe, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe pengantin mone dènge rèngu era, aa'i-aa'i ra ra'a-rinu palere-lere. te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo rai rèti ka pengantin mone ne, hèia mone aanga-angalai na, d'ara ra susa, de heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: no one puts a new patch on old clothes, otherwise it will shrink and make the tear worse.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe rare bèla hiu ca èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ropa base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a deo na karuku, na kodho deo na asa mae aae.

source_text: no one puts new wine in old wineskins either, otherwise the wineskins will burst, spilling the wine and ruining the wineskins. no, new wine is put into new wineskins, and both last.
target_text: j'ara sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge dhua dhu heka rèti mai nèti kapua, bisa boe bhori asa d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na sabha ne madhore, hèia dhua bhori eele asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu, sèna ka dua ra be'a taruu! dènge sèmi ne'e, yesus nori si, peka na, a'aj'a na dhu hiu, baku pakihu dènge a'aj'a dhu dhui.

source_text: while he was telling them this, one of the leading officials came and bowed before him. my daughter has just died, the man told jesus. but if you come and place your hand on her, i know she will come back to life.
target_text: ètu d'ara yesus padhai lii era dènge ana madhutu yohanis sèra, hèia kapala nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i mai paraga dènge ne. ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a heka madhe kèna. de lati ho ama bane ai mi ana ne, sèna ka na mamuri hari.

source_text: jesus and his disciples got up and followed him.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu na, madhutu dènge ka dhèu deo na.

source_text: at that moment a woman who had been sick with bleeding for twelve years came up behind him and touched the hem of his cloak. she had told herself, if i can just touch his cloak, i'll be healed.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, ca dhèu ina kako la'e madhutu si. bhèni ne lèke papèd'a bhèni, dhu loe boe ciki sa d'ai canguru dua tèu kèna. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke kodho yesus di, tatu èi papèd'a ja'a ne èle. nèti èèna ka, na ara padètu la'e, hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus.

source_text: jesus turned and saw her. be happy, for your trust in me has healed you, he told her. the woman was immediately healed.
target_text: yesus dhu ne'a, hèia na kabib'a, ladhe sa ina ne. ka na lii, peka na, ina, ee! pa'èra la d'ara èu. te, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèti èèna ka èu èle nèti papèd'a. hèia bhèni ne èle dènge ka.

source_text: jesus arrived at the official's house. he saw the flute-players and the crowd that was weeping loudly.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si lasi taruu asa èmu nèti kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. d'ai era nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara, hèia na ladhe nèdhi dhèu dhu tema karihu musiik mamadhe, dènge dhèu ae dhu tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: please leave, he told them, for the girl isn't dead, she's just asleep. but they laughed and made fun of him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ae eele ka tangi, aa lami ka èmu miu! te ana ne madhe boe, dhoka na bhèj'i di. te ngaa dhèu se mari dènge pakapengo hèb'a mi yesus.

source_text: but once the crowd had been sent out, he went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
target_text: èle ka, dhèu se aa'i-aa'i lasi asa li'u. ka yesus maso asa d'ara kama ana bhèni ne. na kèpe ai ana ne, hèia ana ne mamuri dènge ka.

source_text: news of what happened spread throughout that region.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne, ka dhèu mulai palolo lème ètu kabarai ra, lula-nèti ngaa dhu yesus tao ne.

source_text: as jesus continued on from there, two blind men followed him, shouting, son of david, please have mercy on us!
target_text: èle, hèia yesus kako taruu. ètu talora j'ara, abhu dhèu bèdhu dhèu dua dhu madhutu ne. dua ra rodhe, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ji'i la!

source_text: when jesus arrived at the house where he was staying, the blind men came in too. are you convinced that i'm able to do this? he asked them. yes, lord, they replied.
target_text: ropa yesus maso asa d'ara èmu cue, dhèu bèdhu se lasi paraga dènge ne. ka yesus karèi dua ra, peka na, miu se lèka tare'a-re'a, na, ja'a ne dènge koasa ho puri-pa'èle miu, sèna ka bisa ladhe mèdhi, do? hèia dua ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama karèi ia ka, te ji'i dhu lèka mema-mema le.

source_text: then jesus touched their eyes, and said, because of your trust in me it will happen!
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii dhaa dua ra, hèia yesus g'ag'e musi madha ra, ka na peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i ka madhutu parcaya miu.

source_text: and they could see. then jesus warned them, make sure nobody knows about this.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, hèia dua ra ladhe rèdhi dènge ka. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, peka na, baku miu peka dènge ca dhèu sa, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le!

source_text: but they went and spread the word about jesus everywhere.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se taha rare boe d'ara ra. ka ra kako palème kabarai èèna, lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, tatao yesus mi rèngu dua ra.

source_text: as jesus and his disciples were leaving, a man was brought to him who was dumb and demon-possessed.
target_text: ropa dhèu bèdhu se lasi, dhèu rèti dhèu leo hari èci asa yesus. dhèu ne bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: once the demon had been thrown out of him, the dumb man spoke, and the crowds were amazed. nothing ever happened like this before in israel, they said.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, hèia yesus paredha nidhu kalua nèti dhèu lii aad'o ne. nidhu èèna kalua, ka dhèu ne padhai lii dènge ka. hèia dhèu ae ètu era èèna malaa, ka ra peka na, ira ii! èdhi dhèu yahudi paraga tèdhi mèka madha j'ara sèmi ne'e ne!

source_text: but the pharisees remarked, he throws out demons using the power of the chief of demons.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parisi ka'uu, peka na, dhèu aae nidhu ka dhu hia ne koasa, sèna ka na bisa babège eela nidhu.

source_text: jesus went all over, visiting the towns and villages. he taught in their synagogues, telling them about the good news of the kingdom, and he healed all kinds of sicknesses and diseases.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae, sèna ka aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a sèra. na aj'a dhèu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua, aa j'ara tasamia rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. na puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: when he saw the crowds, jesus was deeply moved with compassion for them, because they were troubled and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae se, hèia na taha nare boe d'ara, lula dhèu se re'a heka tao sèmi ngaa sa. te rèngu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe dhèu madhenga.

source_text: he told his disciples, the harvest is large, but there are only a few workers.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae se, nuka sèmi nganga'a ae-ae ètu d'ara oka-tedhe. masi ka nganga'a ae titu kèna, te ngaa dhèu sab'a d'ai boe ho puu-g'ètu, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara gud'a.

source_text: pray to the lord of the harvest, and ask him to send more workers for his harvest.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i manèngi ku mi lamatua oka, sèna ka na tabha hari dhèu sab'a, ho lasi puu-g'ètu isi oka se.

source_text: jesus called his twelve disciples together and gave them power to throw out evil spirits, and to heal all kinds of diseases and sicknesses.
target_text: èle ka, yesus paroa ana madhutu na, sèna ka mai pakaboko. hèia na hia si koasa ho babège eele nidhu aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: these are the names of the twelve apostles: first, simon also called peter, andrew his brother, james the son of zebedee, john his brother,
target_text: ana madhutu na dhu na pua sèra, dhèu canguru dua, nuka: partama, ngara na simon dhu dhèu tema paroa ne, ‘petrus', dènge ari na, anderias, yakobis, dènge ari na, yohanis dua ra ana sabadeus,

source_text: philip, bartholomew, thomas, matthew the tax collector, james the son of alphaeus, thaddeus,
target_text: pelipus, bertolomeos, tomas, mateos dhèu roro doi bea, yakobis dhu leo nuka ana alpius, tadius,

source_text: simon the revolutionary, and judas iscariot, who betrayed jesus.
target_text: simon nèti partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: jesus sent out these twelve, telling them, don't go to the foreigners, or to any samaritan city. you are to go to the lost sheep of the house of israel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua ana madhutu na canguru dua dhèu sèra, aa paredha si, peka na, ja'a pua miu lami asa dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra, lula ae nèti rèngu dhu madhutu boe j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dènge mola. rèngu cakaraa kahib'i-kalèbho dhu sala j'ara. nèti èèna ka, baku lami asa dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dhèu samaria.

source_text: wherever you go, tell the people, ‘the kingdom of heaven has arrived. '
target_text: lami peka dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra, na, ‘ne'e ne, d'ai lod'o kèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. '

source_text: heal those who are sick. resurrect the dead. cure the lepers. drive out demons. you received freely, so give freely!
target_text: aa lami puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a, pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, pa'èle dhèu kusta, aa babège eele nidhu. ama lamatua hia le miu ae-ae, te ngaa na manèngi hari boe ca ana maa sa. de lami ka ho pala pa'ae-ae mi dhèu leo, te ngaa mage mi manèngi hari ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: don't carry any gold, silver, or copper coins in your pockets,
target_text: pakèd'i dènge ai hua. baku mèti doi,

source_text: or a bag for your journey, or two cloaks, or sandals, or a walking stick, for a worker deserves to be supported.
target_text: gee j'ara, mèdha silu, salapa, do tatea. te dhèu hud'i hia ku dhèu sab'a, ngaa dhu pantas ho ra bisa mamuri.

source_text: wherever you go, whatever town or village, ask for someone who lives according to good principles, and remain there until you leave.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota do rae èci, na, miu hud'i tenge ku dhèu dhu neo sèmi rare miu. hèia miu pea ètu èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: when you enter the house, give it your blessing.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu, peka la dènge rèngu, ‘saloom! lamatua hia miu mèngi-nale. '

source_text: if the home deserves it, let your peace rest on it, but if it doesn't deserve it, let your peace return to you.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara èmu ne, sèmi rare miu dènge be'a, na, miu manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia si berkat. te ngaa ladhe ra ro'o boe sèmi rare miu, na, lamatua hia boe rèngu berkat.

source_text: if someone doesn't welcome you, and refuses to listen to what you have to say, then leave that house or that town, shaking its dust off your feet as you go.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, mi kalua nèti èmu èèna, do kota èèna, hèia miu caro eele ahu nèti haga miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ladhe ro'o boe nanene, pe rèngu d'ui rare pala ra.

source_text: i tell you the truth, it will be better for sodom and gomorrah at the day of judgment than for that town!
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lod'o ama lamatua huku dhèu ètu rai-haha ne'e, tatu na pabia mi dhèu sodom dènge gomora dhu uru èèna bhelu titu kèna. te ngaa sanèd'e! èèna na, nèngu huku bia risi hari mi dhèu dhu ro'o boe sèmi rare miu!

source_text: look, i'm sending you out like sheep among wolves. so be as wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! te ja'a pua miu ne, èci èèna ka ja'a patabuli kahib'i-kalèbho asa talora aae busa hui. nèti èèna ka, ngangee miu hud'i sèmi mege dhu d'èlu-mèu. aa d'ara mi hud'i mola ku nuka sèmi koro j'aha dhu ne'a boe tenge lii langu.

source_text: watch out for those who will hand you over to be tried by town councils and will whip you in their synagogues.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu paj'èra miu, sama sèmi busa hui kadhi pamadhe kahib'i-kalèbho. èèna na, rèngu nuni rèti miu asa era parisa lii langu agama. aa dhèu hake paparu miu ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a.

source_text: you will be dragged before governors and kings because of me, to witness to them and to the foreigners.
target_text: pe rèngu ère rèti miu asa madha gubernur dènge dhèu aae, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o sèra, ho peka-padhai dènge ra lii lolo be'a nèti ja'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua tadèngi kahèi kolongara ja'a ne.

source_text: but when they put you on trial, don't worry about how you should speak or what you should say, because you'll be told what to say at the right time.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe rèngu nuni rèti miu sèmi èèna, mage miu madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na, ja'a peka tasamia? ' do, ‘ja'a neo dhaa peka sèmi ngaa? ' baku j'aj'i mi ngangee, te ladhe d'ai lod'o na, ama mi ètu sorga ka dhu peka dènge miu, nèti j'ara mia ka dhu miu hud'i peka-padhai.

source_text: for it isn't you who will speak but the spirit of the father will speak through you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ngaa dhu miu padhai, mai boe nèti d'ara miu unu mi, te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu aj'a-nori ètu d'ara miu, sèna ka miu padhai sèmi ngaa sa.

source_text: brother will betray brother and have him killed, and a father will do the same to his child. children will rebel against their parents, and have them put to death.
target_text: sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu ca dhèu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu mesa na, ka dhu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. aa ladhe ana ka dhu parcaya, èèna na ama na ka dhu pamadhe ne. ladhe ina-ama ka dhu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a ana-ana ra ka dhu pamadhe si.

source_text: everyone will hate you because you follow me, but those who endure until the end will be saved.
target_text: sanèd'e! te bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha taruu, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri.
