source_text: when you're persecuted in one town, run away to the next. i'm telling the truth: you won't finish going to the towns of israel before the son of man comes.
target_text: ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu ètu d'ara kota cue, rai lami asa kota leo! lèke kèna! ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ropa miu palème aa'i mèka kota-kota ètu isra'el, te ngaa ja'a dhu lèpa hari mai le èèna.

source_text: disciples are not more important than their teacher; servants are not more important than their master.
target_text: biasa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu mese risi nèti ana sakola na sèra. aa dhèu pakab'ua ca dhèu lamatua risi nèti ènu na sèra.

source_text: disciples should be satisfied to become like their teacher, and servants like their master. if the head of the house has been called the head demon beelzebub, then the members of his household will be demonized even more!
target_text: ladhe ana sakola mèu sama sèmi mese na, nèngu pangee na d'ai le. aa ladhe ènu d'èlu-mèu sama sèmi lamatua na, nèngu ngee na d'ai le. de sanèd'e paie! ladhe dhèu paroa lamatua èmu, peka na, ‘èu ne, baalsebul, dhèu aae nidhu! ' tatu isi èmu na abhu kolongara dhu karehe risi hari.

source_text: so don't be frightened of them, for there's nothing covered that won't be exposed, and nothing hidden that won't be made known.
target_text: de miu baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu lab'a miu. te, ngaa dhu dhèu tao pahuni, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi.

source_text: what i tell you here in the dark, declare when it's light, and what you hear whispered in your ear, shout from the rooftops.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a-nori le miu mesa mi, miu hud'i lami lole ku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa ngaa dhu ja'a paholo le dènge miu, miu se hud'i lami peka ku palème era.

source_text: don't be afraid of those who can kill you physically, but can't kill you spiritually. instead, be afraid of the one who can destroy you physically and spiritually in gehenna.
target_text: baku madha'u dènge dhèu rai-haha, te rèngu bisa dhoka pamadhe ngi'u aae dhèu di, te ngaa bisa boe pa'ele iie samanga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge ama lamatua, te dhoka nèngu di dhu dènge koasa ho pamaso ngi'u aae dhèu dènge samanga kateme, asa d'ara dhasi ai dhu heo na loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: aren't two sparrows sold for just one penny? but not a single one of them falls to the ground without your father knowing about it.
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu. dhèu pahie ana mangungu ètu d'ara pasa dènge kab'ua ciki oo'e di. te ngaa ci'u sa bisa boe madhe, ladhe ama mi ètu sorga no'o mèka.

source_text: even the hairs on your head have all been counted.
target_text: ama miu ètu sorga dhu loe boe ladhe-leru miu, toke j'ara-j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki. d'ai rèu kètu ètu kab'a kètu miu, na ige nare aa'i hèi.

source_text: so don't worry-you're worth more than many sparrows!
target_text: de baku madha'u! lula ama lamatua pakab'ua miu risi nèti ana mangungu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: anyone who publicly declares their commitment to me, i will also declare my commitment to them before my father in heaven.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, dhèu dhu bani mangaku ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne, pe ja'a kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu katanga madha ama ku ètu sorga, peka na, ‘nèngu ne dhèu ja'a. '

source_text: but anyone who publicly denies me, i will also deny before my father in heaven.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu pasili ja'a ètu madha dhèu ae, peka na nèngu tadhe boe ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a peka dènge ama ku ètu sorga kahèi, na, ‘ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e. '

source_text: don't think i've come to bring peace on earth. i haven't come to bring peace, but a sword.
target_text: mage mi pangee na, ja'a ne mai kèti dame asa rai-haha ne. te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha ne èci lab'a èci.

source_text: i've come ‘to turn a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua peka tèke èèna, ‘èèna na, ana mone lab'a ama na, ana bhèni lab'a ina na, aa bhèni dhèu èmu ana na, lab'a ina nèti dhèu èmu na,

source_text: your enemies will be those of your own family! '
target_text: te isi èmu mae-manyèla, lula èci lab'a èci. '

source_text: if you love your father or mother more than me you don't deserve to be mine, and if you love your son or daughter more than me you don't deserve to be mine.
target_text: de dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a tare'a-re'a, nèngu hud'i sue ku ja'a, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i, risi nèti ina-ama na, aa risi nèti ana niki na. ladhe aad'o, na, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: if you don't pick up your cross and follow me you don't deserve to be mine.
target_text: te dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, te ngaa d'èi boe pasae j'aj'èra, nèngu nia boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: if you try to save your life, you will lose it, but if you lose your life because of me you will save it.
target_text: dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula na madhutu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu dhoka neo mamuri hia ngi'u nèngu unu na, èèna na, mamuri na ele iia d'ara!

source_text: those who welcome you welcome me, and those who welcome me welcome the one that sent me.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare miu dènge be'a, nèngu sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ja'a, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: those who welcome a prophet because that's what they are, will receive the same reward as a prophet. those who welcome someone who does right will receive the same reward as someone who does right.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, lula na padhue-padhai lii holo-nori ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu. aa dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu d'ara mola, lula dhèu èèna madhutu tare'a-re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua b'ala nèngu sama sèmi na b'ala mi ca dhèu d'ara mola.

source_text: i tell you the truth, those who give a drink of cool water to the least important of my disciples will definitely not miss out on their reward.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi nare ca dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a, tatu ama lamatua b'ala ne. masi ka dhèu hia èi hua ca galaa di, tatu ama lamatua bhèlu boe ne.

source_text: when jesus had finished giving instructions to his twelve disciples, he left to go and teach and speak publicly in the nearby towns.
target_text: ropa yesus hia nare lii moa mi canguru dua ana madhutu na, hèia na la'e kako palème rae-rae ètu rai èèna, sèna ka aj'a dhèu ètu sèra. aa na peka-padhai lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: while john was in prison he heard what the messiah was doing, so he sent his disciples
target_text: lod'o èèna, yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. ropa na tadèngi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus tao, hèia na pua ana madhutu na ho lasi karèi yesus, peka na,

source_text: to ask on his behalf, are you the one we were expecting to come, or should we continue to look for someone else?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka, na, nèngu neo pua kristus mai, sèna ka pala mamuri mi èdhi dhèu yahudi. ama ne, kristus, do? do, èdhi hud'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? ka lasi karèi yesus.

source_text: jesus answered them, go back and tell john what you hear and what you see.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se tadèngi le, aa mèdhi unu mi dènge madha. de lèpa ho lami peka dènge yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i, nuka sèmi ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, yesaya, suri tèke le, peka na:

source_text: the blind can see, the crippled can walk, the lepers are healed, the deaf can hear, the dead are resurrected, and the poor hear the good news.
target_text: dhèu bèdhu, ladhe rèdhi. dhèu karuku, kèd'i kako. dhèu pèd'a kusta, ka'uri ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, bisa tadèngi. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu unu aad'o, nanene lii lolo be'a.

source_text: blessed are those who don't reject me!
target_text: de sèmi ne'e: lami peka dènge yohanis, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu a'oto, ladhe na parcaya ja'a taruu. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a pa'èra-èra!

source_text: as they left, jesus began to talk to the crowds about john. what were you expecting to see when you went out into the desert? a reed tossed about by the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae se, lula-nèti yohanis ne, aku nèngu na, lod'o miu neo paraga dènge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, miu pangee, na, neo paraga dènge dhèu dhu sèmi ngaa sa? tatu boe, miu paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aala-aala, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu ngèlu di!

source_text: so what did you go to see? a man dressed in fancy clothes? people dressed like that live in kings' palaces.
target_text: aa tatu boe miu mèdhi dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: so what did you go to see then? a prophet? yes, and i tell you he is much more than a prophet!
target_text: de lami ladhe dhèu sèmi ngaa sa ètu nèi? mi pangee na, miu lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua! tare'a! te nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu kapai risi.

source_text: he's the one this scripture was written about: ‘i'm sending my messenger on ahead of you. he will prepare your way for you. '
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna, dhu suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: i tell you the truth, that among humanity there's no one greater than john the baptist, but even the least important in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he is.
target_text: nanene paie! ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis ne. te ngaa nèti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i dhu mangaku ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae, dhèu dhu haha d'ai seli èèna ka, nèngu dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: from the time of john the baptist up till now the kingdom of heaven continues to be under attack, and violent people are trying to seize it by force.
target_text: karèi nèti yohanis pakako sasab'a na, d'ai sange ne'e ne, abhu dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo dhu pangee sala, peka na rèngu hud'i pamusu ku, sèna ka laka-seti dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua.

source_text: for all the prophets and the law spoke for god until john came.
target_text: toke d'ai lod'o mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi dhu tema madhutu atora musa, dènge atora dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua leo sèra.

source_text: if you're prepared to believe it, he is elijah, the one who was expected to come.
target_text: de parcaya la ja'a! yohanis ne, nuka elia, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, peka mema le lula-nèti mamai na.

source_text: anybody with ears should be listening!
target_text: de dhu neo me'a mèu, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie!

source_text: what shall i compare this generation to? it's like children sitting in the marketplaces shouting to each other,
target_text: ja'a neo hia lii pakasame, sèna ka miu me'a, rupa sèmi mia ka dhèu taa limuri ne. te rèngu se cakaraa dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. rèngu dhu pa'oo-parodha dènge angalai ra, peka na,

source_text: ‘we played the flute for you and you didn't dance; we sang sad songs and you didn't cry. '
target_text: ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino dènge karej'e-karae, te ngaa miu roge-ledho boe. hèia ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: john didn't come feasting and drinking, so people say, ‘he's devil-possessed! '
target_text: miu se sama sèmi ana iiki dhu re'a boe roca. lod'o yohanis mai, nèngu d'èi puasa, aa ninu boe èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu, nidhu tao! '

source_text: on the other hand the son of man came and did feast and drink, and people say, ‘look, he's greedy and drinks too much; he's a friend of tax collectors and sinners! ' but wisdom is shown to be right by what it does…
target_text: te ngaa ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, mai le. ja'a puasa boe, aa kinu èi anggor. te ngaa dhèu peka na, ‘nèngu èèna, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! dhèu tema mahu bia! la'e pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. nèngu dhu ne'a boe makae! ' te ngaa mi patadhe lii padhai ja'a ne! mamèu ama lamatua èèna, cèu ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu unu na.

source_text: then he began to reprimand the towns where he'd done most of his miracles because they had not repented.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua yesus pasanèd'e dhèu-dhèu dhu pea ètu pèri-pèri rae. na tao le tadha-tadha malaa ae risi ètu nèi, te ngaa ro'o boe ae eele nèti sasala ra, ho madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua dhu mola.

source_text: shame on you, korazin! shame on you, bethsaida! if the miracles had been performed in tyre and sidon which happened among you, they would have repented in sackcloth and ashes long ago.
target_text: yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu dhèu korasin, aa miu dhèu betsaida! mate unu miu! bèli-camèd'a pasae mere mamadhe-mamopo! ja'a tao le rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha miu, te ngaa miu mo'o boe parcaya ama lamatua. masi ka miu dhèu yahudi dhu peka na, miu tadhe lamatua, te ngaa ladhe sèmi tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao se'e ètu kota tirus dènge kota sidon, tatu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra èle le ho'a, aa tèke eele le sasala-sasigo ra ho madhutu ama lamatua. aa tatu ra pake le bèla mèdhi, dènge tao ahu mi kètu ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu manyasa nèti sasala ra. masi ka dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon sèra dhèu yahudi boe, dhu mangaku na, tadhe lamatua.

source_text: but i tell you that on the day of judgment it will be better for tyre and sidon than it will for you!
target_text: ja'a monya boe! bèli-camèd'a mèdhi unu mi! d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, hahuku dhèu tirus dènge dhèu sidon samaa risi nèti hahuku miu.

source_text: and what about you, capernaum? will you be exalted to heaven? no, you'll go down to hades! if the miracles had been performed in sodom which happened among you, sodom would still be here today.
target_text: miu dhèu kapernaum! mage-mage, ee! mage mi pangee, na, ama lamatua paca'e miu lami asa sorga. aad'o! èèna na lamatua pèci mi asa d'ara naraka! ladhe sèmi tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao ètu rae miu dhu j'aj'i uuru le ètu kota sodom, tatu ama lamatua parluu boe labhu pakèpu kota èèna. te ladhe dhèu sodom rèdhi tadha malaa se, tatu ra rai eele le nèti bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but i tell you that on the day of judgment it will be better for sodom than it will for you!
target_text: tare'a! pe mèdhi unu mi! ladhe d'ai ka lod'o ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, hahuku dhèu sodom samaa risi nèti hahuku miu se!

source_text: then jesus prayed, i praise you, father, lord of heaven and earth, for you've hidden these things from the clever and sophisticated. instead you've revealed them to ordinary people.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus sabaj'a, peka na, ama! ama dhu j'aj'i lamatua ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae, lula ama pahuni pamèno-mèno j'ara-j'ara dhu ama hia huku mi dhèu-dhèu dhu pangee na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, aa dhu padedha iisi ra. te ngaa ama bhoke patalele j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu haha dènge dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: yes, father, you were pleased to do this!
target_text: tare'a, ama! te sèmi èèna ka, dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama!

source_text: everything has been entrusted to me by my father, and no one really understands the son, except the father, and no one really understands the father, except the son, and those to whom the son chooses to reveal him.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, na, nanene paie-iie! ama ku ètu sorga pangèd'u le koasa aa'i-aa'i mi ja'a ne. dhu tadhe mèu ja'a, dhoka ama ku di. aa dhu tadhe mèu ama, dhoka ana na, nuka ja'a ne. aa ja'a hag'e kore dhèu leo, sèna ka peka dènge ra, ho rèngu tadhe mèu ne kahèi.

source_text: come to me, all of you who struggle and who are burdened down. i will give you rest.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu roe lula sab'a bia, mai madhutu ja'a! aa miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu pasae bia, mai la asa ja'a!

source_text: accept my yoke, and learn from me. for i am kind and have a humble heart, and in me you will find the rest you need.
target_text: ladhe miu sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a, ho kako palere-lere dènge ja'a, na, èdhi ca ropa dènge sapi dua ngi'u dhu nuni kataka pare rai èci. te ja'a ne, d'ara hua iia, aa lii mako. ladhe miu madhutu ja'a, miu j'aj'i èra hari.

source_text: for my yoke is gentle, and my burden is light.
target_text: lula a'aj'a ja'a, carui boe. aa paredha ja'a, bia boe kahèi.

source_text: around that time jesus was walking through fields of grain on the sabbath day. his disciples were hungry so they started to pick ears of grain and eat them.
target_text: ca lod'o, lèke dènge ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu kako re karasa oka dhèu. ana madhutu na manganga, hèia ra g'ètu are-gandum ka ra'a noo-noo.

source_text: when the pharisees saw this they said to jesus, look at your disciples-they're doing what isn't allowed on the sabbath!
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu madhutu pa'èra ad'a dhèu yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus se tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra kai ne, peka na, ana madhutu mu, g'ètu gandum lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a! rèngu baku tao sèmi ne'e! te tatao ne sisu atora èdhi.

source_text: but jesus told them, haven't you read what david did when he and his men were hungry? he went into the house of god, and he and his men ate the sacred bread that they weren't allowed to eat since it's only for the priests.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? miu teko bhèlu lii lolo daud, si? daud dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu manganga titu kèna. hèia na maso asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ka nare roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua, ka rèngu ra'a. te ngaa dhu bisa ra'e roti se dhodhoka ama agama sèra. dhèu leo bisa boe. èle ka daud si ra'a, te ngaa ca dhèu sa pasala boe si. miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu baca mèdhi boe sasuri lii holo-nori ama lamatua!

source_text: haven't you read in the law that on the sabbath day the priests in the temple break the sabbath but are not considered guilty?
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri èèna, suri kahèi nèti sasab'a ama agama yahudi sèra, ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. te ngaa rèngu sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: however, i tell you that someone is here who is greater than the temple!
target_text: nanene! uru èèna, èmu sabaj'a ka dhu kab'ua, te ngaa limuri ne abhu dhu kab'ua risi, nuka ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: if you'd known the meaning of this scripture, ‘i want mercy, and not sacrifice, ' you wouldn't have condemned those who are innocent.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na peka na, ‘dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: dhèu ja'a sèra hud'i pad'elo ku rasa kasia èci dènge èci. ladhe ra tao boe madhutu j'ara ne, na, badha korban dhu rèngu rèti hia ja'a, dènge boe kab'ua. ' de ladhe miu me'a mèu sasoa nèti lii padhai lamatua ne, tatu miu pasala boe ana madhutu ja'a se. te ra tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for the son of man is lord of the sabbath.
target_text: te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète, peka na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: then jesus left and went into their synagogue.
target_text: èle ka yesus tèke eele era èèna, la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: a man was there with a crippled hand. does the law allow healing on the sabbath? they asked him, looking for a reason to accuse him.
target_text: ètu ne'e, abhu mone ca dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka. dhèu parisi sèra dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho pasala yesus, ladhe sèmi na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu kacui-aai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a-la'a, do aad'o?

source_text: suppose you have a sheep and it falls into a hole in the ground on the sabbath. don't you grab hold of it and pull it out? jesus asked them.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ci'u manahu asa d'ara ro'a, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a, dhèu unu na mai name nare, sina ma?

source_text: don't you think a human being is worth much more than a sheep? so yes, you are allowed to do good on the sabbath.
target_text: de ama lamatua sue dhèu rai-haha, risi nèti dhèu unu kahib'i-kalèbho deo na. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bisa tao j'ara dhu be'a lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a.

source_text: then he said to the man, hold out your hand. the man held out his hand, and it was healed, just as healthy as the other hand.
target_text: ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai! hèia, na j'ole kacui-aai dhu madhe èèna, kaca'a la èle dènge ka, sama dènge kacui-aai dhu iia èèna.

source_text: but the pharisees went out and plotted how to kill jesus.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi se rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa titu kèna. èle ka ra kalua tèke eele èmu sabaj'a ne, hèia lasi pare'a, aku rèngu na, èdhi hud'i tenge ku j'ara, sèna ka pamadhe ne!

source_text: knowing this, jesus left, with large crowds following him. he healed all of them,
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a ngangee rèngu dhu karehe ne, nèti èèna ka la'e asa era leo. dhèu ae madhutu ne, hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but instructed them not to tell people who he was.
target_text: te ngaa na kai si, peka na, mage lami palolo kahèi dènge dhèu leo lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: this fulfilled what isaiah the prophet said:
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna, madhutu sèmi lii padhai ama lamatua dhu peka le mi dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya, dhu suri tèke, na,

source_text: this is my servant whom i've chosen, the one i love, who pleases me. i will put my spirit on him, and he will tell the foreigners what's right.
target_text: ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a, dhu ja'a hag'e kore le. ja'a sue ne, aa d'ara ja'a karej'e taruu dènge ne. èèna na, ja'a pangèd'u ne roh ja'a, ho la'e aj'a-nori dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: he won't argue, he won't shout out, and nobody will hear his voice in the streets.
target_text: nèngu ne, ne'a boe tèb'a kakara. nèngu ne, ne'a boe padedha iisi.

source_text: he won't break a damaged reed, and he won't extinguish a smoking wick, until he has proved that his judgment is right,
target_text: d'ara na hua iia. dhu ne'a boe paj'èra dhèu. aj'u dhu oe padhe, na lèku eele boe. labhu dhu saruru, na tiu pamadhe boe. na loe boe aj'a-nori dhèu, toke dhèu aa'i-aa'i tao madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu mola nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and foreigners will put their hope in him.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i èèna na parcaya ne, lula re'a na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: then a man was brought to jesus who was demon-possessed and blind and dumb. jesus healed him, so that the dumb man could speak and see.
target_text: ca tèka, rèti asa yesus ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao toke bèdhu aa ele lii. hèia yesus pa'èle ne dènge babège eele nidhu nèti dhèu ne'e. ka dhèu ne bisa nèdhi, aa bisa padhai lii.

source_text: all the crowds were amazed, and asked, this man couldn't really be the son of david, could he?
target_text: dhèu ae se, ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra malaa-maloha. ra papeka na, nèngu ne'e, ele boe ana-èpu daud, dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka! nèngu ne'e, tatu dhèu dhu èdhi mate tae-tae èèna!

source_text: but when the pharisees heard this, they replied, this man can only throw out demons through the power of beelzebub, the chief of demons!
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu parisi tadèngi rare, hèia ra ro'o boe parcaya. ka ra papeka, na, wee! dhèu ne bisa babège nidhu, lula dhèu aae nidhu baalsebul ka dhu pangèd'u na koasa.

source_text: knowing what they were thinking, jesus told them, any kingdom that is divided against itself will be destroyed. no town or household that is divided against itself can stand.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai dhèu parisi se. hèia na peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, lii padhai miu ne, lèke boe! ladhe ètu d'ara rai cue, ana kabarai na patao-palaha, tasa mera mia ho rai ne bisa taha! sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ètu d'ara kota èci, do d'ara èmu cue, èci patao dènge èci, tatu ra mae-manyèla, toke laho mae-mae, si!

source_text: if satan drives out satan, then he's divided against himself-so how could his kingdom stand?
target_text: de ladhe nidhu pamusu dènge nidhu, aa palab'a èci dènge èci, tatu dhèu aae ra nèd'u paredha nèbhu boe!

source_text: if i'm throwing out demons in the name of beelzebub, in whose name are your people throwing out demons? your own people prove you're wrong!
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu miu re'a kahèi babège eele nidhu. ra pake koasa nèti nidhu, do? aad'o! de miu baku padhai lii ore dhu peka na, ja'a pake koasa nidhu, ho babège eele nidhu. pe dhèu miu unu mi ka dhu pama'ète, peka na, ngaa dhu miu galaa ne, lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: but if i'm throwing out demons through the power of the spirit of god, then the kingdom of god has come to you!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe ja'a tare'a-re'a babège eele nidhu pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua, èèna pad'elo na, lamatua èèna tare'a-re'a dhèu aae dhu ètu le katanga madha miu.

source_text: can you enter a strong man's house and take his belongings unless you tie him up first? if you do that then you can take everything in his house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo lasi mana'u èmu dhèu èci dhu èra, nèngu hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku dhèu lamatua èmu ne. heka na mana'u nèti mèdha-panyau na sèra.

source_text: those who are not with me are against me, and those who do not gather together with me do the opposite: they are scattering.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! te dhèu dhu pa'èci boe dènge ja'a, nèngu pamusu dènge ja'a. aa dhèu dhu soru-bara boe ja'a ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a, nèngu ne'a dhoka pa'iu dhèu di.

source_text: that's why i'm telling you that every sin and blasphemy you commit will be forgiven, except blasphemy against the spirit which won't be forgiven.
target_text: de nanene paie-iie lii padhai ja'a ne! ama lamatua dhu sadia saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu leo, ama lamatua sadia abho ne era. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu bani padhai pakarehe roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na èèna.

source_text: those who say something against the son of man will be forgiven, but those who say something against the holy spirit won't be forgiven, neither in this life nor the next.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pakarehe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala na. te ngaa cee ka dhu bani padhai lii pahahe roh ama lamatua, te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala na, masi ka toke dai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: either decide that the tree is good, and its fruit is good, or decide that the tree is bad and its fruit is bad-for the tree is known by its fruit.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii taruu dènge dhèu parisi se, peka na, ngee paie-iie! aj'u dhu be'a, hia hua dhu be'a. te ngaa aj'u dhu karehe, hia hua dhu karehe. nèti hua na, dhèu bisa tadhe aj'u ne, be'a do karehe.

source_text: you viper's brood, how can you who are evil say anything good? for your mouth simply says what your mind is busy thinking about.
target_text: te ngaa miu se ca ropa dènge mege, dhu ne'a dhoka kapod'e-kabèli di! miu me'a boe padhai lii dhu be'a. lula ngaa dhu tèke ètu d'ara, èèna ka dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara hèb'a na.

source_text: a good person brings out good from their store of good things, and an evil person brings out evil from their store of evil things.
target_text: dhèu be'a, tatu lii padhai na be'a, lula ètu d'ara na abhu j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu bhelu, tatu lii padhai na karehe, lula ètu d'ara na dhu pènu dènge bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: i tell you, people will have to account for every careless thing they say on the day of judgment.
target_text: lèka la lii ja'a ne! te bèli-camèd'a lod'o èle rai-haha, ama lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lod'o èèna, dhèu èci-èci ka hud'i dhaa lii-lii nèngu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: for what you say will either vindicate you or condemn you.
target_text: de mage-mage! te bèli-camèd'a èèna, ama lamatua dadoo lii-lii miu sèra, aa pama'ète peka na, miu lèke huku do, aad'o.

source_text: then some of the religious teachers and pharisees came to him and said, teacher, we want you to show us a miraculous sign.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, hèia pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi, peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i neo ngèdhi tadha malaa èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, koasa ama, tare'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: an evil and adulterous generation are the ones who look for a miraculous sign. the only sign they will be given is the sign of the prophet jonah, jesus told them.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke si, peka na, weh! miu dhèu taa limuri ne, mo'o boe madhutu ama lamatua! miu se me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a di! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a tao boe. lula uru èèna, lamatua hia le tadha malaa re yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai na. èèna d'ai le!

source_text: in the same way jonah was in the belly of a huge fish for three days and three nights, the son of man will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.
target_text: yunus pea tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda ètu d'ara kabake i'a aae ci'u. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ja'a kahèi ètu d'ara ro'a dhèu madhe, tèlu mèu-tèlu mèda.

source_text: the people of nineveh will rise in the judgment together with this generation and they will condemn it because they repented in response to jonah's message-and as you see, there's someone greater than jonah here!
target_text: ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua j'aj'i hakim. aa dhèu niniwe se titu j'aj'i sakasii ho galaa miu, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i se, goa! ' uru èèna, ropa dhèu niniwe sèra tadèngi lii padhai yunus, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, hèia ra tèke eele sasala ra. te ngaa miu sèmi boe èèna. masi ka limuri ne, abhu le dhèu ètu talora aae miu, dhu kapai risi nèti yunus, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu se pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: the queen of the south will be raised in the judgment together with this generation and will condemn it because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of solomon-and as you see, there's someone greater than solomon here!
target_text: pe, ètu d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe lamatua j'aj'i hakim, bhèni aae syeba nèti balèu, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi. na paj'uj'u ai na mi miu, ho na galaa miu aa'i-aa'i dhu ana loo-limuri ne, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi, goa! ' uru èèna, bhèni aae ne mai nèti rai kaj'èu ho neo nèdhi unu na mamèu dhèu aae soleman. te ngaa limuri ne, abhu ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu kapai risi nèti dhèu aae soleman, nuka ja'a ne. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe ja'a ciki sa hèi.

source_text: when an evil spirit leaves someone, it wanders through deserted places looking for rest, and finds nowhere to stay.
target_text: ladhe babège eele nidhu nèti ca dhèu, nidhu ne la'e pea asa era dhu kaliu, ho j'aj'i mi era ae iisi na. te ngaa abhu boe era dhu mèci ho na pea kalili.

source_text: so it says, ‘i'll go back to the place i left, ' and when it returns it finds the place empty, all clean and tidy.
target_text: hèia na pangee, peka na, ‘abhu boe era dhu be'a sèmi nèi, hua iia ja'a lèpa hari asa dhèu dhu uru èèna ja'a pea. ' ka la'e hari asa era nèngu uru èèna. na ladhe na, era ne mèu bia, aa dhu lalau rare pabe'a-be'a.

source_text: then it goes and brings back seven other spirits even more evil than it is, and it enters and lives there. so the person ends up worse than they were at the beginning. that's the way it will be with this evil generation.
target_text: hèia nidhu ne la'e paroa nare angalai na dhèu pidhu dhu bhabhelu ra risi nèti nèngu. ka lasi pea ètu d'ara dhèu ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra kakeho ne. de limuri ne, mamuri dhèu ne asa ele iie-iie. sèmi èèna kahèi lèke mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a taa limuri ne.

source_text: while he was speaking to the crowds, his mother and his brothers arrived and stood outside, wanting to talk to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus padhai lii era dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na sèra, mai neo paraga dènge ne. rèngu titu ètu li'u, ka ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ne.

source_text: someone came and told him, look, your mother and brothers are outside, wanting to talk to you.
target_text: hèia dhèu mai peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ina dènge ari ama ètu li'u nèi. rèngu neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: who is my mother? who are my brothers? jesus asked.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, cee ka ina ku, aa cee ka a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a?

source_text: he pointed at his disciples, and said, look, they are my mother and my brothers!
target_text: hèia na paj'uj'u asa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, rèngu se'e se ka, ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for those who do the will of my heavenly father, they are my brother, sister, and mother!
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi ama ku ètu sorga, rèngu ka ina ku aa a'ari ja'a dhu tare'a-re'a.

source_text: later that day jesus left the house, and sat down to teach beside the sea.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus kalua nèti èmu èèna, la'e madhèdi asa sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: so many people gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat down there to teach, while all the crowds stood on the beach.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae-ae mai lingu rare ne. ka la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue, dhu panahu ètu era èèna, ho aj'a dhèu sèra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu dae sèra nanene ne.

source_text: he explained many things to them, using stories as illustrations. the sower went out to sow, he began.
target_text: hèia na aj'a madha j'ara ae-ae mi rèngu pake lii pakasame. na lole, peka na, abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: as he was sowing, some of the seeds fell on the path. the birds came and ate them up.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini se, abhu dhu lèke ètu j'ara. hèia manu-bhui mai, ka tutu ra'e aa'i hini se.

source_text: other seeds fell on stony ground where there wasn't much earth where they sprouted quickly.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai dhu dènge hadhu. hini se muri malai, lula abhu rai ciki di.

source_text: the sun rose and scorched them and they withered because they had no roots.
target_text: te ngaa ropa lod'o rea, hèia ana aaj'u se kamale, ka mango eele si. te amo ra marèma boe ètu d'ara rai.

source_text: other seeds fell among thorns that grew up and choked them.
target_text: abhu hini cahag'e dhu lèke ètu era j'u'u padhudhu. hèia j'u'u padhudhu se hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: still other seeds fell on good soil. they produced a harvest-some one hundred, some sixty, and some thirty times what had been planted.
target_text: te ngaa abhu hini cahag'e lèke ètu rai isi. hini se muri, ka ra kapai toke hua-hela. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu dhu èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: anybody who has ears should be listening!
target_text: cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na nanene paie-iie!

source_text: the disciples came to jesus and asked him, why do you use illustrations when you speak to the people?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka ama aj'a dhèu ae pake lii pakasame?

source_text: you're privileged to have revealed to you the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but they're not given such insights, jesus replied.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, lula miu se neo me'a tare'a-re'a paredha ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka mema sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a aj'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: those who already have will have more given to them, more than enough. but those who don't have, whatever they have will be taken away from them.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a neo re'a dad'èi ama lamatua, pe lamatua hia ne asa ne'a ae. te ngaa dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, pe lamatua tao ne asa tabha goa.

source_text: that's why i speak to them in illustrations. for even though they see, they don't see; and even though they hear, they don't hear; nor do they understand.
target_text: ja'a aj'a-nori si pake dhoka lii pakasame di, lula: ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ra pusi-pahae boe. '

source_text: the prophecy of isaiah is fulfilled in them: ‘even though you hear, you won't understand, and even though you see, you won't perceive.
target_text: rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu dhu yesaya suri mema le. yesaya èèna, nuka dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri, na, ‘miu èèna na tadèngi, te ngaa miu pakatele dhilu. miu èèna na ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa mo'o boe pame'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: they have a hard-hearted attitude, they don't want to listen, and they've closed their eyes. if they didn't they might be able to see with their eyes, hear with their ears, and understand in their minds. then they could return to me and i would heal them. '
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e adhu sèmi hadhu, ra pakatele dhilu ra, aa ra pabèdhu musi madha ra. de hud'i rèngu sène, sèna ka ro'a dhilu ra katele-katipa, aa soro tèke si, sèna ka musi madha ra bèdhu sèmi èèna. hud'i laa, ho ja'a puri-pa'èle ia ka si, lula rèngu pusi-pahae boe ja'a. '

source_text: your eyes are blessed, for they see. your ears are blessed too, for they hear.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, oto! lula miu ladhe mèdhi dènge musi madha, aa tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu miu unu mi.

source_text: i'm telling you, many prophets and good people longed to see what you're seeing, but didn't see it. they longed to hear what you're hearing, but didn't hear it.
target_text: parcaya la ja'a! uru èèna, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola, d'ara ra neo rèdhi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu ladhe mèdhi, te ngaa bisa boe. d'ara ra neo kahèi tadèngi ngaa dhu limuri ne miu tadèngi le, te ngaa bisa boe.

source_text: so listen to the story of the sower.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus peka dènge ra, de mi nanene ka sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: when people hear the message about the kingdom and don't understand it, the evil one comes along and rips out what was sown in them. this is what happens to the seeds sown on the path.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori nèti ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, te ngaa nèngu ne'a iia boe. hèia dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu ne.

source_text: the seeds sown on stony ground are people who hear the message and happily accept it straight away.
target_text: hini dhu ceb'e lèke ètu rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia na sèmi nare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: they last for a while, but because they don't have roots, when problems and troubles come, they quickly fall away.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, amo na marèma boe. nèti èèna ka, nare boe nèbhu ètu d'ara dhèu ne. ropa dhèu leo paj'èra ne lula na sèmi nare lii holo-nori ne, ka dhèu ne kèpe pa'èra heka a'aj'a sèra.

source_text: the seeds sown among thorns are people who hear the message, but then life's worries and the temptation of money choke the message so that they become fruitless.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora aae j'u'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori. te ngaa nèngu bhute dènge rupa-rupa j'ara, ho pakarej'e mamuri na. hèia bhabhute se'e ka seti eele lii holo-nori ne nèti d'ara nèngu, toke dènge heka kab'ua.

source_text: the seeds sown on good soil are people who hear the message, and understand it, and who produce a good harvest-some one hundred, some sixty, and some thirty times what was sown.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu rai isi, nuka dhèu dhu pasa paie dhilu na, sèna ka sèmi nare lii holo-nori, aa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. hèia na tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, sama sèmi hini dhu muri toke kapai, ka na hua ae-ae. abhu dhu tèlu nguru hari, abhu kahèi èna nguru hari, aa abhu dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: then he told them another illustrated story: the kingdom of heaven is like a farmer who sowed good seeds in his field.
target_text: yesus lolo hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua ne, nuka sèmi abhu ca dhèu la'e ceb'e hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: but while his workers were sleeping, an enemy came and sowed weed seeds on top of the wheat. then they left.
target_text: d'ara mèda èèna, ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i bhèj'i luu, hèia dhèu bhelu mai, ka na ceb'e lamusi j'u'u ètu d'ara oka ne.

source_text: so when the wheat grew and produced ears of grain, the weeds also grew up.
target_text: ropa hini ètu d'ara oka ne d'ai hua-hela, hèia dhèu sab'a se, ladhe rèdhi j'u'u dhu muri palere-lere dènge hini se.

source_text: the farmer's workers came and asked him, ‘sir, didn't you sow good seeds in your field? where did the weeds come from? '
target_text: ka lasi peka dènge lamatua oka ne, aku rèngu na, ‘ama! ca hari ni ji'i sèle hini dhu be'a ètu d'ara oka ama, si? nga tao ka muri mai pab'ali dènge j'u'u ae-ae? '

source_text: ‘some enemy has done this, ' he replied. ‘do you want us to go and pull up the weeds? ' they asked him.
target_text: lamatua oka ne dhaa, peka na, ‘èèna tatao nèti dhèu bhelu. ' hèia dhèu sab'a se peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ama, ji'i la'a ko'o eele j'u'u sèi, do? '

source_text: ‘no, ' he answered, ‘as you pull up the weeds, you might uproot the wheat too.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ala, peka na, ‘hud'i laa, te ladhe miu ko'o eele j'u'u se, ana nganga'a èdhi se lèke bete kahèi.

source_text: let them both grow until harvest, and then at harvest-time i'll tell the reapers to first gather the weeds, tie them up into bundles and burn them, and then gather the wheat and store it in my barn. '
target_text: hud'i rèngu sène ra muri palere-lere toke hèru puu-g'ètu. pe d'ai lod'o na, ja'a peka dènge dhèu sab'a se, na, miu pakaboko uru ku j'u'u sèra. hèia èki si ca èki-ca èki ho tunu eele si. èle ku, heka ta pakaboko isi oka kèna, sèna ka pamaso asa d'ara babesi. '

source_text: he gave them another illustration: the kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a farmer sowed in his field.
target_text: èle, ka yesus peka hari, na, ja'a pake hari lii pakasame èci, sèna ka miu me'a tasamia ama lamatua j'aj'i dhèu aae mi dhèu ae-ae. dhèu unu na sèra, mulai nuka sèmi lamusi dhu ana iiki titu kèna, dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: even though it's the tiniest of seeds it grows much bigger than other plants. in fact it grows into a tree big enough for birds to roost in its branches.
target_text: masi ka lamusi ne ana iiki d'ai seli, te ngaa ladhe na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae ètu d'ara oka ne. toke manu-bhui tao rèd'a ètu dadana-dadana na.

source_text: he told them another illustrated story: the kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman mixed with a large quantity of flour, until all the dough was raised.
target_text: yesus peka hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu-dhèu unu ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge ragi dhu bhèni èci nare, pab'ali dènge tarigu ca sak. hèia roti ne ca'e toke kapai, lula ragi dhu ciki oo'e deo na.

source_text: jesus explained all these things to the crowds using illustrated stories-in fact he didn't speak to them without using stories.
target_text: yesus aj'a dhèu ae dènge lii lolo rupa-rupa. lii padhai na, aa'i-aa'i se, dhodhoka pake lii pakasame di.

source_text: this fulfilled the prophet's words: i will speak using stories, and i will explain things hidden from the creation of the world.
target_text: na aj'a sèmi èèna, sèna ka madhutu sèmi lii nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke, peka na, pe ja'a aj'a-nori pake lii pakasame. pe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu tadèngi rèdhi mèka, karèi nèti lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: then jesus left the crowds and went into a house. his disciples came over to him, and asked him, please explain to us the story about the weeds in the field.
target_text: èle ka, yesus lèpa èmu tèke eele dhèu ae sèra. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai manèngi, na, ama! peka ku dènge ji'i sasoa nèti lii pakasame j'u'u deo sa!

source_text: the one who sows the good seed is the son of man, jesus explained.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, dhèu dhu ceb'e hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: the field is the world. the good seeds are the children of the kingdom. the weed seeds are the children of the evil one.
target_text: aa oka èèna, nuka rai-haha ne. hini dhu be'a èèna, nuka dhèu-dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu ama lamatua. aa j'u'u sèra, nuka ana pajuu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: the enemy that sowed the weed seeds is the devil. the harvest is the end of the world. the reapers are angels.
target_text: aa dhèu bhelu dhu mai ceb'e lamusi j'u'u, nuka dhèu aae nidhu. aa lod'o puu-g'ètu èèna, nuka d'ai èle rai-haha ne. dhèu sab'a dhu pakaboko isi oka se, nuka ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: just as the weeds are harvested and burned so it will be at the end of the world.
target_text: ropa d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ra oru rare j'u'u se ho tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: the son of man will send out his angels, and they will gather up every sinful thing and everyone who does evil,
target_text: te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a pua ana pajuu nèti sorga mai. rèngu èèna na pakaboko dhèu-dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe madhutu paredha ama lamatua. aa rèngu oru rare kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka baku madhutu paredha lamatua.

source_text: and will throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.
target_text: èèna na ra core dhèu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i se asa d'ara ai naraka, nuka sèmi j'u'u dhu ai na'e pakèpu si. ètu nèi, dhèu se rasa j'èra titu kèna, aa tangi d'ara ma'ète mae-mae loe boe ciki sa.

source_text: then those who live right will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their father. anybody with ears should be listening!
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu pea taruu dènge ama dhèu aae ra ètu sorga. ètu nèi, dhèu se ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti, nuka sèmi madha lod'o. de dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ja'a, pasa dhilu paie-iie!

source_text: the kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. a man found it, reburied it, and then full of joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.
target_text: yesus tabha hari lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu neo abhu mèdha kab'ua aae, dhu dhèu huni tèke ètu d'ara rai cakasib'i. ka dhèu ne la'e kèi, hèia na abhu mèdha ne, nèti èèna ka na karej'e-karae. èle èèna ka, na dhènu hari mèdha deo na. hèia na lèpa hari lai-lai, la'e pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. ka la'e hèli nare rai ne, sèna ka na unu mèdha dhu kab'ua aae deo na.

source_text: the kingdom of heaven is also like a trader looking for good pearls.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii pakasame, peka na, dhèu dhu neo tadhe mèu ama lamatua nèd'u paredha, èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu d'aga ca dhèu dhu d'ara na neo abhu mutiara dhu kab'ua aae titu kèna. èle ka, na patangi-tenge mutiara ho neo hèli.

source_text: when he found the most expensive pearl ever he went and sold all he had and bought it.
target_text: ropa na rage mutiara cue dhu be'a titu kèna, hèia na lèpa lai-lai, sèna ka pahia aa'i mèdha-panyau na. hèia la'e tihe mutiara ne, sèna ka j'aj'i mi unu na.

source_text: or again, the kingdom of heaven is like a fishing net thrown into the sea that caught all kinds of fish.
target_text: yesus peka hari, na, paredha ama lamatua, nuka sèmi pèku èci dhu dhèu sab'a dhasi lasi lolo ètu d'ara dano. ka pèku ne lèke rupa-rupa i'a.

source_text: when it was full it was dragged ashore. the good fish were put into baskets while the bad ones were thrown away.
target_text: ropa pèku ne pènu dènge i'a, dhèu pèku se ded'e rèti asa dedha nebhe. hèia ra madhèdi kabhili i'a nèti pèku ne. i'a dhu be'a, ra tao asa d'ara kalera. te ngaa i'a dhu karehe, ra core eele.

source_text: that's the way it will be when the end of the world comes. the angels will go out and separate the evil people from the good,
target_text: èci èèna ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne. èèna na ana pajuu lamatua mai nèti sorga, sèna ka hag'e eele dhèu dhu d'ara mola nèti dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: and throw them into the blazing furnace where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra, core si asa d'ara ai naraka. ètu nèi, rèngu heka re'a j'aj'èra, aa loe boe tangi roma iisi.

source_text: now do you understand everything? yes, they replied.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus karèi ra, aku nèngu na, miu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai se, do? ra dhaa peka na, nge'a, ama!

source_text: this is why every religious teacher who's learned about the kingdom of heaven is like a house-owner who brings out from his storeroom both new and old treasures, jesus said.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, be'a! te mese agama aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a tare'a-re'a lii holo-nori lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru èèna, ka ra kèpe pa'èra a'aj'a ja'a, na, rèngu ca ropa dènge lamatua èmu dhu d'èi bhoke gud'a na, ho pad'elo mèdha-panyau na dhu dhui, dènge mèdha-panyau na dhu hiu.

source_text: after jesus finished telling these stories, he left.
target_text: ropa yesus aj'a nare dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, hèia la'e, tèke eele era èèna,

source_text: he went back to his home town and taught in the synagogue there. people were amazed, and asked, where does he get his wisdom and miracles from?
target_text: ho lèpa asa rae na. d'ai nèi, maso la'e asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ho aj'a-nori dhèu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi lii padhai na malaa-maloha. ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, ira ii! dhèu ne d'èlu-mèu titu kèna, nga! na sakola ètu mia ne? tasamia ka na bisa tao tadha malaa se'e?

source_text: isn't this the carpenter's son? isn't his mother's name mary, and his brothers james, and joseph, and simon, and judas?
target_text: nèngu ne dhoka ana nèti ca dhèu tuka aj'u di. èdhi patadha be'a dènge ina na maria; aa dènge ari na aa'i-aa'i, nuka yakobis, yusuf, yudas dènge simon.

source_text: don't his sisters live here among us? so where does he get all this from?
target_text: èdhi tadhe ana hèni na kahèi, te èdhi pea ètu d'ara rae cue! de na abhu mamèu na nèti mia? aa na abhu koasa kapai ne nèti cee hari?

source_text: and so they refused to believe in him. a prophet is honored everywhere except in his homeland and in his family, jesus told them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu se kacèki, toke ra ro'o heka nanene lii padhai na. te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! dhèu d'èi risi pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti era leo, te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti rae rèngu unu ra.

source_text: since they failed to trust in him, he did not do many miracles there.
target_text: lula d'ara ra adhu, toke ra parcaya boe yesus, nèti èèna ka na tao tadha malaa ae boe ètu d'ara rae na.

source_text: at that time herod the tetrarch heard what jesus was doing
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi galilea. nèngu ne dhu tadèngi le kahèi rupa-rupa j'ara lula-nèti yesus.

source_text: and he told his servants, he must be john the baptist resurrected from the dead, and that's why he has such powers!
target_text: na peka dènge dhèu sab'a na sèra, aku nèngu na, ele boe yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a pua dhèu poro rare kètu na. limuri ne, na mamuri hari le! nèti èèna ka, na abhu koasa, tao tadha-tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: herod had detained john, and had him put in chains and imprisoned on account of herodias, the wife of philip, his brother.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes peka sèmi èèna, lula uru èèna nèngu dhu tao lii langu dènge yohanis, toke na kèpe yohanis aa pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne, sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia-pa'ela mèka.

source_text: for john had been telling him, it's not legal for you to marry her.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai ne pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae, baku paleo èmu dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te j'ara ne, pamèci boe dènge ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi!

source_text: herod wanted to kill john but he was afraid of the people's reaction for they considered john a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa herodes dale boe lii kai na, hèia leo nare herodias. madhutu iia-iia na, herodes neo pamadhe yohanis tuka sarani. te ngaa na madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, lula ra parcaya na, yohanis ne, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, na pua dhèu sab'a na pamaso yohanis asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: however, on herod's birthday the daughter of herodias danced for the party, and herod was delighted with her.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, hèia herodes tao pesta hari jadi na. lod'o èèna, ana bhèni nèti bhèni aae herodias la'e roge ètu madha tamu se. na roge be'a titu kèna, toke d'ara herodes karej'e bia.

source_text: so he promised with an oath to give her whatever she wanted.
target_text: na roge nare, hèia herodes paroa ne, ka na peka, èu neo manèngi hadia ngaa nèti ja'a, na peka la! te èèna na ja'a hia èu. ja'a leko boe-monya boe. aa ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: prompted by her mother, she said, give me here on a plate the head of john the baptist.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi dhèu aae peka sèmi èèna, hèia ina na kakèj'i ne. nèti èèna ka, ana ne la'e peka na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu nèti yohanis tuka sarani. tèke ne mi d'ara dula, ho rèti mai asa ne'e hia ja'a.

source_text: then the king regretted the promise he had made, but because of the oaths he'd made in front of his dinner guests, he gave the order to do it.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii manèngi ana bhèni ne, hèia d'ara herodes roe dènge. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe ère nare hari lii subha na, te tamu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le. nèti èèna ka, na madhutu dhoka dad'èi ana bhèni ne di.

source_text: the order was passed on and john was beheaded in prison.
target_text: ka na paredha dhèu lasi poro rare kètu yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho.

source_text: john's head was brought on a plate and given to the girl, who took it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, hèia ra tèke mi d'ara dula ho rèti lasi hia mi ana bhèni ne. ropa ana bhèni ne sèmi nare dula, hèia nèti asa ina na.

source_text: john's disciples came and took the body, and buried him. then they went and told jesus.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se tadèngi, ka mai rare ngi'u aae na, ho lasi padhane. èle ka, lasi peka dènge yesus j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: when jesus heard the news he went away by boat to a quiet place to be alone, but when the crowds learned where he was, they followed him on foot from the towns.
target_text: lod'o yesus tadèngi ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi yohanis, hèia nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna. hèia ra ca'e koha, ho lasi asa era dhu dhèu pea boe, sèna ka ra ae rare ciki. te ngaa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi koha yesus si dhu oro-oro re sebhe dano. ka dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae, kako karohe-karohe re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se d'ai uuru nèti yesus si.

source_text: when jesus got out of the boat and saw the huge crowds, he was full of sympathy for them, and healed their sick.
target_text: ropa na puru nèti dedha koha, hèia nèdhi dhèu ae-ae dhu mate le nèngu. ka na rasa kasia mi rèngu. hèia na puri-pa'èle papèd'a-tarègu ra.

source_text: as evening came the disciples went up to him and said, this place is miles from anywhere and it's getting late. send the crowds away so they can go to the villages and buy food for themselves.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia, hèia ana madhutu na, peka dènge ne, ama! hua iia ama pua dhèu se, sèna ka lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae-rae dhu padètu ètu se'e. te lod'o nihia le! ètu ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but jesus told them, they don't need to leave. you give them something to eat!
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, baku! miu ka dhu panga'a si.

source_text: all we have here are five loaves and a couple of fish, they replied.
target_text: te ngaa ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ira ee, ama! ji'i se dènge boe ngaa-ngaa, ho panga'a dhèu ae-ae sèmi ne'e ne. ji'i tao tasamia? te abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua di, aa i'a dua ngi'u di!

source_text: bring them to me, said jesus.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii, peka na, oo! be'a kèna. mèti ku mai!

source_text: he told the crowds to sit down on the grass. then he took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven and blessed them. after that he broke the loaves into pieces and gave the bread to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the crowds.
target_text: ka na pua dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra madhèdi kaboko ètu dedha j'u'u. èle èèna ka, yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. hèia na ladhe asa dedha, ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle ka, na pamae roti se, hèia j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: everybody ate until they were full. then they collected up the leftovers which filled twelve baskets.
target_text: ka dhèu se ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rara, hèia ana madhutu se pakaboko rare dhu ata, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: some five thousand men ate the food, not counting women and children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone pe d'ai lèmi riho sa, iga mèka dhèu bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: right after this he made the disciples get into the boat and go back to the other side of the lake while he sent the crowds on their way.
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a rare, hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na ca'e koha, sèna ka lasi uru asa cabèka dano. te ngaa nèngu ètu èèna era, sena ka pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: after he'd sent the crowds away, he went up into the mountains to pray. evening came and he was there all alone.
target_text: ropa rèngu lèpa aa'i mèu-mèu, hèia yesus ca'e la'e asa ledhe èci, ho sabaj'a. toke mèda, nèngu mesa na ètu èèna era.

source_text: by now the boat was a long way out from land, being pounded by the waves because the wind was blowing against it.
target_text: lod'o èèna, koha ana madhutu na d'ai le talora aae dano. te ngaa rèngu tuku d'ai madhe, lula ngèlu nèti madha, aa naha kapai tatèb'e koha ra.

source_text: about 3 a. m. jesus caught up with them, walking on the sea.
target_text: oe d'ai mèu, hèia yesus la'e madhutu si. te ngaa nèngu dhu kako re dedha èi.

source_text: when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were terrified. they screamed out in fear, it's a ghost!
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, ana madhutu se cag'ag'a, hèia ra padhai dènge lii madha'u, aku rèngu na, heeh! nidhu kèna!

source_text: but immediately jesus said to them, don't worry, it's me! don't be afraid!
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, peka na, miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne, yesus! mau-mau la!

source_text: lord, if it's really you, tell me to come over to you, walking on the water, peter replied.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne'e, hèia petrus peka na, ladhe ama kèna, pua la ja'a kako re dedha èi ne, dhiu asa ama.

source_text: come on then, said jesus. peter got out of the boat and walked on the water towards jesus.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa peka na, mai ka! hèia petrus puru nèti dedha koha, la'e re dedha èi, asa yesus.

source_text: but when he saw how strong the wind was, he became scared, and started to sink. lord! save me! he cried out.
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus rasa na ngèlu aae, hèia na madha'u bia. ka na mulai cène, hèia na pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ira oo, ama, ee! soru ku ja'a la!

source_text: immediately jesus reached out and grabbed hold of him, and said, you have such little trust in me. why did you doubt?
target_text: yesus j'ole dènge ka kacui-aai na, ka kèpe nare petrus. hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, petrus, ee! nga tao ka d'ara èu kajari? èu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a, do?

source_text: when they got into the boat, the wind died down,
target_text: ka dua ra ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, hèia ngèlu mau dènge.

source_text: and those in the boat worshiped him, saying, you really are the son of god!
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ana madhutu na koa-kio padedha-dedha ne, peka na, ira ii! ama ne, mema tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: after crossing the lake they arrived at gennesaret.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, hèia ra puru lasi asa dedha nebhe nèti rae genesaret.

source_text: when the people there realized jesus was there, they let everyone in the whole area know. they brought all who were sick to him,
target_text: lod'o ra puru èèna, dhèu ae dhu tadhe le. hèia dhèu pa'oo, peka na, wee! yesus mai le! ra rai lasi peka palème, hèia dhèu rèti dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and pleaded with him to let the sick just touch the edge of his cloak. everyone that touched him was healed.
target_text: ra manèngi sèna ka ra goi lèke kodho yesus. te ra pangee na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a goi lèke suu kodho na, tatu dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu dhu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i se goi kodho yesus, ka ra èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: then some pharisees and religious teachers from jerusalem came to jesus and asked him,
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu parisi dènge mese agama ca nau mai nèti yerusalem, ho paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: why do your disciples break the tradition of our forefathers by not washing their hands before they eat a meal?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi rèngu. lod'o rèngu tadèngi, na, ladhe ana madhutu yesus ra'a-rinu dhu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu ad'a ra, hèia ra nasa. ka rèngu mai ho pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe ai? èèna na, sisu le ad'a bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: why do you break god's commandment because of your tradition? jesus replied.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! miu d'èlu-mèu lab'a paredha ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu ad'a tatao nèti bèi-baki miu di.

source_text: for god said, ‘honor your father and mother, ' and ‘those who curse their father or mother should be put to death. '
target_text: te ama lamatua paredha, peka na, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa peka hari, na, ‘ladhe ca dhèu padhèd'a aapa ina do ama na, hud'i huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but you say that if someone tells their father or mother, ‘whatever you might have expected to get from me is now a gift to god, ' then they don't have to honor their father. in this way you've annulled god's word for the sake of your tradition.
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna ka, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ca dhèu parluu boe pake mèdha-panyau na, sèna ka soru-bara ina-ama na, masi ka rèngu ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, ladhe na pamoa le neo hia mèdha ne asa lamatua' te ngaa dènge aj'a sèmi èèna, miu core eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho gati dènge atora unu miu.

source_text: you hypocrites! how well isaiah described you when he prophesied:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a dhu peka le, miu se, dhèu dhu padhai lii leo tao leo! èèna na, nuka sèmi yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke, peka na,

source_text: ‘these people say they honor me but in their minds they don't care about me.
target_text: ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara.

source_text: their worship of me is pointless. what they teach are just man-made requirements. '
target_text: masi ka rèngu tao sèmi èèna, te ngaa parcuma. ra pusi-pahae boe ja'a, te rèngu sèra pahae dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. '

source_text: he called the crowd over and told them, listen, and understand this:
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu leo ètu èèna, ka na aj'a si, peka na, pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu!

source_text: it's not what goes into you through your mouth that defiles you. it's what comes out of your mouth that defiles you.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara hèb'a, pakaj'alu boe dhèu. te ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: then jesus' disciples came to him and said, you do realize that the pharisees were offended by what you said.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu na mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama me'a, do? dhèu parisi se d'ara pèd'a ropa tadèngi lii padhai ama.

source_text: every plant my heavenly father didn't plant will be uprooted, jesus replied.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ama ku ètu sorga, èèna na core eele dhèu dhu aj'a madhutu boe dad'èi na. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu ko'o eele j'u'u dhu na d'èi boe.

source_text: forget about them-they are blind guides. if a blind man leads another blind man, then they'll both fall into a ditch.
target_text: de baku pusi-pahae dènge dhèu parisi sèi! te rèngu ca ropa dènge dhèu bèdhu dhu pakako dhèu bèdhu. èèna na ra manahu palere-lere asa d'ara ro'a lasi.

source_text: then peter asked, please tell us what you mean by this illustration.
target_text: ka petrus lii, peka na, ama, lole ku dènge ji'i la, sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na!

source_text: haven't you understood this yet? replied jesus.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, miu me'a mèka kahèi?

source_text: don't you see that whatever goes in through the mouth then passes through the stomach, and then leaves the body as waste?
target_text: sasoa na sèmi ne'e: ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara hèb'a, la'e taruu asa kabake, èle èèna kalua hari la'e asa d'ara kakus.

source_text: but what comes out through the mouth comes from the mind, and that's what defiles you.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara hèb'a, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu, toke ama lamatua madenge dènge ne, aa d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for what comes from the mind are evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false witness, and blasphemy
target_text: te j'ara-j'ara karehe, ae ka dhu mai nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee dhu bhelu, pamadhe dhèu, bersina, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, mana'u, sakasii kapod'e-kabèli, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: and those are what defile you. eating with unwashed hands doesn't defile you.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara se'e ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu dhoka ra'a j'amo boe ai madhutu ad'a, èèna sala boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: jesus left and went to the region of tyre and sidon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tèke eele era ne'e, kako la'e asa kota tirus dènge kota sidon.

source_text: a canaanite woman from that area came, shouting out, lord, son of david! please have mercy on me, because my daughter is suffering badly because she's possessed by a demon!
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu ina ca dhèu dhu j'aj'aj'i na nèti rai ne'e. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe. ropa na tadèngi nare yesus mai le asa ne'e, hèia la'e manèngi, peka na, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud! sue ku ja'a la! te ana bhèni ja'a, lèke nidhu tao. kasia ku ji'i la! te na j'èra d'ai seli.

source_text: but jesus didn't reply at all. his disciples came to him and told him, tell her to stop following us. all her shouting is really annoying!
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, aa dhaa boe ngaa-ngaa ciki sa. hèia ana madhutu na mai peka dènge ne, ama, ina ne pa'oo-parodha loe boe. be'a risi ama babège eele ne nèti ne'e!

source_text: i was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of israel, jesus said to the woman.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, ho soru-bara dhèu èdhi dhèu yahudi, lula rèngu kako sala j'ara, nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu re'a heka j'ara. te na pua boe ja'a sèna ka soru-bara dhèu leo.

source_text: but the woman came and kneeled before him, and said, lord, please help me!
target_text: te ngaa ina ne mai padètu-dètu asa yesus. ka na patitu kètu urutuu dènge lii manèngi, ama! sue ku ja'a la!

source_text: it's not right to take the children's food and throw it to the dogs, jesus told her.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, pantas boe tare nganga'a nèti ana-ana, ka hia mi busa. dènge lii dhu pacele, sasoa na, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu unu na, heka bisa ladhe-leru dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: yes, lord, but even dogs are allowed to eat crumbs that fall from their master's table, she replied.
target_text: te ngaa ina ne b'ala, aku nèngu na, tare'a ama! te ngaa busa dhu mate mema ètu ro'a mei. rèngu ra'a kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe eele nèti d'ara pega ana sèra. sasoa na, ropa ana-ana ra'a, busa kahèi abhu ra'a. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i ladhe-leru dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: you have great trust in me, jesus answered. your wish is granted! and her daughter was healed immediately.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, ka yesus peka na, ira ii! ina parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a! de lèpa ka, lula ngaa dhu ina manèngi èèna, j'aj'i le! èle èèna ka, na lèpa, ka na ladhe nèdhi ana na dhu èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: jesus returned, passing by the sea of galilee. he went into the mountains nearby where he sat down.
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na tèke eele era ne'e, hèia ra kako madhutu re sebhe dano galilea. ka ra ca'e asa ledhe cue, hèia yesus madhèdi ho aj'a-nori si.

source_text: huge crowds came to him, bringing those who were lame, blind, crippled, dumb, and many others who were sick. they laid them on the ground at his feet, and he healed them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae-ae mai asa yesus. ra rèti dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dhèu lii aad'o, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu pèd'a leo kahèi. ra pamadhèdi dhèu pèd'a se padètu-dètu dènge haga yesus. ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: the crowd was astounded at what they saw happen: the deaf could speak, the crippled were healed, the lame could walk, and the blind could see. they praised the god of israel.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia dhèu ae se malaa. ra papeka na, ira ii! malaa titu kèna, nga! dhèu haga roe cabèka, bisa kako èra hari. dhèu bèdhu, bisa rèdhi. dhèu karuku, bisa kako. aa dhèu lii aad'o, bisa padhai lii! se'e se, tatu tatao ama lamatua. aa lamatua èèna ka, dhu uru-uru sèra bèi-baki èdhi pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: jesus called his disciples over and told them, i feel really sorry for all these people, because they've been with me now for three days, and they have nothing to eat. i don't want to send them away hungry, in case they faint on their way home.
target_text: lalu eele pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae-ae se. abhu dhu mai nèti era kaj'èu, ra pakaboko ètu ne'e tèlu lod'o kèna, toke gee ra èle aa'i le. be'a risi baku hia si lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra bèbha ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: where could we find enough bread here in this desert to feed such a huge crowd? the disciples responded.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama! era ne'e kaj'èu nèti rae. tatu, èdhi bisa boe panga'a tare dhèu ae-ae sèmi se'e.

source_text: how many loaves of bread do you have? jesus asked. seven, and a few small fish, they replied.
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, roti miu pèri bua? ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, dhoka pidhu di, dènge i'a pèri ngi'u di!

source_text: jesus told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
target_text: ka yesus pua dhèu se'e madhèdi ètu rai.

source_text: he took the seven loaves and the fish, and after blessing the food he broke it into pieces and gave it to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the crowds.
target_text: hèia nare roti pidhu bua dènge i'a sèra, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti se, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka ra papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: everybody ate until they were full, and then they collected the leftovers, filling seven baskets.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu. ka ra kaboko rare nganga'a dhu ata, pènu pidhu soe hahake.

source_text: four thousand men ate the food, not counting women and children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra'a se, dhèu mone ele boe d'ai èpa riho dhèu sa. dhae ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki sèra.

source_text: then he sent the crowds away, got into a boat, and went to the magadan region.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua dhèu ae-ae sèra lèpa. hèia na ca'e asa dedha koha, ho lasi asa rai magadan.

source_text: the pharisees and sadducees came to test jesus, demanding that he show them a sign from heaven.
target_text: ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki, mai paraga dènge yesus. rèngu neo pakarèi dènge ne, sèna ka tenge j'ara neo pamanahu yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi sèmi ne'e ka, ama! tao ku tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, dhu peka na, ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus replied, in the evening you say, ‘it'll be a fine day tomorrow, because the sky is red, '
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, ladhe èdhi tèdhi liru mea ropa lod'o cèna, èdhi te'a, na, ‘bèli èj'i mai boe. '

source_text: while in the morning you say, ‘it'll be bad weather today, because the sky is red and overcast. ' you know how to predict the weather by what the sky looks like, but you can't recognize the signs of the times!
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o rea, aa liru mèdhi, na èdhi te'a, na, ‘doe ne'e, oe èj'i. ' de ladhe miu bisa patadhe mere tadha ètu liru sèmi sèra, nga tao ka miu bisa boe patadhe mere sasoa nèti tadha-tadha jaman?

source_text: an evil and adulterous generation are the ones who look for a miraculous sign, and no sign will be given to them except the sign of jonah. he left them and went away.
target_text: miu dhèu lod'o limuri ne, me'a dhodhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu di! miu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua! masi ka miu manèngi tadha malaa, te ngaa ja'a dale boe tao. lula uru èèna, lamatua dhu tao le tadha malaa re yunus, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. de èèna d'ai le! ropa padhai lii nare, hèia yesus tèke eele si.

source_text: having crossed to the other side of the lake, the disciples realized they'd forgotten to bring bread with them.
target_text: ropa yesus si lasi asa ca bèka dano, hèia ana madhutu na, heka sanèd'e, na, rèngu rèti boe roti tao gee j'ara.

source_text: watch out for the yeast of the pharisees and sadducees, jesus told them.
target_text: tadèngi rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia na peka na, miu baku pamud'e dènge ragi dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: the disciples started arguing among themselves. he's saying that because we didn't bring any bread, they concluded.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana madhutu na bingu, ka ra peka, na peka ngaa nèi? ele boe ne'a na, èdhi tèti boe roti, sina ma?

source_text: jesus knew what they were saying and said, you have so little trust in me! why are you arguing among yourselves about not having any bread?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. ka na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, wee, miu seli-kolane, nga! nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu parcaya boe ja'a, do?

source_text: haven't you worked it out yet? don't you remember the five loaves that fed five thousand? how many baskets of leftovers did you collect?
target_text: miu dhae me'a iia mèka koasa ja'a, do? te lod'o ja'a pamae lèmi bua roti ho panga'a lèmi riho dhèu sèra, dhu sisa, miu pakaboko mere pèri soe?

source_text: and what about the seven loaves that fed the four thousand? how many baskets of leftovers did you collect?
target_text: aa tasamia hari dènge roti pidhu bua dhu ja'a panga'a èpa riho dhèu sèra? abhu pèri soe hahake dhu miu pakaboko nèti dhu ra'a risi sèra?

source_text: haven't you worked it out yet that i wasn't talking to you about bread? watch out for the yeast of the pharisees and sadducees!
target_text: nga tao ka miu mo'o boe me'a dènge lii padhai ja'a deo na? ja'a padhue-padhai boe lula roti. te ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, sèna ka miu baku pamud'e dènge tatao dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki. te lii aj'a-nori ra bisa ère rare dhèu ae, nuka sèmi ragi dhu tao roti j'aj'i kapai.

source_text: then they realized that he wasn't warning them to watch out for bread yeast, but about the teachings of the pharisees and sadducees.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, hèia heka rèngu re'a kèna, na nèngu peka boe roti. te ngaa na padhue-padhai nèti a'aj'a dhu sale nèti dhèu parisi dènge dhèu saduki.

source_text: when jesus arrived in the region of caesarea philippi, he asked his disciples, who do people say that the son of man is?
target_text: èle, hèia yesus si lasi asa rai dhu padètu dènge kota kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, madhutu lii papeka dhèu, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, cee?

source_text: some say john the baptist, some say elijah, and others say jeremiah or one of the other prophets, they replied.
target_text: ra dhaa, peka na, abhu dhu peka na, ama ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu mamuri hari. cahag'e peka na, ele boe ama ne, elia. cahag'e hari ale na, yermia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu leo nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra.

source_text: but what about you? he asked them. who do you say i am?
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari si, ladhe madhutu miu mesa mi, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: you are the messiah, the son of the living god, simon peter replied.
target_text: hèia simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho neo hia mai! aa ama ne, ana ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia!

source_text: you are truly blessed, simon son of john, jesus told him. for this wasn't revealed to you by human flesh and blood, but by my father in heaven.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii, peka na, simon, ana yunus! èu ne, oto kapai! te nèti boe dhèu rai-haha dhu peka lii ne'e dènge èu. te ngaa ama ku ètu sorga ka peka dènge èu.

source_text: i also tell you that you are peter, and on this rock i will build my church and the powers of death won't overcome it.
target_text: nanene, ee! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, ja'a pangare èu, ‘petrus'. dhu sasoa na, hadhu. lula parcaya èu, èra sèmi hadhu, èèna na èu j'aj'i era padhèdi nèti dhèu-dhèu ja'a dhu parcaya. masi ka rèngu abhu j'aj'èra toke madhe, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu.

source_text: i will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven, and whatever you ban on earth will have been banned in heaven, and whatever you allow on earth will have been allowed in heaven.
target_text: ja'a èèna na hia èu hak, sèna ka èu uri dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nuka sèmi èu mèd'u gagoe sorga. te, ngaa dhu èu kai ètu rai-haha, èèna na lamatua kai ètu sorga kahèi. dènge ngaa dhu èu hia isin ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua hia le isin ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: then he warned his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the messiah.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka yesus kai si ho rèngu baku peka dènge dhèu, na, nèngu ne, kristus.

source_text: from that time on jesus began to explain to his disciples that he would have to go to jerusalem, and that he would suffer terribly at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and religious teachers; and that he would be killed, but he would rise again on the third day.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku ku asa yerusalem. te ngaa ètu nèi, ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae, nèti dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra. èèna na ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari.
