target_text: rèhu ana pajuu ne kale'e sèmi kaha'a bela, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi mèu.

source_text: the guards shook with fear, falling down as if they were dead.
target_text: dhèu madhenga se, madha'u bia toke ra karèbha, ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto, nuka sèmi dhèu madhe sa.

source_text: the angel told the women, don't be afraid! i know you're looking for jesus, who was crucified.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, lii dènge dhèu bhèni se'e, aku nèngu na, miu baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a miu se mai tenge yesus, dhèu dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: he's not here. he's risen from the dead, just as he said he would. come and see where the lord was lying.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu aad'o heka ètu era ne'e. te na mamuri hari le, sama sèmi dhu na peka le uru èèna. maso mai, sèna ka mèdhi unu mi era dhu ra paj'unu ngi'u aae na. era ne ngaa-ngaa aad'o heka!

source_text: now go quickly and tell his disciples that he's risen from the dead and that he's going on ahead of you to galilee. you will see him there, i promise you!
target_text: de pamèri lèpa ka! lami lolo dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le. la'e uuru le asa galilea. rèngu hud'i lasi paraga uuru ku dènge ne ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna, na moa mema mi rèngu. parcaya la. lèpa ka, lami lole ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne!

source_text: they quickly left the tomb, both afraid and very happy, running to tell his disciples.
target_text: hèia bhèni se rai li'u lasi, tèke eele era ne'e. ra madha'u, te ngaa ra karej'e-karae kahèi. ka ra pamèri-mèri lèpa, lasi peka j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra mi ana madhutu yesus.

source_text: suddenly jesus came to meet them, and greeted them. they went over to him, held on to his feet and worshiped him.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, kabèdhi la yesus mai paraga dènge ra. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom! ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia lasi padètu-dètu, liku rare haga na, dènge pahaha iisi ra mi yesus.

source_text: then jesus said to them, don't be afraid! go and tell my brothers to leave for galilee, and they will see me there.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, peka na, baku madha'u! lami peka dènge ana madhutu ja'a, sèna ka ra lasi mate ja'a ètu galilea nèi.

source_text: as they left, some of the guards went into the city and explained to the chief priests everything that had happened.
target_text: lod'o dhèu bhèni se ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu madhenga se lèpa le asa kota. rèngu lasi lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i se mi kètu agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: after the chief priests had met with the elders, and worked out a plan, they bribed the soldiers with a great deal of money.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi rare lii èci dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, sèna ka b'ae doi ae-ae mi dhèu j'aga ho ra hutu hèb'a.

source_text: say that his disciples came during the night and stole him while we were sleeping, they told the soldiers.
target_text: kètu agama yahudi sèra peka, na, ladhe dhèu karèi miu, dhaa sèmi ne'e: d'ara mèda, ropa ji'i bhèj'i luu, nge'a boe, na, ana madhutu na mai mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na.

source_text: and if the governor hears about this, we'll talk to him and you won't have to worry.
target_text: aa ladhe gubernur tadèngi, mage miu madha'u, te ji'i ka dhu ator dènge ne.

source_text: so the soldiers took the money and did what they were told. this story has been spread among the jewish people to this very day.

source_text: john came, baptizing in the desert, announcing a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. everybody from the country of judea and from jerusalem went to him. they admitted their sins publicly and were baptized in the jordan river. john wore clothes made of camel hair, with a leather belt around his waist. he ate locusts and wild honey.

source_text: when jesus heard this, he told them, it's not healthy people who need a doctor, but those who are sick. i haven't come to invite those who live right, but those who don't-the sinners.
target_text: yesus tadèngi lii karèi rèngu èèna, ka na dhaa, peka na, dhèu pèd'a mema parluu dote, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe dote. mamai ja'a ne sèna ka lalau dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. te ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu rasa ngi'u na mola.

source_text: now john's disciples and the pharisees were fasting. some of them came to jesus, and asked him, why is it that john's disciples and the pharisees fast, but your disciples don't?
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi puasa. rèngu rèdhi ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani, puasa kahèi. te ngaa rèdhi boe ana madhutu yesus puasa sèmi rèngu. hèia dhèu rèngu mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama. ji'i puasa sama sèmi ana madhutu yohanis kahèi. te, nga tao ka, ana madhutu ama puasa boe?

source_text: do wedding guests fast while the bridegroom is with them? jesus asked them. no. while the bridegroom's with them, they can't fast.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema miu me'a le, ladhe abhu pesta kab'i, dhèu dhu abhu nèru sèra puasa boe, ka ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna era, dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra'a-rinu.

source_text: but the day is coming when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and then they'll fast.
target_text: te ladhe d'ai lod'o ho ra kèpe rèti dhèu mone dhu kab'i èèna, ka mone aanga-angalai na sèra d'ara susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: no one puts a patch that's not shrunk on old clothes. otherwise the new piece will shrink away from the old, and make the tear worse.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, bèla hiu baku kalape mi kodho dhui. te ladhe base, na, bèla hiu èèna karuku, hèia kodho èèna asa ka mae aae.

source_text: no one puts new wine in old wineskins. otherwise the wine will burst the wineskins, and both the wine and wineskins will be wasted. no. you put new wine in new wineskins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku edhe dhua pèd'u ètu d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha èèna mae, aa dhua pèd'u na bhori eele asa rai. nèti èèna ka yesus peka dènge si, baku pakihu-kee lii holo-nori nèngu dhu hiu, dènge lii holo-nori dhèu parisi dhu dhui.

source_text: one sabbath day as jesus was walking through the grain fields, his disciples started picking heads of grain as they walked along.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, yesus si kako re j'ara ètu d'ara oka. ka ana madhutu na g'ètu rèti are gandum.

source_text: the pharisees asked jesus, look, why are they doing what is not permitted on the sabbath?
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi, ka ra karèi yesus, tasamia ka, ana madhutu èu madhutu boe j'ara-j'ara agama èdhi? rèngu se g'ètu are gandum lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a. miu baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: haven't you ever read what david did when he and his men were hungry and in need? jesus asked them. he went into god's house when abiathar was high priest, and ate the consecrated bread which no one except the priests are permitted to eat, and gave it to his men too.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, samia, ee? miu sanèd'e heka lii lolo daud. tèu èèna, abyatar j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o èèna, daud dènge dhèu madhutu na aa'i-aa'i ra manganga bia. ka ra maso asa d'ara paleo ama lamatua, hèia ra'a roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu bisa ra'a roti èèna, dhoka ama-ama agama di; dhèu leo bisa boe. daud dènge ana madhutu na sèra, ra'e rare roti èèna, te ngaa dhèu èci sa peka boe, na, daud si sala.

source_text: the sabbath was made for your benefit, not for you to benefit the sabbath, he told them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lole hari dènge rèngu, miu baku bhèlu! lamatua hia lod'o a'oro sasab'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha. lamatua paj'aj'i boe èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ho madhutu dhoka atora lod'o a'oro sasab'a di.

source_text: so the son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ne ka dhu peka ho dhèu sab'a, do aad'o, lèke dènge lod'o a'oro sasab'a.

source_text: jesus went to the synagogue again. a man was there who had a crippled hand.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari la'e asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. d'ai nèi, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu èci dhu ai na roe cabèka.

source_text: some of those there were watching jesus to see if he would heal the man on the sabbath, because they were looking for a reason to accuse him of breaking the law.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu patangi-tenge sasala yesus. ra ma'u yesus, neo re'a na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, do aad'o.

source_text: jesus told the man with the crippled hand, come and stand here in front of everyone.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa dhèu dhu ai roe cabèka èèna, aku nèngu na, mai ku! titu ku mi madha ja'a ne.

source_text: is it lawful to do good on the sabbath, or to do evil? should you save life, or should you kill? he asked them. but they didn't say a word.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, èdhi bisa tao ngaa lod'o a'oro sasab'a? tao madha j'ara dhu be'a, do karehe? tao pabe'a dhèu, do pamadhe dhèu? te ngaa dhèu sèra èci sa bani boe bhoke hèb'a.

source_text: he looked around at them in exasperation, very upset by their hard-hearted attitude. then he told the man, hold out your hand. the man held out his hand, and it was healed.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus d'ara pèd'a, lula rèngu madhutu dhoka ad'a di, tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu ai roe cabèka ne. yesus nasa, ka na ladhe lème dhèu sèra. hèia na peka mi dhèu ai roe cabèka, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai sa ne'e! ka dhèu èèna soro kacui-aai asa yesus la'e. kabèdhi laa, èle dènge papèd'a na.

source_text: the pharisees left, and immediately began plotting with herod's party as to how they might kill jesus.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi yesus pa'èle kacui-aai dhèu èèna lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, aa'i-aa'i ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ka lasi padhue dènge dhèu partei politik herodes, ho tenge j'ara neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: meanwhile jesus returned to the sea, and a large crowd followed him. they were from galilee, judea, jerusalem, idumea, transjordan, and from the regions of tyre and sidon. so many people came to see him because they'd heard about all he was doing.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa sebhe dano galilea. te ngaa, lula dhèu ae sèra re'a le ngaa dhu nèngu tao, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai nèti rae-rae ho madhutu ne. rèngu mai nèti propensi galilea, propensi yudea, aa propensi idumea. abhu kahèi dhu mai nèti kota yerusalem, kota sidon dènge kota tirus. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu mai nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden. aa'i-aa'i sèra neo mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: jesus told his disciples to have a small boat ready in case the crowd crushed him,
target_text: taga dhèu dhu mai sèra ae seli, ka yesus pua ana madhutu na lasi tenge koha cue hia nèngu. na neo padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra nèti dedha koha, sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu na, aa tadèngi lii padhai lii na hèi.

source_text: because he had healed so many that all the sick people kept on pressing towards him so they could touch him.
target_text: ca hari ni, na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a ae titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai paseti èci dènge èci, neo g'ag'e yesus.

source_text: whenever the evil spirits saw him they would fall down in front of him and shout out, you are the son of god!
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu nidhu tao sa ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra bèbha d'ai rai ètu madha yesus. hèia ra taraa, aku rèngu na, èu ne mema tare'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: but he commanded them not to reveal who he was.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa hèi, ja'a ne cee!

source_text: then jesus went away to the hill country. he called those he wanted to be with him, and they came to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako la'e asa kolo ledhe èci. na paroa pèri-pèri dhèu dhu nèngu d'èi. ka dhèu se mai madhutu ne.

source_text: he chose twelve to be with him, and called them apostles. they were to be with him, and he would send them out to announce the good news,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hag'e nare dhèu canguru dua. ka na peka, ja'a pili miu ho madhutu taruu ja'a, j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a. ja'a neo pua miu, lami lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and with the authority to drive out demons.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a neo hia miu koasa, sèna ka miu bisa babège-lalèta nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: these are the twelve he chose: simon whom he called peter, james the son of zebedee and his brother john who he called boanerges, meaning sons of thunder, andrew, philip, bartholomew, matthew, thomas, james the son of alphaeus, thaddaeus, simon the revolutionary, and judas iscariot who betrayed him.
target_text: ngara dhèu canguru dua sa, nuka: simon dhu yesus pangare na, petrus, yakobis, yohanis, yakobis dènge ari na, yohanis ne, dua ra ana sabadeus. yesus pangare rèngu dua ra, ngara na ‘boanerges', dhu sasoa na ‘sama sèmi d'oro'. anderias, pelipus, bertolomeos, mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, tadius, simon dhu madhutu partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie eele yesus.

source_text: jesus went home, but such a large crowd gathered again that he and his disciples didn't even have time to eat.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru hari nèti kolo ledhe deo na. ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. dhèu ae titu kèna mai oke rare ne, ka na bisa boe na'a-ninu.

source_text: when jesus' family heard about it, they came to take him away, saying, he's lost his senses!
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku yesus! ne'a heka lalau iisi na. ropa a'ari na tadèngi lii palolo dhèu, ka ra mai neo rare ne.

source_text: but the religious leaders from jerusalem said, he's possessed by beelzebub! it's by the ruler of demons that he's driving out demons!
target_text: lod'o èèna, mese-mese agama nèti yerusalem mai peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku rèngu na, heh! pasa dhilu miu! baku madhutu yesus. te dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra paroa ngara na baalsebul, maso asa d'ara yesus, ka hia ne koasa, ho bata-magèla nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: but jesus called them over to him. using illustrations he asked them, how can satan throw out satan?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii padhue rèngu èèna, heia na paroa nare rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na peka, lèke boe dènge ngangee dhèu! tasamia ka dhèu aae nidhu bisa babège ngi'u mesa na! ?

source_text: a kingdom fighting itself can't continue.
target_text: ladhe ètu d'ara paredha dhèu aae èci, ana kabarai sèra èci patao-palaha dènge èci, paredha dhèu aae èèna taha nèbhu boe.

source_text: a household that's divided is doomed.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu, ladhe isi èmu èci patao dènge èci, isi èmu èèna mae-manyèla!

source_text: if satan is divided and fights against himself, he won't last long-he'll soon come to an end.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge nidhu. ladhe èci pamusu dènge èci, rèngu mae-manyèla kahèi. sèmi èèna na, heka rèngu laho kao-kao.

source_text: clearly, if someone breaks into the house of a strong man and tries to take his things, he won't get far in his theft unless he ties up the strong man first.
target_text: ladhe dhèu parapo neo mai parapo èmu dhèu èra èci, na hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku lamatua èmu na, heka bau nèti mèdha-panyau kèna.

source_text: i tell you the truth: all sins and blasphemies can be forgiven,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu: ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii karehe mi dedha dhèu leo, ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala na era.

source_text: but if people blaspheme by rejecting the holy spirit they can never be forgiven, because they are guilty of an eternal sin.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai lii karehe mi dedha roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala nèngu, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: jesus said this because they said, he has an evil spirit.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu sèra peka na, dhèu èèna, nidhu tao.

source_text: then jesus' mother and brothers arrived. they waited outside and sent him a message, asking him to come out.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ina dènge ari yesus sèra mai tenge ne. d'ai èmu dhu yesus madhèdi ètu d'ara na, rèngu lasi boe asa d'ara, te ngaa ra titu ètu li'u, ka ra hia dhèu lasi paroa yesus.

source_text: the crowd that was sitting around him told him, your mother and brothers are outside asking for you.
target_text: lasi, na, yesus madhèdi padhai lii dènge dhèu ae. ka dhèu sèra peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ina mu dènge a'ari mu nuka ètu li'u si. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: who is my mother? who are my brothers? he responded.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a?

source_text: looking around at all those sitting there in a circle, he said, here is my mother! here are my brothers!
target_text: hèia na ladhe palème asa dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, ka na peka, miu se'e se ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: whoever does what god wants, they are my brother, and sister, and mother.
target_text: te cee ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: jesus began teaching beside the sea again. so many people came to listen to him that he climbed into a boat and sat in it on the water while the crowd listened from the shore.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e hari asa dano galilea. d'ai nèi dhèu ae mai oke rare ne. ka yesus ca'e la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue dhu panahu. na aj'a dhèu sèra dènge lii pakasame. dhèu dhu titu ètu dedha salae sèra aa'i-aa'i nanene yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: he illustrated his teachings using many stories.
target_text: na aj'a si lii holo-nori rupa-rupa pake lii pakasame. aku nèngu sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: listen, he said. a sower went out to sow.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! dhèu èci la'e ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: now as he was scattering the seeds, some fell on the path, and birds came and ate them up.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini sèra, cahag'e lèke ètu sebhe j'ara. kabèdhi laa, manu-bhui mai ka ra'a aa'i.

source_text: other seeds fell on stony ground where there wasn't much earth. in the shallow soil the plants started growing quickly, but because the soil wasn't deep
target_text: cahag'e hari lèke ètu era rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini sèra muri, te ngaa rai isi dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: they were scorched when the sun came up. since they didn't have any real roots, they soon withered.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea mai, ana nganga'a sèra kamale eele hèia madhe aa'i si, lula amo d'ai boe d'ara rai.

source_text: other seeds fell among thorns. the thorns grew up and choked the sprouting seeds, so they produced nothing.
target_text: hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge j'u'u padhudhu. ropa j'u'u sèra muri, hèlu rare ana nganga'a sèra, ka j'aj'i boe hua-hela.

source_text: other seeds fell on good soil where they sprouted and grew. they produced a harvest of some thirty, some sixty, and some a hundred times what was planted.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini sèra muri dènge sega. hua ae titu kèna. cahag'e dhu abhu d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e èna nguru hari, aa cahag'e d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: if you have ears to hear, listen to what i'm saying.
target_text: de ladhe cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: when he was by himself, his twelve disciples and the others who were with him asked him what the illustrations meant.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mesa na. hèia ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge pèri-pèri dhèu dhu tadèngi le lii holo-nori na, mai paraga dènge ne. ka ra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame èèna.

source_text: he told them, the mystery of god's kingdom has been given to you to understand. but outsiders only have the stories,
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, lula miu tare'a-re'a neo me'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a neo peka dènge miu. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: so that even though they see, they don't really ‘see, ' and even though they hear, they don't understand, otherwise they might turn to me and be forgiven.
target_text: tatao dhèu leo sèra sama sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe tèke ètu d'ara. ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i rèngu sène. ra parcaya ia ka lamatua, sèna ka lamatua saku eele ia ka sasala ra. '

source_text: don't you understand this story? jesus asked them. if you can't, how are you going to understand all the other stories?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu sèra sasoa lii pakasame hini èèna, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu me'a boe sasoa nèti lii upama deo na, carui risi hari miu me'a sasoa lii pakasame dhu leo.

source_text: the sower sows the word.
target_text: de sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu ceb'e hini èèna, nuka dhèu dhu lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: the seeds on the path where the word is sown illustrate those who hear the message, but then satan immediately comes along and takes away the word that's been sown in them.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu sebhe j'ara ka manu-bhui mai ra'a aa'i, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ngaa nèbhu boe, dhèu aae nidhu mai parame rare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu èèna.

source_text: likewise the seeds on the rocky ground illustrate those who hear the word, and happily accept it right away.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha hadhu, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene, ka na sèmi nare lii holo-nori èèna dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: but since they have no real roots, they only last for a while until trouble or persecution comes, and then they quickly fall away.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, taha nèbhu boe ètu d'ara dhèu èèna. ropa nèngu paraga j'aj'èra lula na sèmi nare lii ne'e, na tèke eele.

source_text: those sown among the thorns illustrate those who hear the word,
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora j'u'u dhu padudhu, èci èèna ka dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu dhèu nanene.

source_text: but worries of this world, the temptation of wealth, and other distractions choke the growth of the word, and it becomes unproductive.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èèna bhute dhoka dènge rupa-rupa madha j'ara rai-haha dhu pakarej'e ngi'u na. nèti èèna ka, j'ara se'e seti eele lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti d'ara nèngu, ka j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but the seeds sown on good soil illustrate those who hear the word, accept it, and are productive-producing thirty, sixty, and a hundred times what was originally sown.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge karej'e-karae. tatao nèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu ne'e tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, sama sèmi hini dhu nèti hua-hela. abhu kahèi d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e d'ai èna nguru hari, aa abhu kahèi dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: who puts a lamp under a bucket, or beneath a bed? jesus asked them. no, you put a lamp up on a lamp-stand.
target_text: nèti dedha koha, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na. na peka hari lii upama èci, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee! miu mèdhi le, do dhae? dhèu suru rare labhu, ka saguru eele hari dènge soe! ka ra tèke asa ro'a koi la'e! aad'o, sina ma? te ladhe sèmi èèna, tèdhi boe saraa nèngu. dhèu hud'i tao labhu ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka dhèu rèdhi saraa nèngu.

source_text: everything that is hidden will be revealed, and everything that is secret will be brought out into the open.
target_text: ngaa dhu dhèu pahuni deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu rèdhi aa'i. te ngaa dhu dhèu re'a boe lod'o deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu re'a aa'i.

source_text: if you have ears to hear, listen to what i'm saying!
target_text: de ladhe cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: pay attention to what you're hearing, he told them, for you will be given according to how much you want to receive, measure for measure.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu tenge sasala dhèu, na, dhèu leo tenge sasala miu kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua tenge sasala miu. te ngaa na tao bia risi hari nèti èèna.

source_text: more will be given to those who already have understanding, but those who don't want to know will have what little understanding they have taken from them.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, nèngu j'aj'i asa goa.

source_text: god's kingdom is like a man sowing seed in the ground, jesus said.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua asa tabha kapai, sama sèmi hini dhu dhèu ceb'e ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: he goes to bed and gets up, day after day, but the man has no knowledge of how the seeds sprout and grow.
target_text: nèngu ceb'e nare, ka la'e bhèj'i. tao heka ai hèb'a mi hini sèra. te ngaa hini sèra muri, ka asa kapai.

source_text: the earth produces a harvest by itself. first a shoot appears, then the heads of grain, and then the heads of grain ripen.
target_text: hini se muri unu ra. mulai ti rèu, hela, toke d'ai huri.

source_text: when the grain is ripe, the farmer reaps it with a sickle, because the harvest is ready.
target_text: ropa kasere nare nganga'a dhu ètu d'ara oka mami, dhèu unu oka heka la'e puu-g'ètu kèna. sèmi èèna kahèi, paredha ama lamatua. lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: what can we compare god's kingdom to? what illustration shall we use? he asked.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, ja'a peka hari lii upama èci sèmi ne'e ka: miu ladhe sèku, dhèu dhu j'aj'i unu lamatua sèra. uru èèna ciki di, nèbhu-nèbhu j'aj'i ae.

source_text: it's like a mustard seed, the tiniest seed of all.
target_text: èèna sama sèmi lamusi aj'u dhu ana iiki-iiki.

source_text: but when it's sown it grows into a plant that's larger than other plants. it has branches big enough that birds can roost in its shade.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sèla lamusi èèna, na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae. manu-bhui nèti mia-mia mai tèka tenge mamaho, dènge tao rèd'a ètu kolo aj'u èèna.

source_text: jesus used many of these illustrated stories when he spoke to the people so they would understand as much as they could.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara a'aj'a yesus madhutu rare'a dhèu.

source_text: in fact, when he spoke publicly, he only used stories; however in private he explained everything to his disciples.
target_text: ladhe na aj'a dhèu leo, na pake lii pakasame. te ngaa ladhe na aj'a ana madhutu na, nèngu peka aa'i-aa'i sasoa lii pakasame sèra.

source_text: later that day, in the evening, he said to his disciples, let's go across to the other side of the sea.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia na, yesus aj'a dhèu nèti dedha koha era. hèia na pua ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, mai èdhi pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: leaving the crowd behind, the disciples went with jesus, just as he was, and got into a boat. other boats went with them.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha èci dènge yesus. ra pakèd'i tèke eele dhèu ae sèra ètu èèna. te ngaa dhèu cahag'e ca'e koha leo madhutu yesus si.

source_text: soon a terrible storm started blowing, and waves crashed against the boat, filling it with water. jesus was asleep in the stern, resting his head on a cushion. the disciples woke him up, shouting at him, teacher, don't you care that we're about to drown?
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus pasaluu kètu na mi nanèlu, ka bhèj'i luu ètu hui koha. nèbhu boe ka, ngèlu aae mai. naha kapai, ka èi tao sabhori oe pènu koha yesus si. nèti èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u bia. hèia ra parèi ne, ama! kèd'i ku laa! èdhi oe molo kèna! te ngaa ama pusi-pahae boe!

source_text: jesus woke up. he told the wind to die down and told the waves, be quiet! be still. the wind stopped, and the water became completely calm.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii parèi ra, ka na kèd'i, hèia na kai ngèlu, peka na, mau ka! ka na paredha naha, aku nèngu na, mera ka! hèia ngèlu mau, aa naha mera dènge ka.

source_text: why are you so frightened? haven't you learned to trust me? he asked them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus jèke ana madhutu na, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u sèmi èèna? miu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o?

source_text: they were stunned and terrified. they asked each other, who is this? even the wind and the waves obey him!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge malaa, ka èci peka dènge èci, te dhèu ngaa ne? ka bisa ngèlu dènge naha, madhutu lii paredha nèngu?

source_text: they arrived on the other side of the lake in the region of the gerasenes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra d'ai cabèka dano galilea. era èèna, ngara na garasa.

source_text: when jesus got out of the boat a man with an evil spirit came from the graveyard to meet him. this man lived among the tombs, and it had been impossible to tie him up any longer, even with a chain. he had often been tied up with chains and shackles, but he simply tore the chains apart and broke the shackles into pieces. no one had the strength to subdue him. day and night he was always shouting out among the tombs and in the hills nearby, cutting himself with sharp stones. seeing jesus from a distance he ran and kneeled in front of him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci dhu nidhu tao, ka na huj'u. dhèu huj'u ne pea ètu era padhane dhèu madhe. mèu-mèda na kako ca'e-puru ledhe ètu èèna, dènge pake boe mèdha-papake. na pa'oo-parodha ma'ète boe, aa na nare hadhu ho tuku iisi na toke d'ai nu'a. na èra titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe èki ne. masi ka ra èki dènge rate bèsi èèna ka, bisa boe kahèi. pèri-pèri hari, dhèu uj'u haga-ai na kahèi, pake rate dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na pama'ète aa'i si. dhèu ne èra bia, nèti èèna ka, èci sa taha boe ne. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu huj'u èèna ladhe nèdhi rèngu nèti kaj'èu. hèia na kalua nèti era padhane dhèu madhe, ka na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: in a loud voice he cried out, what have you to do with me, jesus, son of almighty god? swear by god that you won't torture me! for jesus had already told the evil spirit to leave the man.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi rèhu dhèu ne'e, hèia yesus peka, na, hee, nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu nèti dhèu ne'e. èle èèna ka, dhèu èèna pajèka, aku nèngu na, weh! èu neo tao ngaa mi ja'a? ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. ja'a manèngi èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: then jesus asked him, what is your name? my name is legion, because we are many! he replied.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ngara ja'a legion, lula ji'i ae titu kèna, sama sèmi ca kaboko sordad'u!

source_text: he also repeatedly pleaded with jesus not to send them a long way away.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nidhu sèra peka re dhèu huj'u èèna, ho manèngi yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu kalua nèti d'ara rae ne.

source_text: a large herd of pigs was feeding on the hillside nearby.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti èèna, abhu hahi ca oka dhu dhèu madhenge. ele boe hahi sèra dua riho ngi'u. dhu tenge nganga'a ètu sebhe ledhe.

source_text: the evil spirits pleaded with him, send us to the pigs so we can enter them.
target_text: ka nidhu sèra manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, hia ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèra.

source_text: jesus allowed them to do this. the evil spirits left the man and went into the pigs. the whole herd, about two thousand, rushed down the steep cliff into the sea and drowned.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia yesus d'èi kahèi. ka nidhu sèra kalua nèti d'ara dhèu èèna, ka lasi asa d'ara hahi sèra. hèia hahi sèra rai paj'ala, ka lasi asa sebhe tèbhi, ka ra manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia madhe aa'i si.

source_text: the pig-keepers ran away, and spread the news all over town and in the countryside. people came out to see what had happened.
target_text: ropa dhèu j'aga hahi sèra ladhe rèdhi madha j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi peka palème dènge dhèu ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu dètu ètu era èèna. nèbhu boe dhèu canau-kateme mai neo re'a.

source_text: when they found jesus they saw the man who had been demon-possessed sitting there, dressed, and in his right mind-the one who had the legion of evil spirits-and they became frightened!
target_text: dhèu sèra mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra ladhe la'a, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu èèna pake le mèdha-papake. kahadhu na mase'a le. rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu sèra madha'u. lula rèngu re'a le, ladhe dhèu cee dhu bisa babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu huj'u èèna, nèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èra risi.

source_text: then those who had seen what had happened to the man who had been demon-possessed and the pigs told the others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra lasi peka palème ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, ji'i ngèdhi le dènge madha, dhèu huj'u ne èle le. sèmi èèna kahèi hahi dhu madhe ètu d'ara dano.

source_text: they began pleading with jesus to leave their district.
target_text: ka dhèu kabarai èèna mai manèngi ho yesus tèke eele ka rai rèngu.

source_text: as jesus climbed into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.
target_text: ropa yesus neo ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ka dhèu dhu èle nèti huj'u dhu nidhu tao èèna manèngi yesus, sèna ka nèngu madhutu ne kahèi.

source_text: but jesus refused, telling him, go home to your own people, and tell them how much the lord has done for you and how he has been merciful to you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai. ka na peka dènge dhèu èèna, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa èmu, ho peka dènge a'ari èu, ngaa dhu ama lamatua tao le mi dedha èu. peka dènge si, mema ama lamatua sue èu titu kèna.

source_text: so the man went on his way and began to tell the people of the ten cities everything jesus had done for him, and everyone was amazed.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu èèna pakèd'i la'e palème rae-rae nèti canguru kota, dhu ngara na ‘dekapolis'. na lole ngaa dhu yesus tao le mi dedha nèngu. dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo na, malaa aa'i mèu-mèu, aku rèngu na, mema lèke tare'a!

source_text: jesus went back again by boat to the other side of the lake where a large crowd gathered around him at the shore.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si pakèd'i hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano. ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus.

source_text: a synagogue leader, a man named jairus, came to him. when he saw jesus, he fell at his feet
target_text: dhèu èci mai, ngara na yairus. nèngu ne, kètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu kota èèna. ropa nèngu nèdhi yesus, ka mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and pleaded with him, saying, my little daughter is about to die. please come and place your hands on her so she may be healed and live.
target_text: ka na pamako, peka na, ama, ee! ana bhèni ja'a, heka canguru dua tèu, pèd'a oe madhe. mai lati ku asa èmu ja'a, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ne nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: so jesus went with him. everybody followed, crowding and jostling him.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, madhutu yairus asa èmu na. te ngaa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, dhèu ae titu kèna, ka ra seti ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: a woman was there who had been ill from bleeding for twelve years.
target_text: ètu talora dhèu ae sèra, abhu dhèu bhèni èci dhu pèd'a dhèu bhèni. papèd'a ne loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna.

source_text: she'd suffered considerably under the care of many doctors, and had spent all she had. but nothing helped her-in fact she'd grown worse.
target_text: mèdha-panyau dènge doi-dhari dhèu bhèni ne'e, èle aa'i mèu-mèu ho b'ae dote. te ngaa papèd'a na èle boe, asa na hoe.

source_text: she had heard about jesus, so she came up behind him through the crowd, and touched his cloak. she was telling herself, if i can just touch his cloak, i'll be healed. the bleeding stopped immediately, and she felt her body healed from her disease.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: jesus, sensing at once that power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, who touched my cloak?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: look at the crowd jostling you. what do you mean, ‘who touched me? ' the disciples replied.
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: but jesus went on looking around to see who had done it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: the woman, realizing what had happened to her, came and fell down before him, and told him the whole truth.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: my daughter, your trust in me has healed you. go in peace. you have been completely cured of your disease, jesus told her.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: while he was still speaking some people came from the home of the synagogue leader. your daughter is dead, they said. you don't need to bother the teacher any longer.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but jesus paid no attention to what they said. he told the synagogue leader, don't be afraid, just trust in me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: he wouldn't let anyone go with him except peter, james, and james' brother john.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: when they arrived at the synagogue leader's house, jesus saw all the commotion, with people crying and wailing.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: he went in and asked them, why are you making such a commotion with all this crying? the little girl isn't dead, she's just sleeping.
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: they laughed scornfully at him. jesus made everyone leave. then he went into the room where the little girl was lying, taking with him the child's father and mother, and the three disciples.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: taking the little girl's hand he said, talitha koum, which means, little girl, get up!
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: the little girl, who was twelve years old, got up immediately and began walking around. they were completely astonished at what had happened. he gave them strict instructions not to let anyone know, and he told them to give the little girl something to eat.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: jesus left and went home to nazareth with his disciples.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: on sabbath he began teaching in the synagogue, and many of those who were listening were surprised. where does he get these ideas? they asked. what's this wisdom he's been given? where does he get the power to do miracles?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: isn't this the carpenter, mary's son-the brother of james, joseph, judas and simon? don't his sisters live here among us? they were offended and rejected him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: a prophet is treated with respect except in his home town, among his relatives, and within his own family, jesus told them.
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: the result was that jesus could not do any miracles there, except to heal a few sick people.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: he was amazed at their lack of trust. jesus traveled around the villages, teaching as he went.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: he called together the twelve disciples, and began sending them out two by two, giving them authority over evil spirits.
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: he told them not to take anything with them except a walking stick-no bread, no bag, and no money in their belts. they could wear sandals, but they were not to take an extra shirt.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: when you're invited into a home, stay there until you leave, he told them.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: if you're not welcomed and not listened to, then shake the dust from your feet as you leave as a sign you have given up on them.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: so they went around telling people to repent.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: they drove out many demons, and healed many who were sick by anointing them with oil.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: king herod got to hear about jesus since he had become well-known. some said, this is john the baptist risen from the dead. that's why he has such miraculous powers.

source_text: then give back to caesar what belongs to him, and give back to god what belongs to him, jesus told them. they were amazed at his reply.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: then the sadducees, who deny the resurrection, came and asked a question:
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: teacher, moses instructed us that if a man dies, leaving his widow childless, then his brother should marry his wife, and have children by her on his behalf.
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: once there were seven brothers. the first one got married, and then died without having children.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: the second married his widow, and then died, childless. the third did the same.
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: in fact all seven died without having children. in the end the woman died too.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection, whose wife will she be, because she was the wife of all seven brothers?
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: jesus told them, this proves you're mistaken, and that you don't know the scriptures or the power of god.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: when the dead rise, they don't marry, and aren't given in marriage. they're like the angels in heaven.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but concerning the resurrection, haven't you read in moses' writings the story of the burning bush, where god spoke to moses and told him, ‘i am the god of abraham, and the god of isaac, and the god of jacob? '
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he's not the god of the dead, but of the living. you are completely mistaken!
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: one of the religious teachers came and heard them arguing. he recognized that jesus had given them a good answer. so he asked him, which is the most important commandment of all?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: jesus replied, the first commandment is, ‘hear, israel, the lord our god is one.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: love the lord your god with all your heart, with all your spirit, with all your mind, and with all your strength. '
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: the second is ‘love your neighbor as yourself. ' there's no more important commandment than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: that's right, teacher, the man replied. it's true as you said that god is one, and there is no other.
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: we are to love him with all our heart, all our understanding, and all our strength, and we are to love our neighbor as ourselves. this is far more important than offerings and sacrifices.
target_text: èdhi hud'i sue risi ne, toke d'ara d'èi ho pa'èci dènge ne, tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi sama sèmi èdhi sue ngi'u èdhi unu ti. lamatua d'èi risi eele tatao sèmi èèna, nèti èdhi madhutu dhodhoka atora agama di. tatao sèmi èèna be'a risi, nèti èdhi tèti badha ho lati tunu hia lamatua, do tèti mèdha leo hia ne.

source_text: jesus saw that he gave a thoughtful answer, and said, you're not far from the kingdom of god. after this no one was brave enough to ask him any more questions.
target_text: ropa yesus nanene nare dhèu ne dhaa sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, mese agama ne ne'a dènge be'a le. hèia yesus peka na, èu oe j'aj'i unu ama lamatua kèna. èle èèna ka, dhèu leo sèra bani heka pakarèi dènge yesus, lula dhèu èci sa segi boe ne.

source_text: while jesus was teaching in the temple, he asked, why do the religious teachers state that christ is the son of david?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a dhèu ae sèra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi si, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, tasamia? mese agama sèra aj'a, peka na, kristus èèna dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. madhutu ngangee rèngu, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud. te ngaa a'aj'a sèmi èèna d'ai lèke mèu mèka.

source_text: david himself declared, inspired by the holy spirit, that the lord said to my lord, ‘sit at my right hand until i put your enemies under your feet. '
target_text: lula, nèti uru ka mai, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake daud ho suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua peka le mi lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi mi era dhu hua iia, re bab'oa g'ana ja'a. pe èèna na ja'a tao musu èu pahaha iisi, toke ra bisa boe ded'e kètu mi èu. '

source_text: since david himself calls him lord, how can he be david's son? the large crowd listened to what jesus said with great delight.
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud paroa kristus èèna, peka na, ‘lamatua' na. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu sèra peka, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna d'ai mèka. lula nèngu èèna j'aj'i lamatua nèti daud kahèi. ropa yesus peka nare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra d'èi titu kèna nanene ne.

source_text: jesus continued to teach them, saying, beware of religious leaders! they love to walk around in long robes, to be greeted respectfully in the marketplaces.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari si, miu hud'i pajiko paie ku mese agama. rèngu d'èi pasia pake kodho madhera d'ai rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, sèna ka dhèu dhu rèdhi rèngu sèra, koa si, peka na, ‘ladhe ku laa! dhèu sèra, dhèu kapai! '

source_text: they love to have the most important seats in the synagogues, and the best places at banquets.
target_text: ladhe sèmi rèngu maso asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, do lasi ra'a-sisi, ra tenge era madhèdi dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: they cheat widows out of what they own, and cover up the kind of people they really are with long-winded prayers. they will receive severe condemnation in the judgment.
target_text: de hua iia mi pajiko paie! rèngu kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu bhèni balu sèra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra sèra dènge j'ara titu ho sabaj'a pamadhera aae, sèna ka dhèu peka na, rèngu se dhèu mola. te ngaa limuri mai, na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi asa rèngu.

source_text: jesus sat down opposite the treasury collection box, watching people tossing in coins. many of the rich were extravagantly throwing in a lot of money.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e madhèdi patangara dènge boaraka derma ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. na ladhe dhèu mai pamaso doi kolete asa d'ara boaraka èèna. ka na ladhe dhèu kaja sèra parèu doi ae.

source_text: then a poor widow came along and put in just two small coins.
target_text: te ngaa abhu bhèni balu èci dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa mai manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na pamaso dua doi asa d'ara boaraka èèna. dua doi dhu na pamaso èèna, kab'ua ciki ood'e di.

source_text: he called his disciples together and told them, i tell you the truth: this poor widow has put in more than all the rest together.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus gape ana madhutu na, ka na peka, mi ladhe ku bhèni balu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa nèi. na pamaso dhoka dua doi di, te ngaa nèngu hia risi eele nèti dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: all of them gave from their wealth what they had, but she gave from her poverty what she didn't have. she put in all she had to live on.
target_text: dhèu leo sèra hia kolete nèti doi sisa rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi nèngu asa lamatua.

source_text: as jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, teacher, look at these massive stones and magnificent buildings!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, hèia ana madhutu na èci paj'uj'u asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na peka, ama! ladhe ku èmu ne'e! ra tao rare, saraga bia. ra pagod'o rare hadhu sèra, mera titu kèna!

source_text: you see all these great buildings? jesus replied. not one stone will be left on top of another. everything will be torn down.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, èmu ne mema saraga titu kèna! te nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eele ne. ka hadhu-hadhu sèra, èci sa pamadhèdi heka ètu dedha èci.

source_text: as jesus sat on the mount of olives overlooking the temple, peter, james, john, and andrew asked him in private,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa ledhe saitun, ka na madhèdi ètu era dhu patangara dènge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia petrus, yakobis, yohanis dènge anderias mai padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: tell us: when this will happen? what's the sign that all this is about to be fulfilled?
target_text: ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama! lole hari ku, lii dhu ama ku peka dènge ji'i deo na. lod'o mia sèra sa j'aj'i? aa tadha-tadha na, samia?

source_text: jesus began telling them, make sure no one deceives you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu pajiko paie-iie, sèna ka baku lèke tipu.

source_text: many will come in my name claiming, ‘i am the christ. ' they will deceive many people.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, ho ra peka na, ‘ja'a ne kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ' aa ra leko-monya dhèu ae.

source_text: don't be troubled when you hear of wars nearby and wars far away. these things must happen but this is not the end.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi dhèu pamusu, do tadèngi lii lolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i dènge pakasiro ètu mia-mia, miu baku madha'u kahèi. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku. te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: nation will fight against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. there will be earthquakes in various places, and famines too. these are the beginnings of the world's birth pains.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku mai pamusu dènge suku leo, rai èci mai pamusu dènge rai leo. ètu mia-mia, j'aj'i rai opo dènge kabake-manganga. sèra sa j'aj'i tadha sama sèmi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: watch out for yourselves! they will hand you over to the courts to be tried. you will be beaten in synagogues. because of me you will have to stand before governors and kings, and you will be witnesses to them.
target_text: de hua iia, na, miu mage-mage! te èèna na dhèu mai kèpa miu, ho ra nuni asa dhèu paredha agama dhu pama'ète lii agama. aa ra game miu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ho èèna na rèti miu asa madha dhèu dhu dènge koasa, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa be'a kahèi, ne'e ne miu abhu tebho ho peka kolongara ja'a mi rèngu.

source_text: the good news must first be announced in every nation.
target_text: te dhèu unu ama lamatua hud'i lasi uuru ku lole lii lolo be'a ja'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, heka lod'o èle rai-haha ne d'ai kèna.

source_text: when they come to arrest you and put you on trial, don't worry about what to say. just say what you're told at that time, because it's not you speaking, but the holy spirit.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe ra èki rèti miu asa era pama'ète lii langu, miu baku madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a neo padhai lii ngaa? do, ja'a neo dhaa ngaa? ' ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, miu padhai lii madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka dènge miu.

source_text: brother will betray brother to death, and a father will betray his child. children will turn against their parents and have them condemned to death.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ana dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ama d'èlu na tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ina-ama dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ana d'èlu rèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe si.

source_text: you will be hated by everyone because of me, but whoever endures until the end will be saved.
target_text: de èèna na, dhèu d'èi boe miu, taga miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa dhèu cee dhu bisa taha toke d'ai èle lod'o èèna, tatu ama lamatua hia mamuri mi nèngu.

source_text: but when you see the ‘idolatry that causes devastation' standing where it shouldn't be let the reader understand, then those who are in judea should run to the mountains.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, èèna na, abhu dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. ho na mai maso ka titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu bisa boe ètu era èèna, ho na pahera era èèna. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu mèdhi le sèmi èèna, na, mi pajiko paie-iie! cee dhu baca lii ne'e, pajiko paie kahèi! èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, dètu ae le. ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, na, dhèu-dhèu ètu propensi yudea lega-rai asa kolo ledhe lasi.

source_text: those who are on the roof-don't go back inside the house to get anything.
target_text: rèngu hud'i rai pamèri-mèri, sèna ka baku abhu j'aj'èra. ladhe dhèu mai le asa li'u, lèpa ia ka rare mèdha asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: those who are out in the fields-don't go home to get a coat.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu ètu d'ara oka, baku lèpa èmu rare mèdha-papake.

source_text: how hard it will be for those who are pregnant or nursing at that time!
target_text: dhu j'èra risi, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, dènge ina dhu pasusu ana rara iisi hiu, lula rèngu rai rare boe.

source_text: pray that this won't happen during the winter.
target_text: de hua iia risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra baku lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: for these will be days of trouble like never before since the beginning of god's creation until now, and they won't ever come again.
target_text: te j'aj'èra lod'o èèna, bia titu kèna! mulai nèti ama lamatua tao rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu bia sèmi èèna. j'aj'èra bia sèmi èèna, lod'o limuri, j'aj'i heka hari.

source_text: if god doesn't cut short these days, no one will survive. however, for the sake of those god has chosen, he has cut them short.
target_text: ladhe ama lamatua pab'ab'e boe lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mamuri. te ngaa, taga ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, ka na pab'ab'e lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: so if anyone tells you, ‘look, here is the messiah, ' or ‘look, there he is, ' don't believe it.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai na, miu tadèngi dhèu mai peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ladhe ku! kristus ètu ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo hari peka, aku rèngu na, ‘aad'o! kristus ètu nèi! ' miu baku nanene kahèi!

source_text: for false messiahs and false prophets will appear, and they will perform miraculous signs and wonders to deceive the chosen of god, if that were possible.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu mai ho tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa cahag'e hari peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na ra tao tadha malaa ae-ae dènge koasa nidhu, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. rèngu patangi-tenge j'ara sèna ka dhèu unu ama lamatua lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: watch out! i've told you everything before it happens.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie-iie! mema lod'o j'aj'èra bia èèna d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e uuru miu!

source_text: this is what will happen after those troubles: ‘the sun will become dark, the moon won't shine,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka hari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe èle lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, na, ‘madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga, aa hèru heo heka.

source_text: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers in the heavens will be shaken. '
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu bèbha nèti dedha-liru mai, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru j'aj'i kaco-balo. '

source_text: then they will see the son of man as he comes on the clouds, possessing great power and glory.
target_text: èle èèna, heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èèna na ja'a mai dènge ra'i-liru nèti dedha. hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi a'èra dènge dadedha ja'a.

source_text: he will send out the angels, and gather together all his chosen ones from wherever they are, from the most distant part of the earth to the farthest point of heaven.
target_text: ka ja'a paredha ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ho puru lasi oru-kaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a hag'e kore nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne; nèti suu haa d'ai suu dhimu, nèti suu badae toke d'ai suu balèu.

source_text: learn a lesson from the fig tree. when its branches grow soft and send out leaves, you know that summer is near.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, ja'a kore upama nèti ana aaj'u. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, èèna tadha hèru hadhu dètu le!

source_text: in the same way, when you see these things happening, you know that it's near-right outside the door!

source_text: keep watch! stay awake! for you don't know when this will happen.

source_text: it's like a man who went away on a journey. he left his house, and gave each of his servants the authority to do what he told them. he told the doorkeeper to stay awake.

source_text: so keep watch, because you don't know when the owner of the house is coming back. it may be in the evening, in the middle of the night, before dawn, or in the morning.
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga mèda-mèu kahèi, lula miu me'a boe lod'o mia ja'a mai hari, sama sèmi ana madhenga èmu ne'a boe lod'o lamatua èmu na lèpa. lèpa lod'o nihia, talora mèda, oe mèu, lod'o rea, do lod'o nètu; miu me'a boe jam èèna.

source_text: you don't want to be caught sleeping if he returns unexpectedly.

source_text: what i'm telling you, i'm telling everyone: watch!
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: it was now two days before passover and the feast of unleavened bread. the chief priests and the religious leaders were trying to find a surreptitious way to arrest jesus and have him killed. but not during passover, they said to themselves, otherwise the people may riot.

source_text: meanwhile jesus was in bethany, eating a meal at simon the leper's home. a woman came in with an alabaster jar of very expensive pure nard perfume. she broke the jar open and poured the perfume on jesus' head.
target_text: ètu rae betania, abhu ca dhèu ngara na simon. uru èèna, dhèu madenge dènge ne, lula nèngu pèd'a kusta. te ngaa limuri ne, èle le nèti papèd'a na. hèia lod'o kalela dhae d'ai mèka, na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra lasi ra'a-rinu ètu èmu simon. ètu talora ra'a-rinu era, dhèu bhèni èci mai paraga yesus. nèd'u dènge boto èci dhu ra tao nèti hadhu. isi boto ne, èi hèu mèngi asli dhu kab'ua titu kèna, dhu ra tao nèti amo aaj'u hèu mèngi. hèia bhèni ne pamae hèb'a boto èèna, ka na pasuti èi hèu mèngi mi kètu yesus, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, nèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: some of those who were there became annoyed and said, why waste this perfume?
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu leo dhu ra'a-rinu pa'èci kahèi. ropa dhèu se rèdhi dhèu bhèni ne tao sèmi èèna, hèia ra nasa. ka ra padhai lii padedha iisi, peka na, ngaa ka unu bhèni nèi? na bhori eele èi hèu mèngi kab'ua aae èèna!

source_text: it could've been sold for a year's wages and the money given to the poor. they were angry with her.
target_text: be'a risi nèngu pahie èi hèu mèngi èèna, ho la'e papala doi ae sèra, mi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu. te kab'ua èi hèu mèngi ne, èci èèna ka dènge gaji tuka d'ara ca tèu. hèia ra jèke bhèni ne.

source_text: but jesus replied, leave her alone! why are you criticizing her for doing something beautiful to me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku pasusa bhèni ne! hud'i laa! ja'a karej'e lula nèngu pasuti le ngi'u ja'a dènge èi hèu mèngi ne'e!

source_text: you'll always have the poor with you, and you can help them whenever you want. but you won't always have me with you.
target_text: dhèu kasia sèra, bèli-bèli ètu talora miu. de lod'o mia èèna ka dhu miu lake mere, na, miu bisa soru-bara si. te ngaa nèbhu heka, ja'a pa'èci heka dènge miu.

source_text: she did what she could: she anointed my body in anticipation of my burial.
target_text: mamuri ja'a nèbhu heka ètu rai-haha ne. dènge tatao bhèni ne, nèngu lalau ngi'u ja'a, sama sèmi nèngu pahèu mèngi mema ngi'u aae ja'a, ho padhane.

source_text: i tell you the truth: wherever the good news is spread in the world, people will remember what she did.
target_text: miu patadhe, ee! èèna na, ladhe dhèu lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua ètu mia-mia, na, ra palolo kahèi tatao be'a bhèni ne'e. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanèd'e nèngu.

source_text: then judas iscariot, one of the twelve disciples, went to the chief priests and arranged to betray jesus to them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, abhu ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru dua sèra, ngara na yudas iskariot. nèngu kalua la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi sèra ho neo pahie yesus mi rèngu. ropa na paraga dènge rèngu, ka na peka naneo na.

source_text: when they heard this, they were delighted, and promised to pay him. so judas began to look for an opportunity to betray jesus.
target_text: lod'o kètu agama sèra tadèngi naneo yudas, ka ra karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra jaji, peka na, ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, tatu ji'i b'ae. hèia yudas kalua, ka na mulai tenge j'ara ho pahie yesus.

source_text: on the first day of the feast of unleavened bread, the time when the passover lamb is sacrificed, jesus' disciples asked him, where do you want us to go and prepare the passover meal for you?
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o partama nèti lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi. de d'ara lod'o èèna, rèngu tema tunu roti dhu dènge boe ragi, aa roro kahib'i-kalèbho kahèi. hèia ana madhutu yesus sèra mai karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! doe ne'e ne, lod'o kalela paska èdhi kèna. de ama neo ji'i lalau era kalela paska ètu mia?

source_text: he sent two of his disciples, telling them, go into the city and there you'll meet a man carrying a water pot. follow him,
target_text: hèia yesus pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua, aku nèngu na, miu lami uuru ku asa d'ara kota. ètu nèi, miu paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, dhu pasae èi d'ara g'ala iiki cue. lami madhutu ne nèti limuri.

source_text: and when he goes into a house, ask the owner where i and my disciples can celebrate the passover.
target_text: ladhe na maso asa èmu mia èèna ka, na, miu madhutu ne asa d'ara. hèia miu peka mi lamatua èmu èèna, sèmi ne'e, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi kama èci, ho na neo tao kalela paska dènge ana madhutu nèngu. '

source_text: he will take you to a large upstairs room that is furnished and ready. you can make preparations for us there.
target_text: pe dhèu èèna paj'uj'u kama aae èci ètu èmu dedha na, dhu na sadia nare le. de miu dua mi dhoka lami lalau nganga'a di.

source_text: the disciples went into the city, and found things just as he'd described them. they prepared the passover meal.
target_text: hèia dua ra lasi ka asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, rèngu rèdhi tare'a, sama sèmi ngaa dhu yesus moa deo na. ka ra sadia aa'i-aa'i, ho yesus si ra'a kalela paska ètu era èèna. èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi paroa yesus si.

source_text: in the evening jesus went there with the twelve disciples.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu dhèu canguru dua sèra d'ai era èèna.

source_text: while they were sitting eating, jesus said, i tell you the truth: one of you is going to betray me; one who is eating with me now.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi ra'a sama-sama. ètu talora ra'a era, yesus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu nanene ku! èèna na dhèu èci nèti miu se pahie eele ja'a mi dhèu leo.

source_text: they were shocked, and they each asked, it's not me, is it?
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, ana madhutu yesus sèra cag'ag'a dènge manyasa. ka rèngu èci-èci mulai karèi yesus, peka na, dhèu dhu ama peka èèna, ja'a aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: it's one of the twelve, one of you sharing this food with me, he replied.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu cèb'u roti palere-lere dènge ja'a asa d'ara mago ne, nèngu ka dhu pahia ja'a.

source_text: the son of man will die, just as the scriptures predicted. but how terrible it will be for the man who betrays the son of man! it would be better for that man if he'd never been born.
target_text: mi sanèd'e! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke le, ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. te ngaa kasia, dhèu dhu neo pahia ja'a èèna, bèli-camèd'a nèngu dui nare pala na! hua iia risi, ina na baku nara iisi ne!

source_text: as they were eating, jesus picked up some bread. he blessed it, and gave it to them. take it. this is my body, he told them.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora ra'a era, yesus nare roti cue, hèia na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na j'ole asa ana madhutu na sèra. ka na peka na, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u ja'a kèna. mere ho mi'a.

source_text: then he picked up the cup. he blessed it, and gave it to them. they all drank from it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na nare galaa dhu isi dènge èi hua anggor. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua kahèi. ka na j'ole galaa èèna asa ana madhutu na, sèna ka rinu.

source_text: this is my blood, he told them, the agreement that's being poured out for many.

source_text: i tell you the truth, i won't drink of the fruit of the vine until the day i drink it fresh in god's kingdom.

source_text: after they had sung a psalm, they left for the mount of olives.

source_text: all of you will abandon me, jesus told them. for as the scriptures say, ‘i will attack the shepherd, and the sheep will be completely scattered. '
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako rèngu èèna, yesus padhai lii, peka na, d'ara mèda ne'e ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. sama sèmi dhu ra suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘èèna na ama lamatua pamadhe ana madhenga badha, ka kahib'i-kalèbho na rai paj'ala asa haa, asa dhimu. '

source_text: but after i have risen from the dead, i will go before you to galilee.
target_text: èèna na ja'a madhe tare'a. te ngaa lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, ja'a laku uru nèti miu asa propensi galilea!

source_text: i won't abandon you even if everyone else does, peter replied.

target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, petrus! mu patadhe! mèda ne'e kahèi, manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te ngaa èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a!

source_text: he took peter, james, and john with him. he began to be very disturbed and troubled.
target_text: ka yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, dènge yohanis lasi dènge ne. mulai nèti èèna ka, na rasa d'ara nèngu ma'ète laho mae-mae.
