source_text: he went a little farther on and then fell to the ground. he prayed, asking to be spared the time that was coming, if it were possible. abba, father! you can do everything, he said. please, take this cup of suffering away from me. yet it's not what i want, but what you want.
target_text: hèia la'e ako kaj'èu ciki nèti era èèna, ka na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu rai, ka na sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ladhe sèmi ama d'èi, na, ja'a baku pasae j'aj'èra ne'e d'ai madhe. ja'a ke'a le, ètu madha ama, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu ama bisa boe tao. de ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne'e nèti kabela-kao ja'a. masi ka sèmi èèna, baku madhutu dad'èi ja'a; te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: then jesus returned and found the disciples asleep. simon, are you sleeping? he asked peter. couldn't you stay awake for just an hour?
target_text: èle èèna ka, na lèpa asa ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, te ngaa ra bhèj'i luu. hèia na parèi si, ka na padhai lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus! èu bhèj'i, do? ja'a nèbhu boe ètu nèi, te ngaa miu bisa boe beke mate ja'a ciki sa!

source_text: stay awake, and pray so you won't fall into temptation. the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.
target_text: kèd'i ho pamako musi madha èu. kèd'i ka, ho beke dènge ja'a! d'ara miu neo tao be'a kahèi, te ngaa ngi'u miu roe. de be'a risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka ladhe miu lèke dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: he left them once more, and prayed, saying the same things.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e manèngi-mangaj'i ca tèka hari. nèngu manèngi hari mi ama lamatua, aku nèngu na, ama! ladhe bisa, na, ama pakaj'èu eele babia ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa hud'i madhutu dad'èi ama ku ka laa.

source_text: then he returned, and again he found them sleeping because they couldn't keep their eyes open. they didn't know what to say!
target_text: ka na lèpa hari asa era ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra. te ngaa rèngu bhèj'i hari le, lula musi madha ra sakaa titu kèna. hèia na parèi hari si, te ngaa rèngu re'a boe dhaa sèmi ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: he returned a third time, and asked them, are you still asleep? are you still resting? well that's enough, because the time has come! look, the son of man is about to be betrayed into the hands of sinners.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele si, ka la'e manèngi-mangaj'i d'ai tèlu hari kèna. èle èèna ka, na lèpa la'e parèi ana madhutu na sèra. na peka, miu bhèj'i taruu era? sange èèna ka laa! kèd'i ka! te dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, nuka mai dènge angalai nèngu sèra. rèngu mai kèpe ja'a, ho saraka mi dhèu bhelu-katub'a si.

source_text: get up! let's go! see, here comes my betrayer.
target_text: kèd'i ka! pamako musi madha miu, ho ladhe ku asa nèi! dhèu dhu neo pahie ja'a ne, nuka mai nèi. mai ho lati paraga dènge si!

source_text: just as he was saying this, judas-one of the twelve disciples-arrived with a mob carrying swords and clubs, sent by the chief priests, religious leaders, and elders.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia yudas d'ai madha yesus dènge dhèu ae titu kèna. rèngu mai rèti dènge hela dènge cèki, ho kèpe yesus. dhèu se tao sèmi èèna, lula ra madhutu lii paredha nèti kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: now the betrayer had arranged a sign with them: he's the one that i kiss. arrest him, and take him away under guard.
target_text: yudas hia mema tadha mi dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe d'ai nèi, ja'a uu cee, na, nèngu kèna. de mi kèpe ne.

source_text: judas went right up to jesus. rabbi, he said, and kissed him affectionately.
target_text: ropa yudas si d'ai era èèna, na la'e asa madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama mese! hèia na liku nare yesus, ka na uu ne.

source_text: so they grabbed hold of jesus and arrested him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae sèra ara asa madha yesus, ka ra kèpe ne.

source_text: but one of those standing there pulled out his sword and struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his ear.
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu dhèu èci. dhèu dhu nu'a ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: am i some kind of rebel that you have come to arrest me with swords and clubs? jesus asked them.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae dhu mai kèpe nèngu sèra, aku nèngu na, tasamia? miu ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, do? ka miu mai kèpe ja'a mèti hela dènge cèki?

source_text: i was there with you, teaching in the temple every day. why didn't you arrest me then? but this is happening to fulfill the scriptures.
target_text: bèli-bèli ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa miu èci sa kèpe boe ja'a. mai ka, kèpe ja'a! te j'ara ne j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: then all jesus' disciples deserted him and ran away.
target_text: ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u titu kèna. hèia ra rai tèke eele yesus mesa na ètu èèna.

source_text: one of his followers was a young man who was wearing only a linen garment. they seized hold of him, but he ran off naked, leaving the garment behind.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu ana mone ngèru èci kahèi dhu madhutu yesus re limuri. ana ne pahutu isi na dènge sig'i ca bèla. dhèu sèra neo kèpe ne kahèi, ka na rai tèke eele sig'i na ètu kacui-aai dhèu sèra, lula na madha'u. hèia na rai dènge boe mèdha-papake ètu ua na.

source_text: they took jesus to the high priest's house where all the chief priests, elders, and religious teachers had gathered.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra rèti yesus asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. ètu èèna, dhèu kapai sèra pakaboko le. rèngu sèra, nuka: kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a sèra.

source_text: peter followed him at a distance, and went into the courtyard of the high priest's house. he sat down with the guards and warmed himself by the fire.
target_text: ropa ra kèpe rèti yesus, petrus madhutu mau-mau nèti limuri. hèia na maso kahèi d'ai madha èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, ka na madhèdi manyiru ai sama-sama dènge dhèu j'aga ètu sèra.

source_text: inside the chief priests and the whole governing council were trying to find some evidence to have jesus put to death, but they couldn't find anything.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra padhue dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi j'ue lii langu agama. ra patangi-tenge bukti ho pamanahu yesus, lula ra neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa rèngu abhu boe bukti èci sa.

source_text: many were giving false testimony against him, but their statements didn't agree.
target_text: ka ra paroa dhèu ae asa madha ho j'aj'i sakasii, sèna ka neo pabèbhe yesus. te ngaa lii sakasii rèngu sèra, èci dènge èci pamèci boe.

source_text: some of them got up to speak falsely against jesus.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu sakasii leo dhu kèd'i titu, ka ra pakapod'e lii, peka na,

source_text: we heard him say, ‘i will destroy this temple that human hands built, and in three days i will build another without hands. '
target_text: ji'i tadèngi dhèu ne'e peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu dhèu rai-haha tao dènge kacui-aai ra. te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o ka, ja'a patitu kore hari le èmu èèna, dènge boe pake kacui-aai dhèu. '

source_text: but even so their testimony didn't agree.
target_text: te ngaa lii lolo rèngu sèra èci dènge èci baka-leo hua.

source_text: then the high priest stood up in front of the council, and asked jesus, have you nothing to say in response to these charges made against you?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi èèna, kèd'i titu ètu talora dhèu ae dhu madhèdi ètu sèra. ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae mai le galaa èu. nga tao ka èu mau-mau, mo'o boe dhaa lii galaa sèra?

source_text: but jesus remained silent and didn't answer. so the high priest asked again, are you the messiah, the son of the blessed one?
target_text: te ngaa yesus mau-mau, lii boe ca hèb'a sa. èle èèna ka, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne, karèi hari ne ca tèka, èu peka ku laa! tare'a-re'a èu ne kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu na moa nèti uuru èèna, do?

source_text: i am, jesus replied, and you will see the son of man sitting on the right of the mighty one, and coming with the clouds of heaven.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a sèmi èèna! nèngu èèna ka, ja'a ne! bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, madhèdi re bab'oa g'ana ama lamatua ètu sorga. koasa nèngu kapai risi eele! ladhe èèna na, ja'a dènge nèngu, ngèd'u paredha sama-sama. èle èèna na, ja'a puru mai nèti sorga dènge ra'i-liru.

source_text: the high priest tore his clothes and asked, why do we need any more witnesses?
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii padhai yesus, kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ne nasa titu kèna, hèia na ciu pamae kodho madhera ètu ua na. ka na pajèka peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, èdhi parluu heka sakasii!

source_text: you have heard the blasphemy! what's your reaction? they all found him guilty and condemned him to death.
target_text: miu tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu miu, si? nèngu unu na ka dhu peka sèmi èèna! nèngu padedha iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. lii ne'e ne, lii dhu pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua, dhèu èèna hud'i lèke huku madhe ku! de mi pama'ète tasamia? hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i pama'ète, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a sala! de nèngu ne hud'i lèke huku pamadhe!

source_text: then some of them began to spit on him. they blindfolded him, hit him with their fists, and said, why don't you prophesy then, you ‘prophet'! the guards took him away and beat him up.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu kèd'i lasi sabhuu ilu mi rèhu yesus. ra hutu musi madha na, ka ra game ne. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu j'aj'i dhèu mèti lii padhai ama lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu? èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu dhu madhenge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho mai pakako rèti yesus. ropa ra kako, ra tèb'e pa'oke ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: meanwhile peter was down below in the courtyard. one of the high priest's servant-girls passed by, and seeing peter warming himself, looked straight at him and said, you were with jesus of nazareth too!
target_text: mèda èèna, petrus madhèdi era ètu madha èmu èèna. hèia ènu dhèu bhèni èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, mai ka nèdhi petrus madhèdi manyiru ai. na ladhe kaloo ka rèhu petrus, ka karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na èu sama-sama dènge yesus, dhèu nasaret èèna, si?

source_text: but he denied it. i don't know what you're talking about or what you mean, he replied. then he went out to the forecourt, and a rooster crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, peka na, aad'o! nga tao ka èu karèi sèmi èèna! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu èèna. hèia petrus kalua, ka la'e titu ètu hèb'a tedhe. kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo.

source_text: seeing him there, the servant girl repeated to those standing around, this man is one of them!
target_text: hèia dhèu bhèni èèna ladhe nèdhi hari petrus. ka na peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne ca dhèu nèti rèngu kahèi!

source_text: once more peter denied it. a little while later they said to peter again, you're definitely one of them because you're a galilean too!
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, ka na peka, tao-tao èu huj'u! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne'e! nèbhu boe ka, dhèu èci ètu èèna kahèi, peka hari mi petrus, aku nèngu na, èu ne baku pasili, peka na, èu dènge boe dhèu se'e se! we! miu se aa'i-aa'i mi, dhèu galilea, si?

source_text: peter began calling down curses on himself and he swore, i don't know this man you're talking about.
target_text: ka petrus pab'ala hari, aku nèngu na, ja'a bani subha! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu nèi!

source_text: immediately the rooster crowed the second time. then peter remembered what jesus had said to him: before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times. when he realized what he'd done, he burst into tears.
target_text: petrus dhu padhai lii nare mèka, kabèdhi laa, manu kokotoo ka dua hari kèna. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii dhu yesus peka dènge nèngu, ladhe manu kokotoo d'ai mèka dua hari, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari peka na èu tadhe boe ja'a! ropa ngee nèdhi, hèia petrus tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: early the next morning, the chief priest, elders, and religious teachers-the whole governing council-came to a decision. they had jesus bound and sent him to be handed over to pilate.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu-dhèu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi sèra pare'a lii ho pamadhe yesus. ka ra èki rèti ne, lasi asa madha gubernur pilatus.

source_text: pilate asked him, are you the king of the jews? you said it, jesus replied.
target_text: ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ka na karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, tasamia? èu ne tare'a dhèu aae yahudi, do? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, tare'a. ama gubernur peka lèke kèna.

source_text: the chief priests kept on making many accusations against him.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e tao sala ae titu kèna! hèia ra lolo ka sasala na èci-èci.

source_text: pilate questioned him again, aren't you going to answer? see how many charges they're bringing against you!
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari yesus, èu tadèngi boe lii padhai dhèu se'e, do? dhèu se'e, pasala le èu ae-ae. èu b'ala ku laa!

source_text: but jesus didn't give any more answers, much to pilate's surprise.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala boe ca hèb'a sa, ka gubernur malaa.

source_text: now it was pilate's custom at the passover feast to release a prisoner to the people, whoever they requested.
target_text: tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, dhèu ae sèra paj'uj'u ana bèdho èci, ho gubernur patalale ne.

source_text: one of the prisoners was a man called barabbas who belonged to a group of rebels who had committed murder during an uprising.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana bèdho èci, ngara na barabas. uru èèna, ra kèpe ne, taga na palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: the crowd went to pilate and asked him to release a prisoner following his usual custom.
target_text: lula lod'o tatao paska èèna oe dètu le, dhèu ae lasi manèngi gubernur pilatus, ka ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, ama gubernur! lod'o tatao paska dètu le! lod'o sèmi ne'e, ama gubernur patabuli ku ana bèdho èci, sama sèmi tèu-tèu uru sèra.

source_text: do you want me to release to you the king of jews? he asked them,
target_text: hèia gubernur b'ala lii rèngu, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a patabuli cee? tasamia, ladhe ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do? miu mo'o, do aad'o?

source_text: for he realized that it was because of their jealousy of jesus that the chief priests had handed jesus over to him.
target_text: gubernur peka sèmi èèna, lula nèngu ne'a le, kètu agama yahudi ka rèti yesus mai asa nèngu, taga ra kacèki dènge yesus.

source_text: but the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release barabbas to them instead.
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi se dadugu dhèu ae sèra, ho manèngi gubernur, peka na, ji'i ngo'o boe nèngu! ji'i d'èi dhoka patabuli barabas di!

source_text: then what should i do with the one you call the king of the jews? he asked them.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, ladhe sèmi èèna, yesus, dhu ra pangare na ‘dhèu aae yahudi' èèna, ja'a tao ne, tasamia?

source_text: crucify him! they shouted back.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: why? what crime has he committed? pilate asked them. crucify him! they shouted back even louder.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, sasala na ngaa? ja'a parisa kore le. te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu nèngu tao! te ngaa dhèu se asa ka hino pa'oo-parodha, aku rèngu na, pamadhe ne! paku ne mi aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: wanting to please the mob, pilate released barabbas to them. first he had jesus flogged and then handed him over to be crucified.
target_text: lula gubernur neo pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae sèra, ka na patabuli barabas madhutu dad'èi rèngu. ka na paredha dhèu j'aga sèra lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui. game rare ne, hèia sordad'u sèra rèti ka yesus lasi neo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: the soldiers took him away into the praetorium courtyard, where they called out the whole battalion.
target_text: èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère rèti yesus asa era dhu taleo èci ètu madha èmu gubernur. ka ra paroa anga sordad'u dhu leo sèra ca batalion, ho pakaboko.

source_text: they put royal purple robes on him and made a crown of thorns that they placed on him.
target_text: ra papake yesus kodho madhera aae èci, dhu mea oe sèmi mangèru sa, sama sèmi mèdha-papake dhèu aae-dhèu aae. ka rare loro aj'u dhu padhudhu, ho ènyu solo. hèia ra ènyi solo padhudhu èèna mi kètu yesus. ka ra tao ne, sèmi dhèu aae dhu ded'e hiu, dhu pake solo dhèu aae.

source_text: then they saluted him, saying, hail king of the jews!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sangaja pakab'ua yesus. ra peka, aku rèngu na, ama dhèu aae yahudi dhu hua iia!

source_text: they repeatedly beat him around the head with a rod, spat at him, and fell on their knees before him as if in worship.
target_text: aa ra sangaja pacud'u kètu ho pakab'ua yesus. ka ra sabhuu ilu pèri-pèri hari mi rèhu yesus. sèmi èèna kahèi, ra d'eu kètu yesus dènge gui pahari-pahari.

source_text: after they finished mocking him, they took off the purple robes, and put his own clothes back on him. then they led him away to be crucified.
target_text: ropa ra tao rare sèmi èèna, ka ra bhoke eele kodho madhera nèti ua na. ka ra papake hari mèdha-papake na. èle ka, rèti yesus asa li'u yerusalem, ho neo paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha d'ai madhe.

source_text: they forced a passer-by, simon of cyrene, who was coming from the countryside, to carry his cross. simon was the father of alexander and rufus.
target_text: ropa rèngu kalua nèti yerusalem, d'ai talora j'ara paraga dènge dhèu kota kirene èci. ngara na simon, ama nèti aleksander dènge rufus. ropa na neo maso asa yerusalem, sordad'u sèra pakaseti ne pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus.

source_text: they brought jesus to the place called golgotha, which means the place of the skull.
target_text: ère rèti yesus asa era èci, ngara na golgota. sasoa na, ‘era rui kètu'.

source_text: they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he refused it.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra neo hia yesus ninu èi hua anggor manyilu dhu pab'ali dènge èi na'i, sèna ka na taha rarii nèti nu'a-nu'a ètu ngi'u na sèra. te ngaa yesus no'o boe ninu.

source_text: then they crucified him. they divided his clothes, and threw dice to decide who would have what. it was nine in the morning when they crucified him.
target_text: hèia ra paku kacui-aai dènge haga yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. paku rare ka, ra patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ele boe d'ara hake ceo mad'ae sa. èle èèna ka, sordad'u sèra ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake yesus.

source_text: a sign with the written charge against him read: the king of the jews.
target_text: ka ra suri ètu papa èci dhu ra paku re dedha kètu yesus, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae yahudi rèngu pake alasan èèna ka, ho huku pamadhe yesus.

source_text: they crucified two rebels with him, one on his left and one on his right.
target_text: ètu èèna, ra paku parapo dhèu dua kahèi pa'èci dènge yesus. èci re cabèka g'ana, aa èci hari re cabèka kariu yesus.

source_text: people passing by shouted insults at him, shaking their heads, and saying. aha! you who claimed you were going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days;
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re èèna, ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu ra paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ka ra pakareko kètu, aa ra padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, heh! èu ne peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho d'ara tèlu lod'o, èu pakèd'i hari, si?

source_text: save yourself and come down from the cross!
target_text: èu puru sèku nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, ho patabuli ngi'u èu! ladhe sèmi èèna, heka ji'i parcaya, na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: likewise the chief priests and the religious teachers made fun of him, saying to each other, he saved others, but he can't save himself.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, kètu agama yahudi sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne, patabuli le dhèu leo nèti rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, te ngaa nèngu bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu unu na nèti j'aj'èra ne'e.

source_text: if he really is the messiah, the king of israel, then why doesn't he come down from the cross so we can see and believe! even those who were crucified with him insulted him.
target_text: nèngu peka unu na, nèngu ne ‘kristus', dhu uru èèna ama lamatua moa tèke le. dhèu leo peka na, nèngu ne dhèu aae isra'el. ladhe tare'a sèmi èèna, hud'i laa na puru nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne, sèna ka ji'i ngèdhi ne. heka ji'i parcaya ne kèna. dhèu dua dhu ra paku sama-sama dènge yesus sèra, padhai lii pamakae yesus kahèi.

source_text: at noon darkness fell over the whole land until three in the afternoon.
target_text: d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, era èèna maroga, toke d'ai hake tèlu loo nihia.

source_text: at three o'clock jesus cried out, eloi, eloi, lama sabachthani, which means, my god, my god, why have you abandoned me?
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu nihia, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, peka na, eloi! eloi! lema sabaktani? dhu sasoa, peka na, lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka, ama ku tèke eele ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: some of those standing there heard this, and said, he's calling for elijah.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu ètu èèna, tadèngi lii pa'oo yesus. ka ra peka, miu nanene ku laa! te na paroa elia, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru èèna.

source_text: one man ran and filled a sponge with vinegar, put it on a stick, and tried to give it to jesus to drink. leave him alone, he said. let's see if elijah will come to take him down.
target_text: ka dhèu èci rai la'e nare ula dhasi, ka na cèb'u asa d'ara èi hua anggor manyilu. hèia nare ula èèna, èki ètu suu tatea èci, ka na soro asa panyoro yesus ho na camuci. dhèu èèna peka, èdhi tatae sèku. cee ne'a, tao-tao elia mai, ho papuru ne nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: then jesus groaned loudly, and died.
target_text: hèia yesus pa'oo hari ca tèka, heka na madhe kèna.

source_text: the temple veil was ripped in two from top to bottom.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae, ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci. ropa yesus ma'ète a'ae, bèla ne mae cèri bagi mi dua, nèti dedha toke d'ai haha.

source_text: when the centurion standing there in front of jesus saw how he died, he said, this man was truly the son of god.
target_text: ètu golgota abhu komedhaa sordad'u j'aga dhu titu dètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi mamadhe yesus, na cag'ag'a. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ira ii! mema tare'a! dhèu ne'e ne, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: some women were watching from a distance including mary magdalene, mary the mother of james the younger and joses, and salome. they had followed jesus and had taken care of him while he was in galilee. many other women who had come with him to jerusalem were also there.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu lasi asa era èèna kahèi. ra titu nèti kaj'èu, ladhe rèdhi mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. rèngu se ka dhu uru èèna lalau-lalo'o yesus ètu galilea. rèngu sèra, nuka: salome, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yoses, dènge dhèu bhèni leo hari dhu mai asa yerusalem, sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: it was friday, the day before the sabbath. when evening came, joseph of arimathea, a member of the governing council who was himself waiting for the kingdom of god, had the courage to go to pilate and ask for jesus' body.
target_text: ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia dhèu èci tenge j'ara ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhèu èèna, ngara na yusuf, nèti kota arimatea. nèngu ne'e kahèi, ca dhèu dhu j'ue lii langu agama yahudi. nèngu dhèu d'ara be'a kahèi. aa nèngu mate nèbhu le paredha ama lamatua mai. lod'o yesus madhe èèna, lèke hari jumat. bèli na, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, yusuf neo papuru eele ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara lod'o hari jumat èèna. ka na pabani iisi na, la'e paraga dènge gubernur pilatus, manèngi ho papuru ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: pilate was surprised that jesus had died so soon, so he summoned the centurion and asked him if jesus had already died.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii manèngi yusuf ne, na malaa. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, eea! nga tao ka, dhèu ne madhe malai sa mia ne! ja'a ngee, na, dhae madhe mèka! hèia na pua dhèu lasi paroa komedhaa, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, sa mia? yesus madhe le, do dhae?

source_text: once he had confirmation from the centurion, pilate gave permission for joseph to take the body.
target_text: komedhaa èèna b'ala, peka na, tare'a, ama! na madhe le karèi deo na. ropa gubernur tadèngi nare lii dhaa èèna, hèia na hia yusuf la'e nare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: joseph bought a linen sheet. then he took jesus' body down from the cross and wrapped it in the sheet, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of rock. then he rolled a heavy stone up against the entrance.
target_text: hèia yusuf la'e hèli bèla madhera dhu kab'ua èci, ka na la'e asa golgota. d'ai nèi, ka na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. na pahutu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla hiu. tèu èèna, ra heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu d'ara hadhu aae. hèia ra nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus asa d'ara ro'a èèna. ka ra loli rare hadhu kabela dhu kapai èci, ho ra bèdho paie hèb'a ro'a èèna. èle èèna ka, yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: mary magdalene and mary the mother of joses were watching where he was laid.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti rae magdala, dènge maria èci hari, ina yoses, madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. dua ra rèdhi era dhu ra padhane yesus, ka ra patadhe paie era èèna.

source_text: once the sabbath had ended, mary magdalene, mary the mother of james, and salome bought aromatic ointments so that they could go and anoint jesus' body.
target_text: bèli èèna, lèke hari sabtu, nuka lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. ropa lod'o cèna la'e, maria nèti rae magdala, maria dhu leo hari ina yakobis, dènge salome, lasi hèli èi hèu mèngi, sèna ka bèli rèngu bisa lasi pasuti mi ngi'u aae yesus madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: very early on the first day of the week, just at sunrise, they went to the tomb.
target_text: ropa hari migu mad'ae aae èèna, tèlu ra lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: they were asking each other, who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance to the tomb? but when they arrived and looked, they saw that the very large, heavy stone had already been rolled away.
target_text: ètu talora j'ara, tèlu ra padhue, aku rèngu na, waa! d'ai nèi, na, cee ka dhu bisa loli eele hadhu aae èèna nèti hèb'a ro'a? èdhi tèlu ti bisa boe, lula hadhu èèna kapai bia! te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai ro'a èèna, rèdhi hadhu èèna dhu hari eele le nèti hèb'a ro'a.

source_text: when they went into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right, wearing a long white robe. they became very frightened.
target_text: hèia bhèni se maso asa d'ara. rèngu cag'ag'a titu kèna, lula ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, rèdhi ana mone ngèru èci madhèdi ètu sebhe g'ana rèngu, dhu pake mèdha pudhi lao-lao.

source_text: don't be frightened, he told them. you are looking for jesus the nazarene, the one who was crucified. he is risen from the dead. he is not here.
target_text: hèia mone ngèru èèna, peka dènge rèngu, baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a, na, miu mai tenge yesus dhèu nasaret, dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na aad'o heka ètu ne'e, lula na mamuri hari le! mai ho ladhe unu mi, te ngi'u yesus aad'o heka ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na.

source_text: look, this is the place where they laid him to rest. now go, and tell his disciples and peter that he's going ahead of you to galilee. you will see him there just as he told you.
target_text: de lami ka lai-lai, ho lole dènge petrus si, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le! na la'e uuru le asa galilea. èèna na rèngu paraga dènge yesus ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna na peka mema le dènge rèngu. de lami ka!

source_text: they left and ran from the tomb, shaking and confused. they said nothing to anyone because they were too scared.
target_text: ropa bhèni se rèdhi heka ngi'u yesus ètu era dhu ra paj'unu na, rèngu cag'ag'a. ka rai asa li'u lasi. hèia rèngu lèpa dènge ka, ra peka boe dènge dhèu èci sa ètu j'ara, lula rèngu madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: when jesus rose from the dead on the first day of the week, he appeared first of all to mary magdalene, from whom he'd driven out seven demons.
target_text: hari migu mad'ae aae era, yesus pad'elo uuru ngi'u na mi maria nèti magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus babège eele nidhu pidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: she went and told those who had been with him as they mourned and cried.
target_text: ropa na nèdhi nare yesus, hèia la'e dènge ka, peka dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu uru èèna madhutu yesus. dhèu sèra pakaboko taruu ètu era èci. rèngu ètu d'ara susa era, taga ra ngee mamadhe yesus.

source_text: when they heard that jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they didn't believe it.
target_text: ka maria peka dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu susa era? susa ia ka, te yesus mamuri hari le! deo na, ja'a heka paraga dènge ne kèna! te ngaa rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, èu ne, monya! ji'i lèka boe.

source_text: later jesus appeared in a different form to two other disciples who'd left to go to the countryside.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu madhutu yesus dhèu dua lasi asa rae èci. ropa d'ai talora j'ara, yesus pad'elo ngi'u dènge si. te ngaa nèngu ub'a le. nèbhu boe, heka ra tadhe ne.

source_text: they returned and told the others, but they didn't believe them either.
target_text: hèia dua ra lèpa hari, lasi peka dènge angalai ra sèra, aku rèngu na, wee! miu nanene ku laa! lai-lai deo na, ji'i paraga le dènge yesus ètu j'ara! te ngaa angalai ra aa'i-aa'i dhaa, aku rèngu na, eeh! miu baku monya sèmi èèna!

source_text: after this he appeared to the eleven disciples as they were eating. he rebuked them for their lack of trust and their stubbornness, because they had not believed those who'd seen him after he had risen.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paraga dènge ana madhutu na sèra, dhèu canguru èci, ropa ra madhèdi ra'a-rinu. ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, wee! miu kètu hadhu pa'ae sa mia ne! dhèu peka le dènge miu, rèngu rèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha rèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya boe! aku miu na, dhèu sèra monya! de ne'e ne, ja'a unu ku mai. mema tare'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa ja'a mamuri hari le! de mèdhi le, sina ma!

source_text: then he told them, go to the whole world, and announce the good news to everyone.
target_text: de lami ka asa mia-mia palème rai-haha ne. peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lii lolo be'a ja'a ne.

source_text: anyone who trusts in me and is baptized will be saved, but anyone who chooses not to trust will be condemned.
target_text: dhèu cee dhu parcaya ja'a aa abhu sarani, èèna na ama lamatua hia ne mamuri sèna ka na bisa pea taruu dènge ne ètu sorga. te ngaa cee dhu parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na nèngu abhu huku nèti lamatua, ka lamatua core eele ne asa li'u la'e, ho na pea taruu ètu nèi.

source_text: the following signs will accompany those who trust in me: in my name they will drive out demons; they will speak new languages;
target_text: aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a sèra, rèngu tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra re'a, peka na, koasa ra mema mai nèti ama lamatua! conto sèmi, èèna na rèngu bisa babège eele nidhu pake kolongara ja'a. ladhe èèna na, ama lamatua hia si padhai lii pake lii leo dhu rèngu mesa ra dhane rare boe.

source_text: they will be able to handle snakes; if they drink something poisonous they won't be harmed; they will place their hands on the sick and they will be healed.
target_text: ladhe rèngu kèpe mege dhu dènge raco, do, rinu lèke raco, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. ladhe ra tao kacui-aai asa dhèu pèd'a, dhèu èèna èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu na.

source_text: then, the lord jesus, when he had finished speaking to them, was taken up into heaven where he sat down at the right hand of god.
target_text: ropa padhai lii èle dènge ana madhutu na sèra, hèia ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa sorga. ètu nèi, nèngu j'aj'i ai g'ana ama na, ka rèd'u paredha sama-sama.

source_text: the disciples went out and spread the good news everywhere, and the lord worked with them, confirming the message through miraculous signs that accompanied it.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia ana madhutu na sèra madhutu paredha na. rèngu lasi asa mia-mia, ho lole mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lii lolo be'a yesus. hèia ama lamatua hia si koasa ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu yesus peka le dènge rèngu. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae parcaya yesus, taga rèngu re'a le lii lolo be'a èèna, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: as you know, many others have attempted to put down in writing the things that have been fulfilled that involve us. they based their accounts on evidence from the earliest eyewitnesses and ministers of the word, and so i also decided that since i have followed these things very carefully from the beginning, it would be a good idea to write out an accurate account of all that happened.
target_text: ama teofilus dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lii maho'o nèti ja'a. dhèu ae dhu suri sèku le lii lolo nèti mamuri dènge sasab'a-la'a yesus dhu j'aj'i ètu talora aae ji'i. rèngu suri lii lolo sèra pake lii lolo dhu parai reo nèti ji'i asa ji'i karèi nèti uru ka, dhu ji'i nge'a nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu dètu dènge lamatua yesus, aa nèti dhèu leo dhu ladhe rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. lii lolo se'e, lèke mola-mola dènge mamoa ama lamatua karèi nèti uru kèna. de ja'a parisa kore le toke lutu dènge be'a, j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, mulai nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. hèia ja'a pama'ète ho sèna ka suri si paie-iie ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i ra. dènge j'ara ne, ama bisa me'a mèu ngaa dhu j'aj'i le.

source_text: i have done this theophilus, your excellency, so you can be certain that what you were taught is completely reliable.
target_text: aa ama bisa parcaya ngaa dhu dhèu lole sèra, lii dhu monya boe. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i tare'a!

source_text: during the time when herod was king of judea, there was a priest called zechariah, who came from the abijah priestly division. he was married to elizabeth, who was also descended from aaron the priest.
target_text: j'aj'aj'i lii lolo ne sèmi ne'e: lod'o dhèu aae herodes nèd'u paredha ètu propensi yudea, abhu ca dhèu, dhu ngara na sakaria. nèngu ne, ca dhèu ama agama yahudi. aa nèngu kahèi, ca dhèu nèti kaboko ama agama abia. dhèu èmu sakaria, ngara na elisabet, ca dhèu ana-èpu nèti ama agama kahèi. te elisabet ne, ana-èpu nèti harun, a'a musa.

source_text: they both did what was right before god, being careful to follow all the lord's commandments and regulations.
target_text: dua ra mamuri mola madhutu paredha dènge atora aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua. aa dhèu pakab'ua si kahèi.

source_text: they had no children because elizabeth wasn't able to have any, and they were both growing old.
target_text: dua ra dhu heka le, te ngaa dhu abhu boe kolo, te era ana nèti elisabet dhu bèdho mèno.

source_text: while zechariah was serving as a priest before god, on behalf of his priestly division,
target_text: ca tèka, sakaria dènge dhèu d'ara kaboko abia lèke lod'o rèngu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: he was chosen by lot according to priestly custom to enter the temple of the lord and burn incense.
target_text: madhutu atora ama agama, hud'i ère lot, ho re'a cee ka dhu maso asa kama mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, dhèu ne hud'i pasèbu ai pake aj'u hèu mèngi ètu madha ama lamatua. lod'o èèna, sakaria lèke lot.

source_text: during the time of offering incense a large crowd of people were praying outside.
target_text: hèia la'e dènge ka asa d'ara. nèngu dhu talora pasèbu ai ètu d'ara kama èèna, dhèu ae-ae dhu sabaj'a ètu madha èmu.

source_text: an angel of the lord appeared to zechariah, standing to the right of the altar of incense.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga titu re bèka g'ana era tunu aj'u hèu mèngi ne.

source_text: when zechariah saw the angel, he was startled and became terrified.
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi, sakaria madha'u titu kèna, ka ne'a heka tao sèmi ngaa.

source_text: but the angel told him, don't be afraid, zechariah. your prayer has been heard, and your wife elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call him john.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne lii, aku nèngu na, sakaria! baku madha'u! te ama lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu. de bèli-camèd'a, dhèu èmu èu nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yohanis.

source_text: he will bring you joy and gladness, and many will celebrate his birth.
target_text: èèna na dhèu ae karej'e kahèi sama-sama dènge miu, lula miu abhu ana. bèli-camèd'a, ana ne pakarej'e d'ara èu.

source_text: he will be great in the sight of the lord. he will refuse to drink wine or other alcoholic drink. he will be filled with the holy spirit even before he's born.
target_text: koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, bera-bera dènge ne, karèi nèti ina na kad'o nèngu era. nèngu ne hud'i luri ninu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. ropa na kapai, ama lamatua pake ne j'aj'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara.

source_text: he will turn many israelites back to the lord their god.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a èèna pamako nare dhèu isra'el ae-ae, ho ra lèpa hari asa ama lamatua rèngu.

source_text: he will go ahead of the lord in the spirit and power of elijah, to turn the fathers back to thinking about their children, and to turn those who are rebellious back to a right understanding-to prepare a people ready for the lord.
target_text: tatao dènge koasa na nuka sèmi elia, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua karèi uru. nèngu ne mai uuru nèti lamatua èdhi. nèngu ne bisa kabèli d'ara ina-ama, ho sue hari ana-ana ra. aa dhèu dhu rai nèti madha lamatua, na ad'u si ho ra lèpa hari madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti sèmi èèna, nèngu tao dhèu sèna ka sadia d'ara ra sèmi mamai lamatua.

source_text: how can i be sure about this? zechariah asked the angel. i'm an old man, and my wife is getting old too.
target_text: te ngaa sakaria karèi ana pajuu ne, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, sina ma? ! ja'a dènge dhèu èmu ja'a, d'ara heka sèmi ne'e ne! tasamia ja'a bisa ke'a, na, j'ara se bisa j'aj'i?

source_text: i am gabriel, the angel replied. i stand in god's presence, and i was sent to speak to you and give you this good news.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a ne gabriel, dhèu pajuu ama lamatua. nèngu ka paleha ja'a mai, sèna ka peka dènge èu lii lolo dhu be'a ne.

source_text: but since you didn't believe what i told you, you'll become dumb, unable to speak, until the appointed time when my words come true.
target_text: te ngaa èu mo'o boe lèka lii padhai ja'a ne. de tadha dhu èu manèngi, sèmi ne'e! he'o èu èèna na sakaa, ho èu bisa heka padhai lii, nèti deo ne'e ne, toke miu abhu ana. pe èu mèdhi unu mu. te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: outside the people were waiting for zechariah, wondering why he was taking so long in the temple.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu li'u sèra, bingu titu kèna, lula sakaria tao bhodho boe.

source_text: when eventually he came out, he couldn't speak to them. they realized he'd seen a vision in the temple, for though he could make gestures, he was completely unable to speak.
target_text: ropa na kalua mai, nèngu bisa heka padhai lii. ka na hia tadha re kacui-aai na, heka dhèu se'e re'a, na, lamatua hia tanila ropa nèngu ètu d'ara kama mola-mèci èèna.

source_text: after he'd finished his time of service, he went back home.
target_text: ropa èle sasab'a ra, hèia sakaria lèpa asa èmu na.

source_text: some time later his wife elizabeth became pregnant. she stayed at home for five months. the lord has done this for me, she said, now that he's taken away my disgrace in the eyes of others.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka elisabet dènge babia. ka na pea dhoka ètu d'ara èmu toke lèmi hèru. na peka, aku nèngu na, koa-kio lamatua! lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. ladhe ja'a ne dènge ka kolo, dhèu pamakae heka ja'a.

source_text: in the sixth month of her pregnancy, god sent the angel gabriel to a young girl called mary who lived in the town of nazareth in galilee.
target_text: ropa elisabet dènge babia d'ai èna hèru, hèia ama lamatua pua ana pajuu na nèti sorga, la'e asa rae cue ètu propensi galilea, ngara na nasaret. ngara ana pajuu ne, gabriel.

source_text: she was engaged to a man named joseph.
target_text: ètu nasaret, abhu ana bhèni ngèru ca dhèu, ngara na maria. nèngu ne dhèu dhu lii d'ai le, ngara na yusuf. yusuf ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. gabriel la'e paraga dènge maria.

source_text: the angel greeted her. you are very privileged, he told her. the lord is with you.
target_text: ka na pad'elo iisi na mi ana bhèni ne, hèia na lii, peka na, salama, maria, ee! ama lamatua dhu hag'e nare le èu, ho neo ad'u j'ara hua iia èci hia èu. aa nèngu bera-bera dènge èu kahèi.

source_text: mary was very puzzled at what he said, and wondered what this greeting meant.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka maria bingu, lula ne'a boe sasoa nèti lii padhai ana pajuu ne.

source_text: don't worry, mary, the angel went on, for god has shown his graciousness to you.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, maria! baku madha'u. te ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu.

source_text: you will become pregnant and give birth to a son. you shall call him jesus.
target_text: nèbhu heka, èu dènge babia, ho èèna na, èu mora iisi ana mone ca dhèu. èu hud'i pangare ne, yesus.

source_text: he will be very great, and he will be called the son of the most high. the lord god will give him the throne of david his father,
target_text: nèngu ne, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i dhèu kapai. èèna na lamatua pangare ne, ‘nèngu ne, ana d'èlu ja'a. ' nuka, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. pe ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka nèd'u paredha, nuka sèmi baki na, dhèu aae daud.

source_text: and he will reign over the house of jacob forever. his kingdom will never come to an end.
target_text: nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha taa-taa mi dhèu isra'el. te paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: how is this possible? mary asked. i'm still a virgin.
target_text: te ngaa maria karèi gabriel, peka na, ja'a ne j'unu kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone èci sa! tasa mera mia ka ja'a dènge babia?

source_text: he replied, the holy spirit will come upon you, and the power of the most high will cover you. the baby who is to be born is holy, and will be called the son of god.
target_text: hèia gabriel dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci puru mai asa èu. aa koasa nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele, èèna na mai sarimu nare èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana dhu bèli-camèd'a èu more iisi èèna, tare'a-re'a mola-mèci, lula nèngu èèna, ana ama lamatua.

source_text: and elizabeth, your relative, even she is pregnant in her old age. the woman that people said couldn't have children is already six months pregnant.
target_text: baku malaa! te a'ari èu ca dhèu, ngara na elisabet, dènge le babia kahèi. dhèu peka na, nèngu èèna bisa heka nara iisi, lula nèngu dhu heka le. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu dènge babia èna hèru kèna.

source_text: nothing is impossible for god.
target_text: te bagi ama lamatua, aa'i-aa'i bisa j'aj'i!

source_text: here i am, ready to be the lord's servant, said mary. may it happen to me just as you said. then the angel left her.
target_text: ka maria dhaa, peka na, be'a. ja'a ne ènu ama lamatua. hud'i laa aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i madhutu sèmi lii èu èèna ka. ja'a ke'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga ne lèpa, tèke eele maria.

source_text: a little while later, mary got herself ready and hurried up into the hills of judea, to the town where zechariah's house was. she called out to elizabeth as she went in.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia maria pakèd'i nèti nasaret, la'e lai-lai asa rae sakaria, ètu ledhe-ledhe propensi yudea. d'ai nèi, la'e dènge ka asa d'ara èmu sakaria. ka na hia lii maho'o mi elisabet.

source_text: as soon as elizabeth heard mary's voice, the baby jumped for joy inside her. elizabeth was filled with the holy spirit,
target_text: ropa elisabet tadèngi lii maho'o nèti maria, hèia ana ètu d'ara kabake elisabet pasèja. aa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, maso sa elisabet.

source_text: and cried out in a loud voice: how blessed you are among women, and how blessed will be the child born to you!
target_text: ka elisabet pa'oo, peka na, maria! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, risi nèti dhèu bhèni aa'i-aa'i ra ètu rai-haha ne! èèna na dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oke padedha-dedha kahèi ana dhu èu kad'o èèna.

source_text: why am i so honored that the mother of my lord should visit me?
target_text: ra pakab'ua ja'a kahèi, lula ina nèti lamatua ja'a mai pangad'o dènge ja'a.

source_text: as soon as i heard you call out in greeting, my baby jumped for joy inside me.
target_text: ropa èu mèti lii maho'o mi dedha ja'a, cag'ag'a laa ana dhu ja'a kad'o ne pasèja ètu d'ara kabake ja'a, lula karae.

source_text: how fortunate you are, because you are convinced that the lord will do what he has promised you!
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èu, lula èu ne parcaya, peka na, nèngu tao madhutu lii dhu na moa tèke.

source_text: mary replied, how i praise the lord!
target_text: maria bhoka hèb'a, peka na, nèti d'ara iiki ja'a, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha lamatua!

source_text: i am so happy with god my savior,
target_text: d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae, lula ama lamatua hia ja'a mamuri!

source_text: because he decided that i, his servant, was worthy of his consideration, despite my humble background. from now on every generation will say i was blessed.
target_text: nèngu ne tao le madha-dhilu mi ja'a, nuka ana pua-paleha na dhu dènge boe kab'ua ne. karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ngee na, ja'a ne, bhèni dhu kalua mèngi titu kèna,

source_text: god almighty has done great things for me; his name is holy.
target_text: lula lamatua tao j'ara malaa mi dedha ja'a. nèngu ne, dhu koasa dedha risi aa dhu mola-mèci risi.

source_text: his mercy lasts for generation after generation to those who respect him.
target_text: ama lamatua loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakab'ua aa dhu pahaha iisi ra mi nèngu, nèti lai ana-lai èpu.

source_text: with his power he has broken to pieces those who arrogantly think they're so clever.
target_text: na pake koasa na, sèna ka tao pakaco dhèu-dhèu dhu padedha iisi sèra.

source_text: he tears the powerful down from their thrones, and elevates those who are humble.
target_text: na pamanahu dhèu aae-dhèu kapai dhu rèd'u koasa, lula ra padedha iisi. te ngaa na j'oka padedha-dedha dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: he fills the hungry with good things to eat, and he sends the rich away empty-handed.
target_text: na panga'a dhèu dhu manganga toke bècu, te ngaa na babège-lalèta dhèu-dhèu kaja ho lasi dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: he has helped his servant israel, remembering him in mercy,
target_text: na soru-bara dhèu isra'el na, dènge loe boe pad'elo sasue na mi rèngu.

source_text: just as he promised our fathers, to abraham and his descendants for ever.
target_text: uru èèna, na pa'èki tèke le lii pajaji dènge bèi-baki èdhi, nuka baki abraham dènge ana-èpu na aa'i-aa'i ra. d'ai sange ne'e, lii pajaji èèna pa'èki mèno.

source_text: mary stayed with her for three months and then returned home.
target_text: hèia maria pea dènge elisabet toke tèlu hèru, heka lèpa asa èmu na ètu nasaret.

source_text: the time came for elizabeth to have her baby and she gave birth to a son.
target_text: ropa d'ai hèru, ka elisabet nara iisi ana mone ca dhèu.

source_text: her neighbors and relatives heard how the lord had showed her great kindness, and they celebrated together with her.
target_text: lii ne'e, ra palolo d'ai a'ari na dènge rae lesa, aku rèngu na, ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na, ka na hia elisabet ana mone ca dhèu. hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra karej'e kahèi.

source_text: eight days later they came to circumcise the boy. they planned to call him zechariah after his father.
target_text: lod'o ana ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne, madhutu atora dhèu yahudi. ra neo pangare ana ne, sakaria, madhutu ngara ama na.

source_text: no, elizabeth said. he shall be called john.
target_text: te ngaa ina na b'ala ra, aku nèngu na, aad'o sèmi èèna! ngara na hud'i yohanis ku!

source_text: but there's nobody among your relatives who has this name, they told her.
target_text: te ngaa ra b'ala ne, nga tao ka pili ngara yohanis? nèti a'ari miu, ca dhèu sa dhu ngara dhae, sèmi mèka èèna!

source_text: through gestures they asked zechariah, the boy's father, what he wanted to call his son.
target_text: ka ra senen ho karèi sakaria, sèna ka neo pangare ana ne ngara na ngaa.

source_text: zechariah motioned for something to write on. to everyone's surprise he wrote, his name is john.
target_text: hèia sakaria senen ho manèngi lei. ra hia ne lei, ka na suri peka na, ngara na yohanis! ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa titu kèna.

source_text: immediately he could speak again, and he started praising god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, he'o na dhu sakaa mèno èèna, mako dènge ka. ka na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: all those living nearby were in awe at what had happened, and the news spread throughout the hill country of judea.
target_text: hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pea padètu ètu sèra sa, madha'u dènge malaa. ka lii ne'e mulai ra palolo nèti hèb'a sa hèb'a, toke dhèu-dhèu ètu ledhe-ledhe ètu propensi yudea re'a aa'i kahèi.

source_text: everyone who heard the news wondered what it meant. what will the little boy grow up to be? they asked, for it was clear he was very special to god.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, ra pangee, peka na, tatu koasa nèti lamatua bera-bera dènge ana ne. bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na kapai mai, na j'aj'i dhèu sèmi mia, oo?

source_text: zechariah, his father, filled with the holy spirit, spoke this prophecy:
target_text: èle ka, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa sakaria. ka na padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: the lord, the god of israel, he is wonderful, for he has come to his people and set them free.
target_text: koa-kio ama lamatua dhèu isra'el! te na mai le ho sui nare dhèu unu na, sèna ka rèngu baku j'aj'i sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: he has given us a great savior from the line of his servant david,
target_text: lamatua ded'e le ca dhèu dhu koasa na kapai titu kèna, ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèngu ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: as he promised through his holy prophets long ago.
target_text: lamatua moa mema, karèi nèti uru ka, re dhèu dhu maj'èni rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: he promised to save us from our enemies, from those who hate us.
target_text: limuri ne na neo patabuli èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, aa nèti dhèu dhu d'ara pèd'a dènge èdhi.

source_text: he was merciful to our fathers, remembering his holy agreement- the promise that he made to our father abraham.
target_text: na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi bèi-baki èdhi, lula na sanèd'e taruu lii pajaji na mi rèngu, dhu na pa'èki dènge baki abraham.

source_text: he gives us freedom from fear and rescues us from our enemies,
target_text: na patabuli le èdhi nèti musu-musu èdhi, sèna ka ta pahaha iisi mi nèngu, dhu dènge heka d'ara madha'u.

source_text: so we can serve him by doing what is good and right for our whole lives.
target_text: na patalale le èdhi, sèna ka èdhi bisa mamuri mola-mèci dènge be'a taa-taa, ètu katanga madha na.

source_text: even though you are only a small child, you will be called the prophet of the most high, for you will go ahead of the lord to prepare his way,
target_text: yohanis, ee! èu ne, ana ja'a. bèli-camèd'a dhèu tadhe èu, na, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu dedha risi aa'i. èèna na, lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu, sèna ka ra pakabhèle kacui-aai ra ho soru mamai lamatua.

source_text: providing knowledge of salvation to his people through the forgiveness of their sins.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a, lamu paj'uj'u j'ara hia mi dhèu unu lamatua, sèna ka re'a, na, ama lamatua hia mamuri mi rèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu saku eele sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: through god's caring kindness to us, heaven's dawn will break upon us to shine on those who live in darkness and under the shadow of death, and to guide us along the path of peace.
target_text: lula d'ara lamatua taleo aa rasa kasia mi dedha èdhi, nèti èèna ka, na hia èdhi taa-tebho dhu hiu, nuka sèmi lod'o hiu nèti saraa dhu hiu. èdhi dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa èdhi dhu pea dènge d'ara madha'u ètu sanabhu mamadhe, lula pabe'a mèka dènge lamatua, bèli-camèd'a abhu saraa ho lere èdhi asa j'ara dhu nèti mera-milu.

source_text: the boy john grew and became spiritually strong. he lived in the desert until the time came for his public ministry to israel.
target_text: ka yohanis asa kapai noo-noo. aa roh lamatua pa'èra ne. na kapai mai, hèia la'e pea ka ètu d'ara mamoo, toke d'ai lod'o na pakako sasab'a mi dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: it was the time when caesar augustus issued a decree that there should be a census of everyone in the roman empire. this was the first census under governor quirinius of syria.
target_text: ca tèka, ètu d'ara kirenius j'aj'i gubernur ètu siria, dhèu aae kapai agustus, hia paredha, dhu peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu paredha roma, hud'i lèpa asa rae èta-èsu ra ho madhutu sensus! èèna heka hiu-lai kèna, dhèu paredha roma ige ana kabarai na.

source_text: so everybody went to their own city to be registered.
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i lèpa asa rai èta-èsu ra, sèna ka madhutu sensus.

source_text: joseph was descended from king david, so he left nazareth in galilee to go to bethlehem, the city of david, in judea. he went to register there, together with mary, who was pledged in marriage to him and expecting a baby.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yusuf pea ètu rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea. nèngu dhu lii d'ai ana bhèni ca dhèu, ngara na maria, dhu dènge le babia. yusuf ne, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ka nèngu hud'i lèpa ku asa kota daud, nuka betlehem ètu propensi yudea, sèna ka madhutu sensus. nèti èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa kota betlehem.

source_text: while they were there, the time came for her to have her baby.
target_text: ropa dua ra ètu nèi, maria d'ai lod'o nara iisi.

source_text: she gave birth to her firstborn son. she wrapped him up in strips of cloth and laid him in a manger because the inn had no rooms left.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, dua ra abhu boe kama ètu d'ara losmen. nèti èèna ka, dua ra maso lasi asa d'ara oka badha. hèia maria nara iisi ana uuru, mone ca dhèu. ka pasig'i ne dènge kaha'i bèla, aa paj'unu ètu d'ara karab'a, era badha ra'a-rinu.

source_text: nearby some shepherds were spending the night out in the fields, keeping watch over their flocks.
target_text: mèda èèna, abhu ana madhenga badha dhèu pèri-pèri dhu beke madhenge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a ètu li'u kota.

source_text: an angel of the lord appeared to them, and the glory of the lord shone all around them. they were scared out of their wits!
target_text: kaca'a laa, rèngu rèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga. hèia saraa lamatua rai-reo nare rèngu, ka ra madha'u bia.

source_text: don't be afraid! the angel told them. i'm here to bring you good news that will make the all the people really glad.
target_text: te ngaa ana pajuu ne peka, baku madha'u! nanene pabe'a-be'a! te ja'a ne mai ho peka lii lolo be'a èci hia miu. cee dhu tadèngi lii ne'e, tatu rèngu karej'e.

source_text: the savior has been born to you today, here in david's city. he is the messiah, the lord.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne, sèmi ne'e ka: deo ne'e, ca dhèu ina nara iisi le kristus ètu betlehem, nuka kota dhèu aae daud. kristus ne'e ka dhu ama lamatua pajaji tèke le karèi nèti uru ka. lamatua hia na mai, sèna ka na patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèngu ne'e, èèna na dhèu paroa na, ‘lamatua'!

source_text: you will recognize him by this sign: you will find the child wrapped in strips of cloth and lying in a manger.
target_text: pe miu tadhe ne sèmi ne'e ka: miu paraga dènge ana rara iisi hiu ca dhèu dhu pahutu dènge sig'i. ra paj'unu ne ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: suddenly many heavenly beings appeared, praising god, saying,
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, hèia cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae mai nèti sorga. ka ra pa'èci dènge ne. hèia ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge lii sod'a, peka na,

source_text: glory to the god of heaven, and on earth peace to those who please him!
target_text: ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua! nèngu dhu nèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru dhu dedha risi. ama lamatua neo hia dame dènge mera-milu mi dhèu rai-haha, dhu pakarej'e d'ara na!

source_text: after the angels had left them and returned to heaven, the shepherds said to one another, let's go to bethlehem and see what's happened concerning these things the lord has told us about.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu se lèpa hari asa sorga. hèia ana madhenga badha se padhai lii, peka na, mai lati ku asa betlehem, ho ladhe ku ana nèi! te lamatua pa'adhu le lii ne hia èdhi.

source_text: they hurried there and found mary, joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.
target_text: hèia lasi ka lai-lai asa betlehem. ka rèngu paraga maria dènge yusuf. aa ladhe rèdhi kahèi ana dhu heka rara iisi, dhu bhèj'i ètu d'ara karab'a.

source_text: after they'd seen for themselves, they spread the news of what had happened and what they had been told about this baby.
target_text: ropa rèngu rèdhi ana ne, hèia ra lolo, peka na, deo na ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhu peka le dènge ji'i, lula-nèti ana ne'e ne! ka ra lolo aa'i-aa'i toke èle.

source_text: all those who heard about it were amazed at what the shepherds told them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, tadèngi lii lolo ana madhenga badha se.

source_text: but mary was careful to remember all the things that had happened and often thought about them.
target_text: te ngaa maria tèke ka ètu d'ara na, aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le. aa na pangee mau-mau, ho neo ne'a sasoa na tasa mera mia.

source_text: the shepherds went back to watching their flocks, glorifying and thanking god for all that they'd heard and seen, for it was just as they'd been told.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhenga badha se lèpa hari asa era kahib'i-kalèbho ra. hèia ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua. ra manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula dhu rèngu tadèngi aa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra, lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi ngaa dhu ana pajuu ama lamatua peka sèra.

source_text: after eight days, the time came for the baby to be circumcised, and he was named jesus. this was the name given to him by the angel before he had even been conceived.
target_text: ropa ana iiki ne d'ai aru lod'o, ka ra suna ne madhutu atora musa. hèia ama dènge ina na pangare ne, ‘yesus'. ngara ne, ngara dhu ana pajuu nèti sorga peka le dènge rèngu, lod'o ina na dènge mèka babia.

source_text: when the time of their purification according to the law of moses was finished, joseph and mary took him to jerusalem to present him to the lord,
target_text: atora èci nèti baki musa peka na, bhèni dhu rara iisi rare, d'ai èpa nguru lod'o hud'i madhutu ku ad'a, pamèu iisi ra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa maso sèmi biasa asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a. nèti èèna ka, yusuf dènge maria lasi asa kota yerusalem, sèna ka tao madhutu ad'a. lasi rèti dènge ana iiki èèna asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho saraka ne, sèna ka j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: as the law of the lord states, every firstborn son must be dedicated to the lord.
target_text: rèngu madhutu atora lamatua dhu peka na, bhèni dhu nara iisi ana mone uuru, nèngu hud'i saraka ana ne j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: there they made a sacrifice, as god's law also states, of a pair of turtle doves or two young pigeons.
target_text: madhutu atora lamatua, ladhe saraka ana èèna mi lamatua, ina-ama hud'i hia ku koro iia ca pasa, do koro j'aha ngèru dua ngi'u. nèti èèna ka, yusuf dènge maria tao madhutu atora èèna.

source_text: living in jerusalem at that time was a man called simeon. simeon did what was good and was very devout. he was waiting expectantly for the hope of israel, and the holy spirit was upon him. the holy spirit had shown him that he would not die before he saw the lord's messiah.
target_text: taa èèna, abhu mone heka ca dhèu ngara na simeon, dhu pea ètu kota yerusalem. nèngu ne dhèu d'ara mola, aa d'èi lamatua. roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge ne, na, nèngu hud'i nèdhi ku kristus, heka na madhe kèna. kristus èèna ka, dhu bèli-camèd'a hia mamuri mi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: following the spirit's leading, he went to the temple. when jesus' parents brought in the little boy to be dedicated as required by the law,
target_text: lod'o èèna, roh lamatua lere simeon la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. lod'o èèna kahèi, ina-ama yesus rèti ne, ho saraka j'aj'i unu lamatua.

source_text: simeon took jesus in his arms, thanked god, and said,
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi ana ne, ka simeon sa'u nare ne, hèia na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, aku nèngu na,

source_text: lord and master, now you can let your servant die in peace as you promised,
target_text: koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lamatua tao le madhutu lii pajaji na mi dedha ja'a. de ne'e ne lamatua bisa le patabuli ja'a, sèna ka ja'a madhe dènge mera-milu,

source_text: because i have seen for myself your salvation
target_text: te ja'a kèdhi le dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai, ho patabuli ji'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ji'i!

source_text: which you have prepared for everyone.
target_text: lamatua neo pake ana ne'e, sèna ka hia mamuri mi suku aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he is a light that will show you to the nations, the glory of your people israel.
target_text: nèngu nuka sèmi saraa, dhu pakab'ua suku-suku isra'el, dhèu lamatua sèra. nèngu kahèi èci èèna ka dènge saraa, dhu pad'elo j'ara lamatua, pala mi suku-suku leo kahèi.

source_text: jesus' father and mother were shocked at what simeon said about him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia yusuf dènge maria malaa lula lii padhai dhu simeon peka lula-nèti ana rèngu ne.

source_text: then simeon blessed them, and said to jesus' mother mary, this child is destined to cause many in israel to fall and many to rise. he is a sign from god that many will reject,
target_text: èle ka simeon padhai lii hia si mèngi-nale. hèia na peka dènge maria, aku nèngu na, ina yesus! bèli-camèd'a dhèu ae ètu isra'el tule eele ana èu ne. te ngaa tatao rèngu mi dedha nèngu ne, èèna na pamanahu hari rèngu. ana ne'e, bèli-camèd'a pakarej'e d'ara dhèu ae kahèi.

source_text: revealing what they really think. for you it will feel like a sword piercing right through you.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, lamatua bhoke patalele d'ara dhèu. te ngaa èu, maria, pe mu paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae, nuka sèmi samala dhu lose adhe-usu èu.

source_text: anna the prophetess also lived in jerusalem. she was the daughter of phanuel of the tribe of asher, and she was very old. she had been married for seven years, and then she had been widowed. she was eighty-four years old. she spent her time at the temple in worship, fasting and praying.
target_text: ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu kahèi bhèni heka ca dhèu, ngara na hana. umur na, aru nguru èpa tèu kèna. ngara ama na fanuel, nèti suku aser. na leo-èmu pidhu tèu, ka dhèu èmu na madhe. hana ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. nèngu loe boe sabaj'a dènge puasa ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua mèda-mèu.

source_text: she came up to them right at that moment, and began praising god. she spoke about jesus to all those who were looking forward to the time when god would set jerusalem free.
target_text: lod'o simeon padhai lii dènge yusuf dènge maria era, hèia hana mai padètu-dètu. ka nanene si padhai lii, hèia na koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. ka na padhai lii lula-nèti yesus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatae mamai dhèu aae dhu lamatua lii dhu moa tèke neo pua mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu isra'el.

source_text: once they had completed everything god's law required, they returned to their home town of nazareth in galilee.
target_text: ropa yusuf dènge maria tao le madhutu atora nèti baki musa ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra lèpa asa rae nasaret, ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: the child grew strong, and was very wise. god's blessing was with him.
target_text: ka yesus asa kapai, asa èra, asa d'èlu-mèu dènge ne'a madha j'ara ae-ae. aa ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi yesus kahèi.

source_text: jesus' parents traveled to jerusalem every year for the passover festival.
target_text: yusuf dènge maria dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lasi asa kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: when jesus was twelve years old, they went to the festival as they always did.
target_text: ca tèka, ropa umur yesus canguru dua tèu, hèia la'e palere dènge ina-ama na asa yerusalem, lasi ra'a kalela paska sèmi biasa.

source_text: when the festival had finished and it was time to return home, the boy jesus remained in jerusalem, but his parents didn't realize this. they assumed he was with all the others traveling home. a day passed before they started looking for him among their friends and relatives.
target_text: lod'o èle paska, yusuf dènge maria mulai lèpa lasi asa nasaret palere-lere dènge dhèu ae dhu lèpa asa galilea. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe, na, yesus ètu yerusalem era. ra pangee, na, nèngu palere dènge mone aanga-angalai na. te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, yusuf dènge maria rèdhi boe ne. ka dua ra mulai patangi-tenge kèna. lasi pakarèi mi a'ari ra, aa mone aanga-angalai ra.

source_text: when they couldn't find him they returned to jerusalem to look for him there.
target_text: lula rage boe ne, hèia dua ra lèpa hari sa yerusalem, lasi tenge ne ètu nèi.

source_text: it was three days before they found him in the temple. he was sitting among the religious teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra patangi-tenge ne toke tèlu lod'o kateme, heka paraga dènge ne kèna, ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu dhu madhèdi padhue-padhai dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: all who heard him speak were surprised by his understanding and his answers.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene lii dhaa na, malaa-maloha, lula nèngu tare'a-re'a ne'a mèu isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, aa na ne'a dhaa lii karèi dènge mola.

source_text: his parents were totally confused when they saw what he was doing. his mother asked him, son, why have you treated us like this? your father and i-we've been worried sick! we've been looking everywhere for you!
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna ka, ina-ama na malaa kahèi. hèia ina na lii, aku nèngu na, yesus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ji'i sèmi ne'e? ama mu dènge ja'a patangi-tenge èu heo d'èlu!

source_text: why is it that you were looking for me? jesus replied. didn't you know i should be here in my father's house?

source_text: but they didn't understand what he meant.

source_text: then he went back with them to nazareth, and did what he was told. his mother kept a careful note of everything that happened.
target_text: hèia aa'i-aa'i ra lèpa asa nasaret. ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ina dènge ama na. ka ina na tèke aa'i-aa'i se'e ètu d'ara na.

source_text: jesus grew steadily wiser and stronger, favored both by god and by the people.
target_text: hèia yesus asa tabha kapai, asa tabha d'èlu-mèu, asa pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, dènge dhèu rai-haha asa tabha d'èi ne.

source_text: by now tiberias had been caesar for fifteen years. pontius pilate was governor of judea. herod was ruler of galilee, his brother philip was ruler of iturea and trachonitis, and lysanius was ruler of abiline. annas and caiphas were the current high priests. this was the time when the word of god came to john, zechariah's son, who was living in the desert.
target_text: taa èèna, tiberius j'aj'i dhèu aae kapai dhu nèd'u paredha ètu roma, canguru lèmi tèu kèna. pontius pilatus j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi yudea. herodes j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi galilea. a'a herodes ka pelipus, j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi iturea dènge propensi trakonitis. aa lisanias j'aj'i gubernur ètu propensi abilene. taa èèna kahèi hanas dènge kayafas, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu kota yerusalem. lod'o èèna, yohanis, ana sakaria, dhu pea ètu era kaj'èu nèti rae. ètu era ne'e, lamatua pangèd'u ne lii.

source_text: he went throughout the whole jordan region, announcing to everyone that they needed to be baptized to show they had repented and their sins had been forgiven.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia yohanis la'e asa d'ara rae dhu dètu dènge loko yarden, ho peka dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, miu hud'i ele-ho'a ku, aa tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala sèra. èle èèna, miu sarani uuru ku, sèna ka j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, miu pabe'a le dènge lamatua.

source_text: as isaiah the prophet wrote: a voice was heard crying out in the desert, ‘prepare the way of the lord: make his paths straight.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, baki yesaya, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri tèke le lula-nèti yohanis ne, peka na, abhu dhèu dhu ètu d'ara mamoo, pa'oo, peka na: ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pa'èra, sèna ka tao paie-iie j'ara, ho sèmi mamai lamatua! pamola j'ara sèna ka lami soru ne.

source_text: every valley will be filled, and every mountain and hill will be leveled. crooked ways will be straightened, and rough roads will be smoothed.
target_text: dhènu pamera era kajèlo aa'i-aa'i. tao pamera-mera ledhe aa'i-aa'i. tao pamola j'ara dhu koe-kalèko, tao pamilu j'ara dhu ako kabhuku.

source_text: every human being will see god's salvation. '
target_text: sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a, na, ama lamatua neo pakaj'èu dhèu nèti sasala-sasigo ra. '

source_text: john addressed the crowds that came to him to be baptized. you viper's brood! who warned you to flee from the coming judgment? he asked.
target_text: dhèu ae mai nèti mia-mia, manèngi ho yohanis sarani si. te ngaa na jèke si, peka na, miu se dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! miu èci èèna ka mege dhu dènge raco! mage miu pangee na miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti hahuku lamatua, sad'i dhoka ele-ho'a di! aad'o! nèbhu heka lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tare'a-re'a ele boe ho'a.

source_text: demonstrate that you have truly repented. don't try to justify yourselves by saying, ‘we're abraham's descendants. ' let me tell you, god can create children of abraham from these stones.

' abhu ètu mia sèmi èèna? j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham bisa boe tao miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci. lamatua bisa tao hadhu se, sèna ka j'aj'i ana-èpu abraham. ja'a peka kèna! pad'elo ètu d'ara mamuri miu, dhu peka na, miu tèke eele le sasala-sasigo miu, aa mai ho madhutu lamatua.

source_text: the ax is set to begin chopping at the base of the trees. any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into the fire.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku j'ara be'a. ladhe aad'o, na, hahuku lamatua dhu bia, bèbhe mai lèke miu, nuka sèmi dhèu pake kataka ho patue aj'u nèti amo na. nuka sèmi èèna ka! aj'u dènge boe guna, ladhe hua-hela na nèti boe babe'a! de be'a risi patue ne, aa core eele asa d'ara ai la'e.

source_text: so what should we do? the crowds asked him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae karèi yohanis, ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i se tasamia?

source_text: if you have two coats, then share with someone who doesn't have one. if you have food, then share with those who don't, he told them.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, ladhe èu dènge kodho dua bèla, hia èci sa dhèu dhu dènge boe kodho. aa ladhe èu dènge nganga'a, bagi hia dhèu dhu dènge boe nganga'a.

source_text: some tax collectors came to be baptized. teacher, what should we do? they also asked.
target_text: hèia dhèu roro bea mai manèngi kahèi, sèna ka yohanis sarani si. ka ra karèi, peka na, ama mese! ji'i se hud'i tao sèmi ngaa ku?

source_text: don't collect any more tax than you're meant to, he replied.
target_text: ka na dhaa, miu se d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. de nèti deo ne'e, miu hud'i sab'a ku dènge mola. baku roro bea risi nèti atora paredha. hud'i laa kabarai b'ae madhutu atora na.

source_text: what about us? some soldiers asked. what should we do? don't demand money with threats of violence. don't make accusations that are untrue. be satisfied with your wages, he replied.

source_text: the people were waiting expectantly, and wondered whether john himself might be the messiah.

source_text: the spirit of the lord is upon me, for he has anointed me to announce good news to the destitute. he has sent me to proclaim that prisoners will be released, the blind will see, the oppressed will be freed,

source_text: and to proclaim the time of the lord's favor.
target_text: te limuri ne d'ai le lod'o lamatua, sèna ka pala mamuri mi dhèu unu na.

source_text: he rolled up the scroll and gave it back to the attendant. then he sat down. everybody in the synagogue was staring at him.
target_text: baca nare sasuri ne, ka yesus lulu hari, hèia na j'ole asa ama dhu nèd'u kasasi, ka na madhèdi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna ladhe patae ne.

source_text: this scripture you've just heard has been fulfilled today! he told them.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, dhu miu tadèngi nèti sasuri ama lamatua deo na, ne'e ne, j'aj'i le!

source_text: everybody expressed their approval of him, amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. isn't this joseph's son? they wondered.
target_text: ka dhèu sèra mulai padhai lii padedha yesus, aku rèngu na, waa! ngaa dhu na padhai lii deo na, be'a titu kèna! te ngaa nèngu ne ana yusuf, si? tasamia ka na bisa sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: jesus replied, i'm sure you'll repeat this proverb to me, ‘physician, heal yourself! ' and ask, ‘why don't you do here in your own hometown what we heard you did in capernaum? '
target_text: hèia yesus lole dènge si, tatu miu tadèngi le lii dhu peka na, ‘wee, dote! puri uuru ku ngi'u èu! ' miu neo pake lii èèna, ho kabèli hari sa ja'a, peka na, ‘nga tao ka èu tao boe tadha malaa èci hia ji'i ètu ne'e, sèmi dhu èu tao le ètu kota kapernaum nèi? '

source_text: but i tell you the truth, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
target_text: mamola na sèmi ne'e: dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti d'ara rae unu na.

source_text: i guarantee that there were many widows in israel during the time of elijah when there was a drought for three and a half years, causing a great famine throughout the country. yet elijah wasn't sent to any of them. he was sent to a widow in zarephath in the region of sidon!
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi baki elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ca tèka, èj'i mai boe tèlu tèu catenga. taa èèna, abhu bhèni balu ae ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua hia boe elia ho soru-bara si ètu isra'el sèra. lamatua dhoka pua la'e asa ca dhèu bhèni balu ètu rae sarfat, dhu dètu dènge kota sidon. masi ka bhèni ne dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: even though there were many lepers in israel in the time of elisha, the only one who was healed was naaman the syrian!
target_text: tare hari conto leo nèti elisa, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. taa èèna, dhèu yahudi ae dhu lèke èi papèd'a kusta ètu isra'el. te ngaa lamatua pa'èle boe si nèti papèd'a ra. ama lamatua dhoka pua elisa la'e puri-pa'èle dhèu kusta èci, ngara na naaman, masi ka nèngu ne dhèu siria, dhèu yahudi boe. te ngaa na parcaya koasa ama lamatua.

source_text: when they heard this everyone in the synagogue became furious.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii yesus ne, hèia aa'i-aa'i ra nasa titu kèna dènge ne.

source_text: they jumped to their feet and threw him out of the town. then they dragged him to the top of the hill on which the town was built in order to throw him off the cliff.
target_text: ka ra kèd'i aa'i-aa'i, ra babège eele ne nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èèna. hèia ra nuni rèti ne asa karasa rae, ho neo tule ne nèti dedha tèbhi ètu èèna, asa haha la'e.

source_text: but he walked right through them and went on his way.
target_text: te ngaa na kako asa li'u la'e re talora aae rèngu, ka tèke eele si ètu era èèna.

source_text: jesus went down to capernaum, a town in galilee. on sabbath he started teaching them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus puru la'e asa kota kapernaum ètu sebhe dano galilea. d'ai lod'o-lod'o sabaj'a, na aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: they were amazed at what he taught them for he spoke with authority.
target_text: dhèu sèra malaa ladhe ra nanene lii padhai na, te ne'a mèu isi lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: in the synagogue there was a man who was possessed by a demon. he cried out,
target_text: ca tèka, ropa yesus aj'a-nori ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu ca dhèu dhu nidhu tao, na pa'oo-parodha, peka na,

source_text: so, what do you want with us, jesus of nazareth? have you come to destroy us? i know who you are: god's holy one!
target_text: ee! yesus, dhèu nasaret! èu neo tao ngaa mi ji'i? èu mai sèna ka palaho ji'i, do? ji'i se tadhe èu. èu ne, dhèu mola, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pajaji tèke ho hia mai.

source_text: jesus interrupted him, saying. be quiet! then he ordered the demon, come out of him! throwing him to the ground right before them, the demon left the man without injuring him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus jèke ne, peka na, rèno laa! hutu hèb'a èu na! kalua ka nèti dhèu ne'e! cag'ag'a laa, nidhu ded'e kalabhe dhèu ne asa rai, ètu talora aae dhèu sèra. ropa pabèbhe nare, hèia nidhu ne kalua tèke eele aa papèd'a boe isi dhèu ne hèi.

source_text: they were all amazed and asked each other, what is this teaching? with power and authority he orders evil spirits to leave-and they do!
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i malaa-maloha, ka ra peka na, ira ii! lii padhai dhèu ne'e, dènge koasa kapai bia! toke nidhu madhutu paredha na kahèi, ka kalua nèti dhèu!

source_text: news about jesus spread throughout the nearby region.
target_text: hèia lii lolo lula-nèti yesus pale-lème rai èèna aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: leaving the synagogue, jesus went to simon's house. simon's mother-in-law was sick with a high fever and those who were there asked jesus to help.
target_text: lod'o rèngu kalua nèti èmu sabaj'a, yesus la'e asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. lod'o èèna, teto na dhu pèd'a maringi-sagoro isi pana bia. hèia ra manèngi yesus, peka na, ama! puri-pa'èle ku bhèni heka ne, laa!

source_text: jesus went and stood over her. he told the fever to leave her-which it did. she got up right away and prepared a meal for them.
target_text: ka yesus la'e titu ètu sebhe koi, ka puri papèd'a bhèni heka ne. cag'ag'a laa, èi papèd'a na ele dènge ka. hèia na kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a hia si ra'a-rinu.

source_text: when the sun set, they brought to him all who were sick, suffering from various diseases. jesus placed his hands on them, one after the other, and he healed them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lod'o nihia èèna kahèi, ropa lod'o oe cèna, dhèu lere rèti dhèu pèd'a ae-ae mai asa yesus. èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa. hèia na bane ai mi dhèu pèd'a se'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra èle nèti papèd'a-tarègu ra.
