source_text: demons came out of many people, shouting, you are the son of god. but jesus stopped them and refused to let them speak because they knew he was the christ.
target_text: nèti dhèu pèd'a se abhu kahèi dhu nidhu tao. hèia yesus paredha nidhu se, sèna ka kalua nèti dhèu sèra. ra rai kalua dènge lii taraa, peka na, èu ne, ana ama lamatua! te nidhu se re'a, na, nèngu ne kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. nèti èèna ka, yesus kai si sèna ka bisa boe ra padhai ca hèb'a sa, lula-nèti nèngu.

source_text: early the following morning jesus left to find some peace and quiet. but the crowds went out looking for him, and finally found him. they tried to stop him leaving because they did not want him to go.
target_text: asa bèli d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus kèd'i, ka la'e asa era dhu kaliu èci ètu li'u kota. hèia dhèu tenge ne asa mia-mia. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka ra pamako ne, aku rèngu na, ama pea ka dènge ji'i laa! lamu iia ka asa era leo!

source_text: but he told them, i have to go to other towns to tell them the good news of the kingdom of god too, because that is what i was sent to do.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a hud'i laku asa rae-rae leo, ho peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèti paredha ama lamatua. te ama lamatua pua ja'a mai ne, sèna ka pakako sasab'a èèna.

source_text: so jesus went on traveling around, teaching the good news in the synagogues of judea.
target_text: hèia na kako nèti rae èci asa rae leo, ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: one day, as jesus was standing beside the sea of galilee, people crowded around him to hear the word of god.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu sebhe dano galilea. dhèu ae mai sèna ka neo nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. rèngu mai toke ra kalibhu rare yesus.

source_text: jesus noticed two boats lying on the shore, left there by fishermen who were washing their nets.
target_text: padètu dènge era èèna, abhu dhèu dhu pamèu pèku ra ètu dedha nebhe. ka yesus nèdhi koha dua bua dhu panahu ètu era èèna.

source_text: jesus got into a boat, the one that belonged to simon, and asked him to push it out into the water, just offshore. then jesus sat down in the boat and taught the people from there.
target_text: cue nèti koha se, unu simon. èle ka, yesus ca'e asa dedha koha ne, ka na manèngi sèna ka simon tob'e asa era marèma ciki. hèia na madhèdi ho aj'a dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: after he'd finished speaking, he told simon, go out into deeper water, and let down your nets for a catch.
target_text: aj'a nare, hèia na padhai lii dènge simon, peka na, simon! padedha hari ku asa d'ara marèma, ho core pèku la'a. te èèna na miu abhu i'a ae.

source_text: teacher, we worked hard all night, and didn't catch anything. but if you say so, i'll let down the nets, simon replied.
target_text: ka simon dhaa, peka na, te ngaa, ama. ji'i sab'a d'ai madhe d'ara camèd'a kateme kèna, te abhu boe ci'u sa hèi! te ngaa lula ama ku peka le sèmi èèna, ja'a madhutu! ja'a papuru sèku.

source_text: having done this, a large shoal of fish filled the nets full to breaking point.
target_text: hèia ra papuru pèku. ropa ra neo ère paca'e hari, re'a boe na pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a, ka mulai mae.

source_text: they waved to their partners in the other boat, asking them to come over and help. the others came over and together they filled both of the boats with fish. the boats were so full that they began to sink.
target_text: hèia simon rodhe angalai na ètu koha leo sèra, ho mai bara rèngu ère pèku. ka ra da'u i'a tao asa d'ara koha, toke koha dua bua se pènu dènge i'a, ka oe cène.

source_text: when simon peter saw what had happened, he dropped to his knees before jesus. lord, please stay away from me, for i am a sinful man! he exclaimed. for he and everybody with him were completely amazed by the catch of fish that they had landed. james and john, the sons of zebedee, simon's partners, felt the same way. don't be afraid, jesus told simon. from now on you'll be fishing for people!
target_text: angalai simon se, nuka yakobis dènge yohanis, ana nèti sabadeus, ètu era èèna kahèi. rèngu se malaa, lula ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna. ropa simon petrus ladhe nèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, hèia na patitu dènge ka, kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus, hèia na peka, ja'a ne, ca dhèu dhu ue le sasala ae-ae. de be'a risi, lamatua padètu ia ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, simon! pangee ia ka j'ara ne'e, te ja'a neo pake miu se. miu tema le tenge i'a. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a aj'a miu sèna ka tenge dhèu ho madhutu ja'a.

source_text: so they dragged the boats onto the shore, left everything, and followed jesus.
target_text: èle ka, rèngu nuni dènge ka koha ra asa dedha nebhe. ka lasi tèke eele ka ngaa-ngaa ra aa'i-aa'i, lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: once when jesus was visiting one of the towns, he met a man there who had a very bad case of leprosy. the man fell with his face to the ground and begged jesus, please lord, if you're willing, you can make me clean.
target_text: ètu rae èci, yesus paraga dènge ca dhèu dhu ngi'u na pènu dènge èi papèd'a kusta. ropa dhèu ne nèdhi yesus, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu na, aa na pacud'u d'ai rai. hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sue ku ja'a laa! te ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa puri-pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge ia ka dènge ja'a. sad'i ama mo'o.

source_text: jesus reached out and touched the man. i am willing, he said. be clean! immediately the leprosy disappeared.
target_text: ka yesus j'ole kacui-aai na ho g'ag'e ne. aa na peka, ja'a ko'o! èu èle dènge kèna! ropa na padhai lii nare, èi papèd'a dhèu ne èle dènge.

source_text: say nothing to anyone, jesus instructed him. go and show yourself to the priest and make the ceremonial offerings as required by the law of moses as proof that you've been healed.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e ne, peka na, baku bhèlu, ee! èu èle le, te ngaa baku peka dènge dhèu èci sa! èu hud'i madhutu uuru ku paredha baki musa. de lamu asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u èu, sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a ne èle tare'a, do dhae. èle èèna na, èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, èu ne èle tare'a le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: yet the news about jesus spread more and more. large crowds came to hear jesus and to be healed from their diseases.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai, te ngaa lii lolo nèti koasa na, pale-lème nèti dhèu èci asa èci d'ai mia-mia. ka dhèu mai sèmi tao cèci sa, ho ra nanene na aj'a-nori. hèia na puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a ra.

source_text: but jesus often used to retreat to quiet places and pray.
target_text: te ngaa catèka-catèka, yesus d'èi kahèi patalele iisi, ho la'e manèngi-mangaj'i asa era dhu kaliu.

source_text: one day when jesus was teaching, the pharisees and religious teachers who had come from all over galilee, judea, and jerusalem were sitting there. the power of the lord to heal was with him so he could heal.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus aj'a dhèu ètu d'ara èmu cue. lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge pèri-pèri mese agama, mai ho nanene lii padhai na. dhèu se mai nèti rae-rae ètu propensi galilea, propensi yudea, dènge kota yerusalem. ama lamatua hia yesus koasa, sèna ka pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a.

source_text: some men arrived carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. they tried to take him in and lay him in front of jesus. but they couldn't find any way through the crowd, so they went up on the roof and made a hole in the roof tiles. then they lowered the man down on the mat, right into the crowd in front of jesus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pèri-pèri ded'e rèti dhèu karuku èci ètu dedha karad'a. rèngu tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka yesus puri-pa'èle ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara èmu ne, dhèu sèmi tao cacèci sa, ka rèngu bisa boe pasuki asa d'ara. nèti èèna ka, ra ded'e dhèu ne asa kolo èmu. rare dedha, ka ra bèdi eele rèu èmu, sèna ka tao ro'a, ho dulu dhèu karuku ne dènge karad'a kateme asa haha la'e. ra dulu dhèu ne'e asa talora aae dhèu ae-ae se, lèke mola-mola ètu madha yesus.

source_text: when jesus saw the trust they had in him, he said to the man, your sins are forgiven.
target_text: ropa nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia yesus ne'a, na, rèngu se parcaya, na, nèngu bisa pa'èle angalai ra nèti karuku na. ka na lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku pamèu le sasala èu.

source_text: the religious teachers and the pharisees began to argue with that. who is this who's speaking blasphemies? they asked. who can forgive sins? only god can do that!
target_text: ropa tadèngi yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka dhèu parisi dènge mese agama sèra, pakarèi, na, eeh! dhoka ama lamatua dhu dènge hak di, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu. cee ka nèngu ne, ka na tao iisi na nuka sèmi ama lamatua! ne'e ne pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua!

source_text: jesus knew what they were arguing about, so he asked them, why are you thinking to question this?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a d'ai d'ara rèngu. hèia na peka, nga tao ka miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua?

source_text: what is easier? to say your sins are forgiven, or to say get up and walk? however, i will prove to you that the son of man has the authority here on earth to forgive sins. then he said to the paralyzed man, i tell you: get up, pick up your mat, and go home.
target_text: ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a ne dènge hak kahèi, ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ladhe ja'a lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, ‘ja'a abho le sasala èu, ' miu mèdhi boe koasa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka na, ‘kèd'i ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe nèngu kèd'i dènge ka, na, miu heka mèdhi koasa ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku ne, sèna ka miu me'a, na, ja'a dènge hak ho abho sasala-sasigo dhèu. ka na piku asa dhèu karuku ne, aa lii, peka na, titu ka! ded'e karad'a èu, ho lèpa ka!

source_text: immediately the man stood up in front of them. he picked up the mat he'd been lying on, and went home, praising god as he went.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, dhèu ne kèd'i titu ètu madha dhèu ae sèra, ka kèpe nare karad'a na. hèia na lèpa ka dènge koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: everyone was completely astonished at what had happened, and in great awe they praised god, saying, what we saw today was amazing!
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i se malaa. ka ra ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama lamatua, peka na, lamatua kapai risi eele! deo ne'e ne, èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi unu ti, tadha malaa dhu kapai!

source_text: later, as jesus was leaving the town, he saw a tax collector called levi sitting at his tax booth. follow me, jesus told him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus kalua nèti d'ara èmu, hèia ladhe nèdhi dhèu roro bea ca dhèu, dhu madhèdi ètu era roro doi bea. ngara dhèu ne, lewi. ka yesus peka dènge ne, mai ka madhutu ja'a!

source_text: levi stood up, left everything, and followed jesus.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii paroa ne, hèia lewi kèd'i dènge ka, tèke eele aa'i-aa'i sèra, la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: levi organized a large banquet at his home in jesus' honor. many tax collectors and others were in the crowd that sat down to eat with them. but the pharisees and the religious teachers complained to jesus' disciples, asking,
target_text: èle ka, lewi tao tatao kapai ètu èmu na, ka na nèru yesus. aa na nèru kahèi angalai na dhèu roro bea sèra, dènge tamu-tamu dhu leo ho lasi ra'a-rinu.

source_text: why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?
target_text: te ngaa pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dènge mese-mese agama, ka'uu-kamuki mi ana madhutu yesus, aku rèngu na, tasamia ka miu mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu laku boe, nuka dhèu roro bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra? dhèu be'a bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra sa!

source_text: healthy people don't need a doctor-but sick people do, jesus replied.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge rèngu, peka na, dhèu pèd'a parluu dote-matarii. te ngaa dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe.

source_text: i didn't come to call those who are living right to repentance-i came to call sinners.
target_text: mamai ja'a ne, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu karehe sèra. te ngaa ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu ngee na, ngi'u ra mola le.

source_text: well, john's disciples often fast and pray, and the pharisees' disciples do so as well. but your disciples don't-they go on eating and drinking, they told him.
target_text: hèia dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge mese-mese agama ka'ugu mi yesus, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama! ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, rèngu tema puasa dènge sabaj'a. ana-ana madhutu dhèu parisi sèmi èèna kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka, ana madhutu ama sèra, loe boe dènge ra'a-rinu? rèngu se re'a boe puasa, do?

source_text: should the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? jesus asked.
target_text: ka na dhaa pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao pesta kab'i, dhèu-dhèu dhu ra nèru sèra, bisa boe puasa, te ngaa ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna, dènge rèngu era, tatu rèngu ra'a palere aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: no-but the time is coming when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. then they can fast.
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu leo rai rèti mone dhu kab'i ne, hèia angalai na susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: then he gave them an illustration: you don't tear out a patch from new clothes to mend old clothes. otherwise you'd ruin new clothes, and the patch from the new wouldn't match the old.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu mèka dhèu dhu rare bèla hiu ca'èta, ho kalape mi kodho dhui dhu mae. te ladhe base kodho ne, bèla hiu dhu kalape la'a èèna karuku, na kodho ne asa mae aae.

source_text: you don't put new wine into old wineskins, because if you did the new wine would burst the wineskins. then both wine and wineskins would be wasted. you put new wine in new wineskins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhua dhu heka rèti nèti kapua, dhèu bhori boe asa sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha madhore eele, aa dhua èèna soli soo-soo asa rai la'e. de dhua dhu hiu, hud'i bhori ku asa d'ara sabha hiu. sèmi èèna ka, yesus aj'a si, peka na, lii aj'a na dhu hiu bisa boe pab'ali dènge lii aj'a dhu dhui nèti dhèu parisi.

source_text: and nobody after drinking old wine wants new wine, for they say, ‘the old tastes good. '
target_text: dhèu dhu rinu rèdhi le èi anggor dhui, d'èi boe rinu dhu hiu. te dhu re'a na, ‘èi anggor dhu kee risi nuka èi anggor dhui! '

source_text: one sabbath while jesus was walking through grainfields, his disciples began picking some heads of grain, rubbing them in their hands, and eating them.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, kako re j'ara ètu sebhe oka dhèu. ka ana madhutu na puru are-gandum dhu ètu madha rèngu sèra. hèia ra sarod'e d'ara kacui-aai, ka ra'a.

source_text: some of the pharisees questioned him, asking, why are you doing what is not permitted on the sabbath?
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dhu kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi ra. ropa ladhe rèdhi ana madhutu yesus tao sèmi èèna, ka ra kai ne, peka na, tasamia ka ana-ana èu se sisu atora agama èdhi? rèngu sab'a lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a! ladhe ku laa! rèngu puru are-gandum nèi. baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: jesus replied, have you never read what david did when he and his men were hungry? how he went into the house of god and took the consecrated bread? he ate it, and gave it to his men too. that's not permitted either. the consecrated bread is only for the priests.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia, ee? miu sanèd'e lii lolo baki daud? daud dènge dhèu madhutu na lula manganga ae, ka maso lasi asa d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia ra'e roti dhu ama agama hia le lamatua. te ngaa roti se'e dhodhoka ama agama di dhu bisa ra'e. dhèu leo bisa boe. ka baki daud si ra'e, te ngaa ca dhèu sa peka boe, na, rèngu sale. miu se, sèmi baca mèdhi boe sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua!

source_text: then he told them, the son of man is lord of the sabbath.
target_text: pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète, na, dhèu bisa sab'a ngaa, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a.

source_text: on another sabbath he went into the synagogue to teach. a man was there with a crippled right hand.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhu leo, yesus la'e aj'a ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci, dhu ai madhe cabèka.

source_text: the religious teachers and the pharisees were observing jesus closely to see if he would heal on the sabbath. they wanted to find something to accuse him of.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri mese agama, dènge dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, dhu tenge j'ara ho pamanahu yesus. ra tatae, tao-tao na neo puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa abhu j'ara ho galaa ne ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: but jesus knew what was in their minds. he told the man with the crippled hand, get up, and stand here in front of everyone. the man got up and stood there.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngangee rèngu. nèti èèna ka, na paroa dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, aku nèngu na, angalai! mai ku. titu ètu talora aae ne! hèia la'e titu dènge ka ètu talora èèna.

source_text: then jesus turned to them and said, let me ask you a question. is it legal to do good on the sabbath, or to do bad? to save life, or to destroy it?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, ja'a karèi ku miu laa. madhutu atora agama èdhi, ngaa dhu èdhi bisa tao ètu lod'o a'ae sasab'a? èdhi tao dhu be'a, do, tao dhu karehe? hia mamuri mi dhèu, do, pa'ele iie mamuri na?

source_text: he looked round at all of them there. then he said to the man, hold out your hand. the man did so, and his hand became like new.
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe palème rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na lii dènge dhèu dhu ai madhe cabèka ne, peka na, j'ole ai èu mai! ka na soro ai na, hèia èle dènge ka.

source_text: but they flew into a rage, and began to discuss what they could do to jesus.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka dhèu kapai se nasa titu kèna. hèia ra peka, na, èdhi tenge hari ku j'ara leo, sèna ka pamanahu ne!

source_text: one day shortly after, jesus went up a mountain to pray. he remained there all night, praying to god.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, yesus la'e sabaj'a asa ledhe èci. na sabaj'a ètu èèna camèd'a kateme.

source_text: when morning came he called together his disciples, and chose twelve of them. these are the names of the apostles:
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae, yesus paroa ana madhutu na. ka nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, hag'e nare canguru dua dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. dhèu dhu hag'e nare sèra, nuka:

source_text: simon also called peter by jesus, andrew his brother, james, john, philip, bartholomew,
target_text: simon dhu yesus pangare ne, ‘petrus' anderias ari simon, yakobis, yohanis ari yakobis, pelipus, bertolomeos,

source_text: matthew, thomas, james the son of alphaeus, simon the revolutionary,
target_text: mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, simon nèti partei politik selot,

source_text: judas the son of james, and judas iscariot who became a traitor.
target_text: yudas ana yakobis, aa yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahia yesus.

source_text: jesus went back down the mountain with them, and stopped at a place where there was some flat ground. there a crowd made up of his disciples and many other people from all over judea, jerusalem, and the sea coast of tyre and sidon, had gathered to listen to him and to be cured from their diseases.
target_text: ropa puru mai nèti ledhe deo na, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, ae taha ètu era mera èci. ètu èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu pakaboko. dhèu se mai nèti propensi yudea, nèti kota yerusalem, aa nèti tirus dènge sidon, nuka dua kota ètu sebhe dhasi.

source_text: those who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.
target_text: rèngu mai ho nanene lii padhai yesus, aa abhu kahèi dhu neo manèngi sèna ka na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ka yesus pa'èle si. na pa'èle kahèi dhèu dhu nidhu tao, dènge magèle eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: everyone in the crowd tried to touch him, because power was coming out from him and healing them all.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu neo goi ne. te ropa goi lèke ne, dhèu se èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra, lula abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti nèngu.

source_text: looking at his disciples, jesus told them,
target_text: èle ka yesus kabib'a asa ana madhutu na, hèia na aj'a si, aku nèngu na, dhèu unu aad'o sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula ama lamatua mesa na, j'aj'i dhèu aae miu dhu be'a.

source_text: how happy are you who are poor, for the kingdom of god is yours. how happy are you who are hungry now, for you will eat all you need. how happy are you who are weeping now, for you will laugh.
target_text: dhèu dhu kabake manganga sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula lamatua ka dhu hia miu bècu-manèsa. dhèu dhu tangi dènge d'ara susa sèra! miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na d'ara mi karej'e.

source_text: how happy are you when people hate you, exclude you, insult you, and curse your name as evil because of me, the son of man. when that day comes, be happy. jump for joy, for great is your reward in heaven. don't forget their forefathers mistreated the prophets just like this.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ka dhèu dhu abhu susa lula madhutu ja'a, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala rui-j'aj'èra miu ètu sorga. masi ka dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, do pakarehe kolongara miu, do j'èli marèu miu, do bata eele miu, tao sèmi dhèu bhelu sa, miu abhu a'oto, lula èèna na lamatua bhèlu boe miu ètu sorga. de ladhe dhèu paj'èra miu sèmi èèna, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu! aa karae laa dènge pasoa-pasoka! mage malaa kahèi, lula dhèu dhu paj'èra miu limuri ne, bèi-baki ra dhu uru èèna, paj'èra le dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra kahèi. de ladhe miu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi sèra, pakarej'e laa d'ara miu, lula èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu ae-ae ètu sorga!

source_text: but how sad are you who are rich, for you have already received your reward.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula mamuri karej'e miu, dhoka d'ai ne'e di.

source_text: how sad are you who are full now, for you will become hungry. how sad are you who laugh now, for you will mourn and cry.
target_text: dhèu dhu bècu-manèsa! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula hèru manganga madèu dhu seli eele, mai salake nare miu. dhèu dhu kea rae-rae sèra! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula j'aj'èra mai, tao miu tangi ngob'i-ngob'i.

source_text: how sad are you when everyone praises you. don't forget that their forefathers praised false prophets just like this.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi dhèu koa-kad'iri! miu abhu mamadhe-mamopo, lula uru sèra bèi-baki miu d'èi pad'iri kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu rèti lii leko-monya sèra!

source_text: but i say to those of you who are listening: love your enemies. do good to those who hate you.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! èu hud'i sue ku musu èu, aa tao pabe'a laa mi dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge èu.

source_text: bless those who curse you. pray for those who mistreat you.
target_text: sabaj'a ho manèngi ama lamatua, sèna ka hia babe'a mi dhèu dhu dhoo èu. aa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi dhèu dhu paj'èra èu rupa-rupa.

source_text: if someone hits you on one cheek, turn the other cheek. if someone takes your coat, don't prevent them taking your shirt.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tèb'e ripi èu cabèka, soro hari ripi cabèka ho na tèb'e. ladhe dhèu parame rare kodho pana èu, na, hia hari laa kodho èu dhu leo.

source_text: give to anyone who asks you. if someone takes something from you, don't ask for it back.
target_text: ladhe dhèu manèngi mèdha èu èci, hia laa. aa ladhe dhèu ded'e rèti mèdha èu èci, soro tèke sène. mage mu manèngi hari!

source_text: do to others what you want them to do to you.
target_text: èu hud'i tao ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu neo dhèu tao mi ngi'u èu.

source_text: if you love those who love you, why should you deserve any credit for that? even sinners love those who love them.
target_text: èu d'èi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu èu mesa mu. èèna be'a. te ngaa kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu sue dhèu rèngu kahèi.

source_text: if you do good to those who do good to you, why should you deserve any credit for that either? sinners do that as well.
target_text: ladhe èu pabe'a dhoka dènge dhèu dhu be'a dènge èu di, kolo-karisi ètu mia? te dhèu bhelu sèra, re'a b'ala babe'a dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: if you lend money expecting to be repaid, why should you deserve any credit for that? sinners lend money to other sinners as well, expecting to be repaid what they loaned.
target_text: ladhe èu dhodhoka hia pija mi dhèu dhu bisa pula hari doi èu, kolo-karisi na ngaa? te dhèu bhelu kahèi re'a hia dhèu leo pija doi, sad'i bèli-camèd'a sèmi aa'i hari dhu kateme iisi.

source_text: no: love your enemies, do good to them, and lend without expecting to be repaid anything. then you will receive a great reward, and you will be children of the most high god, for he is kind to ungrateful and wicked people.
target_text: te ngaa dhu lèke ka, sèmi ne'e: sue la musu èu sèra! aa tao la be'a mi rèngu. ngaa dhu ra parluu, hia si pija. baku pangee, na, ra pula hari do aad'o. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na ama lamatua b'ala èu. pe èu j'aj'i ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele. lula mamuri èu sama sèmi ama mu, dhu d'èi ad'u-ue j'ara hua iia hia dhèu bhelu. nèngu d'èi kahèi tao j'ara hua iia hia dhèu dhu re'a boe manèngi makasi.

source_text: be compassionate, just as your father is compassionate.
target_text: de èu hud'i pad'elo ku kasia mi dhèu, nuka sèmi ama mu ètu sorga dhu pad'elo kasia na mi èu.

source_text: don't judge, and you won't be judged; don't condemn, and you won't be condemned; forgive, and you'll be forgiven;
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii aj'a na, peka na, baku lee dhèu, sèna ka dhèu baku lee hari èu. baku kahèti leli lii padhai dhèu, te aad'o na dhèu tao hari èu sèmi èèna kahèi. pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, sèna ka rèngu baku nui sasala èu.

source_text: give, and you will be given generously in return. when what you're given is measured out, it's pressed down so more can be added, spilling out over the top, pouring into your lap! for how much you give will determine how much you receive.
target_text: ladhe èu hia dhèu ngaa dhu ra parluu, pe èu abhu hari. te bèli-camèd'a ra hia hari èu pènu ai. èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu isi kab'ui asa d'ara balee a'uku, ka ra karèko ne, aa cèci ne, toke bua lale eele. dhu èu abhu, sama èci èèna ka. ladhe èu hia ciki, èu abhu hari ciki kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èu hia ae, èu abhu hari ae-ae.

source_text: then he illustrated the point: can a blind person lead another? wouldn't they both fall into a ditch?
target_text: yesus aj'a pake lii upama kahèi. na lole, peka na, dhèu bèdhu bisa boe pad'elo j'ara hia dhèu bèdhu dhu leo. te aad'o na, dua ra manahu asa d'ara ro'a lasi!

source_text: do students know more than the teacher? only when they've learned everything: then they will be like their teacher.
target_text: ana sakola bisa boe mèu risi nèti mese na! te ngaa ladhe na madhutu dènge be'a lii a'aj'a mese na, nèngu bisa j'aj'i sama sèmi mese na.

source_text: why are you so worried about the speck that's in your brother's eye when you don't even notice the plank that's in your own eye?
target_text: èu pa'èki more sasala dhèu, masi ka ana iiki-iiki èèna ka. te ngaa sasala èu dhu kapai, èu sèmi pame'a boe sa. èèna, nuka sèmi èu mèdhi ahu ca katèd'a ètu musi madha dhèu. masi ka agarii aae dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu, te ngaa èu oe sèmi pame'a boe sa!

source_text: how can you say to your brother, ‘brother, let me take out the speck that's in your eye, ' when you don't even see the plank that's in your own eye? hypocrite! take out the plank from your own eye first, and then you'll be able to see well enough to take out the speck from your brother's eye.
target_text: tasamia ka èu bani peka dènge angalai mu, na, ‘mai, ho ja'a tiu eele ahu nèti d'ara madha èu. ' te ngaa èu mesa mu bisa boe ladhe mèdhi ngaa-ngaa, te agarii dhu pa'abhe nare musi madha èu! weeh! èu ne, mema dhèu kapod'e-kabèli! tao eele uru ku agarii nèti d'ara madha èu, heka èu ladhe mèdhi, ho tiu eele ahu ca katèd'a èèna, nèti d'ara madha angalai mu.

source_text: a good tree doesn't produce bad fruit, and a bad tree doesn't produce good fruit.
target_text: ka yesus tabha lii pakasame èci hari, peka na, abhu ètu mia, aj'u be'a, ladhe d'ai lod'o hua, hua na karehe. aa abhu boe ladhe aj'u karehe na hua, hua na be'a.

source_text: you recognize a tree by the fruit it produces. you don't pick figs from thorn bushes, or harvest grapes from brambles.
target_text: dhèu bisa tadhe ladhe aj'u ca kapua, be'a do aad'o, mai nèti hua na. dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, peka na, ètu mia dhèu puu lolobhangi, do, hua anggor nèti aj'u padhudhu.

source_text: good people produce what's good from the good things they value that they have stored inside them. bad people produce what's bad from the bad things they have stored inside them. what fills people's minds spills out in what they say.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, ne'a tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'ara kaj'alu, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu-katub'a. te nèti lii padhai na, èdhi bisa tadhe babe'a-karehe dhèu.

source_text: so why do you bother to call me, ‘lord, lord, ' when you don't do what i say?
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, miu se loe boe paroa ja'a, na, ‘lamatua'. te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe tao madhutu lii padhai ja'a?

source_text: i'll give you an example of someone who comes to me, hears my instructions, and follows them.
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nanene lii padhai ja'a, ho na tao madhutu, nèngu ne èci èèna ka

source_text: that person is like a man building a house. he digs down deep and lays the foundations on solid rock. when the river bursts its banks and the floodwater breaks against the house it's not damaged because it's built so well.
target_text: dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu dhu èra. na kèi ro'a fanderen toke abhu hadhu. hèia na padhèdi fanderen, heka na patitu èmu kèna. ladhe èi aae lala, èmu ne gaged'o boe sa hèi, lula era padhèdi na èra.

source_text: the person who hears me but doesn't do what i say is like a man who builds a house without foundations. when the floodwater breaks against the house it collapses immediately-it's completely destroyed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nanene dènge d'ara kajari, aa madhutu boe lii padhai ja'a, nèngu ne èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu neo patitu èmu sad'i j'aj'i di. na tao boe fanderen, te ngaa na patitu èmu na ètu dedha rai ètu sebhe loko. hèia ropa èi aae lala, èmu na guri laho mae-mae!

source_text: when he'd finished speaking to the people, jesus left for capernaum.
target_text: ropa aj'a nare, ka yesus lèpa asa kota kapernaum.

source_text: a centurion lived there who had a servant he greatly valued who was sick and was about to die.
target_text: ca dhèu komedhaa sordad'u roma pea ètu ne'e. abhu dhèu sab'a na èci dhu nèngu parcaya. dhèu sab'a ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: when he heard about jesus, the centurion sent some jewish elders to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.
target_text: lod'o èèna, komedhaa tadèngi le tatao yesus, hèia na pua dhèu heka yahudi pèri-pèri lasi manèngi yesus mai puri dhèu sab'a ne.

source_text: when the elders came to jesus, they pleaded with him strongly, saying, please come and do what he asks. he deserves your help,
target_text: d'ai nèi, ra pamako yesus, sèna ka na la'e palere dènge rèngu. ra manèngi, peka na, dhèu roma ne, dhèu be'a! ama hud'i tolong ne.

source_text: because he loves our people and he built a synagogue for us.
target_text: te nèngu ka patitu èmu sabaj'a cue hia ji'i, lula na sue èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: jesus went with them and as they approached the house, the centurion sent some friends to jesus to tell him, lord, please don't trouble yourself by coming into my house, because i'm not worthy of that.
target_text: ka yesus madhutu dènge si. rèngu dhae rare mèka èmu, te ngaa komedhaa ne pua le angalai na la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama roca ia ka mai asa d'ara èmu ja'a, te ja'a nia boe sèmi ama asa d'ara èmu ja'a.

source_text: i didn't even think that i was worthy to come and see you. just give the command, and my servant will be healed. for i'm under the authority of my superior officers, and i have soldiers under my authority too. i command one to go and he goes, another to come and he comes. i command my servant to do something and he does it.
target_text: aa ja'a nia boe kahèi ara dhiu asa katanga madha ama. ja'a ke'a ama dènge koasa. de sad'i ama padhai lii nèti èèna, tatu dhèu sab'a ja'a ne èle dènge nèti papèd'a na. ja'a ke'a j'ara ne'e ne, lula ja'a dènge dhèu paredha dedha kahèi, dhu dènge koasa ho paredha ja'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi ho paredha sordad'u ja'a. ladhe ja'a hia paredha mi sordad'u ja'a, peka na, ‘lamu sa nèi! ' tatu la'e dènge. aa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘mai sa ne'e' tatu na mai. aa ladhe ja'a pua dhèu sab'a ja'a, ‘sab'a ne'e' tatu na sab'a madhutu kahèi. de sad'i ama padhai lii di, dhèu sab'a ja'a ne, èle dènge.

source_text: when jesus heard this he was astounded. he turned to the crowd that was following him, and said, i tell you, i haven't found trust like this even in israel.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, yesus malaa. ka na kabib'a sa dhèu ae dhu madhutu na sèra, hèia na peka, nia kahèi nga! nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a paraga kèdhi mèka dènge dhèu yahudi dhu lèka èra sama sèmi dhèu roma ne!

source_text: then the centurion's friends returned to the house and found the servant in good health.
target_text: de yesus d'ai dhoka era èèna di. hèia angalai komedhaa se lèpa. ropa d'ai èmu komedhaa, ladhe na, dhèu sab'a ne èle le nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: soon after jesus went to a town called nain, accompanied by his disciples and a large crowd.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, pakèd'i lasi asa rae èci, ngara na nain. dhèu ae kako palere dènge ne.

source_text: as he approached the town gate a funeral procession was coming the other way. the man who had died was the only son of a widow, and a sizeable crowd from the town was with her.
target_text: ropa rèngu oe dètu dènge hèb'a tedhe maso asa rae ne, ra paraga dènge dhèu ca nau lasi padhane dhèu madhe. dhèu madhe ne, ana mone mesa nèti ca dhèu bhèni balu.

source_text: when the lord saw her he was filled with compassion for her. don't cry, he told her.
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi bhèni balu ne, ka d'ara na roe. hèia na lii dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, ina! tangi ia ka!

source_text: jesus went over to the coffin and touched it, and the pall-bearers stopped. jesus said, young man, i tell you, get up.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e padètu-dètu, ka na g'ag'e karad'a dhèu madhe ne. ka dhèu dhu pasae karad'a ne titu taha. hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu madhe, aku nèngu na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: the dead man sat up and began to talk, and jesus gave him back to his mother.
target_text: ka ana ne mamuri hari, hèia na kèd'i madhèdi. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii dènge dhèu ae dhu titu reo rare ne. aa yesus peka dènge bhèni balu ne, aku nèngu na, ina! ana mu ka ne'e.

source_text: a sense of awe filled everyone there and they praised god, saying, a great prophet has arisen among us, and god has visited his people.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra madha'u titu kèna! ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ama lamatua pua le ca dhèu na dhu kapai risi, dhu nèti lii padhai na hia èdhi! abhu hari dhu leo, peka na, ama lamatua mai le ètu talora aae èdhi, ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na!

source_text: news about jesus spread throughout judea, and all around.
target_text: hèia lii lolo ne, ra palolo d'ai mia-mia ètu propensi yudea dènge era leo kahèi.

source_text: the disciples of john told john about all this. john called two of his disciples and told them to go and see jesus, and ask, are you the one we've been expecting, or should we wait for someone else? when they came to jesus, they said, john the baptist sent us to you, to ask you, ‘are you the one we've been expecting or should we wait for someone else? '
target_text: ana madhutu yohanis tadèngi aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu yesus ad'u-ue. ka lasi lole dènge yohanis ètu d'ara bèdho. hèia na pua dhèu dua lasi, ho karèi ne, peka na, ama ne tare'a-re'a kristus dhu ji'i mate tae-tae, do? do, ji'i mate hari ku dhèu leo? èle ka ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: at that very moment jesus was healing many people of their diseases, illnesses, evil spirits, and making the blind to see.
target_text: lod'o ana madhutu yohanis se ètu èèna, yesus puri-pa'èle dhèu ae nèti papèd'a ra. na bata eele nidhu nèti dhèu. aa na pa'èle dhèu bèdhu, ka rèdhi hari.

source_text: jesus answered john's disciples, go and tell john what you've seen and heard. the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers cured, the deaf hear, the dead raised back to life, the poor are told the good news.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, lèpa ka ho mi peka dènge a'a ku yohanis, aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi dènge mèdhi unu mi, sèmi dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, ‘dhèu bèdhu rèdhi hari. dhèu karuku, kèd'i ho kako hari. dhèu pèd'a kusta, isi ra milu hari. dhèu katele-katipa, tadèngi hari. dhèu madhe, mamuri hari. dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, nanene lii lolo be'a. '

source_text: how good it is for those who are not offended because of me!
target_text: lami ho peka kahèi dènge a'a ku yohanis, na, ‘dhèu dhu makae boe sèmi rare ja'a, rèngu abhu a'oto. '

source_text: after the messengers from john had left, jesus began telling the crowd, about john: what did you expect to see when you went out to meet him in the desert? some reed blown about by the wind?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis se lèpa, hèia yesus peka dènge dhèu ae sèra lula-nèti yohanis, na, lod'o miu lami tenge yohanis ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a èèna, miu pangee, na, paraga dènge dhèu dhu lalole na sèmi ngaa? tatu miu lami boe ho paraga dènge dhèu dhu roe aai-roe èèla, nuka sèmi kalai èèu dhu bhabheu madhutu lai ngèlu di!

source_text: did you come looking for a man dressed in fine clothes? no, those who have stylish clothes and live in luxury are found in palaces.
target_text: tatu lami boe ho ladhe dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae, te dhèu sèmi èèna, era pea na dhodhoka ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae di!

source_text: were you looking for a prophet? yes he is, and i'm telling you, he's much more than a prophet.
target_text: de miu lami tenge dhèu cee ètu nèi? miu pangee na lami tenge dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, do? tare'a! te nèngu risi nèti ca dhèu nèti padhai lii lamatua.

source_text: it was written about him in scripture: ‘look, i'm sending my messenger to go before you to prepare your way. '
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke le, na, ‘nanene! ja'a pua dhèu ja'a, sèna ka bhoke j'ara hia èu. '

source_text: i tell you, no one born of women is greater than john, but even the most unimportant person in god's kingdom is greater than he is!
target_text: ètu rai-haha ne, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kapai risi nèti yohanis. te ngaa dhèu dhu ana iiki-iiki ètu talora aae dhèu unu ama lamatua, kapai risi nèti yohanis.

source_text: when they heard him, all of them-even the tax collectors-followed what god said was good and right, for they had been baptized by john.
target_text: dhèu dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu re'a le, peka na, j'ara lamatua èèna, j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu roro bea sèra. lula rèngu uru èèna abhu sarani aa nanene kahèi lii aj'a-nori nèti yohanis.

source_text: but the pharisees and the religious teachers rejected what god wanted them to do, for they had refused to be baptized by john.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu nèti partei agama parisi dènge dhèu d'èlu-mèu atora agama yahudi sèra, ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ra manèngi boe yohanis sarani si.

source_text: what shall i compare these people to? asked jesus. what are they like?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, ja'a pakasame dhèu-dhèu taa limuri se'e dènge ngaa? dhèu sèmi ngaa ka see?

source_text: they're like children sitting in the market who tell one another, ‘we played the flute for you but you didn't dance; we sang sad songs but you didn't cry. '
target_text: rèngu se, èci èèna ka dènge ana-ana dhu madhèdi ètu d'ara pasa. ra re'a dhoka pa'oo-parodha dènge ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi tiu sakino, te ngaa miu roge boe dènge karej'e. aa ji'i sod'a lii beke dhèu madhe, te ngaa miu tangi boe. '

source_text: when john the baptist came he didn't eat bread or drink wine, but you say he's demon-possessed.
target_text: te, yohanis tuka sarani ninu boe èi anggor, aa na d'èi puasa, miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘nèngu ne nidhu tao! '

source_text: now the son of man is here, and eats and drinks with people, but you say, ‘look, he spends his time eating too much food and drinking too much wine. plus he's a friend of tax collectors and sinners. '
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, tema kinu èi anggor dènge ku'a roti. ka miu ka'uu-kamuki, peka na, ‘dhèu ne, dhèu gagoo-gagehu! aa tema mahu! pa'angalai dènge dhèu roro bea! aa partei èci dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe! dhu ne'a heka ngi'u na! '

source_text: however, god's wise ways are proved right by all who follow him!
target_text: te ngaa mi patadhe lii ja'a ne! dhèu dhu re'a mèu, tatu rèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: one of the pharisees invited jesus to come and eat with him. jesus went to the pharisee's house and sat down to eat the meal.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota ne, abhu dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na simon. ca lod'o, na nèru yesus si mai ra'a asa èmu nèngu. hèia yesus si lasi madhèdi, ka neo ra'a.

source_text: a woman who was a sinner in that town found out that jesus was eating in the pharisee's house. she went there, carrying an alabaster jar of perfume.
target_text: lod'o èèna, bhèni kajeo ca dhèu tadèngi kahèi, na, yesus si neo ra'a-rinu ètu èèna. ka na maso la'e, nèd'u dènge èi hèu mèngi ca boto dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: she kneeled beside jesus and with her tears wet his feet, and dried them with her hair. she kissed his feet, and then she poured the perfume over them.
target_text: na mai padètu dènge yesus re kabodho na. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na ètu haga yesus. na tangi d'ara pèd'a dènge roma iisi, toke èi madha na hae lèke haga yesus. ka na seka haga yesus pake rèu kètu na, aa na loe boe uu haga yesus kahèi. èle ka, na pasuti èi hèu mèngi èèna mi haga yesus.

source_text: when the pharisee who had invited jesus saw this he said to himself, if this man was really a prophet he would know who this woman was who's touching him, and what kind of person she was-that she's a sinner!
target_text: simon ne'a mèu j'ara mamuri bhèni ne. nèti èèna ka, na pajiko ètu d'ara na, ne'e j'aj'i mi tadha, na, yesus ne, dhèu dhu nèti boe lii padhai ama lamatua! ladhe tare'a-re'a ama lamatua ka dhu pua ne mai, tatu nèngu ne'a, na, bhèni dhu g'ag'e nèngu ne, bhèni kajeo. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua, sèmi boe nèngu ne, lula dhèu mola-mèci bisa boe padètu dènge dhèu kaj'alu!

source_text: jesus spoke up and said, simon, i have something to tell you. tell me, teacher, he responded.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a ngaa dhu simon ngee. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, simon! sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo peka dènge èu ca j'ara. hèia simon dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama mese, peka laa.

source_text: once two people were in debt to a money-lender. one owed five hundred denarii, the other only fifty.
target_text: ka yesus core lii, peka na, abhu ca dhèu dhu tema hia dhèu pija doi na. uru èèna, na hia nèdhi dhèu dua pija doi na. dhèu èci, abhu lèmi ngasu doi iia, aa ca dhèu hari lèmi nguru di.

source_text: neither of them could repay him, so he forgave the debts. which one will love him the most?
target_text: te ngaa d'ai lod'o pula doi se'e, dua ra bisa boe b'ae rare. ka dhèu dhu hia pija, rasa kasia mi rèngu dua ra. nèti èèna ka, na peka mi dua ra, sèna ka b'ae ia ka kèlu ra sèra. de madhutu èu, nèti dhèu dua se, cee ka dhu sue risi dhèu tema hia dhèu pija doi ne?

source_text: the one he forgave the most, i would think, simon answered. you're absolutely right, said jesus.
target_text: ètu d'ara ciki oo'e na kahèi, simon dhaa, peka na, tatu dhèu dhu kèlu na ae risi! ka yesus dhaa, na, mema tare'a!

source_text: turning to the woman, he said to simon, you see this woman? when i came into your house, you didn't give me water to wash my feet. but she has washed my feet with her tears, and wiped them with her hair.
target_text: ka yesus ladhe bhèni ne, hèia na peka dènge simon, aku nèngu na, èu ladhe sèku bhèni ne. deo na ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu tèke boe èi sèna ka rase haga ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa bhèni ne pabasa haga ja'a dènge èi madha na, ka na seka pake rèu kètu na.

source_text: you didn't give me a kiss, but since i came in she hasn't stopped kissing my feet.
target_text: aa ropa èu soru ja'a maso asa d'ara èmu èu, èu uu boe ja'a, madhutu ad'a èdhi. te ngaa karèi nèti ja'a ètu d'ara èmu èu, bhèni ne loe boe uu haga ja'a.

source_text: you didn't anoint my head with oil, but she poured perfume over my feet.
target_text: èu bhèlu eele ad'a dhu palona èi hèu mèngi mi kètu tamu, ropa ja'a mai deo na. te ngaa bhèni ne bhori le èi hèu mèngi dhu kab'ua titu kèna mi haga ja'a.

source_text: so i tell you, her many sins have been forgiven-that's why she loves so much. but whoever is forgiven little, only loves a little.
target_text: èu nanene paie! sasala bhèni ne, mema ae. te ngaa lamatua saku eele aa'i le, lula na pad'elo le sasue na dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ja'a. te ngaa bagi dhèu dhu rasa na tao boe sasala ae, nèngu ngee na parluu boe abhu abho ae kahèi. nèti èèna ka, nèngu ne'a boe sue aa ne'a boe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: then jesus said to the woman, your sins have been forgiven.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge bhèni ne, peka na, ja'a saku eele le sasala èu aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: those who were sitting eating with him began talking among themselves, saying, who is this who even forgives sins?
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ra'a palere-lere, paka'uu, aku rèngu na, huuh! na ngee na, nèngu ne cee? ! na bani titu kèna saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! j'ara ne'e ne dhodhoka ama lamatua mesa na, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu!

source_text: but jesus told the woman, your trust has saved you, go in peace.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu lèka le ja'a, nèti èèna ka lamatua hia le èu mamuri. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: soon after this jesus went around the towns and villages announcing the good news of god's kingdom. the twelve disciples went with him,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, kako palème kota-kota dènge rae-rae ètu sèra. la'e lolo dènge dhèu dad'èi ama lamatua. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a hia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: along with a number of women who had been healed from evil spirits and sickness: mary called magdalene from whom he had cast out seven demons;
target_text: ètu d'ara kaboko rèngu, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu bhèni dhu madhutu. bhèni se dhu uru èèna abhu rupa-rupa papèd'a, aa cahag'e dhu nidhu tao. te ngaa yesus ka dhu puri-pa'èle aa'i si. nuka sèmi maria nèti rae magdala, dhu uru èèna, yesus bata eele pidhu nidhu nèti nèngu.

source_text: joanna, the wife of herod's manager chuza; susanna; and many more who provided support from their personal resources.
target_text: abhu kahèi susana, dènge mama yohana. yohana ne, dhèu èmu kusa. kusa ne, kapala urusan nèti èmu dhèu aae herodes. aa abhu ae kahèi bhèni leo dhu lasi palere-lere dènge yesus si. bhèni se pake doi-dhari rèngu mesa ra ho ogo yesus si ètu j'ara.

source_text: once when a large crowd of people gathered, coming from many towns to see him, jesus spoke to them, using a story as an illustration.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu mai nèti rae-rae ho tenge yesus. ropa dhèu ae se pakaboko, hèia na lolo dènge ra pake lii pakasame èci, aku nèngu na,

source_text: a farmer went out to sow his seed. as he scattered the seed, some fell on the road where people trampled on it and birds ate it up.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu la'e ceb'e hini asa d'ara oka na. hini se cahag'e lèke ètu j'ara. ropa dhèu kako re èèna, j'èli lèke hini se. aa manu-bhui mai ka tutu ra'e aa'i.

source_text: some fell on stony ground, and once the seeds had sprouted they withered for lack of moisture.
target_text: hini cahag'e, lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini se muri, te ngaa nèbhu boe hèia kamale dhae-dhae, lula èi kura.

source_text: some seeds fell among thorns and as they both grew the thorns choked the plants.
target_text: hini cahag'e hari lèke ètu era aj'u padhudhu. te ngaa ropa hini muri, aj'u padhudhu hèlu pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: some seeds fell on good earth and after they grew they produced a harvest one hundred times more than what had been sown. after he told them this, he called out, if you have ears, then listen!
target_text: aa hini dhu leo lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini se muri dènge sega, toke kapai ka hua. hua ae titu kèna, d'ai cangasu hari. lolo èle ka, yesus pa'èle lii pakasame ne, dènge lii dhu mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu dhu pasa dhilu, na, ngee paie-iie!

source_text: but his disciples asked him, what does this illustration mean?
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: jesus replied, you've been given insights into the mysteries of god's kingdom, but the rest are given illustrations so that, ‘even though they see, they don't really see; and even though they hear, they don't really understand. '
target_text: na dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! lula miu se d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka ja'a peka paled'a, ho miu me'a tasamia lamatua neo paredha dhèu unu na. te ngaa dhèu leo ro'o boe pare'a dènge dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, ja'a aj'a-nori si pake lii pakasame di. te dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘rèngu se rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe sèmi. '

source_text: this is the meaning of the illustration: the seed is god's word.
target_text: hèia yesus peka sasoa nèti lii pakasame ne, aku nèngu na, hini se, nuka lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: the seeds that fall on the road are those who hear the message, but then the devil comes and steals away the truth from their minds so they won't trust in god and be saved.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu j'ara, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu aae nidhu mai parame nare nèti d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu parcaya boe lamatua, aa abhu boe mamuri.

source_text: the seeds that fall on the stony ground are those who hear and welcome the message with joy but don't have any roots. they trust for a while but when difficult times come they give up.
target_text: hini dhu lèke dedha hadhu, nuka dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge d'ara karej'e. te ngaa amo na marèma boe. rèngu parcaya, te ngaa ropa paraga dènge j'aj'èra, rèngu manahu.

source_text: the seeds that fall among thorns are those who hear the message but it's choked out by life's distractions-worries, wealth, pleasure-so they don't produce anything.
target_text: hini dhu lèke era aj'u padhudhu, nuka dhèu dhu tadèngi, ka ra sèmi rare lii lolo be'a. te ngaa nare nèbhu boe, ka rèngu bhèlu eele lii lolo be'a, lula rèngu bhute dènge laladhe sasab'a-la'a rèngu, mèdha-panyau rèngu, aa dènge neo mamuri karej'e di. nèti èèna ka, parcaya rèngu dènge boe kab'ua ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: the seeds sown on good earth are those who are honest and do what is right. they hear the message of truth, hold on to it, and through their perseverance produce a good harvest.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka dhèu dhu mamuri mola dènge d'ara hua iia. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, rèngu sèle asa d'ara rèngu. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu parcaya taa-taa, aa ad'u-ue j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: you don't light a lamp and then cover it with a bucket, or hide it under a bed. no, you put it on a stand, so that anyone who comes in can see the light.
target_text: ka yesus peka hari, na, abhu ètu mia, dhèu paheo rare labhu iiki, ho èèna na saguru dènge èru rai. aa abhu ètu mia, dhèu tao labhu ètu ro'a koi. te ladhe tao sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe rèdhi heo na. labhu dhu guna, nuka padhèdi ètu era dedha, sèna ka heo na bisa pasaraa dhèu dhu maso mai.

source_text: for there's nothing hidden that won't be revealed; there's nothing secret that won't become known and obvious.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu pahuni limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a pasabhoka. aa madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu dhèu re'a boe limuri ne, èèna na dhèu bisa re'a mèu.

source_text: so pay attention how you ‘hear. ' to those who have received, more will be given; from those who don't receive, even what they think they have will be taken away!
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee paie-iie ku j'ara se'e. dhèu dhu neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa rèngu dhu pusi pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, rèngu asa goa.

source_text: then jesus' mother and brothers arrived, but they couldn't get through the crowd to see him.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus bhute dènge dhèu ae. hèia ina dènge ari na mai neo paraga dènge ne. te ngaa ra bisa boe lasi padètu, lula dhèu se, ae titu kèna.

source_text: jesus was told, your mother and your brothers are outside. they want to see you.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu la'e peka dènge yesus, na, ama! ina dènge ari ama, ètu li'u sèi. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: my mother and my brothers are those who hear god's word, and do what it says, jesus replied.
target_text: ka na dhaa, peka na, oo! te ngaa sèmi ne'e. ina dènge a'ari ja'a, nuka rèngu dhu tare'a-re'a d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, aa tao madhutu.

source_text: one day jesus said to his disciples, let's cross over to the other side of the lake. so they got into a boat and set off.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus gale dhèu pajuu-paleha na, aku nèngu na, mai lati ka asa cabèka dano. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia pakèd'i lasi.

source_text: as they were sailing, jesus fell asleep, and a storm came down on the lake. the boat began filling with water and they were in danger of sinking.
target_text: ropa rèngu ètu talora dano, yesus bhèj'i. nèbhu boe cag'ag'a laa, ngèlu aae mai. naha tèb'e koha, hèia èi maso sa d'ara, ka oe molo.

source_text: they went over to jesus and woke him up. master, master, we're going to drown! they said. jesus woke up and commanded the wind and the rough waves to stop. they stopped, and all was calm.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ana madhutu se parèi ne, peka na, ama! ama! kèd'i ho tolong ku laa! te èdhi madhe aa'i kèna! ka yesus kèd'i. hèia na kai ngèlu dènge naha, peka na, mau ka! kaca'a laa, ngèlu dènge naha mau dènge ka.

source_text: where is your trust? he asked them. terrified and amazed, they said to each other, so who is this? he gives commands to the winds and the water, and they obey him!
target_text: hèia na pasanèd'e ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu parcaya mèka ja'a? rèngu madha'u dènge malaa, ka ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, cee ka yesus ne? tasamia ka nèngu bisa paredha ngèlu dènge naha, ka ra madhutu dad'èi na?

source_text: they sailed across to the gerasene region that lies opposite galilee.
target_text: nèbhu boe rèngu d'ai rai garasa, ètu sebhe dano galilea.

source_text: when jesus stepped out of the boat onto the shore, a demon-possessed man from the town came to meet him. for a long time he hadn't worn any clothes or lived in a house. he lived in the tombs. when he saw jesus he screamed, fell down at jesus' feet, and asked in a loud voice, what do you want with me, jesus, son of the most high god? please don't torture me, i beg you! for jesus had already commanded the evil spirit to leave the man. it had often seized him, and despite being tied down with chains and shackles, and placed under guard, he would break the chains apart and would be driven by the demon into the desert areas.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu èci dhu nèbhu ae le, nidhu ae pahuj'u ne. dhèu ne dènge boe èmu, ka na pea ètu era ro'a dhèu madhe. bèli-bèli èèna kako la'e-mai, dhu pake boe mèdha-papake. te nidhu sèra loe boe paredha ne. dhèu dhu èki le pèri-pèri hari dènge rate aa pakanau ne dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na lèku èta si. ka nidhu se laka-seti ne ho la'e asa era dhu kaliu. ropa yesus si puru nèti dedha koha, ka dhèu huj'u ne mai asa yesus. hèia na pa'oo-parodha. ka na pabèbhe iisi, aa na patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga yesus. hèia yesus paredha nidhu sèra, aku nèngu na, ee, nidhu! rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e! hèia dhèu huj'u ne pa'oo, peka na, baku gagu ja'a! te ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele! èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: what is your name? jesus asked him. legion, he replied, for many demons had entered him.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? hèia nidhu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, legion, te ji'i se ae, sèmi sordad'u riho-riho. na lii sèmi èèna, lula nidhu se ae-ae dhu maso ètu d'ara ngi'u dhèu èèna.

source_text: they begged jesus not to order them to go into the abyss.
target_text: nidhu se loe boe pamako yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu lasi asa d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra, nuka era taha koasa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: there was a large herd of pigs feeding on the nearby hillside, and the demons begged him to be allowed to go into the pigs. jesus gave them permission,
target_text: te ngaa dhu padètu ètu èèna, hahi canau kateme dhu nyuu rai ètu sebhe ledhe. ka nidhu se manèngi yesus, peka na, pua la ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèi! hèia yesus d'èi kahèi.

source_text: so the demons left the man and entered the pigs. the herd rushed down the steep slope into the lake and drowned.
target_text: ka nidhu se kalua ka nèti d'ara dhèu mone ne, lasi maso asa hahi. hahi se aa'i-aa'i ra huj'u, ka ra rai paj'ala puru nèti sebhe ledhe ne, hèia caroco asa d'ara dano. aa cène, ka madhe aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: when the pig-keepers saw what had happened they ran off and spread the news through the town and the countryside.
target_text: ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu madhenge hahi se, rai lasi palème rae-rae ètu sèra, lolo aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu j'aj'i.

source_text: the people went out to see what had happened. when they came to jesus they found the man freed from the demons. he was sitting there at jesus' feet, wearing clothes and in his right mind; and they became scared.
target_text: ropa dhèu ètu rae se tadèngi lii lolo se, ka lasi ae-ae sèna ka neo rèdhi unu ra tatao dhu j'aj'i le. d'ai era èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi mau-mau padètu ètu haga yesus. nèngu pake le mèdha-papake, aa na huj'u heka. ladhe rèdhi sèmi ne'e, ka aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i madha'u.

source_text: those who had seen what happened explained how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne, ra palolo dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu heka mai sèra, tasamia ka dhèu huj'u ne èle nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: then all the people from the gerasene region asked jesus to leave because they were overwhelmed by fear. so he got into the boat and went back.
target_text: ka dhèu garasa aa'i-aa'i ra manèngi yesus ho tèke eele rai rèngu, te rèngu madha'u titu kèna. hèia yesus si ca'e lasi asa dedha koha, sèna ka lèpa hari asa cabèka dano galilea.

source_text: the man who had been freed from the demons begged to go with him, but jesus sent him away.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu deo na dhu nidhu tao, loe boe pamako yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! hud'i laa ja'a madhutu ama kahèi! te ngaa yesus dhaa ne, peka na,

source_text: go back home, and tell people all that god has done for you, jesus told him. so he went away, telling the whole town all that jesus had done for him.
target_text: sèmi ne'e ku laa! be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa a'ari èu. lamu lolo aa'i dènge ra, na, ama lamatua tao le j'ara dhu be'a hia èu. hèia dhèu ne kako palème d'ara kota ne, na palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, yesus ka dhu pa'èle nèngu.

source_text: a crowd of people was there to welcome jesus when he returned, all eagerly expecting him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano galilea. lod'o rèngu puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae dhu mate mema le yesus. dhèu se mai ae-ae ho soru ne.

source_text: one was a man called jairus, a synagogue leader, who came and fell at jesus' feet. he pleaded with jesus to come to his home because his only daughter was dying. she was about twelve years old. while jesus was on his way there, people were crowding around him.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu ca dhèu, ngara na yairus. nèngu kapala èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. ana na dhoka ca dhèu di; ana bhèni, umur na canguru dua tèu. ana bhèni ne dhu pèd'a aae, oe madhe. ropa yairus nèdhi yesus mai, hèia la'e patitu kètu urutuu na ètu madha yesus. na manèngi ho yesus dhuli èmu na, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ana na. dhaa nare ka, yesus madhutu dènge ne asa èmu na. aa dhèu ae madhutu rèngu. ka rèngu paseti èci dènge èci.

source_text: in the crowd was a woman who had suffered with bleeding for twelve years. she had spent all she had on doctors, but none of them had been able to help her.
target_text: abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kako dènge rèngu. bhèni ne dhu lèke papèd'a dhèu bhèni dhu loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna. doi-dhari dènge mèdha-panyau na èle aa'i le, ho b'ae dote-matarii. te ngaa abhu boe dhu bisa puri-pa'èle ne. papèd'a na asa na hoe.

source_text: she approached jesus from behind and touched the hem of his cloak. immediately the bleeding stopped.
target_text: ka na ara padètu-dètu asa yesus nèti kabodho. hèia na gai lèke suu kodho yesus. ropa na gai lèke kodho yesus ne, hèia papèd'a na èle dènge ka.

source_text: who touched me? jesus asked. everybody around denied doing so. but master, said peter, there are people crowding around you, and they keep pushing up against you.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, yesus titu taha. hèia na karèi, peka na, cee ka dhu goi lèke ja'a? te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mangaku. ka petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama! dhèu ae-ae ka dhu tao paseti aa patule-pajuku nèti kabodho. sèmi ne'e ne, te'a na cee ka dhu goi lèke ama!

source_text: someone touched me, jesus replied. i know because power went out from me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ne, aad'o! deo na ja'a rasa abhu koasa dhu kalua nèti ngi'u ja'a. de ja'a ke'a, na, ca dhèu dhu sangaja gai ja'a.

source_text: when the woman realized she couldn't go unnoticed, she came forward, trembling, and fell down before him. right in front of everybody she explained the reason why she had touched jesus, and that she'd been cured immediately.
target_text: ropa bhèni ne ne'a, na, nèngu bisa boe pasili, hèia na madha'u titu kèna. isi na rèbha-rèbha, ka la'e patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. hèia na lolo mi dhèu ae sèra, nga tao ka nèngu gai yesus. aa na lolo kahèi, na, ropa nèngu gai lèke yesus, nèngu èle dènge nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: jesus said to her, daughter, your trust has healed you, go in peace.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, ana hèni! èu èle nèti papèd'a, lula èu parcaya ja'a. lèpa ka dènge mera-milu!

source_text: while he was still speaking, someone came from the home of the synagogue leader to tell him, your daughter's dead. you don't need to bother the teacher any longer.
target_text: lod'o yesus padhai lii era dènge bhèni ne, ca dhèu nèti yairus mai peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ana ama aad'o heka. na madhe le, de paj'èra ia ka ama mese.

source_text: but when he heard this, jesus told jairus, don't be afraid. if you trust, she will be healed.
target_text: te ngaa ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii peka dhèu èèna, hèia yesus lii dènge yairus, mau-mau! baku madha'u! parcaya mi ama lamatua di. nèngu ka dhu hia mamuri mi ana èu.

source_text: when jesus arrived at the house he didn't allow anyone else to go in except peter, john, and james, and the girl's father and mother. all the people there were crying and mourning for her. don't cry, jesus told them. she's not dead, she's just sleeping. they laughed at him, because they knew that she was dead.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai èmu yairus, dhèu ae le. ra tangi dènge d'ara pèd'a. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ae eele ka tangi laa! ana ne madhe boe. dhoka na bhèj'i di! te ngaa dhèu se pahae boe, ra mari pakapengo hèb'a, te rèngu rèdhi unu ra ana ne ma'ète a'ae. hèia yesus manèngi sèna ka ina-ama nèti ana bhèni ne, petrus, yohanis dènge yakobis maso lasi palere-lere dènge ne. dhèu leo sèra, na hia si mate ètu li'u.

source_text: but jesus took her by the hand, and said in a loud voice, my child, get up!
target_text: rare d'ara, ka yesus kèpe ai ana ne, hèia na paroa peka na, ana! kèd'i ka!

source_text: she came back to life, and she got up at once. jesus told them to give her something to eat.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana ne mamuri hari, ka na kèd'i titu. hèia yesus lii dènge ina ana bhèni ne, na, hia ana ne na'a!

source_text: her parents were astonished at what had happened, but jesus instructed them not to tell anyone about it.
target_text: ina-ama ana ne malaa-maloha. te ngaa yesus pasanèd'e si, baku palolo dènge dhèu, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne.

source_text: jesus called the twelve disciples together. he gave them power and authority over all demons, and the ability to heal diseases.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus pakaboko nare ana madhutu na, dhèu canguru dua sèra. ka na hia si koasa, ho babège eele nidhu, aa puri-pa'èle dhèu nèti rupa-rupa èi papèd'a.

source_text: then he sent them out to proclaim god's kingdom and to heal the sick.
target_text: na pua si lasi lole j'ara-j'ara paredha ama lamatua, aa puri-pa'èle papèd'a dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: take nothing with you for the journey, he told them. no walking stick, no bag, no bread, no money, not even any extra clothes.
target_text: te ngaa na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie-iie! baku mèti kahèi ngaa-ngaa ètu j'ara. kako dhoka dènge kodho ètu ua di. baku mèti kodho silu. baku mèti kahèi tatea, tas, gee j'ara, do doi-dhari!

source_text: whatever house you enter, stay there, and when you leave, leave from there.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka d'ara rae èci, abhu dhèu dhu soru miu, na lami pea dènge ne. mage mi hag'e-hag'e èmu kahèi. pea taruu ètu d'ara èmu èèna, toke miu pakèd'i, tèke eele rae èèna.

source_text: if people refuse to accept you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave town as a warning against them.
target_text: ladhe miu maso asa d'ara rae èci, hèia dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra ro'o boe sèmi miu, aa ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, na, pakèd'i tèke eele rae èèna. lod'o miu tèke eele rae èèna, tao madhutu ad'a ho caro eele ahu nèti haga miu. aa mi peka dènge ra, ‘miu se ladhe mo'o boe nanene lii ji'i, pe miu sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: they left and went around the villages, announcing the good news and healing everywhere they went.
target_text: èle ka, ana madhutu se lasi ka asa rae-rae. ra lole dènge dhèu-dhèu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. aa puri-pa'èle kahèi dhèu nèti papèd'a ètu mia-mia.

source_text: herod the tetrarch had heard about all that was happening, and he was very puzzled. some were saying that john had been raised from the dead;
target_text: ca tèka, rupa-rupa lii lolo lula-nèti yesus ne d'ai le dhèu aae herodes antipas. ropa na tadèngi lii lolo se, hèia na bingu, lula dhèu cahag'e peka na, yesus ne, nuka yohanis tuka sarani, dhu mamuri hari le.

source_text: others that elijah had appeared; still others that one of the ancient prophets had come back to life.
target_text: aa cahag'e hari peka na, nèngu ne, baki elia dhu mamuri hari. abhu dhu leo hari, peka na, nèngu ne, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu uru-uru sèra.

source_text: herod said, there's no question i beheaded john. so who is this man? i'm hearing all these things about him. and he tried to find a way to meet jesus.
target_text: te ngaa herodes sanèd'e era, peka na, ca hari ni, ja'a pua le poro pama'ète kètu yohanis. de na mamuri hari, do? aa ca dhèu ne, cee hari? ka na tenge j'ara, sèna ka patoo madha dènge yesus.

source_text: when the apostles returned they reported to jesus what they had done. then he left with them and went to a town called bethsaida.
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu dhu yesus pua sèra, lèpa mai pa'èci hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge ne aa'i-aa'i dhu rèngu tao. ka yesus si kako mesa-mesa ra asa era èci, dhu padètu dènge rae betsaida, ho ra ae ètu èèna.

source_text: however, the crowds found out where he was going and followed him there. he welcomed them and explained the kingdom of god to them, and healed those who needed healing.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu re'a rare, na, yesus si neo lasi sa mia, ka ra paki'u re limuri. yesus sèmi si, hèia na pa'èle dhèu pèd'a aa'i-aa'i, aa na peka-padhai dènge ra, j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua nèd'u paredha.

source_text: late in the day, the twelve disciples came to him and said, you should send the crowd away now so they can go to the villages and farms nearby and find a place to stay and food to eat-there's nothing here where we are.
target_text: ropa d'ai lod'o nihia, ka canguru dua ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka dènge ne, be'a risi ama pua dhèu se'e lasi asa rae-rae dhu padètu dènge era ne'e, sèna ka ra tenge nganga'a unu ra. aa hud'i laa ra lasi tenge era ho j'unu taha. te era dhu kaj'èu nèti rae sèmi ne'e, tasamia ka rèngu bisa abhu ra'a-rinu?

source_text: you give them something to eat! said jesus. all we have here are five loaves and two fish-unless you want us to go and buy food for everyone, they said. there were about five thousand men present. sit them down in groups of about fifty, he told his disciples.
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala si, peka na, sèmi ne'e! miu ka dhu panga'a si! hèia ana madhutu se dhaa, peka na, ira ii! ama, ee! tasamia bisa sèmi èèna? dhèu se risi nèti lèmi riho dhèu! èèna dhèu mone di, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana niki! ètu d'ara adhe-aai ji'i, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di. ladhe ama neo sèna ka ji'i panga'e dhèu se'e, tasa mera mia ho ji'i hèli nganga'a ae-ae hia ra? ! ka yesus dhaa, pakaboko si madhèdi lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru dhèu, ca kaboko.

source_text: the disciples did so, and everybody sat down.
target_text: hèia lasi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: jesus picked up the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed the food and broke it into pieces. he kept on giving the food to the disciples to share with the people.
target_text: ropa dhèu se madhèdi, ka yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra. ka na tangara sa dedha, ho na manèngi makasi. èle ka yesus pamae roti dènge i'a sèra. hèia na j'ole sa ana-ana madhutu na, ho papala mi dhèu-dhèu sèra.

source_text: everybody ate until they were full, and then twelve baskets of leftovers were collected.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i se ra'a toke bècu. ka nganga'a dhu risi sèra, kaboko rare pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: at another time, when jesus was praying in private with just his disciples with him, he asked them, all these crowds of people-who do they say i am?
target_text: ca tèka, yesus la'e mesa na ho sabaj'a ètu era èci. hèia ana madhutu na mai ka pa'èci dènge ne. sabaj'a nare, ka yesus karèi si, aku nèngu na, miu tadèngi-tadèngi dhèu palolo na ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: some say john the baptist, others say elijah, and still others say one of the ancient prophets risen from the dead, they replied.
target_text: hèia ra dhaa, cahag'e peka na, yohanis tuka sarani. aa cahag'e peka na, baki elia. ladhe aad'o, na, ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra dhu mamuri hari.

source_text: but what about you? he asked. who do you say i am? god's messiah, peter replied.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari si, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, na, ja'a ne, cee? ka petrus dhaa, ama ne, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: jesus gave them strict orders not to tell anybody about this.
target_text: èle ka yesus kai si, sèna ka baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa, peka na, nèngu na, kristus.

source_text: the son of man must experience terrible sufferings, he said. he will be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the religious teachers. he will be killed, but on the third day he will rise again.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a hud'i pasae ku rupa-rupa j'aj'èra dhu bia. bèli-camèd'a dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra, ro'o boe sèmi, ladhe peka, na, ja'a ne kristus. aa èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a. mema tare'a-re'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa asa camèd'a èèna, ja'a mamuri hari!

source_text: if any one of you wants to follow me, you must deny yourself, pick up your cross daily, and follow me, jesus told all of them.
target_text: èle ka na peka dènge dhèu ae se, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu dènge d'ara kateme ètu lod'o bèli-lod'o bèli. nèngu hud'i core eele ku dad'èi d'ara na. nèngu hud'i madhutu taruu, masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na, ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for if you want to save your life, you will lose it; and if you lose your life for my sake, you will save it.
