target_text: ladhe miu bisa boe uri mèdha-panyau dhèu leo, na, dhèu cee ka dhu bani ho hia miu mèdha-panyau ra?

source_text: no servant can obey two masters. either he will hate one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. you can't serve both god and money.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èci bisa boe nanene dua lamatua. te aad'o na, nèngu d'èi boe èci, aa sue èci. nèngu d'ara kateme dènge ca dhèu, te ngaa pusi boe dènge èci. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. te dhèu bisa boe sue ama lamatua palere dènge sue doi-dhari.

source_text: the pharisees, who loved money, heard what jesus said and laughed at him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri dhu nanene lii padhai yesus deo na. ka ra sasei ne, lula rèngu se dhèu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: but jesus told them, you appear pious to people, but god knows what you're thinking. what people value highly is detested by god.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge si, masi ka miu pamèu iisi ètu madha dhèu, te ngaa ama lamatua ne'a d'ara bhelu miu. abhu j'ara ae dhu dhèu rai-haha ded'e padedha-dedha, te ngaa ama lamatua peka na, j'ara sèra karehe, aa dhu madenge dènge rèngu.

source_text: what was written in the law and the prophets lasted until john. from then on the good news of the kingdom of god is being spread, and everyone is forcing their way in.
target_text: toke mamai yohanis tuka sarani, èdhi dhèu yahudi muri madhutu atora nèti baki musa aa nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, lii lolo be'a nèti lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia. dhèu ae dhu tenge le j'ara, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: however, it's easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for the smallest point of the law to disappear.
target_text: masi ka dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa atora nèti ama lamatua ciki sa, ele boe. ca katèd'a sa ele boe hèi!

source_text: any man who divorces his wife and marries someone else commits adultery, and a man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu na, aa na madhèdi hari dènge bhèni leo, nèngu bersina. aa dhèu dhu leo dènge bhèni dhu pa'ia-pa'ela, nèngu bersina kahèi.

source_text: once there was a man who was rich. he wore purple clothes and fine linen, and enjoyed a luxurious life.
target_text: ka yesus lole tabha hari, peka na, abhu dhèu kaja ca dhèu. nèngu d'èi pake mèdha-papake dhu be'a-be'a, tao nèti bèla alus. mèu-mèda na'a-ninu nganga'a dhu be'a hua, aa karae taruu.

source_text: a beggar named lazarus used to sit at his gate, covered in sores,
target_text: ètu kota ne'e, abhu kahèi ca dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa. ngara na, lasarus. ngi'u na dhu pènu dènge kamèu. bèli-bèli angalai na rèti pamadhèdi ne ètu hèb'a tedhe dhèu kaja èèna.

source_text: longing to eat the leftovers from the rich man's table. even the dogs came and licked his sores.
target_text: na sanao teko-teko abhu kaha'i nganga'a nèti dhèu kaja ne, sèna ka bisa na'a, te ngaa na abhu boe ngaa-ngaa. dhoka busa di mai, ho j'ore nana kamèu na.

source_text: then the beggar died, and angels carried him away to be with abraham. the rich man also died and was buried.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, lasarus madhe. hèia ana pajuu ama lamatua mai nèti sorga, ka rèti lasi pamadhèdi ne ètu baboa abraham. aa nèbhu boe ka, dhèu kaja ne madhe kahèi, ka dhèu ded'e lasi padhane.

source_text: in hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw abraham in the far distance, with lazarus beside him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne maso boe sorga. nèngu maso asa d'ara naraka, sama-sama dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhe le. ètu era nèi, dhèu kaja ne abhu j'aj'èra taa-taa. ca tèka na boti kètu, ka ladhe nèdhi lasarus madhèdi ètu baboa baki abraham.

source_text: ‘father abraham, ' he called out, ‘have mercy on me and send lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because i'm burning in agony. '
target_text: hèia na pa'oo, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! sue ku ja'a laa! pua ku lasarus cèb'u kolo ai na asa d'ara èi, sèna ka mai pabasa ku kolo he'o ja'a ne. te ja'a j'èra titu kèna ètu d'ara ai naraka ne! '

source_text: but abraham replied, ‘my son, remember that you enjoyed the good things of life, while lazarus had a very poor life. now he is here being comforted, while you suffer in torment.
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ana, ee! sanèd'e ku! uru èèna lod'o èu mamuri era ètu rai-haha nèi, èu abhu le aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a. te ngaa lasarus ne, unu dhodhoka sasusa di. ka limuri ne, lamatua pakarej'e ne ètu ne'e, te ngaa èu pasae more j'aj'èra.

source_text: apart from that, there's a great gulf that stretches between us and you. nobody who wants to cross from here to you can do so, and nobody can cross from there over to us. '
target_text: risi-risi hari, ètu talora aae èu dènge ji'i, lamatua tao tèke loe aae èci dhu taleo dènge marèma. de dhèu nèti ne'e bisa boe dhiu asa era èèna, aa dhèu nèti èèna bisa boe pège sa ne'e mai. '

source_text: the rich man said, ‘then father, i beg you, please send him to my father's house.
target_text: hèia dhèu kaja ne pamako hari, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, baki abraham pua lasarus la'e asa èmu ama ku.

source_text: for i have five brothers and he can warn them so that they don't end up here in this place of torment. '
target_text: te ja'a ne dènge ari dhèu mone, dhèu lèmi era. sèna ka lasarus la'e pasanèd'e si, ho ra lèpa ka asa lamatua. masi ka lod'o d'ai ra madhe, rèngu maso ia ka asa era j'aj'èra ne. '

source_text: but abraham replied, ‘they have moses and the prophets. they should listen to them. '
target_text: te ngaa abraham b'ala ne, ‘ama lamatua hia le rèngu sasuri nèti baki musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na. ari mu si, bisa baca pahari-pahari ho re'a dad'èi lamatua. '

source_text: ‘no, father abraham, ' said the man. ‘but they would repent if someone went to them from the dead! '
target_text: te ngaa dhèu kaja ne pasisu, peka na, ‘baki abraham, ee! èèna dhae d'ai mèka. rèngu sèi pahae boe lii holo-nori ama lamatua! hud'i abhu ku ca dhèu nèti talora dhèu madhe la'e asa rèngu, heka rèngu ele-ho'a, aa neo nanene kèna. '

source_text: abraham said to him, ‘if they won't listen to moses and the prophets, they won't be convinced even if someone returns from the dead. '
target_text: te ngaa abraham dhaa, peka na, ‘ladhe rèngu sèi ro'o boe nanene lii holo-nori nèti musa dènge nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, na, masi ka dhèu madhe bhodho nèti d'ara ro'a ra, ho padhai lii dènge rèngu èèna ka, rèngu ro'o boe nanene. '

source_text: jesus said to his disciples, temptations are unavoidable, but it will be a disaster for those through whom they come!
target_text: yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ae ka dhèu manahu asa d'ara sasala, lula tatao dhèu leo. te ngaa dhèu dhu pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala èèna, pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: for such people it would be better to have a millstone hung around the neck and be thrown into the sea than to cause these little ones to sin.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, toke ana iiki parcaya boe ja'a, èèna na ama lamatua huku ne bia. dhu samaa risi, ladhe èki ladha goro dhèu ne'e dènge hadhu aae cue, ho parèu eele asa d'ara dhasi ètu talora lèu.

source_text: so take care what you do. if your brother sins, warn him; and if he repents, forgive him.
target_text: de j'aga ngi'u pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka miu baku pamanahu dhèu asa d'ara sasala! te ngaa ladhe a'ari mu tao sala, pasanèd'e ne. ladhe na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai manèngi abho, na pabhèlu eele sasala na.

source_text: even if he sins against you seven times a day, and seven times comes back and tells you, ‘i'm really sorry, ' forgive him.
target_text: ladhe a'ari èu tao sala pidhu hari d'ara ca lod'o, ka na ele-ho'a, hèia na mai pidhu hari ho manèngi abho, èu hud'i pabhèlu eele sasala na pidhu hari kahèi.

source_text: the apostles said to the lord, help us to have more trust!
target_text: ca lod'o, ana madhutu se mai asa yesus, ka ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! parcaya ji'i se èra boe. de ama pa'èra ku parcaya ji'i.

source_text: the lord replied, even if your trust was as small as a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, ‘uproot yourself, and plant yourself in the sea, ' and it would obey you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe miu parcaya koasa nèti ama lamatua, masi ka ciki oo'e èèna ka, te ngaa miu bisa paredha aj'u aae ne, ‘tahoi eele, ho pidha asa d'ara dhasi! ' ka aj'u ne madhutu lii paredha miu.

source_text: say you have a servant who does plowing or shepherding. when he comes in from work, do you say to him, ‘come in and sit down now for a meal'?
target_text: èle ka yesus lii, aku nèngu na, tare conto èci. nuka sèmi ènu dhu pare rai ètu d'ara oka, do, ladhe kahib'i-kalèbho ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. sab'a nare, ka lèpa sa èmu. tatu lamatua na peka boe dènge ne, ‘mai ho dua ti ta'a sama-sama! '

source_text: no. you say to him, ‘prepare a meal for me, get yourself dressed, and serve me until i've finished my meal. after that you can have your meal. '
target_text: aad'o, sina ma? dhu lèke ka, lamatua paredha ne, peka na, ‘lamu lalau mei hia ja'a. ku'a-kinu kore ku, pe èu mu'a-minu ètu kabodho nèi! '

source_text: and do you thank the servant for doing what you told him? no.
target_text: ladhe ènu ne lalau nare madhutu dad'èi lamatua na, miu ngee, na, lamatua ne manèngi makasi mi ènu ne, do? aad'o!

source_text: likewise once you've done everything you were told, you should simply say, ‘we are undeserving servants. we just did our duty. '
target_text: miu èci èèna kahèi. ladhe sab'a mere aa'i dhu lamatua paredha le, miu peka na, ‘ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i tenge boe lii koa-kad'iri. ji'i dhoka pakako sasab'a-la'a ji'i di. '

source_text: as jesus continued on his way to jerusalem, he passed along the border between samaria and galilee.
target_text: lod'o yesus si lasi asa yerusalem, rèngu d'ai too propensi galilea dènge propensi samaria.

source_text: as he entered a particular village, ten lepers met him, standing at a distance.
target_text: ropa rèngu neo maso asa d'ara rae cue ètu èèna, dhèu canguru dhu pèd'a kusta mai, neo paraga dènge yesus. rèngu se titu nèti kaj'èu.

source_text: they called out, jesus, master, please have mercy on us.
target_text: ka ra pa'oo palere-lere, peka na, yesus! mone kapai, ee! sue ku ji'i laa!

source_text: when jesus saw them, he said to them, go and show yourselves to the priests. on their way there, they were healed.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii pa'oo ra, ka na ladhe si, hèia na pua, aku nèngu na, lami pad'elo uuru ku isi miu asa ama agama, sèna ka ra parisa papèd'a kusta miu sèra, èle le, do dhae! ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka lasi dènge. te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, cag'ag'a laa, rèngu dhu èle le nèti kusta.

source_text: one of them when he saw that he was healed, returned to jesus, shouting praises to god.
target_text: rèngu lasi taruu dènge karej'e-karae. te ngaa abhu ca dhèu di, dhu lèpa hari mai asa yesus. na pa'oo, peka na, koa-kio lamatua! te ja'a èle le nèti papèd'a!

source_text: he fell down at jesus' feet, thanking him. he was a samaritan.
target_text: hèia na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho manèngi makasi ae-ae mi yesus. te'a boe, te nèngu ne dhèu yahudi boe. nèngu ne ca dhèu samaria dhu loe boe tao lii langu dènge dhèu yahudi.

source_text: weren't ten lepers healed? jesus asked. where are the other nine?
target_text: ka yesus karèi dhèu sèra dhu madhutu dènge ne, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee? deo na ja'a pa'èle dhèu canguru si? dhu ceo, mia lasi?

source_text: didn't anyone else come back to praise god-only this foreigner?
target_text: tasamia ka dhoka dhèu leo kara ne'e di, dhu lèpa mai ho manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, dènge koa-kio kolongara na?

source_text: jesus told the man, get up and go on your way. your trust has healed you.
target_text: hèia na peka mi dhèu ne, na, èu èle le, lula èu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. de kèd'i, lèpa ka dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: once, when the pharisees came and asked him when god's kingdom would come, jesus replied, god's kingdom doesn't come with visible signs that you can observe. people won't be saying, ‘look, it's here' or ‘look, it's there, ' for god's kingdom is among you.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu parisi pèri-pèri mai karèi yesus, peka na, ama mese! peka ku dènge ji'i, lod'o mia ama lamatua neo pakako paredha na? ka yesus dhaa, sèmi ne'e. mage mi pangee, na, lamatua pakako paredha na dènge rupa-rupa tadha ètu rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. dhèu abhu boe tadha dhu peka na, ‘ladhe ku asa ne'e mai! te ama lamatua pakako paredha na ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘na pakako paredha na ètu nèi! ' aad'o! te na pakako paredha na ètu talora aae miu, ètu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: then jesus told the disciples, the time is coming when you'll long to see the day when the son of man comes, but you won't see it.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, nèbhu boe, na, ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, pa'èci heka dènge miu. d'ai ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, miu d'èi titu kèna neo mèdhi mamai hari ja'a. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o mamai ja'a.

source_text: they'll be telling you, ‘look, there he is, ' or ‘look, here he is, ' but don't go running off after them.
target_text: ladhe èèna na dhèu mai peka, na, ‘kristus ètu ne'e! ' do, ‘kristus ètu nèi! ' na, miu baku bhute ho patangi-tenge, te lii padhai rèngu sèra, kapod'e-kabèli.

source_text: the day when the son of man comes will be just like lightning that flashes, lighting up the sky from one side to the other.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, nuka sèmi bela dhu heo kacèb'a ètu dedha-liru nèti suu asa suu.

source_text: but first he will have to suffer many things, and be rejected by this generation.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu hud'i abhu uuru ku j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. ka dhèu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ro'o boe nanene, aa neo tule eele ne.

source_text: the time when the son of man comes will be like it was in noah's day.
target_text: te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ladhe na neo mai hari, dhèu mamuri karehe sama biasa, èci èèna ka dènge lod'o noh mamuri era.

source_text: people went on eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage until the day noah went into the ark. then the flood came and destroyed them all.
target_text: taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, tao pesta kab'i toke lod'o noh maso asa d'ara kapa na. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe nanene kahèi. kaca'a laa, èi aae lala, ka pamadhe aa'i si.

source_text: it will be like it was in lot's day. people went on eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o lot mamuri era, dhèu mamuri karehe titu kèna. taa èèna, rèngu ra'a-rinu, bad'aga, sab'a oka-tedhe, patitu èmu, aa mamuri karehe sèmi biasa.

source_text: but on the day lot left sodom, fire and brimstone rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
target_text: te ngaa ro'o boe nanene kahèi. hèia mad'ae aae era, ropa lot rai eele nèti kota sodom, cag'ag'a laa, èj'i ai dènge èi nasu bhori mai nèti dedha-liru, aa labhu pakèpu rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: the day when the son of man appears will be just like that.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e ku! mage dhoka bèli-camèd'a dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, dhèu mamuri dhoka sèmi biasa di. te ngaa kaca'a laa, na cèu mai.

source_text: if you're up on the roof that day don't go down and get your things; and if you're out in the fields don't go back home either.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu madha èmu, maso ia ka asa d'ara ho lalau mèdha. dhèu dhu sab'a ètu d'ara oka, lèpa ia ka asa èmu ho rare mèdha ra.

source_text: remember lot's wife!
target_text: sanèd'e ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu lot. na madhe, lula nèngu ngee mèdha-panyau ètu èmu na.

source_text: if you try to hold on to your life you'll lose it; but if you lose your life you'll save it.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe madhutu ja'a lula sue ngi'u na, èèna na mamuri na ele iia d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a toke soro mamuri na, lula sue ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu sod'a-mole, aa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: i tell you, at that time two will be in bed at night; one will be taken and the other left.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ropa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, lèpa hari mai, ladhe dhèu dua j'unu ètu era èci, kabèdhi laa lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: two women will be grinding grain, one will be taken; and the other left.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu bhèni dhèu dua dhu maj'u are, èèna na lamatua ded'e paca'e ca dhèu, aa tèke eele ca dhèu.

source_text: where, lord? they asked. where the carcass is, that's where the vultures gather, jesus replied.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu tadèngi rare, hèia ra karèi yesus, ama mese! sèra sa bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i ètu mia? ka yesus core lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e! ladhe miu mèdhi ka manu-bhui dhu tema ra'a sisi badha madhe, ra lela pa'oru ètu mia, na, miu me'a èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, dhu peka na, tatu abhu sisi hèu ètu era èèna. dènge sasoa dhu pahuni, peka na, ladhe yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, tadha na dhu mèu aadha-aadha, sad'i dhèu re'a baca tadha sèra.

source_text: jesus told them this story to encourage them to pray at all times, and not to become discouraged.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus padhai lii dènge ana madhutu na, pake lii pakasame ho rèngu loe boe manèngi-mangaj'i, aa baku ma'ète sanao-maena. rèngu hud'i parcaya taa-taa lamatua.

source_text: once there was a judge in this particular town who didn't respect god or care about anyone, jesus explained.
target_text: lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: ètu d'ara kota cue, abhu ca dhèu ama pama'ète lii langu, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. na pahae boe ca dhèu sa hèi.

source_text: in the same town lived a widow who time and again went to the judge, saying, ‘give me justice in the case against my enemy! '
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu kahèi bhèni balu èci, dhu loe boe mai sa dhèu pama'ète lii ne, ho manèngi, peka na, ‘ama hakim! j'ue ku lii langu ja'a dènge mola! '

source_text: for a while he didn't want to do anything about it, but eventually he said to himself, ‘even though i don't respect god or care about anyone,
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna, dhèu pama'ète lii ne pusi boe dènge bhèni balu ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka, na roca nanene ne. hèia na madhèdi pangee ka, ‘mema ja'a ne pusi boe dènge ama lamatua, risi-risi dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: this widow is so annoying i'll make sure she receives justice. then she won't wear me out by her coming to see me so often. '
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne pakabo'o kètu ja'a. de be'a risi ja'a pama'ète lii na dènge mola. te ladhe ja'a panena, na mai taruu paj'èra ja'a. '

source_text: listen to what even an unjust judge decided, said the lord.
target_text: de miu pangee ku lii padhai dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bhelu ne.

source_text: don't you think that god will make sure his chosen people receive justice, those who cry out to him day and night? do you think he will make them wait?
target_text: ladhe nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu pama'ète lii ne tao ai-hèb'a mi bhèni balu ne, tatu ama lamatua kahèi neo tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu unu na dhu sabaj'a mèu-mèda mi nèngu ho manèngi sasue na. te ngaa lamatua mate heka panèbhu.

source_text: no, i tell you, he will give them justice quickly. however, when the son of man comes, will he find people on earth who trust in him?
target_text: te nèngu uri lii langu rèngu dènge boe pamata. de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ladhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne mai hari, ja'a bisa paraga dènge dhèu parcaya ètu rai-haha ne era, do aad'o?

source_text: he also told this story about those who are so sure that they are living right, and who put everybody else down.

source_text: two men went to the temple to pray. one was a pharisee, and the other a tax collector.

source_text: but jesus replied, i tell you that if they keep quiet then the stones will shout!
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, ja'a pasanèd'e mema! ladhe dhèu se'e kutu hèb'a ra, èèna na, hadhu se ka dhu koa-kio kolongara lamatua!

source_text: i really wish today that you, even you, had known the path that leads to peace! he said. but now it's hidden from your eyes.
target_text: peka na, ira ii! dhèu yerusalem, ee! dad'èi ja'a deo ne'e, miu abhu dame dhu ja'a kèti mai. te ngaa lula miu pahae boe lamatua, ka miu unu heka. dame ne pakaj'èu le nèti miu.

source_text: the time is coming upon you when your enemies will besiege you, building ramps to attack you, encircling you and closing you in from every side.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a musu miu mai udhu padedha rai palème li'u tedhe miu ne, hèia ra maso sa d'ara, musu dènge miu.

source_text: they will smash you to the ground, you and your children within you. they won't leave one stone on another within you, for you refused to accept salvation when it came to you.
target_text: ra dhedhe palaho kota miu, toke pamera dènge rai, hèia ra pamadhe aa'i miu dènge ana-ana mi. ra tèke eele boe hadhu cue sa dhu titu, lula miu mo'o boe tadhe lamatua lod'o na mai hia miu mamuri!

source_text: jesus entered the temple and began driving out all the people trading there.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao sèmi pasa sa, ho ra pahia badha korban. ropa nèdhi, hèia yesus babège si nèti era èèna.

source_text: he told them, scriptures state that my house will be a house of prayer, but you've turned it into a den of thieves.
target_text: ka na jèke si, peka na, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘ja'a patitu èmu ne, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa mai manèngi-mangaj'i ètu era ne'e. ' te ngaa mi tao ne nuka sèmi era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: he was teaching in the temple every day. the chief priests, the religious teachers, and the leaders of the people were trying to kill him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, bèli-bèli yesus la'e aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, patangi-tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but they couldn't find a way to do it because everyone appreciated him, hanging on his every word.
target_text: te ngaa ra abhu boe j'ara, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi titu kèna, nanene lii padhai yesus.

source_text: once when jesus was teaching the people in the temple, telling them the good news, some of the chief priests and religious teachers came with the elders.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na aj'a-nori lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu èèna. hèia kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai karèi ne.

source_text: they asked him, tell us: by whose authority are you doing what you do? who gave you the right to do this?
target_text: ra peka na, mu peka ku laa! cee ka dhu hia èu hak sèna ka ad'u-ue maruru ètu ne'e med'a na?

source_text: let me ask you a question too, jesus replied. tell me:
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, ja'a neo karèi miu ca madha j'ara kahèi, heka ja'a dhaa lii karèi miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john-was it from heaven, or was it just human?
target_text: sèmi ne'e: miu se tadhe yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, do? cee ka dhu hia ne koasa ho sarani dhèu? ama lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: they talked about it among themselves: if we say it was from heaven, he'll ask, ‘then why didn't you believe him? '
target_text: hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, ira ee! èdhi sèmi tare le pala ti ngaa. ladhe èdhi peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka pua', èèna na b'ala, aku nèngu na, ‘ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu lèka boe yohanis? '

source_text: and if we say it was just human, everybody will stone us for they're sure john was a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘dhèu rai-haha ka pua', na dhèu ae sèra pèci pamadhe èdhi. te dhèu sèra parcaya, na, yohanis ne dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: so they answered, we don't know where it came from.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe.

source_text: jesus replied, then i won't tell you by whose authority i do what i do.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ra, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: then he began to tell the people a story: once there was a man who planted a vineyard, leased it to some farmers, and went to live in another country for a long while.
target_text: hèia yesus lolo dènge dhèu ae sèra, pake lii pakasame, peka na, abhu dhèu èci dhu sèle anggor ètu d'ara oka na. na hia dhèu seb'a oka anggor ne, sèna ka rèngu pabagi isi rai nèti oka-tedhe ne. ka na pidha la'e pea panèbhu asa rai kaj'èu.

source_text: at harvest-time he sent a servant to the tenant farmers to collect his share of the crop, but the farmers beat the servant and sent him away with nothing.
target_text: d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu, hèia lamatua oka anggor ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu, la'e nare pala nèngu. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se, game ana paleha ne, ka ra hia ne lèpa dènge ai hua.

source_text: so the owner sent another servant, but they beat him too and treated him shamefully, and sent him away with nothing.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua ana paleha na ca dhèu hari. te ngaa dhèu sab'a oka se game, ka ra pamakae ne. hèia ra babège ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: so he sent a third servant, but they wounded him and threw him out.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua oka ne pua hari ana paleha na ka tèlu, te ngaa ra game ne, toke diu raa, ka ra core ne asa li'u oka.

source_text: the owner of the vineyard asked himself, ‘what shall i do? i know, i'll send my son whom i love. perhaps they will respect him. '
target_text: hèia lamatua oka ne pangee ka, ‘ja'a tao hari ku tasamia? be'a risi ja'a pua ana pasue ja'a ka la'e. ele boe ra pakab'ua ne, de ra sèmi ne dènge be'a. ' de na pua ana d'èlu na la'e.

source_text: but when they saw him coming, the farmers said to themselves, ‘this is the owner's heir. let's kill him! that way we can take his inheritance. '
target_text: te ngaa ropa dhèu sab'a oka anggor se ladhe rèdhi ne, hèia ra papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, ‘mi ladhe ku laa! te lamatua oka ne hia ana d'èlu na nuka mai nèi. nèngu ne ka dhu bèli-camèd'a unu pusaka ama na aa'i-aa'i ra. de ta pamadhe ne! sèna ka èdhi ka dhu unu oka anggor ne. '

source_text: they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. now what will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
target_text: ropa ana ne d'ai, hèia dhèu se nuni pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u oka, ka ra pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu pangee, na, lamatua oka ne tao dhèu sab'a oka sèra tasamia?

source_text: he will come and kill these farmers and let others have the vineyard. when they heard the story, they said, may this never happen!
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, tatu na mai pamadhe aa'i si, ka na hia hari dhèu leo seb'a oka ne. ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus, rèngu peka na, ladhe bisa, na, ji'i baku abhu huku nèti ama lamatua sèmi èèna!

source_text: but jesus looked at them and said, then why is it written in the scriptures, ‘the stone the builders rejected has now become the chief cornerstone'?
target_text: hèia yesus laladhe patae si, ka na karèi, ladhe huku boe si sèmi èèna, nga tao ka dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua suri, na: ‘hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le era padhèdi agarii talora? '

source_text: anyone who falls on that stone will be broken in pieces; anyone it falls upon will be crushed.
target_text: dhèu dhu kadhunu lèke hadhu ne, nèngu tatu laho teb'o-teb'o, lula abhu huku. aa ladhe hadhu ne bèbhe lèke dhèu cee, nèngu laho kao-kao, lula lèke huku.

source_text: immediately the religious teachers and the chief priests wanted to arrest him because they realized that the story jesus told was aimed at them, but they were afraid of what the people would do.
target_text: ropa mese agama dènge kètu agama yahudi se tadèngi lii lolo ne, rèngu re'a, na, yesus padhai lii padhèto dènge rèngu pake lii pakasame. rèngu se cakaraa dènge dhèu seb'a oka anggor deo sa. de ra nasa titu kèna. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe ne. te ngaa rèngu madha'u dènge dhèu ae sèra, dhu d'èi nanene lii aj'a yesus. ka lasi tèke eele ne.

source_text: watching for an opportunity they sent spies who pretended to be sincere. they tried to catch jesus out in something he said so they could hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.
target_text: èle ka, musu-musu yesus ma'u ne. rèngu tenge dhèu j'aj'i mata-mata dhu bisa tao iisi ra sèmi dhèu mola, sèna ka ra kèpe ne. rèngu sanao sèna ka yesus padhai lii dhu palab'a dènge dhèu paredha roma, ho èèna na lasi peka dènge gubernur, sèna ka ra pua dhèu lasi kèpe yesus.

source_text: they said, teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is good and right, and that you're not swayed by the opinions of others. you truly teach the way of god.
target_text: ka ra pua mata-mata, sèna ka pakarèi dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a ama ca dhèu dhu d'ara mola. ama me'a boe kapod'e-kabèli, aa hag'e boe dhèu. ama aj'a-nori dhèu madhutu lii lolo be'a ama lamatua dènge mola.

source_text: so should we pay taxes to caesar or not?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ca j'ara: madhutu atora agama èdhi dhèu yahudi, hud'i ji'i b'ae ku doi bea mi dhèu aae kapai paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: but jesus saw through their trickery, and said to them,
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee kaj'alu rèngu ho neo pamanahu ne. ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na,

source_text: show me a coin-a denarius. whose image and inscription is on it? caesar's, they answered.
target_text: pad'elo sèku ja'a doi iia cue. hèia ra pad'elo dènge ne doi èci. ka yesus karèi si, ne'e ne, rupa cee ka ne? aa ngara cee, ne? ra dhaa, peka na, èèna, dhèu aae kapai, keser.

source_text: then give back to caesar what belongs to caesar, and give back to god what belongs to god, he told them.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, hia asa dhèu paredha, ngaa dhu unu rèngu. aa hia mi ama lamatua ngaa dhu j'aj'i hak ama lamatua.

source_text: they weren't able to trap him by what he told the people. they were stunned at his reply, and fell silent.

target_text: ama mese! atora musa dhu suri tèke hia èdhi, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone madhe, aa dhu dènge mèka kolo, na, ari nèti dhèu madhe ne madhèdi nare hari bhèni balu ne, sèna ka abhu kolo hia a'a dhu madhe ne.

source_text: once there were seven brothers. the first had a wife, and died without having children.
target_text: mema uru èèna baki musa aj'a sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ana mone dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. dhu uru leo-èmu, te ngaa madhe dènge boe ana.

source_text: the second
target_text: hèia ari na todhe nare hari bhèni balu ne. nèbhu boe ka, na madhe, dhu dènge mèka kolo kahèi.

source_text: and then the third brother also married her. in the end all seven brothers married her, and then died without having children.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ana ka tèlu. na leo dènge bhèni balu ne, te ngaa madhe kahèi dènge boe ana. toke ari ra limuri tèka, madhe kahèi dènge boe kolo.

source_text: finally the wife died too.
target_text: hèia bhèni balu ne madhe.

source_text: now whose wife will she be in the resurrection, since all seven brothers had married her?
target_text: de ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: bhèni ne leo nèdhi le dènge ana mone dhèu pidhu sèra. ladhe d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe sèra, bhèni ne j'aj'i mi dhèu èmu cee?

source_text: here in this age people marry and are given in marriage, jesus explained.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, dhèu dhodhoka paleo èmu ètu rai-haha ne di.

source_text: but those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and the resurrection from the dead don't marry or are given in marriage. they can't die any longer; they're like the angels and are children of god since they're children of the resurrection.
target_text: te ngaa ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. aa ètu era nèi, dhèu madhe heka. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te, lod'o ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, na hag'e nare si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na.

source_text: but on the question of whether the dead are raised, even moses proved this when he wrote about the burning bush, when he called the lord, ‘the god of abraham, the god of isaac, and the god of jacob. '
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri baki musa, dhu lole aj'u iiki ca kapua dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. nèti lii lolo ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu madhe bisa mamuri hari. ètu èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti baki èu dhu uru-uru sèra. nuka baki abraham, isak dènge yakob. rèngu se mangaj'i taa-taa mi ja'a toke d'ai sange ne'e ne. '

source_text: he is not the god of the dead, but of the living, for to him they all are alive.

source_text: some of the religious teachers responded, that was a good answer, teacher.
target_text: tadèngi yesus dhaa sèmi èèna, ka mese agama padhai lii, peka na, lii dhaa ama mese èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: after this no one dared to ask him any more questions.

source_text: then jesus asked them, why is it said that christ is the son of david?
target_text: yesus aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi dhèu sèra, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? mese agama sèra, aj'a peka na, kristus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru-uru ka. madhutu a'aj'a rèngu, nèngu ne dhodhoka ana-èpu dhèu aae daud di. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for david himself says in the book of psalms: the lord said to my lord, ‘sit at my right hand
target_text: lula uru èèna, dhèu aae daud mesa na dhu suri le, ètu d'ara lii sod'a koa-kio, na, ‘ama lamatua peka le dènge lamatua ja'a, na, mai madhèdi mi era dhu kab'ua ètu babo g'ana ja'a ne.

source_text: until i make all your enemies a footstool for your feet. '

source_text: david calls him ‘lord, ' so how can he be david's son?
target_text: de nèti sasuri ne, èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud mesa na paroa kristus ne, ‘lamatua'. sasoa na, ladhe dhèu peka na kristus ne dhoka ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud di, èèna dhae d'ai mèka! lula nèngu ne j'aj'i lamatua nèti dhèu aae daud kahèi!

source_text: while everyone was paying attention, he said to his disciples,
target_text: ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i taru kira mi lii padhai yesus, hèia na peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na,

source_text: watch out for religious leaders who like to go around in long robes, and love to be greeted with respect in the markets, and to have the best seats in the synagogues and places of honor at banquets.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge mese agama sèra. te rèngu d'èi kako pake kodho robho rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, ho dhèu koa si, peka na, ‘rèngu se dhèu kapai! ' rèngu d'èi tenge era re madha ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a, ètu d'ara pesta, aa ètu era-era dhèu ae pakaboko.

source_text: they cheat widows out of what they own, and cover up the kind of people they really are with long-winded prayers. they will receive severe condemnation in the judgment.
target_text: de miu baku pamud'e, lula rèngu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu ra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra dènge titu ho sabaj'a panèbhu-nèbhu. rèngu d'èi dhèu koa ra, peka na, rèngu dhèu mola. te ngaa lamatua ne'a sasala ra, de èèna na nèngu huku si bia risi.

source_text: looking around, jesus watched rich people putting their gifts into the collection box.
target_text: lod'o yesus aj'a ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ladhe nèdhi dhèu kaja mai pamaso doi asa d'ara boaraka derma.

source_text: he also saw a very poor widow put in two small coins.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi kahèi bhèni balu ca dhèu dhu unu boe ngaa-ngaa mai madhutu sabaj'a. na pamaso kahèi doi dua sen asa d'ara boaraka ne. doi na se'e, kab'ua ciki oo'e di.

source_text: i tell you the truth, he said, this poor widow has put in more than all the rest together.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, nanene pabe'a-be'a! bhèni balu ne, dhoka pamaso doi dua sen di, te ngaa na hia risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: all of them gave from their wealth what they had, but she gave from her poverty all she had to live on.
target_text: dhèu leo se pamaso doi kolete nèti doi karisi rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi na tao mi doi kolete. masi ka nèti doi ne'e, nèngu ako taha mamuri.

source_text: some of those there were talking about the temple, its fine stonework and the beautiful gifts that had been donated. but jesus said,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus dhu koa-kad'iri èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama! ladhe ku laa, èmu ne be'a titu kèna! ra pake hadhu cetak dhu kapai hua, ka ra paca'e mera titu kèna. aa dhèu hia kahèi mèdha ra dhu kab'ua, sèna ka pasaraga èmu lamatua ne! te ngaa yesus b'ala, na,

source_text: regarding these things you're looking at… the time is coming when not one stone will be left on another; everything will be destroyed!
target_text: èmu ne mema saraga. te ngaa nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eela hadhu se, toke mera dènge rai.

source_text: teacher, when will this happen? they asked him. what will be the sign that these things are about to happen?
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yesus se karèi, peka na, ama mese! ngaa dhu ama peka-padhai deo na, j'aj'aj'i na pèri lod'o? ladhe lod'o na dètu le, tadha-tadha na sèmi ngaa sa?

source_text: make sure you're not deceived, jesus warned them. many people will come claiming to be me, saying, ‘here i am! ' and, ‘the time has come! ' but don't follow them.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu j'aga paie-iie, ho baku lèke tipu. te èèna na rupa-rupa dhèu mai tèb'a kakara ra, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus. ' abhu kahèi dhu peka na, ‘lod'o a'èle rai-haha dètu kèna! ' te ngaa baku mi parcaya kahèi!

source_text: when you hear of wars and revolutions, don't be frightened, because these things have to happen first, but the end won't come immediately.
target_text: ladhe miu tadèngi ka dhèu palolo, peka na: dhèu patao-palaha, dènge papara-pakèj'i ètu mia-mia, baku mi cag'ag'a. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uru ku. te ngaa d'ai mèka lod'o èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: nation will fight nation, and kingdom will fight kingdom, he told them.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a suku èci pamusu dènge suku leo. negara èci papara-pakèj'i dènge negara leo.

source_text: there will be severe earthquakes, famines, and epidemic diseases in many lands, and extraordinary signs in the sky that are terrifying.
target_text: èèna na, j'aj'i rai opo dhu kapai aae. ètu mia-mia, manganga-mad'èu dhu seli eele, aa èi papèd'a pad'ai cèu palème era. bèli-camèd'a dhèu ladhe rèdhi kahèi tadha dhu pamadha'u dhèu, aa tadha-tadha dhu kapai aae ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: but before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. they will drag you before synagogues and throw you into prison, and put you on trial before kings and governors on account of me.
target_text: j'ara se'e se j'aj'i aa'i mèka, te ngaa èèna na dhèu mai kèpe rare miu, aa paj'èra miu, lula miu parcaya ja'a. hèia ra soro miu asa dhèu dhu uri lii langu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, aa ra taha miu ètu d'ara bèdho. ra rèti miu asa madha dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu paredha leo. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, lula miu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: but this will provide you an opportunity to speak on my behalf before them.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i pake lod'o ne'e, sèna ka peka dènge rèngu lii lolo be'a ja'a.

source_text: so make up your mind beforehand not to worry about how to defend yourselves,
target_text: de mage pangee tasamia miu siri iisi.

source_text: for i will give you words of wisdom that your enemies won't be able to dispute or contradict.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ja'a hia miu lii-lii dhu pamèci dènge lii dhaa. dènge sèmi èèna, musu miu sèra, re'a heka peka-padhai sèmi ngaa hari.

source_text: you will be betrayed even by your parents, brothers, relatives, and friends, and they will kill some of you. everyone will hate you because of me.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a dhèu tèka d'ara dènge miu, lula miu madhutu ja'a. abhu nèti a'ari miu unu mi, sèmi ina-ama, a'ari, kera ba'i, rae lesa dènge mone anga-aangalai. èèna na nèti rèngu se'e ka, tenge j'ara ho pahie eele miu, toke ra pamadhe miu cahag'e.

source_text: but not a single hair of your head will be lost.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madha'u, te lamatua bhèlu boe miu. rèu kètu miu ca loa sa kabhui eele boe, ladhe dènge boe dad'èi na.

source_text: by standing firm you will gain your lives.
target_text: ladhe miu taha mere taruu, tatu ama lamatua pala-bagi mamuri hia miu.

source_text: however, when you see jerusalem surrounded by armies, then you know that its destruction is near.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu mèdhi ka sordad'u mai pamusu reo rare yerusalem, miu me'a le, na, d'ai lod'o ele iie yerusalem kèna.

source_text: those who are in judea should run away to the mountains, and those who are in jerusalem should leave, and those who are the countryside shouldn't enter the city.
target_text: ropa ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, dhèu ètu propensi yudea rai dènge ka asa ledhe-ledhe. dhèu ètu d'ara kota kèd'i kahèi, sèna ka rai. aa dhèu ètu rae, mai ia ka asa d'ara kota.

source_text: for these are days of punishment, fulfilling all that's written.
target_text: te lamatua hia lod'o-lod'o sasusa sèra, ho huku dhèu-dhèu dhu ro'o boe nanene nèngu. se'e se lèke nuka sèmi lii padhai nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu suri tèke karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: how hard it will be for those who are pregnant or nursing babies at that time! for terrible trouble is coming on the land and punishment against this people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu j'èra risi, nuka, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, aa ina-ina dhu dènge ana susu. lod'o èèna, abhu susa palème rai-haha, aa dhèu yahudi j'èra bia, lula ama lamatua nasa dènge rèngu sèra.

source_text: they will be killed by the sword and taken away as prisoners to all the nations. jerusalem will be trodden down by the foreign nations until their time is fulfilled.
target_text: èèna na musu mai pamadhe si cahag'e, aa taha cahag'e ho j'aj'i ènu ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo rai kara dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, mai j'aj'èli pakaj'alu kota yerusalem, aa koasa rare kabarai na, toke èle lod'o ra.

source_text: there will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars, and on the earth the nations will be in distress, confused by the sea's rolling and crashing.
target_text: èle ka yesus lole mamai hari na, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a neo mai hari, abhu tadha ètu madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua hètu-hua hètu. ètu rai-haha ne abhu tadha kahèi, sèmi uli sea, dhasi ko'a dhu loe boe, aa naha aae lalulu mai. se'e se tao dhèu rai-haha ne, madha'u dènge ele ngangee, toke re'a heka tao ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: people will be faint from fear, terrified about what is happening to the world, for the powers of heaven will be shaken.
target_text: koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru loe boe karèbha. ropa ladhe rèdhi aa'i-aa'i, hèia ra madha'u titu kèna, lula rai-haha ne oe ele iie kèna!

source_text: then they'll see the son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
target_text: èle ku heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a kèna, ‘dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne puru mai ètu d'ara ra'i-liru'. ja'a mai dènge koasa, aa dènge dadedha dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: but when these things happen, stand up and look up, because you will soon be saved.
target_text: ladhe mulai j'aj'i ka tadha sèra, na, miu boti ka kètu miu, te lod'o d'ai kèna, lamatua hia mamuri mi miu.

source_text: then he told them this story as an illustration. look at the fig tree, or any other kind of tree.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lolo pake lii pakasame, aku nèngu na, miu taru kira pabe'a-be'a ku mi aj'u sèra.

source_text: when you see new leaves appear, you don't need to be told that summer is near.
target_text: ladhe d'ai ka hèru rèu ra karara, èèna tadha na hèru hadhu dètu le.

source_text: in the same way, when you see these things happening, you don't need to be told that god's kingdom is near.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge lod'o-lod'o sasusa. ladhe cèu, èèna tadha na paredha ama lamatua dhu dètu iiki le.

source_text: i tell you the truth, this generation won't come to an end before all this happens.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e mema miu! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri limuri ne, bèli-camèd'a cahag'e dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra se mai le.

source_text: heaven and earth will come to an end, but my word will not.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a taha taa-taa.

source_text: watch out that you don't become distracted by partying or getting drunk or by the worries of this life, so that this day catches you by surprise.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, mi j'aga-j'aga, te cag'ag'a laa ja'a mai hari sahèka! mage dhoka miu taru kira heka, hèia miu mamuri dènge minu mahu, aa bhute dhoka tenge mamuri karej'e di. mage dhoka miu me'a boe tadha ne, lula miu bhute dènge j'ara dhu leo.

source_text: for this day will come upon everyone who lives on the face of the earth.
target_text: ladhe ja'a lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pahuni iisi ra nèti madha ja'a.

source_text: always keep watch and pray, so that you may be able to escape all that will happen and stand before the son of man.
target_text: de miu hud'i mate tatae ku. baku ma'ète manèngi-mangaj'i, sèna ka miu bisa taha ètu talora aae sasusa sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ropa ja'a lèpa hari mai, miu makae boe titu ètu madha dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne.

source_text: every day jesus taught in the temple, and every evening he went and stayed on the mount of olives.
target_text: bèli-bèli, ladhe re mèu, yesus la'e aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. te ngaa ladhe re mèda, kalua nèti yerusalem ho la'e bhèj'i asa rae ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: all the people came early in the morning to listen to him in the temple.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, dhèu ae-ae dhu mai le pakaboko ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho nanene lii aj'a-nori na.

source_text: now the festival of unleavened bread, also called the passover, was approaching.
target_text: lod'o èèna, oe d'ai lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, nuka pesta roti dhu dènge boe ragi. ètu d'ara lod'o hua iia se, ra roro kahib'i-kalèbho tao kalela paska kahèi. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, sèna ka pasanèd'e uru èèna, lod'o bèi-baki rèngu kalua nèti masir.

source_text: the chief priests and religious teachers were looking for a way to kill jesus, but were afraid of what the people would do.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus. te ngaa ra mage dhèu ae sèra maruru, lula dhèu se d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: satan entered into judas, surnamed iscariot, one of the twelve disciples.
target_text: nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus, dhèu canguru dua sèra, èci ngara na yudas iskariot. lod'o kètu agama yahudi sèra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe yesus, dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas iskariot.

source_text: he went and discussed with the chief priests and guard officers how he could betray jesus.
target_text: hèia la'e tenge kètu agama yahudi se dènge kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. la'e neo pane'a dènge ra, sèna ka pahie yesus dènge rèngu.

source_text: they were delighted, and offered him money.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii padhai yudas, hèia ra karej'e titu kèna. ra pamoa, peka na, la'a, ma! ladhe èu neo pahie yesus dènge ji'i, na ji'i b'ae.

source_text: he agreed, and began to look for an opportunity to hand over jesus when a crowd would not be there.
target_text: ka yudas d'èi, hèia na mulai tenge lod'o dhu lake nare, sèna ka dhèu ae baku re'a nèngu pahie eele yesus.

source_text: the day of unleavened bread arrived when the passover animal had to be sacrificed.
target_text: hèia d'ai ka lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi, dhu rèngu biasa roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao kalela paska.

source_text: jesus sent peter and john, telling them, go and prepare the passover meal, so we can eat it together.
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus dènge yohanis, aku nèngu na, dua mi lami uuru, sèna ka sadia tèke nganga'a kalela paska ho ta'a sama-sama.

source_text: they asked him, where do you want us to prepare for it?
target_text: ka dua ra karèi, ama! ji'i la'a sadia nganga'a asa mia?

source_text: he replied, when you enter the city you'll meet a man carrying a jar of water. follow him and go into the house he enters.
target_text: hèia na b'ala, ladhe miu maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem, pe miu paraga dènge dhèu mone ca dhèu dhu pasae g'ala èi cue. madhutu ne toke d'ai èmu na.

source_text: tell the owner of the house that the teacher asks you, ‘where is the dining room where i can eat the passover with my disciples? '
target_text: peka dènge lamatua èmu ne, ‘ama mese ji'i manèngi ca kama, ho neo pake tao kalela paska dènge ana-ana madhutu na. abhu, do? '

source_text: he'll show you a large upstairs room that already has the necessary furniture. prepare the meal there.
target_text: èèna na lamatua èmu ne pad'elo dènge miu kama èci dhu taleo ètu èmu dedha. nèngu lalau pamèci nare aa'i le kama èèna. ate dhoka miu dua mi lami sadia nganga'a ètu èèna.

source_text: they went and found that everything was just as he had told them, and they prepared the passover meal there.
target_text: ka dua ra lasi. hèia ra paraga ka nuka sèmi ngaa dhu yesus peka le. ka dua ra sadia nganga'a-nganginu kalela paska ètu nèi.

source_text: when the time came, he sat down at the table with his apostles. he told them,
target_text: ropa lalau rare aa'i, yesus si mai. yesus madhèdi ètu mei, aa ana-ana pajuu-paleha na madhèdi kahèi ra'a pesta.

source_text: i've been really looking forward to eating this passover meal with you before my sufferings begin.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, ja'a d'èi titu kèna madhèdi ku'a kalela paska dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi, uru nèti ja'a abhu j'aj'èra.

source_text: i tell you i shall not eat it again until the time is fulfilled in the kingdom of god.
target_text: patadhe pabe'a-be'a. te èle ne'e ne, ja'a madhèdi heka ku'a kalela paska dènge miu. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ku, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka ku'a hari kèna.

source_text: jesus took the cup, and after he had given thanks, he said, take this and share it among yourselves.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare galaa cue dhu isi èi anggor. ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, èle ka na soro galaa ne asa rèngu. hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi mere galaa ne, ho èci-èci minu.

source_text: i tell you that i won't drink again of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of god comes.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! karèi nèti mèda ne'e ne, ja'a kinu heka èi anggor. ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu ka, peka na, ama ku nèd'u paredha, ja'a heka kinu hari kèna.

source_text: he picked up some bread, and after he had given thanks, he broke it into pieces and gave it to them. this is my body which is given for you; do this in order to remember me, jesus told them.
target_text: hèia na kèpe nare roti cue, ka manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pamae roti ne, hèia na soro sa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. ka na peka, roti ne'e ne, ngi'u aae ja'a dhu ja'a hia sa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. lod'o-lod'o dhu miu mi'e ne, pasanèd'e taruu miu, lula tatao ja'a.

source_text: in the same way after they had finished supper, he picked up the cup and said, this cup is the new agreement in my blood which is poured out for you.
target_text: ropa ra'a rare, ka na ded'e nare galaa dhu isi èi anggor. hèia na lii, peka na, èi anggor ne'e ne, raa ja'a ka ne, dhu bhori mai sèna ka hia sod'a-mole mi miu. nèti raa ne'e ka, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhu hiu dènge miu.

source_text: in spite of this, my betrayer is sitting right here with me at the table.
target_text: mage pamud'e, te abhu dhèu dhu madhèdi sama-sama dènge èdhi ètu mei ne, èèna na, nèngu pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: for it has been determined that the son of man will die, yet how disastrous it will be for his betrayer!
target_text: mema ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe ku madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu pahie eele ja'a, sanèd'e, ee! te bèli-camèd'a, nèngu pasae nare mamadhe-mamopo!

source_text: they began to argue among themselves as to who this might be and who could do this.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi lii ne, ana-ana pajuu-paleha se pakarèi, peka na, cee ka dhu ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhelu ne mi dedha na?

source_text: at the same time they also got into a quarrel about which of them was the most important.
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus se pasisu, peka na, nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, cee ka dhu dhèu re madha.

source_text: jesus told them, foreign kings lord it over their subjects, and those having power even want people to call them ‘benefactors. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai si, peka na, ètu rai-rai dhu kabarai ra tadhe boe lamatua, dhèu aae ra hia paredha dhu bia risi mi kabarai rèngu. te ngaa rèngu neo sèna ka kabarai paroa rèngu, peka na, ‘ama dhu taru kira kabarai'.

source_text: but it should not be so with you! whoever is highest among you should be like the lowest, and the leader should be like a servant.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku madhutu j'ara sèra. cee dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu kapai, mamuri na hud'i tare'a-re'a sama sèmi dhèu haha ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. dhu neo j'aj'i kètu, hud'i ladhe-leru ku sama sèmi ana pua-paleha.

source_text: who is greater-the one who sits at the table, or the one who serves? isn't it the one who sits at the table? but i'm among you as the one who serves.
target_text: miu pangee sèku, dhèu kapai sèra nuka mia? dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei, do, dhu lalau mei? tatu dhèu dhu madhèdi ne, dhèu kapai, si? te ngaa ja'a ne, tao boe ngi'u sèmi sèra. ja'a mai lalau-lalo'o miu.

source_text: you have stayed with me throughout my trials.
target_text: miu se'e ka dhu bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra.

source_text: and i grant to you authority to rule, just as my father granted it to me,
target_text: ama ku ded'e le ja'a, sèna ka kèd'u paredha ètu era paredha na. ka limuri ne, ja'a ded'e miu kahèi,

source_text: so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of israel.
target_text: ho miu bèli-camèd'a madhèdi mi'a dènge ja'a ca mei ètu sorga. ja'a hia koasa kahèi, sèna ka miu paredha canguru dua suku dhèu isra'el.

source_text: simon, simon-satan has asked to have all of you to sift like wheat,
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge petrus, peka na, petrus. dhèu aae nidhu neo hia miu pacèri nèti ja'a, nuka sèmi dhèu tatai ho hag'e eele èto nèti laludhu.

source_text: but i have prayed for you that your trust in me may not fail. and when you have returned, encourage your brothers.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, petrus, ho èu lèka ja'a taruu. ladhe èu lèpa hari mai asa ja'a, na, èu hud'i pa'èra ku d'ara a'ari èu, nuka dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: peter said, lord, i'm ready to go with you to prison, and to die with you!
target_text: hèia petrus b'ala, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama! masi ka tasamia èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe tèke eele ama. te ja'a pa'èra maso bui sama-sama dènge ama. masi ka ja'a madhe palere-lere dènge ama, ngaa-ngaa tao boe.

source_text: jesus replied, i'm telling you, peter, before the cock crows today, you will deny three times that you know me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka na, petrus! nanene paie. mèda ne'e kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, èu pasili le tèlu hari, na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: jesus asked them, when i sent you out without money, without a bag, and without an extra pair of sandals, did you lack anything? no, nothing, they replied.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ca hari na, ja'a pua miu lami lole lii lolo be'a ja'a asa mia-mia, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho baku mèti doi, tas, dènge salapa. lod'o èèna, miu kura ngaa? ka aa'i-aa'i ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, ca hari na, ji'i kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa!

source_text: but now, if you have money you should take it, as well as a bag, and if you don't have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.
target_text: hèia yesus peka tabha hari, na, te ngaa limuri ne, leo. ladhe miu dènge doi, na todhe mèti. ladhe dènge tas, na mèti kahèi. ladhe dènge boe samala, pahia kodho miu, sèna ka hèli.

source_text: i tell you that this statement in scripture about me must be fulfilled: ‘he was counted with the wicked. ' what was said about me is now being fulfilled.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi pangee na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu. hèia nèbhu heka, rèngu mai kèpe ja'a. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhu baki yesaya suri tèke le: ‘ra tao ne sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a! '

source_text: look, lord, here are two swords, they said. that's enough, he replied.
target_text: ka ra peka na, ama! ji'i ngèti hela dua. hèia yesus peka, d'ai le. ale ia ka sèra!

source_text: jesus left and as usual went to the mount of olives together with his disciples.
target_text: ra'a rare paska, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa ledhe saitun, sèmi biasa.

source_text: when he arrived he said to them, pray that you don't give in to temptation.
target_text: d'ai nèi, yesus peka dènge si, miu hud'i sabaj'a ku, ho baku lèke dadugu-rariu.

source_text: then he left them and walked about a stone's throw away, where he kneeled down and prayed.
target_text: hèia na tèke eele si, la'e kaj'èu boe. ka na patitu kètu urutuu na, ho sabaj'a, peka na,

source_text: father, he prayed, if you're willing, please take away this cup of suffering from me. but i want to do what you want, not what i want.
target_text: ama! ladhe ama d'èi na, pakaj'èu ku j'aj'èra ne nèti ja'a. te ngaa mage madhutu dad'èi ja'a; hud'i laa madhutu dhoka dad'èi ama di.

source_text: then an angel appeared from heaven to strengthen him.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ama lamatua èci mai nèti sorga pa'èra d'ara na.

source_text: in great distress jesus prayed even harder, and his sweat fell like drops of blood onto the ground.
target_text: lula d'ara na j'èra titu kèna, toke èi kabhèsu na suti sèmi raa sa.

source_text: he finished praying, stood up, and went over to the disciples. he found them asleep, worn out by grief.
target_text: ropa sabaj'a nare, na kèd'i la'e paraga dènge ana madhutu na. te ngaa rèngu dhu bhèj'i, lula ngi'u roe aa d'ara susa.

source_text: why are you sleeping? he asked them. get up and pray so that you won't fall into temptation.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ra, tasamia ka miu se bhèj'i? be'a risi miu sabaj'a, ho ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, miu baku manahu.

source_text: while he was still speaking, a crowd appeared led by judas, one of the twelve disciples. judas went up to jesus to kiss him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, yudas ca dhèu nèti canguru dua ana madhutu na, mai dènge dhèu ae-ae. na mai padètu-dètu dènge yesus, neo kèpe ho uu ne.

source_text: but jesus asked him, judas, are you betraying the son of man with a kiss?
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, yudas! èu neo pahie eele dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a dènge a'uu, do?

source_text: jesus' followers asked him, lord, should we attack them with our swords?
target_text: ropa ana madhutu leo sèra re'a tatao bhelu nèti yudas ne, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ji'i lab'a si, do? te ji'i dhu ngèti hela.

source_text: and one of them struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear.
target_text: ka ca dhèu nèti rèngu se, bete hela na, ka na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne, ènu nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: stop! no more of this! said jesus. he touched the man's ear and healed him.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa si, peka na, sange èèna ka! baku lab'a si. hèia na g'ag'e dhilu dhèu ne, ka pa'èle.

source_text: then jesus spoke to the chief priests, and the officers of the temple guard, and the elders. am i some kind of criminal that you had to come with swords and clubs? he asked.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu mai kèpe yesus, nuka: kètu agama yahudi sèra, dhèu heka d'ara rae, kètu nèti dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dènge dhèu leo hari kahèi. yesus karèi si, tasamia? miu se ngee, na, ja'a ne dhèu bhelu, ka mai kèpe ja'a mèti samala dènge aj'u cèki, do?

source_text: you didn't arrest me before, even though i was with you in the temple every day. but this is your moment now, the time when darkness is in power.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, ja'a aj'a miu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu mai kèpe ja'a. de hud'i laa! ne'e d'ai lod'o miu. ne'e ne mai nèti koasa dhèu aae nidhu!

source_text: they arrested him and led him away, taking him to the chief priest's house. peter followed at a distance.
target_text: hèia ra kèpe rare lamatua yesus, ka nuni rèti ne asa èmu kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. petrus kako mau-mau re kabodho.

source_text: they started a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down by it. peter was there among them.
target_text: ètu madha èmu ne, dhèu tao ai raci. hèia petrus la'e manyiru ai kahèi.

source_text: as he sat there, a servant girl noticed him in the firelight, and stared directly at him and said,
target_text: ka bhèni sab'a ca dhèu ladhe nèdhi petrus dhu manyiru ai. na ladhe patae rèhu petrus, ka peka dènge dhèu leo ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhèu ne'e ne dhu madhutu yesus kahèi!

source_text: this man was with him. but peter denied it. woman, i don't know him! he said.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! ja'a tadhe boe dhèu ne. èu me'a ngaa?

source_text: a little later someone else looked at him and said, you're also one of them. no, i'm not! peter replied.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ca dhèu ladhe sa petrus, èle ka na lii, aku nèngu na, tare'a. èu ne, mema ca dhèu nèti dhèu yesus sèra, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, ka na peka, aad'o! èu peka leli na!

source_text: about an hour later, another person insisted, i'm sure he was with him too-he's a galilean.
target_text: pe d'ai ca jam sa, ca dhèu leo hari, peka na, ja'a ke'a dhèu ne'e ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus. te nèngu ne, dhèu galilea kahèi.

source_text: i've no idea what you're talking about! peter replied. right then, while he was still speaking, the cock crowed. the lord turned and looked at peter.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu monya èèna! ropa petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna, kaca'a laa manu kokotoo.

source_text: and peter remembered what the lord had said, how he'd told him: before the cock crows today, you'll deny me three times.
target_text: hèia yesus kabib'a sa nèngu. ka petrus sanèd'e lii yesus deo na, dhu peka na, mèda ne'e ne kahèi, manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te èu pasili le ja'a tèlu hari kèna.

source_text: peter went out and wept bitterly.
target_text: ngee nèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia petrus kalua nèti madha èmu ne, dènge tangi dhu d'ara laho mae-mae.

source_text: the men guarding jesus began to mock him and beat him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu j'aga yesus, padhai lii pahaha ne, dènge game pa'oke ne.

source_text: they put a blindfold on him, and then asked him, if you can prophesy, tell us who hit you that time!
target_text: ra pahutu rèhu na pake bèla, ka ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, wee! ladhe èu ne dhèu mèti lii padhai lamatua, na, èu peka sèku! cee ka dhu j'ubhu èu?

source_text: and shouted many other insults at him.
target_text: èle ka, ra padhèd'a aape ne.

source_text: early in the morning the council of elders gathered together with the chief priests and religious teachers. jesus was led before the council.
target_text: mad'ae aae era, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, pakaboko le uri lii langu yesus. ka ra pua dhèu lasi nuni rèti yesus asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: if you really are the messiah, then tell us, they said. even if i were to tell you, you wouldn't believe me, jesus replied.
target_text: ropa yesus maso, ka ra karèi ne, èu peka ku laa! èu ne, tare'a kristus, do? hèia na b'ala, peka na, masi ka ja'a dhaa na tare'a, miu se lèka boe.

source_text: and if i were to ask you a question, you wouldn't answer.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a bari miu ca madha j'ara, tatu miu dhaa boe.

source_text: but from now on the son of man will sit at the right hand of the mighty god.
target_text: nèbhu heka ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai èèna, ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. ho èèna na, ja'a madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana na, sèna ka paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: they all asked, so are you the son of god? you say that i am, jesus replied.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, ka aa'i-aa'i ra karèi, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ngee, na, èu ne ana ama lamatua, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a, sèmi dhu miu peka na.

source_text: why do we need any more witnesses? they said. we've heard it ourselves from his own mouth!
target_text: hèia dhèu dhu uri lii langu se, aa'i-aa'i peka, na, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadèngi le, si? na ded'e iisi na, j'aj'i ana ama lamatua. ne'e ne lii pahahe kolongara ama lamatua! madhutu atora agama èdhi, ladhe dhèu tao iisi ra nuka sèmi lamatua, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku. de tasamia? èdhi parluu heka sakasii. huku pamadhe ne!

source_text: the whole council rose and took him to pilate.
target_text: masi ka dhèu uri lii langu agama yahudi sèra pama'ète rare le sèna ka huku pamadhe yesus, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe hak ho huku pamadhe dhèu. nèti èèna ka, lere rèti yesus asa madha gubernur nèti paredha roma, dhu ètu èèna nuka pilatus. rèngu d'èi ladhe gubernur ka dhu huku ne.

source_text: there they started to accuse him. we found this man deceiving our nation, telling people not to pay taxes to caesar, and claiming he is messiah, a king, they said.
target_text: de ropa d'ai madha gubernur, ra lole sasala yesus èci-èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tuka lab'a paredha roma. na aj'a peka na, dhèu baku b'ae bea sa dhèu paredha. na ded'e iisi na, peka na, nèngu ne, kristus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi.

source_text: are you the king of the jews? pilate asked him. so you say, replied jesus.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka gubernur karèi ne, peka na, tare'a, do? èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do? hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a. sèmi lii padhai ama.

source_text: then pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, i don't find this man guilty of any crime.
target_text: parisa èle ka, gubernur ladhe sa kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu ae sèra. ka na lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a abhu boe sasala dhèu ne ciki sa hèi.

source_text: but they insisted, saying, he is inciting rebellion all over judea with his teachings, from galilee to right here in jerusalem.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se pakadhii taruu, aku rèngu na, aad'o, ama gubernur. dhèu ne la'e aj'a sa mia-mia, ho kakèj'i kabarai, sèna ka palab'a dènge dhèu paredha. na tao maruru mulai nèti propensi galilea toke d'ai kota yerusalem ne'e.

source_text: when he heard this, pilate asked, is this man a galilean?
target_text: tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur karèi si, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu ne dhèu galilea, do? ka dhèu se dhaa, tare'a. nèngu nèti galilea.

source_text: when he discovered that jesus came under herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to herod who was also in jerusalem at the time.
target_text: ropa ne'a nare sèmi èèna, hèia gubernur pua lere rèti yesus asa dhèu aae herodes, dhu paredha propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, nèngu ètu kota yerusalem.

source_text: herod was very pleased to see jesus since he had wanted to meet him for a long time. he had heard about jesus and was hoping to see him perform a miracle.
target_text: herodes ne, dhu tadèngi ae le, dhèu palolo tatao yesus, aa nèbhu le neo paraga dènge ne kahèi. nèngu dhu sanao-maena bisa nèdhi dènge madha na tadha malaa èci-dua sa nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, lod'o lere rèti yesus asa nèngu, d'ara na karej'e.

source_text: he asked jesus many questions, but jesus did not answer him at all.
target_text: hèia na karèi yesus rupa-rupa j'ara, te ngaa yesus dhaa boe ca hèb'a sa.

source_text: the chief priests and religious teachers stood there, angrily accusing him.
target_text: ropa herodes padhai lii era dènge yesus, te ngaa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra galaa hari yesus dènge rupa-rupa sasala.

source_text: herod and his soldiers treated jesus with contempt and mocked him. then they placed a royal robe on him and sent him back to pilate.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae herodes dènge sordad'u na padhai lii pahahe ne. ka ra papake yesus kodho saraga dhu madhera robho d'ai rai èci, sèmi dhèu aae tema pake, hèia ra padhai lii pahahe ne taruu. ka rèti hari ne la'e asa gubernur pilatus.

source_text: from that day on herod and pilate were friends-before that they had been enemies.
target_text: uru nèti èèna, gubernur dènge dhèu aae herodes dhu pamusu. te ngaa nèti lod'o èèna, dua ra pa'angalai.

source_text: pilate called together the chief priests, rulers, and the people,
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus paroa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, sama-sama dènge dhèu ae sèra, mai pakaboko ho nanene lii pama'ète.

source_text: and told them, you brought this man before me, accusing him of inciting the people to rebellion. i've carefully examined him in your presence, and do not find him guilty of the charges you have brought against him.
target_text: aku nèngu na, miu mèti le yesus asa ja'a, aa mi galaa ne, peka na, nèngu d'èi kakèj'i kabarai ho lab'a paredha roma. ja'a parisa le toke lutu ètu madha miu, te ngaa ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: neither did herod, for he sent him back to us. he has done nothing that demands he should be put to death.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes parisa le kahèi. te ngaa na abhu boe sasala ngaa-ngaa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na hia hari ne mai sa ja'a. dhèu ne dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. de ja'a bisa boe huku pamadhe ne.

source_text: so i will have him flogged and then release him.
target_text: ja'a neo pama'ète sèmi ne'e: ja'a pua kalabhe ne pake gui, èle na ja'a patabuli eele ne.

source_text: but they all shouted together, kill this man, and release barabbas to us.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, bisa boe! pamadhe ne! patabuli barabas. ra pa'oo-parodha sèmi èèna, lula tèu mai-tèu mai, dhu tema le, ladhe d'ai lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, gubernur patabuli ca dhèu nèti d'ara bèdho madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: barabbas had been put in prison for taking part in a rebellion in the city, and for murder.
target_text: barabas ne maso bèdho, lula na kakèj'i dhèu lab'a paredha roma ètu kota yerusalem, aa na pamadhe dhèu kahèi.

source_text: pilate wanted to release jesus, so spoke to them again.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur neo patabuli yesus. ka na karèi hari dhèu ae sèra, tasamia ladhe ja'a patabuli yesus?

source_text: but they kept on shouting, crucify him! crucify him!
target_text: te ngaa asa ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, aad'o! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha!

source_text: pilate asked them for the third time, but why? what crime has he committed? i don't find any reason for executing him. so i will have him flogged and then release him.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur ngee na j'ara ne lèke boe, ka na karèi d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, nga tao ka ja'a madhutu miu ho paku pamadhe ne? bhabhelu na ngaa? ja'a parisa le nèngu ne, te ngaa abhu boe j'ara èci sa kahèi, ho huku pamadhe ne. de ja'a neo dhoka kalabhe ne, èle ku, heka patabuli ne.

source_text: but they continued insisting with loud shouts, demanding that he be crucified. their shouting succeeded,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha hari pamèdhu-mèdhu, sèna ka laka-seti ne ho paku pamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia gubernur taha nare heka,

source_text: and pilate gave the sentence they demanded.
target_text: ka na pama'ète madhutu dad'èi dhèu sèra.

source_text: he released the man imprisoned for rebellion and murder, but he sent jesus to be put to death in accordance with their demands.
target_text: hèia na patabuli barabas, ca dhèu dhu d'èi palab'a, dènge pamadhe dhèu. te ngaa na soro yesus la'e asa adhe-aai dhèu se'e, sèna ka ra tao ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: as the soldiers led him away, they seized a man called simon of cyrene, who had come in from the countryside. they put the cross on him and made him carry it behind jesus.
target_text: èle ka, sordad'u roma sèra nuni rèti yesus asa li'u kota yerusalem. ètu talora j'ara, ra paraga dènge dhèu èci nèti kota kirene, dhu ngara na simon, dhu neo maso asa d'ara kota yerusalem. ka ra laka-seti ne, sèna ka pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha ne gati yesus. ka na kako re limuri madhutu yesus.

source_text: a large crowd followed him, along with women who were mourning and lamenting him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai laladhe yesus. abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu pasuti èi madha, lula d'ara pèd'a ropa rèdhi ne.

source_text: jesus turned to them and said, daughters of jerusalem, don't weep for me. weep for yourselves and your children.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe bhèni se tangi, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, ina-ina nèti yerusalem. baku tangi ja'a ne. tangi hiu ngi'u miu mesa mi, dènge ana niki miu.

source_text: for the time is coming when they'll say, ‘happy are those who are childless, and those who never had babies, and those who never nursed them. '
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, sasusa dhu kapai risi mai, hèia dhèu peka na, ‘bhèni dhu kalua hua iia, nuka, bhèni dhu rara iisi rèdhi boe, aa dhu pasusu rèdhi boe ana. '

source_text: they'll say to the mountains, ‘fall down on us, ' and to the hills, ‘cover us. '
target_text: lod'o sasusa aae na mai, dhèu j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi, peka na, ‘be'a risi, ledhe guri mai ho kabhie ka ji'i! ' aa ra peka kahèi, ‘dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne, be'a risi kabhuku dhènu eele ka ji'i. '

source_text: for if they do this to wood that is green, what will happen when it's dried out?
target_text: ladhe dhèu bisa paj'èra dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala, tasamia hari mi dhèu bhelu?

source_text: they also took two others who were criminals to be executed with him.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se rèti yesus, ra nuni rèti kahèi dhèu bhelu dhèu dua, ho huku pamadhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: when they reached the place called the skull they crucified him together with the criminals, one on his right, and the other on his left.
target_text: rèngu d'ai era èci, dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu. ' hèia ra paku yesus dènge dhèu bhelu dhèu dua se, mi aj'u palolo-palèbha ra èci-èci. ka ra sèle patitu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèra. ra hia dhèu bhelu èci ètu karasa g'ana yesus, aa èci hari ètu karasa kariu na.

source_text: jesus said, father, please forgive them, for they don't know what they're doing. they divided up his clothes by throwing dice for them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus sabaj'a peka na, ama! bhèlu eele sasala dhèu se, te rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue. èle ka sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka neo re'a cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: the people stood and watched and the leaders sneered at jesus. he saved others, let him save himself, if he is really god's messiah, the chosen one, they said.
target_text: dhèu ae mai laladhe ètu era èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu kapai yahudi sèra, peka pa-aape yesus, aku rèngu na, nèngu dhu patabuli nare le dhèu leo nèti mamadhe-mamopo, te ngaa bisa boe patabuli ngi'u nèngu mesa na. ladhe nèngu ne, tare'a-re'a kristus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare, hud'i laa na puru unu na nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ne.

source_text: the soldiers also mocked him, coming up to him and offering him wine vinegar, saying,
target_text: sordad'u se padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi. ra hia ne ninu èi anggor manyilu,

source_text: if you're the king of the jews, then save yourself.
target_text: aa ra parodha pahaha ne, peka na, ladhe èu ne tare'a-re'a dhèu aae yahudi, na, patabuli eele ka ngi'u mu nèti mamadhe!

source_text: above jesus was a sign on which it was written, this is the king of the jews.
target_text: ra suri ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi. ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, ra huku ne lula j'ara ne'e ka.

source_text: one of the criminals hanging there joined in the insults against jesus. aren't you the messiah? he asked. then save yourself-and us too!
target_text: ca dhèu bhelu dhu paku ètu karasa yesus padhai lii pa-aape ne kahèi, aku nèngu na, èu ne tare'a kristus, do? ladhe tare'a, na, patabuli eele ka èdhi!

source_text: but the other criminal disagreed and argued with him, don't you fear god even when you're suffering the same punishment? he asked.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu bhelu èci hari kai ne, aku nèngu na, weh! èu ne me'a boe madha'u dènge ama lamatua, hèi? te èu ne abhu huku madhe èci èèna ka dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: for us the sentence is right since we're being punished for what we did, but this man didn't do anything wrong.
target_text: èdhi dua ti pasae tare huku madhe ne, lèke dènge tatao èdhi. te ngaa dhèu ne, tao boe sasala ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: then he said, jesus, please remember me when you come into your kingdom.
target_text: ka dhèu ne, peka hari, aku nèngu na, yesus! ladhe ama maso ka asa era paredha ama, na baku bhèlu ja'a.

source_text: jesus replied, i promise you today you will be with me in paradise.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge èu kèna, na, lod'o deo ne'e kahèi, èu lamu asa sorga palere-lere dènge ja'a.

source_text: by this time it was around noon and darkness fell over the whole land until three in the afternoon. the sun's light was shut out, and the temple veil was torn in two.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhu lod'o nètu le. te ngaa madha lod'o saraa boe, aa maroga kiu-kiu abhe nare era èèna, toke d'ai hake tèlu lod'o nihia. ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla bhèla aae èci dhu ra kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. kaca'a laa, bèla ne mae bagi mi dua.

source_text: jesus called out in a loud voice, father, i place myself in your hands. having said this he breathed his last.
target_text: ètu era dhu ngara na ‘rui kètu' èèna, yesus pa'oo, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a pangèd'u samanga ja'a mi d'ara adhe-aai ama. ropa padhai lii èle, hèia yesus ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: when the centurion saw what had happened he praised god and said, surely this man was innocent.
target_text: abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma titu ètu era èèna, dhu padètu dènge aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus. ropa ladhe nèdhi yesus madhe, ka na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a re'a dhèu d'ara mola!

source_text: when all the crowds that had come to watch saw what happened they went home beating their chests in grief.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra rèdhi mamadhe yesus, ra manyasa, dènge d'ara ra roe bhilu, ka ra lèpa dènge d'ara susa.

source_text: but all those who knew jesus, including the women who'd followed him from galilee, watched from a distance.

source_text: very early on the first day of the week, the women went to the tomb, taking the spices they'd prepared.

source_text: but our high priests and leaders handed him over to be condemned to death, and they crucified him.

source_text: for the law was given through moses; grace and truth came through jesus christ.
