source_text: while no one has ever seen god, god the one and only, who is close beside the father, has shown us what god is like.
target_text: abhu mèka ca dhèu sa hèi dhu rèdhi ama lamatua. te ngaa ana pasue mone mesa na èèna ka dhu pad'elo mi èdhi, d'ara ama lamatua. ana ne, ètu baboa ama na. te nèngu ne, nuka ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: this is what john publicly stated when the jewish leaders sent priests and levites from jerusalem to ask him, who are you?
target_text: ca tèka, ama-ama dhèu yahudi ètu kota yerusalem pua pèri-pèri ama agama, dènge pèri-pèri dhèu nèti suku lewi dhu tema lalau-lalo'o ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. hèia rèngu lasi asa cabèka loko yarden sèna ka karèi yohanis tuka sarani, na, èu ne'e ka, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai èèna, do? hèia na peka dènge dhèu se, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: john declared plainly and clearly without hesitation, i am not the messiah.
target_text: yohanis peka mola-mola, aku nèngu na, aad'o. ja'a ne, kristus boe.

source_text: so then, who are you? they asked. elijah? no, i'm not, he answered. are you the prophet? no, he replied.
target_text: ka ra karèi hari, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ne, cee? elia, do? na dhaa, peka na, aad'o kahèi. hèia ra tatu'i hari, aku rèngu na, tao-tao èu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua dhu na padhadha tèka èèna, do? na dhaa, peka na, aad'o kahèi.

source_text: well, who are you, then? they asked. we have to give an answer to those who sent us. what do you say about yourself?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, èu ne, cee? peka ku laa! te ji'i lèpa, aa hud'i peka ku dènge ama-ama dhu pua ji'i mai!

source_text: i am a voice calling in the desert, ‘make the lord's way straight! ' he said, using the words of the prophet isaiah.
target_text: hèia na peka madhutu ngaa dhu yesaya suri tèke, na, ja'a ne, nuka dhèu dhu pa'oo-parodha ètu d'ara mamoo, dhu peka na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i pa'èra mema, sèna ka pabe'a j'ara, ho sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru ne. '

source_text: the priests and levites sent by the pharisees
target_text: ètu talora aae dhèu dhu mai nèti yerusalem se'e, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu nèti partei agama parisi.

source_text: asked him, why then are you baptizing, if you're not the messiah, or elijah, or the prophet?
target_text: dhèu se karèi yohanis, na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu ne kristus boe, elia boe, aa dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èèna boe, nga tao ka èu sarani dhèu? èu abhu hak nèti mia?

source_text: john replied, i baptize with water, but standing among you is someone you don't know.
target_text: ka yohanis b'ala, peka na, ja'a ne, sarani dhèu dhoka pake èi di. te ngaa abhu le ca dhèu ètu talora aae miu dhu miu tadhe boe.

source_text: he is coming after me, but i am not even worthy to untie his sandals.
target_text: nèngu èèna kapai risi nèti ja'a, masi ka ja'a aj'a-nori uuru dhèu. j'aj'i ènu na, ja'a nia boe sa hèi.

source_text: this all happened in bethany beyond the jordan, where john was baptizing.
target_text: j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ètu betania, ètu cabèka loko yarden. yohanis dènge ana-ana madhutu na aa'i-aa'i, sarani dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: the next day john saw jesus approaching him, and said, look, the lamb of god, who takes away the sin of the world!
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yohanis ladhe nèdhi yesus kako mai asa nèngu. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ladhe ku dhèu nèi! nèngu èèna ka, ana kahib'i-kalèbho ama lamatua dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: this is the one i was talking about when i said, ‘a man who is coming after me is more important than me, for before i ever existed he already was. '
target_text: dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu ja'a peka le dènge miu med'a, na, ‘bèli-camèd'a abhu ca dhèu dhu cèu mai. nèngu kapai risi nèti ja'a, lula nèngu karèi uru j'ara nèti ja'a. '

source_text: i didn't know myself who he was, but i came baptizing with water so that he could be revealed to israel.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèka, na, nèngu ne, kristus. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a ke'a le, na, ja'a hud'i patadhe ne dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mai ho sarani dhèu pake èi.

source_text: john gave his evidence about him, saying, i saw the spirit descend from heaven like a dove and rest upon him. i wouldn't have known him except he who sent me to baptize with water had told me, ‘the one you see the spirit descend to and rest upon, he is the one who baptizes with the holy spirit. '
target_text: ama lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka sarani dhèu pake èi. na peka dènge ja'a kahèi, na, ‘èèna na dhèu èci mai asa èu. èle èèna, roh ja'a puru mai asa nèngu. dhèu èèna ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèti roh ja'a dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu ja'a. ' lod'o dhèu ne mai, ja'a tadhe mèka ne. te ngaa ropa ladhe kèdhi roh lamatua puru mai nèti sorga nuka sèmi koro j'aha, hèia pea ètu nèngu, ka ja'a heka tadhe nèngu, na, ‘nèngu èèna, kèna! '

source_text: i saw it happen and i declare that this is the son of god.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi j'ara se dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ka ja'a lole dènge miu, na, ‘dhèu dhu mai èèna, ana ama lamatua! '

source_text: the next day john was standing there with two of his disciples.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, yohanis dhu titu dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu dua.

source_text: he saw jesus passing by, and said, look! this is the lamb of god!
target_text: ropa yohanis ladhe nèdhi yesus kako re era èèna, ka na peka, ladhe ku laa! te nèngu ne ka ana kahib'i-kalèbho ama lamatua dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i korban!

source_text: when the two disciples heard what he said they went and followed jesus.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu yohanis dhèu dua dhu tadèngi lii padhai na, tèke eele ne, ho lasi madhutu yesus.

source_text: jesus turned round and saw them following him. what are you looking for? he asked them. rabbi which means ‘teacher', where are you staying? they asked in reply.
target_text: ka yesus kabib'a asa kabodho, hèia ladhe nèdhi si, na, rèngu madhutu ne. hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, tasamia? parluu, do? te ngaa dua ra karèi ne, rabi pea ètu mia? ètu d'ara lii aram rèngu, ‘rabi' sasoa na, ‘ama mese'.

source_text: come and see, he told them. so they went with him and saw where he was staying. it was about four p. m. , and they spent the rest of the day with him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, mai sèna ka mèdhi unu mi. hèia lasi madhutu ne, ka rèdhi era pea na. rèngu d'ai nèi, pe d'ara hake èpa nihia sa. ka ra pea dènge ne toke d'ai lod'o cèna.

source_text: andrew, the brother of simon peter, was one of these two disciples who had heard what john said and followed jesus.
target_text: nèti rèngu dua ra dhu tadèngi lii padhai yohanis, ka lasi dènge madhutu yesus, èci ngara na anderias. nèngu ne, ari simon petrus.

source_text: he went at once to find his brother simon and told him, we've found the messiah! which means christ.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu, ka anderias la'e dènge tenge a'a na simon, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, a'a, ee! ji'i paraga le dènge mesias! madhutu lii rèngu, ‘mesias' sasoa na, ‘kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua padhadha tèke karèi nèti uru ka, ho neo hia mai. '

source_text: he took him to jesus. looking directly at simon, jesus said, you are simon, son of john. but now you will be called cephas, which means peter.
target_text: ka anderias lere nèti a'a na asa yesus. hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi ne, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, èu ne, simon. ama mu, ka yohanis. mulai nèti doe ne'e dhèu paroa èu, ‘kefas' ‘kefas', èci èèna ka dènge ‘petrus', sasoa na ‘hadhu'.

source_text: the next day jesus decided to go to galilee. jesus found philip there, and told him, follow me. philip was from bethsaida, the same town that andrew and peter came from.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu leo èci, ngara na pelipus. rae èta-èsu na betsaida. petrus dènge anderias nèti rae èèna kahèi. asa bèli èèna, yesus neo la'e asa propensi galilea. hèia na la'e paraga dènge pelipus, ka na gale ne, aku nèngu na, mai madhutu ja'a sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: philip found nathanael and told him, we've found the one that moses wrote about in the law and that the prophets did too-jesus of nazareth, the son of joseph.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e tenge natanel, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, angalai, ee! ji'i paraga le dènge dhèu dhu musa suri tèke ètu d'ara atora lamatua. dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra suri kahèi lula-nèti dhèu ne'e ne. dhèu ne, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ama na, ngara na yusuf.

source_text: from nazareth? can anything good come from there? nathanael wondered. just come and see, philip replied.
target_text: te ngaa natanel dhaa, na, dhèu nasaret! ? abhu boe j'ara hua iia èci sa dhu cèu nèti nèi, nga! ka pelipus lii, peka na, wee! baku sèmi èèna. lati ho mèdhi unu mu!

source_text: as jesus saw nathanael approaching, he said about him, look, here's a true israelite! there's nothing false about him.
target_text: ropa natanel kako mai, yesus ladhe nèdhi le, ka na peka, nèngu ne dhèu d'ara mola! te d'ara na dhu ne'a boe pakapod'e. nèngu ne, dhèu isra'el tare'a-re'a!

source_text: how do you know who i am? nathanael asked. i saw you there under the fig tree, before philip called you, jesus replied.
target_text: ka natanel karèi, tasamia ka ama tadhe ja'a? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a kèdhi le èu, ropa èu dhu ae ètu mamaho aj'u èèna. lod'o èèna, pelipus dhae dhiu mèka paroa èu.

source_text: rabbi, you are the son of god, the king of israel! nathaniel exclaimed.
target_text: hèia natanel dhaa, peka na, ama mese ne, tatu ana ama lamatua! aa tatu ama dhèu aae ji'i dhèu isra'el kahèi!

source_text: you believe this just because i told you i saw you under the fig tree? jesus replied. you'll get to see much more than that!
target_text: yesus karèi ne, peka na, tao-tao èu ne lèka ja'a, lula deo na ja'a peka na, ‘ja'a ladhe kèdhi èu, ropa èu dhu ae ètu mamaho aj'u èèna, ' si? sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a pe èu mèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi eele hari!

source_text: then jesus said, i tell you the truth, you will all see heaven open, and the angels of god going up and down on the son of man.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. bèli-camèd'a miu ladhe mèdhi liru bhoke tèke. hèia ana-ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga ca'e-puru re baboa ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: two days later a wedding was held at cana in galilee, and jesus' mother was there.
target_text: asa camèd'a èèna, dhèu tao pesta kab'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. aa ina yesus ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
target_text: ra nèru yesus dènge ana madhutu na kahèi, ka rèngu lasi.

source_text: the wine ran out, so jesus' mother told him, they don't have any more wine.
target_text: ètu d'ara pesta kab'i ne, nèbhu boe ka èi anggor èle. hèia ina yesus la'e peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, soru-bara si ku laa! te èi anggor rèngu èle le.

source_text: mother, why should you involve me? my time hasn't come yet, he replied.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ina. nga tao ka ina ku neo sèna ka ja'a ka ator? te lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: his mother told the servants, do whatever he tells you.
target_text: te ngaa ina na peka dènge dhèu sab'a ètu sèra, na, nanene! ladhe na pua miu tao ngaa, na, mi tao madhutu laa.

source_text: standing nearby were six stone jars used by the jews for ceremonial washing, each one holding twenty to thirty gallons.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu g'ala èna bua dhu dhèu tao nèti hadhu. g'ala cue, isi na pe d'ai pidhu nguru lèmi toke cangasu canguru lèmi liter èi. dhèu yahudi tema dhui èi nèti g'ala se ho pamèu ngi'u ra madhutu atora agama ra.

source_text: fill the jars with water, jesus told them. so they filled them right up.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge dhèu sab'a se, peka na, lami mere èi, ho isi papènu g'ala se. ka ra isi toke pènu oe bua eele.

source_text: then he told them, pour some out, and take it to the master of ceremonies. so they took him some.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ra, dhui mere ciki, ho mèti asa lamatua tatao. hèia dhèu sab'a se madhutu kahèi.

source_text: the master of ceremonies didn't know where it had come from, only the servants knew. but when he tasted the water that had been turned to wine, he called the bridegroom over.
target_text: ropa lamatua pesta sèmi nare, ka na ngao. te ngaa re'a rare boe, èi ne dhu j'aj'i le anggor! dhèu ne malaa, te ne'a boe, na, dhèu se abhu anggor ne nèti mia. te ngaa dhèu sab'a se re'a. ka na paroa nare pengantin dhèu mone.

source_text: everyone serves out the best wine first, he told him, and once people have had plenty to drink, then they put out the cheaper wine. but you have kept the best wine till last!
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. dhu tema le, lamatua èmu hia uuru ku anggor dhu be'a risi. ladhe dhèu rinu ae ku, heka hia anggor dhu ako karehe kèna. te ngaa èu tao leo. èu hia uuru anggor dhu ako karehe, heka limuri dhu be'a risi!

source_text: this was the very first of jesus' miraculous signs, and was performed in cana of galilee. here he revealed his glory, and his disciples put their trust in him.
target_text: j'ara ne j'aj'i ètu rae kana, propensi galilea. ne'e ne heka hiu-hiu kèna yesus tao tadha malaa dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. na pad'elo dadedha na sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na parcaya ne.

source_text: after this jesus left for capernaum with his mother, brothers, and disciples where they stayed for a few days.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus, ina na, ari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, puru lasi asa kota kapernaum. te ngaa rèngu pea dhoka pèri lod'o di ètu èèna.

source_text: since it was almost time for the jewish passover, jesus went on to jerusalem.
target_text: ropa oe dètu dènge lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi, yesus ca'e la'e asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: in the temple he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves; and money-changers sitting at their tables.
target_text: ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu pahia sapi, kahib'i-kalèbho, dènge koro j'aha dhu dhèu hèli ho j'aj'i korban. ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu mei ho pasilu doi dhu ra pake hia mi ama lamatua ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èèna.

source_text: he made a whip out of cords and drove everyone out of the temple, along with the sheep and cattle, scattering coins of the money-changers and turning over their tables.
target_text: hèia yesus nare dhari pèri-pèri loa ho na èpi j'aj'i sèmi gui sa. ka na babège-lalèta dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra nèti madha èmu èèna. nèngu bhabhoo eele sapi, dènge kahib'i-kalèbho sèra kahèi. na lege eele mei, aa na ceb'e eele doi sèra kahèi.

source_text: he ordered the dove-sellers, take these things out of here! don't turn my father's house into a market!
target_text: hèia na pua dhèu pahia koro j'aha sèra, aku nèngu na, mèti sa li'u manu-bhui dènge karogo ra sèra nèti ne'e! ne'e, era pahia-pahèli boe! baku tao èmu ama ku, j'aj'i mi era d'aga!

source_text: his disciples remembered the scripture that says, my devotion for your house is like a fire burning inside me!
target_text: ka ana madhutu na ngee rèdhi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua dhu suri, peka na, ja'a sue èmu ama ku titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a èra ho j'aga ngara be'a èmu èèna.

source_text: the jewish leaders reacted, asking him, what right do you have to do this? show us some miraculous sign to prove it!
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ladhe èu dènge hak ho babège-lalèta dhèu sèmi ne'e, na, mu pad'elo tadha malaa èci hia ji'i, sèna ka j'aj'i mi bukti!

source_text: jesus replied, destroy this temple, and in three days i'll raise it up!
target_text: ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, ladhe miu paguri era mola-mèci ne, pe camèd'a èèna, ja'a patitu kore hari le èèna.

source_text: it took forty-six years to build this temple, and you're going to raise it up in three days? the jewish leaders replied.
target_text: te ngaa ra pab'ala, peka na, abhu ètu mia? te dhèu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne èpa nguru èna tèu. tasamia ka, èu peka na, èu parluu dhoka tèlu lod'o di, sèna ka patitu more hari? !

source_text: but the temple jesus was speaking of was his body.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu se'e re'a rare boe, yesus peka lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu unu na, dhu nuka sèmi era mola-mèci.

source_text: after he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered what he said, and so they believed in scripture and jesus' own words.
target_text: de d'ai lèpa lod'o limuri, ropa yesus madhe, hèia mamuri hari, heka ana-ana madhutu na sanèd'e kèna, ngaa dhu na peka tèke dènge rèngu. ka ra parcaya ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua karèi nèti uru-uru ka, dènge ngaa dhu yesus peka mema dènge rèngu.

source_text: as a result of the miracles jesus did while he was in jerusalem during the passover, many believed in him.
target_text: ka yesus pea taha ètu kota yerusalem, ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. hèia dhèu ae rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra parcaya ne.

source_text: but jesus did not trust himself to them, because he knew all about people. he didn't need anyone to tell him about human nature for he knew the way people think.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lèka boe rèngu, lula ne'a mèu d'ara dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèngu parluu boe dhèu ho peka dènge ne, lula na ne'a mema le mamuri dènge tatao dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: there was a man named nicodemus, a pharisee and a member of the jewish ruling council.
target_text: abhu ca dhèu nèti partei agama parisi, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne, mese aae nèti dhèu yahudi.

source_text: he came at night to where jesus was and said, rabbi, we know you are a teacher who has come from god, for nobody could do the miraculous signs you're doing unless god was with him.
target_text: ca tèka, na mai paraga dènge yesus re mèda. hèia na padhai lii dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ama ho aj'a-nori ji'i. te tadha-tadha malaa dhu ama tao sèra, pad'elo, na, lamatua ka dhu pangèd'u koasa mi ama. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, tatu tadha malaa se'e bisa boe j'aj'i.

source_text: i tell you the truth, jesus replied, unless you are reborn, you can't experience god's kingdom.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! aa ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e ku: ladhe dhèu rara iisi hari boe ne, nèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: how can you be reborn when you're old? nicodemus asked. you can't go back into your mother's womb and be born a second time!
target_text: hèia nikodemus karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia dhèu dhu kapai le bisa rara iisi hari ne! ? nèngu tatu bisa boe maso hari asa d'ara kabake ina na, sèna ka ina na nara iisi hari ne. bisa boe, sina ma! ?

source_text: i tell you the truth, you can't enter god's kingdom unless you are born of water and the spirit, jesus told him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te ngaa ja'a peka dènge èu sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i rara iisi ku re èi sèna ka j'aj'i mèu, aa re roh ho j'aj'i dhèu hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu heka bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua kèna.

source_text: what's born of the body is body, and what's born of the spirit is spirit.
target_text: te dhèu rai-haha ne rara iisi nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa roh dhèu rara iisi hiu nèti roh ama lamatua.

source_text: don't be surprised at my telling you, ‘you must be reborn. '
target_text: baku malaa ladhe ja'a peka, na, ‘miu hud'i rara iisi hiu ku, ho abhu mamuri hiu. '

source_text: the wind blows wherever it wants, and just as you hear the sound it makes, but don't know where it's coming from or where it's going, that's how it is for everyone who is born of the spirit.
target_text: èdhi pasoro ku dènge lai ngèlu. te lai ngèlu g'oro madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi bisa tadèngi lii na, te ngaa te'a boe mai nèti mia, aa la'e asa mia. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rara iisi hiu nèti roh lamatua sama sèmi èèna kahèi. te èdhi bisa ladhe tèdhi roh lamatua tao dhèu j'aj'i hiu, masi ka te'a boe tasa mera mia j'ara èèna bisa j'aj'i.

source_text: how is this possible? nicodemus asked.
target_text: ka nikodemus karèi, na, tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: you're a famous teacher in israel, and yet you don't understand such things? jesus replied.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, èu ne mese aae dhèu isra'el. tasamia ka èu me'a boe j'ara se'e?

source_text: i tell you the truth, we speak of what we know and give evidence regarding what we have seen, but you refuse to accept our testimony.
target_text: ja'a peka j'ara dhu lèke mola-mola. ja'a dènge dhèu-dhèu ja'a, nge'a j'ara se'e. te ji'i j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu ngèdhi unu mi. te ngaa miu sèmi boe lii padhai ji'i.

source_text: if you don't trust what i say when i tell you about earthly things, how would you ever trust what i say if i were to tell you about heavenly things?
target_text: miu mo'o boe lèka, ropa ja'a lole lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari ladhe ja'a lole j'ara-j'ara dhu j'aj'i ètu dedha-liru nèi. tatu miu asa lèka boe!

source_text: no one has gone up to heaven, but the son of man came down from heaven.
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ca'e la'e paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu dedha-liru nèi. dhodhoka ja'a di, nuka dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, dhu puru mai nèti nèngu.

source_text: just as moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, so the son of man must be lifted up,
target_text: uru-uru sèra ètu d'ara mamoo, musa kadhoe mege tabaga ci'u ètu kolo aj'u, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu laladhe ne, rèngu abhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi èèna hud'i j'aj'i ku mi dedha ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. bèli-camèd'a ra kadhoe ja'a ètu aj'u,

source_text: so that everyone who trusts in him will have eternal life.
target_text: sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: for god loved the world, and this is how: he gave his one and only son, so that everyone who trusts in him shouldn't die, but have eternal life.
target_text: te ama lamatua sue seli dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, na pua ja'a, ana mesa na mai, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, cèri eele boe nèti lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: god didn't send the son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
target_text: lamatua pua boe ja'a, ana na, mai asa rai-haha ne ho pama'ète hahuku dhèu. te ngaa na hia ja'a mai, sèna ka patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: those who trust in him are not condemned, while those who don't trust in him are condemned already because they didn't trust in the one and only son of god.
target_text: ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a. te ngaa nèngu dhu pama'ète nare le hahuku mi dedha dhèu dhu parcaya boe, lula rèngu parcaya boe ja'a, nuka ana mesa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: this is how the decision is made: the light came to the world, but people loved the darkness rather than the light, for their actions were evil.
target_text: nuka sèmi ne'e: lamatua hia le saraa ho pasaraa rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhèu d'èi risi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. rèngu ro'o boe mamuri ètu d'ara saraa lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua neo huku si.

source_text: all those who do evil hate the light and don't come into the light, because they don't want their actions to be exposed.
target_text: te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatao ra lèke boe, d'èi boe saraa èèna. rèngu d'èi boe saraa ne d'elo rèngu, sèna ka saraa ne baku pasabhoka bhabhelu-katub'a ra.

source_text: but those who do good come into the light, so that what god accomplishes in them can be revealed.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao lèke, rèngu ara mai sèna ka saraa ne d'elo si. te saraa ne'e ka dhu pad'elo, na, rèngu dhu tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: after this jesus and his disciples went into judea and spent some time with the people, baptizing them.
target_text: ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti kota yerusalem, te ngaa rèngu pea taha ètu rai yudea. ètu era ne'e rèngu sarani dhèu.

source_text: john was also baptizing at aenon near salim, because there was plenty of water there and people kept coming to be baptized. this was before john was imprisoned.
target_text: lod'o èèna, herodes si dhae pamaso mèka yohanis tuka sarani asa d'ara bèdho. aa yohanis sarani dhèu ètu rae ainon, padètu dènge rae salim, lula abhu èi ae ètu era èèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai asa yohanis ho na sarani si.

source_text: an argument developed between john's disciples and a jew over ceremonial purification.
target_text: madhutu ad'a agama yahudi, ladhe neo sabaj'a, hud'i pamèu uuru ku iisi. ètu era ne'e abhu dhèu yahudi ca dhèu dhu patao-palaha dènge ana-ana madhutu yohanis, lula j'ara èèna.

source_text: they went to john and told him, rabbi, the man you were with on the other side of the jordan river, the one you testified in support of-see, now he's baptizing, and everyone is going to him!
target_text: ka dhèu se mai asa yohanis, hèia ra peka na, ama mese! sanèd'e era, do aad'o? dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge ama ètu sebhe loko yarden, dhu ama peka na, nèngu èèna, kristus. nèngu sarani dhèu kahèi! nèti èèna ka, abhu heka dhèu dhu mai asa ji'i! te lasi aa'i asa nèngu!

source_text: no one receives anything unless they're given it from heaven, john replied.
target_text: hèia yohanis dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa, ladhe ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara hia ne.

source_text: you yourselves can testify that i declared, ‘i'm not the messiah. i've been sent to prepare his way. '
target_text: miu tadèngi dhu ja'a peka le mola-mola dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus boe, dhu èdhi tatae. te ngaa lamatua pua uuru ja'a mai, ho oti j'ara hia kristus. j'ara na sèmi èèna ka! '

source_text: the bridegroom is the one who has the bride! the best man waits, listening for the bridegroom, and is so happy when he hears the bridegroom's voice-in the same way my happiness is now complete.
target_text: ladhe abhu pengantin dhèu mone, tatu abhu pengantin dhèu bhèni kahèi. te ngaa sakasii na, dhu titu dènge ne, d'ara na karej'e, ladhe tadèngi lii padhai lii pengantin dhèu mone. yesus ne, sama sèmi pengantin dhèu mone. aa ja'a ne, sama sèmi sakasii na. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae.

source_text: he must become more important, and i must become less important.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, nèngu hud'i asa tabha kapai, aa hud'i laa ja'a asa kura j'aj'i dhèu haha.

source_text: he who comes from above is greater than all; he who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and talks about earthly things. he who comes from heaven is greater than all.
target_text: yohanis tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèngu ne mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, nèti èèna ka nèngu kapai risi aa'i. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka mai nèti rai-haha, nèti èèna ka ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a padhai lii lula-nèti j'ara dhu biasa j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa dhu mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga, tatu nèngu kapai risi nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he gives evidence about what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts what he has to say.
target_text: nèngu peka lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèdhi, dènge ngaa dhu na tadèngi le. te ngaa dhèu sèmi boe lii padhai na.

source_text: yet anyone who accepts what he says confirms that god is truthful.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sèmi rare ngaa dhu dhèu nèti dedha-liru ne peka, èèna pad'elo bukti kahèi, na, nèngu parcaya lii padhai ama lamatua èèna, lèke tare'a.

source_text: for the one god sent speaks god's words, because god doesn't restrict the spirit.
target_text: dhèu dhu lamatua pua mai èèna, lole lii moa ama lamatua. te ama lamatua hia le nèngu roh na dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: the father loves the son and has placed everything in his hands.
target_text: te ama ètu sorga sue ana na titu kèna. aa na pangèd'u aa'i mèu-mèu mi d'ara adhe-aai ana na.

source_text: anyone who trusts in the son has eternal life, but anyone who refuses to trust the son will not experience eternal life but remains under god's condemnation.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu parcaya ana ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne, aa tao boe madhutu lii moa na, rèngu abhu boe mamuri èèna. tatu ama lamatua nasa ka huku si.

source_text: when jesus realized that the pharisees had discovered that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than john, although it wasn't jesus who was baptizing, but his disciples,
target_text: ladhe pasoro yohanis dènge yesus, ana-ana madhutu yesus mulai sarani dhèu dhu madhutu ne ae risi nèti yohanis. yesus sarani boe dhèu, dhodhoka ana madhutu na ka dhu sarani si. ka ropa yesus ne'a, na, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi re'a, na, yesus si sarani dhèu ae risi,

source_text: he left judea and returned to galilee.
target_text: hèia nèngu dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele rai yudea, lèpa hari asa propensi galilea.

source_text: on the way he had to pass through samaria.
target_text: te ngaa kakako rèngu èèna re propensi samaria asa propensi galilea.

source_text: so he came to the samaritan city of sychar, near to the field that jacob had given his son joseph.
target_text: ètu d'ara kakako ra, rèngu d'ai kota èci ètu samaria, ngara na sikar, padètu dènge rai dhu yakob hia ana na yusuf.

source_text: jacob's well was there, and jesus, who was tired from the journey, sat straight down beside the well. it was around noon. a samaritan woman came to fetch water. jesus said to her, please could you give me a drink? for his disciples had gone to the town to buy food.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu madha èi èci, ngara na ‘madha èi yakob'. d'ai loo nètu ku, yesus si d'ai era ne'e. lula j'èra nèti kakako deo na, ka yesus madhèdi taha ètu madha èi ne'e. ka ana madhutu na sèra tèke eele mesa na, lasi hèli nganga'a ètu d'ara kota. hèia bhèni ca dhèu nèti kota èèna, mai usu èi. ka yesus manèngi ne èi, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa kinu èi ciki, do?

source_text: you're a jew, and i'm a samaritan woman. how can you ask me for a drink? the woman replied, for jews don't associate with samaritans.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni ne cag'ag'a, lula dhèu yahudi tema boe padhai lii dènge dhèu samaria. ka bhèni ne karèi yesus, aku nèngu na, èu dhèu yahudi. ja'a ne dhèu samaria. sala boe ne, ladhe èu manèngi ja'a èi ho minu?

source_text: jesus answered her, if you only recognized god's gift, and who is asking you, ‘please could you give me a drink? ' you would have asked him and he would have given you the water of life.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe èu me'a ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne cee, dhu manèngi èu èi ne, na, tatu èu manèngi hari èi nèti ja'a. pe ja'a hia èu èi dhu nèti mamuri.

source_text: sir, you don't have a bucket, and the well is deep. where are you going to get the water of life from? she replied.
target_text: ka bhèni ne b'ala, peka na, èu dènge boe sabha uusu. aa madha èi ne marèma. nèti mia èu abhu èi dhu nèti mamuri èèna? èi èèna abhu ètu mia hari?

source_text: our father jacob gave us the well. he drank from it himself, as well as his sons and his livestock. are you greater than he?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èu kapai risi nèti baki èdhi yakob! nèngu ka dhu tèke eele madha èi ne hia ji'i. aa nèngu, ana-ana na, dènge badha-manu na rinu nèti èi ne'e kahèi.

source_text: jesus answered, everyone who drinks water from this well will become thirsty again.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, sanèd'e, ee! dhèu dhu tema rinu nèti madha èi ne, èèna na koko-kamango hari.

source_text: but those who drink the water i give won't ever be thirsty again. the water i give becomes a bubbling spring of water inside them, bringing them eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu rinu èi dhu ja'a hia, èèna na koko-kamango heka. te èi dhu ja'a hia èèna, nuka sèmi èi madha dhu sabhoka asa li'u. èi ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: sir, replied the woman, please give me this water so i won't be thirsty, and i won't have to come here to fetch water!
target_text: ka aku dhèu bhèni ne, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, èu hia ku ja'a èi èèna, sèna ka ja'a koko-kamango ia ka! dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a mai heka pahari-pahari asa ne'e ho usu èi.

source_text: go and call your husband, and come back here, jesus told her.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, sèmi ne'e. èu lèpa, lamu paroa ku dhèu èmu mu, mai asa ne'e.

source_text: i don't have a husband, the woman answered. you're right in saying you don't have a husband, jesus told her. you've had five husbands, and the one you're living with now is not your husband. so what you say is true!
target_text: ka bhèni ne dhaa, peka na, te ngaa ja'a dènge boe dhèu èmu. hèia yesus peka na, tare'a. èu peka mola-mola èèna. te èu leo mèdhi le èmu lèmi hari. aa mone dhu limuri ne, dhèu èmu èu boe.

source_text: i can see you're a prophet, sir, the woman replied.
target_text: ka bhèni ne lii, peka na, ira ii! ja'a heka ke'a kèna, ama ne ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua.

source_text: tell me this: our ancestors worshiped here on this mountain, but you say that jerusalem is where we must worship.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi. bèi-baki ji'i dhèu samaria pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe gerisim. te ngaa miu dhèu yahudi peka na, ladhe neo sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa kota yerusalem. madhutu ama, mia ka dhu lèke?

source_text: jesus replied, believe me the time is coming when you won't worship the father either on this mountain or in jerusalem.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, èu parcaya ku lii ja'a ne, te dhu lèke sèmi ne'e ku. dhèu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua ètu ledhe ne'e, do, ètu yerusalem, pe d'ai lod'o na, dua era se guna heka.

source_text: you really don't know the god you're worshiping, while we worship the god we know, for salvation comes from the jews.
target_text: miu dhèu samaria me'a mèu boe, mi cee ka miu pahaha iisi. te ngaa ji'i dhèu yahudi nge'a mèu, lula-nèti ama lamatua dhu ji'i pahaha iisi mi nèngu. te nèngu neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa abhu mamuri nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu.

source_text: but the time is coming-and in fact it's here already-when true worshipers will worship the father in spirit and in truth, for these are the kind of worshipers the father wants.
target_text: pe d'ai lod'o na, nuka mulai ne'e ne, dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a pahaha iisi mi ama èdhi ètu sorga, na, rèngu pahaha iisi mi nèngu madhutu roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke. te ama ètu sorga d'èi dhèu sèmi sèra dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: god is spirit, so worshipers must worship in spirit and in truth.
target_text: te lamatua èèna, roh. de dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu hud'i pahaha iisi madhutu ku roh na, aa madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: the woman said, well, i know that the messiah is coming, the one who is called christ. when he comes he will explain it all to us.
target_text: ka dhèu bhèni ne lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a le mesias neo mai èèna, dhu dhèu peka na, ‘kristus'. ama lamatua padhadha tèke neo hia mai. ladhe na mai ka, tatu nèngu bhoke paled'a aa'i-aa'i mi ji'i.

source_text: jesus replied, i am-the one who is speaking to you.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, na, nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: just then the disciples returned. they were shocked that he was talking to a woman, but none of them asked what are you doing? or why are you talking with her?
target_text: ropa nèngu padhai lii era, ana madhutu na sèra lèpa nèti d'ara kota. rèngu malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi yesus dhu padhai lii dènge bhèni samaria ca dhèu. te ngaa ca dhèu sa bani boe karèi dhèu bhèni, na, èu parluu ngaa? aa èci sa bani boe karèi yesus kahèi, peka na, nga tao ka ama padhai lii dènge dhèu bhèni ne?

source_text: the woman left her water jar behind and ran back to the town, telling the people,
target_text: ka bhèni ne tèke eele g'ala na ètu era èèna, la'e asa d'ara kota. hèia na lolo dènge dhèu ètu sèra, peka na,

source_text: come and meet a man who told me everything i ever did! could this be the messiah?
target_text: mai lati ladhe ku dhèu nèi laa! te na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi. tao-tao nèngu ne'e ka, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pamoa hia mai!

source_text: so they went out of the town to go and see him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ae kalua nèti d'ara kota, lasi laladhe ne.

source_text: meanwhile jesus' disciples were urging him, rabbi, please eat something!
target_text: lod'o bhèni ne la'e asa kota, hèia ana madhutu na peka dènge ne, ama mese! mai ka ta'a!

source_text: but jesus replied, i have food to eat that you know nothing about.
target_text: te ngaa na dhaa, peka na, ja'a abhu le nganga'a dhu miu me'a boe.

source_text: did someone bring him food? the disciples asked one another.
target_text: ka ana madhutu na pakarèi èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, tasamia, ne? cee ka dhu rèti nganga'a hia ne?

source_text: jesus told them, my food is to do the will of the one who sent me, and to complete his work.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, sèmi ne'e. ama lamatua pua ja'a mai, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na, aa pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke d'ai èle. ne'e ne, nuka sèmi nganga'a-nginu dhu ja'a abhu.

source_text: don't you have a saying, ‘four more months until harvest? ' open your eyes and look around! the crops in the fields are ripe, ready for harvest.
target_text: miu ladhe ku asa d'ara oka-tedhe, aa mi kasere sèku, ele boe miu peka na, ‘di èpa hèru ka, heka bisa puru are kèna. ' nanene, ee! ja'a pasanèd'e miu. ladhe miu laladhe paie-iie, are ètu d'ara oka-tedhe d'ai le lod'o puu-g'ètu. oka-tedhe sèra nuka sèmi dhèu-dhèu dhu mai asa èdhi. te rèngu se'e ka dhu sadia le parcaya ja'a.

source_text: the reaper is being paid and harvesting a crop for eternal life so that both the sower and the reaper can celebrate.
target_text: mesa boe sèmi se'e di, te dhèu dhu puu-g'ètu sèra pakaboko hua-hela ètu d'ara gud'a, rèngu mulai sèmi rare rui-j'aj'èra ra. rèngu se'e, nuka sèmi dhèu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu parcaya mi ama lamatua, ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu sèle hini dènge dhèu puu-g'ètu, bisa sama-sama karej'e-karae.

source_text: so the proverb ‘one sows, another reaps, ' is true.
target_text: dhèu peka na, ‘dhèu èci sèle hini; dhèu leo ka dhu kaboko isi rai. ' èèna, lèke kèna.

source_text: i sent you to reap what you didn't work for. others did the hard work and you have reaped the benefits of what they did.
target_text: ja'a pua-paleha miu ho lami kaboko isi rai nèti sasab'a dhèu leo. mema sasab'a miu boe, te ngaa miu abhu leto nèti rui-j'aj'èra rèngu.

source_text: many samaritans from that town trusted in him because of what the woman said: he told me everything i ever did.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu d'ara kota samaria ae ka dhu parcaya yesus, lula lii padhai bhèni ne, dhu peka na, na bhoke patalele aa'i le ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a ad'u-ue kèdhi.

source_text: so when they came to see him they pleaded with him to stay with them. he stayed for two days,
target_text: ka ropa dhèu se'e mai d'ai madha yesus, ra pamako ne, peka na, ama pea ku laa dènge ji'i mi ne'e! hèia yesus pea dènge dhèu se, dua lod'o.

source_text: and because of what he told them many more trusted in him.
target_text: aa dhèu leo ae kahèi dhu parcaya ne, lula lii padhai na.

source_text: they said to the woman, now our trust in him isn't just because of what you told us but because we have heard him for ourselves. we're convinced that he really is the savior of the world.
target_text: hèia dhèu se peka dènge dhèu bhèni ne, aku rèngu na, med'a na, ji'i nanene dhoka lii èu di. te ngaa ne'e ne ji'i parcaya ne, lula ji'i nanene lii padhai na patoo madha dènge madha. ji'i nge'a tare'a, na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu bisa patalale èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ètu rai-haha ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: after the two days he continued on to galilee.
target_text: hèia yesus si tèke eele era èèna, pakèd'i lasi asa propensi galilea.

source_text: jesus himself had made the comment that a prophet is not respected in his own country.
target_text: ca tèka yesus dhu peka nèdhi, na, dhèu d'èi boe pakab'ua dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae èta-èsu na.

source_text: but when he arrived in galilee, the people welcomed him, because they had also been at the passover feast and had seen everything he'd done in jerusalem.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhèu dhae tao mèka kalela paska, dhèu galilea ae ka dhu lasi asa yerusalem, sèna ka tao lod'o hua iia ètu nèi. ka rèdhi aa'i-aa'i kahèi dhu yesus tao ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, lod'o na lèpa asa galilea, dhèu sèmi ne dènge be'a.

source_text: he visited cana in galilee again, where he had turned water into wine. nearby in the town of capernaum lived a royal official whose son was very sick.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi hari asa rae kana ètu propensi galilea. ètu era ne'e ka dhu yesus tao nèdhi èi j'aj'i anggor. lod'o èèna, abhu pegawi ca dhèu dhu pea ètu kota kapernaum. ana mone na dhu pèd'a.

source_text: when he heard that jesus had returned from judea to galilee, he went to jesus and begged him to come and heal his son who was close to death.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne tadèngi, yesus lèpa le asa galilea nèti propensi yudea, hèia ca'e la'e asa rae kana ho tenge yesus. ropa paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako, sèna ka yesus puru la'e ho puri-pa'èle ana na nèti papèd'a-tarègu. te ana ne dhu pèd'a oe madhe.

source_text: unless you see signs and wonders you people really won't trust me, said jesus.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge pegawi ne, ladhe miu mèdhi boe tadha-tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao, na, miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a!

source_text: lord, just come before my child dies, the official pleaded.
target_text: te ngaa pegawi ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, lati ku laa. te aad'o, na, ana ja'a madhe.

source_text: go on home, jesus told him. your son will live! the man trusted what jesus told him and left for home.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, lèpa ka. te ana mu mamuri. ka na lèpa dènge ka, lula nèngu parcaya lii padhai yesus.

source_text: while he was on his way, his servants met him with the news that his son was alive and recovering.
target_text: ropa pegawi ne ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu-dhèu sab'a na mai paraga dènge ne, ka ra peka na, ama susa ia ka, te ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a.

source_text: he asked them what time it was when his son began to get better. yesterday at one p. m. the fever left him, they told him.
target_text: ka na karèi si, na èle, d'ara hake pèri sa? ka dhèu se dhaa, peka na, karèi med'a, lod'o titu mera d'ara hake èci sa, maringi-sagoro na èle dènge ka.

source_text: then the father realized this was the precise time when jesus had told him, your son will live! so he and everyone in his household trusted in jesus.
target_text: hèia pegawi ne ngee nèdhi dènge, na, ana na be'a le, ropa yesus peka na, ana ama èle le nèti papèd'a. ka pegawi ne, dènge isi èmu na aa'i-aa'i parcaya yesus.

source_text: this was the second miraculous sign jesus did after coming from judea to galilee.
target_text: de ne'e ne, tadha malaa ka dua dhu yesus tao, lod'o na kalua nèti yudea la'e asa galilea.

source_text: after this there was a jewish festival, so jesus went to jerusalem.
target_text: nèbhu boe nèti èèna, abhu lod'o hua iia agama yahudi. ka yesus si lasi asa kota yerusalem.

source_text: now near the sheep gate in jerusalem is a pool called bethzatha in hebrew, with five porches beside it.
target_text: ètu nèi, abhu kolam cue dhu dènge lèmi teras dhu padètu dènge hèb'a babèdho èci, dhu dhèu peka na, babèdho kahib'i-kalèbho. dènge lii aram kolam ne, ngara na ‘batesda'.

source_text: crowds of sick people were lying in these porches-those who were blind, lame, or paralyzed.
target_text: dhèu pèd'a ae-ae dhu tema mate ètu teras se'e. dhèu pèd'a se nuka sèmi: dhèu bèdhu, dhèu karuku, dènge dhèu bisa boe eso. rèngu se mate, ladhe pèri lod'o èi ne mulai dènge gagèb'o.

source_text: one man who was there had been sick for thirty-eight years. jesus looked at him, knowing he had been lying there for a long time, and asked him,
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu pèd'a tèlu nguru aru tèu le.

source_text: do you want to be healed?
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ne j'unu ètu èèna. nèngu ne'a dhèu ne dhu pèd'a nèbhu le, ka na karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu neo èle nèti papèd'a, do?

source_text: sir, the sick man answered, i don't have anyone to help me get into the pool when the water is stirred. while i'm trying to get there, someone always gets in before me.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne dhaa, na, ko'o, ama. te ngaa ako carui ka, ladhe èi ne mulai gagèb'o, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ded'e ja'a ho pamaso asa d'ara èi ne. ladhe ja'a sèku maso, na, abhu le dhèu leo dhu maso uuru nèti ja'a.

source_text: stand up, pick up your mat, and start walking! jesus told him.
target_text: ka yesus pua ne, aku nèngu na, titu ka! lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka.

source_text: immediately the man was healed. he picked up his mat and started walking. now the day that this happened was the sabbath.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia dhèu ne èle dènge ka nèti karuku na. ka na kèd'i, ded'e nèti dhèpi na, hèia la'e dènge ka. j'ara ne j'aj'i, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi.

source_text: so the jews said to the man who'd been healed, this is the sabbath! it's against the law to carry a mat!
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi jèke dhèu dhu heka èle nèti papèd'a ne, aku rèngu na, weh! èu me'a, do aad'o? doe ne'e ne, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu bisa boe nedhe dhèpi na, te èèna ngara na, sasab'a!

source_text: the man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and start walking, he replied.
target_text: ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! baku nasa dènge ja'a. te dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a, dhu paredha ja'a peka na, ‘lulu dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. '

source_text: who's this person who told you to carry your mat and walk? they asked.
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi ne, cee ka dhu pua èu nedhe dhèpi èèna?

source_text: however, the man who'd been healed didn't know who it was, for jesus had slipped away into the surrounding crowd.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu èle nèti pèd'a ne, tadhe boe, na, yesus ne, cee. te yesus dhu kalua le mau-mau, lula dhèu ae ètu èèna.

source_text: later on jesus found the man in the temple, and told him, look, now you've been healed. so stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.
target_text: nèbhu boe, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu ne ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, nanene! èu èle le nèti papèd'a èu. baku ad'u-ue hari sasala, sèna ka èu baku abhu hari j'aj'èra dhu bia risi.

source_text: the man went and told the jews it was jesus who had healed him.
target_text: hèia dhèu ne la'e asa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, ka na lolo, peka na, dhu puri-pa'èle ja'a nèti papèd'a èèna, ngara na yesus.

source_text: so the jews started to harass jesus because he was doing things on the sabbath.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra mulai paj'èra yesus, lula nèngu pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke dènge lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: but jesus told them, my father is still working, and so am i.
target_text: te ngaa yesus peka dènge ra, sèmi ne'e. ama ku ae boe nèti sasab'a-la'a na. de ja'a sab'a taruu kahèi.

source_text: this was why the jews tried even harder to kill him, for not only did he break the sabbath but also called god his father, making himself equal with god.
target_text: lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi se cap le, peka na, yesus sisu atora lod'o ae sasab'a rèngu, nèti èèna ka ra tenge-tenge j'ara tasamia, ho pamadhe ne. risi-risi hari, na peka na, ama lamatua èèna, ama nèngu. dènge lii padhai sèmi ne'e, nèngu tao iisi na sama sèmi ama lamatua.

source_text: so jesus explained to them, i tell you the truth, the son can do nothing by himself; he can only do what he sees the father doing. whatever the father does the son does as well.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, tare'a! ja'a peka mema, na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu d'ara ja'a unu ku. te ja'a ne, ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa sab'a dhodhoka madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a kèdhi ama ku sab'a. ja'a kèdhi ama ku tao ngaa, na, ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for the father loves the son, and reveals to him everything he does; and the father will show to him even more incredible things that will completely amaze you.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a, nuka ana na. na pad'elo dènge ja'a kahèi aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu tao. na neo pad'elo dènge ja'a j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai risi hari, sèna ka miu mèdhi aa asa tabha malaa!

source_text: for just as the father gives life to those he resurrects from the dead, in the same way the son also gives life to those that he wants.
target_text: ama ku pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke mi cee èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ja'a.

source_text: the father judges no one. he has given to the son all the authority to judge,
target_text: dhu mola-mola, sèmi ne'e ka: ama ku mesa na pama'ète boe hahuku mi dhèu. te ngaa na pangèd'u aa'i hak èèna mi ja'a, te ja'a ne, ana na. hèia ja'a ka dhu pama'ète, na, tatao dhèu lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: so that everyone may honor the son just as they honor the father. anyone who doesn't honor the son doesn't honor the father who sent him.
target_text: ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ja'a, sama sèmi rèngu pakab'ua nèngu kahèi. te dhèu dhu pakab'ua boe ja'a, ana nèngu ne, èci èèna ka rèngu pakab'ua boe ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: i tell you the truth: those who follow what i say and trust the one who sent me have eternal life. they won't be condemned, but have gone from death to life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema. dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a nanene lii padhai ja'a, aa parcaya ama lamatua dhu pua ja'a mai, na, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. lamatua huku heka nèngu. te dhèu èèna abhu heka hahuku madhe, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri taruu dènge lamatua.

source_text: i tell you the truth: the time is coming-in fact it's here already-when the dead will hear the voice of the son of god, and those who hear will live!
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka mema dènge miu kèna. lod'o na dètu le, limuri ne dhu j'aj'i le, nuka dhèu-dhèu madhe nanene lii ja'a, ana ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu nanene dènge sèmi nare lii padhai ja'a, nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: just as the father has life-giving power in himself, so has he given the son the same life-giving power in himself.
target_text: mamuri aa'i-aa'i kapua na nèti ama ku. nèngu hia ja'a mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. te ja'a ne, ana na.

source_text: the father also granted the authority for judgment to him, for he is the son of man.
target_text: ama ku pangèd'u koasa dènge hak mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pama'ète hahuku mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, lula ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a.

source_text: don't be surprised at this, for the time is coming when all those in the grave will hear his voice
target_text: miu baku malaa, te ciki oo'e hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i ra tadèngi lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: and will rise again: those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of condemnation.
target_text: hèia ra mamuri hari. ka rèngu kalua nèti d'ara ro'a ra. dhèu dhu uru sèra tao be'a, abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu uru sèra ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a, pasae hahuku taruu.

source_text: i can do nothing by myself. i judge based on what i'm told, and my decision is right, for i'm not doing my own will but the will of the one who sent me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ladhe dhae tadèngi mèka nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a tadèngi kore ku, heka ja'a pama'ète lii langu dhèu kèna. nèti èèna ka, ngaa dhu ja'a pama'ète sèra, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku. lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai!

source_text: if i were to make claims about myself, such claims wouldn't be valid;
target_text: lèke iia boe, ladhe ja'a mesa ku dhu padhue-padhai lula-nèti ngi'u ja'a.

source_text: but someone else gives evidence about me, and i know what he says about me is true.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu j'aj'i sakasii lula-nèti ja'a. aa ja'a ke'a lii padhai nèngu lula-nèti ja'a, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: you asked john about me, and he told the truth,
target_text: miu dhu pua mèdhi dhèu lasi pakarèi dènge yohanis tuka sarani. ka na peka lèke lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but i don't need any human endorsement. i'm explaining this to you so you can be saved.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a parluu boe lii sakasii nèti dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e lii se'e, sèna ka miu bisa pakaj'èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: john was like a brightly-burning light, and you were willing to enjoy his light for a while.
target_text: lii padhai yohanis ne, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu heo pasaraa miu. ropa heo na d'elo miu era, d'ara miu karej'e-karae.

source_text: but the evidence i'm giving is greater than john's. for i am doing the work that the father gave me to do,
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a abhu dhèu èci dhu kapai risi eele nèti yohanis dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a ne. nèngu, nuka ama ku ètu sorga, dhu pangèd'u mi ja'a sasab'a ae-ae, sèna ka sab'a toke pa'èle. sasab'a ae se'e ka dhu j'aj'i mi tadha, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: and this is the proof that the father sent me. the father who sent me, he himself speaks on my behalf. you've never heard his voice, and you've never seen what he looks like,
target_text: lula nèngu ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a, nèngu ka dhu peka mola-mola lula-nèti ja'a kahèi. miu mesa mi tadèngi mèdhi mèka lii nèngu, do, patoo madha dènge madha, aa ladhe mèdhi mèka rèhu na.

source_text: and you don't accept what he says, because you don't trust in the one he sent.
target_text: lii holo-nori lamatua mamuri boe ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya boe ja'a dhu nèngu pua mai.

source_text: you search the scriptures because you think that through them you'll gain eternal life. but the evidence they give is in support of me!
target_text: miu d'èi parisa toke lutu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, lula miu pangee, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu j'ara ho abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. aa te ngaa sasuri sèra ka dhu lole lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: and yet you don't want to come to me so that you might live.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe ara mai asa ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i'm not looking for human approval
target_text: ja'a parluu boe dhèu ded'e kolongara ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: -i know you, and that you don't have god's love in you.
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a mèu d'ara iiki miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a ke'a, na, miu sue boe ama lamatua.

source_text: for i've come to represent my father, and you won't accept me; but if someone comes representing themselves, then you accept them!
target_text: ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, lula ama ku dhu nèd'u koasa ka pua ja'a mai. te ngaa miu mo'o boe sèmi mere ja'a. aa te ngaa ladhe dhèu leo dhu mai pake koasa nèngu, miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a.

source_text: how can you trust in me when you look for praise from one another and yet you don't look for praise from the one true god?
target_text: miu èci dènge èci d'èi sèna ka abhu koa-kad'iri. te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe, ladhe ama lamatua koa miu, do aad'o. aa te ngaa nèngu èèna, ama lamatua! abhu boe dhu leo. de ladhe miu pahae boe ne, na, tasamia miu bisa parcaya nèngu?

source_text: but don't think i will be making accusations about you to the father. it's moses who is accusing you, the one in whom you place such confidence.
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a pèci sasala mi dedha miu ètu katanga madha ama ku. aad'o. dhu pèci sasala sa dedha miu nuka musa. aa te ngaa, era maena miu ka nèngu, lula nèngu ka dhu hia miu atora ama lamatua.

source_text: for if you really trusted moses you would trust in me, because he wrote about me.
target_text: de ladhe miu lèka musa, tatu miu parcaya ja'a tare'a-re'a. te nèngu ka dhu suri lula-nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: but since you don't trust what he said, why would you trust what i say?
target_text: te ngaa lula miu parcaya èra boe mi ngaa dhu na suri, tasamia ka miu bisa lèka ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai? aad'o, sina ma?

source_text: some time later jesus left to go to the other side of the sea of galilee also known as the sea of tiberias. a large crowd was following him, for they'd seen his miracles of healing. jesus went up a hill and sat down there with his disciples. the time for the jewish festival of the passover was approaching.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhèu yahudi oe dètu. hèia yesus si lasi asa cabèka dano galilea. ngara leo dano ne, ‘dano tiberias'. dhèu ae dhu madhutu ne, lula rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, lod'o puri-pa'èle dhèu-dhèu pèd'a. d'ai cabèka dano, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na ca'e asa ledhe iiki èci. hèia ra madhèdi ètu era èèna.

source_text: when jesus looked up, and saw a large crowd coming towards him, he asked philip, where can we buy bread to feed these people?
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi dhèu ae mai pakaboko, hèia na karèi ana madhutu na ca dhèu, ngara na pelipus, aku nèngu na, ètu era mia èdhi bisa hèli nganga'a, ho hia dhèu se ra'a?

source_text: he only asked this to see how philip would respond, because jesus already knew what he was going to do.
target_text: yesus ne'a le ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. te ngaa na peka sèmi èèna, sèna ka neo sèku pelipus.

source_text: two hundred silver coins wouldn't buy enough bread to give everyone only a little, philip replied.
target_text: ka pelipus dhaa, na, waa! masi ka gaji tuka ca dhèu dua ngasu lod'o èèna ka, d'ai mèka hèli roti ho panga'a dhèu udhu sobhu-sobhu se! masi ka ca dhèu abhu roti ciki oo'e èèna ka, pad'ai boe hèi!

source_text: one of his disciples, andrew, simon peter's brother, spoke up.
target_text: hèia, ca dhèu hari nèti ana madhutu na, ngara na anderias, ari simon petrus, peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na,

source_text: there's a boy here who has five barley loaves and a couple of fish, but what good is that when there are so many people?
target_text: ama! ana iiki èci ètu ne'e nèti roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u. te ngaa d'ai dhèu ae-ae se ra'a, do aad'o?

source_text: have everybody sit down, jesus said. there was plenty of grass there, so they all sat down, the men numbering around five thousand.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, j'u'u muri ae-ae. ka yesus peka dènge ana madhutu na, ator si madhèdi. hèia dhèu se madhèdi ka. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna. dhèu mone di, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: jesus took the bread, gave thanks, and had it handed out to the people as they sat there. then he did the same with the fishes, making sure the people had as much as they wanted.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti se, ka na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ka na pangèd'u mi ana madhutu na sèra. sèna ka rèngu bagi hia dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra. na tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge i'a sèra. dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: once they were all full, he said to his disciples, collect what's left over so nothing is wasted.
target_text: ropa ra'a toke bècu, hèia yesus peka dènge ana-ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, pakaboko mere nganga'a dhu sisa se'e, sèna ka baku core eele iia d'ara.

source_text: so they collected and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves the people had eaten.
target_text: ka ra pakaboko nganga'a dhu sisa nèti roti lèmi bua deo sa, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: when the people saw this miracle, they said, surely this is the prophet who was to come into the world.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae-ae se ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa dhu yesus tao ne, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! nèngu ne, tatu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu na jaji le neo hia mai.

source_text: jesus realized that they were about to force him to become their king, so he left them and went up into the hills to be by himself.
target_text: yesus ne'a, na, dhèu se neo laka-seti ne sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. hèia la'e tèke eele si, ka na ca'e asa era kaj'èu ètu ledhe iiki èci, sèna ka nèngu mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: when evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
target_text: ropa lod'o heka cèna, ana-ana madhutu yesus puru lasi asa sebhe dano.

source_text: climbed into a boat, and headed across the water towards capernaum. by now it was night and jesus had not joined them yet.
target_text: yesus mai mèka pa'èci dènge rèngu. ka ra ca'e koha cue, hèia ra tuku lasi asa kota kapernaum ètu cabèka dano. ropa rèngu pakèd'i, lod'o dhu maroga le.

source_text: a strong wind began blowing and the sea grew rough.
target_text: lula ngèlu aae, ka naha mulai kapai.

source_text: when they had rowed three or four miles, they saw jesus walking on the sea, coming towards the boat. they were very frightened.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yesus se'e tuku kaj'èu pe d'ai lèmi kilometer sa, hèia ladhe rèdhi yesus dhu kako re dedha èi. na mai padètu-dètu dènge koha rèngu, ka ra madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: don't be afraid! he told them. it's me.
target_text: te ngaa yesus lii dènge ra, aku nèngu na, baku madha'u! te ja'a ne.

source_text: then they gladly took him into the boat, and immediately they reached the shore where they were going.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu madha'u heka. aa ra neo sèna ka yesus ca'e sama-sama dènge rèngu. cag'ag'a laa, koha ne d'ai le dae dhu rèngu neo lasi.

source_text: the next day the crowd that had stayed on the other side of the sea noticed that there had been only one boat there, and that jesus had not got into the boat with his disciples, but they had left without him. then other boats arrived from tiberias, landing near to the place where they'd eaten the bread after the lord had blessed it. once the crowd realized that neither jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went over to capernaum, looking for jesus.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae sèra ètu cabèka dano era. rèngu padètu iiki dènge era dhu med'a na yesus manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, ropa hia si ra'a. hèia dhèu se re'a, na, med'a na koha dhoka cue di ètu era èèna. te ngaa ana madhutu yesus se pake koha ne, lasi tèke eele era ne'e, aa yesus dhu ca'e boe dènge rèngu. te ngaa abhu pèri-pèri koha leo nèti kota tiberias dhu lasi-mai ètu era èèna. hèia, ropa dhèu ae se re'a, na, yesus dènge ana-ana madhutu na dhu aad'o heka, ka ra ca'e koha leo sèra lasi tenge yesus asa kapernaum, ètu cabèka dano.

source_text: when they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, rabbi, when did you get here?
target_text: ka ra paraga dènge yesus ètu cabèka dano. hèia ra karèi yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese! ama d'ai era ne'e sange mera mia sa?

source_text: i tell you the truth, jesus replied, you're looking for me because you ate as much bread as you wanted, not because you understood the miracles.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: miu se tenge ja'a lula boe miu mèdhi le tadha-tadha malaa, te ngaa lula ja'a panga'a miu toke bècu.

source_text: don't be preoccupied about food that doesn't last, but concentrate on the lasting food of eternal life which the son of man will give you, for god the father has placed his seal of approval on him.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! baku sab'a tenge dhoka nganga'a di dhu bèli-camèd'a ele iie d'ara. te ngaa be'a risi miu sab'a sèna ka abhu nganga'a dhu taha taruu, dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ka dhu bisa hia miu mamuri èèna. te ama ètu sorga pangèd'u le hak mi ja'a ne.

source_text: so they asked him, what should we be doing in order to do what god wants?
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ji'i hud'i tao tasamia, sèna ka bisa pakako sasab'a ama lamatua?

source_text: jesus replied, what god wants you to do is to trust in the one he sent.
target_text: yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sasab'a lamatua, sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a ne. te ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: what miracle are you going to perform for us to see so we can trust you? what are you able to do? they asked.
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi hari, peka na, ama neo pad'elo tadha malaa sèmi ngaa, ho ji'i ngèdhi aa parcaya ama? aa ama neo tao ngaa hari hia ji'i?

source_text: our forefathers ate manna in the desert in fulfillment of the scripture that says, ‘he gave them bread from heaven to eat. '
target_text: nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki ji'i ra'a roti manna ètu d'ara mamoo. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, ‘nèngu hia si roti dhu mai nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka ra'a. '

source_text: i tell you the truth, it wasn't moses who gave you bread from heaven, jesus replied. it's my father who gives you the true bread of heaven.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, ja'a peka dhu lèke sèmi ne'e: uru èèna, musa boe ka dhu papuru roti èèna nèti dedha-liru hia mi bèi-baki miu. te dhu papuru mai roti èèna, nuka ama ku ètu sorga. limuri ne na sadia hia miu roti nèti liru kahèi. te ngaa roti ne'e ne, roti dhu tare'a-re'a taha toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for the bread of god is the one who comes from heaven and gives life to the world.
target_text: te roti nèti lamatua ne, nuka, dhu puru mai nèti sorga aa nèti mamuri hia mi dhèu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: lord, please give us this kind of bread all the time! they said.
target_text: hèia dhèu se manèngi, aku rèngu na, ama! hia taruu ji'i roti èèna!

source_text: i am the bread of life, jesus replied. anyone who comes to me will never be hungry again, and anyone who trusts in me will never be thirsty again.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka, roti èèna. te ja'a ka dhu kèti mamuri dhu lèke. de dhèu dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, manganga heka! aa dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, koko-kamango heka!

source_text: but as i explained to you before, you have seen me, but you still don't trust me.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka kèdhi le dènge miu, na, masi ka miu mèdhi le ja'a, te ngaa miu parcaya mèka ja'a.

source_text: all those the father gives me will come to me, and i won't reject any of them.
target_text: aa te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mai asa ja'a. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai asa ja'a, tatu ja'a babège eele boe ne!

source_text: for i came down from heaven not to do what i want, but to do what the one who sent me wants.
target_text: te ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. ja'a mai sèna ka sab'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. ja'a ko'o boe madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku.

source_text: what he wants is for me not to lose anyone he has given to me, but for me to raise them up at the last day.
target_text: dad'èi ama lamatua sèmi ne'e: nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, nèngu d'èi ja'a oru-kaboko si aa'i-aa'i. ja'a bisa boe soro tèke ca dhèu sa ele. te ngaa ladhe lod'o d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: what my father wants is for everyone who sees the son and trusts in him to have eternal life, and for me to raise them up at the last day.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu ja'a peka deo na, ama ku d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadhe aa parcaya ja'a, nuka ana na, èèna na rèngu bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. hèia ètu lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: then the jews began to grumble about him because he had said, i am the bread that came down from heaven.
target_text: ka ama-ama dhèu yahudi se mulai ka'uu-kamuki, lula yesus peka na, roti dhu mai nèti lamatua èèna, nuka ja'a dhu mai nèti sorga.

source_text: they said, isn't this jesus, the son of joseph? we know his father and his mother. so how can he now tell us, ‘i came down from heaven'?
target_text: ra padhai lii, peka na, tasamia ka sèmi ne'e? dhèu ne'e ne, yesus ana yusuf, si? ji'i tadhe ina-ama na. de tasamia ka nèngu ne peka na, ‘ja'a mai nèti sorga? ' abhu ètu mia?

source_text: stop grumbling to each other, jesus said.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, eee! loe eele ku ka'uu-kamuki!

source_text: no one can come to me unless the father who sent me attracts them, and i will raise them up at the last day.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa mai asa ja'a, ladhe ama ku lere boe ne mai. aa d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari si.

source_text: as is written in scripture by the prophets, ‘everyone will be taught by god. ' everyone who listens to and learns from the father comes to me.
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra suri rèdhi le, peka na, ‘ama lamatua neo aj'a-nori dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ' de dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu nanene ama ètu sorga, aa rèngu abhu aj'a-nori nèti nèngu, rèngu mai sa ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: not that anyone has seen god, except he who is from god; he has seen the father.
target_text: ja'a ne ka dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua. de dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku kèdhi ne. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu patoo madha dènge ama ètu sorga.

source_text: i tell you the truth: anyone who trusts in him has eternal life.
target_text: tare'a! ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: i am the bread of life.
target_text: te ja'a ne, nuka roti dhu nèti mamuri èèna.

source_text: your forefathers ate manna in the desert but they still died.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna lod'o ra kako rai-reo d'ara mamoo. masi ka ra'a le roti èèna, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu madhe kahèi.

source_text: but this is the bread that comes down from heaven, and anyone who eats it won't ever die.
target_text: te ngaa roti dhu limuri ne puru mai nèti sorga, leko-leo. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa ra'a. sasoa na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a, rèngu cèri eele heka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: i am the life-giving bread from heaven, and anyone who eats this bread will live forever. the bread is my flesh that i give so that the world may live.
target_text: lula ja'a ne, roti dhu nèti mamuri, dhu mai nèti sorga. pe ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a soro ngi'u ja'a sèna ka madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, ho ra bisa mamuri. aa dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: then the jews argued heatedly among themselves. how can this man give us his flesh to eat? they asked.
target_text: ropa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se tadèngi rare lii padhai yesus ne, hèia ra pab'ala èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, na padhai lii sèmi ngaa ka nèi? tasamia ka dhèu ne bisa hia ngi'u na, èdhi ta'e?

source_text: jesus told them, i tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the son of man and drink his blood, you cannot truly live.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, ja'a padhai lii dhu mola-mola dènge miu kèna. ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. dhèu dhu neo mamuri lèke, hud'i pa'èki ku dènge ja'a. de ladhe miu mi'a boe ngi'u ja'a, aa minu boe raa ja'a, na, miu abhu boe mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: those who eat my flesh and drink my blood have eternal life, and i will raise them up at the last day.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ra'e ngi'u ja'a, aa rinu raa ja'a, rèngu abhu le mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha, ja'a pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: for my flesh is true food, and my blood is true drink.
target_text: te nganga'a dhu lèke, nuka ngi'u ja'a. aa nganginu dhu lèke, nuka raa ja'a.

source_text: those who eat my flesh and drink my blood remain in me, and i remain in them.
target_text: de dhèu dhu ra'a ngi'u ja'a, dènge rinu raa ja'a, mamuri ra dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu.

source_text: just as the life-giving father sent me and i live because of the father, so anyone who feeds on me will live because of me.
target_text: ama ètu sorga dhu pua ja'a, nèngu mamuri tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke nèti nèngu kahèi. nèti èèna ka dhèu dhu na'e ngi'u ja'a, nèngu unu mamuri dhu lèke nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: now this is the bread that came down from heaven, not the kind your forefathers ate and still died. anyone who eats this bread will live forever.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki miu ra'a roti manna nèti dedha-liru. masi ka rèngu ra'a, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu rèngu madhe kahèi. te ngaa roti dhu mai nèti sorga ne, leko-leo. te dhèu dhu ra'a roti ne, bèli-camèd'a abhu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: jesus explained this while he was teaching in a synagogue at capernaum.
target_text: yesus aj'a j'ara se'e ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhèu yahudi cue ètu kota kapernaum.

source_text: many of his disciples when they heard it said, this is hard to accept! who can follow it?
target_text: dhèu ae dhu madhutu yesus. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii padhai na sèmi èèna, hèia abhu dhu peka na, a'aj'a na, bia! cee ka dhu bisa sèmi rare a'aj'a èèna?

source_text: jesus saw that his disciples were complaining about this, so he asked them, are you offended by this?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a le lii padhai rèngu se, hèia na karèi si, aku nèngu na, a'aj'a ne tao miu susa, do?

source_text: then what if you were to see the son ascend to where he was before?
target_text: tasamia hari, ladhe miu mèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ca'e hari asa era pea ja'a uru èèna?

source_text: the spirit gives life; the physical body doesn't do anything. the words i've told you are spirit and life!
target_text: roh lamatua ka dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke. mamuri dhu lèke mai boe nèti ngi'u dhèu. te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a kapua na nèti roh ama lamatua. de lii holo-nori ne'e bisa hia mamuri dhu lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i kahèi.

source_text: yet there are some of you who don't trust me. jesus had known from the very beginning who didn't trust him, and who would betray him.
target_text: te ngaa abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu lèka boe ja'a. yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèngu dhu ne'a le karèi nèti uru j'ara, cee dhu parcaya boe, aa cee ka dhu èèna na pahie eele nèngu.

source_text: jesus added, this is why i told you that no one can come to me unless it is made possible by the father.
target_text: hèia yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema le dènge miu, na, ama ku ètu sorga hud'i bhoke uuru ku j'ara hia dhèu, heka dhèu ne bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a kèna.

source_text: from this time on many of jesus' disciples gave up and no longer followed him.
target_text: karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ana madhutu na ae ka dhu tèke eele ne, lula rèngu ro'o heka madhutu nèngu.

source_text: then jesus asked the twelve disciples, what about you? you don't want to leave as well, do you?
target_text: ka yesus karèi ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, aku nèngu na, aa miu tasamia? neo tèke eele ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: simon peter answered, lord, who would we follow? you're the one who has the words of eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa simon petrus dhaa, peka na, ama! ji'i patai-patapa mi cee hari? abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa lole dènge ji'i, j'ara tasamia ji'i bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. dhoka èu mesa mu di!

source_text: we trust in you, and we're convinced that you are god's holy one.
target_text: aa ji'i lèka ama. lula ji'i dhu nge'a le, na, èu ne, nuka dhèu mola-mèci nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus replied, didn't i choose you, the twelve disciples? yet one of you is a devil.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ja'a hag'e kore le miu dhèu canguru dua. te ngaa sanèd'e! nèti miu se'e, abhu ca dhèu nuka sèmi nidhu!

source_text: jesus was referring to judas, son of simon iscariot. he was the one of the twelve disciples who would betray jesus.
target_text: dhu na peka ne, nuka yudas, ana simon iskariot. yudas ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra. nèngu ne'e ka dhu èèna na pahie yesus.

source_text: after this, jesus spent his time going from place to place in galilee. he did not want to do so in judea because the jews were out to kill him.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia yesus si kako palème propensi galilea. nèngu neo boe kako palème propensi yudea, lula abhu ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but as it was almost time for the jewish festival of the tabernacles,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela puu-g'ètu dhu ra peka na, kalela paleo.

source_text: his brothers told him, you ought to leave and go to judea so your followers will be able to see what miracles you can do.
target_text: ka ari yesus sèra peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, be'a risi, èu pakeso nèti ne'e, lamu asa yudea. sèna ka dhèu dhu madhutu èu ètu nèi, bisa ladhe rèdhi j'ara-j'ara dhu èu tao.

source_text: no one who wants to be famous keeps what they do hidden. if you can do such miracles, then show yourself to the world!
target_text: te ladhe cee dhu neo sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi kolo-karisi nèngu, na, nèngu baku tao pahuni-pahuni. lula èu dhu tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa, be'a risi hari, ladhe dhèu ae-ae bisa ladhe rèdhi ngaa dhu èu tao sèra!

source_text: for even his own brothers really didn't believe in him.
target_text: ari na sèra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhu lèka nèngu èra iia boe.

source_text: jesus told them, this is not my time to go, not yet; but you can go whenever you want, for any time's the right time for you.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lod'o ja'a dhae d'ai mèka. te ngaa ladhe miu neo lami, sad'i lake mere.

source_text: the world has no reason to hate you, but it does hate me, because i make it clear that its ways are evil.
target_text: dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tèka boe d'ara dènge miu. te ngaa rèngu tèka d'ara dènge ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele aa'i tatao rèngu. te d'ara ra bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: you go on to the festival. i'm not going to this festival because this is not the right time for me, not yet.
target_text: lod'o kalela agama èdhi dètu le. de miu ka laa lami asa yerusalem. ja'a neo mèka laku, te dhae d'ai mèka lod'o.

source_text: after saying this he stayed behind in galilee.
target_text: na peka nare, hèia na pea ètu propensi galilea.

source_text: after his brothers left to go to the festival, jesus also went, but not openly-he stayed out of sight.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ari na si lasi madhutu kalela agama dhèu yahudi ètu yerusalem, yesus madhutu kahèi. te ngaa la'e pahuni-pahuni, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi ne.

source_text: now at the festival the jewish leaders were searching for him and kept on asking, where is he?
target_text: ètu yerusalem, lod'o kalela agama dhèu yahudi, ama-ama dhèu yahudi patangi-tenge yesus. ra pakarèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia?

source_text: many people in the crowds were complaining about him. some said, he's a good man, while others argued, no! he deceives people.
target_text: dhèu ae dhu paka'uu lula-nèti nèngu. cahag'e peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu be'a. cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne dhu kapod'e-kabèli dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: but no one dared to speak openly about him because they were afraid of what the jewish leaders would do to them.
target_text: te ngaa abhu boe dhu pacèu lii padhai lula-nèti yesus, te rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama se.

source_text: when the festival was halfway through, jesus went to the temple and began to teach.
target_text: pas ètu talora kalela ne, yesus maso la'e asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka na aj'a dhèu ètu era èèna.

source_text: the jewish leaders were very surprised, and asked, how does this man have so much learning when he hasn't been educated?

source_text: however, because moses told you to circumcise-not that it really came from moses, but from your forefathers before him-you perform circumcision on the sabbath.
