source_text: if you circumcise on the sabbath to make sure that the law of moses isn't broken, why are you angry with me for healing someone on the sabbath?

source_text: don't judge by appearances; decide what is right!

source_text: then some of those from jerusalem began wondering, isn't this the one they're trying to kill?

source_text: but see how openly he's speaking, and they're saying nothing to him. do you think the authorities believe he's the messiah?

source_text: but that's not possible because we know where he comes from. when the messiah comes, nobody will know where he's from.

source_text: while he was teaching in the temple, jesus called out in a loud voice, so you think you know me and where i'm from? however, i did not come for my own sake. the one who sent me is true. you don't know him,
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus aj'a dhèu era ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa tadèngi dhèu se peka sèmi èèna, hèia na karèi si dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, miu pangee, na, miu se tadhe ja'a, aa me'a mèu ja'a mai nèti mia, do? ja'a ne, mai boe asa ne'e madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te dhu pua ja'a èèna, abhu tare'a-re'a. aa miu tadhe boe nèngu.

source_text: but i know him, for i come from him, and he sent me.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a tadhe ne, lula ja'a mai nèti nèngu, aa nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: so they tried to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him because his time had not yet come.

source_text: then jesus told the people, i'll be with you just a little longer, but then i'll return to the one who sent me.

source_text: you judge in a typically human way, but i don't judge anyone.

source_text: your own law states that the testimony of two witnesses is valid.

source_text: i am my own witness, and my other witness is my father who sent me.

source_text: jesus told them, you are from below; i am from above. you are of this world; i am not of this world.

source_text: that is why i told you that you'll die in your sins. for if you don't trust in me, the ‘i am, ' you'll die in your sins.

source_text: then they asked him, who are you? exactly who i told you i was from the beginning, jesus replied.

source_text: there's much i could say about you, and much i could condemn. but the one who sent me tells the truth, and what i'm saying to you here in this world is what i heard from him.

target_text: dhu nèngu padhue-padhai, nuka ama na ètu sorga. te ngaa dhèu se re'a rare boe sasoa lii padhai na.

source_text: so jesus explained to them: when you have lifted up the son of man then you'll know that i am the ‘i am, ' and that i do nothing of myself, but only say what the father taught me.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, pe ladhe miu ded'e ka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, heka miu me'a kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus. aa ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a aj'a-nori dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ama ètu sorga aj'a-nori le ja'a.

source_text: the one who sent me is with me; he has not abandoned me, for i always do what pleases him.

source_text: many who heard jesus say these things put their trust in him.
target_text: ropa yesus peka j'ara se'e, dhèu ae parcaya nèngu.

source_text: then jesus said to those jews who trusted in him, if you follow my teaching then you really are my disciples.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ladhe miu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge lii holo-nori ja'a, aa aj'a taruu nèti ja'a, na, miu bisa j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a dhu lèke.

source_text: you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
target_text: miu bisa me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèra ka dhu patabuli miu, sèna ka miu j'aj'i ia ka ènu.

source_text: we're descendants of abraham! we've never been anyone's slaves, they answered. how can you say that we'll be set free?
target_text: ka dhèu se pab'ala, aku rèngu na, hee! ji'i se, j'aj'i boe ènu dhèu! te ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! de, nga tao ka èu peka, na, èèna na ji'i bebas?

source_text: jesus replied, i tell you the truth, everyone who sins is a slave of sin.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, j'aj'i sama sèmi ènu dhu dhoka madhutu dad'èi sasala di.

source_text: a slave doesn't have a permanent place in the family, but the son is part of the family forever.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tema, sèmi ne'e: ènu se abhu boe pala nèti lamatua èmu na. te dhoka ana lamatua èmu di dhu abhu pala taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: if the son sets you free, then you're truly free.
target_text: de ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne, ladhe saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, na, miu bebas, aa j'aj'i heka ènu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. dènge j'ara ne, miu madhutu heka dad'èi sasala, aa tare'a-re'a bebas!

source_text: i know you're abraham's descendants, yet you're trying to kill me because you refuse to accept my words.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le miu se, ana-èpu abraham. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu loe boe patangi-tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ja'a, lula mo'o boe sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a. te ètu d'ara miu, abhu heka era tatèka lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: i'm telling you what the father has revealed to me, while you do what your father told you.
target_text: ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a kèdhi le, dhu ama ku paj'uj'u le dènge ja'a. aa miu tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu miu tadèngi le nèti ama-ama miu.

source_text: abraham is our father, they answered. if you really were children of abraham, you'd do what abraham did, jesus told them.
target_text: dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu j'aj'i tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham, miu hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri nèngu.

source_text: but you are trying to kill me now, because i told you the truth that i heard from god. abraham would never have done that.
target_text: te ngaa abraham tao boe bhabhelu sama sèmi dhu miu tao! te miu loe boe tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a. aa te ngaa ja'a ne, dhu peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: you're doing what your father does. well we are not illegitimate, they responded. god alone is our father!
target_text: tatao miu se mema beda boe nèti tatao ama miu. te ngaa rèngu pab'ala, aku rèngu na, heh! ji'i se, ana d'èlu! baku peka na ji'i se, ana ama aad'o! te ama ji'i, èci di, nuka ama lamatua!

source_text: jesus replied, if god really was your father, you would love me. i came from god and now i am here. the decision to come wasn't mine, but the one who sent me.
target_text: hèia, aku yesus na, ladhe ama lamatua tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ama miu, tatu miu sue ja'a. te ja'a mai nèti nèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a ka ne'e ne. ja'a mai ne madhutu boe dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a mai, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: why can't you understand what i'm saying? it's because you refuse to hear my message!
target_text: nga tao ka miu dhane mere boe lii padhai ja'a? ele boe, lula miu mema mo'o boe nanene!

source_text: your father is the devil, and you love to follow your father's evil desires. he was a murderer from the beginning. he never stood for the truth, because there is no truth in him. when he lies he reveals his true character, for he's a liar and the father of lies.
target_text: miu se, ca ropa dènge dhèu aae nidhu. te miu d'èi madhutu dad'èi na! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, nèngu d'èi dhoka pamadhe dhèu. nèngu lab'a j'ara dhu lèke, lula na tule eele j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke! ladhe na kapod'e-kabèli, mema sasab'a na kèna. te nèngu ne, tuka kapod'e-kabèli, aa baki nèti leko-monya!

source_text: so because i tell you the truth, you don't believe me!
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu lole j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ja'a.

source_text: can any one of you prove that i'm guilty of sin? if i'm telling you the truth, why don't you believe me?
target_text: pangee sèku! nèti miu se, cee ka dhu bisa pad'elo bukti, peka na, ja'a ne ad'u-ue sasala? malaa, nga! ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a?

source_text: anyone who belongs to god listens to what god says. the reason you don't listen is because you don't belong to god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i nèti ama lamatua nanene lii holo-nori na. te ngaa miu se j'aj'i boe nèti ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mo'o boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: aren't we right to call you a samaritan who is demon-possessed? said the jews.
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi b'ala, peka na, lii padhai ji'i lèke tare'a-re'a. te ji'i dhu peka le, na, èu ne, dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa dhèu samaria. èu ne nidhu tao!

source_text: no, i don't have a demon, jesus replied. i honor my father, but you dishonor me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a nidhu tao boe. ja'a pakab'ua ama ku ètu sorga, te ngaa miu mo'o boe pakab'ua ja'a.

source_text: i'm not here looking to glorify myself. but there is one who does this for me and who judges in my favor.
target_text: ja'a padedha boe iisi ho pad'elo kolo-karisi ja'a. te ngaa abhu èci dhu neo pad'elo dadedha ja'a. hud'i laa nèngu ka dhu pama'ète, na, lii padhai ja'a ne lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: i tell you the truth, anyone who follows my teaching will never die.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a, lèke tare'a. de dhèu dhu nanene aa tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe.

source_text: now we know you're demon-possessed, said the jews. abraham died, and the prophets did too, and you're telling us ‘anyone who follows my teaching will never die'!
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii ne, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, limuri ne ji'i nge'a le èu dhèu huj'u, lula nidhu tao le èu. te abraham, madhe. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, madhe le kahèi. te ngaa aku èu, na, ‘dhèu dhu nanene dènge madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe. ' mema èu ne tare'a-re'a huj'u le!

source_text: are you greater than our father abraham? he died, and the prophets died. who do you think you are?
target_text: do, èu ne pangee, na, èu ne kapai risi nèti abraham dhu madhe le? do, èu kapai risi nèti dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu madhe sèra? èu ngee, na, èu ne, cee?

source_text: jesus answered, if i glorify myself, my glory means nothing. but it is god himself who glorifies me, the one you claim, ‘he is our god. '
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe ja'a ka dhu padedha iisi, dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare. madhutu iia-iia, na, ja'a boe ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha iisi, te ngaa dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha nuka ama ku. nèngu ne'e ka dhu miu mangaku, na, nèngu j'aj'i ama lamatua miu.

source_text: you don't know him, but i know him. if i were to say, ‘i don't know him, ' i'd be a liar, just like you. but i do know him, and i do what he says.
target_text: te ngaa miu tadhe boe ne. dhu tadhe mèu ka ja'a ne. ladhe ja'a peka na ja'a tadhe boe ne, ja'a leko-monya, sama sèmi miu. te ngaa ja'a tadhe mèu ne, aa ja'a tao madhutu lii holo-nori na kahèi.

source_text: your father abraham was delighted as he looked forward to see my coming, and was so happy when he saw it.
target_text: d'ara baki miu abraham karej'e titu kèna, lod'o na tatae neo nèdhi mamai ja'a. nèngu mema nèdhi le, ka na karej'e-karae.

source_text: the jews replied, you're not even fifty years old, and you've seen abraham?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi se b'ala ne, aku rèngu na, umur èu dhae d'ai mèka lèmi nguru tèu sa hèi! te ngaa èu peka na, mèdhi le abraham. tare'a, do?

source_text: i tell you the truth, before abraham was born, i am, said jesus.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te dhae rara iisi mèka abraham, ja'a dhu mema-mema le.

source_text: at this they picked up stones to stone him, but jesus was hidden from them and he left the temple.
target_text: ka dhèu se rare hadhu ho neo pèci ne, lula na tao iisi sama sèmi ama lamatua. te ngaa yesus kako mau-mau kalua nèti madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: as jesus was passing by, he saw a man born blind.
target_text: hèia yesus si kako taruu. ka na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu, dhu bèdhu karèi nèti ina na nara iisi nèngu.

source_text: his disciples asked him, rabbi, why was this man born blind? was it him who sinned, or was it his parents?
target_text: hèia ana-ana madhutu na karèi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! cee ka tao sasala, ka dhèu ne bèdhu? nèti nèngu mesa na, do, nèti ina-ama na?

source_text: jesus replied, it wasn't because of the sins of the man or his parents. but so that what god can do may be shown in his life,
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu bèdhu ne tao boe sala. aa ina-ama na aad'o kahèi. rara iisi na sèmi ne'e, ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi tatao ama lamatua dhu be'a mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: we have to keep on doing the work of the one who sent me as long as it is still daytime. the night is coming when no one can work.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a. de èdhi hud'i tenge j'ara, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na, lod'o saraa era. te ladhe maroga mai, dhèu bisa heka sab'a.

source_text: while i'm here in the world i am the light of the world.
target_text: ropa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era, ja'a nuka sèmi saraa dhu d'elo hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: after he'd said this, jesus spat on the ground and made some mud with the saliva which he put on the man's eyes.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka na paru'e ilu mi rai. hèia na madhèdi pasaboti, ho pakihu rai ne j'aj'i kabheca. ka na lame musi madha dhèu ne dènge kabheca deo na.

source_text: then jesus told him, go and wash in the pool of siloam which means sent. so the man went and washed, and when he went home he could see.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, lamu asa kolam siloam, sèna ka riu rèhu èu. ètu d'ara lii ibrani, siloam, sasoa na, ‘nèti mai'. ka dhèu bèdhu ne la'e, ka riu rèhu na. ropa na lèpa hari mai, nèngu bisa nèdhi le!

source_text: his neighbors and those who had known him as a beggar, asked, isn't this the man who used to sit and beg?
target_text: hèia rae lesa dènge dhèu dhu rèdhi ne, dhu tema manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu bèdhu dhu tema madhèdi ho kanata ai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, sina ma?

source_text: some said he was, while others said no, it's just someone who looks like him. but the man kept saying, it is me!

source_text: so how is it you can see? they asked him.
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi?

target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu dhu ngara yesus èèna, pakihu kabheca ka lame mi musi madha ja'a. ka na pua ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘lamu asa kolam siloam, ho riu rèhu èu ètu nèi. ' hèia ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa ladhe kèdhi le!

source_text: where is he? they asked. i don't know, he replied.
target_text: èle ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia? ka na dhaa, ke'a boe, mia la'e!

source_text: they took the man who had been blind to the pharisees. now it was the sabbath when jesus had made the mud and opened the blind man's eyes.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa yesus pakihu rai j'aj'i kabheca, ka puri-pa'èle dhèu bèdhu ho bisa ladhe nèdhi èèna, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka lere rèti dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, asa madha dhèu-dhèu partei agama parisi.

source_text: so the pharisees also asked him how he could see. he told them, he put mud on my eyes, and i washed, and now i can see.

source_text: so they went on questioning the man. what's your opinion about him, then, since it's your eyes he opened, they asked. he's surely a prophet, the man replied.

source_text: the jewish leaders still refused to believe that the man who had been blind could now see until they had called in the man's parents.
target_text: te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe lèka, na, dhèu ne uru èèna bèdhu, ka limuri ne bisa nèdhi le. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ina-ama na mai.

source_text: they asked them, is this your son whom you say was born blind? so how is it that now he can see?
target_text: ropa ina-ama na mai d'ai madha si, hèia ama-ama se karèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, ana miu, do? tare'a, do aad'o, nèngu ne dhu bèdhu mema karèi nèti mera iisi ne? tasamia ka limuri ne nèngu bisa ladhe nèdhi?

source_text: his parents answered, we know this is our son who was born blind.
target_text: ka ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu ne, mema ana ji'i. aa na bèdhu karèi nèti ngara iisi ne.

source_text: but we've no idea how he can see now, or who healed him. why don't you ask him, he's old enough. he can speak for himself.

target_text: dua ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. lula re'a, na, ama-ama dhèu yahudi se dhu rare le lii èci, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu mangaku, na, yesus ne, nuka kristus, na, babège eele dhèu sèra nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: that was why his parents said, ask him, he's old enough.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu kapai le. de karèi ne.

source_text: once more they called in the man who had been blind, and told him, give god the glory! we know this man is a sinner.
target_text: hèia ra paroa hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu. ka ra karèi ne, sèmi ne'e! èu hud'i peka ku mola-mola ètu madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aga paie kolongara na. te ji'i nge'a, na, yesus ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: the man replied, whether he's a sinner or not, i don't know. all i know is that i was blind and now i can see.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ama si baku nasa! te ja'a ke'a boe, na, nèngu èèna, dhèu bhelu, do aad'o. dhu ja'a ke'a mola-mola, nuka, uru èèna ja'a bèdhu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: then they asked him, what did he do to you? how did he open your eyes?

source_text: they shouted abuse at him, and said, you're that man's disciple.
target_text: ka ra padhai pa-aape ne, hèia ra peka, hud'i laa èu ka j'aj'i ana madhutu na! te ji'i se, ana madhutu musa.

source_text: we're disciples of moses. we know that god spoke to moses, but as for this person, we don't even know where he comes from.
target_text: ji'i nge'a ama lamatua ka dhu padhai lii dènge musa. te ngaa nge'a boe dhèu èèna bhodho nèti ro'a mia.

source_text: the man answered, that's incredible! you don't know where he comes from but he opened my eyes.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu na, dhaa, ja'a malaa, nga! miu me'a boe nèngu mai nèti mia. aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu bhoke pamèu musi madha ja'a, ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: we know that god doesn't listen to sinners, but he does listen to anyone who worships him and does what he wants.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, na, ama lamatua parluu boe nanene lii dhèu bhelu, si? te ngaa ama lamatua nanene dhèu d'ara mola, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: never before in the whole of history has anyone heard of a man born blind being healed.
target_text: karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e, abhu mèka lii lolo èci sa hèi, lula-nèti dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a dhèu bèdhu karèi rara iisi ne, ho nèngu bisa nèdhi.

source_text: if this man weren't from god, he could do nothing.
target_text: de ladhe yesus mai boe nèti ama lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, sina ma?

source_text: you were born totally sinful, and yet you're trying to lecture us, they replied. and they threw him out of the synagogue.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! èu ne, dhèu bhelu karèi ina mu nara iisi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa aj'a hari ji'i, do? ka ra babège eele dhèu ne nèti èmu sabaj'a rèngu.

source_text: when jesus heard that they had thrown him out, he went and found the man, and asked him, do you trust in the son of man?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi rèngu babège eele dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu nèti èmu sabaj'a ra, hèia na la'e tenge dhèu ne, toke abhu. ka na peka, tasamia! èu parcaya dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, do?

source_text: the man replied, tell me who he is, sir, so i can put my trust in him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari ne, aku nèngu na, ama, te nèngu èèna cee? peka ku laa, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne.

source_text: you've already seen him. he's the one speaking with you now! jesus told him.
target_text: hèia yesus peka, na, èu paraga le dènge ne. nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a ne, dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: i trust you, lord! he said, and he kneeled in worship before jesus.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a parcaya! hèia na patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi mi yesus.

source_text: then jesus told him, i've come into the world to bring judgment so that those who are blind may see, and those who see will become blind.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka pad'elo sasala-sasigo dhèu, ho dhèu bèdhu bisa ladhe rèdhi, aa dhèu dhu rèdhi bisa j'aj'i bèdhu.

source_text: some pharisees who were there with jesus asked him, we're not blind too, are we?
target_text: ètu era èèna abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, tasamia! ji'i se bèdhu boe, sina ma?

source_text: jesus answered, if you were blind, you wouldn't be guilty. but now that you say you see, your guilt remains.
target_text: yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe musi madha miu bèdhu, abhu boe dhu pasala miu. te ngaa lula miu peka, na, miu bisa mèdhi, nèti èèna ka miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: i tell you the truth, anyone who doesn't come in through the gate of the sheepfold but climbs in some other way is a thief and a robber.
target_text: yesus padhai lii pake lii pakasame, peka na, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. abhu kahib'i-kalèbho dènge oka ra. ladhe dhèu maso boe re hèb'a oka, te ngaa ca'e re kolo oka, na, te'a le, nèngu ne, dhèu mana'u.

source_text: the one who comes in through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe maso re hèb'a oka, nuka dhèu madhenga dhu piara kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: the gatekeeper opens it for him, and the sheep respond to his voice. he calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
target_text: dhèu j'aga hèb'a oka, tadhe dhèu madhenga kahib'i-kalèbho, hèia na bhoke babèdho hia nèngu. kahib'i-kalèbho se tadhe lii dhèu madhenga badha kahèi. ka ropa dhèu madhenga ne paroa ngara ra èci-èci, kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne asa li'u.

source_text: after bringing them out, he walks ahead of them, and the sheep follow him because they recognize his voice.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhenga ne neo nèti si asa mia, nèngu kako uuru. kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne re limuri, lula ra tadhe lii na.

source_text: they won't follow strangers. in fact they run away from a stranger because they don't recognize the voice of strangers.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kahib'i-kalèbho tadhe boe, na, rèngu madhutu boe ne. te ngaa ra rai pakaj'èu, lula rèngu tadhe boe lii dhèu leo.

source_text: when jesus gave this illustration those who were listening to him didn't understand what he meant.
target_text: masi ka yesus lole lii pakasame ne hia dhèu se'e, te ngaa re'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: so jesus explained again, i tell you the truth: i am the gate of the sheep.
target_text: ka yesus peka tabha hari dènge dhèu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a lole dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ja'a ne nuka sèmi hèb'a oka kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: all those who came before me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai uuru nèti ja'a, rèngu sama sèmi dhèu mana'u. masi ka rèngu loe boe paroa, te ngaa kahib'i-kalèbho se nanene boe lii rèngu.

source_text: i am the gate. anyone who comes in through me will be healed. they will be able to come and go, and find the food they need.
target_text: aa ja'a ne èci èèna ka dènge hèb'a oka èèna. ladhe abhu dhèu neo maso re ja'a, ama lamatua neo patabuli ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. èèna sama sèmi nèngu la'e asa era ama lamatua, maso re ja'a dhu j'aj'i hèb'a oka. aa dhèu dhu maso re ja'a, nèngu neo asa mia èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, dènge abhu na'a-ninu dhu be'a.

source_text: the thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy. i've come to bring you life, life full to overflowing.
target_text: dhèu mana'u re'a dhoka tao maruru di, te rèngu mai ho mana'u, pamadhe dhèu, aa pa'ele iie mamuri dhèu. te ngaa ja'a kèti mamuri dhu hua iia titu kèna, te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mera-milu, aa unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: i am the good shepherd. the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
target_text: ja'a kahèi nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. te dhèu madhenga dhu be'a, sadia saraka ngi'u na toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho na bisa mamuri.

source_text: the man paid to look after the sheep is not the shepherd and he runs away when he sees the wolf coming. he abandons the sheep because they're not his, and the wolf attacks and scatters the flock
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu lamatua boe nèti kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, ropa nèdhi busa hui mai, na rai pakaj'èu, tèke eele kahib'i-kalèbho se. hèia busa hui ne kadhi nare kahib'i-kalèbho, ka rèngu cahag'e rai paceb'a.

source_text: for the man is only working for pay and doesn't care about the sheep.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èèna rai, lula nèngu dhoka sab'a tenge doi di. na pusi-pahae boe j'aga paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: i am the good shepherd. i know who are mine, and they know me,
target_text: lèke tare'a! ja'a ne nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. ja'a tadhe hua iia kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a sèra. aa rèngu tadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: just as the father knows me and i know him. i lay down my life for the sheep.
target_text: èèna, èci èèna ka dènge ama ku ètu sorga tadhe ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe nèngu kahèi. ja'a sadia kore le ho soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a bisa mamuri.

source_text: i have other sheep that are not in this sheepfold. i must bring them too. they will listen to my voice and there will be one flock with one shepherd.
target_text: abhu kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu leo era, dhu dhae kaboko kore mèka sèna ka pa'èci dènge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu se'e se. ja'a hud'i eo pa'oru kore si mi ca era kahèi. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii ja'a, rèngu tadhe dènge. hèia ra mai pa'èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ca kaboko dhu dènge dhèu madhenga èci.

source_text: this is why the father loves me, because i lay down my life so i may take it up again.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a. te ja'a dhu sadia le soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: no one takes it from me; i choose to lay it down. i have the right to give it up, and i have the right to take it back. this is the command my father gave me.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu laka-seti ja'a ho madhe, te ngaa ja'a mesa ku soro iisi la'a toke madhe. ja'a dènge hak ho soro ngi'u ja'a, aa dènge hak kahèi sèna ka kore hari. paredha ne, dhu ja'a sèmi kore le nèti ama ku ètu sorga.

source_text: the jews were again divided in their opinion about jesus over these words.
target_text: lula dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi se pab'ala hari isi-aanga ra.

source_text: many of them said, he's demon-possessed! he's mad! why are you listening to him?
target_text: abhu dhèu ae nèti rèngu dhu peka na, dhèu ne, huj'u! aa nidhu tao ne! nga tao ka miu d'èi nanene ne?

source_text: others said, these aren't the words of someone who's demon-possessed. besides, a demon can't open eyes that are blind.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e peka na, ne'e ne nèti boe lii padhai dhèu huj'u, sina ma? lii padhai sèmi se'e se, kalua boe nèti d'ara hèb'a nidhu! aa nidhu sèra bisa boe kahèi puri-pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu, si?

source_text: it was winter, and the time of the festival of dedication in jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi neo tao kalela agama rèngu. lod'o be'a ne, lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. pesta ne, pasanèd'e dhèu yahudi lod'o dhu dhèu leo mai pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra pamèu ne sèna ka ringi hari ca tèka.

source_text: jesus was walking in the temple through solomon's porch. the jews surrounded him, asking,
target_text: yesus kako palème ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, ètu era dhu ra pangare na, ‘paleo dhèu aae soleman'.

source_text: how long are you going to keep us hanging in suspense? if you are the messiah then tell us plainly!
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi mai lingu rare ne, ka ra peka, eeh! ji'i se mate toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari, ho nge'a? ladhe èu ne, nuka kristus, na, peka mola-mola.

source_text: jesus replied, i already told you but you refuse to believe it. the miracles i do in my father's name prove who i am.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka. aa te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao, aa'i-aa'i madhutu paredha ama ku di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pad'elo, na, ja'a ne, cee.

source_text: you don't believe me because you are not my sheep.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a, lula miu se kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a boe.

source_text: my sheep recognize my voice; i know them, and they follow me.
target_text: te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu tare'a sèra, tadhe lii ja'a. rèngu madhutu ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe rèngu kahèi.

source_text: i give them eternal life; they shall never be lost, and no one can snatch them from me.
target_text: ja'a hia si mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, aa rèngu cèri eele boe nèti ama lamatua kahèi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa parame rare si nèti ja'a.

source_text: my father who gave them to me is greater than anyone else; no one can snatch them from him.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka dhu pangèd'u rèngu mi ja'a. nèngu èra risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa parame rare si nèti nèngu.

source_text: i and the father are one.
target_text: te ama ku dènge ja'a ne, èci.

source_text: once again the jews picked up stones to stone him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se rare hari hadhu, neo pèci pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus said to them, you've seen many good deeds that i've done from the father. which one are you stoning me for?
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a pad'elo le j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae nèti ama ku. miu pake j'ara be'a mia, ho neo pèci pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the jews replied, we're not stoning you for a good deed, but for blasphemy because you are just a man but you're claiming to be god.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i pèci boe èu lula èu tao j'ara be'a. te ngaa ji'i huku èu dènge j'ara pèci pake hadhu, lula èu pahahe ama lamatua. te èu dhoka dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa tao iisi mu nuka sèmi ama lamatua! seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: jesus answered them, isn't it written in your law, ‘i said, you are gods'?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia? ètu d'ara atora agama dhu miu mèd'u, dhu suri na, ‘ja'a peka mema, na, miu ama-ama se, dewa'.

source_text: he called those people ‘gods, ' the people to whom the word of god came-and scripture can't be altered.
target_text: èdhi te'a le, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lèke, aa bisa boe core eele. ama lamatua mesa na dhu peka le dhèu sèra, na, rèngu se, ‘dewa'.

source_text: so why are you saying the one whom the father set apart and sent into the world is blaspheming because i said ‘i am the son of god'?
target_text: de tasamia ka miu bisa peka, na, ja'a ne pahahe ama lamatua lula ja'a peka, na, ja'a ne ana ama lamatua? maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, si! te ama ètu sorga ka dhu paj'uj'u ja'a aa pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: if i'm not doing what my father does, then don't believe me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. ladhe ja'a pakako boe sasab'a-la'a ama ku, na, miu baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but if that is what i'm doing, even though you don't believe me, you should believe because of the evidence of what i've done. that way you can know and understand that the father is in me, and i am in the father.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pakako taruu sasab'a ama ku. de masi ka miu lèka boe ja'a, te ngaa miu hud'i sèmi mere ku tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa me'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: once again they tried to arrest him, but he escaped from them.
target_text: ka dhèu se sèku kèpe ne hari, te ngaa na tabhèli eele nèti kacui-aai rèngu.

source_text: he went back across the jordan river to the place where john had begun baptizing, and he stayed there.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e hari asa cabèka loko yarden, ètu era dhu uru èèna yohanis sarani dhèu. ka na pea taha ètu nèi.

source_text: many people came to him, and they said, john didn't perform miracles, but everything he said about this man has come true.
target_text: dhèu ae mai tenge ne. hèia ra peka, aku rèngu na, yohanis tao nèdhi boe tadha malaa. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu lole lula-nèti yesus ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: many who were there put their trust in jesus.
target_text: ka dhèu ae ètu nèi parcaya yesus.

source_text: a man named lazarus was sick. he lived in bethany with his sisters mary and martha. mary was the one who had anointed the lord with perfume and wiped his feet with her hair. it was her brother lazarus who was sick.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lasarus. nèngu pea ètu rae betania, sama-sama dènge a'a na bhèni dhèu dua, maria dènge marta. maria ne'e, ka dhu pakose haga lamatua yesus dènge èi hèu mèngi, ka pamèu pake rèu kètu na. ca lod'o, ka lasarus pèd'a aae.

source_text: so the sisters sent a message to jesus: lord, your close friend is sick.
target_text: ka ana hèni na dhèu dua se pa'adhu lii moa hia yesus, aku rèngu na, lasarus, angalai ama èèna, pèd'a aae.

source_text: when jesus heard the news he said, the end result of this sickness will not be death. through this god's glory will be revealed so that the son of god may be glorified.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii moa ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èi papèd'a ne nèti boe mamadhe. ama lamatua neo pake j'ara ne'e ho pad'elo dadedha na. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne.

source_text: even though jesus loved martha, mary, and lazarus,
target_text: yesus sue marta, maria, dènge ari ra lasarus.

source_text: and had heard that lazarus was sick, he remained where he was for two more days.
target_text: lod'o na tadèngi, na, lasarus dhu pèd'a, yesus pea dua lod'o era ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: then he told the disciples, let's return to judea.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mai lati hari asa era pea lasarus ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: the disciples replied, rabbi, just a few days ago the jews were trying to stone you. do you really want to go back there now?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na pab'ala, peka na, ama mese. lai-lai ne, ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra neo pèci pamadhe ama ètu nèi. te ngaa ama neo lamu hari asa nèi?

source_text: aren't there twelve hours in a day? jesus replied.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, baku madha'u! bèli-bèli, nèti lod'o rea toke lod'o cèna, canguru dua jam, si? ladhe kako ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu kadhunu boe. te saraa pasaraa rai-haha ho dhèu bisa ladhe rèdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: if you walk during the day you don't stumble because you can see where you're going by the light of this world. but if you walk during the night you stumble because you have no light.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga, na kadhunu pahari-pahari, te dènge boe saraa.

source_text: after telling them this, he said, our friend lazarus has fallen asleep, but i'm going to go there and wake him up!
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, ka na peka, angalai èdhi lasarus bhèj'i le. te ngaa pe ja'a laku parèi ne.

source_text: the disciples said, lord, if he's sleeping then he'll get better.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu na peka, na, ama, ladhe nèngu bhèj'i di, sasoa na, èèna na nèngu èle nèti papèd'a, si?

source_text: jesus had been referring to the death of lazarus, but the disciples thought he meant actual sleep.
target_text: ra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, yesus padhai lii lula-nèti bhèj'i dhu biasa di. aa te ngaa, yesus lole lula-nèti mamadhe lasarus.

source_text: so jesus told them plainly, lazarus is dead.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mola-mola dènge ra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lasarus madhe le.

source_text: for your sake i'm glad i wasn't there, because now you will be able to trust in me. let's go and see him.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a karej'e lula ja'a aad'o ètu nèi lod'o dhu na madhe mèka, sèna ka miu baku susa. te, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne'e, èèna ka dhu tao miu bisa parcaya ja'a. mai lati ka!

source_text: thomas, the twin, said to his fellow-disciples, let's go too so we can die with him.
target_text: hèia tomas, dhu dhèu paroa, na, ana kembar, peka dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, mai ka! be'a risi aa'i-aa'i ti lati, sèna ka madhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: when he arrived, jesus learned that lazarus had been in the tomb for four days. bethany was just two miles from jerusalem, and many jews had come to console mary and martha at the loss of their brother.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi asa rae betania. rae ne, kaj'èu nèti yerusalem tèlu kilometer di. ka dhèu yahudi nèti nèi, ae ka dhu mai beke, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara marta dènge maria. ropa yesus si d'ai nèi, heka re'a, na, dhèu padhane le lasarus èpa lod'o kèna.

source_text: when martha found out that jesus was coming, she went to meet him, but mary stayed at home.
target_text: ka lod'o marta tadèngi, na, yesus mai le, hèia la'e paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa maria mate ètu èmu.

source_text: martha said to jesus, lord, if you'd been here, my brother wouldn't have died.
target_text: hèia marta lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama, ee! ladhe ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: but i'm certain that even now god will give you whatever you ask.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a parcaya kahèi, sad'i ama manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama lamatua, tatu abhu.

source_text: jesus told her, your brother will rise again.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, marta! èèna na, ari mu mamuri hari.

source_text: i know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day, martha answered.
target_text: marta padhai lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i, nèngu pamamuri hari kahèi ari ja'a.

source_text: jesus said, i am the resurrection and the life. those who trust in me will live, even though they die.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu madhe mamuri hari. ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu, mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. de dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, abhu mamuri èèna, masi ka nèngu madhe.

source_text: all who live in me and trust in me will never die. do you believe this?
target_text: ka dhèu dhu unu mamuri dhu lèke èèna, aa parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe, te ngaa mamuri taruu. marta, èu parcaya lii padhai ja'a ne, do?

source_text: yes, lord, she replied, i believe you are the messiah, the son of god, the one expected to come to this world.
target_text: hèia marta dhaa, na, oo, ama! ja'a parcaya, na, èu ne, nuka kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa èu ne, ana ama lamatua dhu na padhadha tèke hia mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: when she had said this, she went and told her sister mary in private, the teacher's here, and asking to see you.

target_text: ne'e ne palèke dènge lii yesaya, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua! abhu boe dhèu dhu parcaya lii padhai ji'i! te masi ka lamatua pad'elo le koasa, te ngaa dhèu sèra ladhe rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: they were not able to trust him, and as a result they fulfilled what isaiah also said:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu yahudi cahag'e parcaya boe lamatua, lèke sèmi dhu yesaya suri tèke ètu era leo d'ara sasuri na, peka na,

source_text: he blinded their eyes, and made their minds dull, so that their eyes would not see, and their minds would not think, and they would not turn to me-for if they did i would heal them.
target_text: ama lamatua pabèdhu le d'ara ra, sèna ka baku rèdhi ngaa-ngaa. na soro tèke d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu, sèna ka baku re'a mèu. soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka baku ra lèpa tenge ja'a, aa ja'a tao boe pabe'a si.

source_text: isaiah saw jesus' glory and said this in reference to him.
target_text: yesaya peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèdhi le dadedha yesus, ka na lole mema lula-nèti yesus ne.

source_text: even so many of the leaders did trust in him. however, they did not openly admit it because they did not want the pharisees to expel them from the synagogue,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu parcaya yesus. mesa boe dhèu biasa di, te abhu kahèi ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa rèngu mangaku boe yesus ètu madha dhèu ae, lula ra madha'u, mage dhèu parisi babège eele si nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: loving human admiration more than god's approval.
target_text: ama-ama yahudi se pusi-pahae boe ho lamatua koa si, lula rèngu d'èi risi abhu koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: jesus called out, if you trust in me you're not just trusting in me but also in the one who sent me.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, nèngu parcaya boe ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèngu parcaya kahèi dhèu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: when you see me, you're seeing the one who sent me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi ja'a, na, nèngu ladhe nèdhi kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i have come as a light shining into the world, so if you trust in me you won't remain in the dark.
target_text: ja'a mai sèna ka j'aj'i nuka sèmi saraa ètu rai-haha ne. ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: i don't judge anyone who hears my words but doesn't do what i say. i came to save the world, not to judge it.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ja'a, te ngaa madhutu boe, na, ja'a pama'ète boe hahuku na. te mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, neo boe pama'ète hahuku dhèu, te ngaa ja'a neo patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: anyone who rejects me and does not accept my words will be judged at the end-time judgment in accordance with what i have said.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tule eele ja'a, aa d'èi boe sèmi lii holo-nori ja'a, pe na paraga dènge hakim. te d'ai èle rai-haha ne, lii holo-nori dhu ja'a lole kèdhi sèra, ka dhu pama'ète hahuku mi dedha rèngu èci-èci.

source_text: for i'm not speaking for myself but for my father who sent me. he is the one who instructed me what to say and how to say it.
target_text: lula ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka pake kolongara ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a padhai lii kèti kolongara ama ku ètu sorga. te nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. aa nèngu ka dhu paredha ja'a, sèna ka ja'a padhai lii ngaa.

source_text: i know that what he told me to say brings eternal life-so whatever i say is what the father told me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, lii paredha na hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai ja'a madhutu mola-mola ngaa dhu ama ku pua ja'a padhai lii.

source_text: it was the day before the passover festival, and jesus knew that the time had come to leave this world and go to his father. he had loved those in the world who were his own, and he now demonstrated his complete love for them.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhae d'ai mèka, yesus ne'a le, na, d'ai le lod'o ho nèngu tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa la'e hari asa ama na ètu sorga. nèngu sue titu kèna dhèu unu na ètu rai-haha ne, toke na saraka mamuri na kateme aae hia mi rèngu.

source_text: it was during supper, and the devil had already put the thought of betraying jesus into the mind of judas, son of simon iscariot.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu-rariu le yudas, ana simon iskariot, sèna ka pahie eele yesus. ka yudas dhu pama'ète le, sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èèna, ropa yesus si madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu d'ara kalela paska.

source_text: jesus knew that the father had placed everything under his authority, and that he had come from god and was going back to god.
target_text: yesus ne'a mema le, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, de nèbhu heka nèngu lèpa hari la'e asa ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ama na ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: so jesus stood up from eating supper, took off his robe and wrapped a towel around his waist.
target_text: hèia yesus kèd'i nèti mei, ka na tao eele kodho li'u na. nare bèla èci, ho èki mi lalole na.

source_text: he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples' feet, drying them with the towel he had wrapped around him.
target_text: ka na bhori èi asa d'ara bokor iiki cue. hèia na rase haga ana madhutu na sèra. ropa na rase pamèu nare haga dhèu èci, na seka pamango pake bèla dhu pa'èki ètu lalole na.

source_text: he came to simon peter, who asked him, lord, are you going to wash my feet?
target_text: na rase haga si èci-èci. ropa d'ai simon petrus, ka simon petrus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo rase haga ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: jesus replied, you won't realize what i'm doing for you now. but one day you'll understand.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, deo ne'e ne, èu dhae me'a mèka ngaa dhu ja'a tao ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, èu heka me'a kèna.

source_text: no! peter protested. you'll never wash my feet! jesus replied, if i don't wash you, you have no part with me.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasisu, aku nèngu na, ama baku tao sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe ama rase haga ja'a. hèia yesus peka na, ladhe ja'a rase pamèu boe haga èu, na, èu bisa boe pa'èki dènge ja'a.

source_text: then, lord, wash not just my feet but my hands and my head as well! simon peter exclaimed.
target_text: ka simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, mesa boe haga di. te ngaa ama rase kacui-aai dènge kètu ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus responded, those who have had a bath only need to wash their feet and then they're clean all over. you are clean-but not all of you.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu diu le èi, parluu dhoka rase haga di. te ngi'u na mèu le. mema tare'a d'ara miu mèu le, te ngaa miu aa'i mi boe.

source_text: for he knew who was betraying him. that's why he said, not all of you are clean.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula ne'a le cee ka dhu neo pahie ne. nèti èèna ka, na peka na, miu aa'i mi boe dhu mèu.

source_text: after jesus had washed their feet, he put his robe back on, and sat down. do you understand what i've done to you? he asked them.
target_text: ropa yesus pamèu nare haga si, hèia na silu hari kodho na, ka madhèdi hari asa mei. ka na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, tasamia? ropa ja'a rase haga miu, miu me'a sasoa nèti dhu ja'a tao ne, do aad'o?

source_text: you call me ‘teacher' and ‘lord, ' and rightly so, for that's who i am.
target_text: miu tema paroa ja'a ne, ‘ama mese' aa ‘lamatua'. èèna lèke kèna, lula mema hud'i sèmi èèna ku.

source_text: so if i, your teacher and lord, washed your feet, you ought to wash one another's feet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mese dènge lamatua miu ne, rase le haga miu nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha sa, na, tasamia hari dènge miu? miu hud'i lalau-lalo'o isi-aanga mi èci dènge èci; conto nuka: miu hud'i èci dènge èci rase haga mi.

source_text: i have set you an example, so you should do just as i did.
target_text: te ja'a tao le j'ara ne, sèna ka miu madhutu. ladhe ja'a tao tasamia, na, miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: i tell you the truth, servants are not more important than their master, and the one sent is not greater than the sender.
target_text: ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge miu. ca dhèu ènu bisa boe risi nèti lamatua na. aa ca dhèu pajuu-paleha bisa boe risi nèti dhèu dhu pua nèngu.

source_text: now that you understand these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, miu oto ladhe miu tao madhutu.

source_text: i'm not talking about all of you-i know those i have chosen. but this is to fulfill scripture: ‘the one who shares my food has turned against me. '
target_text: ja'a padhai lii boe lula-nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. ja'a tadhe mèu dhèu dhu ja'a hag'e kore. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa j'ara ne hud'i j'aj'i ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘dhèu dhu madhèdi na'a-ninu pa'èci dènge ja'a, soro kabodho mi ja'a le. '

source_text: i'm telling you this now, before it happens, so when it does happen you will be convinced that i am who i am.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu, ho ladhe abhu dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele ja'a, na, miu bisa parcaya kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus.

source_text: i tell you the truth, whoever welcomes anyone i send welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me, welcomes the one who sent me.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu tare'a-re'a kèna, dhèu cee dhu bhoke d'ara na ho sèmi nare dhèu dhu ja'a pua, na, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ja'a. aa cee ka dhu sèmi nare ja'a dènge be'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: after he had said this, jesus was deeply troubled, and declared: i tell you the truth, one of you is going to betray me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia d'ara na mulai susa. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ca dhèu nèti miu, èèna na pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: the disciples looked at each other, wondering which of them jesus was talking about.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ana-ana madhutu na palaladha èci dènge èci, te rèngu malaa. re'a boe na, cee ka dhu nèngu peka.

source_text: the disciple whom jesus loved was sitting next to jesus at the table, leaning close to him.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu yesus sue nuka ja'a, yohanis dhu suri sasuri ne. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus.

source_text: simon peter motioned to him to ask jesus which one he was talking about.
target_text: hèia simon petrus pangètu kètu, ho ja'a karèi yesus, cee ka dhu na peka èèna.

source_text: so he leaned over to jesus and asked, lord, who is it?
target_text: ka ja'a eso padètu dènge yesus, ho karèi ne, dhèu dhu ama peka ne, cee?

source_text: jesus replied, it's the one to whom i will give a piece of bread after i have dipped it.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo kore roti ca'èta, ho cèb'u asa d'ara mago ne. èèna na ja'a hia mi dhèu dhu ja'a peka deo na. ka yesus cèb'u nare roti ne asa d'ara mago, hèia na j'ole asa yudas, ana simon iskariot.

source_text: after dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to judas, son of simon iscariot. once judas had taken the bread, satan entered him. what you're going to do, do it quickly, jesus told him.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare roti ne, hèia dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas. ka yesus peka dènge ne, èu neo tao ngaa, na, tao ka lai-lai. pamata ia ka.

source_text: no one at the table understood what jesus meant by this.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo dhu madhèdi ètu sèra re'a rare boe, nga tao ka yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: since judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that jesus was telling him to go and buy what was needed for the passover festival, or to donate something to the poor.
target_text: lula yudas dhu tèke doi-dhari, ka abhu dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, peka na, lamu hèli ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka tao pesta paska. aa abhu kahèi dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, lamu hia doi d'ai ciki sa, mi dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèra.

source_text: judas left immediately after he'd taken the piece of bread, and went out into the night.
target_text: ropa yudas sèmi nare roti ne, hèia la'e dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kalua èèna, dhu mèda le.

source_text: after he'd left, jesus said, now the son of man is glorified, and through him god is glorified.
target_text: ropa yudas la'e, hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. d'ai lod'o kèna, ho ama lamatua ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. aa nèti j'ara ne'e, dhèu rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: if god is glorified through him, then god will glorify the son himself, and will glorify him immediately.
target_text: lula ja'a pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa pad'elo dadedha na, nèti èèna ka na ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a. na pamata heka.

source_text: my children, i will be with you only a little while longer. you will look for me, but i'm telling you now just as i told the jews: you cannot come where i'm going.
target_text: ana aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ja'a sue miu titu kèna, te ngaa nèbhu heka ja'a pa'ana-lalu eele miu. èèna na miu patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe. lii dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, èci èèna ka dènge dhu ja'a lole dènge ama dhèu yahudi sèra, na, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa mèka madhutu. '

source_text: i am giving you a new command: love one another. love one another in the same way i have loved you.
target_text: ja'a hia miu lii paredha hiu èci, nuka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu. de miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: if you love one another you will prove to everyone that you are my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu pasue sèmi èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, miu se, ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: simon peter asked him, where are you going, lord? jesus answered, you can't follow me now where i'm going. you will follow me later.
target_text: ka simon petrus karèi, peka na, te ama neo lamu mia? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku asa era èci dhu èu bisa mèka lamu. te ngaa lod'o limuri ku, heka èu lamu kèna.

source_text: lord, why can't i follow you now? peter asked. i'll lay down my life for you.
target_text: petrus karèi hari, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ja'a bisa mèka laku hèi? te ja'a dhu pa'èra iisi le ho madhe pala ama!

source_text: are you really ready to die for me? i tell you the truth: before the cock crows you will deny me three times, jesus replied.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, do? èu neo soro mamuri èu sèna ka madhe pala ja'a? dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e: manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te ngaa èu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: don't be anxious. trust in god, trust in me as well.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, d'ara miu baku susa. parcaya mi ama lamatua, aa parcaya mi ja'a kahèi.

source_text: in my father's house there are many rooms. if this wasn't so i would have told you. i'm going to prepare a place for you.
target_text: ètu èmu ama ku abhu kama ae-ae. ladhe era d'ai boe, tatu ja'a peka le dènge miu. ne'e ne, ja'a neo laku sadia tèke era hia miu ètu nèi.

source_text: once i've gone and prepared a place for you, i will come again and take you back with me, so that you can be there with me too.
target_text: ladhe ja'a laku aa sadia kore era pea hia miu, pe ja'a lèpa hari mai kore miu ho lati pea asa nèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe ja'a ètu mia, na, miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: you know the way to where i'm going.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara asa era dhu ja'a neo laku.

source_text: thomas said to him, lord, we don't know where you're going. how can we know the way?
target_text: te ngaa tomas karèi, peka na, ama! ji'i nge'a boe ama neo lamu mia. de tasamia ka ji'i nge'a j'ara ho la'a asa nèi?

source_text: jesus replied, i am the way and the truth and the life. no one comes to the father except through me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, abhu boe j'ara leo dhu bisa nèti dhèu asa ama ètu sorga. dhodhoka re ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te ja'a ne ka j'ara asa ama lamatua. ja'a ne ka kapua mamola. aa ja'a ne'e ka dhu hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: if you had known me, you would know my father as well. from now on, you do know him and you have seen him.
target_text: ladhe miu tadhe mèu ja'a, na, miu tadhe ama ku kahèi. de karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, miu tadhe nèngu le, dènge mèdhi ne kahèi.

source_text: philip said, lord, show us the father, and we'll be convinced.
target_text: pelipus manèngi, peka na, ama mese! pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i! te èèna d'ai le.

source_text: jesus replied, have i been with you such a long time, philip, and yet you still don't know me? anyone who has seen me has seen the father. how can you say, ‘show us the father'?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pelipus. ja'a sama-sama dènge miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, te ngaa miu tadhe iia mèka ja'a, do? te dhèu dhu nèdhi le ja'a, èèna sama sèmi nèngu nèdhi le ama ku. de, nga tao ka deo na èu peka na, ‘pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i'?

source_text: don't you believe that i live in the father and the father lives in me? the words i speak are not mine; it's the father living in me who is doing his work.
target_text: tasamia kèna? lod'o ja'a peka na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama, aa ama pa'èki dènge ja'a, èu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o? lii padhai dhu ja'a peka dènge miu sèra, mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku. aa na pake ja'a sèna ka sab'a taruu sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: believe me when i tell you that i live in the father, and the father lives in me, or at least believe because of the evidence provided by all that i've done.
target_text: parcaya la mi ja'a ropa ja'a peka na, ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge ama ku, aa nèngu pa'èki dènge ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu bisa boe parcaya sèmi èèna, na, parcaya la ja'a, lula miu mèdhi le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: i tell you the truth, anyone who trusts in me will do the same things i am doing. in fact they will do even greater things because i am going to the father.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a se, lèke! te dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na nèngu bisa tao j'ara dhu ja'a tao kahèi. te ngaa, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku, ka ngaa dhu dhèu tao sèra, kapai risi nèti dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: i'll do whatever you ask in my name, so that the father may be glorified through the son.
target_text: miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, unu hak pake kolongara ja'a. de ladhe miu sabaj'a sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake la kolongara ja'a, pe èèna na ja'a tao hia miu. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a ded'e ama ku padedha-dedha, sèna ka hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a.

source_text: whatever you ask for in my name, i will do it.
target_text: ja'a peka hari ca tèka: miu sabaj'a ho sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na ja'a tao hia miu.

source_text: if you love me, you will keep my commands.
target_text: yesus peka tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra.

source_text: i will ask the father, and he will give you another comforter, the spirit of truth, who will always be with you. the world cannot accept him because it isn't looking for him and doesn't know him. but you know him because he lives with you and will be in you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama ku, sèna ka, lod'o ja'a dènge heka miu, na, nèngu hia miu ca dhèu era sarai-maena, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. nèngu ne, nuka roh lamatua, dhu aj'a-nori miu ngaa dhu lèke. dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha ne ro'o boe sèmi rare ne, lula rèngu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi nèngu, aa tadhe boe nèngu. te ngaa miu tadhe ne, lula na pa'èki dènge miu. aa na muri ètu d'ara miu. èèna na, nèngu dènge miu taa-taa.

source_text: i will not abandon you like orphans: i will come back to you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele boe miu mesa mi, nuka sèmi ana lalu-eela. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari mai asa miu.

source_text: soon the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. because i live, you will live too.
target_text: nèbhu heka, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne rèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa miu mèdhi ja'a. lula ja'a mamuri hari, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: on that day you will know that i live in the father, you live in me, and i live in you.
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, miu me'a mèu, na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama ku; miu pa'èki dènge ja'a; aa ja'a pa'èki dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: those who keep my commands are the ones who love me, those who love me will be loved by my father. i will love them too, and will reveal myself to them.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi rare, aa tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, nèngu ka dhu sue ja'a. aa ama ku sue kahèi dhèu dhu sue ja'a. ja'a sue dhèu èèna kahèi, aa pad'elo iisi ja'a dènge ne.

source_text: judas not iscariot responded, lord, why would you reveal yourself to us and not to the world?
target_text: ètu era ne, abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. nèngu ne, yudas iskariot boe. ropa na tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo pad'elo iisi mi ji'i. te ngaa tasamia ka ama pad'elo boe iisi mi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne?

source_text: jesus replied, those who love me will do as i say. my father will love them, and we will come and make our home with them.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu dhu sue ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a. ama ku sue nèngu kahèi. ka ja'a dènge ama ku mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne.

source_text: those who don't love me don't do what i say. these words don't come from me, they come from the father who sent me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sue boe ja'a, nèngu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ja'a kahèi. aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi nèti ja'a, mai boe nèti ja'a, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i'm explaining this to you while i'm still here with you.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka tèke j'ara se'e dènge miu.

source_text: but when the father sends the comforter, the holy spirit, in my place, he will teach you everything and remind you of all that i told you.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, ama ku pua mai ca dhèu era sarai-maena, nuka roh mola-mèci na. roh ne'e ka dhu gati ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. sasab'a na, nuka: aj'a-nori miu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, dènge pasanèd'e miu j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a padhue-padhai le dènge miu.

source_text: peace i leave with you; my peace i'm giving you. the peace i give you is nothing like what the world gives. don't be anxious, and don't be afraid.
target_text: pe, ladhe d'ai lod'o ja'a laku, ja'a tao d'ara miu ho mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu bisa tao d'ara mera-milu sèmi èèna. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha ne bisa boe tao rare d'ara miu mera-milu sèmi èèna. de miu baku susa, aa baku madha'u.

source_text: you've heard me tell you, ‘i am going away, but i will come back to you. ' if you really loved me, you would be happy because i'm going to the father, for the father is greater than i.
target_text: miu tadèngi mèdhi le, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a tèke eele miu, te ngaa èèna na mai hari. ' d'ara miu baku susa. te ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, d'ara miu karej'e-karae, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku. ama ku kapai risi nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: i've explained this to you now before it happens so that when it does happen you will be convinced.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ja'a dhu peka mema le dènge miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe j'ara se j'aj'i ku, na, miu bisa parcaya ja'a.

source_text: i can't talk to you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming. he has no power to control me,
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a padhai lii heka dènge miu. te dhèu aae nidhu dhu mai le. nèngu nèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa koasa na lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: but i'm doing what my father told me to do so that the world will know that i love the father. now get up. let's go.
target_text: masi ka nidhu ne mai, te ngaa ja'a sab'a taruu madhutu paredha ama ku. ne'e ne ka dhu pad'elo dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, na, ja'a sue ama ku titu kèna. de mai lati ka!

source_text: i am the true vine, and my father is the gardener.
target_text: yesus padhai lii, peka na, nanene! miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. ja'a ne sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. te ngaa ja'a ne, aj'u anggor dhu lèke! aa ama ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka.

source_text: he cuts off every one of my branches that doesn't bear fruit. he prunes every branch that bears fruit so it can bear even more.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, te ngaa sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa, ama ku core eele ne, sama sèmi dhèu sab'a oka dhu pare eele aa'i dadana dhu hua boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge ja'a, ama ku pamèu kaj'alu ètu d'ara dhèu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka poro pabab'a dadana, sèna ka hua na asa ae.

source_text: you are already pruned and made clean through what i've told you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: remain in me, and i will remain in you. just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it remains part of the vine, so it is for you: you cannot bear fruit unless you remain in me.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki taruu ku dènge ja'a, sama sèmi ja'a pa'èki dènge miu. te dadana dhu pare eele le nèti laa na, bisa boe hua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa dhu be'a, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a.

source_text: i'm the vine, you're the branches. those who remain in me, and i in them, will produce plenty of fruit-for apart from me you can't do anything.
target_text: ja'a sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. miu nuka sèmi dadana nèngu. de dhèu dhu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi, na, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge dadana dhu hua ae-ae. te, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a, miu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a.

source_text: anyone who doesn't remain in me is like a branch that is thrown out and dries up. such branches are gathered together, thrown into the fire and burned.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki boe taruu dènge ja'a, nèngu cakaraa dadana èci dhu guna heka. dadana sèmi èèna, dhèu poro eele, sèna ka pamango eele ne. hèia pakaboko ho core asa d'ara ai, tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: if you remain in me, and my words remain in you, then you can ask for whatever you want, and it will be given you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: my father is glorified as you produce plenty of fruit, proving you are my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: as the father loved me, so i have loved you. remain in my love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if you do what i say, you will remain in my love, just as i do what my father says and remain in his love.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: i've explained this to you so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: this is my command: love one another as i have loved you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: there is no greater love than to give your life for your friends.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: you're my friends if you do what i tell you.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: i don't call you servants any longer, for servants are not taken into their master's confidence. i call you friends, for everything my father told me i've explained to you.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: you didn't choose me, i chose you. i have given you the responsibility to go and produce lasting fruit. so the father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: this is my command to you: love one another.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: if the world hates you, remember that it hated me before it hated you.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if you were part of this world, it would love you as its own. but you're not part of the world, and i chose you out of the world-that's why the world hates you.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: remember what i told you: servants aren't more important than their master. if they persecuted me, they will persecute you too. if they did what i told them, they would do what you tell them too.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: but everything they do to you will be because of me, for they don't know the one who sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i hadn't come and spoken to them, they wouldn't be guilty of sin-but now they have no excuse for their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: anyone who hates me hates my father as well.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i had not given them such a demonstration through things that no one had ever done before, they wouldn't be guilty of sin, but despite seeing all this they hated both me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: but this just fulfilled what scripture says, ‘they hated me for no reason at all. '
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: but i will send you the comforter from the father. when he comes, he will give evidence about me. he is the spirit of truth who comes from the father.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: you will also give evidence about me because you were with me from the beginning.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

source_text: i've told you this so you won't give up your trust in me.
target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they will expel you from the synagogues-in fact the time is coming when those who kill you will think they are doing god a service.
target_text: èèna na dhèu yahudi sèra babège eele miu nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra. mesa boe j'ara ne'e di, te bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ladhe dhèu pamadhe miu, ra pangee, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke hia ama lamatua.

source_text: they'll do this because they have never known the father or me. i've told you this so that when these things happen, you'll remember what i told you.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: i didn't need to tell you this right at the beginning because i was going to be with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: but now i'm going to the one who sent me, and yet not one of you is asking me, ‘where are you going? '
target_text: yesus aj'a tabha hari, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. te ngaa abhu boe nèti miu ca dhèu sa dhu karèi, na, ‘ama neo lamu mia? '

source_text: of course, now that i've told you, you're full of grief.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: but i'm telling you the truth: it's better for you that i go away, for if i don't the comforter won't come to you. if i go away, i will send him to you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: when he comes, he will convince those in the world that they have wrong ideas regarding sin, about what is right, and about judgment:
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: sin, for they don't trust in me.
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: what is right, for i'm going to the father and you won't see me any longer.
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: judgment, for the ruler of this world has been condemned.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: there's much more i want to explain to you, but you couldn't stand it now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: however, when the spirit of truth comes, he will teach you the whole truth. he doesn't speak for himself, but he only says what he hears, and he will tell you what's going to happen.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he brings me glory for he teaches you whatever he receives from me.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: all that belongs to the father is mine. this is why i said that the spirit teaches you whatever he receives from me.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: in a little while you won't see me anymore, but then a little while after that you will see me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: some of his disciples said to one another, what does he mean, ‘in a little while you won't see me, but a little while after that you will see me'? and ‘for i'm going to the father'?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: they were asking, what does he mean by ‘in a little while'? we don't know what he's talking about.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: jesus realized that they wanted to ask him about this. so he asked them, are you wondering about my comment, ‘in a little while you won't see me, but a little while after that you will see me'?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: i tell you the truth, you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice. you will grieve, but your grief will turn into joy.
target_text: be'a kahèi, ladhe miu neo me'a sèmi èèna. ja'a neo peka dènge miu kahèi sèmi ne'e: èèna na miu tangi dènge d'ara susa, te ngaa dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne karej'e-karae. masi ka d'ara miu susa, te ngaa èèna na d'ara miu karej'e-karae hari.

source_text: a woman in labor suffers pain because her time has come, but once the baby is born, she forgets the agony because of the joy that a child has been brought into the world.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: yes, you're grieving now, but i will see you again; and you will rejoice, and no one can take away your joy.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: when that time comes you won't need to ask me about anything. i tell you the truth, the father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: until now you haven't asked for anything in my name, so ask and you shall receive, and your happiness will be complete.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: i've been talking to you using picture language. but shortly i won't use such picture language any more when i speak to you. instead i'll explain the father to you very plainly.
