target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: at that time you will ask in my name. i'm not saying to you that i will plead with the father on your behalf,
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: for the father himself loves you-because you love me and believe that i came from god.
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i left the father and came into the world; now i leave the world and return to my father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: then the disciples said, now you're talking very plainly and not using picture language.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now we're certain that you know everything, and that in order to know what questions people are thinking you don't need to ask them. this convinces us that you came from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: are you really convinced now? jesus asked.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: the time is coming-in fact it's just about to happen-when you will be scattered, each of you to your own homes, leaving me all alone. but i'm not really alone, for the father is with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: i've told you all this so that you may have peace because you are one with me. you will suffer in this world, but be brave-i have defeated the world!
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: when jesus finished saying this he looked up to heaven and said, father, the time has come. glorify your son so that the son may glorify you. for you gave him authority over all people so that he might give eternal life to all those you have given to him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: eternal life is this: to know you, the only true god, and jesus christ whom you sent.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have brought glory to you here on earth by completing the work you gave me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: now father, glorify me in your presence with the glory i had with you before the beginning of the world.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i have revealed your character to those you gave me out of the world. they belonged to you; you gave them to me; and they have done what you said.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: i have given them the message that you gave me. they accepted it, completely convinced that i came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i'm praying for them-not for the world, but for those you gave me, for they belong to you.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.

source_text: all who belong to me are yours, and those who belong to you are mine, and i have been glorified through them.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i unu ja'a, sèra sa unu ama kahèi. aa aa'i-aa'i unu ama, sèra sa unu ja'a kahèi. ka dhèu unu ja'a se, dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: i am leaving the world, but they will remain in the world; i am coming to you. holy father, protect them in your name, the name that you gave to me, so that they may be one, just as we are one.
target_text: ja'a pea boe taruu ètu rai-haha ne, lula nèbhu heka ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku. te ngaa dhèu se hud'i pea taruu ètu rai-haha ne. ama dhu mola-mèci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ladhe-leru si pake koasa dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a. ja'a manèngi kahèi ho rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ja'a pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci dènge ama.

source_text: while i was with them, i protected them in your name that you gave to me. i watched over them so that no one was lost except the ‘son of the lost, ' so scripture was fulfilled.
target_text: karèi nèti ja'a ètu rai-haha ne bera-bera dènge rèngu, ja'a leru si, lula rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu ama. ja'a j'aga aa sanoro si, sèna ka rèngu pa'èki taruu dènge ama. abhu boe dhu ele. dhodhoka yudas di dhu cèri eele, madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua karèi nèti uru èèna.

source_text: now i'm coming to you, and i say these things while i am still here in the world so they may share completely in my joy.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. ja'a peka le j'ara se'e lod'o ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era. dènge sèmi ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a se d'ara rèngu bisa karej'e-karae taruu, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i gave them your message, and the world hated them because they are not of the world, just as i'm not of the world.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka-padhai le dènge rèngu lii holo-nori ama. dhèu leo ètu rai-haha tèka d'ara dènge dhèu unu ja'a, lula mamuri dhèu ja'a, sama boe dènge mamuri rèngu. ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi, te ja'a sama boe sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i'm not asking you to take them out of the world, but for you to protect them from the evil one.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sabaj'a, ja'a manèngi boe ho ama more si nèti rai-haha ne. aad'o! te ngaa ja'a manèngi, ho ama j'aga si, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu.

source_text: they are not of the world, just as i'm not of the world.
target_text: rèngu sama boe dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a dhu sama boe kahèi dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: make them holy by the truth; your word is truth.
target_text: pake ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka pamèu d'ara ra. te dhu lèke ka, lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: just as you sent me into the world, i have sent them into the world.
target_text: ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pua-paleha rèngu kahèi sèmi èèna, sèna ka rèngu mamuri pale-lème ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: i dedicate myself for them so that they may also be truly holy.
target_text: ja'a j'aga ngi'u ja'a ho mola-mèci taruu hia mi ama. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a j'aga mamuri ra kahèi sèna ka mola-mèci hia mi ama. te lii holo-nori ama dhu lèke, dhu tao si ho ra saraka mamuri rèngu kateme mi ama.

source_text: i'm not only praying for them, i'm also praying for those who trust in me because of their message.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii manèngi-mangaj'i na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sabaj'a, mesa boe hia mi dhèu limuri ne'e di, te ngaa hia rèngu dhu lod'o limuri dhu parcaya ja'a kahèi, lula lii padhai dhèu se'e.

source_text: i pray that they all may be one, just as you, father, live in me, and i live in you, so that they too may live in us so that the world will believe you did send me.
target_text: ama, ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, sama sèmi èdhi pa'èki j'aj'i èci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i èci dènge èdhi, ho hud'i laa dhèu rai-haha ne bisa parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i have given them the glory that you gave me, so that they may be one, just as we are one.
target_text: ama pad'elo le dadedha ja'a mi dhèu sèra. ka ja'a ded'e le rèngu padedha-dedha sama sèmi ja'a. dènge jara ne'e, rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i èci, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi j'aj'i èci.

source_text: i live in them, and you live in me. may they be completely one, so the whole world will know that you did send me, and that you love them, just as you love me.
target_text: ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu. ama kahèi pa'èki dènge ja'a. rèngu hud'i pa'èki j'aj'i èci sèmi èèna ku, toke ra mamuri d'ara èci dènge be'a. te ladhe rèngu mamuri d'ara èci sèmi èèna, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne re'a, na, ama dhu sue si, nuka sèmi ama sue ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu re'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: father, i want those you have given me to be with me where i am, so they can see the glory which you gave to me-for you loved me before the world was created.
target_text: ama, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo, sèna ka rèngu bisa ladhe rèdhi ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. te ama sue ja'a mema-mema le, lod'o èdhi dhae paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne.

source_text: good father, the world does not know you, but i know you, and these here with me know that you sent me.
target_text: ama pasue dhu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tadhe boe ama. ja'a tadhe ama. aa dhèu unu ja'a re'a kahèi, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i have revealed your character to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love you have for me will be in them, and i will live in them.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka le dènge rèngu, ama ne, cee. aa èèna na ja'a loe boe peka dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, lula ja'a d'èi ho rèngu re'a mèu sasue ama. te sasue dhu rèngu re'a rèdhi ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge sasue ama mi dedha ja'a, sèna ka hud'i laa ja'a pa'èki taruu dènge rèngu.

source_text: after jesus had finished speaking, he and his disciples crossed over the kidron brook and went into an olive grove.
target_text: ropa yesus manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia la'e palere-lere dènge ana madhutu na. lasi asa d'ara oka cue ètu sebhe loko kidron.

source_text: judas the betrayer knew the place, for jesus had often gone there with his disciples. so judas took with him a troop of soldiers together with guards from the chief priests and the pharisees. they arrived there carrying torches, lanterns, and weapons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei agama parisi saraka mi yudas, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri. te nèngu neo pahie eele yesus. yudas ne'a oka ne kahèi, lula yesus pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na ètu era ne'e pèri-pèri hari le. ka yudas si lasi asa oka ne rèti dènge ob'o, labhu lantera dènge rèka.

source_text: jesus knew everything that was going to happen to him. he went to meet them, and asked, who are you looking for?
target_text: aa te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a uru le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na j'aj'i. hèia ara la'e asa madha rèngu, ka na lii, peka na, miu tenge cee?

source_text: are you jesus of nazareth? they asked. i am, jesus told them. judas the betrayer was standing with them.
target_text: ka ra b'ala, na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka ne'e. lod'o èèna, yudas dhu titu dènge dhèu se'e. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pahie yesus.

source_text: when jesus said i am, they fell back and dropped to the ground.
target_text: ropa yesus peka na, ja'a ka ne'e, hèia dhèu se hari kabodho, ka ra bèbha.

source_text: so he asked them again, who are you looking for? are you jesus of nazareth? they asked again.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari, na, miu tenge cee? hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: i already told you i am, jesus replied. so if i'm the one you're looking for, let these others go.
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, deo na ja'a peka kore le, na, nèngu ka ja'a ne. de ladhe miu tenge ja'a, na, baku kèpe dhèu leo. hud'i si lasi.

source_text: these words fulfilled what he had previously said: i have not lost any of those you gave me.
target_text: nèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, sèna ka pamèci dènge ngaa dhu nèngu peka nèdhi le, na, ama. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, abhu boe èci sa dhu ele.

source_text: then simon peter drew a sword and struck malchus, the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus nèti dènge samala iiki èci. ka na bete ho neo pare dhèu. kabèdhi laa, na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne ngara na malkus. nèngu ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus told peter, put the sword away! do you think i shouldn't drink the cup the father has given me?
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus, aku nèngu na, we, petrus! pasaluu hari samala èu èèna asa d'ara sope la'e. te ama ku dhu peka le, na, ja'a hud'i paraga ku dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. de hud'i laa! èèna nuka sèmi nèngu hia ja'a galaa èci dhu isi na pèd'u-èd'u. hud'i laa ja'a kinu toke èle.

source_text: then the soldiers, their commander, and the jewish guards arrested jesus and tied his hands.
target_text: hèia komedhaa, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe yesus, ka ra èki ne.

source_text: first they took him to annas, the father-in-law of caiaphas, the current high priest.
target_text: ka lere rèti uuru ne asa anas. anas ne, ama dhèu èmu kayafas. tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: caiaphas was the one who had told the jews, it's better that one man die for the people.
target_text: kayafas ne'e ka dhu peka nèdhi le dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi, aku nèngu na, be'a risi hia miu, ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: simon peter followed jesus, and another disciple did so too. this disciple was well-known to the high priest, and so he entered the high priest's courtyard with jesus.
target_text: simon petrus dhu madhutu yesus re limuri palere-lere dènge ana madhutu yesus èci, nuka ja'a, yohanis ne. lula kètu kapai risi agama yahudi tadhe ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa maso kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus asa madha èmu na.

source_text: peter had to remain outside by the door. so the other disciple who was known to the high priest went and spoke to the servant girl watching the door and brought peter inside.
target_text: te ngaa petrus titu ètu li'u, padètu dènge hèb'a tedhe. hèia ja'a laku asa li'u, ho peka dènge dhèu bhèni èci dhu j'aga hèb'a tedhe ne, sèna ka kèti petrus asa d'ara.

source_text: the girl asked peter, aren't you one of that man's disciples? me? no, i'm not, he replied.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne karèi petrus, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne, ca dhèu ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o!

source_text: it was cold, and the servants and guards were standing by a fire they had made, warming themselves. peter went and stood with them, warming himself.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu madhenga dènge ana pua-paleha sèra dhu titu manyiru ai. ka petrus la'e manyiru ai sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: then the chief priest questioned jesus about his disciples and what he had been teaching.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu kapai risi dhui nèti agama yahudi parisa yesus lula-nèti a'aj'a na, aa lula-nèti ana madhutu na.

source_text: i've spoken openly to everyone, jesus replied. i always taught in the synagogues and in the temple where all the jewish people meet. i haven't said anything in secret.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge nèngu, aku nèngu na, ja'a peka paled'a, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa tadèngi. ja'a tema aj'a ètu era dhu biasa dhèu yahudi èdhi pakaboko, nuka ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi, dènge ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ja'a padhai lii pahuni kèdhi boe.

source_text: so why are you questioning me? ask the people who heard me what i told them. they know what i said.
target_text: nga tao ka èu karèi ja'a? karèi la dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai ja'a. te, tatu re'a ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai.

source_text: when he said this, one of the guards standing nearby slapped jesus, saying, is that any way to speak to the high priest?
target_text: ropa na padhai lii sèmi èèna, dhèu j'aga èci dhu titu ètu èèna, tèb'e yesus, ka na peka na, èu baku padhai lii sèmi èèna dènge kètu kapai risi.

source_text: jesus replied, if i said something wrong, tell everyone what was wrong with it. but if what i said was right, why did you hit me?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii sale, na, pad'elo mia dhu sale nèti lii padhai deo na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka èu tèb'e ja'a?

source_text: annas sent him, his hands still tied, to caiaphas the high priest.
target_text: èle ka, anas pua dhèu lere ne asa kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o lere rèti ne, yesus dhu ra èki era.

source_text: as simon peter stood warming himself by the fire, the people there asked him, aren't you one of his disciples? peter denied it and said, no, i'm not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus titu manyiru ai era. ka dhèu leo dhu ètu èèna, karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, peka na, aad'o!

source_text: one of the high priest's servants, a relative of the man whose ear peter had cut off, asked peter, didn't i see you in the olive grove with him?
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu sab'a èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. nèngu ne, pa'a'ari kahèi dènge dhèu dhu petrus pare pama'ète rèu dhilu na. hèia dhèu ne karèi petrus, peka na, waa! deo na, èu ne ètu d'ara oka nèi, si? te ja'a kèdhi èu ètu nèi!

source_text: peter denied it again, and immediately a cock crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: early in the morning they took jesus from caiaphas to the palace of the roman governor. the jewish leaders didn't enter the palace because if they did they would become ceremonially unclean and they wanted to be able to eat the passover meal.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, lere rèti yesus nèti kayafas asa èmu jabatan gubernur ètu benteng sordad'u roma. dhèu yahudi se maso boe asa èmu dhèu roma, te èèna pakaj'alu rèngu. te ladhe ra maso, na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a pesta paska.

source_text: so pilate came out to meet them. what charge are you bringing against this man? he asked.
target_text: hèia gubernur pilatus la'e asa li'u paraga dènge dhèu yahudi se. ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu pèci sasala ngaa mi dedha dhèu ne'e?

source_text: if he wasn't a criminal, we would not have handed him over to you, they answered.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a boe, na, tatu ji'i mai boe asa madha ama. ngaa hari ji'i mai saraka ne asa kacui-aai ama.

source_text: then you take him and judge him according to your law, pilate told them. we're not permitted to execute anyone, the jews answered.
target_text: ka gubernur peka dènge dhèu se, na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa miu ka dhu uri lii langu na, madhutu atora miu dhèu yahudi. hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, peka na, bisa boe ama. ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge heka hak ho pama'ète hahuku madhe. dhoka miu dhèu paredha roma di dhu dènge hak èèna.

source_text: this fulfilled what jesus had said about how he would die.
target_text: lii padhai lii rèngu èèna, palèke dènge lii padhai dhu uru èèna yesus peka nèdhi le. te nèngu dhu peka le dènge dhèu unu na sèra, na, nèngu madhe madhutu j'ara paredha roma, nuka ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: pilate went back into the governor's palace. he summoned jesus, and asked him, are you the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur maso hari asa d'ara benteng sordad'u. ka na paroa yesus, hèia na karèi, peka na, èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do?

source_text: did you think of this question yourself, or did others talk to you about me? jesus responded.
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama ka peka sèmi èèna, do abhu dhèu leo ka dhu peka dènge ama lula-nèti ja'a?

source_text: am i a jew? pilate countered. it was your own people and high priests who handed you over to me. what is it that you've done?
target_text: hèia gubernur dhaa, na, eee! ja'a ne dhèu yahudi boe. ana kabarai èu mesa mu ka dhu saraka èu. ngaa hari kètu agama yahudi sèra. èu ne, tao sala ngaa? èu peka sèku!

source_text: jesus answered, my kingdom is not of this world. if it was of this world, my subjects would fight to keep me from being handed over to the jews. but my kingdom is not from here.
target_text: ka yesus peka na, ja'a ne, dhèu aae boe nèti rai-haha ne. te ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae sama sèmi èèna, tatu dhèu-dhèu ja'a palab'a le, ka dhèu yahudi kèpe boe ja'a. tare'a, ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ca dhèu sa ètu rai-haha ne ded'e boe ja'a.

source_text: then pilate asked, so you are a king, then? you say that i'm a king, jesus replied. the reason why i was born and i came to the world was to give evidence for the truth. all those who accept the truth pay attention to what i say.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi hari, peka na, de èu ne, dhèu aae, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama unu mu ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ne dhèu aae. dhu lèke ka, rara iisi ja'a ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne ho j'aj'i dhèu aae, sèna ka ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe pa'èra j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, rèngu sèra ka dhu nanene ja'a.

source_text: what is truth? pilate asked. having said this pilate went back out to the jews and told them, i find him not guilty of any crime.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi, peka na, dhu lèke èèna, sèmi ngaa sa? ropa gubernur pilatus padhai lii nare, hèia kalua hari la'e asa dhèu yahudi sèra. ka na peka, ja'a parisa le nèngu, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: however, it is customary for me to release a prisoner to you at passover. do you want me to release the king of the jews?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lod'o d'ai pesta paska sèmi ne'e, ja'a patabuli ana bèdho ca dhèu hia miu. de tèu ne'e mo'o sèna ka ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do tasamia?

source_text: no, not him! we want barabbas instead! they shouted back. barabbas was a rebel.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, baku patabuli dhèu èèna! patabuli barabas di! barabas ne, ca dhèu dhu bhelu titu kèna.

source_text: then pilate took jesus and had him flogged.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus pua sordad'u na lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui.

source_text: soldiers made a crown of thorns and placed it on his head, and put a purple robe on him. time and again they went up to him and said, hail, king of the jews! and slapped him.
target_text: aa sordad'u se'e rare kalai aj'u padhudhu kahèi, ho ènyu tao solo. ka ra lalilu solo ne mi kètu yesus, nuka sèmi rèngu neo ded'e dhèu aae hiu dhu pake solo dhèu aae. aa te ngaa sasoa na, ra neo pahahe ne di. hèia ra papake yesus kodho madhera èci dhu mea sanama mangèru, nuka sèmi dhèu aae biasa pake. aa ra sasei ne, peka na, tabea, dhèu aae yahudi! sordad'u se tèb'e ne g'ana-kariu kahèi.

source_text: pilate went outside once more and said to them, i'm bringing him out here to you so you'll know i find him not guilty of any crime.
target_text: ka gubernur la'e hari catèka peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a kèti ne asa li'u hia miu. te ngaa miu hud'i me'a ku, na, ja'a parisa kore le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: then jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. look, here's the man, said pilate.
target_text: ropa rèti yesus asa li'u, nèngu dhu pake era solo padhudhu dènge kodho madhera dhu mea sanama mangèru. hèia gubernur lii dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe ku, dhèu ne.

source_text: when the chief priests and the guards saw jesus, they shouted out, crucify him! crucify him! you take him and crucify him, pilate answered. i find him not guilty.
target_text: ropa kètu agama dènge dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! te ngaa gubernur peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa miu ka dhu mèti ne, lami pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu palèke dènge hahuku madhe.

source_text: the jewish leaders replied, we have a law, and according to that law he must die because he claimed to be the son of god.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when pilate heard this he was more afraid than ever,
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: and he went back into the governor's palace. he asked jesus, where do you come from? but jesus didn't respond.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: are you refusing to talk to me? pilate said to him. don't you realize that i have the power to have you released or to crucify you?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: you would have no power over me unless it had been given to you from above, jesus answered. therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of the greater sin.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: because of this statement pilate tried to set jesus free, but the jewish leaders shouted, if you set this man free you're not caesar's friend. anyone who sets himself up as a king is rebelling against caesar.
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: when pilate heard this, he brought jesus outside and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called stone pavement gabbatha in hebrew.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: it was around noon on the preparation day before the passover. look, here is your king, he said to the jews.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: kill him! kill him! crucify him! they screamed out. do you want me to crucify your king? pilate asked. the only king we have is caesar, the chief priests replied.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu asa hoe pa'oo-parodha peka na, mèti ne, asa li'u mai! pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha! hèia gubernur papane si, peka na, de tasamia? miu d'èi, ladhe ja'a pamadhe dhèu aae miu ne, do? ka kètu agama yahudi se b'ala, peka na, dhèu aae ji'i dhodhoka ca dhèu di, nuka keser! dhèu leo aad'o!

source_text: so he handed jesus over to them to be crucified.
target_text: hèia gubernur hia yesus asa sordad'u sèra, sèna ka ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se sèmi rare yesus.

source_text: they led jesus away, who carried his own cross, and went out to the place of the skull, golgotha in hebrew.
target_text: ka yesus pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na la'e asa li'u kota. lasi asa era èci dhu ngara na, era rui kètu. madhutu lii aram, era ne ngara na, golgota.

source_text: they crucified him there, and two others with him: one on either side, with jesus between them.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra paku yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èci. dhèu se paku kahèi dhèu leo dhèu dua. èci re sebhe g'ana, aa ca dhèu hari re sebhe kariu yesus. ka yesus ètu talora rèngu dua ra.

source_text: pilate had a notice made and placed on the cross which said, jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews.
target_text: ka gubernur paredha sordad'u na sèra, suri ètu papa èci, ho paku re dedha kètu yesus. ètu papa ne ra suri, peka na, yesus, dhèu nasaret. nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi

source_text: many people read the notice because the place where jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in hebrew, latin, and greek.
target_text: rèngu suri ètu papa ne pake tèlu lii, nuka: lii aram, lii yunani, dènge lii latin. dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu baca sasuri ne, lula era mamadhe yesus ne, padètu dènge kota yerusalem.

source_text: then the chief priests came to pilate and asked him, don't write ‘the king of the jews, ' but ‘this man said i am the king of the jews. '
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra ro'o boe. ka lasi peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, ama! baku suri ‘dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi'! be'a risi suri laa peka na, ‘dhèu ne peka na, nèngu dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi. '

source_text: pilate replied, what i have written i have written.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu pua si suri sèmi èèna. de hud'i ka laa!

source_text: when the soldiers had crucified jesus they took his clothes and divided them in four so that each soldier had his share. there was also his robe, made without seams, woven in one piece.
target_text: ropa sordad'u paku rare yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra pabagi mèdha-papake na mi èpa pala. ca dhèu sordad'u abhu ca pala. hèia rare kodho li'u na, dhu j'au boe, dhu manènu kateme nèti dedha.

source_text: so they said to each other, let's not tear it, but let's decide who will have it by rolling dice. this fulfilled the scripture that says, they divided my garments among them and rolled dice for my clothing. so that is what the soldiers did.
target_text: ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, èdhi baku ciu eele kodho na. be'a risi ère lot, sèna ka te'a, na, cee ka dhu abhu. èèna j'aj'i madhutu sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, rèngu pabagi mèdha-papake ja'a, ka ra ère lot ho abhu kodho ja'a. hèia sordad'u se tao madhutu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: standing near the cross were jesus' mother and his mother's sister, mary the wife of clopas and mary magdalene.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni pèri-pèri dhu titu. rèngu se, nuka: ina yesus, ina iiki yesus, maria dhèu èmu klopas, dènge maria nèti rae magdala.

source_text: when jesus saw his mother, and the disciple he loved standing beside her, he said to his mother, mother, this is your son.
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi ina na dhu titu ètu èèna, sama-sama dènge ja'a, yohanis, nuka ana madhutu dhu nèngu sue. ka yesus lii dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, ina. nèngu ne, ana mu.

source_text: then he said to the disciple, this is your mother. from then on the disciple took her into his home.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ja'a, peka na, yohanis. nèti deo ne'e, tao laa nèngu sèmi ina èu! ka karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ina yesus pea dènge ja'a.

source_text: jesus now realized that he had finished all that he had come to do. in fulfillment of scripture, he said, i'm thirsty.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ne'a le, na, nèngu sab'a nare aa'i le sasab'a-la'a na. se'e se pamèci dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. hèia yesus peka, na, ja'a koko-kamango.

source_text: a jar of wine vinegar was standing there, so they soaked a sponge in the vinegar, put it on a hyssop stick, and held it to his lips.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu èi anggor manyilu ètu d'ara g'ala iiki cue. ka sordad'u sèra rare ula ho cèb'u asa èi anggor, hèia èki mi suu aj'u ca laa, ka j'ole asa hèb'a na.

source_text: after he'd had the vinegar, jesus said, it's finished! then he bowed his head and breathed his last.
target_text: ropa yesus camuci nare, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èle kèna. hèia kètu na loe, ka ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: it was preparation day, and the jewish leaders didn't want to leave the bodies on the crosses during the sabbath day in fact this was a special sabbath, so they asked pilate to break the legs, so that the bodies could be removed.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke hari jumat. madhutu atora agama, dhèu yahudi hud'i sadia mema d'ara lod'o èèna, sèna ka bèli èèna rèngu soru lod'o sabaj'a ra. nèti èèna ka, ro'o boe tèke eele ngi'u aae dhèu madhe, kadhoe tèke ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. te lod'o sabaj'a èèna, lod'o be'a. de ama-ama dhèu yahudi manèngi gubernur, sèna ka pua dhèu lasi hake papadhe haga dhèu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, rèngu madhe malai, ho dhèu bisa papuru ngi'u aae ra nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ako lod'o aae era.

source_text: so the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first one and then the other of those crucified with jesus,
target_text: hèia sordad'u se lasi asa era èèna. ka ra hake papadhe uru haga dhèu dua sèra, dhu paku sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: but when they came to jesus they saw he was already dead, so they didn't break his legs.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ra d'ai yesus, rèdhi, na, yesus dhu madhe le. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hake papadhe boe haga na.

source_text: however, one of the soldiers stuck a spear into his side, and blood mixed with water came out.
target_text: te ngaa sordad'u ca dhèu nare kapoke na, hèia kèj'i d'ara karasa yesus. ka raa kalua, aa èi kalua kahèi.

source_text: the one who saw this has given this evidence, and his evidence is true. he's certain that what he says is true so you can believe it too.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu ladhe kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. ja'a kèdhi aa'i, aa dhu ja'a suri ne lèke tare'a-re'a. te ja'a ke'a mèu ngaa dhu ja'a lolo ne lèke mola-mola, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: it happened like this so scripture would be fulfilled: not one of his bones will be broken,
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, na, rui na ca laa sa, padhe boe.

source_text: and as another scripture says, they will look at the one they pierced.
target_text: ètu era leo d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ne, suri kahèi, peka na, èèna rèngu ladhe rèdhi dhèu dhu ra kèj'i ne.

source_text: after this joseph of arimathea asked pilate if he could take down the body of jesus, and pilate gave his permission. joseph was a disciple of jesus, but in secret because he feared the jews. so joseph came and took the body away.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci ngara na yusuf, nèti rae arimatea. nèngu ana madhutu yesus kahèi. te ngaa na madhutu pahuni-pahuni, lula madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. yusuf la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi ijin sèna ka bisa nèti ngi'u aae yesus. gubernur d'èi kahèi. ka yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus, hèia ded'e nèti.

source_text: he was joined by nicodemus, the man who had first visited jesus at night. he brought with him a mixture of myrrh and aloes weighing about seventy-five pounds.
target_text: nikodemus la'e sama-sama dènge yusuf kahèi. nikodemus ne'e ka dhu uru èèna la'e paraga dènge yesus re mèda. na hèli rampe ae titu kèna, pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèlu kilo sa, sèna ka tao mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: they took jesus' body and wrapped it in linen cloth together with the mixture of spices, in accordance with jewish burial customs.
target_text: hèia ra hèlu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla halus. ladhe hèlu ca tèka, ra tao rampe la'a. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi ladhe padhane dhèu madhe.

source_text: there was a garden near where jesus was crucified; and in the garden was a new, unused tomb.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era yesus madhe ne, abhu oka bunga cue. ètu d'ara oka ne, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a dhèu madhe kèna. ra padhane rèdhi mèka dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara ro'a èèna.

source_text: since it was the jewish day of preparation and the tomb was nearby, they laid jesus to rest there.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lod'o sadia dhèu yahudi ho soru lod'o sabaj'a ra, oe èle kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se tèke ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, te era èèna kaj'èu boe.

source_text: early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, mary magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been moved from the entrance.
target_text: hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. mad'ae aae era, maria nèti rae magdala la'e asa ro'a yesus. d'ai era èèna, ladhe nèdhi hadhu aae dhu pake katange ro'a, hari eele nèti era na.

source_text: so she ran to tell simon peter and the other disciple, the one jesus loved, they've taken the lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they've put him.
target_text: hèia na rai lèpa hari la'e paraga dènge simon petrus aa dènge ja'a, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue, ka na peka, dhèu mana'u rèti le lamatua èdhi nèti ro'a na! te'a boe rèngu tèke ne ètu mia!

source_text: then peter and the other disciple went to the tomb.
target_text: ka ja'a dènge petrus rai la'a asa era ro'a èèna.

source_text: the two of them were running together, but the other disciple ran faster and reached the tomb first.
target_text: ji'i rai palere-lere, te ngaa ja'a malai risi, ka d'ai uuru ro'a èèna.

source_text: he bent down, and looking in he saw the grave-clothes lying there, but he didn't go in.
target_text: te ngaa laku boe asa d'ara ro'a, dhoka patigi nèti li'u di. ètu d'ara ro'a, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bèla halus dhu ra pake hèlu mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: then simon peter arrived after him and went right into the tomb. he saw the linen grave-clothes lying there,
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus d'ai, la'e dènge asa d'ara. nèdhi bèla halus dhu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and that the cloth that had been on jesus' head wasn't with the other grave-clothes but had been folded and placed on its own.
target_text: nèdhi kahèi lesu dhu ra pahutu kètu yesus. te ngaa lesu ne dhu lèpe ètu era leo nèti bèla halus ne.

source_text: then the other disciple who had reached the tomb first went inside as well.
target_text: hèia ja'a, dhu d'ai uuru ro'a, maso madhutu kahèi asa d'ara. ropa ladhe kèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, ka ja'a parcaya lii padhadha dhu uru èèna yesus peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: he looked around and believed it was true-for up till then they hadn't understood the scripture that jesus had to rise from the dead.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ji'i dhu j'aj'i ana madhutu na, dhae nge'a mèka sasoa nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri mema, peka na, kristus hud'i mamuri hari ku nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: then the disciples went back to where they were staying.
target_text: èle ka, ji'i dua mi lèpa.

source_text: but mary stayed outside the tomb crying. as she was crying, she bent down and looked into the tomb.
target_text: te ngaa maria titu era ètu li'u ro'a èèna. nèngu tangi taruu. ka na patigi asa d'ara ro'a ne, aa na tangi era.

source_text: she saw two angels in white, one sitting at the head and the other at the foot of where jesus' body had been lying.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhèu dua. ana pajuu se, pake mèdha-papake pudhi. dua ra madhèdi ètu era dhu ca lod'o ni dhèu paj'unu ngi'u aae yesus. ca dhèu madhèdi re era kètu, aa èci hari dhu madhèdi re era haga.

source_text: why are you crying? they asked her. she answered, because they've taken my lord away, and i don't know where they've put him.
target_text: ana pajuu se karèi maria, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka èu tangi? hèia maria dhaa, peka na, ja'a tangi, lula dhèu ded'e rèti ngi'u aae lamatua ja'a. te ngaa ke'a boe ra tèke ne ètu mia.

source_text: after she'd said this, she turned round and saw jesus standing there, but she didn't realize it was jesus.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, nèngu kabib'a asa li'u. ka ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, te ngaa ne'a boe, na, dhèu ne, nuka yesus.

source_text: why are you crying? he asked her. who are you looking for? assuming he was the gardener, she said to him, sir, if you've taken him away, tell me where you've put him so i can go and get him.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tangi? te èu tenge cee? maria pangee, na, nèngu ne dhèu madhenga oka. ka maria pamako dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ama ka ded'e mèti ngi'u aae na, peka ku laa, ama tèke ne ètu mia. hud'i laa laku ded'e kèti ne asa era leo, sèna ka padhane ne pabe'a-be'a. sue laa, ama!

source_text: jesus said to her, mary! she turned to him and said, rabboni, which means teacher in hebrew.
target_text: ka yesus paroa ne, peka na, maria. hèia na kabèli ladhe asa yesus, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, raboni! lii aram, sasoa na, mese ja'a!

source_text: don't hold onto me, jesus said to her, for i haven't yet ascended to my father; but go to my brothers and tell them i am ascending to my father and your father, my god and your god.
target_text: yesus peka dènge ne, baku g'ag'e ku ja'a, te ja'a dhae ca'e mèka laku asa ama ku ètu sorga. te ngaa lamu uuru ku peka dènge angalai ja'a sèra, na, ‘ja'a neo ca'e laku asa ama ku. nèngu èèna, ama miu kahèi. nèngu èèna, ama lamatua ja'a. de nèngu, ama lamatua miu kahèi. '

source_text: so mary magdalene went and told the disciples, i've seen the lord, and she explained to them what he had said to her.
target_text: èle ka, maria, dhèu magdala èèna, la'e lolo dènge ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka na, ja'a paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, yesus! ka na peka dènge rèngu lii moa yesus.

source_text: that evening, on the first day of the week, as the disciples were meeting together behind locked doors because they were afraid of the jews, jesus came and stood among them and said, may you have peace.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. lod'o heka cèna kèna, ka ana madhutu yesus pakaboko. rèngu patèke babèdho èmu ne pa'èra-èra, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. re'a rare boe, na, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom!

source_text: after this greeting he showed them his hands and his side. the disciples were full of joy to see the lord.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, hèia na pad'elo nu'a dhu ètu kacui-aai dènge karasa na. ana madhutu na karej'e titu kèna, ropa ladhe rèdhi lamatua rèngu.

source_text: may you have peace! jesus told them again. in the same way the father sent me, so i'm sending you.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, hud'i laa miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. sanèd'e, te ama ku pua-paleha ja'a tasamia, na, ja'a pua-paleha miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: saying this, he breathed on them, and told them, receive the holy spirit.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na ara padètu la'e asa rèngu, hèia na tiu a'ae na mi rèngu èci-èci. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ja'a pangèd'u miu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. sèmi mere ne.

source_text: if you forgive anyone's sins, they are forgiven; if you hold them unforgiven, unforgiven they remain.
target_text: de, ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, sasala ne ele le, te ama lamatua saku eele sasala èèna kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, lamatua saku eele boe sasala sèra kahèi.

source_text: one of the twelve disciples, thomas, who was called the twin, wasn't with them when jesus came.
target_text: ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus canguru dua sèra, ngara na tomas. ra pangare na, ‘ana kembar' kahèi. ropa yesus pad'elo iisi na dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, tomas aad'o.

source_text: so the other disciples told him, we've seen the lord. but he replied, i won't believe it unless i see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger in them, and put my hand in his side.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa angalai na sèra peka dènge ne, ji'i paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, hèia tomas dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a hud'i ladhe kèdhi ku nu'a era paku sèra ètu kacui-aai na, aa pamaso ai ja'a asa nu'a ètu d'ara karasa na. ladhe ja'a tao mèka sèmi èèna, ja'a bisa mèka parcaya, na, nèngu mamuri hari le.

source_text: one week later the disciples were together inside the house; and thomas was with them. the doors were closed, and jesus came and stood among them. may you have peace! he said.
target_text: ca migu hari, ka ana madhutu yesus sama-sama dènge tomas ètu d'ara èmu cue. masi ka babèdho dhu patèke, te ngaa yesus maso asa d'ara, titu ètu talora aae rèngu. ka na hia lii maho'o dènge ra, peka na, saloom!

source_text: then he said to thomas, put your finger here, and look at my hands. put your hand in the wound on my side. stop doubting and trust in me!
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge tomas, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai, ho g'ag'e kacui-aai ja'a ne. aa mai g'ag'e nu'a ètu d'ara karasa ja'a ne. parcaya ka, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le! core eele ka d'ara parcaya boe èu èèna.

source_text: my lord and my god! thomas responded.
target_text: tomas dhaa, peka na, ira ii, ama, ee! ja'a heka lèka tare'a-re'a kèna! ama ne, kètu ja'a, aa ama lamatua ja'a kahèi!

source_text: you trust in me because you've seen me, jesus told him. happy are those that haven't seen me yet still trust in me.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ne, tomas! èu parcaya, na, ja'a mamuri hari le, lula èu mèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha èu unu mu. te ngaa dhu oto risi ka, nuka dhèu dhu rèdhi boe ja'a, te ngaa ra parcaya.

source_text: jesus did many other miraculous signs while he was with his disciples that are not recorded in this book.
target_text: yesus tao tadha malaa dhu leo ae-ae kahèi, dhu ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne. ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa se'e dènge musi madha rèngu unu ra.

source_text: but these are written down here so that you may trust that jesus is the messiah, the son of god, and that by trusting in him as he is you will have life.
target_text: te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, sèna ka miu parcaya, na, yesus ne, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke hia mai. yesus ne, ana ama lamatua kahèi. aa ropa miu parcaya ne, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu.

source_text: later jesus appeared again to the disciples by the sea of galilee. this is how it happened.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, ka yesus pad'elo hari iisi na ètu sebhe dano tiberias. lii lolo na, sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: simon peter, thomas the twin, nathanael of cana in galilee, and zebedee's sons, and two other disciples were together.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus, dhèu pidhu dhu pakaboko. rèngu se, nuka: simon petrus, tomas, dhu ra pangare ne, ‘ana kembar', natanel, nèti rae kana ètu propensi galilea, ana dhèu dua nèti sabadeus, dènge ana madhutu yesus dhu leo dhèu dua.

source_text: i'm going fishing, simon peter said to them. we'll come with you, they replied. so they left and went out in the boat, but all night they caught nothing.
target_text: simon petrus peka dènge angalai na se'e, ja'a neo laku pèku i'a. hèia angalai na se'e dhaa, aku rèngu na, oo! ji'i la'a kahèi. ka lasi asa sebhe dano. hèia ca'e koha lasi tenge i'a. te ngaa mèda èèna rèngu rara boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: when dawn came jesus was standing on the shore, but the disciples didn't know it was him.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, yesus titu ètu sebhe dano ne. te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra re'a boe, na, nèngu ne, yesus.

source_text: jesus called to them, my friends, haven't you caught anything? no, they replied.
target_text: ka na pa'oo, peka na, mera i'a, do? hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mola-mèu lao! ci'u sa, aad'o hèi.

source_text: throw the net out on the right side of the boat, and you'll find some, he told them. so they threw out the net, and they weren't able to haul it in because it had so many fish.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, lolo sèku pèku miu asa cabèka koha èèna. pe miu abhu. ka rèngu tao madhutu kahèi. ka ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna, toke rèngu bisa boe ère rare pèku ne asa dedha koha.

source_text: the disciple jesus loved said to peter, it's the lord. when peter heard it was the lord, he put some clothes on because he was undressed, and jumped into the sea.
target_text: aa ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. ja'a ne, ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ka ja'a peka dènge petrus, na, ira ii! nèngu nèi, lamatua èdhi! ropa tadèngi nare lii ja'a deo na, hèia simon petrus pake hari kodho na, ka ridhu asa d'ara dano, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: the other disciples followed in the boat, pulling the net full of fish, because they were not far from the shore, only about a hundred yards.
target_text: te koha ne kaj'èu nèti dae pe d'ai cangasu meter sa. hèia angalai na kao koha asa dae, todhe dènge pèku dhu pènu dènge i'a deo sa.

source_text: once they'd landed they saw a fire with fish cooking on it, and some bread.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai dae, hèia rèdhi ai karoo, dènge i'a dhu ra paga. aa abhu roti kahèi.

source_text: jesus told them, bring some of the fish you've just caught.
target_text: yesus lii dènge ra, mèti ku i'a osa miu d'ai ciki sa, dhu miu heka pèku mere deo na.

source_text: simon peter went aboard and pulled the net full of fish ashore. there were 153 large fish, yet even so the net hadn't torn.
target_text: ka simon petrus ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ho ère pa'eta pèku ne asa dae. pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a aae, cangasu lèmi nguru tèlu ngi'u. masi ka i'a ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa pèku ne mae boe ciki sa hèi.

source_text: come and eat some breakfast, jesus said to them. none of the disciples was brave enough to ask him, who are you? they knew it was the lord.
target_text: ka yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai mi'a ka! rèngu dhu re'a le, na, nèngu ne lamatua rèngu, ka ra bani boe karèi ne, na, ama ne, cee?

source_text: jesus took the bread and gave it to them and the fish as well.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti dènge i'a, nèti hia si.

source_text: this was the third time jesus had appeared to the disciples after being raised from the dead.
target_text: ne'e ne, ka tèlu hari kèna yesus pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na sèra, ropa na mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: after breakfast, jesus asked simon peter, simon, son of john, do you love me more than these? yes, lord, he replied, you know i love you. take care of my lambs, jesus told him.
target_text: ropa ra'a-rinu rare, yesus karèi simon petrus, aku nèngu na, hee, simon ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a risi nèti angalai se sue ja'a, do? ka petrus dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. hèia yesus peka, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, madhenga paie ana kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: simon, son of john, do you love me? he asked for the second time. yes, lord, he answered, you know i love you. look after my sheep, jesus said to him.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari, aku nèngu na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. ka yesus peka hari dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a.

source_text: simon, son of john, do you love me? he asked a third time. peter was hurt that jesus had asked him for the third time if he loved him. lord, you know everything. you know i love you, peter told him. take care of my sheep, said jesus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi hari petrus, peka na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu ne, angalai ja'a, do? hèia d'ara petrus susa titu kèna, lula yesus karèi ne d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhu me'a aa'i j'ara. de ama dhu me'a le, na, ja'a ne angalai ama. hèia yesus peka dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a se, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: i tell you the truth, said jesus, when you were young, you dressed yourself and went wherever you wanted. but when you're old, you'll hold out your hands and someone will dress you and take you where you don't want to go.
target_text: èu dhane more le naneo ja'a, do? ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: uru èèna lod'o èu ngèru era, èu tema pake unu mu kodho dènge dhara hake, ho lamu asa mia-mia madhutu dad'èi èu. te ngaa ètu d'ara heka, èu j'ole kacui-aai ho dhèu èki, pake dhara hake èu unu mu. hèia ra ère rèti èu asa era dhu èu d'èi boe.

source_text: jesus said this to explain the kind of death by which he would glorify god. then he said to peter, follow me.
target_text: lii padhai yesus ne, peka mi petrus, lula-nèti ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a mi dedha nèngu. te èèna na mamadhe petrus pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. hèia yesus lii dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: as peter turned round, he saw the disciple jesus loved following them, the one who had leaned over to jesus during the supper and asked, lord, who is going to betray you?
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus kabib'a asa kabodho. ka ladhe nèdhi ja'a dhu re limuri madhutu rèngu dua ra. ja'a ne, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus, lod'o ji'i nga'a kalela paska. ja'a ne ka dhu karèi yesus, peka na, ama! cee ka dhu neo pahie ama?

source_text: peter asked jesus, what about him, lord?
target_text: ropa petrus ladhe nèdhi ja'a, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! deo na ama peka-padhai le lula-nèti ja'a ne. te ngaa tasamia dènge nèngu hari?

source_text: jesus told him, if i want him to remain alive here until i return, why is that your concern? you follow me!
target_text: yesus b'ala lii petrus, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa? dhu lèke ka èu hud'i sanèd'e ku lii moa dhu ja'a peka deo na, nuka: mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a.

source_text: this is why the saying spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. but jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die, just that if i want him to remain alive here until i return, why is that your concern?
target_text: lula yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na dhu leo sèra papeka, na, yohanis ne, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe. aa te ngaa yesus padhai lii boe sèmi èèna. dhu na peka, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa?

source_text: this disciple confirms what happened and wrote all this down. we know that what he says is true.
target_text: ana madhutu dhu yesus peka èèna, nuka ja'a ne, yohanis. ja'a ka lole se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. ja'a ka dhu kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ja'a ka suri aa'i-aa'i se. ka èdhi te'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a lole hia miu se, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: jesus did many other things as well, and if it all was written down, i doubt the whole world could hold all the books that would be written.
target_text: abhu j'ara leo ae era dhu yesus tao. ladhe dhèu neo suri aa'i mèu-mèu, karèi nèti yesus pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke èle, ja'a ngee na buku se pènu risi rai-haha ne. d'ai sange ne'e ka, yohanis

source_text: dear theophilus, in my previous book i wrote about all that jesus did and taught from the beginning until the day he was taken up to heaven. this was after he'd given instructions through the holy spirit to his chosen apostles. over the course of forty days after the death he suffered, he showed himself to them, proving that he was alive with convincing evidence. he appeared to them, and told them about the kingdom of god.
target_text: ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, lukas. ètu d'ara sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, ja'a suri aa'i mèu-mèu lula-nèti mamuri lamatua yesus. nuka, ngaa dhu na tao, dènge ngaa dhu na aj'a-nori, karèi nèti uru tèka. na hag'e nare dhèu pajuu-paleha na. masi ka dhèu paj'èra ne, aa ra pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ropa na kèd'i nèti mamadhe, na pad'elo iisi mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ra rèdhi ne padhutu-dhutu toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, ka ra re'a, na mamuri hari tare'a. nèngu peka dènge rèngu, na, ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae dhu nèd'u paredha. ka na pua rèngu kahèi pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. lii dhu ja'a suri ne, lole ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao nèti uru, toke d'ai na ca'e hari asa sorga. se'e se ka dhu ja'a suri kèdhi le.

source_text: while he was still with them he instructed them, do not leave jerusalem. wait to receive what the father promised, just as you heard it from me. it's true that john baptized in water, but in just a few days' time you will be baptized in the holy spirit.

source_text: this promise is given to you, to your children, and to all who are far away-everyone the lord our god calls.
target_text: te ama lamatua moa le hia roh na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na. dènge j'ara ne'e, lii mamoa lula-nèti roh na, j'aj'i hia miu dènge ana-èpu miu kahèi. na moa hia mi dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: peter went on speaking, giving them much more evidence. he warned them, save yourselves from this perverted generation.
target_text: aa petrus padhai lii ae hari mi rèngu, aku nèngu na, limuri ne, dhèu ae sero le nèti j'ara mamuri dhu mola. de miu mage-mage, sèna ka miu baku madhutu tatao dhèu bhelu sèra. te ngaa miu hud'i madhutu dhoka j'ara mola nèti ama lamatua di. dènge j'ara èèna, miu abhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: those who accepted what he'd said were baptized, adding about three thousand people to the group of believers that day.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu ae sèra sèmi rare lii padhai lii petrus èèna dènge d'ara kateme. ka ra madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus, hèia ra soro iisi ra sèna ka abhu sarani. lod'o èèna, pe d'ai tèlu riho dhèu mai pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu yesus sèra.

source_text: they committed themselves to what the apostles had taught them, and to the fellowship of the believers, breaking bread and praying together.
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu yesus. aa rèngu mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu maj'èni nanene lii holo-nori nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus. rèngu d'èi manèngi-mangaj'i sama-sama kahèi. aa rèngu d'èi ra'a-rinu mei èci.

source_text: everyone was in awe, and many miracles and signs were done through the apostles.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra tao tadha malaa ae-ae, ka dhèu dhu ètu sèra sa malaa dènge madha'u.

source_text: all the believers were together and shared everything they had.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ka ngaa dhu unu dhèu èci, j'aj'i unu rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ho ra pake sama-sama.

source_text: they sold their property and belongings, sharing the proceeds with everyone as they needed.
target_text: abhu cahag'e pahia mèdha-panyau ra, ho ra pala-bagi doi kab'ua na mi dhèu parcaya sèra, madhutu èci-èci dhu parluu.

source_text: day after day they continued to meet together in the temple, and ate together in their homes. they enjoyed their meals humbly and happily. they praised god, and everyone thought favorably of them.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu ra'a-rinu boko-boko mue-mue dènge d'ara karej'e-karae, nèti èmu èci asa èmu èci, dènge boe ka'uu-kamuki. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri èci tulu èci, dènge boe kire-kome.

source_text: every day the lord added to their number those who were being saved.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra ma'ète boe koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu leo sèra d'èi rèngu titu kèna. nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o ama lamatua hia mamuri mi dhèu sèra, ho ra pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka rèngu asa ka ae.

source_text: peter and john were on their way up to the temple at the time of the afternoon prayer, around 3 p. m.
target_text: ca lod'o, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho neo sabaj'a dènge dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: a man who had been lame from birth was being carried there. every day he was placed beside the temple gate called beautiful so he could beg from the people going into the temple.
target_text: rèngu neo maso re hèb'a oka, dhu ngara na ‘hèb'a saraga'. ètu èèna, rèngu rèdhi dhèu mone karuku èci, dhu karuku nèti ina na nara iisi ne. bèli-bèli mai, na, dhèu nedhe rèti ne asa era èèna, ho na kanata kacui-aai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu cee dhu neo maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i re èèna.

source_text: he saw peter and john as they were about to enter the temple and asked them for some money.
target_text: ropa na ladhe nèdhi petrus dènge yohanis oe maso asa d'ara, ka na kanata kacui-aai, manèngi, peka na, ama-ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. hia ku ja'a ngaa, do?

source_text: peter looked right at him. john did, too. look at us! peter said.
target_text: ka dua ra ladhe kaloo ka dhèu ne'e, hèia petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku mai!

source_text: the lame man gave them his full attention, expecting to get something from them.
target_text: hèia nèngu boti kètu na, ladhe asa rèngu dua ra, ka na pangee, na, waa! ele boe dua ra neo hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa ne.

source_text: i don't have any silver or gold, peter told him, but i'll give you what i have. in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, walk!
target_text: te ngaa petrus peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a dènge boe doi hualaa ho hia mi èu! te, ngaa dhu ja'a unu, èèna ka dhu ja'a neo hia mi èu. de nanene paie-iie! dènge koasa yesus kristus, dhèu nasaret, ja'a pua èu kèd'i titu, ho kako!

source_text: peter took him by the right hand and helped him up. right away his feet and ankles became strong.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe ai g'ana dhèu karuku èèna, ka na pakèd'i patitu ne. kaca'a laa, haga dhèu ne'e be'a dènge ka, ètu d'ara ciki ood'e èèna kahèi.

source_text: he jumped to his feet, and then began to walk. he went with them into the temple, walking and jumping and praising god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, na pasoka titu, hèia na kako la'e-mai neo ne'a, haga nèngu be'a le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, na la'e palere dènge rèngu dua ra asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. na kako pasoa-pasoka dènge koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: everyone there saw him walking around and praising god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ladhe rèdhi dhèu ne'e kako la'e-mai, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: they recognized him as the beggar who used to sit by the temple's beautiful gate, and they were surprised and amazed at what had happened to him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra tadhe ne, ka ra malaa, hèia peka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne'e ka dhèu karuku dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a saraga, ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa èèna, sina ma? tasamia ka na j'aj'i sèmi ne'e?

source_text: he held on tightly to peter and john while everyone ran to them by solomon's porch in complete astonishment at what had happened.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, madhutu petrus dènge yohanis. ka tèlu ra lasi d'ai èmu taleo cue, ngara na ‘èmu taleo dhèu aae soleman'. ètu èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai lingu rare rèngu malaa titu kèna.

source_text: when peter saw this opportunity he told them, people of israel, why are you surprised at what's happened to this man? why are you staring at us as if it was by our own power or faith that we made him walk?
target_text: ropa petrus nèdhi rèngu, ka na padhai lii, peka na, dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! nga tao ka miu malaa, lula j'ara ne'e ne? nga tao ka miu ladhe kaloo ji'i? miu ngee, na, dhèu ne kako lula ji'i pake na'i, do, lula ji'i maj'èni madhutu ama lamatua? do, tasamia?

source_text: the god of abraham, isaac, and jacob-the god of our forefathers-has glorified his servant jesus. he was the one you betrayed and rejected in the presence of pilate, even after pilate had decided to release him.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: bèi-baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge yakob manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. lamatua èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha dhèu nèngu dhu na pili nare, nuka yesus. yesus èèna ka dhu miu tule eele ne, ka saraka ne asa gubernur pilatus. ka gubernur neo patabuli ne, te ngaa miu ka dhu palab'a, sèna ka na baku patabuli eele yesus.

source_text: you rejected the one who is holy and good, and demanded a murderer be released to you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus, dhèu dhu sala boe. d'ara nèngu be'a. gubernur neo patabuli eele dhèu dhu sala boe ne, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi lab'a ne. aa dhu bhelu risi hari ka, miu dadugu-rariu ne, sèna ka na patabuli hia miu dhèu bhelu-katub'a èci dhu pamadhe nèdhi dhèu.

source_text: you killed the author of life, the one god raised from the dead-and we are witnesses to this.
target_text: miu ka dhu pamadhe yesus! aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu hia èdhi mamuri. mema tare'a nèngu madhe le, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. nèngu ka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i.

source_text: by trusting in jesus' name this man was healed by him. you see this man here; you know him. through trusting in jesus this man has received complete healing right in front of all of you.
target_text: miu tadhe dhèu karuku ne. nèngu èra le, te ngaa ji'i boe ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne. ji'i se dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa. koasa èèna mai nèti yesus. dhèu ne'e ne èra, lula nèngu parcaya lamatua yesus. yesus ka dhu pa'èle ne, ètu katanga madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: now i know, brothers and sisters, that you did this in ignorance, like your rulers.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! limuri ne, ja'a ke'a le, miu dènge dhèu aae-dhèu kapai miu, tao bhelu mi dedha yesus, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i lèpa limuri.

source_text: but god fulfilled what he had prophesied through all the prophets: that his messiah would suffer.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka mema nèti uru ka mai, pake dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, peka na, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu na hag'e nare èèna, hud'i d'ui ku j'aj'èra. ka j'aj'i le, sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: now repent, and change your ways, that your sins can be wiped away, so the lord can send opportunities for you to heal and recover,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i ele-ho'a, tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia lèpa asa ama lamatua, ho na saku eele aa baku ngee ia ka sasala miu sèra.

source_text: and send jesus, the messiah appointed for you.
target_text: pe ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu. ka na neo pua kristus dhu na hag'e nare èèna, mai hari asa miu. kristus èèna, nuka yesus, dhu na pua le mai asa miu.

source_text: for he must stay in heaven until the time when everything is restored, as god announced through his holy prophets long ago.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, lamatua padhai lii re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, ama lamatua pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka j'aj'i hiu. ' yesus hud'i mate ku ètu era mola-mèci toke d'ai lod'o nèngu mai hari, ho na pahiu ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: moses said, ‘the lord god will send you a prophet from among your own people who is like me. you must listen to everything he tells you.
target_text: uru èèna, baki musa peka le dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘lamatua miu, nuka ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na pua dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sama sèmi na pake ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu kèti lii padhai na. de miu hud'i pasa dhilu, sèna ka mi nanene paie, ngaa-ngaa dhu na neo peka mi miu.

source_text: anybody who doesn't listen to him will be totally removed from the people. '
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe nanene paie, lii padhai lii dhèu èèna, èèna na cèri eele nèti dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dènge heka hak ètu talora rèngu. '

source_text: all the prophets who have spoken, from samuel on, prophesied about these days.
target_text: mesa boe baki musa di dhu peka sèmi èèna. te lamatua pake dhèu leo kahèi, j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na. rèngu peka sèmi èèna kahèi. sama sèmi uru èèna, lamatua pake baki samuel, ho lolo j'ara-j'ara dhu limuri ne èdhi tèdhi dènge musi madha èdhi.

source_text: you are the sons of the prophets, and of the agreement which god made with your fathers when he said to abraham, ‘from your descendants all the families of the earth will be blessed. '
target_text: ama lamatua moa tèke le, mi baki abraham, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, re ana-èpu èu èci, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi dedha suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ' lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka le mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, limuri ne, j'aj'i le mi dedha miu, nuka a'ari ja'a dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: god prepared his servant and sent him to you first, to bless you by turning every one of you from your evil ways.
target_text: ama lamatua pua ana na dhu na hag'e nare èèna, ho paj'uj'u j'ara, sèna ka miu tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu. lamatua pua uuru ana na mai asa miu, èle èèna, heka na pua ne asa suku leo sèra. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti.

source_text: while they were talking to the people, the priests, the captain of the temple guard, and the sadducees came up to them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa petrus dènge yohanis padhai lii era dènge dhèu ètu sèra, dhèu kapai canau mai. rèngu sèra, kètu agama yahudi, dhèu nèti partei saduki, dènge komedhaa j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu mai neo patao dènge petrus dènge yohanis.

source_text: they were angry that they were teaching the people, telling them that through jesus there is resurrection from the dead.
target_text: dhèu sèra nasa, lula rèngu dua ra d'èi peka dènge dhèu ae, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. dènge j'ara èèna, nèngu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu madhe sèna ka bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: they arrested them and placed them under guard until the following day since it was already evening.
target_text: ka ra paredha dhèu rèngu lasi kèpe dua ra. te ngaa, lula lod'o oe cèna kèna, ka ra pamaso taha si asa d'ara bèdho. ho bèli èèna, heka ra neo parisa si kèna.

source_text: but many who had heard the message believed it, and the total number of believers grew to about five thousand.
target_text: te ngaa ètu talora dhèu dhu d'èi nanene dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra, ae ka dhu mangaku, na, lii aj'a-nori rèngu sèra lèke tare'a. nèti èèna ka dhèu parcaya asa tabha ae, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: the next day, the rulers, elders, and religious leaders met together in jerusalem.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu kapai yahudi sèra pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem, nuka dhèu paredha, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: they included the high priest annas, caiaphas, john, alexander, and others of the high priest's family.
target_text: kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, dhu ngara na hanas, ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu kapai leo, sèmi kayafas, yohanis, aleksander, dènge a'ari leo sèra nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: they brought peter and john before them and asked, by what power or by whose authority have you done this?
target_text: ropa ra tesa aa'i, ka ra paredha dhèu lasi rare petrus dènge yohanis, ho rèti mai asa madha ama-ama dhèu kapai se'e. ropa rèngu mai, ka ra karèi si, peka na, tasamia ka miu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku? miu pake koasa nèti cee? aa cee ka dhu pua miu ka miu bani tao j'ara èèna?

source_text: peter, filled with the holy spirit, answered them. rulers of the people, and elders:
target_text: hèia roh ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara petrus, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! miu ka dhèu kapai, dènge dhèu heka kabarai isra'el! baku nasa ladhe ji'i ako malaa ciki.

source_text: are we being interrogated regarding a good deed done to a man who couldn't help himself, and how he came to be healed?
target_text: ji'i ladhe, na, ama-ama si neo tao lii langu, lula ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èci. aa miu neo me'a ji'i pake koasa nèti cee?

source_text: if so, all of you should know, and all the people of israel, that it was in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, the one you killed on a cross and whom god raised from the dead-it's because of him that this man stands before you completely healed.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: tatu ama si sanèd'e era dhèu nasaret, dhu ngara na yesus. nèngu èèna, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema nèti uru ka mai. te ngaa miu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ja'a d'èi sèna ka ama si dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èèna, pake dhodhoka koasa yesus.

source_text: ‘he is the stone you builders rejected, but he has been made the chief cornerstone. '
target_text: yesus ne'e ka dhu ra suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka core eele; te ngaa limuri mai, hadhu èèna j'aj'i hadhu padhèdi. '

source_text: there is no salvation in anyone else; there is no other name under heaven given to humanity that can possibly save us.
target_text: ètu palème rai-haha ne, ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara leo dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. dhodhoka j'ara èci di, nuka yesus. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu bisa hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: when they saw peter and john's confidence, and realized they were uneducated, ordinary men, they were very surprised. they also recognized them as jesus' companions.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra sa re'a, na, petrus dènge yohanis se, dhoka dhèu biasa di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe baca-suri. te ngaa dhèu sèra malaa dènge babani dua ra, lula rèngu padhai lii dhu dènge boe pahuni-pahuni. tabha hari, ra re'a, na, dhèu dua se, dhèu pa'èci nèti yesus.

source_text: since they could see the man who had been healed standing right there with them, they had nothing to say in response to what had happened.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hèb'a dhèu se kutu mèno, toke ra padhai lii heka ae-ae, lula dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, titu dhii-dhii patoo madha dènge madha.

source_text: so they instructed them to wait outside the council while they discussed the matter among themselves.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dhèu dua sèra, aku rèngu na, dua mi lami ku asa li'u ciki. ka ra padhue ho neo tenge j'ara aapa.

source_text: what should we do with these men? they asked. we can't deny a significant miracle has happened through them. everybody living here in jerusalem knows about it.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! èdhi hud'i tao dhèu dua se samia? te dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i ra re'a le, na, rèngu dua se ka dhu tao tadha malaa deo na. èdhi pasili tare heka, lula bukti nèngu abhu le!

source_text: but to prevent it spreading among the people any further, we should threaten them never to speak to anybody in this name again.
target_text: de hua iia èdhi tenge j'ara, sèna ka lii ne'e baku ra lolo palème asa mia-mia la'e. be'a risi èdhi pamadha'u si, sèna ka ra baku aj'a ia ka j'ara mamuri yesus. ladhe ra nanene boe, na, re'a mema!

source_text: so they called them back in and ordered them never to speak or teach in the name of jesus again.
target_text: hèia ra paroa dua ra maso hari asa d'ara, ka ra peka dènge si, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe unu mi, ee! miu bisa heka lolo, do, aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti yesus!

source_text: but peter and john responded, whether it's right in god's eyes to obey you rather than god-you decide.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dènge yohanis b'ala, peka na, cob'a ama-ama si pajiko ku laa. mia dhu be'a risi? madhutu paredha ama si, do, madhutu paredha ama lamatua?

source_text: we can't help talking about what we've seen and heard!
target_text: te ji'i ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i, aa tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i madha j'ara ae. de tasamia ji'i kutu hèb'a, ho baku lolo dènge dhèu leo!

source_text: after making more threats they let them go. they couldn't work out how to punish them because everyone was glorifying god for what had happened.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi pama'ète lii langu èèna, kai hari rèngu. ka ra patalale eele dua si, lula ra re'a heka j'ara ho huku si. rèngu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka dhèu ae ètu li'u sèi pagama. te dhèu ae sèra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula dhèu karuku èèna èle le.

source_text: for the man who received this miracle of healing was more than forty years old.
target_text: dhèu èèna karuku èpa nguru risi tèu le, ka heka bisa kako kèna.

source_text: after the disciples had been released, they went to the other believers and told them everything the chief priests and elders had said to them.
target_text: ropa ra patabuli eele petrus dènge yohanis, dua ra lèpa lasi asa angalai rèngu. hèia dua ra lole aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu kapai leo sèra kai rèngu ho baku palolo.

source_text: when they heard what had happened, they prayed to god together: lord, you made heaven and earth and sea, and everything that is in them.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii lolo èèna, ka angalai rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ho ra manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. ama dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: you spoke by the holy spirit through david, our forefather and your servant, saying ‘why did the people of the other nations become so angry? why did they plot so foolishly against me?
target_text: uru-uru sèra, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake le baki daud ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka suri mema lula-nèti dhèu lab'a yesus, peka na, ‘dhèu nèti rai leo sèra nasa lula lii lai-ngèlu; dhèu se'e tao lèke boe, ho tao lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: the kings of the earth prepared for war; the rulers united together against the lord and against his chosen one. '
target_text: dhèu aae rai-haha sèra pakaboko ho neo pamusu lab'a ama lamatua; sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu kapai sèra rare lii èci neo lasi lab'a ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka mai. '

source_text: now this has really happened right here in this city! both herod and pontius pilate, together with the foreigners and the people of israel, united together against your holy servant jesus, whom you anointed as messiah.
target_text: ka ngaa dhu baki daud suri na, limuri ne j'aj'i le. aa sasoa na led'a le. ètu kota ne'e, dhèu aae herodes, gubernur pontius pilatus, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a isra'el, dènge dhèu kapai suku leo sèra, pakaboko le. rèngu pare'a lii ho lab'a yesus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le.

source_text: they did whatever you had already decided because you had the power and the will to do it.
