target_text: te ngaa ja'a padhai lii pamadhera heka, ja'a kore dhoka isi di. de ja'a manèngi ama nanene paie-iie, j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a neo peka lula-nèti paulus ne.

source_text: we discovered that this man is a real pest, stirring up rebellions among jews all over the world, a ringleader of the nazarene sect.
target_text: sèmi ne'e ku, ama. madhutu a'abhu ji'i dhèu yahudi, paulus ne èci èèna ka dènge èi papèd'a dhu rai nèti era èci asa era èci la'e. nèngu ne, d'èi palab'a dènge agama ji'i, aa tuka pa'ele iie ad'a ji'i ètu mia-mia. nèngu la'e asa era mia èèna ka, tatu dhèu yahudi hud'i tao ku lii langu èci dènge èci. nèngu ne tuka dadugu-rariu nèti partei agama dhu madhutu ca dhèu nèti nasaret, dhu ji'i pangare na, ‘partei nasrani'. te ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a sèra, pasala kapai dènge agama ji'i.

source_text: he tried to defile the temple, so we arrested him.
target_text: dhèu ne'e ne, neo pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ji'i dhu mola-mèci èèna. aa nèti dènge dhèu dintiu asa d'ara la'e. nèti èèna ka, ji'i kèpe ngare ne. madhutu dad'èi ji'i, ji'i neo huku ne, pake atora ji'i unu mi.

source_text: by interrogating him yourself you will discover the truth of our accusations.
target_text: hèia na paredha, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu neo tao lii langu dènge paulus, hud'i lasi ku asa madha ama gubernur ètu kaisarea. madhutu dad'èi na, sèna ka ama gubernur unu mu ka dhu uri lii èèna. ka limuri ne, ji'i mai asa ne'e, sèna ka ama parisa lii ne. pe èèna na, ama unu mu me'a ngaa dhu ji'i lole ne, mema lèke tare'a-re'a. d'ai sange èèna ka. makasi ae.

source_text: the jews joined in, saying that this was all true.
target_text: ropa tertulus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu yahudi leo sèra, re lii padhai lii na kahèi, aku rèngu na, tare'a, ama! dhu lèke kèna!

source_text: the governor motioned for paul to respond. recognizing you have been a judge over this nation for many years, i gladly make my defense, paul began.
target_text: hèia gubernur paredha paulus, aku nèngu na, ne'e ne, ja'a hia èu tebho ho siri iisi èu. hèia paulus kèd'i titu, ka na ded'e lii padhai, aku nèngu na, ama gubernur! ama paredha nèbhu le ètu propensi ji'i ne. de ama dhu me'a le tare'a-re'a, j'ara mamuri ji'i dhèu yahudi, tasa mera mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a madha'u boe siri iisi ètu katanga madha ama.

source_text: you can easily verify that i arrived in jerusalem to worship just twelve days ago.
target_text: pe d'ai canguru dua lod'o dhu la'e èèna, ja'a laku asa yerusalem ho sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ama bisa karèi sèku dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a sama-sama dènge ja'a lod'o èèna.

source_text: nobody found me arguing in the temple with anyone, or inciting people to riot in any synagogue or anywhere in the city.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a pab'ala boe dènge ca dhèu sa. aa ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a dhu leo sèra kahèi, ja'a oru kore boe dhèu ho tao maruru. sèmi èèna kahèi, ètu yerusalem, ja'a pakaco boe.

source_text: nor can they prove to you any of their accusations against me.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, dhèu se neo pamanahu ja'a. ngaa dhu ra padhai lii deo sa, lèke boe, lula dènge boe bukti.

source_text: but i will admit this to you: i serve the god of our fathers following the beliefs of the way, which they call a heretical sect. i believe everything the law teaches and what is written in the books of the prophets.
target_text: sèmi ne'e ka, ama gubernur. ja'a hud'i mangaku ku mi ama, ngaa èci. ja'a dhu madhutu partei hiu èci, dhu dhèu pangare na ‘j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus'. ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi bèi-baki ja'a sèra sabaj'a mi nèngu. ja'a madhutu kahèi atora aa'i-aa'i nèti baki musa, dènge parcaya tare'a-re'a ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, suri tèke hia ji'i.

source_text: i have the same hope in god that they do, believing that there will be a resurrection of the good and the wicked.
target_text: ja'a sanao-maena mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi rèngu dhu titu ètu se'e se, ho ra lab'a ja'a ne. ji'i se parcaya, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe: dhèu be'a, do bhelu-katub'a, èci èèna ka.

source_text: consequently i try to make sure i always have a clear conscience before god and everyone.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a ma'ète boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri dènge d'ara mola ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, aa dhèu rai-haha kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe pamanahu ja'a.

source_text: having been away for a few years i returned to bring some money to help the poor and to give offerings to god.
target_text: ja'a sab'a pèri-pèri tèu kèna, ètu li'u rai isra'el, ka ja'a heka lèpa asa yerusalem kèna. lod'o ja'a mai èèna, ja'a kèti doi dhu dhèu pakaboko sèna ka bantu dhèu-dhèu ji'i dhu mamuri j'èra. èle ka, ja'a laku asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ho neo sabaj'a, aa hia korban rupa-rupa mi ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: that's what they found me doing in the temple-completing the ceremony of purification. there was no crowd and no disturbance.
target_text: ropa ja'a pamèu iisi ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i madhutu j'ara ad'a ji'i, ka rèngu mai ho neo kèpe ja'a. te ngaa lod'o èèna, dhèu ae boe ètu sèra, aa èci sa dhu tao pakaco boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: but some jews from the province of asia were there, who should be present here before you today to bring their charges, if they have anything against me.
target_text: dhu ètu èèna, dhoka pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi nèti propensi asia, dhu mai neo sabaj'a ètu èèna kahèi. de ladhe rèngu sèi dhu neo tao lii langu dènge ja'a, rèngu sèra ka dhu hud'i mai tao lii langu dènge ja'a ku ètu ne'e. ama se'e se, aad'o!

source_text: otherwise let these men here explain themselves what crime they found me guilty of when i stood before the council,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sèi cèu boe. de ama karèi ku si, sasala ja'a ngaa? uru èèna, lod'o rèngu parisa lii ja'a ètu era parisa lii langu agama èèna, rèngu abhu boe sasala ja'a èci sa hèi. de ama ku karèi sèku rèngu!

source_text: except for the time when i shouted out to them, ‘i am on trial before you today because of my belief in the resurrection of the dead. '
target_text: dhoka ele boe ca j'ara di, dhu tao ngangee rèngu kaco, aa ra d'èi boe ja'a. ropa ja'a padhai lii dènge lii aae, peka na, ‘miu neo huku ja'a, lula ja'a parcaya, na, ama lamatua bisa pamamuri hari dhèu madhe! '

source_text: felix who was well-informed about the way then adjourned the trial. when lysias the commander comes i will make my decision regarding your case, he said.
target_text: paulus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa, lula gubernur feliks tadèngi ae le kahèi lula-nèti ‘j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus', ka na katange eele sidang èèna, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ka! ja'a neo paroa komedhaa lisias, ho nanene uuru ku lii lolo nèngu. ladhe ja'a padhai lii kore ku dènge nèngu, heka ja'a pama'ète lii ne'e kèna.

source_text: he ordered the centurion to keep paul in custody but to allow him some measure of freedom and to let paul's friends care for him without interference.
target_text: ka na pua ama sordad'u ca dhèu la'e taha paulus. te ngaa na paredha, sèna ka ako hia ne bebas ciki, aa baku kai mone-aanga angalai na sèra mai lalau ne.

source_text: some days later felix returned with his wife drusilla, who was jewish. he sent for paul and listened to him speak about trusting in christ jesus.
target_text: dhèu èmu gubernur feliks, dhèu yahudi, ngara na dorsila. pèri-pèri lod'o dhu la'e èèna, gubernur tenge lod'o dhu hua iia, sèna ka nèngu dènge dhèu èmu na neo padhai lii dènge paulus. ka na pua sèna ka dhèu rèti ne mai asa madha rèngu dua ra. hèia paulus lole dènge ra, j'ara tasamia sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya yesus kristus, dhèu dhu lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: he discussed with them about living right, self-control, and the coming judgment. felix became alarmed and told paul, you can go now, and i'll send for you when i get the chance.
target_text: na peka kahèi j'ara tasamia ho dhèu bisa muri mola, aa tasamia ho dhèu bisa j'aga ngi'u, sèna ka baku tao sala. na lole kahèi, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, peka na, lèke, do sala. ropa feliks tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka na madha'u. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, paulus! d'ai sange èèna ka laa! ladhe abhu lod'o taleo, na, ja'a paroa hari èu.

source_text: hoping that paul would give him a bribe, felix often sent for paul and talked with him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, gubernur feliks tenge-tenge j'ara, sèna ka paulus palèke ne doi, ho na patabuli eele ne. nèti èèna ka, na paroa taruu paulus, ho padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: two years passed and felix was succeeded by porcius festus. to stay in favor with the jews, felix left paul in prison.
target_text: te ngaa re j'ara leo, gubernur feliks neo ère d'ara kètu agama yahudi sèra kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na pama'ète boe lai-lai lii paulus ne'e. na soro tèke lii ne'e sène, toke d'ai dua tèu. èle èèna ka, abhu dhèu hiu dhu gati eele gubernur feliks. ngara na porkius festus. te ngaa rèngu taha taruu paulus.

source_text: three days after festus had arrived in the province he left caesarea to go to jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o èèna, gubernur hiu, festus, pidha asa kaisarea, ho neo pakako paredha na. nèngu pea ètu èèna dhoka tèlu lod'o di, ka na la'e taruu asa yerusalem.

source_text: the chief priests and jewish leaders came to him and brought their charges against paul.
target_text: ètu nèi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra, mai paraga sèna ka neo patadha dènge gubernur hiu ne. rèngu rèti kahèi dènge lii galaa rèngu mi paulus ètu d'ara lii padhue-padhai rèngu.

source_text: they begged festus as a favor to send paul to jerusalem, plotting to ambush and kill him on the way.
target_text: ra manèngi kahèi, ladhe bisa, na, gubernur pua dhèu nèngu sèra, rèti hari paulus ho lèpa asa yerusalem. te ngaa rèngu pare'a lii, neo pamadhe paulus ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: but festus replied that paul was in custody at caesarea and that he himself would be there shortly.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e ku, ama-ama! hud'i laa ra taha ne ètu kaisarea. te ja'a neo lèpa asa nèi d'ara lai-lai ne.

source_text: your leaders can come with me, and make their accusation against this man, if he has done anything wrong, he told them.
target_text: de ladhe nèti miu dhu abhu koasa ho uri lii langu ne, na, rèngu pakèd'i palere dènge ja'a asa kaisarea. ladhe tare'a dhèu ne'e tao sala ngaa, miu bisa tao lii dènge ne ètu nèi.

source_text: after staying there with them for no more than eight or ten days, festus returned to caesarea. the following day he took his seat as judge, and ordered that paul be brought before him. when he came in the jews that had come from jerusalem surrounded him and brought many serious charges against him that they couldn't prove.
target_text: èle èèna ka, festus pea pe d'ai canguru lod'o sa ètu yerusalem, heka na lèpa asa kaisarea kèna. lod'o èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu dènge nèngu, d'ai nèi. asa bèli èèna, hèia gubernur mulai parisa lii langu èèna. ka na pua dhèu lasi rare paulus mai asa madha na. ropa paulus maso asa èèna, dhèu yahudi se kèd'i titu rai-reo rare ne, ka ra mulai core sasala ae-ae mi nèngu. te ngaa rèngu bisa boe pad'elo bukti èci sa hèi.

source_text: paul defended himself, telling them, i have not sinned at all against the jewish law, the temple, or caesar.
target_text: hèia paulus siri iisi na, aku nèngu na, ama gubernur. ja'a tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu nèti bhabhelu-katub'a. ja'a tao boe kahèi j'ara èci sa dhu palab'a dènge agama yahudi ji'i. ja'a pakaj'alu boe èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu yerusalem. aa ja'a tao boe kahèi ngaa-ngaa dhu palab'a dènge j'ara-j'ara paredha roma.

source_text: but festus, who was looking to gain favor with the jews, asked paul, are you willing to go to jerusalem and be tried before me there about these matters?
target_text: te ngaa lula gubernur neo nare d'ara dhèu yahudi sèra, ka na karèi paulus, aku nèngu na, èu ngee tasamia? èu mo'o, do aad'o, ladhe ja'a uri lii langu èu ne ètu yerusalem?

source_text: i'm standing before caesar's court to be tried, right where i should be, paul replied. i have not done any wrong to the jews, as you very well know.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii karèi gubernur sèmi èèna, hèia paulus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama gubernur. ja'a ne, ana kabarai roma. ka limuri ne, ja'a titu ètu madha ama gubernur, dhèu paredha roma, dhu dènge hak ho parisa lii langu ja'a madhutu atora. de ja'a ko'o boe laku asa yerusalem, ho pama'ète lii ja'a ètu nèi. ama dhu me'a unu mu, peka na, ja'a ne tao boe sala ngaa-ngaa ho lab'a dhèu yahudi se'e.

source_text: if i've committed a crime and have done something that deserves death, i do not ask to be pardoned from a death sentence. but if there's no substance to these accusations they're making against me, then nobody has the right to hand me over to them. i appeal to caesar!
target_text: de ladhe tare'a-re'a ja'a tao sala ngaa-ngaa dhu palèke dènge huku mamadhe, ja'a sèmi kore. te ngaa ladhe ngaa dhu rèngu peka na, lèke boe madhutu atora roma, na, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu soro ja'a asa d'ara adhe-aai dhèu se'e. rèngu dhodhoka tenge j'ara di, sèna ka neo pamadhe ja'a. de madhutu hak ja'a, ja'a manèngi sèna ka lii langu ja'a ne hia asa dhèu aae kapai, keser, ètu kota roma. hud'i nèngu unu ku j'ue lii ja'a ne!

source_text: festus then conferred with the council, and replied, you have appealed to caesar. to caesar you shall go!
target_text: ropa tadèngi paulus manèngi sèmi èèna, ka gubernur padhue-padhai dènge anga na dhu madhutu uri lii langu èèna. èle èèna ka, na peka dènge paulus, aku nèngu na, lula èu manèngi le ca'e banding asa dhèu aae kapai, de èu hud'i lamu ku asa roma. peka èle sèmi èèna ka, gubernur katange eele sidang èèna.

source_text: several days later, king agrippa and his sister bernice arrived in caesarea and came to pay their respects to festus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, ngara na agripa, dènge ana hèni na, ngara bernike, mai asa kaisarea. rèngu dua ra mai sèna ka hia hormat mi gubernur hiu.

source_text: they were staying some time so festus presented paul's case to the king, explaining, there's a man that felix left as a prisoner here.
target_text: rèngu manubha pèri-pèri lod'o dènge gubernur festus. ca tèka, festus lole lii langu paulus dènge rèngu dua ra. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama dhèu aae! ètu kaisarea ne'e, ji'i taha dhèu èci, ngara na paulus. uru èèna, gubernur dhui abhu boe lod'o ho pama'ète lii langu na.

source_text: when i was in jerusalem, the jewish chief priests and leaders came and made accusations against him and asked me to sentence him.
target_text: d'ara lai-lai ne, lod'o ja'a ètu yerusalem, kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu heka d'ara rai sèra, mai galaa sasala paulus, ka ra manèngi ja'a sèna ka huku mema ka.

source_text: i replied that it is not according to roman law to convict anyone without having them face their accusers and giving them the opportunity to defend themselves against the charges.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka dènge rèngu, aku ja'a na, ‘madhutu atora paredha roma, ja'a hud'i parisa uru ku lii langu, heka hia huku kèna. aa dhèu dhu tao lii langu sèra, hud'i mai patoo madha dènge madha kahèi. sèna ka ja'a neo tadèngi ku sasala ngaa dhu miu pasale ne. aa nèngu kahèi abhu tebho sèna ka siri iisi na. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, ja'a heka pama'ète lii langu na, ladhe na sala, ja'a huku ne. '

source_text: so when his accusers arrived here, i wasted no time and convened the court the very next day. i ordered the man to be brought in.
target_text: lod'o ja'a lèpa asa kaisarea, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu palere dènge ja'a asa ne'e. asa bèli èèna, ja'a parisa dènge lii ne. ka ja'a hia rèti paulus mai asa madha ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo nanene j'aj'aj'i lii langu ne tasa mera mia.

source_text: however, when the accusers got up they didn't bring charges of criminal acts as i expected.
target_text: hèia dhèu-dhèu yahudi se titu, ho ra lolo sasala paulus èci-èci. te ngaa, ngaa dhu ra peka sèra bia boe sèmi dhu ja'a ngee.

source_text: instead they brought up controversies over religious questions, and over a man called jesus who was dead but whom paul insisted was alive.
target_text: rèngu se dhodhoka patasala ètu j'ara-j'ara agama rèngu di. te rèngu pab'ala dènge paulus, lula-nèti dhèu èci, ngara na yesus. madhutu rare'a dhèu yahudi, yesus èèna, madhe le. te ngaa paulus dènge èra, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le.

source_text: since i was undecided as to how to proceed in investigating such matters, i asked him if he was willing to go to jerusalem and be tried there.
target_text: rèngu pasisu sèmi èèna, te ngaa, lula ja'a ne dhèu hiu, ka ja'a ke'a mèka uri lii agama ne, tasamia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a karèi paulus, peka na, ‘tasamia ladhe ja'a parisa lii langu èu ne ètu yerusalem nèi? '

source_text: however, paul appealed for his case to be heard by the emperor, so i ordered him detained until i could send him to caesar.
target_text: te ngaa na sèmi nare boe. nèti èèna ka, na manèngi ca'e asa paredha dedha mi dhèu aae kapai ètu roma. ka ja'a patabuli boe ne, mate ja'a abhu lod'o ho rèti ne la'e asa roma.

source_text: i would like to hear the man myself, agrippa told festus. i'll arrange for you to hear him tomorrow, festus replied.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii lolo festus sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu aae agripa peka, aku nèngu na, be'a risi ja'a neo tadèngi unu ku, nèti dhèu èèna. hèia festus dhaa, na, bisa! bèli ku, pe ja'a uri ho ama nanene unu mu nèti dhèu èèna.

source_text: the next day agrippa arrived with bernice in great ceremonial splendor and entered the auditorium with the commanders and leading citizens. then festus ordered paul to be brought in.
target_text: d'ai bèli èèna, gubernur festus uri ho dhèu aae agripa bisa nanene lii padhai paulus. na uri kahèi, sèna ka dhèu ae nanene paulus. nuka: komedhaa-komedhaa sordad'u, dènge dhèu-dhèu kapai ètu kota kaisarea. èle èèna ka, dhèu aae agripa dènge bernike maso dènge mèdha-papake dhèu aae. ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra pakab'ua si. ropa rèngu pakaboko tesa-tesa le, hèia gubernur pua rèti paulus asa d'ara.

source_text: king agrippa, and everyone who is present here with us, festus began, you see before you this man whom all the jewish people, both here and in jerusalem, have complained to me about, shouting that he shouldn't be allowed to live.
target_text: hèia ra rèti paulus asa d'ara la'e. ka gubernur bhoka hèb'a, peka na, ama dhèu aae agripa, ama-ama, dènge miu tamu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu ja'a pakab'ua. dhèu ne'e ne, ngara na paulus. pèri-pèri ama dhèu yahudi sèra tao lii langu dènge ne. ka abhu dhu mai asa ja'a, rèngu cahag'e nèti yerusalem, aa cahag'e nèti era ne'e, mai laka-seti ja'a, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, bisa heka hia ne mamuri.

source_text: however, i discovered he has not committed any crime that deserves death, and since he has appealed to the emperor i decided to send him there.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a parisa ne. te ngaa ja'a abhu boe sasala dhu pamèci dènge huku madhe. te ngaa, lula nèngu unu na dhu manèngi le, ca'e asa paredha dedha ètu roma, nèti èèna ka, to'o do to'o boe, ja'a hud'i hia rèti ne ku la'e asa roma.

source_text: but i don't have anything specific to write about him to his imperial majesty. that's why i have brought him before you so i can have something definite to write. it doesn't seem fair to me to send on a prisoner without explaining the charges made against him.
target_text: ladhe ja'a hia lere rèti ne, ja'a hud'i ku tao sasuri. te ngaa deo ne'e ne, ja'a suri sasuri ne tasamia, hia mi dhèu aae kapai nèi? de nèti èèna ka, ja'a pakaboko ama-ama aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka miu nanene lii langu na. ropa tadèngi mere lii na, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama dhèu aae agripa, nori ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa suri ngaa dhu palèke dènge ngangee dhèu aae kapai nèi. ja'a ngee, na, lèke boe ladhe ja'a pa'adhu lii langu ne asa dhèu aae kapai la'e, te ngaa peka boe sasala dhu dhèu ne ad'u-ue. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii padhai lii ja'a. makasi!

source_text: agrippa then said to paul, you are free to speak on your own behalf. with a sweep of his arm, paul began his defense.
target_text: hèia dhèu aae agripa pua paulus, aku nèngu na, ne'e ne, èu bisa siri iisi èu. ji'i aa'i mi mate le neo nanene èu. ka paulus tao tadha dènge kacui-aai na, hèia na padhai lii, aku nèngu na,

source_text: i am delighted, king agrippa, to make my defense before you today regarding everything i am accused of by the jews,
target_text: ama dhèu aae agripa dhu ja'a pakab'ua. ja'a rasa oto, lula ama hia ja'a tebho sèna ka ja'a padhai lii dènge miu, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu yahudi se galaa mi ja'a.

source_text: particularly because you are an expert in all jewish issues and customs. i beg your patient indulgence as you listen to what i have to say.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, ama me'a risi eele ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi, dènge j'ara madhe-muri èdhi. de ja'a manèngi ho ama nanene paie ku lii ja'a ne.

source_text: all the jews know my life story-from my earliest days beginning in my own country and then in jerusalem.
target_text: karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai, ra aj'a-nori le ja'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. uru èèna, ra aj'a ja'a ètu rae. èle èèna ka, ja'a sakola tabha hari ètu yerusalem. dhèu yahudi ètu yerusalem sèra re'a le j'ara mamuri dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: they have known me for a long time and can verify, if they choose to, that i have followed the religious school that observes our faith in the strictest way-i lived as a pharisee.
target_text: ladhe kètu agama se ro'o, rèngu bisa lolo, peka na, rèngu se ka dhu tadhe le ja'a karèi nèti uru èèna ka. te ja'a ne maso partei agama parisi kahèi. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a, na, ji'i dhèu parisi se, dhu kèpe pa'èra aa madhutu atora aa'i-aa'i nèti agama yahudi.

source_text: now i am standing here to be judged regarding the promised hope god gave to our fathers that our twelve tribes hoped to receive as they continually dedicated themselves in god's service. yes, it's because of this hope that i'm accused by the jews, your majesty! why should any of you think it's unbelievable that god raises the dead?
target_text: ja'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti canguru dua suku isra'el, mate tae-tae ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii moa na. lii moa èèna, dhu na peka tèke le dènge bèi-baki èdhi karèi nèti uru ka. ka toke d'ai sange ne'e, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti manèngi-mangaj'i mèu-mèda, sèna ka lii moa lamatua èèna j'aj'i ka. isi lii moa èèna, peka na, èèna na nèngu neo pamamuri hari dhèu dhu madhe sèra. ama dhèu aae agripa dhu ja'a pakab'ua. lula ja'a parcaya, peka na, èèna na lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, nèti èèna ka, rèngu se tao lii langu dènge ja'a. de ja'a karèi ku: tasamia ka ètu talora aae miu se, abhu dhu mo'o boe parcaya, peka na, ama lamatua bisa pamamuri hari dhèu dhu madhe le? tatu nèngu bisa!

source_text: previously i was sincerely convinced i should do as much as i could to oppose the name of jesus of nazareth.
target_text: uru èèna, mema ja'a tao rupa-rupa j'ara ho palab'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: this is what i did in jerusalem. i threw many of the believers in prison, having been given authority to do this by the chief priests. when they were sentenced to death i cast my vote against them. i had them punished in all the synagogues, trying to make them recant. i was so furiously opposed to them that i went to cities outside our country to persecute them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ja'a koasa, sèna ka laku paj'èra dhèu unu yesus ètu mia-mia. ja'a kèpe si, ka nuni kèti si asa yerusalem, ho core si pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. ja'a madhutu pama'ète sèna ka huku madhe si cahag'e. ja'a laku kahèi asa d'ara èmu-èmu sabaj'a, ho paj'èra si. aa ja'a neo pakaseti si, sèna ka rèngu tèke eele parcaya rèngu mi yesus. ae ka dhu ja'a laku magèi si dènge d'ara sagoro tob'i-tob'i. sad'i ja'a tadèngi dhèu parcaya yesus sèra ètu era èci, do masi ka d'ai rai leo èèna ka, ja'a laku magèla kore si!

source_text: that's why one day i was on my way to damascus with the authority and orders from the chief priests.
target_text: èle èèna ka, paulus tuhu hari lii na, peka na, ca tèka, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ja'a sasuri koasa ho laku magèla dhèu parcaya yesus ètu kota damsik. ka ja'a laku.

source_text: at about noon as i was on my way, your majesty, i saw a light from heaven that blazed brighter than the sun. it shone around me and those who were traveling with me.
target_text: ama dhèu aae agripa! ropa ji'i ètu talora j'ara era, pe d'ai lod'o titu mera sa, cag'ag'a laa, saraa aae èci dhu mariu nèti dedha-liru, senter lèke ja'a dènge anga ja'a sèra.

source_text: all of us fell to the ground. then i heard a voice speaking to me in aramaic, ‘saul, saul, why are you persecuting me? it's hard for you to fight against me! '
target_text: ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi bèbha baa-baa ètu rai, lula saraa èèna mariu aae. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci, pake lii aram, peka na, ‘we, saul! nga tao ka èu loe boe paj'èra ja'a ne? bia titu kèna, ladhe èu sisu taruu dad'èi ja'a. '

source_text: ‘who are you, lord? ' i asked. ‘i am jesus, the one you're persecuting, ' the lord replied.
target_text: ja'a tadèngi lii èèna, te ngaa ladhe kèdhi boe dhèu èèna. ka ja'a karèi, peka na, ‘ama dhu padhai lii ne, cee ka èu? ' hèia lii èèna dhaa mi ja'a, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, yesus, dhu èu paj'èra taruu èèna.

source_text: ‘but pick yourself up and get to your feet. the reason why i've appeared to you is to appoint you as my servant, to be a witness for me, telling others how you have seen me and everything i will reveal to you.
target_text: saul! kèd'i ka! ja'a pad'elo iisi mi èu ne, sèna ka èu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a. èu hud'i lamu ku lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ngaa dhu èu mèdhi le nèti ja'a limuri ne. ladhe èèna na, ja'a pad'elo asa ae hari dènge èu, ngaa-ngaa dhu hiu, sèna ka lamu lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: i will save you from your own people and from the foreigners. i am sending you to them
target_text: èèna na, èu paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae-ae. te ngaa ja'a j'aga èu nèti dhèu dhu neo paj'èra èu, masi ka nèti dhèu yahudi, do nèti dhèu yahudi boe. tare'a! ja'a pua èu lamu asa dhèu dhu yahudi boe.

source_text: to open their eyes so they can turn from darkness to light, from the power of satan to god, and so they can receive forgiveness for their sins and a place with those who are set right as they trust in me. '
target_text: lamu bhoke musi madha si, sèna ka re'a, ho ra mamuri ètu d'ara saraa. hèia ra tèke eele j'ara-j'ara mamuri ra dhu koe-kapengo sèra. aa èu hud'i pad'elo kahèi, j'ara mamuri dhu mola. lamu ho patabuli eele si nèti koasa dhèu aae nidhu, sèna ka mèti si asa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo aa'i-aa'i si. ka rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu lamatua hag'e nare le, lula rèngu parcaya ja'a. èèna ka dhu ja'a peka dènge èu, saul! '

source_text: clearly, king agrippa, i could not disobey this vision from heaven.
target_text: hèia paulus tuhu hari lii, peka na, de ama dhèu aae. sasab'a dhu ja'a sèmi kore unu ku nèti sorga, ja'a pakako ne. toke d'ai doe ne'e ne, ja'a sab'a taruu, ae mèka ciki sa.

source_text: first in damascus, then in jerusalem, and then all over judea and also to the foreigners i shared the message of repentance: how they should turn to god, demonstrating their repentance through their actions.
target_text: hiu-hiu èèna, ja'a lole j'ara mamuri yesus mi dhèu yahudi ètu damsik sèra. èle èèna ka, ja'a mai lole dènge dhèu yahudi dhu ètu yerusalem dènge palème propensi yudea. hèia ja'a laku palème kabarai dhèu dhu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a padhai lii pahuni boe dènge rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ho ra tèke eele j'ara mamuri rèngu dhu sala sèra, sèna ka ra saraka mamuri rèngu mi ama lamatua. rèngu hud'i tao dhu be'a ku ètu d'ara mamuri rèngu hia mi dhèu leo kahèi, ho j'aj'i tadha, peka na, rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu hiu ètu lamatua.

source_text: that's why the jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi sèra kèpe ja'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ètu yerusalem. rèngu neo pamadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: god has looked after me so i can stand here today as a witness to everyone, both to ordinary people and to those who are important. i am only repeating what moses and the prophets said would happen-
target_text: te ngaa malo-malo ka ama lamatua soru ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mamuri d'ai sange ne'e ne. de ja'a bisa titu ètu ne'e, ho lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, ana iiki-dhèu kapai, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri yesus. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, aa'i-aa'i ra, èci èèna ka dènge lii a'aj'a-nanori nèti musa dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru sèra.

source_text: how the messiah had to suffer, and that by being the first to rise from the dead he would announce the light of god's salvation to both jews and foreigners.
target_text: rèngu aj'a-nori lula-nèti kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa neo hia mai. dhu peka na, kristus hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra. hèia na madhe. te ngaa èle èèna, nèngu ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu uru dhu ama lamatua pamamuri hari. nèngu ka dhu pasaraa dhèu yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu-dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: festus interrupted paul as he made his defense, shouting out, paul, you've gone mad! all your knowledge is driving you insane!
target_text: ropa paulus lole sasab'a na era, ka festus cag'ag'a laa poro ète lii padhai na dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, he! paulus! èu ne, tao-tao dhu huj'u le. èu mèu ae ka, kahadhu èu, ele iie.

source_text: i'm not mad, festus your excellency, paul replied. what i am saying is true and makes sense.
target_text: te ngaa paulus dhaa, peka na, ama gubernur dhu ja'a pakab'ua. ja'a ne huj'u boe. ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a lole ne, mema lèke tare'a. ja'a leko boe.

source_text: the king recognizes this, and i'm explaining it very clearly. i am sure that he is aware of what's been happening, because none of this took place as if it were hidden in a corner.
target_text: ama dhèu aae agripa unu na dhu ne'a le kahèi, ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bani padhai lii dènge boe pasili. ja'a lèka ama dhèu aae dhu tadèngi le j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i, lula ngaa dhu j'aj'i sèra, j'aj'i boe ètu era pahuni. dhu peka na, yesus dhu madhe èèna, muri hari le. dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a le j'ara ne.

source_text: king agrippa, do you believe what the prophets said? i'm sure you do!
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra peka mema le j'ara ne'e. ja'a bani patèka, peka na, ama dhèu aae parcaya kahèi, lii dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra, sina ma?

source_text: do you think you can convince me to become a christian so quickly? agrippa asked paul.
target_text: ka dhèu aae agripa, poro ète lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na, ee, paulus! nèbhu boe, te èu pamaso ja'a j'aj'i dhèu sarani!

source_text: whether it takes a short time or a long time doesn't matter, paul answered. but my prayer to god is that not just you, but everybody listening to me today would become like me-except for these chains!
target_text: te ngaa paulus dhaa, sèmi ne'e, ama. ja'a manèngi mi ama lamatua, sèna ka d'ara lai-lai ne, do ako nèbhu hari ciki, baku dhoka ama dhèu aae di mesa na, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu deo ne'e ne tadèngi lii padhai ja'a ne, j'aj'i sama sèmi ja'a, nuka dhèu unu yesus! sad'i dhodhoka ama si baku j'aj'i dhèu bèdho, sama sèmi dhu ja'a pasae ne.

source_text: the king stood up, along with the governor and bernice, and everyone who had been sitting with them.
target_text: ropa paulus peka nare, ka dhèu aae agripa dènge ana hèni na bernike, gubernur festus, dènge dhèu kapai aa'i-aa'i sèra, kèd'i titu, hèia lèpa aa'i.

source_text: they conferred together after they had left. this man hasn't done anything that deserves death or imprisonment, they concluded.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, ra padhue, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, tao sala boe ngaa-ngaa dhu palèke dènge huku madhe, do pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho!

source_text: agrippa told festus, he could have been freed if he hadn't appealed to caesar.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aae agripa peka dènge gubernur festus, aku nèngu na, kasian. dhèu ne manèngi le ca'e asa paredha dedha mi dhèu aae kapai ètu roma. ladhe aad'o, na, lii langu ne èle le, aa bisa patabuli ne.

source_text: when the time came for us to sail to italy, paul and some other prisoners were handed over to a centurion called julius, of the imperial regiment.
target_text: hèia gubernur festus pama'ète, sèna ka lere rèti paulus la'e asa madha dhèu aae kapai keser ètu roma, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu na ètu nèi. ka na pangèd'u paulus dènge dhèu bèdho dhu leo sèra, asa komedhaa sordad'u èci, ngara na yulius, ho lere nèti si asa propensi italia. yulius ne, komedhaa nèti sordad'u dhu madhenge keser.

source_text: we boarded a ship based in adramyttium that was headed to the coastal ports of the province of asia, and we set sail. aristarchus, a macedonian from thessalonica, went with us.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ja'a nuka lukas, laku lere kahèi paulus. aa dènge angalai èci, dhèu makedonia nèti kota tesalonika, ngara na aristarkus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ca'e kapa cue, dhu mai nèti kota adramitium. madhutu dad'èi juraga, kapa ne neo dhuli hèb'a-namo ae ètu propensi asia.

source_text: the next day we had a brief stop at sidon, and julius was kind enough to let paul go ashore and visit his friends so they could provide what he needed.
target_text: ji'i pakèd'i tèke eele kaisarea. ka d'ai bèli èèna, ji'i d'ai kota sidon. komedhaa yulius tao paulus dènge be'a, aa na peka dènge ne kahèi, bisa la'e pangad'o dènge angalai na ètu dae. dad'èi yulius sèna ka paulus bisa abhu nèti rèngu, ngaa dhu na parluu ètu d'ara kakako na.

source_text: we set out from there and sailed to the leeward of cyprus because the winds were against us.
target_text: hèia ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ca'e hari, ho pakèd'i. te ngaa ngèlu madha kapai seli, toke kapa ne oe kako nare boe. ka ra pod'e kaduru kapa ne, re talora aae pulu siprus dènge rai siria, sèna ka ako abhe ngèlu nèti madha.

source_text: then we sailed directly across the open sea off the coast of cilicia and pamphylia, arriving at the port of myra in lycia.
target_text: nèti èèna, ji'i pab'ab'e j'ara, ète re madha propensi kilikia dènge propensi pamfilia. ka ji'i la'a taruu d'ai kota mira, ètu rai likia. d'ai nèi, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi puru tèke eele kapa èèna.

source_text: there the centurion found a ship from alexandria that would be sailing to italy, and arranged for us to join it.
target_text: ètu mira, komedhaa yulius tenge kapa leo dhu neo pakèd'i asa italia. ka na abhu kapa cue dhu mai nèti kota aleksandria, dhu neo pakèd'i asa italia. hèia na pua ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ho ca'e kapa èèna.

source_text: we sailed slowly for several days and eventually arrived off cnidus. but since the winds wouldn't allow us to continue we sailed across to the lee of crete, near to salmone.
target_text: ji'i pakèd'i pèri-pèri lod'o kèna, te ngaa ngare boe mia-mia, lula ngèlu madha mèdhu aae. nèbhu j'oo-aae ku, heka ji'i padètu dènge kota knidus. te ngaa ngèlu madha loe boe, ka ji'i poro hari j'ara la'a asa pulu kreta, sèna ka ako pa'abhe ciki. èle èèna ka, ji'i oe seli suu rai èci, ngara na salmone.

source_text: with some difficulty we made our way along the coast until we arrived at a place called fair havens, near to the town of lasea.
target_text: ji'i seli suu rai èèna dènge j'èra titu kèna. ka ji'i oro-oro re sebhe pulu kreta, hèia ji'i heka d'ai era èci, ngara na hèb'a-namo saraga. era èèna, padètu dènge kota lasea.

source_text: we'd lost a lot of time, and the voyage was becoming dangerous because it was now after the fast. paul warned them,
target_text: d'ai èèna, ana mataroo kapa se ae rara iisi ciki, lula ji'i nèbhu ae le ètu lèu, te ngaa d'ai mèka italia. lod'o èèna, seli le lod'o kalela saku eele dosa dhèu yahudi. dhu tema le, ropa èle lod'o kalela èèna, j'aj'i ngèlu aae dènge dhasi kapai. hèia ana mataroo kapa se pakarèi, j'aj'i pakèd'i, do aad'o. ropa tadèngi lii ana mataroo kapa se, paulus padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: men, i predict that this voyage will result in much hardship and loss-not just of the cargo and the ship, but also our very lives.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i. ja'a neo padhai lii ciki. ja'a pangee, ladhe sèmi èdhi kako taruu, bisa èdhi paraga dènge j'aj'èra ae. kapa ne bisa molo kahèi, mèdha-panyau ela aa'i mèu-mèu, aa èdhi bisa madhe aa'i ti kahèi.

source_text: but the centurion paid more attention to the advice of the ship's captain and its owner than to what paul said.
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa sordad'u èèna, d'èi boe nanene lii paulus. nèngu lèka risi juraga dènge lamatua kapa èèna. lula rèngu neo kako taruu, tèke eele era èèna.

source_text: since the harbor was not large enough to over winter in, the majority were in favor of leaving and trying if possible to reach phoenix and spend the winter there-a harbor in crete that faces northwest and southwest.
target_text: dhu carui ka, ladhe d'ai lod'o dhasi aae, kapa bisa boe panahu dènge be'a ètu hèb'a-namo saraga èèna. nèti èèna ka, ae ka nèti rèngu d'èi sèna ka ji'i pakèd'i taruu, ho la'a asa kota feniks. rèngu sanao ladhe bisa, na, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi pea ètu nèi, d'ara hèru dhasi aae ne. kota feniks nèi, hèb'a-namo pulu kreta dhu mau, lula nèngu ne era dhu abhe nèti ngèlu badae-haa dènge ngèlu badae-dhimu, aa abhu boe naha kapai.

source_text: when a moderate south wind began to blow, they thought they could do what they planned. they pulled up the anchor and sailed close inshore along the coast of crete.
target_text: ropa ngèlu balèu tiu g'oro mau-mau, ra pangee, na, ngèlu ne bisa lere ji'i d'ai kota feniks, ka ra peka na, ngèlu ne be'a. de mai ti pakèd'i ka! hèia ra balu tangad'a, dènge ère lai, ka la'a oro-oro re sebhe pulu.

source_text: but it wasn't long before a hurricane-force wind called a northeaster blew from the land. the ship was forced out to sea and could not face into the wind. so we had to give in and allow ourselves to be driven before the wind.
target_text: ji'i dhu pakèd'i nèbhu mèka, te ngaa ngèlu aae mai. dhu dhèu peka na, ‘ngèlu badae-dhimu'. ka lai ngèlu ne, tiu nèti kapa ne asa talora lèu. ana mataroo se soro lèke heka kad'uru kapa, ka ra soro tèke ne sène, hud'i madhutu ngèlu tao ne.

source_text: we were eventually able to run into the lee of a small island called cauda, and managed with some difficulty to secure the ship's boat on board.
target_text: naha hae nèti kapa, toke d'ai padètu pulu iiki cue, ngara na kauda. lod'o èèna, ana kèni dhu èki ètu hui kapa. hèia ji'i d'ai madhe ère ana kèni ne asa dedha kapa mai.

source_text: after hoisting it aboard, the sailors bound ropes around the hull to strengthen it. then, worried that they would be wrecked on the syrtis banks, they lowered the sea anchor and allowed the ship to be driven along.
target_text: ropa ana kèni d'ai dedha kapa, ra hèlu kapa ne dènge dhari, lula mage dhoka papa aj'u se bhoke eele, ho molo. rèngu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka naha hahake kapa ne, ho eta ètu d'ara mara sirtis ètu afrika nèi. ka ra palalodhe tangad'a, sèna ka taha kakako kapa ne.

source_text: the following day as we were violently thrown about by the storm, the crew started throwing the cargo overboard.
target_text: ngèlu aae hahake kapa ji'i ne sebhe g'ana-kariu. ka asa bèli mad'ae èèna, ana mataroo kapa se mulai core eele mèdha asa d'ara dhasi.

source_text: on the third day they grabbed the ship's gear and tossed it into the sea.
target_text: toke d'ai camèd'a èèna, ngèlu dhu kapai era. de rèngu asa madha'u. nèti èèna ka, ra core eele tabha hari mèdha-mèdha dhu ra hua ètu dedha kapa, sèna ka pasamaa kapa. aa ana mataroo kèpe rare kahèi, mèdha-panyau kapa èèna, ka ra core eele.

source_text: we hadn't seen the sun or the stars for many days as the storm beat down on us; so any hope of our being saved was lost.
target_text: mèu-mèda ngèlu aae ne loe boe ciki sa, toke d'ai pèri-pèri lod'o. aa liru bhoka boe ciki sa, ka ji'i ladhe ngèdhi boe madha lod'o dènge hua-hètu. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ele ngangee, ka dhu ngee, na, ji'i mamuri heka.

source_text: nobody had eaten anything for a long time. then paul stood before them and told them, men, you should have listened to me and not sailed from crete. then you could have avoided all this hardship and loss.
target_text: pèri-pèri lod'o kèna, ji'i nga'a-nginu boe ciki sa. hèia paulus paroa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, aku nèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i! sèmi dhu miu se madhutu lii ja'a, baku tèke eele hèb'a-namo saraga, tatu èdhi abhu boe j'èra ae sèmi ne'e, aa èdhi rugi boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but now i advise you keep up your courage, because nobody is going to be lost, just the ship.
target_text: deo ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi miu aa'i-aa'i mi, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara mi. èèna na kapa èdhi ne laho mae-mae. te ngaa baku madha'u, te ca dhèu sa nèti èdhi madhe boe.

source_text: last night an angel of my god and whom i serve, stood beside me.
target_text: ja'a neo sèna ka miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ja'a ne dhèu unu ama lamatua. nèngu ka dhu pangèd'u ja'a sasab'a. mèda deo na, na pua ana pajuu na èci nèti sorga, mai ka titu ètu sebhe ja'a. hèia na peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na,

source_text: ‘don't be afraid, paul, ' he told me. ‘you have to stand trial before caesar. see, god has graciously given to you everyone who is sailing with you. '
target_text: ‘paulus! èu baku madha'u. èèna na, èu lamu paraga dènge dhèu aae kapai ètu roma, sèna ka uri lii langu èu. lula d'ara lamatua be'a dènge èu, nèti èèna ka na hia mamuri kahèi mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha kapa ne. '

source_text: so men, have courage! i trust god, and i'm convinced things will happen just as i was told.
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i mi! miu baku ele ngangee. ja'a ne lèka tare'a-re'a ama lamatua, peka na, ngaa dhu na peka dènge ja'a mèda deo na, èèna na j'aj'i sama sèmi èèna.

source_text: however, we will be wrecked on some island.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èèna na, kapa ne eta ètu pulu cue.

source_text: at around midnight on the fourteenth night of the storm, still being blown over the sea of adria, the crew suspected they were getting close to land.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhasi-ngèlu hahake kalabhe ka ji'i eeb'o-eeb'o ètu lèu aae d'ara canguru èpa lod'o kèna, ètu dhasi adria. te ngaa pe d'ai talora mèda sa, ana mataroo kapa se, sèmi dhu re'a, na, ji'i oe dètu le dènge dae.

source_text: they checked the depth and found it was forty meters, and a little while later they checked again and it was thirty meters.
target_text: hèia ra papuru dhari ho uku marèma dhasi. era èèna, marèma na dua nguru rèpa. kapa ara hari ciki asa madha, ra papuru hari dhari, ka era èèna, canguru lèmi rèpa.

source_text: they were concerned that we might be wrecked on rocks, so they dropped four anchors from the stern, and prayed for daylight to come.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u, mage dhoka kapa ne rage hadhu. ka ra papuru tangad'a hui, èpa bua. ka ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi sanao, sèna ka mèu ka lai-lai.

source_text: the crew tried to leave the ship, and had lowered the ship's boat into the water with the pretext that they were going to drop anchors from the ship's bow.
target_text: te ngaa ana mataroo kapa se, rare lii èci, ho neo rai eele kapa ne dènge mau-mau, sèna ka dhèu re'a boe. ka ra papuru ana kèni, tao nuka sèmi neo papuru tangad'a-tangad'a kaduru.

source_text: but paul told the centurion and the soldiers, unless the crew stays with the ship, you will be lost.
target_text: te ngaa paulus bhoke ngangee karehe rèngu mi komedhaa dènge sordad'u na sèra, peka na, ladhe ana mataroo se rai eele kapa ne, miu madhe aa'i mi.

source_text: so the soldiers cut the ropes holding the ship's boat, and let it loose.
target_text: ropa tadèngi paulus peka sèmi èèna, hèia sordad'u sèra j'ue pama'ète dhari ana kèni na, sèna ka ana kèni na pataleb'o eele pakaj'èu nèti kapa. nèti èèna ka, ana mataroo se j'aj'i heka rai.

source_text: at daybreak paul urged all of them to eat something. it's been fourteen days now that you haven't eaten anything because you've been so worried and preoccupied, he told them.
target_text: ropa d'ara oe mèu sa, hèia paulus rarange dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ho ra'a-rinu, aku nèngu na, canguru èpa lod'o kèna, èdhi dhoka madhèdi di, dènge sanao-maena, dhu ta'a-tinu boe ngaa-ngaa ciki sa.

source_text: please do what i say and eat some food. this will help give you strength. for not even a hair from anyone's head is going to be lost!
target_text: de ja'a manèngi sèna ka èdhi ta'a-tinu ku ciki, ho èdhi abhu hari a'èra. ja'a parcaya, na, abhu boe èci sa nèti èdhi dhu paraga dènge j'aj'èra. tatu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti mamuri!

source_text: when he'd finished speaking he picked up a loaf of bread, and gave thanks to god for it in front of everyone. then he broke the bread, and began to eat.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka paulus nare roti. ka na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua ètu madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. hèia nare ca'èta, ka na'a.

source_text: everyone was encouraged and they ate too. the total number of people on board was two hundred and seventy-six.
target_text: ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka d'ara rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i èra hari. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra ra'a kahèi. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi ètu dedha kapa ne, dua ngasu pidhu nguru èna dhèu. ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi nga'a-nginu.

source_text: once they'd had enough to eat, the crew made the ship lighter by throwing the supplies of wheat overboard.
target_text: ropa bècu ngare, ana mataroo kapa se core eele karo-karo are-gandum asa d'ara dhasi, sèna ka ngi'u kapa abhu samaa hari.

source_text: when dawn came they didn't recognize the coastline, but they saw a bay that had a beach. they planned to try running the ship aground there.
target_text: ropa d'ara mèu te'e sa, ana mataroo kapa se ladhe rèdhi rai-dedha. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe rai mia èèna. rèngu ladhe rèdhi kahèi sai èci, dhu dènge salae. ka rèngu sanao ka, teko-teko rèngu bisa rèti kapa ne, maso asa hèb'a, ladhe oro-oro ku re sebhe lia ètu d'ara dhasi èèna, heka ra d'ai era salae èèna kèna.

source_text: so they cut the anchor ropes, leaving the anchors in the sea. at the same time they untied the ropes holding the rudders, raised the foresail to the wind, and made for the beach.
target_text: hèia ra ète eele tangad'a sèra, hud'i sène ètu d'ara dhasi. ka ra papuru uli, sèna ka hia kapa ne asa dae la'e. hèia ra ère paca'e lai cika, sèna ka ngèlu tiu kapa ne asa era salae èèna.

source_text: but they struck a sandbar and the ship grounded. the bow hit, and stuck so firmly it couldn't be moved, while the stern began to be broken apart by the pounding surf.
target_text: te ngaa, lula kapa ne rage oto, ka eta dènge ètu èèna, bisa heka kalau ciki sa. hèia naha aae mai, hake pamae hui kapa ne.

source_text: the soldiers planned to kill the prisoners so none of them could swim away and escape.
target_text: ropa sordad'u se ladhe rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka ra neo pamadhe aa'i ana bèdho sèra. lula ra pangee, mage dhoka ana bèdho sèra nangi lasi asa dae, ho ra rai.

source_text: but the centurion, because he wanted to save paul's life, prevented them from doing this, and ordered those who could swim to jump overboard first and make for land.
target_text: te ngaa komedhaa yulius kai sordad'u nèngu sèra, lula na neo sèna ka paulus bisa mamuri. ka na paredha ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a nangi ridhu asa d'ara dhasi, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: the rest grabbed hold of planks and other wreckage, so that everyone was able to reach land safely.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu re'a boe nangi, na pua si kèpe papa, do sad'i rage ngaa sa, sèna ka madhutu naha hae asa dae. ka ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ai dae dènge sod'a.

source_text: when we were safely ashore, we discovered that we were on the island of malta.
target_text: ropa ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi d'ai dae dènge sod'a, heka nge'a kèna, na, rai èèna, pulu malta.

source_text: the people there were very kind-they started a fire and called all of us over so we could warm up from the rain and the cold.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu ètu kabarai èèna, sèmi rare ji'i dènge be'a. lula èj'i mai, ka pacuhi titu kèna, nèti èèna ka, ra bhubhu ai ètu kètu nebhe èèna, ka ra gale ji'i la'a manyiru ai.

source_text: paul collected a bundle of firewood and threw it on the fire. but a poisonous snake was driven out of the bundle because of the heat and bit him, fastening itself on his hand.
target_text: paulus madhutu kabhili aj'u kahèi, ho palake asa d'ara ai. te ngaa ropa na tao aj'u asa d'ara ai, cag'ag'a laa, mege ci'u dhu dènge raco kalua asa li'u mai, lula taha boe dènge ai pana. ka na kadhi kacui-aai paulus.

source_text: when the people there saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, this man must be a murderer. even though he escaped death from the sea, justice won't let him live.
target_text: ropa dhèu malta sèra ladhe rèdhi mege dhu dhone-dhone ètu kacui-aai paulus, ka ra paka'uu èci dènge èci, peka na, èle boe dhèu ne, tuka pamadhe dhèu. ka masi ka nèngu madhe boe dhasi, te ngaa ne'e ne d'ai unu nèngu kèna. nèti èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka mamuri! lula cee dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, nèngu ka dhu sèmi nare babia na.

source_text: however, paul shook the snake off into the fire, and suffered no ill effects. they were expecting him to swell up, or suddenly fall down dead. but after waiting a long time, they saw that nothing bad had happened to him so they changed their minds and decided he must be a god.
target_text: dhèu se pangee, na, tatu ciki oo'e hari, kacui-aai paulus bai, ho na madhe dènge ka. te ngaa paulus pici mege ne asa d'ara ai la'e. aa na rasa boe pèd'a ciki sa. ka dhèu se'e tatae ku nèbhu j'oo aae, te ngaa paulus ngaa-ngaa tao boe. hèia ra pangee, na, èle boe dhèu ne, dewa!

source_text: nearby were lands that belonged to publius, the chief official of the island. he welcomed us and looked after us for three days very hospitably.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era èèna, abhu èmu-èmu gubernur ètu rai dhu taleo. gubernur èèna, ngara na publius. na mai soru ji'i ètu nebhe dhasi, ka gale nèti ji'i la'a pea ètu èmu na. ètu èèna, na ladhe-leru ji'i tèlu lod'o.

source_text: now publius' father was sick, lying in bed suffering from fever and dysentery. paul went in to see him, and prayed for him, placed his hands on him, and healed him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama d'èlu gubernur pèd'a maringi sagoro, dènge pèd'a po'e taruu. ka paulus la'e ladhe ne asa d'ara kama na. hèia na soro kacui-aai na g'ag'e dhèu pèd'a ne, ho na sabaj'a hia ne. ka na èle dènge ka.

source_text: after this happened, everyone else who was sick on the island came and was healed.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi ama d'èlu gubernur èle le, ka dhèu pèd'a dhu leo sèra mai asa paulus. ra manèngi tulu nèti nèngu, ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: they presented us with many gifts, and when we had to sail they provided everything we needed for the voyage.
target_text: hèia dhèu se pad'elo tadha makasi rèngu, dènge rèti mèdha ae titu kèna hia ji'i.

source_text: after a three month stay we set sail aboard a ship from alexandria that had spent the winter at the island. it had a figurehead of the heavenly twins.
target_text: ji'i pea ètu malta tèlu hèru, toke pa'èle hèru dhasi-ngèlu aae. lod'o èèna, abhu kapa cue nèti alexandria dhu karèi nèti hèru dhasi aae ngèlu aae panahu le ètu èèna. ngara kapa na, ana kembar, lula ètu kaduru kapa ne, ra tao patung dewa kembar. ka ji'i neo ca'e kapa èèna, ho la'a taruu asa roma. de lod'o ji'i neo ca'e asa dedha kapa, dhèu malta sèra hia ji'i parèko j'ara dènge mèdha leo dhu ji'i parluu ètu d'ara kakako.

source_text: we stopped at syracuse, and spent three days there.
target_text: ji'i kako mau-mau, ka ji'i d'ai kota sirakusa, ètu pulu sisilia. hèia ji'i panahu ètu èèna, tèlu lod'o.

source_text: from there we sailed on to rhegium. the following day a south wind blew, and on the second day we arrived at the port of puteoli,
target_text: nèti èèna, ji'i kako oro-oro re sebhe pulu sisilia, ka ji'i d'ai kota regium. asa bèli èèna, ngèlu balèu mèdhu aae, hèia ji'i kako taruu, ka d'ai malai. asa camèd'a èèna, ji'i d'ai kota hèb'a-namo cue, ngara na putioli.

source_text: where we discovered some believers. they asked us to stay with them for a week. so we came to rome.
target_text: ètu èèna, ji'i puru tèke eele kapa èèna. hèia ji'i la'a tenge dhèu sarani dhu ètu era sèra. ropa paraga dènge ra, ka ra manèngi sèna ka ji'i pea dènge rèngu. ka ji'i manubha ètu èèna, ca migu. èle èèna ka, ji'i kako haga la'a asa roma.

source_text: when some of the believers from rome heard we had arrived they came to meet us at the forum of appius and the three taverns. when paul saw them, he was thankful to god and much encouraged.
target_text: ropa dhèu sarani ètu roma sèra tadèngi, na, ji'i neo la'a asa nèi, hèia rèngu mai soru ji'i ètu talora j'ara. cahag'e paraga dènge ji'i ètu pasa apius; aa cahag'e hari paraga dènge ji'i ètu era èci, ngara na pasanggrahan tèlu. lod'o paulus ladhe nèdhi si, ka na manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, ka d'ara na èra dènge.

source_text: when we entered rome, paul was permitted to stay under house arrest with a soldier to guard him.
target_text: ropa d'ai roma, sordad'u sèra pamaso dhèu bèdho sèra asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa ra pamaso boe paulus. ra hud'i ne sène, ho bisa seb'a èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, na pea dènge sordad'u dhèu èci dhu j'aga ne. kacui-aai rèngu dua ra, dhu èki pake rate.

source_text: three days later paul invited the jewish leaders there to come to see him. when they were all together he told them, brothers, even though i had not done anything wrong against the people or the customs of our forefathers, i was arrested in jerusalem and handed over to the roman authorities.
target_text: èle tèlu lod'o, hèia paulus paroa dhèu heka-dhèu heka dhèu yahudi ètu sèra, ho mai paraga dènge ne. ropa ra pakaboko, hèia paulus padhai lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ètu ne'e ne, lula a'ari èdhi dhèu yahudi sèra kèpe rare ja'a ètu yerusalem. ka ra soro ja'a asa d'ara kacui-aai dhèu paredha roma. te ngaa ja'a tao sala boe ngaa-ngaa! ja'a tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu lab'a isi kabarai èdhi. aa ja'a lab'a boe kahèi atora ad'a dhu èdhi sèmi tare nèti bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: after they had interrogated me they wanted to release me because i had done nothing that warranted execution.
target_text: dhèu paredha parisa le lii ja'a ne ètu nèi. te ngaa ra abhu boe sasala ja'a èci sa dhu bisa abhu huku madhe. nèti èèna ka, ra neo patalale eele ja'a.

source_text: but the jewish leaders opposed this, so i was forced to appeal to caesar-not that i had any accusations against my own people.
target_text: te ngaa, lula ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèmi boe lii pama'ète nèti dhèu paredha ho patalale ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ko'o do ko'o boe, ja'a hud'i ca'e banding ku mai asa roma. masi ka ja'a tao sèmi ne'e, te ngaa dènge boe d'ara neo galaa dhèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: that's why i asked to see you, and talk to you, because it is on account of the hope of israel that i am chained up like this.
target_text: nèti lii langu ne'e ka, ja'a pakaboko a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e. madhutu dad'èi ja'a, èdhi bisa padhue-padhai ngaa dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi sanao-maena: nuka, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sanao mi dhèu aae dhu ama lamatua neo hia mai, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi dhèu isra'el. nèti j'ara se'e ka, ra èki ja'a dènge rate ne.

source_text: we have not received any letters from judea about you, and none of our people have come here with reports against you or to speak badly of you, they told him.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, toke d'ai lod'o deo ne'e ne, ji'i sèmi mèka sasuri èci sa nèti yudea, dhu peka lii langu èu ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, a'ari dhu mai nèti nèi, lolo boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa lula-nèti èu.

source_text: but we do want to hear from you what you believe-especially regarding this sect, which we know is condemned everywhere.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i neo nanene ngaa dhu èu parcaya, lula ji'i tadèngi le ètu mia-mia, peka na, dhèu sèmi boe ngaa dhu partei kristen sèra aj'a-nori si. de mamèci na, tasamia? ji'i dhae nge'a mèka. de lolo ku dènge ji'i laa.

source_text: they made an appointment to meet with him. on that day many people came to where he was staying. from morning till night paul was explaining to them, telling them about the kingdom of god. he tried to convince them about jesus using the writings of the law of moses and the prophets.
target_text: ka rèngu rare lii èci ho pili ca lod'o dhu leo, sèna ka ra paraga hari. ropa d'ai lod'o pamoa èèna, dhèu ae titu kèna mai pakaboko ètu era pea paulus. hèia paulus mulai lole ka dènge rèngu, dad'èi ama lamatua mi dhèu unu na. na pake isi nèti sasuri musa, dènge sasuri dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu leo sèra, sèna ka rèngu bisa parcaya yesus. na padhai lii nèti mad'ae toke d'ai lod'o nihia.

source_text: some accepted what paul said, but some refused to believe.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii padhai lii paulus ne, abhu ka cahag'e dhu parcaya. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu parcaya boe.

source_text: they couldn't agree among themselves, and they left after paul told them this: the holy spirit said it well through isaiah the prophet to your forefathers,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu pab'ala èci dènge èci, toke cahag'e neo lèpa. te ngaa paulus peka, aku nèngu na, mema lii pasisu miu ne, lèke sama sèmi ngaa dhu uru èèna roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge yesaya,

source_text: ‘go to these people and tell them: even though you hear, you won't ever understand, and even though you see, you won't ever comprehend.
target_text: peka na, ‘lamu peka dènge dhèu se'e se, na, èèna na, miu nanene taruu lii ja'a, te ngaa me'a boe ciki sa! miu laladhe taruu ngaa dhu ja'a tao, te ngaa miu pusi boe ciki sa.

source_text: for the minds of these people have become calloused and hard, their ears cannot hear, their eyes are shut, in case they might see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and understand with their minds, and might come back to me and i would heal them. '
target_text: lula d'ara dhèu se'e se adhu sèmi hadhu. dhilu rèngu d'èi heka nanene! aa musi madha rèngu, bèdho mèno le! hud'i rèngu sène, ra tadèngi ia ka; aa hud'i laa, sèna ka musi madha ra ladhe rèdhi ia ka. aa hud'i laa, sèna ka d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu taruu. toke d'ai rèngu sèra re'a heka j'ara ho lèpa mai asa ja'a, de j'ara tasamia ka ja'a bisa tao pabe'a hari rèngu? '

source_text: consequently you should know that this salvation that comes from god has been sent to the foreigners and they will listen.
target_text: hèia paulus katange lii padhai lii na, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, a'ari! sèna ka miu se me'a, na, ama lamatua sadia tèke le mamuri hia dhèu yahudi boe, lula rèngu dhu d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: for two full years paul stayed there in the house he rented, welcoming everyone who came to see him.
target_text: paulus pea ka ètu èmu dhu na seb'a èèna, d'ai dua tèu. na sèmi dènge karej'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai tenge paraga dènge ne.

source_text: he spoke of the kingdom of god, and taught about the lord jesus christ very boldly. no one prevented him.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu abhu j'ara sèna ka na aj'a-nori si lula-nèti paredha ama lamatua, aa j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus kahèi. na lole dènge pahuni boe, aa na abhu boe dhu pahèb'e ne. ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii lolo ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka. makasi. nèti ja'a, lukas

source_text: this letter comes from paul, a servant of jesus christ. i was called to be an apostle by god. god appointed me to announce the good news
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua pili nare le ja'a ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ka na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus, ho laku lole lii lolo be'a na dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: that he had previously promised through his prophets in the holy scriptures. the good news is about his son, whose human forefather was david,
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhu ator tèke le, ho dhèu rèti lii padhai na suri j'ara-j'ara nèti lii lolo be'a èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci na. te, ètu d'ara sasuri ne, lamatua pajaji neo hia mai ana na yesus, ho j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha. de limuri ne, lii moa na èèna j'aj'i le, lula yesus dhu mai le nèti ana-èpu dhèu aae daud.

source_text: but who was revealed as god's son by his resurrection from the dead through the power of the holy spirit. he is jesus christ our lord.
target_text: te ngaa re èci hari, ama lamatua pad'elo tadha, peka na, yesus kristus èèna, ana nèngu kahèi. te roh yesus èèna, mola-mèci tare'a-re'a, sama sèmi ama lamatua. aa lamatua pake koasa na, sèna ka pamamuri hari yesus nèti mamadhe na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, ana ama lamatua èèna, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: it was through him that i received the privilege of becoming an apostle to call all nations to obedient trust in him.
target_text: yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, te na pili nare le ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, ho lole lii aj'a-nori na buli mia-mia. dad'èi na, dhèu dhu yahudi boe parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. ja'a neo kahèi, sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i lèka kristus, aa mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: you are also included among those who were called to belong to jesus christ.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu ètu kota roma. miu j'aj'i nèti suku ae-ae nèti mia-mia, yesus kristus dhu hag'e nare le miu, peka na, mai ka! mai j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a!

source_text: i'm writing to all of you in rome who are loved by god, and called to be his special people. grace and peace to you from god our father and the lord jesus christ!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'adhu sasuri ne hia miu ètu roma, dènge pasanèd'e, peka na, ama lamatua sue miu. nèngu manèngi kahèi ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra, aa hia miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: let me begin by saying that i thank my god through jesus christ for all of you, because the way in which you trust in god is spoken about all over the world.
target_text: ja'a bhoke sasuri ja'a ne, dènge manèngi makasi ae-ae mi ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus sab'a ètu d'ara miu. ja'a manèngi makasi kahèi, lula dhèu dhu pea ètu rae-rae d'ara paredha roma, ra palolo lula-nèti parcaya miu mi yesus.

source_text: i'm always praying for you, as god can confirm-the god i serve with the whole of my being as i share the good news about his son.
target_text: ja'a loe boe sabaj'a hia miu. tare'a! lamatua mesa na ne'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a padhai ne, lèke. nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ja'a ne sab'a dènge d'ara kateme ho lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a nèti ana na.

source_text: in my prayers i'm always asking that i might eventually come and see you, if that's what god wants.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i, ja'a peka sèmi ne'e ka: lamatua, ja'a mesa ku ke'a boe j'ara na tasamia. te ngaa, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, bhoke la j'ara, sèna ka ja'a bisa laku pangad'o dènge angalai ja'a sèra ètu roma.

source_text: i really want to visit you and share with you a spiritual blessing to strengthen you.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèmi èèna, te ja'a neo titu kèna kèdhi miu, sèna ka ja'a bisa bagi hia miu koasa nèti roh lamatua, ho hud'i laa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu taha pa'èra-èra.

source_text: in this way we can be encouraged together by each others' trust in god, both your trust and mine.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu pea dènge miu, ja'a neo pa'èra d'ara miu, ho sèna ka parcaya miu asa èra. aa ja'a neo kahèi ho miu pa'èra d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i want you to know, my brothers and sisters, i often planned to visit you, but i was kept from coming up till now. i want to see some good spiritual results among you just as i've seen among other people.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi ladhe miu me'a, na, ja'a neo ae le ho dhiu pangad'o dènge miu ètu roma. te ngaa toke sange ne'e, dhodhoka tao nelu di. de ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhiu, ja'a sanao sèna ka abhu dhèu ae era dhu lèka èra kristus, sama sèmi dhu ja'a abhu ètu era-era leo. ladhe sèmi èèna, na, rui-j'aj'èra ja'a abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: for i have an obligation to work for both the civilized and the uncivilized, both the educated and the uneducated. that's why i'm really keen to come to rome and share the good news with you.
target_text: masi ka, tasamia èèna ka, ja'a hud'i lole ku lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. mi dhèu dhu pake lii yunani do, dhèu dintiu dhu pake lii leo, dhèu kapai do, dhèu haha do, dhèu sakola do, dhèu sakola boe. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra neo dhiu sa roma, sèna ka paraga dènge miu.

source_text: i'm certainly not ashamed about the good news, for it's god's power to save everyone who trusts in him-to the jewish people first, and then to everyone else as well.
target_text: ja'a makae boe ciki sa, dènge lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua, lii lolo be'a ne dènge koasa nèti lamatua, ho patabuli dhèu ne'e nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. dhèu yahudi ka dhu re'a uuru j'ara ne'e ne, heka dhèu suku leo sèra kèna.

source_text: for in the good news god is revealed as good and right, trustworthy from start to finish. as scripture says, those who are right with god live by trusting him.
target_text: lii lolo be'a ne pad'elo kahèi j'ara lamatua ho pamola dhèu nèti sasala ra. aa'i-aa'i sèra sa bisa j'aj'i, sad'i dhèu parcaya ne. te dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu hud'i parcaya uuru ku ama lamatua, heka bisa pabe'a dènge nèngu kèna. te ladhe ra mamuri dènge parcaya ne, heka abhu mamuri dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: god's hostility is revealed from heaven against those who are godless and who are not morally right, those who suppress the truth through the evil that they do.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka le, na, abhu dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. aa abhu dhu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa j'ara bhelu-katub'a. te ngaa lamatua sèmi nare boe tatao rèngu sèra. lula ètu d'ara iiki rèngu, dhu re'a le, mia ka dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe sèra. ra kakèj'i dhèu, toke dhèu re'a heka mia ka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru hahuku nèti dedha-liru, sèna ka paj'èra si.

source_text: what can be known about god is obvious, because he has made it very clear to them. ever since the creation of the world, the invisible aspects of god-his eternal power and divinity-are clearly visible in what he has made. such people have no excuse,
target_text: dhèu se'e se, abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, lula j'ara-j'ara dhu pahuni boe dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu nèti lamatua. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pad'elo! a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: mulai nèti na paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e ne, ladhe dhèu neo re'a mèu nèti ngi'u lamatua, aa dènge koasa na dhu dènge boe too-lane èèna, bisa kahèi! masi ka ladhe tèdhi boe ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu bisa tadhe ne nèti ngaa-ngaa dhu na ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka, na, dhèu bhelu sèra abhu boe alasan ho siri iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a boe ngaa-ngaa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: because even though they knew god, they did not praise him or thank him, but instead their thinking about god turned into complete foolishness, and darkness filled their empty minds.
target_text: de masi ka rèngu re'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe mangaku, na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua èdhi! rèngu se ro'o boe, manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi. ka ngangee ra j'aj'i kahèlu, toke ra re'a heka ngaa dhu lèke. rèngu j'aj'i bingu aa padhai lii rupa-rupa dhu kolo-kapua aad'o lula-nèti ama lamatua. aa d'ara ra maroga aatu-aatu.

source_text: even though they claimed to be wise, they became foolish.
target_text: rèngu èci-èci padedha iisi ra, peka na, ja'a ke'a mèu madha j'ara ae-ae! masi ka ngangee ra sèmi èèna, te ngaa madhutu mola-mola na, rèngu goa titu kèna.

source_text: they exchanged the glory of the immortal god for idols, images of mortal human beings, birds, animals, and reptiles.
target_text: ka dhèu se pahaha boe iisi ra mi ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, te rèngu peka na, ji'i pusi boe lamatua sèmi èèna! te ngaa ra sogo-tagu mi rupa-rupa patung, raropa sèmi dhèu rai-haha, sèmi manu-bhui sa, do sèmi badha leo sèra, toke d'ai patung dhu rupa sèmi mege sa. dènge ra sogo-tagu sèmi èèna, rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa, ho ra gati eele dènge mèdha-panyau dhu bisa madhe!

source_text: so god abandoned them to the evil desires of their depraved minds, and they did shameful, degrading things to each other.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rèngu. na soro tèke si, ho ra tao j'ara bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa, dhu amo le ètu d'ara rèngu. toke rèngu se re'a heka makae sa hèi. hèia dènge ngi'u aae ra, rèngu ad'u-ue madha j'ara kaj'alu rupa-rupa, aa ra tao sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: they exchanged god's truth for a lie, worshiping and serving creatures instead of the creator, who deserves praise forever. amen.
target_text: ètu d'ara iiki ra dhu re'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa ro'o boe madhutu. ngangee rèngu dhu moca le, hèia ra pangee, na, be'a risi èdhi tao rupa-rupa. masi ka pakarehe aa'i-aa'i, ngaa-ngaa tao boe! ra koa-kad'iri mèdha dhu lamatua paj'aj'i, te ngaa rèngu pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu paj'aj'i mèdha se. ra tao iisi sèmi dhèu dhu mola-mèci, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao di! dhu lèke ka, ladhe èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne koa-kio taruu ama lamatua! èèna ka dhu mèci!

source_text: that's why god abandoned them to their evil desires. their women exchanged natural sex for that which is unnatural,
target_text: nèti bhabhelu-katub'a rèngu sèra ka, lamatua soro tèke si, ho rèngu tao karehe sèmi èèna madhutu dad'èi ra. hèia ra tao rupa-rupa j'ara makae, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae. bhèni ra, ro'o heka pa'èci dènge mone dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi tao dhu lèke boe. te bhèni j'unu tao j'ara makae dènge bhèni.

source_text: and in the same way the men gave up sex with women and burned with lust for each other. men did indecent things to each other, and as a result they suffered the inevitable consequences of their perversions.
target_text: dhèu mone sèmi èèna kahèi! ra d'èi heka j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu ra, te ngaa d'èi j'unu dènge dhèu mone leo! rèngu se, dhu dènge heka d'ara makae! nèti èèna ka, pe rèngu dui rare j'aj'èra pamèci dènge tatao rèngu sèra! te rèngu se dhu sigo eele kaj'èu le, nèti j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: since they didn't consider it worthwhile to get to know god, he abandoned them to their worthless, distrustful way of thinking, doing things that should never be done.
target_text: ra pangee, na, be'a risi baku patai-patapa dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua soro tèke si, sèna ka ra tao madhutu dad'èi ra! de rèngu ngee dhoka dhu karehe di! ka ra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe!

source_text: they filled themselves with all that's wrong: evil, greed, hate, envy, murder, quarreling, deception, malice, and gossip.
target_text: mamuri ra pènu dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a. ka re'a heka tao dhu be'a, te ngaa dhoka dhu bhelu di. rèngu manga'a. èci tèke d'ara dènge èci. èci d'èi boe karisi èci. èci pamadhe èci. ra d'èi patao-palaha. ra kapod'e-kabèli. ra leko-monya. ra d'èi padhai-kakoli dhèu.

source_text: they're back-stabbers and god-haters. they're arrogant, proud, and boastful. they devise new ways of sinning. they rebel against their parents.
target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. ra palab'a dènge ama lamatua. ra kurang ajar, d'èi pahahe dhèu, d'èi padedha iisi, d'èi tenge j'ara-j'ara karehe, aa d'èi palab'a dènge ina-ama ra.

source_text: they don't want to understand, they don't keep their promises, they don't show any kindness or compassion.
target_text: ro'o boe re'a dènge j'ara dhu mola. ro'o boe re'a dènge lii pamoa unu ra, ka dhèu lèka heka rèngu. re'a boe sue dhèu. dènge boe d'ara kasia ciki sa mi dedha dhèu.

source_text: even though they realize exactly what god requires, they do things that deserve death. not only do they do such things themselves, they also support others in doing them.
target_text: rèngu re'a le atora ama lamatua dhu peka na, dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu, hud'i abhu huku madhe. masi ka re'a le atora ne, te ngaa loe boe tao rupa-rupa bhabhelu. mesa boe se'e se di, te ngaa ra dadugu-rariu dhèu leo, sèna ka tao bhelu kahèi. ne'e ne seli-kolane!

source_text: so if you judge others you don't have any excuse, whoever you are! for in whatever way you condemn others, you're judging yourself, because you're doing the same things.
target_text: èu dhu tadèngi le rupa-rupa j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a deo na, si? hèia èu pangee, na, bhabhelu dhèu se'e seli-kolane! ladhe èu pangee le sèmi èèna, na, mu mage-mage, ee! te èu mesa mu bhelu sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, èu dènge boe alasan ho siri iisi èu, masi ka èu ne cee èèna ka. ladhe èu peka, na, lèke tare'a dhèu dhu bhelu sèra abhu huku, te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, èu mesa mu ka pèci sasala mi ngi'u èu unu mu. te èu tao sala sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: we know that god's judgment on those who do such things is based on truth.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua hia huku mi dhèu bhelu sèra, tatu nèngu pama'ète lii langu ra dènge mola.

source_text: when you judge them do you really think that you however can avoid god's judgment?
target_text: do, tasamia? ele boe èu pangee, na, lèke tare'a ladhe dhèu dhu tao bhelu-katub'a sèra abhu hahuku nèti lamatua. aa te ngaa èu kahèi dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu sama sèmi rèngu. te èu pangee, na, ja'a abhu boe hahuku nèti lamatua. ngangee èèna mai nèti mia?

source_text: or is it that you're treating his wonderful kindness, tolerance, and patience with contempt, not realizing that god in his kindness is trying to lead you to repent?
target_text: ama lamatua dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu. aa na mau-mau era, nèti tatao èu sèra. te ngaa tasamia ka èu pahahe ne? ele boe èu me'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èu ne, sèna ka èu tèke eele sasala èu, aa lèpa hari asa nèngu.

source_text: due to your hard-hearted attitude and your refusal to repent, you're making things far worse for yourself on the day of retribution when god's judgment is demonstrated to be absolutely right.
target_text: te ngaa èu ne kètu hadhu, aa mo'o boe nanene! aa mo'o boe core eele sasala èu, ciki sa hèi! de èu mesa mu ka dhu ad'u ho abhu huku dhu bia risi hari. te ropa d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, lamatua tai-dadoo mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i. aa èèna na dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, lamatua pama'ète lii langu dènge mola. pe na huku èu bia, lula na sèmi nare boe tatao èu sèra.

source_text: god will make sure everyone receives what they deserve according to what they've done.
target_text: mamuri èu tasamia èèna ka, pe lamatua ka dhu b'ala madhutu tatao èu.

source_text: those who have kept on trying to do what is good and right will receive glory and honor, immortality and eternal life.
target_text: te dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a taruu-taruu, lamatua hia ne mamuri dhu mola d'ai mia-mia. rèngu abhu pakab'ua nèti dhèu kahèi, kolongara hua iia, dènge mamuri taruu dènge ne toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: but those who think only of themselves, rejecting the truth and deliberately choosing to do evil, will receive punishment and furious hostility.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua sèmi nare boe dhèu dhu tao bhelu-katub'a. nèngu nasa titu kèna dènge si, te re'a dhoka palab'a di. dhèu se tao boe madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, te re'a dhoka tao madhutu j'ara dhu bhelu di.

source_text: everyone who does evil will have trouble and suffering-the jewish people first, and the foreigners too.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao bhelu, bèli-camèd'a abhu j'aj'èra. masi ka dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe èèna ka, aa'i-aa'i ra pasae rare.

source_text: but everyone who does good will have glory, honor, and peace-the jewish people first, and the foreigners too.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao j'ara dhu be'a, bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha, aa pakab'ua si, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri mera-milu. masi ka dhèu yahudi, do dhèu yahudi boe èèna ka, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu.

source_text: god has no favorites.
target_text: te lamatua dhu hag'e boe rèhu dhèu!

source_text: those who sin even though they don't have the written law are still lost, while those who sin that do have the written law will be condemned by that law.
target_text: atora lamatua lèke mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe atora ne, dhu tao sala, èèna na cèri eele nèngu nèti lamatua. aa ladhe dhèu dhu re'a le atora ne, te ngaa na tao sala, pe lamatua pake hari atora ne, ho pama'ète hahuku na. rèngu cèri eele nèti lamatua kahèi, lula ra sisu le atora na.

source_text: just listening to what the law says doesn't make you right in god's sight. it's those who do what the law says who are made right.
target_text: neo pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, ladhe nanene dhoka atora di, èèna d'ai mèka. te hud'i tao madhutu ku atora na, heka na sèmi nare si kèna. de baku dhoka nanene di!

source_text: the foreigners don't have the written law, but when they instinctively do what it says, they are following the law even without having the written law.
target_text: masi ka dhèu yahudi boe sèra, re'a boe isi nèti atora lamatua, te ngaa abhu kahèi nèti rèngu dhu tao madhutu atora ne. lula d'ara iiki rèngu unu ra ka dhu peka, mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia ka dhu sale.

source_text: in this way they show how the law works that's written in their minds. as they think about what they're doing, their conscience either accuses them for doing wrong or defends them for doing what is good and right.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne rèngu pad'elo, na, atora lamatua dhu suri ètu d'ara ra, nuka sèmi loa hèngu dhu lamatua manènu ètu d'ara ra. d'ara rèngu mesa ra, ka dhu tai-dadoo ngaa dhu rèngu ad'u-ue. hèia ngangee rèngu unu ra ka dhu galaa, na, rèngu dhu tao sale, aa peka na abhu dhu tao lèke.

source_text: the good news i share is that a day is coming when god will judge, through jesus christ, everyone's secret thoughts.
target_text: de lod'o ama lamatua ded'e yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu pama'ète lii langu, na parisa toke lutu j'ara-j'ara dhu pahuni ètu d'ara dhèu. ja'a aj'a sèmi ne'e, sama sèmi dhu suri le ètu d'ara lii lolo be'a lamatua.

source_text: what about you who call yourself a jew? you rely on the written law and boast about having a special relationship to god.
target_text: de miu dhèu yahudi, tasamia? miu d'èi padedha iisi, peka na, dhoka miu di dhu kèpe atora lamatua, dhu na papuru mai re musa, sina ma? miu kahèi d'èi koa iisi, lula pa'èci miu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: you know what he wants; you do what's right because you've been taught from the law.
target_text: tare'a! miu dhu me'a le, dad'èi lamatua. miu dhu me'a kahèi, mia ka dhu be'a risi. miu me'a mèu le j'ara se aa'i-aa'i, lula mese agama ka dhu aj'a-nori miu nèti atora lamatua.

source_text: you're absolutely sure that you can guide the blind, and that you are a light to those in darkness.
target_text: miu padedha iisi, peka na, miu bisa paj'uj'u j'ara hia dhèu dhu re'a boe lasi sa mia. miu tao iisi nuka sèmi saraa dhu pasaraa dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: you think you can set ignorant people straight, a teacher of children, because you know from the law all the truth there is to know.
target_text: lula miu kèpe pa'èra atora lamatua, ka miu pangee, na, miu me'a aa'i mèu-mèu, aa miu kèpe pa'èra-èra aa'i dhu lèke, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, miu pangee, na, miu bisa nori dhèu goa dènge ana iiki dhu re'a boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so if you're busy teaching others, why don't you teach yourself? you tell people not to steal, but are you stealing?
