target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu d'èi aj'a dhèu leo, te ngaa tasamia ka miu mo'o boe nori ngi'u mi? ! miu d'èi ca'e mimbar, ho peka na, dhèu baku mana'u. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu unu mi mana'u? !

source_text: you tell people not to commit adultery, but are you committing adultery? you tell people not to worship idols, but do you profane temples?

target_text: masi ka abraham dènge mèka ana, te ngaa na lèka ama lamatua, aa tatae lamatua tao madhutu lii pajaji na. nèti parcaya èèna ka, lamatua tao ne j'aj'i mi bèi-baki nèti suku ae-ae. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, na, ana-èpu ae-ae bèli-camèd'a mai nèti èu.

source_text: his trust in god didn't weaken even though he thought his body was practically dead he was around a hundred years old, and knew that sarah was too old to have children.
target_text: abraham lèka èra lamatua, masi ka ne'a nèngu dhu heka bhora le, umur dhu cangasu tèu kèna. era ana nèti sara dhu bèdho mèno le, aa na heka d'ai seli le.

source_text: he held on to god's promise-he didn't doubt it. instead his trust in god grew stronger, and he gave glory to god.
target_text: te ngaa lalèka abraham kura boe, ho pangee na, lamatua bisa boe tao madhutu lii padadha na. parcaya na asa tabha èra mi lamatua, aa na ded'e padedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: he was totally convinced that what god had promised he had the power to deliver.
target_text: abraham lèka tare'a-re'a, ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha le, nèngu bisa tao.

source_text: that's why abraham was considered right by god.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua cap abraham, peka na, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge nèngu.

source_text: the words abraham was considered right weren't just written down for his benefit.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka na, lamatua ige boe sèmi èèna hia abraham mesa na,

source_text: they were for us too, those of us who will be considered as right, since we trust in god who raised our lord jesus from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa mi èdhi kahèi! te ladhe èdhi parcaya lamatua, na cap èdhi kahèi dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: jesus was handed over to die because of our sins, and was raised to life to make us right.
target_text: yesus madhe, lula èdhi ad'u-ue sasala-sasigo. hèia na mamuri hari, ho bhoke j'ara, sèna ka èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: now that we have been made right by god by trusting in him, we have peace with him through our lord jesus christ.
target_text: de, lula èdhi parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na cap èdhi dhèu d'ara mola. hèia d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mola-mèci hia lamatua, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai, bhoke j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: it's through jesus, trusting in him, that we've gained access to this position of grace where we now stand, looking forward with happiness and confidence to sharing in god's glory.
target_text: kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula èdhi parcaya le nèngu. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i èra. aa d'ara èdhi karae kahèi, lula te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e èdhi, sèna ka te'a mèu dadedha na.

source_text: not only this-we also remain confident when problems come, because we know that experiencing problems develops spiritual stamina.
target_text: masi ka èdhi abhu rupa-rupa sasusa, te ngaa d'ara èdhi karej'e-karae taruu. te èdhi te'a, na, j'èra uuru ku heka bisa taha dènge èra risi hari.

source_text: spiritual stamina in turn develops a mature character, and this mature character results in confident hope.
target_text: ladhe èdhi èra ka ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èèna ka dhu tao èdhi manahu boe, aa mamuri èdhi pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna, èèna ka dhu pa'èra parcaya èdhi, peka na, pe lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: since we have this hope we're never disappointed, for god's love has been poured into us through the holy spirit he's given us.
target_text: ladhe lalèka èdhi asa èra sèmi èèna, èdhi makae boe. te lamatua dhu bagi le hia èdhi, roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka èdhi te'a mèu, na, nèngu dhu sue èdhi titu kèna.

source_text: when we were completely helpless, at just the right time christ died for us ungodly people.
target_text: nèngu pad'elo sasue na sèmi ne'e ka: ropa èdhi mampu boe pabe'a dènge lamatua, te'a boe, na, lamatua dhu pua kristus madhe pala èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu mamuri pusi-pahae boe lamatua. lamatua pili lod'o dhu lèke sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: who would die for anybody else, even someone who does what's right? though perhaps somebody would be brave enough to die for someone really good.
target_text: pangee paie-iie ku! te cadhui ku abhu dhèu dhu sadia madhe hia angalai na dhu d'ara mola. ele boe abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu sadia madhe, ho soru dhèu d'ara be'a.

source_text: but god demonstrates his love for us in that christ died for us while we were still sinners.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le sasue na ae-ae mi dedha èdhi. lula, lod'o èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara sasala era, kristus madhe le gati èdhi.

source_text: now that we are made right by his death, we can be absolutely sure we'll be saved by him from the coming judgment.
target_text: ama lamatua cap èdhi, dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne, lula kristus pasuti raa na, sèna ka madhe gati èdhi. aa te ngaa, ladhe dhèu ue sasala, lamatua nasa. te ngaa nèti mamadhe kristus, èdhi dhu tao sala abhu heka huku.

source_text: while we were his enemies, god made us his friends through the death of his son, and so we can be absolutely sure that he will save us through the life of his son.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi pamusu dènge lamatua. te ngaa ana ama lamatua mesa na madhe, ho cuhi d'ara lamatua, sèna ka èdhi bisa padame dènge lamatua. de limuri ne, èdhi pamusu heka, te ngaa pabe'a hari le. risi-risi hari, kristus dhu mamuri hari le, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, na hia èdhi mamuri, sèna ka èdhi baku lèke hahuku.

source_text: in addition to this we now celebrate what god has done through our lord jesus christ to reconcile us and make us his friends.
target_text: mesa boe èèna di! d'ara èdhi bisa karae, peka na, lamatua ne, dedha risi eele! lula èdhi pa'èki dènge ne. èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, madhe le pala èdhi, sèna ka èdhi padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for through one man sin entered the world, and sin led to death. in this way death came to everyone, for everyone sinned.
target_text: de karèi nèti uuru èèna ka, adam ka dhu tao uru sasala-sasigo. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia boe ne mamuri taruu. hèia karèi nèti lod'o èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne madhutu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu. aa, lula rèngu tao sala sama sèmi adam, ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku nuka sèmi nèngu kahèi.

source_text: even before the law was given, sin was in the world, however it wasn't counted as sin because there was no law.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, lod'o ama lamatua papuru mèka atora na, dhèu tao le sasala dhu pale-lème le rai-haha ne. te ngaa, lula dènge mèka atora, ka abhu boe dhu ige sasala-sasigo dhèu sèra.

source_text: but death still ruled from adam until moses, even over those who didn't sin in the same way as adam did. now adam prefigured the one to come.
target_text: mulai nèti adam toke d'ai musa sèmi rare atora lamatua èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tatu madhe. masi ka rèngu sisu boe paredha lamatua dhu pangèd'u mi adam, te ngaa ra tao rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i madhe ku, nuka sèmi adam. ladhe èdhi pasoro adam dènge lamatua yesus, abhu dhu sama, aa abhu dhu sama boe. te adam èci èèna ka dènge rupa dhu paj'uj'u asa raropa yesus, dhu bèli-camèd'a èèna cèu mai.

source_text: but the gift of jesus is not like the sin of adam. though many people died because of one man's sin, god's grace is so much greater and has been shared with so many through his gracious gift in the person of jesus christ.
target_text: te ngaa sasala adam, sama boe dènge babe'a dhu yesus hia èdhi. te dhèu èci, nuka adam, sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus, tao rupa-rupa babe'a hia mi èdhi, aa pamata boe dhèu b'ala babe'a na. nèti tatao ca dhèu ne'e ka, pad'ai mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, te ama lamatua d'èi tao be'a hia èdhi.

source_text: the result of the gift is not like that of the sin. the result of adam's sin was judgment and condemnation, but the gift sets us right with god, despite our many sins.
target_text: dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u mi èdhi, sama boe dènge sasala dhu adam tao èèna. ropa adam tao sasala, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu, peka na èu sala. de èu hud'i abhu huku! te ngaa masi ka dhèu ue sasala ae titu kèna, ama lamatua, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i, neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era, aa pama'ète, na, èu sala boe. de èu bebas le, aa mu abhu heka huku. mai, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ja'a!

source_text: as a result of one man's sin, death ruled because of him. but god's grace is so much greater and his gift sets us right, for everyone who receives it will rule in life through the person of jesus christ!
target_text: de ca dhèu nuka adam dhu tao sala, aa sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhe ku. te ngaa dhèu èci hari, nuka yesus kristus dhu tao be'a. lula tatao na dhu be'a èèna ka, èdhi bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi mèdha èci dhu na hia iia d'ara mi èdhi. na neo hia èdhi mamuri dhu lèke, sama sèmi èdhi j'aj'i angalai dhèu aae.

source_text: just as one sin brought condemnation on everyone, in the same way one right act gave everyone the opportunity to live right.
target_text: de nèti ca dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala, na bhoke j'ara ho ama lamatua babège eele dhèu aa'i-aa'i nèti madha na. aa nèti ca dhèu leo hari dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke, na bhoke j'ara ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, sèna ka mamuri mola dènge ne.

source_text: just as through one man's disobedience many became sinners, in the same way through one man's obedience many are made right with god.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: adam ne, ca dhèu dhu d'èi boe nanene lamatua, ka sisu paredha lamatua. aa dhèu ae kahèi madhutu tao sasala, sama sèmi adam. aa yesus ne, ca dhèu dhu nanene lamatua, ka tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu ae bisa pabe'a hari dènge lamatua.

source_text: when the law was introduced, sin became even more obvious. but while sin became much more obvious, grace became even more obvious!
target_text: ama lamatua papuru atora na re musa, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a mèu, mia dhu sala. te ngaa ètu mia-mia sasala dhèu asa tabha ae. ètu èèna kahèi, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae risi hari.

source_text: just as sin ruled us and brought us death, now grace rules by making us right with god, bringing us eternal life through jesus christ our lord.
target_text: uru èèna, bhabhelu ètu d'ara dhèu abhu koasa dhu uri rèngu, toke ra tao sasala dhu nèti mamadhe. te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara be'a dhu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus tao èèna, ama lamatua pake ho pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. aa j'ara be'a ne dènge koasa sèna ka ator èdhi kahèi, hèia èdhi bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua, aa mamuri mola taruu dènge ne.

source_text: so what's our response? should we continue to sin so we can have even more grace?
target_text: de èdhi peka ngaa hari? ele boe miu pangee, na, ama lamatua pabhèlu eele le sasala èdhi, lula d'ara hua iia na. nèti èèna ka, hud'i laa èdhi tino tao sala, sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na risi hari mi èdhi.

source_text: of course not! since we're already dead to sin, how can we continue to live in sin?
target_text: aad'o sèmi èèna! lèke boe ladhe èdhi tao sala taruu. te èdhi dhu pama'ète tare le, peka na, èdhi tèke eele aa'i le sasala-sasigo èdhi. lula èdhi pa'èki heka dènge bhabhelu-katub'a, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi dhu madhe le! te dhèu dhu madhe le bisa heka tao sala, si? ladhe èdhi madhe le, tasamia hari èdhi bisa mamuri ad'u-ue sasala? bisa boe, sina ma?

source_text: don't you know that all of us who were baptized into christ jesus were baptized into his death?
target_text: ele boe miu me'a boe, na, ropa sarani èdhi, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, èdhi tèke eele le mamuri dhui, ho abhu mamuri hiu, nuka dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: through baptism we were buried with him in death so that just as christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the father we too can live a new life.
target_text: lod'o kristus madhe, ra padhane ne. aa lod'o ra sarani èdhi, èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe kahèi, tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia ra padhane èdhi. de ama lamatua pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho pamamuri hari kristus nèti mamadhe na. ama lamatua d'èi ladhe èdhi sèmi tare koasa na kahèi, ho mamuri hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu hiu.

source_text: if we've become one with him in dying like he did, then we'll be raised like him too.
target_text: te èèna sama sèmi èdhi madhe palere dènge yesus. de èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge ne, tatu bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri hari nèti mamadhe, sama sèmi nèngu mamuri hari.

source_text: we know that our old self was crucified with him to dispose of the dead body of sin so that we wouldn't be enslaved by sin any longer.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu tao rupa-rupa sasala. te ngaa mamuri èdhi dhu dhui èèna, madhe le, èci èèna ka dènge paku pamadhe èdhi ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha palere-lere dènge kristus. limuri ne, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dènge heka koasa ho uri èdhi. limuri ne, èdhi aad'o heka ètu d'ara a'èki sèna ka tao hari sasala. te èdhi sèmi heka ènu dhu dènge boe hak ho pili neo tao ngaa.

source_text: anyone who has died has been set free from sin.
target_text: ladhe dhèu dhu madhe le, nèngu bebas le, si? abhu heka ngaa èci sa laka-seti ne, ho ad'u-ue hari sasala.

source_text: since we died with christ, we have confidence that we will also live with him,
target_text: de, lula èèna nuka sèmi èdhi madhe le palere-lere dènge kristus, na, èdhi parcaya, peka na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taruu dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: for we know that because christ has been raised from the dead he won't ever die, because death has no longer any power over him.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, lula yesus kristus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, de nèngu bisa heka madhe hari. te abhu boe èci sa dhu dènge koasa ho pamadhe hari ne.

source_text: in dying, he died to sin once and for all, but now he lives, and he lives for god!
target_text: na madhe ca tèka èèna ka, ho segi koasa nèti sasala. te ngaa limuri ne na mamuri ho pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: in just the same way you should consider yourselves dead to sin, but alive to god through christ jesus.
target_text: miu hud'i tao ku iisi sèmi èèna. nuka sèmi miu dhu madhe le, nèti èèna ka sasala dènge heka koasa mi dedha miu. de limuri ne, miu hud'i mamuri ku ho pakab'ua ama lamatua, lula miu dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: don't let sin have control over your mortal body, don't give in to its temptations,
target_text: bhabhelu ètu d'ara èu dhu dènge koasa. baku soro tèke bhabhelu èèna ator èu, ka èu dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae sèna ka èu tao bhabhelu-katub'a. te èèna na ngi'u aae èu madhe.

source_text: and don't use any parts of your body as evil tools of sin. instead dedicate yourselves to god as those who have been brought back from death to life, and use all parts of your body as tools to do something good for god.
target_text: aa baku soro isi èu sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke boe, te èèna sala kahèi. te ngaa pangèd'u mamuri èu mi ama lamatua di, sèna ka nèngu ka dhu uri mamuri èu. sama sèmi èu dhu madhe le, ka mamuri hari. de pake la mamuri èu kateme aa'i, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu lèke sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: sin won't rule over you, because you're not under law but under grace.
target_text: baku soro tèke sèna ka sasala ator miu, sama sèmi sasala ka dhu j'aj'i lamatua miu. de limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri madhutu ia ka atora musa, sèna ka pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te miu dhu mamuri mola le, lula lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu. de limuri ne d'ara hua iia lamatua ka dhu uri mamuri miu.

source_text: so then, should we sin because we're not under law, but under grace? of course not!
target_text: de tasamia? ele boe miu ngee, na, èdhi madhutu ia ka atora musa, ho pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. de hud'i laa èdhi tao sala taruu di. te lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na era mi èdhi! miu pangee sèmi èèna ka, si? ja'a pasanèd'e, èèna na sale!

source_text: don't you realize that if you make yourselves someone's slaves, obeying their orders, then you are slaves to the one you obey? if you are slaves of sin, the result is death; if you obey god, the result is you are made right with him.
target_text: ja'a kore upama nèti ènu dènge lamatua na. ladhe miu soro ngi'u mi ho sab'a hia dhèu èci, na, miu hud'i nanene, aa sab'a madhutu dad'èi na. te nèngu èèna kètu miu, aa miu j'aj'i ènu na. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu bisa pili neo madhutu mia. te miu bisa pili, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala, hèia miu j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala ne. te ngaa ladhe miu pili sèmi èèna, miu tao iisi mi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. do, miu bisa pili tao dhu lèke, dènge j'aj'i ènu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua pua mi. ladhe pili sèmi èèna, miu bisa pabe'a dènge ne!

source_text: thank god that though you once were slaves to sin, you whole-heartedly chose to follow the truth about god that you learned.
target_text: uru èèna, miu soro tèke sèna ka sasala uri miu, te ngaa limuri ne miu nanene d'ara iiki miu, sèna ka tao madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu sarani aj'a-nori miu. nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: now that you've been freed from sin, you've become slaves of doing what is morally right.
target_text: te lamatua dhu patalale le miu nèti koasa sasala, toke sasala sèra uri heka miu. de limuri ne, j'ara dhu lèke ka dhu uri miu.

source_text: i'm using this everyday example because your human thinking is limited. just as you once enslaved yourselves to immorality, piling up sin upon sin, now you must enslave yourselves to what is pure and right.
target_text: ja'a peka ne'e, pake conto dhu j'aj'i bèli-bèli, nèti lamatua dènge ènu, sèna ka miu me'a malai ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai. uru èèna, miu hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu sèna ka tao sala, dhu pakaj'alu miu madhutu atora musa. te ngaa limuri ne, miu hud'i hia ngi'u miu j'aj'i ènu dhu me'a dhoka tao dhu be'a di, dhu hia miu j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: when you were slaves to sin you were not required to do what's right.
target_text: uru èèna, ropa miu dhoka nanene aa tao madhutu dad'èi sasala, miu mo'o boe nanene aa tao dhu lèke.

source_text: but what were the results back then? aren't you ashamed of the things you did? such things that lead to death!
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: miu abhu ngaa dhu be'a nèti tatao miu sèra? aad'o, sina ma? aa te ngaa, ngaa dhu miu abhu sèra tao miu mi'e makae di. lula miu tao sala sèmi èèna, ka dhu miu abhu, nuka lamatua soro kabodho mi miu.

source_text: but now that you're set free from sin, and have become god's slaves, the results will be a pure life-and in the end, eternal life.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, ama lamatua patalale eele le miu nèti lamatua uru èèna, de miu parluu ia ka tao sasala. de ne'e ne miu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu sab'a nèti ama lamatua. lèpa lod'o limuri, pe miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia ne, aa abhu mamuri mola-mèci dhu d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: the wage sin pays is death, but god's free gift is eternal life through christ jesus our lord.
target_text: te ropa èdhi tao sasala, lamatua tule eele èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna ka dhu èdhi abhu. èdhi madhe kèna! te ngaa ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara èci hia èdhi. te na neo hia iia èdhi mamuri mola dhu ma'ète boe. èdhi abhu mamuri èèna, ladhe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: brothers and sisters i'm speaking here to people who know the law, don't you see that the law has authority over someone only while they're alive?
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo padhai lii dènge miu dhu me'a mèu atora huku sèra. sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe miu mamuri era, atora huku dènge hak ho ator miu. te ngaa ladhe miu madhe le, atora huku dènge heka hak mi miu.

source_text: for example, a married woman is bound by the law to her husband while he's alive, but if he dies, she's released from this legal obligation to him.
target_text: ja'a kore pakasame nèti atora dhèu èmu-kamali. ladhe dhèu bhèni èci leo le èmu dènge mone èci, na, madhutu atora huku, dua ra j'aj'i dhèu èmu-kamali toke madhe. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mone madhe uuru, bhèni balu ne pa'èki heka dènge atora deo na. nèngu bisa hari leo-èmu.

source_text: so if she lives with another man while her husband is alive, she would be committing adultery. however, if her husband dies and then she marries another man, she wouldn't be guilty of adultery.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe bhèni ne leo hari èmu lod'o dhèu èmu na mamuri era, nèngu bersina. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe le, atora nèti laleo èmu lèke heka nèngu. bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu kalora iisi. de ladhe na madhèdi hari dènge dhèu leo, madhutu atora, nèngu bersina boe.

source_text: in the same way, my friends, you've become dead to the law through the body of christ, and so now you belong to someone else-christ, who was raised from the dead so that we could live productive lives for god.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu dhèu parcaya! sèmi ne'e: kristus madhe le. èèna nuka sèmi miu madhutu madhe dènge ne kahèi, hèia tèke eele mamuri miu dhu dhui. ka atora huku lèke heka mi miu. limuri ne atora huku lèke heka miu, te ngaa mamuri miu pa'èki dènge kristus, dhu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. èèna cakaraa dènge bhèni balu dhu leo hari èmu. ngaa-ngaa tao boe. de limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu miu ad'u-ue sèra, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: while we were controlled by old nature, our sinful desires as revealed by the law were at work within us and resulted in death.
target_text: te uru èèna, èdhi tao dhoka madhutu dad'èi ngi'u aae èdhi di. lula èdhi te'a atora, èèna ka dhu hia èdhi sisu atora sèra, ho tao j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe. de sasala èdhi sèra ka dhu tao ama lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi.

source_text: but now we've been set free from the law, and have died to what kept us in chains, so that we can serve in the newness of the spirit and not the old letter of the law.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi hud'i tao madhutu ku atora. te ngaa limuri ne, atora ne lèke heka èdhi, dhu tèke eele le mamuri dhu dhui. madhutu dad'èi j'ara dhui, na, atora musa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci èèna, dhu èki tèke èdhi. te ngaa madhutu dad'èi j'ara hiu, na, èdhi pa'èki heka dènge atora èèna. te roh lamatua ka dhu uri èdhi! nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi sab'a dhoka hia lamatua.

source_text: so what do we conclude? that the law is sin? of course not! i wouldn't have known what sin was unless the law defined it. i wouldn't have realized that wanting to have other people's things for myself was wrong without the law that says, don't desire for yourself what belongs to someone else.
target_text: de èdhi neo peka ngaa? neo peka, na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa ne, sala! aad'o! te ladhe ja'a ke'a mèu boe atora ne, tatu ja'a bisa boe ke'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu d'ara ja'a. nuka sèmi, abhu atora dhu peka na, mage d'ara neo mere mèdha-panyau dhèu. te ngaa dènge j'ara tasamia ka, ja'a bisa ke'a, na, d'ara neo sèmi èèna, sala, ladhe ke'a boe atora èèna? bisa boe!

source_text: but through this commandment sin found a way to stir up in me all kinds of selfish desires-for without law, sin is dead.
target_text: te ngaa lula abhu atora dhu peka sèmi èèna, èèna nuka sèmi j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, sèna ka ja'a neo kore rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau dhèu. ladhe dènge boe atora dhu kai, sasala na abhu boe koasa ho ator dhèu.

source_text: i used to live without realizing what the law really meant, but when i understood the implications of that commandment, then sin came back to life, and i died.
target_text: ètu mamuri ja'a uru èèna, ja'a ke'a mèu mèka dad'èi nèti atora lamatua. nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka ke'a kèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a mulai mase'a, na, ja'a sisu le atora sèra ka ad'u-ue sasala. de hua nèti sasala èèna ka, ja'a hud'i madhe ku.

source_text: i discovered that the very commandment that was meant to bring life brought death instead,
target_text: hèia d'ara ja'a roe bhilu, te ke'a na, ja'a mesa ku bisa boe pabe'a ja'a dènge lamatua, ladhe tao madhutu dhoka atora na. de pantas ladhe ja'a abhu nanasa nèti lamatua, nuka huku madhe èèna, lula ja'a sisu le atora na. aa te ngaa lamatua hia atora ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri dhu lèke. te ngaa bagi ja'a, atora ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ja'a, ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a.

source_text: because sin found a way through the commandment to deceive me, and used the commandment to kill me!
target_text: atora ne mema pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu mola. te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu sub'u ètu d'ara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a tipu hari ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, ho pangee na, ja'a bisa pabe'a ja'a dènge ama lamatua, sad'i ja'a tao madhutu atora na. hèia èèna nuka sèmi atora mesa èèna ka dhu tao toke lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a.

source_text: however, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, right, and good.
target_text: de ladhe deo na dhèu peka na, atora dhu lamatua hia re musa èèna, sala, na, ja'a dhaa na, aad'o! atora lamatua ne, mola-mèci! aa paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara atora ne mola-mèci, lèke, aa be'a kahèi.

source_text: now would something that is good kill me? of course not! but sin shows itself to be sin by using good to cause my death. so by means of the commandment, it's revealed how evil sin really is.
target_text: ele boe miu pangee, na, atora ne ka dhu tao lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a, do? aad'o! te masi ka ja'a ke'a atora sèra, te ngaa ja'a nanene taruu bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a tao sala. de nèti sasala ja'a èèna ka lamatua soro kabodho mi ja'a. atora ne mema be'a, te èèna ka dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu tao èdhi pacèri nèti ama lamatua. de ropa lamatua pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, atora èèna ka dhu peka paled'a, na, bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi èèna, be'a boe.

source_text: we realize that the law is spiritual; but i'm all-too-human, a slave to sin.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, atora dhu lamatua pangèd'u re musa, puru mai nèti roh lamatua. te ngaa ja'a ne dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di, dhu dènge d'ara dhu èra boe. hèia ja'a nanene j'ara-j'ara bhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, toke ja'a manahu asa d'ara sasala. èèna nuka sèmi sasala dhu j'aj'i lamatua ja'a, aa ja'a j'aj'i mi ènu nèti sasala.

source_text: i really don't understand what i'm doing. i do the things i don't want to do, and what i hate doing, that's what i do!
target_text: pamalaa ja'a. ja'a ke'a boe ngaa ka dhu ja'a tao. te ja'a tao boe madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a neo tao. te ngaa ja'a tao madhutu ngaa dhu ja'a d'èi boe tao.

source_text: but if i'm saying that i do what i don't want to, this shows that i admit the law is good and right.
target_text: ladhe ja'a tao ngaa dhu ja'a neo boe tao, ja'a mangaku, na, atora lamatua ne lèke.

source_text: so it's no longer me who does this, but sin living in me-
target_text: de ja'a boe ka dhu uri ngi'u ja'a. te bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ka dhu uli ja'a!

source_text: for i know that there's nothing good in me as far as my sinful human nature is concerned. even though i want to do good, i'm just not able to do it.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le, na, abhu boe j'ara dhu be'a muri ètu d'ara ja'a. te ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha dhu d'ara karehe. d'èi do d'èi boe, ja'a bisa boe pakaseti iisi sèna ka tao dhu lèke. ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe!

source_text: the good i want to do, i don't do; while the evil i don't want to do, that's what i end up doing!
target_text: te ja'a d'èi tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe tao. aa ko'o boe tao dhu bhelu, te ngaa cèku tao!

source_text: however, if i'm doing what i don't want to, then it's no longer me doing it, but sin living in me.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ad'u-ue ngaa dhu ko'o boe tao, èèna mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa lula sasala dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: this is the principle i've discovered: if i want to do what's good, evil is always there too.
target_text: ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tate'a èci, sèmi ne'e ka: masi ka ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa abhu bhabhelu dhu palab'a ètu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: my inner self is delighted with god's law,
target_text: aa te ngaa madhutu iia-iia ètu d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna, ladhe ja'a pangee atora lamatua.

source_text: but i see a different law at work within me that is at war with the law my mind has decided to follow, making me a prisoner of the law of sin that is within me.
target_text: te ngaa nuka sèmi abhu koasa ètu d'ara ja'a dhu pa'ele iie ja'a. te ja'a neo tao dhu be'a, te ngaa j'aj'i boe. èèna nuka sèmi koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a dhu kèpe nare ja'a, ho laka-seti madhutu ne.

source_text: i'm totally miserable! who will rescue me from this body that's causing my death? thank god-for he does this through jesus christ our lord!
target_text: ira ii, kasian, ee! ja'a ne dhèu j'èra! dhèu cee ka dhu bisa patabuli ja'a nèti koasa bhabhelu dhu muri ètu d'ara ja'a ne, dhu tao lamatua mad'enge dènge ja'a?

source_text: here's the situation: while i myself choose with my mind to obey god's law, my human nature obeys the law of sin.
target_text: te ngaa malo-malo ka! ama lamatua unu na ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele ja'a! ja'a manèngi makasi ae-ae mi lamatua, lula kètu èdhi yesus kristus bisa hia mamuri mi ja'a! de ladhe ja'a mamuri maena dhoka mi ngi'u ja'a di, na, ja'a j'èra. masi ka ja'a neo tao madhutu atora lamatua, te ngaa abhu koasa bhabhelu ètu d'ara ja'a, dadugu ja'a, sèna ka tao taruu dhoka bhabhelu-katub'a di.

source_text: so there is now no condemnation for those who are in christ jesus.
target_text: de ama lamatua huku boe dhèu dhu pa'èki dènge yesus kristus!

source_text: the law of the spirit of life in christ jesus has set me free from the law of sin and death.
target_text: te abhu dua lii tate'a dhu lèke: ka èci peka na, ladhe èdhi pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, roh lamatua hia koasa mi èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola. ka dua peka na, abhu bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi dhu kakèj'i èdhi ho tao sala. aa ladhe èdhi tao sala, ama lamatua mad'enge dènge èdhi. aa ladhe èdhi abhu roh lamatua, na patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: what the law couldn't do because it was powerless due to our sinful nature, god was able to do! by sending his own son in human form, god dealt with the whole problem of sin and destroyed sin's power in our sinful human nature.
target_text: masi ka èdhi tao madhutu atora musa, èèna bisa boe patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, lula èdhi se dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di dhu tao bhabhelu katub'a taruu. te ngaa lamatua ka dhu bhoke j'ara. te nèngu pua ana mone mesa na mai, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha biasa, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi. masi ka èdhi dhèu rai-haha biasa tao rupa-rupa sasala, te ngaa yesus mesa-mesa na dhu tao nèdhi boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. ngaa hari, nèngu j'aj'i korban, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu.

source_text: in this way we could fulfill the good requirements of the law by following the spirit and not our sinful nature.
target_text: ama lamatua hia kristus mai, sèna ka na madhe, ho hud'i laa èdhi bisa tao j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke, madhutu atora lamatua. ka limuri ne, èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu mola madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, aa tao heka madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ti.

source_text: those who follow their sinful nature are preoccupied with sinful things, but those who follow the spirit concentrate on spiritual things.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi d'ara unu ra, tao sèmi èèna lula ra pangee dhoka j'ara bhabhelu di. te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi roh lamatua, rèngu dhoka pangee j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara roh lamatua di.

source_text: the sinful human mind results in death, but having the mind led by the spirit results in life and peace.
target_text: dhèu dhu soro tèke bhabhelu ator ngangee na, sama sèmi dhèu dhu nanene boe roh lamatua, nuka sèmi d'ara nèngu aad'o heka dènge lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu soro tèke roh lamatua ator ngangee na, mamuri na mola, aa d'ara na mera-milu.

source_text: the sinful human mind is hostile to god because it refuses to obey the law of god-in fact it never can,
target_text: dad'èi èdhi dhèu rai-haha ne, palab'a bia dènge dad'èi lamatua. hèia èdhi to'o boe pahaha iisi ho nanene lamatua, lula èdhi mesa ti bisa boe.

source_text: and those who follow their sinful nature can never please god.
target_text: te dhèu dhu soro tèke dad'èi ra ator rèngu, d'èi do d'èi boe, èèna bisa boe pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: but you're not following your sinful nature, but the spirit-if it's true that the spirit of god is living in you. for those that don't have the spirit of christ in them don't belong to him.
target_text: te ngaa miu se, dhèu dhu mamuri bhelu heka, madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi. te ladhe abhu roh lamatua dhu mamuri ètu d'ara miu, miu tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara nèngu. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu roh kristus pea boe ètu d'ara na, nèngu j'aj'i boe dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: however, if christ is in you, even though your body is going to die because of sin, the spirit gives you life because you're now right with god.
target_text: ngi'u aae miu bèli-camèd'a madhe, lula sasala dhu miu tao uru sèra. te ngaa, lula limuri ne kristus mamuri ètu d'ara miu, roh miu mamuri taruu, lula ama lamatua cap le miu dhèu d'ara mola, hèia miu pabe'a hari le dènge ne.

source_text: the spirit of him who raised jesus from the dead lives in you. he who raised jesus from the dead will also give life to your dead bodies through his spirit that lives in you.
target_text: te ama lamatua ka dhu pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. de masi ka èdhi madhe, te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi, pe nèngu pamamuri hari èdhi kahèi. sasoa na, na pamamuri èdhi sama sèmi na pamamuri hari kristus.

source_text: so brothers and sisters, we don't have to follow our sinful nature that operates according to our human desires.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari aa'i-aa'i! èdhi dhu dènge kèlu-g'ètu. mage nèti kèlu-g'ètu ne, ho mamuri èdhi madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa èdhi hud'i mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: for if you live under the control of your sinful nature, you're going to die. but if you follow the way of the spirit, putting to death the evil things you do, then you will live.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri madhutu dhoka bhabhelu ètu d'ara èdhi di, tatu lamatua soro kabodho mi èdhi, aa èdhi pasae tare huku madhe! te ngaa ladhe èdhi soro tèke roh lamatua palaho koasa sasala ètu d'ara èdhi, èèna na èdhi heka bisa mamuri dhu mola kèna.

source_text: all those who are led by the spirit of god are god's children.
target_text: dhèu dhu nanene roh lamatua, sèna ka na ator si, na, dhèu se'e ka dhu j'aj'i ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: you were not given a spirit to enslave and terrify you once more. no, what you received was the spirit that makes you children in god's family. now we can shout out, god is our father!
target_text: ladhe èdhi soro tèke roh lamatua ator èdhi, na tao boe èdhi sèmi ènu dhu mamuri dhoka dènge d'ara madha'u di. uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa, lula èdhi sèmi tare le roh lamatua ho uri èdhi, èdhi te'a le, na, èdhi j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, nèngu d'èi tadèngi, ladhe èdhi paroa ne, ama pasue!

source_text: the spirit himself agrees with us that we're god's children.
target_text: d'ara èdhi unu ti ka dhu peka na, èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua. aa roh lamatua kahèi peka sèmi èèna.

source_text: if we're his children, then we're his heirs. we are heirs of god, and heirs together with christ. but if we want to share in his glory we must share in his sufferings.
target_text: ladhe èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua, èèna sasoa na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi sèmi tare pusaka na, lula nèngu j'aj'i ama èdhi. aa ladhe ama hia pusaka mi ana na kristus, èdhi kahèi sèmi palere-lere dènge ne. te ngaa abhu ca j'ara era: èdhi hud'i abhu ku j'aj'èra, sama sèmi kristus kahèi dhu abhu le j'aj'èra, sèna ka bèli-camèd'a lamatua ded'e èdhi padedha-dedha, nuka sèmi nèngu ded'e padedha-dedha le kristus.

source_text: yet i'm convinced that what we suffer in the present is nothing compared to the future glory that will be revealed to us.
target_text: te ngaa madhutu a'abhu ja'a, j'aj'èra dhu èdhi pasae ne'e ne, kab'ua na aad'o, ladhe pasoro dènge dadedha dhu lamatua neo pad'elo mi èdhi.

source_text: all of creation is patiently waiting, longing for god to reveal his children.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dhu mate tatae neo rèdhi na pad'elo ana-ana na sèra, nuka cee! te na neo pad'elo dènge ra, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: for god allowed the purpose of creation to be frustrated.
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, aa dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa ra madhutu boe, lula boe dad'èi rèngu, te ngaa nèti dad'èi lamatua, te na huku si sèna ka pa'ele iie si. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu era maena era.

source_text: but creation itself waits in hope for the time when it will be set free from the slavery of decay and share the glorious freedom of god's children.
target_text: te limuri ne aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i sèra ele iie, aa abhu boe j'ara kalua. te ngaa èèna na, lamatua neo patabuli si, sèna ka ra ele iie heka, te ngaa rèngu bisa j'aj'i kapai titu kèna madhutu dad'èi na. lamatua kahèi neo ded'e padedha-dedha ana-ana na, ho patabuli rèngu nèti dhu ele iie sèra.

source_text: we know that all creation groans with longing, suffering birth-pains even up till now.
target_text: te èdhi te'a le, na, abhu j'aj'èra ae ètu rai-haha ne. karèi nèti uru ka d'ai doe ne'e, aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i sèra, taraa pèd'a, dhu ra tatae ho lamatua tao aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i hiu. èèna nuka sèmi bhèni dhu taraa kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: not only creation, but we too, who have a foretaste of the spirit, we groan inwardly as we wait for god to adopt us-the redemption of our bodies.
target_text: mesa boe rai-haha di dhu tatae, te ngaa èdhi kahèi mate sèmi èèna. masi ka lamatua hia uru le roh na mi èdhi, èdhi taraa d'ara pèd'a kahèi. te èdhi dhu tatae mate ama lamatua ded'e nare èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana dhu mola, dènge patabuli ngi'u èdhi aa'i-aa'i nèti dhu ele iie.

source_text: for we were saved by hope. yet hope that's already seen isn't hope at all. who hopes for what they can already see?
target_text: lod'o lamatua hia èdhi mamuri, na peka kahèi, bèli-camèd'a na tao sèmi ngaa. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi dhu tatae era lula dhae j'aj'i mèka. ladhe èdhi tèdhi ka j'ara èci dhu j'aj'i le, èdhi pamata heka neo tèdhi j'ara èèna. te dhèu parluu heka mate, sèna ka rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i le, sina ma?

source_text: since we're hoping for what we haven't yet seen, we wait for it patiently.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi dhu tatae ho neo tèdhi ca j'ara dhu dhae j'aj'i mèka, èdhi pa'èra d'ara taruu.

source_text: similarly the spirit helps us in our weakness. we don't know how to speak with god, but the spirit himself intercedes with and through us by groans that can't be put into words.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lod'o èdhi mate tae-tae èèna, roh lamatua ka dhu soru-bara èdhi, lula èdhi se dhu roe-bhilu, aa te'a boe sabaj'a dhu lèke. te ngaa roh lamatua unu na ka dhu sabaj'a gati èdhi, masi ka te'a dhoka taraa di, aa te'a boe sabaj'a peka lii ngaa.

source_text: the one who examines the minds of everyone knows the spirit's motives, because the spirit pleads god's cause on behalf of the believers.

source_text: but the attitude of doing right that comes from trust says this: don't ask ‘who'll go to heaven? ' asking to bring christ down,
target_text: te ngaa sasuri mola-mèci lamatua pad'elo j'ara leo, peka na, dhèu bisa pabe'a dènge ama lamatua sad'i rèngu parcaya yesus kristus. dhu suri tèke, na, mage karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu bisa ca'e asa sorga? ' èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu neo ca'e la'e peka dènge kristus, na, èdhi dhèu rai-haha d'èi ladhe nèngu puru mai sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: or ‘who'll go to the place of the dead? ' asking to bring christ back from the dead.
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, peka na, mage karèi, na ‘cee ka dhu neo puru la'e asa d'ara naraka, ètu era dhèu madhe sèra? ' èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu puru la'e ho paca'e kristus nèti era mamadhe na, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: what scripture actually says is: the message is very close to you-it's what you talk about and what's in your mind. in fact it's this message based on trust that we're presenting.
target_text: baku sèmi èèna! te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, na, lii moa nèti lamatua ètu katanga madha èu! te lii moa èèna abhu le ètu hèb'a dènge d'ara èu. lii moa ne dhu èdhi peka-padhai dènge dhèu, peka na, ladhe èu neo abhu mamuri, na, hud'i parcaya ku kristus!

source_text: for if you declare that you accept jesus as lord, and you are convinced in your mind that god raised him from the dead, then you will be saved.
target_text: ladhe èu mangaku dènge hèb'a mu, peka na, kristus èèna, kètu ja'a, aa parcaya ètu d'ara èu, na, ama lamatua pamamuri hari le yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na, ka ama lamatua patabuli èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èu.

source_text: your trust in god makes you right and good, and your declaration of accepting god saves you.
target_text: te ladhe èu parcaya kristus dènge d'ara kateme, ama lamatua cap èu, peka na, èu dhèu d'ara mola dhu pabe'a dènge ne. aa ladhe èu mangaku dènge hèb'a mu, peka na, yesus j'aj'i kètu èu, ama lamatua patabuli èu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èu kahèi.

source_text: as scripture says, those who trust in him will not be disappointed.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, cee dhu parcaya ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a, na'e boe makae, lula lamatua neo tao j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu, ngaa dhu na peka nare le.

source_text: there's no difference between jew and greek-for the same lord is lord of everyone, and he gives generously to everyone who asks him.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, èci èèna ka. beda boe. abhu dhoka kètu èci di, aa nèngu ka kètu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na ae-ae mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi bara nèti nèngu.

source_text: for everyone who calls on the name of the lord will be saved.
target_text: te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manèngi lamatua soru-bara si, pe nèngu patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: but how can people call on someone they don't trust? how can they trust someone they haven't heard about? how can they hear unless they're told?
target_text: te ngaa tasamia dhèu bisa manèngi bara nèti ca dhèu, ladhe rèngu dhae parcaya mèka ne? aa tasamia rèngu bisa parcaya ne, ladhe rèngu dhae tadèngi mèka j'ara mamuri dhèu ne? tasamia rèngu bisa tadèngi lula-nèti nèngu ne, ladhe abhu boe dhèu dhu lole dènge ra?

source_text: how can they go out and tell others unless they're sent? just as scripture says, those who come bringing the good news are truly welcome!
target_text: aa tasamia rèngu bisa lole dènge dhèu, ladhe abhu boe dhu pua-paleha si? ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe dhèu rèti mai lii lolo be'a, mamai dhèu se'e se be'a titu kèna!

source_text: but not everyone has accepted the good news. as isaiah asks: lord, who trusted in the news they heard from us?
target_text: te ngaa miu kahèi me'a, na, abhu dhèu isra'el cahag'e ro'o boe nanene lii lolo be'a lamatua. te yesaya, ca dhèu dhu nèti lii padhai lamatua, suri peka na, lamatua! dhèu se'e ro'o boe lèka lii moa dhu rèngu tadèngi le nèti ji'i!

source_text: trusting in god comes from hearing-hearing the message of christ.
target_text: de ladhe neo parcaya ama lamatua, na, hud'i nanene uuru ku lii holo-nori na. aa neo me'a lii moa na, hud'i tadèngi uuru ku lula-nèti kristus.

source_text: it's not that they haven't heard. quite the opposite: the voices of those speaking for god have been heard all over the earth-their message went out to the whole world.
target_text: ja'a karèi sèku, sèmi ne'e: ele boe miu pangee, na, dhèu isra'el sèra tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula-nèti kristus, do? tatu ra tadèngi le! nuka sèmi dhèu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu palolo lula-nèti lamatua ne pale-palème le rai-haha; lii rèngu d'ai aa'i le palème rai-haha toke d'ai suu-suu rai.

source_text: so my question is, didn't israel know? first of all moses says, i'll make you jealous by using people who aren't even a nation; i will make you angry by using ignorant foreigners!
target_text: ja'a neo karèi hari ca j'ara, dhèu isra'el sèra dhane rare mèka j'ara ama lamatua, do? musa ka, dhèu uru j'ara dhu suri peka na, lamatua peka mi dhèu isra'el sèmi ne'e: ja'a neo tao j'ara èci hia dhèu nèti suku leo sèra. j'ara ne tao miu tèka d'ara. aa ja'a neo tao j'ara èci, hia dhèu dhu mi pangee na kahadhu ènyu. j'ara ne tao miu kadhi ngutu.

source_text: then isaiah said it even more strongly: i was found by people who weren't even looking for me; i revealed myself to people who weren't even asking for me.
target_text: limuri hari, yesaya suri dhu paled'a risi lula-nèti dhèu yahudi boe, dhu peka na, abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna tenge boe ja'a, te ngaa rèngu paraga le dènge ja'a. abhu dhèu dhu uru èèna manèngi boe ho rèdhi ja'a, te ngaa ja'a pad'elo iisi le mi rèngu.

source_text: as god says to israel, all day long i reached out my hands to a disobedient and stubborn people.
target_text: te ngaa, lula-nèti dhèu isra'el sèra, lamatua peka le sèmi ne'e: mèda-mèu, ai ja'a dhu pakabhèle tèke, sèna ka tatae mamai dhèu isra'el asa ja'a. te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ja'a, aa ra d'èi palab'a dènge ja'a.

source_text: but then i ask, has god rejected his people? of course not! i'm an israelite myself, from the tribe of benjamin.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: ele boe miu pangee, na, lula dhèu isra'el ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na tule eele le si. sèmi èèna ka, do? aad'o! te j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti rèngu kahèi! ja'a ne, nèti suku benyamin. ama benyamin, nuka yakob. baki na, isak, ama isak, ka abraham, dhu j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: god has not rejected his chosen people. don't you recall what scripture says about elijah? how he complained about israel to god, saying,
target_text: ama lamatua tule eele nèdhi boe dhèu unu na sèra. rèngu se'e ka dhu na tadhe karèi nèti uru-uru ka. miu sanèd'e era, ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti elia, si? elia ka'uu-kamuki mi lamatua lula-nèti dhèu isra'el sèra, hèia na manèngi, sèna ka lamatua huku si,

source_text: lord, they've killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. i'm the only one left, and they're trying to kill me too!
target_text: peka na, ama! dhèu se pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai, dhu ama pua mai. ra pa'ele iie le mei korban kahèi, ètu era dhu dhèu tema pahaha iisi mi ama. nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ate dhoka ja'a mesa-mesa ku di dhu mamuri. te ngaa rèngu tenge j'ara, ho neo pamadhe ja'a kahèi!

source_text: how did god answer him? i still have seven thousand left who have not worshiped baal.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua dhaa, peka na: lii èu èèna, sala! te dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ja'a, abhu pidhu riho dhèu era. rèngu se taha dènge èra, aa sogo-tagu boe ba'al!

source_text: today it's just the same: there are still some faithful people left, chosen by god's grace. and since it's through grace, then clearly it's not based on what people do, otherwise grace wouldn't be grace!
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi limuri ne. te dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i boe dhu soro kabodho mi ama lamatua. abhu ciki nèti ji'i era dhu lamatua pili nare, sèna ka hia mamuri, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i, lula boe nèti tatao ji'i dhu be'a! te ladhe nèngu hud'i pili nare ku ji'i lula tatao ji'i dhu be'a, sasoa na, nèngu bisa boe pama'ète sèna ka neo pad'elo, do pad'elo boe, d'ara hua iia na mi ji'i. ladhe sèmi èèna, peka iia ka, na, ‘nèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia na'.

source_text: so what do we conclude? that the people of israel didn't achieve what they were striving for-only the chosen, while the rest became hard-hearted.
target_text: de lala'e na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu tenge-tenge j'ara ho ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi rèngu, sèna ka rèngu bisa pabe'a kahèi dènge lamatua. te ngaa abhu boe, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu, dènge ro'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa cahag'e nèti dhèu se abhu. dhèu se'e ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si.

source_text: as scripture says, god dulled their minds so their eyes could not see and their ears could not hear, to this very day.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri lula-nèti dhèu kètu hadhu sèra, peka na, lamatua hia si, musi madha dhu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi, ro'a dhilu dhu bisa boe tadèngi, aa kahadhu dhu bisa boe pangee. de rèngu re'a mèu iia boe, toke d'ai sange ne'e.

source_text: david adds, may their feasts become a trap for them, a net that catches them, a temptation that brings punishment.
target_text: dhèu aae daud suri le kahèi lula-nèti dhèu yahudi se, ètu sasuri mola-mèci, na, hud'i laa ho ra tao pesta ètu mei unu ra. te tatao rèngu ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i sasii ho sii hari rèngu, ka ra ngee na aa'i-aa'i se be'a le. aa nèti mèdha-panyau unu ra, ka dhu pasaleku rèngu.

source_text: may their eyes become blind so they cannot see, and may their backs always be bent low in dejection.
target_text: hud'i laa sèna ka musi madha ra maroga, ho rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa! hud'i laa rèngu dui bia taruu, sèna ka kabodho ra asa kabhuku!

source_text: so am i saying that they stumbled and consequently failed completely? not at all! but as a result of their mistakes, salvation came to other nations, to make them jealous.
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: nga tao ka dhèu yahudi sèra kadhunu? ra bèbha le, do? aad'o! te ngaa, lula rèngu ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus, ne'e ne ka dhu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu yahudi boe, sèna ka ra bisa abhu mamuri, lula lamatua patabuli si nèti sasala ra. nèti tatao lamatua sèmi èèna, nèngu neo ho dhèu yahudi sèra tèka d'ara, hèia ra lèpa hari ho madhutu ne.

source_text: now if even their failure benefits the world, and their loss profits the foreigners, how much more beneficial it would be if they were to completely fulfill what they were meant to be.
target_text: de dhu mola na kèna, peka na, dhèu yahudi se sisu ngaa dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo nèti palème rai-haha ne bisa rasa kakee-mamènyi d'ara hua iia lamatua. de dhèu yahudi rugi kapai. te ngaa èèna tao dhèu yahudi boe sèra oto titu kèna. de nèbhu-nèbhu, ladhe dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra pabe'a hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi hari!

source_text: now let me speak to you foreigners. insofar as i'm a missionary to foreigners, i promote what i'm doing
target_text: ja'a neo peka j'ara èci dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, sèmi ne'e: lamatua pua ja'a sèna ka, laku peka-padhai dènge miu, lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, sèna ka pakako sasab'a dhu be'a aae ne.

source_text: that somehow i might make my people jealous and save some of them.
target_text: te ladhe ja'a pakako sasab'a ne dènge be'a, ja'a sanao sèna ka dhèu yahudi unu ku tèka d'ara. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ja'a bisa bara rèngu cahag'e sèna ka abhu mamuri.

source_text: if the result of god's rejection of them is that the world becomes god's friends, the result of god's acceptance of them would be like the dead coming back to life!
target_text: ropa lamatua tule eele dhèu unu na, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua bhoke j'ara, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu j'ara ho maso j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te ngaa èle èèna, ladhe sèmi rèngu padame hari dènge lamatua, èèna be'a risi. te èèna sama sèmi rèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe ra!

source_text: if the first part of the bread dough given as an offering is holy, then so is all the rest; if the roots of a tree are holy, then so are the branches.
target_text: nuka sèmi dhèu neo tao roti. ladhe nare tarigu ciki saraka mi lamatua, èèna na roti se j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua. aa ladhe dhèu hia amo aj'u èci, ho j'aj'i bua sulung mi lamatua, èèna na aj'u ca kapua ne j'aj'i mola-mèci unu lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now if some of the branches have been broken off, and you-a wild olive shoot-have been grafted in, and have shared with them the benefit of nourishment from the olive tree's roots,
target_text: ja'a neo pakasame dhèu yahudi dènge aj'u saitun ca kapua dhu ra piara ètu d'ara oka. ama lamatua dhu tutu eele le dadana cahag'e nèti aj'u ne. te ngaa miu dhu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi saitun j'ami. hèia, nèti dadana miu cahag'e, lamatua pare nare ka la'e patapa mi aj'u dhu ètu d'ara oka deo na. dènge j'ara ne, dadana nèti aj'u dhu ètu li'u oka, sakid'o nare mamuri nèti aj'u ètu d'ara oka deo na. ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge miu dhu yahudi boe, dhu sèmi mere d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, dhu na neo hia mi dhèu unu na, dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: then you shouldn't look down on the other branches. if you're tempted to boast, remember it's not you who are supporting the roots, but the roots that are supporting you.
target_text: te ngaa baku pamud'e! de mage mi padedha iisi, ho pangee na, miu dhu nèti li'u, be'a risi nèti dadana dhu lamatua tutu eele sèra! ladhe èu neo padedha iisi, mage èu bhèlu, te, èu ne dhoka ca dadana di! èu boe ka dhu pa'èra kapua aj'u ne. te amo ka dhu pa'èra aj'u ne!

source_text: you could make the claim, branches were broken off so i could be grafted in.
target_text: ele boe èu neo peka, na, lamatua pare eele dadana èci nèti aj'u dhu muri ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka na pakaj'èpe ja'a mi era deo na, ho gati dadana deo na.

source_text: all well and good-but they were broken off because of their failure to trust in god, and you stay there because you trust in god. so don't think highly of yourselves, but be respectful,
target_text: mema lèke. te ngaa baku bhèlu, na, lamatua tutu eele dadana sèra, lula rèngu parcaya boe ne. aa èu gati si, lula èu parcaya nèngu. de baku padedha iisi! be'a risi loe aa baku lela dedha!

source_text: because if god didn't spare the original branches, he won't spare you either.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi sèra nuka sèmi dadana dhu muri mema, dhu cèu uru tèka. te ngaa lamatua tèke eele boe si toke panèbhu ètu èèna. de ladhe èu parcaya boe taruu mi lamatua, mage èu maena ho na soro tèke èu taruu ètu èèna!

source_text: you should recognize both god's kindness and toughness-he was tough on the fallen, but god is kind to you so long as you trust in his kindness-otherwise you'll be removed too.
target_text: de miu hud'i pangee pabe'a-be'a ku. ama lamatua mema d'ara hua iia. te ngaa ne'a hia huku dhu bia kahèi. pe nèngu huku dhèu dhu manahu le, dhu pabe'a heka dènge ne. te ngaa mi miu dhèu yahudi boe, lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, sad'i miu pa'èki taruu dènge ne, aa miu sèmi mere babe'a na. te ngaa ladhe miu sèmi mere boe j'ara sèmi èèna, lamatua pare eele kahèi miu nèti aj'u na.

source_text: if they no longer refuse to trust in god, they can be grafted in as well, for god is able to graft them back in again.
target_text: sama sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu yahudi sèra. ladhe ra ele-ho'a ka, ho mulai parcaya kristus, pe lamatua tape hari rèngu mi aj'u uru èèna. te nèngu dènge koasa ho bisa tao j'ara sèmi èèna!

source_text: if you could be cut from a wild olive tree, and then be grafted artificially onto a cultivated olive tree, how much more easily they could be grafted back naturally to their own tree.
target_text: te miu dhu dhèu yahudi boe, nuka sèmi dadana nèti aj'u saitun hui, dhu muri tab'a ètu li'u oka. te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare miu, ka pakaj'èpe laa mi aj'u saitun dhu hua iia, dhu na sèle ètu d'ara oka na, sèna ka hud'i laa aj'u hui èèna leko-leo, aa aj'u ètu d'ara oka leko-leo. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe, bisa j'aj'i sèmi sèra, ngaa hari dhèu yahudi. rèngu bisa risi eele hari, ladhe lamatua pakaj'èpe hari si mi laa aj'u rèngu unu ra.

source_text: i don't want you, my brothers and sisters to miss this previously-hidden truth, for otherwise you could become conceited. the people of israel have become hard-hearted in part, until the process of the foreigners coming in is complete.
target_text: a'ari ètu roma! miu hud'i me'a ku ngaa dhu uru èèna j'aj'i mi rahasia. te ladhe miu me'a, miu mage pakapai iisi, dhu peka na, miu d'èlu-mèu risi. te j'ara na sèmi ne'e: limuri ne d'ara dhèu yahudi, adhu sèmi hadhu, aa ro'o boe parcaya kristus. te ngaa rèngu bisa boe sèmi èèna taruu. te ladhe dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pili nare si, parcaya le kristus, bèli-camèd'a dhèu yahudi sèra parcaya ne kahèi.

source_text: this is how all israel will be saved. as scripture says, the savior will come from zion, and he will turn jacob away from his opposition to god.
target_text: de ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, pe lamatua patalale dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. j'ara ne'e j'aj'i, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu patabuli èdhi nèti mamadhe-mamopo. nèngu mai nèti ledhe sion, nuka kota yerusalem. èèna na, nèngu ka dhu tao ho ana-èpu yakob ele-ho'a. te rèngu mamuri pusi-pahae boe ja'a, aa ra soro kabodho mi j'ara mamuri ja'a dhu mola.

source_text: my promise to them is that i'll take away their sins.
target_text: ja'a neo saku eele sasala-sasigo ra. te ja'a pa'èki le lii padhadha dènge rèngu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: though they are enemies of the good news-and this is to your benefit-they are still the chosen people, and loved because of their forefathers.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo be'a lamatua, ra tao iisi ra nuka sèmi musu dhu palab'a dènge ne. dènge sèmi ne'e ka, rèngu hia j'ara mi miu dhu yahudi boe! masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua sue si era, lula na sue bèi-baki ra, aa na hag'e nare si j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: god's gifts and his calling can't be withdrawn.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua hia le mèdha èci, na nare heka. aa ladhe na paroa nare le dhèu, peka na, mai madhutu ja'a! mai asa d'ara ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a! na babège eele heka si.

source_text: at one time you disobeyed god, but now god has shown you mercy as a result of their disobedience.
target_text: uru èèna, miu dhèu yahudi boe, mo'o boe nanene lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere rasa kasia nèti lamatua, lula dhèu yahudi ro'o boe nanene ne.

source_text: in just the same way that they're now disobedient as you were, they will also be shown mercy like you received.
target_text: de rèngu se'e ka dhu limuri ne ro'o boe tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi miu era. aa bèli-camèd'a nèngu neo pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dedha rèngu kahèi.

source_text: for god treated everyone as prisoners because of their disobedience so that he could be merciful to everyone.
target_text: limuri ne, lamatua tao ai-hèb'a mi dedha dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu yahudi boe. te aa'i-aa'i ra tao boe madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi rèngu ètu d'ara babèdho, aa re'a boe j'ara kalua. lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa pad'elo rasa kasia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: oh how deep are god's riches, wisdom, and knowledge! how incredible his decisions, how unimaginable his methods!
target_text: ama lamatua d'èlu-mèu titu kèna! aa na pake mamèu na, sèna ka tao j'ara hua iia. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu tadhe mèu ne. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lamatua pama'ète lii langu. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a mèu, nga tao ka lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara èci.

source_text: who can know god's thoughts? who can give him advice?
target_text: abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu ne'a mèu ngangee ama èdhi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa holo ne.

source_text: who has ever given anything to god that god would be obliged to repay?
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa hia iia lamatua mèdha èci. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa laka-seti lamatua sèna ka na b'ala hari!

source_text: everything comes from him, everything exists through him, and everything is for him. glory to him forever, amen!
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i kapua ra nèti ama lamatua! aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula nèngu ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao, èdhi sab'a hia ne. èdhi koa-kio ne, taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia! lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: so i encourage you, my brothers and sisters, because of god's compassion for you, to dedicate your bodies as a living offering that is holy and pleasing to god. this is the logical way to worship.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ama lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka saraka mamuri miu kateme mi lamatua, sama sèmi korban dhu mamuri. j'ara sèmi ne'e ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. pa'èra ngi'u miu ho madhutu dad'èi na, aa mamuri mola, te j'ara sèmi èèna ka dhu pad'elo sasue miu aa pakab'ua ne. mema lèke, ladhe miu pahaha iisi mi nèngu sèmi èèna.

source_text: don't follow the ways of this world; instead be transformed by the spiritual renewal of your mind so you can demonstrate what god's will really is-good, pleasing, and perfect.
target_text: baku soro tèke ho dhèu rai-haha ne pua miu tao sèmi ne'e, do sèmi èèna, do mamuri sèmi ngaa sa, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. baku sad'i madhutu iia d'ara di, j'ara ngangee ra, j'ara mamuri ra, do ad'a tatao ra. te ngaa dhu be'a risi eele, ladhe miu soro tèke lamatua ub'a ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu, sèna ka miu laladhe aa'i-aa'i se, madhutu j'ara hiu. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu bisa me'a dad'èi lamatua mi dedha miu. te dad'èi lamatua èèna, be'a, pamèci, dènge pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: let me explain to all of you, through the grace given to me, that no one should think of themselves better than they ought to. you should think about yourselves realistically, according to the degree of trust god has shared with you.
target_text: lula lamatua pajuu le ja'a, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e ka: lee ngi'u miu dènge j'ara dhu lèke! baku padedha ngi'u risi nèti dhu lèke. baku pake j'ara dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. dhèu èci-èci hud'i tenge j'ara ho ne'a mèu a'èra dènge karunya dhu lamatua hia le mi nèngu, lula na parcaya kristus.

source_text: just as there are many parts to the body, but they don't all do the same thing,
target_text: tare pakasame dènge ngi'u dhèu. ètu ngi'u ne, abhu bagian-bagian, dhu dènge sasab'a-la'a baka-leo.

source_text: so we are one body in christ, even though we are many-and we all belong to one another.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge kristus. èdhi se dhèu ae-ae, te ngaa pa'èki j'aj'i mi ngi'u èci. aa dhèu èci-èci ka dènge sasab'a-la'a na, nuka sèmi bagian nèti ngi'u ne. èci parluu èci. tare conto nèti kacui-aai dhu poro pama'ète nèti ngi'u ne, gaguna na aad'o heka, si?

source_text: we each have different gifts that vary according to the grace given to us. so if it's speaking for god, then you should do so depending on how much you trust in god.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: lamatua pangèd'u èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti koasa, sèna ka pakako rupa-rupa sasab'a-la'a na, lula na d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi. nuka sèmi, ladhe lamatua hia èu koasa sèna ka èu peka lii moa na, èu hud'i peka aa'i lii moa deo na. te ngaa baku peka risi nèti lii moa èèna.

source_text: if it's the ministry of service then you should serve; if teaching then you should teach;
target_text: ladhe lamatua hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, èu hud'i lalau-lalo'o pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho aj'a-nori dhèu lula-nèti nèngu, na, èu hud'i aj'a-nori ku pake koasa deo na.

source_text: if encouragement then you should encourage; if giving then you should give generously; if leadership then you should lead with commitment; if being merciful then you should do so gladly.
target_text: ladhe na pala hia èu a'èra dènge karunya, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu, èu hud'i pa'èra si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na hia èu koasa ho soru-bara dhèu leo dènge mèdha-panyau dhu èu unu, hia la mèdha-panyau sèra mi dhèu sèna ka èu soru-bara si. ladhe na hia èu a'èra dènge karunya ho pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a lamatua dènge be'a, na, èu hud'i maj'èni ho pimpin si pake koasa deo na. ladhe na pala hia èu rasa kasia ho soru-bara dhèu dhu ètu d'ara sasusa, èu hud'i bara si dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: love must be genuine. hate what is evil; hold on tightly to what is good.
target_text: ladhe miu pad'elo sasue mi dhèu, na, tao dènge d'ara mola; baku peka leo tao leo. core eele bhelu-katub'a, aa kèpe pa'èra-èra j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: be completely dedicated to each other in your love as family; value others more than yourselves.
target_text: miu dhèu sarani hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci. pa'èra iisi ho pad'elo pakab'ua miu èci dènge èci.

source_text: don't be unwilling to work hard; serve the lord with an enthusiastic spirit.
target_text: ladhe miu sab'a, sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, baku dènge paloa-pad'ui. hud'i laa sèna ka d'ara miu karae, lod'o miu ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a. aa miu hud'i sab'a hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: remain cheerful in the hope you have, put up with the troubles that come, keep on praying.
target_text: d'ara miu hud'i karej'e mèda-mèu, te miu me'a le, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo tao tasamia hia miu. pa'èra d'ara ladhe abhu sasusa. baku roca sabaj'a mèda-mèu.

source_text: share in providing for the needs of god's people, and welcome strangers with hospitality.
target_text: pake mèdha-panyau miu, ho bara dhèu sarani dhu parluu miu bara si. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu mai nèti rae leo, hia ra'a-rinu, aa sèmi mere si sèna ka manubha ètu d'ara èmu mi. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo le sasue miu mi dedha rèngu.

source_text: bless those who persecute you-bless them, and don't curse them.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu tino paj'èra miu, manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia si mèngi-nale. tare'a! baku dhoo si!

source_text: be happy with those who are happy; cry with those who are crying.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu d'ara karej'e, na, karej'e sama-sama dènge ra. aa ladhe abhu dhu tangi roma iisi, lula d'ara pèd'a, na, tangi sama-sama dènge ra.

source_text: think about one another. don't consider yourself more important than others; live humbly. don't be conceited.
target_text: mamuri pasue dènge d'ara èci. baku padedha iisi. be'a risi miu pa'angalai dènge dhèu haha. baku padedha iisi ho pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu me'a.

source_text: don't pay back anyone evil for evil. make sure you show everybody that what you're doing is good,
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao bhelu mi dedha èu, na, èu baku b'ala dènge bhabhelu kahèi. te ngaa èu hud'i tenge j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa sèmi rare dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: and as far as it's up to you, live at peace with everyone.
target_text: ladhe bisa, na, tenge j'ara ho mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: my dear friends, don't seek revenge, but leave it to god to execute judgment-as scripture points out, ‘it's for me to dispense justice, i will repay, ' says the lord.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ladhe dhèu tao sala mi miu, na, baku b'ala ne. soro tèke, sèna ka lamatua ka dhu ator. te lamatua nasa ladhe dhèu tao bhelu-katub'a sama sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ka dhu dènge hak ho b'ala sasala dhèu. te ja'a ka dhu huku bhabhelu dhèu.

source_text: if those who hate you are hungry, give them food; if they're thirsty, give them a drink; for by doing so you pile fiery coals on their heads.
target_text: dhu be'a risi ka, tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, ladhe musu èu manganga, na, hia ne na'a. ladhe musu èu koko-kamango, na, hia ne ninu. te ladhe tao ka sèmi èèna, nèngu makae unu na, aa na pakab'ua hari èu.

source_text: don't be defeated by evil-conquer evil with good.
target_text: baku soro tèke bhabhelu ator èu. be'a risi ladhe j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a ka dhu uli èu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èu bisa segi madha j'ara dhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: everyone should obey government authorities, because no one has the power to rule unless god gives permission. these authorities have been put there by god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i nanene ku atora nèti dhèu paredha. te rèngu dènge hak aa koasa ho paredha dhèu. te ngaa koasa èèna, mai nèti ama lamatua. lula lamatua ka dhu ded'e si, nèti èèna ka rèngu abhu koasa ho rèd'u paredha.

source_text: whoever resists the authorities opposes what god has put in place, and those who do so shall find themselves judged accordingly.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu lab'a dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, èci èèna ka rèngu lab'a dhu lamatua ded'e nare le. ladhe ra ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu huku nèti lamatua.

source_text: for rulers don't frighten those who do right, but those who do wrong. if you don't want to live in fear of the authorities, then do what is right, and you'll have their approval.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu lèke, baku madha'u dènge dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te ngaa ladhe miu ad'u j'ara bhelu, be'a risi miu madha'u dènge ra! de j'aga ngi'u ho tao dhu lèke, sèna ka miu baku madha'u dènge ra. aa ladhe miu tao ka j'ara sèmi èèna, pe ra koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: those in power are god's servants, put there for your own good. if you do wrong, you should be frightened-it's not without reason that authorities have the power to punish! they are god's servants, punishing offenders.
target_text: te dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha, rèngu sèra ka dhu lamatua hag'e nare si, ho ladhe-leru miu. te ngaa ladhe miu loe boe nèti tao sala, be'a risi miu madha'u! te rèngu dènge hak dhu iia d'ara boe ho huku miu. rèngu, nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha lamatua, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. te lamatua sèmi nare boe bhabhelu dhu dhèu tao; na nasa dènge ra.

source_text: so it's important to do as you're told, not just because of the threat of punishment, but because of what your conscience tells you.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i nanene ku, mi dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha. te miu dhu me'a mèu le, èèna ka dhu lèke mola-mola. aa miu me'a kahèi, na, lamatua nasa, ladhe èdhi tao boe dhu lèke.

source_text: that's why you have to pay taxes, for the authorities are god's servants taking care of such things.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu hud'i b'ae bea dhu madhutu atora, lula dhèu dhu rèd'u paredha sèra, pakako sasab'a lamatua.

source_text: pay whatever you owe: taxes to the tax authorities, fees to the fee-collectors; give respect to those who should be respected, honor those who should be honored.
target_text: de miu hud'i b'ae aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke madhutu atora. b'ae hia dhèu roro bea sèra, bea aa'i-aa'i dhu miu hud'i b'ae ku. pakab'ua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mema nia sèmi lii pakab'ua. aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a taruu, ded'e padedha kolongara si, sèna ka dhèu re'a, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: don't owe anybody anything, except love for one another-for those who love their neighbor have kept the law.
target_text: b'ae pama'ète kèlu èu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka baku mamuri ètu d'ara kèlu-g'ètu. te èdhi pakèlu dhoka ètu ca madha j'ara di, nuka pasue. ladhe miu sue dhèu, miu tao le madhutu atora-atora nèti lamatua.

source_text: you must not commit adultery, you must not kill, you must not steal, you must not jealously want things for yourself-these and the other commandments are summed up in the statement, love your neighbor as yourself.
target_text: te atora sèra peka na, baku tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali mu; baku pamadhe dhèu; baku mana'u; baku d'èi leli neo unu mèdha-panyau dhèu, aa dhu leo hari. ladhe neo madhutu aa'i atora se'e, hud'i tao madhutu ku atora èci ne'e, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu.

source_text: love doesn't do wrong to anyone, so love fulfils the law.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi pad'elo sasue mi dhèu leo, èdhi tao boe bhelu mi nèngu, si? de ladhe èdhi loe boe pad'elo sasue èdhi, èdhi bisa tao madhutu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: you should do this because you realize how urgent the time is-that it's high time for you to wake up from your sleep. for salvation is closer to us now than when we first put our trust in god.
target_text: ama lamatua neo patabuli èdhi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a dhèu rai-haha. aa limuri ne, lod'o sèna ka dhèu abhu mamuri nèti lamatua dètu ae le, ladhe èdhi pasoro dènge lod'o dhu èdhi heka parcaya yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i mamuri pasue, lula èdhi te'a le madha j'ara ne'e. nuka sèmi uru èèna, èdhi dhu bhèj'i era. te ngaa limuri ne d'ai le lod'o na, ho èdhi kèd'i ka nèti bhabhèj'i èdhi!

source_text: the night is nearly over, the day is almost here! so let's get rid of our dark deeds and put on the armor of light.
target_text: nèbhu boe, te mèda oe èle kèna, aa lod'o rea kèna. de be'a risi èdhi ae eele ka nèti bhabhelu-katub'a èdhi. j'ara ne, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, aa ad'u-ue madha j'ara bhabhelu, te rèngu pangee, na, abhu boe dhu ladhe rèdhi tatao rèngu sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi hud'i j'aj'i ku sama sèmi sordad'u dhu bori mema mèdha-papake pamusu, ho pa'èra ngi'u sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa.

source_text: let's behave properly, showing that we're people who are living in the light. we shouldn't spend our time going to wild parties and getting drunk, or having affairs and acting immorally, or getting into fights and being jealous.
target_text: èdhi hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi, na, èdhi dhu tao j'ara be'a. be'a boe ladhe èdhi mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara tao pesta, dènge tinu mahu di. be'a boe ladhe èdhi tao j'ara makae. be'a boe ladhe bau lii langu g'ana-kariu. aa be'a boe ladhe èdhi tèka d'ara, lula èdhi d'èi boe dhèu risi èdhi.

source_text: instead put on the lord jesus christ, and forget about following your sinful desires.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi ka, miu ub'a d'ara miu, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai. aa ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue j'ara dhu lèke boe, na, taha d'ara mu! mage soro tèke ho madhutu dad'èi mu dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: accept those who are still struggling to trust in god, and don't get into arguments over personal opinions.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa parcaya na èra mèka, aa j'ara ae ka dhu ne'a mèka. pakabhèle ai èu ho sèmi more ne dènge d'ara kateme. baku sisu ngaa dhu na peka-padhai. hud'i laa nèngu pa'angalai dènge miu.

source_text: one person may believe they can eat anything, while another whose trust is weak only eats vegetables.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu pangee na, dhèu sarani bisa ra'a ngaa sa, nuka sèmi sisi, do ngaa èèna ka. te ngaa abhu dhèu sarani leo, dhu parcaya ra èra mèka, dhu ra'a dhoka sayur di. te ra luri sisi.

source_text: those who eat anything must not look down on those who won't, and those who won't eat must not criticize those who do-for god has accepted them both.
target_text: te ngaa nanene, ee! dhèu sarani dhu bisa ra'a ngaa èèna ka, baku pahahe dhèu dhu neo boe ra'a sisi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sarani dhu neo boe ra'a sisi, baku peka dènge dhèu dhu bisa ra'a sisi, na, weh! mu'a sisi, sala! lula ama lamatua sèmi nare le dua ra ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na!

source_text: what right do you have to judge someone else's servant? it's their own master who decides whether they are right or wrong. with the lord's help they will be able to take their stand for right.
target_text: ladhe èu me'a dhoka karitik a'ari mu dhèu parcaya sèra, te èu ngee na, èu ne cee? èu dènge hak ngaa, ho pèci sasala mi dhèu leo? dhèu ne ènu èu boe, si! aa èu ne, lamatua boe nèngu, si. te dhodhoka lamatua nèngu di dhu unu hak, sèna ka peka paled'a, tatao na èèna lèke, do sala. te ngaa baku bhèlu, bèli-camèd'a lamatua na sèmi nare dhèu ne'e dènge be'a, lula lamatua na bisa pa'èra ne, sèna ka na bisa titu èra.

source_text: some people consider some days more important than others, while others consider each day the same. everyone should be completely convinced in their own minds.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pama'ète rare, peka na, lod'o èci be'a risi nèti lod'o leo. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu peka na, lod'o aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, lod'o èci sa risi boe nèti lod'o leo. dhèu èci-èci ka pama'ète unu na j'ara ne'e.

source_text: those who respect a special day do so for the lord; and those who eat without worrying do so for the lord since they give thanks to god; while those who avoid eating certain things do so for the lord, and they also give thanks to god.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pangee, na, abhu lod'o dhu be'a risi nèti lod'o leo, nèngu tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhèu dhu na'a sisi dènge nganga'a dhu leo, bisa na'a ho pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu na'a boe sisi. nèngu neo pakab'ua kahèi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèngu manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi.

source_text: none of us live for ourselves, or die for ourselves.
target_text: lod'o èdhi mamuri, èdhi mamuri boe dhoka hia ngi'u èdhi mesa ti. aa ladhe èdhi madhe, madhe boe dhoka pala ngi'u mesa ti.

source_text: if we live, we live for the lord, or if we die, we die for the lord-so whether we live or die, we belong to the lord.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri era, èdhi pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi madhe, èdhi pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de masi ka èdhi mamuri, do madhe, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na era.

source_text: this was the reason christ died and came back to life-so that he could be the lord of both the dead and the living.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus madhe, hèia mamuri hari. na tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa j'aj'i kètu bagi mi dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era kahèi.

source_text: so why do you criticize your fellow-believer? why do you despise your fellow-believer? for all of us will stand before god's throne of judgment.
target_text: de, nga tao ka èu ded'e iisi mu, tao sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu, ho karitik leli lii padhai a'ari mu dhèu sarani? nga tao ka èu pahahe ne? te bèli-camèd'a èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti hud'i lati asa madha ama lamatua, ho na parisa mamuri èdhi èci-èci.

source_text: for the scriptures say, ‘as surely as i am alive, ' the lord says, ‘every knee shall bow before me, and every tongue will declare that i am god. '
target_text: abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ama èdhi mesa na dhu peka, na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pe patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ja'a, dènge pakab'ua ja'a. bèli-camèd'a, nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu èci-èci, ra mangaku, na, ja'a j'aj'i kètu rèngu, lula ja'a ne, ama lamatua. '

source_text: so every one of us will have to explain ourselves to god.
target_text: de èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, bèli-camèd'a hud'i dhaa ètu madha lamatua, ho peka na, èdhi tao tasamia, aa nga tao ka èdhi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: therefore let's not judge each other anymore, but decide to do this instead-we won't put obstacles in the way of fellow-believers, or cause them to fall.
target_text: uru èèna, miu ètu roma pèci sasala taruu mi a'ari miu dhèu sarani sèra. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! be'a risi èdhi pama'ète sèmi ne'e: èdhi baku tao sèna ka a'ari èdhi kadhunu. èdhi baku tenge j'ara ho sii pamanahu si, sèna ka ra tao sasala.

source_text: i'm certain-persuaded by the lord jesus-that nothing in itself is ceremonially unclean. but if someone considers it to be unclean, to them it is unclean.
