target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ja'a ke'a mèu, sèmi ne'e: abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu bisa pakaj'alu dhèu, toke na bisa boe sabaj'a mi lamatua. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu èci dhu pangee, na, mèdha èci tao ne kaj'alu, toke nèngu ngee na, bisa heka dènge hak sèna ka sabaj'a, na, hud'i laa mèdha ne j'aj'i mèdha luri hia nèngu.

source_text: if your fellow-believer is hurt by you over matters of food, then you're no longer behaving in a loving way. don't destroy someone for whom christ died by the food you choose to eat.
target_text: conto sèmi èu mu'a sisi, aa papèd'a d'ara a'ari mu, na, èu pad'elo boe sasue èu mi nèngu, si? ladhe sèmi èèna, baku mu'a! baku pa'ele iie a'ari mu, lula èu neo mu'a nganga'a èci! te kristus madhe pala mi dhèu ne'e kahèi.

source_text: don't let the good things you do be misrepresented-
target_text: be'a boe ladhe èu ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu a'abhu èu, be'a, te ngaa dhèu leo padhai kakoli kolongara èu, lula ra pangee na, tatao èu deo na, karehe.

source_text: for god's kingdom is not about eating and drinking, but about living right, having peace and joy in the holy spirit.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! te ama lamatua ka, dhèu aae èdhi. te ngaa èdhi j'aj'i boe dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, lula èdhi ta'a-tinu madhutu dhoka atora di. aad'o! ladhe èdhi neo j'aj'i dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, èdhi hud'i tao dhu lèke, d'ara mola-mèci, mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, aa d'ara dhu karej'e-karae. aa'i-aa'i se bisa j'aj'i, ladhe èdhi pa'èki taruu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: anyone who serves christ in this way pleases god, and is appreciated by others.
target_text: dhèu dhu lalau-lalo'o hia kristus sèmi èèna, pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. aa dhèu leo lee kahèi mamuri dhèu ne'e, hèia padedha kolongara dhèu ne'e, peka na, nèngu ne, be'a!

source_text: so let's pursue the path of peace, and find ways to encourage each other.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i pa'èra ètu d'ara mamuri padame, aa maj'èni pa'èra èci dènge èci.

source_text: don't destroy the work of god with arguments over food. everything is clean-but it would be wrong to eat and offend others.
target_text: baku pa'ele iie sasab'a lamatua ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo, lula dhoka nèti j'ara ta'a-tinu di. lamatua dhu peka le, èdhi bisa ta'a ngaa èèna ka, te aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa ladhe èu patao-palaha dènge a'ari mu lula j'ara nganga'a-nganginu di, èu sala le. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: it's better not to eat meat or drink wine or anything else that would cause your fellow-believer to stumble.
target_text: hua iia taha iisi mu. mu'a ia ka sisi, do minu ia ka èi anggor, do baku mu'a-minu ngaa dhu leo, dhu tao a'ari mu kadhunu.

source_text: what you personally believe is between you and god. happy are those who don't condemn themselves for doing what they think is right!
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe èu more lii èci dènge lamatua, hèia èu pama'ète, na, èu neo parcaya ne lula-nèti nganga'a-nganginu, na, èu oto aa dènge heka lii langu. pangee ia ka ngaa-ngaa dhu peka na, èu tao sala, do aad'o. te èu dhu pama'ète more le sèmi èèna.

source_text: but if you have doubts whether it's right or wrong to eat something, then you shouldn't, because you're not convinced it's right. whatever isn't based on conviction is sin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe d'ara èu kajari, ka mu'a mèdha èci dhu èu ngee na pakaj'alu èu, lamatua pasala èu, lula èu madhutu boe ngaa dhu èu parcaya lod'o dhu èu mu'a. te ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue ngaa sa èci, te ngaa èu parcaya, peka na, èèna lèke boe ètu madha lamatua, na, èèna èu sala le.

source_text: those of us who are spiritually strong ought to support those who are spiritually weak. we shouldn't just please ourselves.
target_text: èdhi dhu parcaya èra, hud'i dènge d'ara maho'o ho bara dhèu dhu parcaya èra mèka, sèna ka rèngu taha ètu d'ara sasusa. be'a boe, ladhe èdhi dhoka pakarej'e ngi'u èdhi mesa ti.

source_text: we should all encourage others to do what's morally right, building them up.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a hud'i sèmi ne'e ku: èdhi èci-èci ka tenge j'ara, sèna ka tao dhu be'a hia a'ari èdhi dhèu sarani, ho parcaya ra asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa karej'e dènge èdhi.

source_text: christ didn't live to please himself, but as scripture says of him, the insults of those who abused you have fallen on me.
target_text: te yesus kristus mesa na, pakako boe sasab'a na ho pakarej'e d'ara nèngu unu na, te ngaa na neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua kahèi. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua lula-nèti ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dedha yesus, dhu peka na, lii pa-aape rèngu hia mi èu, noto mi dedha ja'a kahèi.

source_text: these scriptures were written down in the past to help us understand, and to encourage us so that we could wait patiently in hope.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna dhèu suri ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, sèna ka nori èdhi. nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka asa pa'èra èdhi, taha pa'èra-èra, aa lii holo-nori na pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, èdhi bisa taha ètu d'ara tatae neo tèdhi lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: may the god who gives patience and encouragement help you to be in full agreement among yourselves as you follow christ jesus,
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia dhèu a'èra, sèna ka ra bisa taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi lamatua pad'elo j'ara, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci madhutu dad'èi yesus kristus.

source_text: so that you can with one mind and with one voice together glorify god, the father of our lord jesus christ!
target_text: te ladhe miu mamuri d'ara èci, miu bisa sama-sama koa-kio ama lamatua. nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: so accept one another, just as christ accepted you, and give god the glory.
target_text: de miu isi-aanga mi hud'i sèmi mere èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sèmi nare le miu. te ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, pe dhèu ae j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: i maintain that christ came as a servant to the jews to show god tells the truth, keeping the promises he made to their forefathers.
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka hia dhèu yahudi re'a mèu, peka na, ama lamatua padhai lii lèke mola-mola. aa kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha kahèi, ho pamèci aa'i mèu ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha neo tao, hia mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: he also came that foreigners could praise god for his mercy, as scripture says, therefore i will praise you among the foreigners; i will sing praises to your name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu re'a, na, nèngu dhu rasa kasia mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. sèra nuka sèmi dhu daud suri uru èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, mi suku dhu leo sèra. ja'a neo sod'a lii koa-kio kolongara èu ètu katanga madha udhu rasa dhu leo sèra.

source_text: and also: foreigners, celebrate with his people!
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, na, we! miu dhèu leo rai kara dhu nèti rai leo. tao d'ara miu karej'e kea rae-rae, palere-lere dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: and again: all you foreigners, praise the lord, let all peoples praise him.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, daud suri, peka na, miu dhu nèti suku leo sèra. lami peka palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti dadedha lamatua, sèna ka rèngu koa-kio kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: and again, isaiah says, jesse's descendant will come to rule the nations, and foreigners will put their hope in him.
target_text: ètu era leo hari, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, yesaya suri, peka na, nèti dhèu aae daud, ana isai, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai ana-èpu na ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha mi suku leo sèra. rèngu dhu re'a le, naneo mamai nèngu èèna. hèia rèngu mate tatae ne, te rèngu re'a mèu, na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: may the god of hope completely fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you will overflow with hope through the power of the holy spirit!
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi sanao-maena. ladhe miu parcaya ne, nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara miu aa pamau d'ara miu. hud'i laa sèna ka koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, tao miu asa me'a mèu lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao.

source_text: i'm convinced that you, my brothers and sisters, are full of goodness, and that you are filled with every kind of knowledge, so you are well able to teach one another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, d'ara miu pènu dènge madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu be'a, j'ara ae-ae dhu miu me'a mèu le, aa me'a holo èci dènge èci.

source_text: i've been blunt in the way i have written to you about some of these things, but this is just to remind you. for god gave me grace
target_text: ja'a suri paled'a-led'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ho pasanèd'e miu catèka hari nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara. ja'a suri sèmi ne'e, lula lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a,

source_text: to be a minister of christ jesus to the foreigners, like a priest sharing god's good news, so that they could become an acceptable offering, made holy by the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèngu asa dhèu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a pakako sasab'a ja'a èèna, nuka sèmi ama agama èci dhu neo pa'èra dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i mi persembahan èci dhu pamaho'o d'ara lamatua. te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu tao si j'aj'i mola-mèci, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare si.

source_text: so even though i have something to boast about because of my service for god,
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa boti kètu ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: i wouldn't dare talk about any of this except as christ has done it through me, i have led foreigners to obedience through my teaching and demonstration,
target_text: ja'a bani boe padhai lii j'ara leo. ja'a dhoka lole tatao dhu kristus ad'u-ue, aa dènge j'ara sèmi ngaa na pake ja'a. limuri ne, abhu dhèu yahudi boe dhu madhutu kristus, lula lamatua pake ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara pake lii padhai dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: through the power of signs and miracles done with the holy spirit's power. from jerusalem all the way over to illyricum, everywhere i've shared fully the good news of christ.
target_text: kristus pangèd'u le mi ja'a koasa nèti roh lamatua, sèna ka bisa tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na pangèd'u koasa èèna mi ja'a, sèna ka neo pad'elo, peka na, kristus ne cee. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a peka-padhai le aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti lii lolo be'a kristus dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a lole nèti kota yerusalem, pale-lème toke d'ai rai ilirikum dètu dènge italia.

source_text: in fact i was keen to spread the good news in places that hadn't heard the name of christ, so that i wouldn't be building on what others have done.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a dhu pangee, na, ja'a d'èi titu kèna lole lula-nèti kristus mi dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lii lolo be'a na! te ja'a d'èi boe aj'a-nori ètu era dhu dhèu leo aj'a le.

source_text: as scripture says, those who haven't been told the good news will discover him, and those who haven't heard will understand.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, suku dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ne. dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa, rèngu sèra ka dhu pe re'a mèu lula nèngu.

source_text: that's why i was prevented so many times from coming to see you.
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a ae sèmi èèna, ka lake kore mèka dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu.

source_text: but now, as there's nowhere left here to work, and since i've looked forward to visiting you for many years,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, sasab'a ja'a ètu ne'e èla aa'i le. aa ja'a nelu nèbhu ae le pèri-pèri tèu kèna, dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: when i go to spain i hope to see you when i pass through. maybe you can give me some help for my journey once we've enjoyed some time together.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a laku asa spanyol, ja'a neo dhuli miu. aa ladhe ja'a dhuli taha ètu era miu, miu bisa ogo ja'a kahèi laku asa spanyol.

source_text: at the moment i'm on my way to jerusalem to help the believers there,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo laku uru asa yerusalem, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: because the believers in macedonia and achaia thought it was a good idea to send a contribution to the poor among the believers in jerusalem.
target_text: te a'ari èdhi ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya, hia le doi kolete, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa dhu parcaya lamatua ètu yerusalem.

source_text: they were happy to do this because they're in their debt. now that foreigners are sharing their spiritual benefits, they owe it to the jewish believers to help them in material things.
target_text: rèngu neo tao sèmi ne'e, lula ra pangee, na, rèngu oe sèmi pakèlu sa, mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem. te dhèu-dhèu nèti suku leo ètu mia-mia, rèngu abhu le j'ara hua iia kahèi dhu uru èèna roh lamatua hia le mi dhèu yahudi sèra. de lèke mola-mola ladhe dhèu sarani dhu dhèu yahudi boe, pake mèdha-panyau ra ho soru-bara a'ari ra dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: so once i've done this, and have safely delivered this contribution to them, i'll visit you on my way to spain.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pabagi kore ka doi se'e mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem, ja'a neo dhuli pangad'o dènge miu, ropa laku asa spanyol.

source_text: i know that when i come, christ will give us his full blessing.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu, kèti dènge mèngi-nale ae-ae nèti kristus.

source_text: i want to encourage you, my brothers and sisters through our lord jesus christ and through the love of the spirit, to join together in praying hard for me.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lula yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, aa lula roh lamatua ka tao miu pasue èci dènge èci, nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi ho miu sabaj'a patare'a-re'a, sèna ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: pray that i may be kept safe from the unbelievers in judea. pray that my work in jerusalem will be welcomed by the believers there.
target_text: manèngi sèna ka lamatua bhiri-sarobho ja'a ètu propensi yudea, ho dhèu dhu ro'o boe parcaya lamatua baku tao bhelu mi dedha ja'a. aa manèngi ho ladhe ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani ètu yerusalem, rèngu sèmi rare ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: pray that i will come to you with gladness, as god wills, so we can enjoy one another's company.
target_text: èle èèna, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, ja'a bisa dhiu asa miu dènge d'ara karej'e, lula ja'a neo ae kore ciki dènge miu.

source_text: may the god of peace be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu. te nèngu ka dhu bisa tao ho dhèu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. lèke tare'a!

source_text: i recommend to you our sister phoebe, who is a deaconess at the cenchreae church.
target_text: dènge sasuri ne'e, ja'a neo patadha miu dènge ana hèni èdhi febe, aa manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne. nèngu ka dhu ra ded'e ho ladhe-leru juma'at ètu kota kengkrea.

source_text: please welcome her in the lord, as believers should, and help her in whatever way she needs, because she has been a great help to many people, myself included.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a. tao dhu pantas mi nèngu, nuka sèmi hia dhèu sarani sèra, lula nèngu ne pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ladhe na parluu ngaa, soru-bara ne. te nèngu biasa soru-bara le ja'a dènge dhèu ae-ae, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: pass on my greetings to prisca and aquila, my co-workers in christ jesus,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, priskila dènge dhèu èmu na, akila. ji'i ka dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ae-ae nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: who risked their lives for me. it's not just me who is very thankful for them, but all the churches of the foreigners too.
target_text: dua ra oe madhe sad'i neo pamamuri ja'a. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di dhu manèngi makasi mi dua ra. te dhèu yahudi boe dhu j'aj'i le dhèu sarani, nèti juma'at aa'i-aa'i buli mia-mia, manèngi makasi kahèi, lula tatao ra dhu be'a.

source_text: please also give my greetings to the church that meets in their home. pass on my best wishes to my good friend epaenetus, the first person to follow christ in the province of asia.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara èmu priskila dènge akila. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi angalai ja'a, epenetus. nèngu ka, dhèu uru tèka parcaya kristus ètu propensi asia.

source_text: give my greetings to mary, who worked hard for you,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, maria. nèngu dhu sab'a ne'a boe j'èra ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: and also andronicus and junia, from my own country and fellow-prisoners. they are well-known among the apostles, and became followers of christ before me.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi andronikus dènge ana hèni èdhi, yunia. dua ra dhèu yahudi, sama sèmi ja'a kahèi. dua ra parcaya uuru kristus nèti ja'a. uru èèna, rèngu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho. dua ra j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, aa dhèu ae tadhe si.

source_text: give my best to ampliatus, my good friend in the lord;
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ampliatus. ja'a sue ne, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: to urbanus, our co-worker in christ; and to my dear friend stachys.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi urbanus. nèngu kahèi pakako sasab'a kristus sama-sama dènge èdhi. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi stakis, dhu ja'a sue.

source_text: my greetings to apelles, a trustworthy man in christ. greetings to aristobulus's family,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi apeles. masi ka nèngu lèke dadugu-rariu, te ngaa na segi ka nare li'u, lula lèka èra kristus. hia lii maho'o mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i nèti aristobulus.

source_text: to my countryman herodion, and to those from narcissus' family who belong to the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi a'a herodion. nèngu dhèu yahudi kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi isi èmu narkisus dhu parcaya kristus.

source_text: my best wishes to tryphaena and tryphosa, hard workers for the lord, and to my friend persis, who has done so much in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi ana hèni èdhi, trifena dènge trifosa. rèngu pakako kahèi sasab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. hia lii maho'o mi angalai ja'a, ana hèni èdhi, persis. te nèngu kahèi sab'a bia hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: give my greetings to rufus, an exceptional worker, and his mother-who i count as my mother too.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi rufus. kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu hag'e nare ne. hia lii maho'o mi ina na kahèi. te nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ina d'èlu ja'a.

source_text: greetings to asyncritus, phlegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas, and the fellow-believers who are with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi asinkritus, flegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas dènge a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge rèngu.

source_text: best wishes to philologus and julia, nereus and his sister, olympas, and to all the believers with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi filologus, ana hèni èdhi, yulia, olimpas, nereus dènge ana hèni na, dènge dhèu-dhèu sarani aa'i dhu sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet one another affectionately. all the churches of christ send their greetings to you.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, mi pa'uu èci dènge èci, dhu pantas mi dhèu parcaya. juma'at kristus aa'i-aa'i ètu se'e, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi.

source_text: now i'm pleading with you my fellow-believers: watch out for those who cause arguments and confuse people about the teachings you learned. stay away from them!
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mage-mage! j'aga paie-iie, te abhu dhèu dhu tao miu mae-manyèla, aa dhu neo sii pabèbhe miu. ngaa dhu rèngu peka dènge miu sèra, palab'a dènge ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a-nori le miu. de baku pa'angalai dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: these people are not serving christ our lord but their own appetites, and by their smooth-talking and pleasant words they deceive the minds of unsuspecting people.
target_text: dhèu sèra sab'a boe hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rèngu sèra dhoka sab'a ho pa'oto ngi'u rèngu unu ra. dhèu sèra dhoka hèb'a mènyi mi dhèu dhu dhae re'a mèka mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe. rèngu hèb'a mènyi ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu.

source_text: everyone knows how faithful you are. this makes me really happy. however, i want you to be wise about what's good, and innocent of anything bad.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le, na, miu loe boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna lula miu. dad'èi ja'a ka, ladhe miu d'èlu-mèu ètu j'ara-j'ara be'a, aa baku pakihu kee dènge j'ara-j'ara karehe.

source_text: the god of peace will soon break the power of satan and make him subject to you. may the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu bisa hia èdhi mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ka dhu èèna na palaho koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, aa pad'elo, peka na, miu ka dhu segi. se'e se nèbhu heka j'aj'i. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: timothy my co-worker sends his greetings, as do lucius, jason, and sosipater, my fellow-countrymen.
target_text: ari èdhi, timotius, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ja'a, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi. lukius, yason, dènge sosipater, hia lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a.

source_text: tertius-who wrote down this letter-also sends you greetings in the lord.
target_text: ja'a ne, tertius, ka dhu suri sasuri ne'e madhutu ngaa dhu paulus pua ja'a suri. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, te ja'a ne dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: my host gaius, and the whole church here, send you greetings. erastus the city treasurer, sends his best wishes, as does our fellow-believer quartus.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, manubha ètu èmu gayus. dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i tema pakaboko ètu èmu na ho manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi. erastus, dhu j'aj'i bendahara kota, dènge a'ari èdhi kuartus, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: now to him who can make you strong through the good news i share and the message of jesus christ, according to the mystery of truth that has been revealed, the mystery of truth, hidden for eternity,
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! te nèngu ka dhu unu koasa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i èra. lii lolo be'a na peka sèmi èèna ka, aa ja'a aj'a-nori dhèu sèmi èèna kahèi, ropa ja'a peka dènge rèngu lula-nèti yesus kristus. lamatua ka dhu bhoke paled'a hia mi èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti kristus, dhu uru-uru sèra dhèu dhae re'a mèka, lula dhu pahuni era.

source_text: now made visible; through the prophets' writings, and following the command of the eternal god, the mystery of truth is made known to everyone everywhere so they can trust and obey him;
target_text: te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci, limuri ne mèu aadha-aadha le. ama lamatua dhu madhe nèdhi boe, nèngu ka ator sèna ka dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, re'a mèu madha j'ara dhu pahuni uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu sèra bisa parcaya ne, aa tao madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: to the one and only wise god, through jesus christ- to him be glory for ever. amen.
target_text: dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na di, ama lamatua. dhodhoka nèngu mesa-mesa na, dhu ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara. ja'a d'èi j'oka padedha-dedha ne, lula tatao yesus kristus! lèke tare'a! sasuri ja'a d'ai sange ne'e ka, saloom, paulus

source_text: this letter comes from paul, called to be an apostle of jesus christ according to the will of god, and from sosthenes, our brother.
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua hag'e nare le ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. sostenes hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: it is sent to the church of god in corinth, those who are being made right in christ jesus, called to live holy lives-and to everyone who worships the lord jesus christ everywhere, the lord both of them and of us.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu dhèu parcaya ama lamatua ètu kota korintus. na hag'e nare le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci nèngu, lula miu parcaya le yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema le karèi nèti uru ka ho na mai. ama lamatua tao miu mola-mèci kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. te rèngu manèngi le sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus soru-bara si. nèngu ne j'aj'i kètu mi dedha èdhi aa rèngu kahèi.

source_text: may you have grace and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i'm always thanking god for you because of the grace of god given to you in christ jesus.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a ngee kèdhi miu, ja'a padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, makasi ae-ae lula parcaya dhèu korintus sèra! te lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu, lula miu lèka taruu yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua na mai.

source_text: through him you have been made rich in everything, in all that you say and every aspect of what you know.
target_text: hèia na hia miu a'èra, ka miu bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a aa'i-aa'i, lula miu pa'èki dènge ne. èèna ka dhu tao d'ara miu kaja-su'i dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka miu me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia risi, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri nèngu. miu me'a kahèi j'ara mia dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu lole mi dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: in fact the testimony of christ was proved valid in your experience,
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i ne'e ka dhu padelo, na, j'ara-j'ara dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu lula-nèti kristus èèna, dhu amo le ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu me'a tare'a-re'a, na, j'ara sèra lèke.

source_text: so that you're not missing any spiritual gift as you wait for the coming of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: de miu abhu le j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia dhèu unu na. kura boe ciki sa. hèia miu tatae lod'o dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua bhoke ho pad'elo kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he will also keep you strong to the very end, so you will be kept right until the day of the lord jesus christ.
target_text: kristus èèna ka dhu neo pa'èra miu sèna ka miu taha taruu, toke na mai hari asa rai-haha ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu manahu boe, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala mi dedha miu.

source_text: god is trustworthy who called you to share together in fellowship with his son jesus christ our lord.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ama lamatua, lula ngaa dhu nèngu peka, èèna ka dhu j'aj'i. tatu nèngu neo tao j'ara se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa tadhe ana na, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus èèna.

source_text: brothers and sisters, i plead with you in the name of our lord jesus christ that you all agree and that you're not divided. instead develop a united attitude and purpose.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ètu d'ara aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a padhai lii pake kolongara kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de ja'a manèngi tare'a-re'a, sèna ka miu loe ka nèti padhèto ètu d'ara lii padhai. te ngaa miu hud'i tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci, aa baku mae-manyèla. miu hud'i pake ngangee madhera, ho me'a, na, miu neo d'ai too-lane dhu èci èèna ka di.

source_text: for i have been told things about you, my brothers and sisters, by some of chloe's people-that you are quarreling among yourselves.
target_text: te abhu dhèu nèti isi èmu ana hèni èdhi kloe dhu mai peka dènge ja'a, na, ètu talora miu abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: let me explain what i mean. you're all making different claims: i follow paul, or i follow apollos, or i follow peter, or i follow christ.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a re paulus! aa cahag'e peka na, ja'a re apolos! aa abhu kahèi dhu paka'uu, na, ja'a re petrus! aa dhu leo hari peka na, ja'a ne, nanene dhoka kristus di!

source_text: is christ divided? did paul die on a cross for you? was it in the name of paul that you were baptized?
target_text: miu pangee tasamia, ee? dhèu unu kristus bisa boe mae-manyèla. do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ka dhu madhe pala miu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? aad'o! do, lod'o ra sarani miu, rèngu pake ngara ja'a, ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, do? bisa boe, si?

source_text: i'm grateful to god that i didn't baptize any of you, except crispus and gaius,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, te lod'o ja'a ètu èèna dènge miu, ja'a sarani boe dhèu ae. dhu ja'a sarani ètu nèi dhoka krispus dènge gayus di.

source_text: so nobody can claim they were baptized in my name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa peka na, ra sarani ja'a pake ngara paulus, ka ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu paulus.

source_text: oh, and i also baptized the stephanas family-i can't think of anyone else.
target_text: ee, ja'a heka sanèd'e kèna. ja'a sarani isi èmu stefanus cahag'e kahèi. te ngaa ja'a sanèd'e heka, abhu dhèu era dhu ja'a sarani, do aad'o.

source_text: for christ didn't send me out to baptize, but to spread the good news, and not with eloquent human wisdom, otherwise the cross of christ would be made powerless.
target_text: te kristus pua boe ja'a ho laku sarani dhèu. kapua sasab'a ja'a, nuka peka-padhai dènge j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a lole mi dhèu, nèngu d'èi boe ja'a peka mamèu ja'a, do, pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii sèmi èèna, èèna pakura koasa nèti lii lolo mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: for the message of the cross is nonsense to those who are lost, but it's the power of god to those of us who are saved.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi peka-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, goa titu kèna. te ngaa dhèu sèmi sèra, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. aa te ngaa, bagi mi èdhi, mamadhe kristus ne, sèna ka pad'elo koasa lamatua ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: as scripture says, i will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and i will wipe out the cleverness of the clever.
target_text: j'ara ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na, ama lamatua peka na, ‘madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu re'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pa'ele iie aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua. rupa-rupa mamèu rèngu, bèli-camèd'a ja'a core eele aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu guna boe. '

source_text: so how about the wise, the writers, and the philosophers of this age? hasn't god turned the wisdom of this world into foolishness?
target_text: uru èèna, mema lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, tasamia hari? dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra, sèmi ngaa sa? mese agama sèra, j'aj'i sèmi ngaa? aa tuka tao lii langu sèra, tasa mera mia? miu nanene sèku! lamatua tao si nuka sèmi dhèu goa! nèngu bete eele aa'i le mamèu dhu amo ètu d'ara kahadhu dhèu rai-haha ne, aa tao mamèu sèra nuka sèmi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: since god in his wisdom allowed the world in its wisdom not to know god, it was god's gracious plan that by the foolishness of the good news those who trusted in him would be saved. the jews ask for miraculous signs, and greeks look for wisdom,
target_text: mamèu ama lamatua lènge aa'i mèu-mèu. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa j'ara ngangee rèngu mesa ra d'ai mèka ho ra tadhe hua iia ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua pake le mamèu na ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu rai-haha. te uru èèna, lamatua pangee, peka na, masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a sèra goa, te ngaa tasamia èèna ka, hud'i ja'a pua ku dhèu lasi lole dènge ra j'ara dhu lèke nèti ja'a. te lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na ho lasi lole dènge dhèu. na pama'ète nare le neo pake lii moa èèna, sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya ne. nèngu pake j'ara ne, ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, j'ara ama lamatua ne, goa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pusi-pahae boe dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te dhèu yahudi neo manèngi dhoka tadha-tadha malaa di, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. aa dhèu yunani neo nanene dhoka j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu maso asa d'ara kahadhu ra, madhutu ngangee rèngu mesa ra.

source_text: but our message is of christ killed on a cross-offensive to the jews, and foolishness to the foreigners.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa èdhi dhu j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua lati peka dènge dhèu, na, lamatua pua le kristus, nuka dhèu dhu nèngu pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, mai asa rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ropa dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo ne'e, rèngu sisu, te madhutu a'abhu ra, dhèu dhu lamatua neo pua mai èèna, bisa boe madhe sèmi èèna. ropa dhèu yunani tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na, lii lolo dhèu goa!

source_text: however, for those who are called by god, both jews and foreigners, christ is the power of god and the wisdom of god.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. rèngu sèra cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, mamadhe kristus dhu pad'elo le mi rèngu, na, koasa ama lamatua dènge boe too-lane, aa mamèu na risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: for the foolishness of god is wiser than we are; and the weakness of god is stronger than we are.
target_text: masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, j'ara lamatua ne unu dhèu goa, te ngaa nèngu mèu risi eele rèngu. aa masi ka ra pangee, na, lamatua dènge boe koasa, te ngaa koasa na dedha risi eele nèti rèngu.

source_text: brothers and sisters, remember your calling-and that this did not include many who are wise, humanly speaking; not many who are powerful; not many who are important.
target_text: a'ari pasue! sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu lii padhai ja'a ne, sanèd'e mamuri miu, lod'o lamatua hag'e nare miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha, ètu talora aae miu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu d'èlu-mèu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu dènge pangaru kapai, aa abhu boe dhèu ae dhu a'ari ra dhu dènge kolongara kapai.

source_text: instead god chose the things the world considers foolish to humiliate those who think they are wise. he chose the things the world considers weak to humiliate those who think they are strong.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, na, tabhènga ana liku, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu. aa na hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu dhèu rai-haha, dhèu dhu dènge boe koasa, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dènge koasa.

source_text: he chose the things that are unimportant and despised by the world, even things that are not, to bring to nothing the things that are,
target_text: hèia na hag'e nare dhèu haha dhu dènge boe kolongara, aa dhu biasa dhèu pahaha si. te lamatua neo pake si, sèna ka dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu kapai, j'aj'i sèmi dhèu dènge boe pangaru ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so that nobody should boast in god's presence.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa tèb'a kakara ètu madha ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu dhèu kapai.

source_text: it's because of him that you live in christ jesus, who god made to be wisdom for us. he sets us right, keeps us right, and frees us.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu bhoke pataleo j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. lamatua ka pake yesus j'aj'i dhèu dhu pala-bagi mamèu na mi dedha èdhi. yesus èèna ka dhu oti j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua. yesus èèna ka dhu tao èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola dènge mèci. aa nèngu ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: so as scripture says, whoever wants to boast, let them boast in the lord.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, cee ka dhu d'èi pakapai kolongara dhèu, be'a risi pakapai kolongara lamatua èdhi. baku pakapai iisi!

source_text: brothers and sisters, when i came to you i didn't try to impress you with wonderful words or great wisdom when i told you what god had to say to you.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a dhiu asa miu, ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna dhèu rai-haha ne re'a mèka. te ngaa ja'a kèti boe lii sèra ho padedha iisi. aa ja'a padhai boe pake lii dhu carui, sèna ka pad'elo mamèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: i decided that while i was with you i didn't want to concentrate on anything except jesus christ, and that he was crucified.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a pad'elo dhoka ca j'ara di, nuka yesus kristus. nèngu ne, dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. te ngaa ropa yesus mai, dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhoka j'ara ne'e di, dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: i came to you in weakness, fearful and trembling.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a rasa mamèu ja'a d'ai boe, aa ja'a madha'u ka isi karèbha.

source_text: i didn't speak to you with persuasive words of wisdom to convince you. i just explained it all to you through the evidence and power of the spirit.
target_text: j'ara lii padhai ja'a, aa ngaa dhu ja'a lole, mud'a di. te ja'a ko'o boe pake lii dhu karisi sèna ka pamako miu. aad'o! te ngaa ropa ja'a peka-padhai, na, lii padhai ja'a j'aj'i led'a, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu ator ja'a, aa koasa na sab'a ètu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: that way your trust in god wouldn't rely on human wisdom but on the power of god.
target_text: te ja'a pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe miu parcaya ama lamatua, lula miu nanene lii padhai dhèu d'èlu-mèu di. dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu parcaya lamatua, lula na pad'elo koasa na mi dedha miu.

source_text: however, we do use words of wisdom when we speak to those who are spiritually mature, but this isn't wisdom that comes from this world, or from the rulers of this world who soon fade from the scene.
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe ji'i padhai lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya èra le, ji'i aj'a rèngu pake lii padhai dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu. te ngaa dhu re'a mèu èèna, madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, do, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu paredha sèra aj'a limuri ne. te sèra sa, bèli-camèd'a ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: on the contrary we explain god's wisdom in terms of a revealed mystery that was previously hidden which god planned for our glory before the creation of the worlds.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i aj'a dhoka j'ara mamèu dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. lula uru-uru sèra, lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, lamatua pahuni j'ara sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu pama'ète le, sèna ka neo bhoke patalele lii pahuni èèna hia èdhi, ho èdhi kahèi abhu pala ètu d'ara kolongara na dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: none of the rulers of this world understood anything about this-for if they had, they would not have crucified the lord of glory.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu paredha limuri ne, re'a mèu iia boe mamèu lamatua. te ladhe re'a tare'a, tatu ra paku pamadhe boe kètu èdhi dhu dedha risi èèna, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: but as scripture says, no one has ever seen, and no one has ever heard, and no one has ever imagined what god has prepared for those who love him.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri lula-nèti rahasia lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke, peka na, abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae rèdhi mèka dènge musi madha ra, aa abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae tadèngi rèdhi mèka dènge ro'a dhilu ra, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ngee rèdhi boe. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na lamatua sadia tèke le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: but god has revealed this to us through the spirit, because the spirit delves into the depths of god.
target_text: uru èèna, mema dhèu re'a boe j'ara sèra, te ngaa limuri ne ama lamatua pake roh na ho bhoke paled'a hia èdhi. roh lamatua èèna ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. te nèngu parisa toke lutu d'ara iiki lamatua kahèi.

source_text: who knows anyone's thoughts except the actual person? in the same way no one knows god's thoughts except the spirit of god.
target_text: èdhi èci-èci ka dènge roh ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhèu rai-haha, èci-èci ka dènge ngangee aa tatao na. aa abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu ne'a mèu d'ara iiki èdhi, dhoka roh èdhi unu ti dhu ne'a. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a d'ara iiki lamatua. dhoka roh nèngu mesa na ka dhu ne'a mèu.

source_text: for we have received the spirit from god, not the spirit of this world, so that we could understand what god so generously gave us.
target_text: èdhi dhu sèmi tare le roh lamatua, ka nèngu ka dhu ator èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. lula roh lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi tadhe aa'i j'ara dhu be'a, dhu nèngu tao le hia èdhi.

source_text: that's what we speak about-not using words taught by human wisdom, but what the spirit teaches. we explain what is spiritual using spiritual terms.
target_text: j'ara sèra ka dhu èdhi tema padhue-padhai. te ji'i lole j'ara-j'ara dhu roh lamatua aj'a-nori ji'i. ka ji'i se aj'a boe pake lii dhu nèti mamèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori pake lii dhu mai nèti roh lamatua mi dhèu dhu tadhe nèngu.

source_text: of course people who are not spiritual don't accept what comes from god's spirit. it's just foolish nonsense to them, and they can't understand it, because what is spiritual has to be properly examined.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe roh lamatua, ropa na nanene lii padhai ji'i, nèngu d'èi boe sèmi. lula nèngu ngee, na, ngaa kèna? maso boe d'ara kahadhu! aa te ngaa, masi ka tasamia èèna ka, dhèu ne bisa boe ne'a j'ara sèra, te nèngu dhu mamuri pa'èki boe dènge roh lamatua.

source_text: people who are spiritual investigate everything, but are not placed under investigation themselves.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, heka re'a j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. te ngaa dhèu leo pajiko rare boe ngangee dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for who understands the lord's mind, and would think to instruct him? but we do have christ's mind!
target_text: bisa tasamia? te abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na: cee ka dhu bisa re'a ngangee ama lamatua? do, cee ka dhu bisa ator lamatua, ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii holo-nori dhèu èèna? abhu boe ca dhèu sa! madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi te'a j'ara se'e, lula kristus ka dhu soru-bara sèna ka èdhi bisa pangee madhutu ngangee nèngu.

source_text: my brothers and sisters, i couldn't talk with you as spiritual believers, but as worldly people-like baby christians.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ja'a ètu èèna era, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dhae pa'èki èra mèka dènge roh lamatua. lula miu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu dhoo-dhoo di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha dhu leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe padhai lii dènge miu, nuka sèmi padhai lii dènge dhèu ee'a, te miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa.

source_text: i gave you milk-i couldn't give you solid food to eat, because you weren't ready for it.
target_text: ja'a hud'i aj'a miu j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe, lula miu bisa mèka sèmi mere j'ara dhu carui, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu bisa mèka ra'a sisi. miu hud'i kadhii ku, sama sèmi dhèu ee'a dhu tema ra'a sisi. te ngaa limuri ne, miu nuka sèmi ana rara iisi hiu era, dhu me'a dhoka minu susu di.

source_text: even now you're not ready for it, because you're still worldly. since you're still jealous and argumentative, doesn't that show you're worldly, behaving just like ordinary people do?
target_text: lula ngangee miu cakaraa dhèu dhu neo dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu risi nèti miu, miu tèka d'ara aa patao-palaha leli! nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka na, miu me'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi miu dhoo-dhoo. de sèmi èèna na, miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: when one of you says, i follow paul, while another says, i follow apollos, doesn't that show you're being so very human?
target_text: lula miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a ne, re paulus! aa cahag'e dhu peka na, ja'a ne, re apolos! lod'o-lod'o miu padhai lii sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo, na, miu èci èèna ka dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: who is apollos, anyway? and who is paul? we're just servants through whom you believed. each of us does the work god gave us to do.
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, apolos èèna, cee? aa ja'a, paulus ne, cee? te ji'i dua mi se, dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i dhoka pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus. apolos pakako sasab'a madhutu paredha kètu èdhi. aa ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: i did the planting, apollos did the watering-but it was god who made you grow!
target_text: ja'a ka dhu uru tèka lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu sèle hini. hèia apolos mai aj'a-nori miu. èèna nuka sèmi nèngu ka dhu bui-tatee hini dhu ja'a sèle kore sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao hini sèra muri j'aj'i kapai aae.

source_text: so the one who does the planting doesn't count for anything, any more than the one who does the watering. the only one who matters is god who is growing you!
target_text: de dhèu dhu sèle hini sèra dènge boe kab'ua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu bui. dhodhoka èci di dhu dènge kab'ua, nuka ama lamatua. lula nèngu ka tao hini sèra muri, ka sub'u dènge sega.

source_text: the one planting and the one watering have the same goal, and both will be rewarded according to what they've done.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèle, aa dhèu dhu bui-tatee, sab'a sama-sama, te sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakako sasab'a lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na b'ae rui-j'aj'èra ra.

source_text: we are workers together with god-and you are god's field, his building.
target_text: te ji'i sama-sama dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. aa miu nuka sèmi oka lamatua, dhu nèngu neo uri. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu ama lamatua patitu.

source_text: through the grace of god that he gave to me, i laid down the foundation like a skilled building supervisor. now someone else is building on it. whoever does the building needs to watch what they're doing.
target_text: de lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèti èèna ka ja'a sama sèmi dholu. ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a ho ke'a mèu j'ara-j'ara nèti kapua, sèna ka ja'a tao era padhèdi dhu èra ètu d'ara mamuri miu. hèia dhèu leo aj'a-nori miu kahèi, ho rèngu patitu mi era padhèdi dhu ja'a tao kore èèna. te ngaa tuka èci-èci hud'i sab'a ku dènge d'ara kateme, ho rèngu patitu èmu dhu èra.

source_text: for no one can lay any other foundation than what's already laid-that is jesus christ.
target_text: era padhèdi dhu èra èèna, abhu le. nuka yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo bisa boe tao era padhèdi leo ètu d'ara miu, te lamatua dhu tao tèke le era padhèdi dhu lèke.

source_text: those who build on that foundation may use gold, silver, precious stone, wood, hay, or straw-
target_text: tatu abhu dhèu dhu neo patitu kahèi ètu era padhèdi èèna pake rupa-rupa nèu. abhu dhu neo pake nèu dhu kab'ua, sèmi hualaa, doi pudhi do hadhu kale'e. abhu dhu pake nèu biasa, nuka sèmi aj'u, j'u'u do rèu hidhu.

source_text: but whatever is used to build with will be exposed. for on the day of judgment, fire will reveal it and test it. everyone's work will be shown for what it is.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a tuka èci-èci ka bisa te'a, aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a sasab'a rèngu èèna, be'a do aad'o. te lod'o èle rai-haha, lamatua neo sèku ne, sama sèmi na pake ai ho pad'elo, na, sasab'a dhèu sèra, bisa taha do aad'o.

source_text: those whose building survives will be rewarded.
target_text: ladhe uji nare sasab'a nèti ca dhèu pake ai, aa nèu dhu na pake bisa taha, bèli-camèd'a lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra na ètu sorga.

source_text: those whose building is burned up will lose out. they will still be saved, but it will be like passing through fire!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe uji nare sasab'a dhèu pake ai, aa ai na'e aa'i nèu dhu nèngu pake patitu ètu era padhèdi èèna, na, lamatua hia boe dhèu ne ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa tuka ne abhu mamuri era, masi ka sèmi dhèu dhu rai kalua nèti d'ara èmu ai na'e.

source_text: don't you know you are god's temple and that god's spirit lives in you?
target_text: miu hud'i me'a ku, dhu peka na, miu sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a lamatua, aa roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara.

source_text: anyone who destroys god's temple will be destroyed by god, for god's temple is holy, and you are the temple.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie èmu sabaj'a lamatua, nuka era pea na, na mage-mage! bèli-camèd'a lamatua pa'ele iie ne kahèi! te èmu sabaj'a lamatua èèna mola-mèci. de miu hud'i mola-mèci ku kahèi.

source_text: don't deceive yourselves. if there's any one of you who thinks they're worldly wise, they should become fools so they can become truly wise!
target_text: miu baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi! ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu aa ne'a aa'i madhutu mamèu dhèu ètu rai-haha lod'o limuri ne, èèna peka na, nèngu ne'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa. ladhe èu mase'a le, peka na, èu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa, heka èu mulai me'a kèna.

source_text: this world's wisdom is plain foolishness to god. as scripture says, he uses the cleverness of the wise to catch them out,
target_text: ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ama lamatua peka na, goa. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke, peka na: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa èèna na lamatua pake hari ngangee na dhu karehe sèra, j'aj'i mi sasii, ho sii pa'ele iie hari nèngu!

source_text: and the lord knows the arguments of the wise are pointless.
target_text: ètu era leo dhu suri kahèi, peka na, lamatua èdhi dhu ne'a le ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra pangee, aa dhèu dhu hud'i re'a ku neo tao ne tasa mere mia, nèngu dhu ne'a nare le, na, rèngu dhoka ngee iia d'ara di.

source_text: so don't boast about people. for you have everything, whether it's paul or apollos or peter-or the world, or life, or death, or the present, or the future. you have everything-
target_text: de miu baku padedha dhèu èci sa, dhu peka na, nèngu èèna lènge aa'i dhèu. te lamatua ka dhu ded'e dhèu, ho ator miu. aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu miu. de dhèu dhu ator miu sèra, sama sèmi: ja'a, apolos, dènge petrus, ji'i se j'aj'i unu miu. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne unu miu kahèi, masi ka miu mamuri do miu madhe, masi ka deo ne'e do lod'o dhu mai, aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu miu kateme aae.

source_text: and you are christ's, and christ is god's.
target_text: aa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. aa kristus unu ama lamatua!

source_text: so think of us as christ's servants given the responsibility for the mysteries of god.
target_text: de miu baku koa-kad'iri ji'i, te ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha kristus di. aa ama lamatua lèka ji'i, sèna ka j'aga paie-iie j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke.

source_text: more than this, those who have such responsibilities are required to be trustworthy.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhenga mèdha-panyau lamatua na, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: personally it hardly matters to me if you or anyone else judges me-in fact i don't even judge myself.
target_text: tasamia dènge ja'a? ja'a sab'e madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, do aad'o? ja'a ko'o boe ke'a, miu nile ja'a tasa mera mia. aa ja'a pusi-pahae boe kahèi dhèu leo nile ja'a sèmi ngaa sa. ja'a ke'a boe nile ngi'u ja'a unu ku kahèi.

source_text: i don't know of anything i've done wrong, but that doesn't make me morally right. it's the lord who judges me.
target_text: te masi ka d'ara iiki ja'a peka na, ja'a be'a le, tatu boe sasoa na, ja'a be'a. dhu mèci ka, lamatua ka dhu nile ja'a tasa mera mia.

source_text: so don't judge anything before the right time-when the lord comes. he will bring to light all the darkest secrets that are hidden, and he will reveal people's motives. god will give everyone whatever praise they deserve.
target_text: de miu baku tao ngi'u sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu ho nile dhèu leo sèra. mate mamai hari lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu. nèngu ka pasabhoka aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao pahuni ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu neo bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu ngee ètu d'ara ra. hèia ama lamatua neo peka aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu tao le.

source_text: now, brothers and sisters, i have applied this to apollos and myself as an example for you. that way you will learn not to go beyond what has been written, and not in arrogance prefer one over the other.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a dènge apolos, nuka sèmi ja'a j'aj'i mi conto ho miu bisa aj'a nèti ji'i, nuka: tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua. baku tao dhu leo. ladhe miu madhutu ka j'ara se'e, miu baku bia re èci sa, aa padedha iisi lula madhutu ca dhèu, aa pahahe dhèu leo.

source_text: who made you so special? what do you have that you weren't given? since you were given it, why do you proudly claim you weren't?
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, miu risi nèti dhèu leo, do? baku! te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu unu, miu abhu nèti ama lamatua. de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu nged'e ej'a ai, nuka sèmi miu ad'u-ue unu mi?

source_text: you think you have all you need. you think you're so wealthy. you think you're kings already, and don't need us. i wish you were really ruling as kings, so we could rule with you!
target_text: nuka sèmi aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu, miu abhu le. nuka sèmi miu kaja le! miu tao ngi'u mi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu kapai sama sèmi dhèu aae sa, aa ji'i soru-bara boe ciki sa. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua ka dhu hia aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu. te ngaa ladhe miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu aae, ele boe ji'i ngèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge miu, si?

source_text: the way i see it, god has put us apostles on display as the last in the line, condemned to die. we have been made a public show before the entire universe, to angels and to human beings.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha ji'i, ho la'a asa mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka lole dènge dhèu j'ara-j'ara kristus. te ngaa ca tèka-ca tèka sa ja'a pangee, na, lamatua pua ji'i titu re limuri tèka, sama sèmi ana bèdho dhu tatae abhu huku madhe. hèia na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga mai laladhe ji'i.

source_text: we're christ's fools, but you are so wise in christ! we're the weak ones, but you are so strong! you have the glory, but we are despised!
target_text: miu kapai titu kèna, nga! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, miu d'èlu-mèu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus. te ngaa rèngu pangee, na, ji'i goa titu kèna, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. ele boe rèngu ngee, na, miu èra risi, aa ji'i se roe aala-aala. ele boe ra ded'e miu padedha-dedha, te ngaa ro'o boe pusi-pahae ji'i ciki sa hèi. seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: right up till now we're hungry and thirsty. we have no clothes. we're badly beaten up, and we have no place to call home.
target_text: toke d'ai deo ne'e, ji'i manganga dènge koko-kamango. mèdha-papake ji'i kaha'i-kaheru. dhèu loe boe game ji'i. ji'i nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era pea.

source_text: we struggle on doing manual work. when people curse us, we bless them. when they persecute us, we put up with it.
target_text: ji'i sab'a dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi toke d'ai èi kabhèsu hae. ladhe dhèu padhai-kakoli ji'i, ji'i dhoka b'ala, peka na, ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia miu. ladhe dhèu paj'èra ji'i, na, ji'i b'ala boe, dhoka mau-mau di.

source_text: when they insult us, we respond with kindness. even now we are treated like dirt, the worst trash in the whole world.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i, ji'i dhoka dhaa dènge rèhu mare di. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ji'i se nuka sèmi kaj'alu do mamumu dhu core eele.

source_text: i'm not writing like this to make you feel ashamed, but to caution you as my children whom i love so much.
target_text: ja'a suri j'ara se'e, neo boe pamakae miu. te ngaa ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, lula ja'a sue miu nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a sa. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho lèpa asa j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: even though you may have thousands of christian instructors, you don't have many fathers-it was in christ jesus that i became your father when i shared the good news with you.

target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe mone ne d'èi era sèna ka dua ra mamuri pa'èci taruu.

source_text: for a husband who is not a christian, the marriage relationship is made holy by the christian wife, and for a wife who is not a christian, the marriage relationship is made holy by the christian husband. otherwise it would mean your children were impure, but now they are holy.
target_text: te mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa mola-mèci, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge bhèni dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. aa bhèni dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. te ladhe aad'o, na, ana-ana rèngu bisa boe mola-mèci. te ngaa dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: however, if the non-christian spouse leaves, let them leave. in such cases the christian man or woman is not slavishly bound, for god has called us to live in peace.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu bhèni do dhèu mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, dhu la'e tèke eele dhèu èmu-kamali na dhu parcaya, na hud'i nèngu sène. ka dhèu èmu dhu parcaya, pa'èki heka dènge ne. te ama lamatua paroa miu sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: wives, who knows? you may save your husband! husbands, who knows? you may save your wife!
target_text: dhèu bhèni dhu parcaya, dhu leo le èmu aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu mone dhu parcaya dhu leo le èmu sèra! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. miu me'a iia mèka.

source_text: apart from such cases, each of you should remain in the situation that the lord has placed you, and continue to live the life to which god has called you. that's my instruction to all the churches.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa mamuri dhèu èci-èci tasa mera mia lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri taruu sèmi èèna. baku ub'a hari, te ama lamatua dhu ator nare le sèmi èèna. ja'a aj'a-nori atora ne ètu juma'at aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: were you circumcised when you were converted? don't become uncircumcised. were you uncircumcised when you were converted? don't become circumcised.
target_text: conto, ladhe miu suna le sèna ka pad'elo, na, miu dhèu yahudi, hèia lod'o limuri miu tadèngi ama lamatua paroa nare miu, na, baku pasili, peka na, miu suna le. aa dhèu dhu dhae suna mèka ropa tadèngi ama lamatua paroa si, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, na, suna ia ka. lula rèngu dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: circumcision doesn't mean anything, and uncircumcision doesn't mean anything. keeping the commandments of god is what really matters.
target_text: ladhe dhu suna le, èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. aa suna mèka èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. dhu dènge kab'ua ka, nuka èdhi madhutu lii paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: everyone should remain in the position they were in when they were called.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua hag'e nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lamatua pua boe miu suna, do baku suna. de hud'i ka laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka.

source_text: if you were a slave when you were called, don't worry-though if you have an opportunity to become free, take it.
target_text: ja'a hia hari conto èci. ladhe èu j'aj'i ènu lod'o ama lamatua paroa èu, na, hud'i laa sèmi èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa ladhe sèmi èu dhu ènu boe, na, hud'i laa! ladhe bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu bebas, ngaa-ngaa tao boe kahèi.

source_text: if you were a slave when the lord called you, you are now free, working for the lord. in the same way if you were called when you were free, you are now christ's slave!
target_text: te ropa lamatua paroa ca dhèu ènu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ènu ne j'aj'i le sèmi ca dhèu dhu bebas, dhu sab'a hia lamatua na ètu sorga. aa lod'o ama lamatua paroa ca dhèu bebas j'aj'i dhèu unu na, dhèu ne j'aj'i ana pua-paleha kristus.

source_text: a price has been paid for you, so don't become a slave to anyone.
target_text: kristus tihe pama'ète nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna! de miu baku j'aj'i ènu hia dhèu leo.

source_text: brothers and sisters, remain in the position you were in when you were called, living with god.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ama lamatua paroa nare miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, mamuri miu tasamia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. baku ub'a ia ka. hud'i laa sèmi èèna ka, hia mi lamatua.

source_text: now about people who are not married, i don't have a specific instruction from the lord, so let me give you my opinion as someone who by the lord's mercy is considered trustworthy.
target_text: miu karèi ja'a lula-nèti dhèu kalora iisi dhu j'unu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa. ama lamatua peka boe ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a nèti j'ara èèna. te ngaa miu bisa sèmi ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai, lula ama lamatua pad'elo rasa kasia mi ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: because of the present difficult situation we are in i think it is best to just stay as you are.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi abhu j'aj'èra rupa-rupa. de mamuri dhèu tasa mera mia èèna ka, hud'i laa sèmi èèna. dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: are you already married? don't try to get divorced. are you unmarried? don't look to get married.
target_text: ladhe èu pa'èki dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, baku ia eele ne. ladhe èu dhu pa'èki heka dènge dhèu èmu èu, na, tenge ia ka bhèni leo, sèna ka leo ia ka èmu.

source_text: if you do get married, you haven't sinned. if an unmarried woman gets married, she hasn't sinned. but you will have many troubles in this current world and i would want to spare you these.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èu leo hari èmu, na, èu sala boe ngaa-ngaa. aa ladhe bhèni dhu pa'èci rèdhi mèka dènge dhèu mone leo-èmu, nèngu ad'u-ue boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa sanèd'e, dhèu dhu paleo èmu, bèli-camèd'a paraga dènge j'aj'èra rupa-rupa ètu rai-haha ne. dad'èi ja'a sèna ka miu baku susa sèmi èèna.

source_text: i'm telling you, brothers and sisters, that time is short, and from now on for those who are married it may seem as if they are not married,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! madhutu ngangee ja'a, nuka: lod'o oe èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le. de mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu, mage ladhe dhoka dhèu èmu nèngu di, te ngaa laladhe kahèi asa lamatua.

source_text: and those who weep as if they did not weep, and those that celebrated as if they had not celebrated, and those that bought as if they did not own,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu dhu tangi, be'a risi pa'èra d'ara ho baku tangi, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu karej'e-karae, be'a risi baku karej'e seli, te ngaa laladhe asa ama lamatua. ladhe abhu dhu hèli ngaa-ngaa, be'a risi tao mamuri na nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe unu, sèna ka laladhe asa ama lamatua.

source_text: and those who are engaged with the world as if it is not fulfilling-for the present world order is passing away.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhu pake mèdha-panyau nèti rai-haha ne, be'a risi tao ngi'u na, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri na dhu maena boe mi mèdha-panyau rai-haha ne, sèna ka na laladhe dhoka asa ama lamatua di. lula j'ara mamuri rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele.

source_text: i would prefer you to be free from such worries. a man who is not married pays attention to what is important to the lord, and how he can please the lord.
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu baku pangee ae-ae. te dhèu dhu leo boe èmu, lod'o nèngu ae ho na tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. sèna ka nèngu bisa tenge j'ara ho sab'a pakarej'e d'ara lamatua.

source_text: but a man who is married pays attention to what is important in this world, and how he can please his wife. as a result his loyalties are divided. similarly an unmarried woman or girl pays attention to what is important to the lord, so she may live a life dedicated both in body and spirit. but a married woman pays attention to what is important in this world, and how she can please her husband.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu leo le èmu, hud'i taru kira dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèngu kahèi hud'i taru kira ku mi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu hud'i tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi. j'ara se'e se ka tao ngangee na j'aj'i mi kajari. sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge heka dhèu èmu, aa bhèni kalora iisi. rèngu taru kira dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka bisa mamuri mola-mèci ètu d'ara dènge ngi'u aae. te ngaa bhèni dhu leo le èmu, d'ara na kajari. nèngu taru kira ka mi dad'èi lamatua, te ngaa na tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara dhèu èmu na kahèi.

source_text: i'm telling you this for your benefit. i'm not trying to put a noose around your neck, but to show you the right thing to do so you can serve the lord without being distracted.
target_text: ja'a lole j'ara se'e, sèna ka nèti babe'a hia miu. ja'a ko'o boe ho miu lèke sasii. dad'èi ja'a ka, miu tao dhu lèke, aa tangare asa dad'èi ama lamatua, sèna ka ngangee miu baku kajari.

source_text: but if a man thinks he's behaving improperly with the woman he's engaged to, and if he thinks he will give in to his strong sexual desire, and if he thinks he ought to get married, he is not sinning by getting married.
target_text: ladhe dhèu mone dhu lii d'ai le bhèni dhu d'ai umur paleo èmu, na, hud'i laa ra paleo, ladhe mone ne d'èi heka pamata. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu tao boe j'ara sala. te ladhe ra mate panèbhu, mage dhoka mone èèna taha nare boe d'ara, hèia nèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: but if a man stays true to his principles, and there is no obligation to marry, and if he has the power to keep his feelings under control and stay engaged to her, he does well not to marry.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mone ne bisa taha nare d'ara, nèngu baku laka-seti ho kab'i lai-lai. te ne'a ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao. masi ka nare nèbhu, dènge boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: so the man who marries the woman he's engaged to does well, while the one who does not get married does better.
target_text: de dhèu mone dhu leo dènge bhèni na, èèna be'a. aa dhu leo boe èmu èèna, be'a risi hari.

source_text: a wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. but if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wants in the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu leo le èmu, pa'èki toke madhe dènge dhèu èmu na. te ngaa ladhe dhèu èmu na madhe, nèngu bisa leo hari dènge dhèu mone leo, sad'i mone ne dhèu dhu parcaya kristus kahèi.

source_text: but in my opinion she would be happier if she didn't remarry-and i think i too have the spirit of god when i say this.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a, be'a risi bhèni balu ne, leo ia ka èmu. ja'a pangee, na, lii holo ne cèu nèti roh lamatua dhu ètu d'ara ja'a kahèi.

source_text: now about food sacrificed to idols. so we all have knowledge about this subject. knowledge makes us proud, but love strengthens us.
target_text: ja'a neo lole lula-nèti sisi dhu dhèu pake sogo-tagu nidhu. èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu te'a ae le j'ara se'e. dhu j'aj'i mi lii langu, ka ladhe dhèu ne'a ae, na, nèngu bisa nged'e, te na pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu risi nèti dhèu leo sèra. de be'a risi, èdhi mamuri dènge pasue di. te j'ara pasue ne'e ka tao dhèu aa'i-aa'i asa tabha èra ètu d'ara parcaya ra.

source_text: if anyone thinks they know anything, they don't know as they really should know!
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ne'a mèu, èèna peka na, mamèu nèngu dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: but whoever loves god is known by god.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sue ama lamatua, tatu lamatua tadhe ne. ne'e ka dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: so regarding eating food sacrificed to idols: we know that there are no such things as idols in the world, and that there is only one real god.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu na'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu le mi nidhu, èdhi aa'i-aa'i te'a, na, nèngu dhoka pahaha iisi mi mèdha sogo-tagu ètu rai-haha di, te ngaa pahaha boe iisi mi lamatua dhu lèke. te èdhi te'a, na, abhu dhoka ama lamatua èci di dhu lèke aa, mèdha sogo-tagu aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu sogo-tagu, dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: even though there are some things called gods, whether in heaven or on earth-in fact there are many gods and lords.
target_text: abhu mèdha ae-ae ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne, dhu dhèu peka, na, ‘lamatua rèngu' do aad'o na, ‘kètu rèngu'.

source_text: but for us there is only one god, the father, from whom everything was made, and he is the goal of our existence; and one lord, jesus christ, through whom everything was made, and he is the means of our existence.
target_text: te ngaa bagi èdhi, ama lamatua dhoka èci di. nèngu èèna, ama èdhi. aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti nèngu. aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi tao hia mi nèngu. aa kètu èdhi dhoka èci di, nuka yesus kristus. ama lamatua pake yesus, lod'o na paj'aj'i aa'i-aa'i. aa èdhi mamuri, lula yesus ka dhu hia èdhi.

source_text: but not everyone has this knowledge. some who up to now have been so used to idols as a reality that when they eat food sacrificed to an idol, their conscience which is weak tells them they have defiled themselves.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara se'e. rèngu loe boe pangee mèdha sogo-tagu sèra, hèia ngangee rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ngangee rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, ropa ra'a sisi dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, rèngu pangee, na, nganga'a ne j'aj'i le korban ho pake sogo-tagu nidhu! ladhe ja'a ku'a mèdha ne'e, na, ja'a pa'èki era dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu! de ne'e ne ka dhu pa'ele iie ngangee rèngu, toke rèngu bisa heka unu ngangee madhera, lula d'ara rèngu èra boe.

source_text: but food doesn't gain us god's approval! if we don't eat this food, we're not bad, and if we do eat this food, we're not good.
target_text: nga tao ka sèmi èèna? nganga'a bisa boe nèti èdhi asa madha ama lamatua, si? ladhe ta'a boe, èdhi asa boe bhelu, sina ma? aa ladhe ta'a, tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu be'a, si?

source_text: just take care not to use this freedom you have to eat food sacrificed to idols to become offensive to those with a weaker attitude.
target_text: te ngaa mage-mage! masi ka èu dènge hak sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èci, tatu boe j'ara ne nèti babe'a hia èu. ladhe sèmi abhu a'ari ca dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu tao j'ara èèna, hèia na manahu, na, èèna be'a boe!

source_text: if another believer sees you who have such better knowledge eating food in an idol temple, won't his weak conscience be convinced to eat food sacrificed to idols?
target_text: èu dhu me'a le, j'ara ne j'aj'i boe mi ngaa èci sa. te ngaa ladhe a'ari dhèu parcaya dhu d'ara na èra boe, ladhe nèdhi èu mu'a ètu d'ara èmu sogo-tagu, na pangee sèmi ngaa? tatu na pangee, na, ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a sogo-tagu èèna, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, masi ka nganga'a èèna ra pae'a le nidhu.

source_text: by your better knowledge the weaker believer is destroyed, a believer for whom christ died.
target_text: èu me'a le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa ladhe èu tao sèmi èèna, èu asa paroe d'ara dhèu dhu èra mèka. aa te ngaa dhèu èèna, a'ari èu dhèu parcaya. kristus madhe hia nèngu kahèi!

source_text: in this way you sin against other believers, wounding their weaker consciences, and you sin against christ.
target_text: hua iia pangee sèmi ne'e: ladhe a'ari èu dhu d'ara èra mèka ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu ngangee rèngu sala lula tatao èu, na, èu tao le sasala hia rèngu. aa èu tao sasala mi kristus kahèi.

source_text: so if eating food sacrificed to idols would cause my fellow believer to stumble, i will never eat such meat ever again, so that i don't offend any believer.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a ku'a nganga'a dhu tao a'ari ja'a dhèu parcaya manahu asa d'ara sasala, be'a risi ja'a baku ku'a sisi sèmi sèra, toke d'ai ja'a madhe. te ja'a ko'o boe rèngu manahu asa d'ara sasala.

source_text: am i not free? am i not an apostle? haven't i seen jesus our lord? aren't you the results of my work in the lord?
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a dènge boe hak ho suri sèmi ne'e hia miu. te ama lamatua pua ja'a laku lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a dhu kèdhi le kètu èdhi, yesus èèna. ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne. hèia miu aa'i-aa'i parcaya nèngu kahèi, lula sasab'a-la'a ja'a ne.

source_text: even if i'm not an apostle to others, at least i am one to you. the proof of my being an apostle of the lord is you!
target_text: masi ka dhèu leo ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, te ngaa tatu miu me'a, na, lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a dhiu peka-padhai lii moa na asa miu. ladhe miu neo me'a mèu, na, lee mamuri miu di. te miu dhu pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus!

source_text: here is my reply to those who question me about this:
target_text: ja'a neo dhaa mi dhèu dhu pèci sasala mi dedha ja'a, sèmi ne'e:

source_text: don't we have the right to be provided with food and drink?
target_text: miu ngee, na, ja'a dènge barnabas dènge boe hak ho abhu nganga'a-nganginu nèti dhèu dhu ji'i aj'a-nori si, do?

source_text: don't we have a right to be accompanied by a christian wife, like the rest of the apostles, the lord's brothers, and peter?
target_text: miu pangee, na, ji'i dènge boe hak ho leo dènge dhèu bhèni kristen, dhu la'a sama-sama pakako sasab'a lamatua ètu era leo, do? madhutu iia-iia na, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhu leo sèra, rèti kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. ari lamatua yesus sèra tao sèmi èèna. petrus mesa na sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: is it only barnabas and myself who have to work to support ourselves?
target_text: do, miu ngee na, dhoka ja'a dènge barnabas di dhu hud'i sab'a tenge doi-dhari, sèna ka bisa mamuri ho aj'a-nori dhèu?

source_text: which soldier ever had to pay his own salary? who plants a vineyard and doesn't get to eat its fruits? who feeds a flock and doesn't consume its milk?
target_text: ngangee miu sèmi èèna, mai nèti mia? ladhe sèku sordad'u sèra. rèngu pusi boe hèli nganga'a-nganginu dènge mèdha-papake. ladhe sèku dhèu sab'a ètu oka anggor. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kai, peka na, èu baku mu'a hua anggor sèra! aa ladhe sèku dhèu madhenga badha. dhèu ne dènge hak ho nare susu nèti kahib'i-kalèbho dhu nèngu j'aga.

source_text: am i just speaking from a human point of view? doesn't the law say the same thing?
target_text: ja'a padhai lii ne madhutu boe ngangee ja'a dhèu rai-haha ne. te atora sèra nèti ama lamatua dhu peka sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: in the law of moses it's written, don't muzzle the ox when it's threshing out the grain. was god just thinking about oxen?
target_text: ètu atora musa, dhu suri peka na, ropa sapi j'èli are ho hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, baku kape hèb'a na, sèna ka bisa na'a. miu pangee, na, lamatua soro tèke sèna ka dhoka sapi di dhu bisa na'a, do?

source_text: wasn't he directing this at us? surely this was written for us-for anyone who plows should plow in hope and anyone who threshes should hope to share in the harvest. if we sowed what is spiritual with you, does it really matter if we reap some material benefit?
target_text: aad'o! lamatua peka na, nèngu taru kira èdhi kahèi. te dhu suri tèke, peka na, dhèu dhu kabèli rai, aa dhèu dhu hag'e eele lamusi nèti huri na, ropa ra sab'a, rèngu re'a kahèi, èèna na abhu pala ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, be'a risi dhèu pajuu-paleha dhèu kristen sèra, bisa abhu pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra ra. te lod'o ji'i aj'a-nori miu j'ara-j'ara nèti roh lamatua èèna, ji'i nuka sèmi ca dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe dhu sèle hini. de lod'o ji'i aj'a ngare, ladhe ji'i abhu nganga'a-nganginu do ngaa hari nèti miu, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te j'ara na sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: if others exercise this right over you, don't we deserve it even more? even so we did not exercise this right. on the contrary we would rather put up with anything than hold back the gospel of christ.
target_text: dhèu leo dhu aj'a-nori miu, dènge hak sèna ka abhu dhua-èi dènge mèdha-panyau nèti miu, si? aa ji'i tasamia? ji'i dènge hak risi eele nèti rèngu! te ngaa miu me'a le. ji'i se pake ngèdhi boe hak ho laka-seti miu. ji'i pa'èra ètu rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka baku magee miu. te, dènge j'ara ne'e, miu d'èi nanene lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu ji'i peka-padhai dènge miu.

source_text: don't you know that those who work in temples receive their meals from temple offerings, and those who serve at the altar receive their portion of the sacrifice on the altar?
target_text: pangee ku laa! ama-ama agama dhu sab'a ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, mamuri nèti persembahan dhu dhèu rèti. aa dhèu dhu sab'a ètu mei korban, ra'a sisi nèti badha dhu dhèu rèti.

source_text: in just the same way the lord ordered that those who announce the good news should live from supporters of the good news.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua dhu moa, na, dhèu dhu sasab'a ra peka-padhai lii lolo be'a kristus, rèngu bisa mamuri nèti rui-j'aj'èra nèti sasab'a-la'a ra. dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: but i have not made use of any of these provisions, and i'm not writing about this to suggest it should be done in my case. i'd rather die than to have anyone take away my pride in not having received any benefit.
target_text: masi ka ja'a dènge hak ho mamuri sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a d'èi boe tao sèmi èèna. ja'a suri boe sasuri ne sèna ka miu hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, ja'a pakako sasab'a lamatua hia miu, te ngaa manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa nèti miu. de hua iia risi ja'a madhe, ladhe dhèu pangee, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti miu.

source_text: i have nothing to boast about in sharing the good news because it's something i feel compelled to do. in fact it's dreadful for me if i don't share the good news!
target_text: masi ka ja'a lole taruu dènge dhèu lula-nèti lii lolo be'a lamatua, te ngaa èèna j'aj'i boe mi ngaa sa èci, dhu ja'a bisa padedha iisi. ja'a hud'i lole ku dènge dhèu lula-nèti lamatua, te lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a sèmi èèna. ladhe ja'a sab'a boe madhutu sasab'a ja'a, na dui kore j'aj'èra! te tatu pasae kore hahuku.

source_text: if i'm doing this work because of my own choice, then i have a reward. but if it wasn't my choice, and an obligation was placed on me,
target_text: ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne lula madhutu dhoka dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, na, ngaa dhu ja'a abhu sèra, nuka sèmi gaji dhu dhèu sab'a sèra abhu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a sab'a sasab'a ne, lula lamatua pua ja'a, èèna leo. te lamatua lèka ja'a ho j'aga mèdha-panyau na dhu kab'ua.

source_text: then what reward do i have? it's the opportunity to share the good news without charging for it, not demanding my rights as a worker for the good news.
target_text: de ladhe sèmi èèna, upa ja'a ngaa? ja'a parluu boe gaji. ja'a padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu manèngi boe ngaa-ngaa. ne'e ka dhu tao ja'a karae, nuka sèmi ja'a abhu le upa. de masi ka ja'a unu rupa-rupa hak, nuka sèmi dhèu leo dhu sasab'a ra padhue-padhai lii lolo be'a èèna, te ngaa ja'a pake aa'i boe hak sèra.

source_text: even though i am free and serve no one, i have placed myself in service to everyone so that i might gain more.
