source_text: this is what is good, and what pleases god our savior.
target_text: manèngi-mangaj'i sèmi èèna ka dhu be'a. j'ara ne'e ne ka pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, dhu hia èdhi mamuri.

source_text: he wants everyone to be saved, and come to understand what truth really is.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu mamuri, aa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. nuka sèmi:

source_text: for there is one god, and one mediator of god and mankind-the man christ jesus.
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, dhoka èci di. aa kalete dhoka èci di dhu padame èdhi dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua, nuka, yesus kristus. aa yesus tare'a-re'a dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: he gave himself so we could all be won back, demonstrating the evidence at the right time.
target_text: na soro iisi na, ho sui èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi. lèke dènge lod'o na, ka ama lamatua bhoke le pasaraa lii lolo be'a èèna hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: i was appointed to share this message and be its messenger, a teacher to the foreigners about trusting god and the truth i'm not lying, i'm telling the truth!
target_text: hèia ama lamatua hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na, sèna ka laku peka-padhai dènge dhèu yahudi boe ètu mia-mia, aa nori si sèna ka ra parcaya lamatua yesus, dènge mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna. ja'a leko-monya boe.

source_text: what i really want is for men everywhere to pray sincerely to god. no anger or arguments!
target_text: dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ètu mia-mia miu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i, hud'i dènge ku d'ara dhu mola-mèci. baku panasa. baku patao-palaha. ladhe sabaj'a, bisa ded'e kacui-aai asa ama lamatua, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, d'ara miu mola-mèci tare'a-re'a.

source_text: in the same way, women should dress sensibly, modestly, and appropriately. they should be attractive not in their hairstyle or by wearing gold or pearls or expensive clothes, but by the good things they do-as is appropriate for women who claim to follow god.
target_text: dad'èi ja'a kahèi ladhe dhèu-dhèu bhèni re'a lalau iisi ra pake mèdha-papake dhu pantas. dhu tao bhèni j'aj'i bhèni iia, lula boe nèti pasaraga rèu kètu, do pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu nèti makae, do pake risi eele mèdha hualaa, doi pudhi dènge mutiara. te dhu tao bhèni sèra j'aj'i bhèni iia, nuka d'ara dhu hua iia, aa rèngu tao dhoka j'ara dhu be'a. èèna ka pamèci dènge dhèu bhèni dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: women should learn quietly, respecting their place.
target_text: ladhe dhèu sarani pakaboko ho nanene lii holo-nori, na, bhèni sa kahèi madhutu atora, sèna ka pasa dhilu ra be'a-be'a ho nanene lii holo-nori dènge d'ara kateme. baku pagagai sèna ka tao maruru.

source_text: i don't allow women to be instructors, or to dominate men; let them remain quiet.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, lèke boe ladhe dhèu bhèni ded'e ngi'u ra ho paredha aa aj'a dhèu mone. be'a risi bhèni sèra taha d'ara.

source_text: for adam was made first, and then eve.
target_text: te ama lamatua paj'aj'i uuru adam, heka hawa kèna.

source_text: adam wasn't deceived, but eve was completely deceived, and she fell into sin.
target_text: aa adam dhu uru boe lèke ag'o nèti dhèu aae nidhu, te ngaa dhèu bhèni. karèi nèti lod'o èèna, dhèu rai-haha mulai lab'a paredha ama lamatua.

source_text: however, women will be saved through becoming mothers, as long as they continue to trust and love, and to live holy, sensible lives.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu bhèni abhu mamuri lula rèngu rara iisi ana. sad'i rèngu parcaya tare'a-re'a mi kristus, mamuri pasue, mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, aa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: this is a trustworthy statement: if someone aspires to be an elder, this is a good work to want to do.
target_text: mema tare'a sèmi lii dhèu, dhu peka na, dhèu dhu neo j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hag'e nare le sasab'a èci dhu hua iia titu kèna.

source_text: an elder must be above reproach, married to one wife, self-controlled, well-balanced, sensible, hospitable, and able to teach.
target_text: kètu juma'at èèna, hud'i dhèu dhu kolongara be'a. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu hud'i taha nare d'ara na, dhèu dhu patao-palaha boe, dhu dhèu pakab'ua ne, dhu d'èi bhoke babèdho èmu ho dhèu lasi pangad'o dènge ne, aa bisa aj'a-nori dhèu leo.

source_text: he should be someone who doesn't get drunk or become violent, but is gentle, and is not argumentative or greedy for money.
target_text: baku dhèu dhu tema mahu, baku dhèu dhu nasa dènge kacui-aai malai. dhu lèke ka, dhèu dhu d'ara hua iia, dhu d'èi tenge dame, aa dhu manga'a boe doi-dhari.

source_text: he must handle his own family well. his children must respect what he tells them to do.
target_text: nèngu hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na dènge be'a. ana-ana na re'a pakab'ua dènge d'èi nanene ne.

source_text: for if a man doesn't know how to manage his own family, how can he manage god's church?
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èèna ne'a boe lalau-lalo'o d'ara èmu na, na, tasa mera mia nèngu bisa ladhe-leru juma'at lamatua.

source_text: he should not be a new believer, in case he gets so full of himself that he falls under the same condemnation as the devil.
target_text: be'a risi, pili dhèu dhu mamuri palèke dènge dad'èi kristus. de baku ded'e kètu juma'at nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu mèka mi yesus. te èèna na, rèngu sèra bisa padedha iisi malai. mage dhoka lamatua huku si, sama sèmi lamatua huku dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: people outside the church should also speak well of him so that he won't disgrace himself and fall into the devil's trap.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i dhèu dhu rai lesa re'a pakab'ua ne kahèi. dènge sèmi èèna nèngu makae boe. aa dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe pabèbhe ne kahèi.

source_text: similarly deacons should be respected, and not be hypocritical. they should not be addicted to drink, and should not be trying to dishonestly enrich themselves.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at. rèngu sèra hud'i dhèu dhu dènge kolongara be'a, dhèu dhu he'o kajari boe, dhu tema boe rinu mahu, aa dhu d'èi boe ra'e a'oto ae-ae.

source_text: they must stick to the revealed truth about god, trusting in him with a pure conscience.
target_text: d'ara rèngu hud'i mola-mèci, aa rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra ku lii holo-nori dhu lamatua bhoke pasaraa hia èdhi, dhèu parcaya se'e.

source_text: they should be tried out first, and if they can't be faulted then let them serve as deacons.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie mamuri dènge sasab'a ra. ladhe abhu boe sasala si, heka ded'e si ho soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra.

source_text: their wives should be respected too. they should not slander people with gossip, and they should be self-controlled and trustworthy in all they do.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu èmu ra. rèngu sèra hud'i bhèni dhu mamuri madhutu madha j'ara dènge tatao dhu be'a. mage dhèu dhu tema padhai-kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo. rèngu hud'i dhèu dhu re'a taha rare d'ara, aa dhèu lèka si kahèi.

source_text: deacons should be married to one wife, managing their children and their homes well.
target_text: aa dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra hud'i mone dhu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. nèngu èèna hud'i ne'a uri d'ara èmu na, aa uri ana-ana na dènge be'a.

source_text: those who serve well as deacons gain a good reputation and much confidence in their trust in christ jesus.
target_text: rèngu dhu lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani dènge be'a, tatu dhèu asa pakab'ua si. aa rèngu asa bani, dènge boe madha'u lole parcaya rèngu mi yesus kristus.

source_text: even though i hope to see you soon, i'm writing about all this to you so that if i'm delayed you'll know how people should behave themselves in god's house. this is the church of the living god, the support pillar and foundation of the truth.
target_text: timotius! ja'a sanao sèna ka nèbhu boe ja'a dhiu ngad'o èu. ladhe ja'a pakai, do ako nena ciki, na, ele boe sasuri ne d'ai uuru èu. sasuri ne ja'a suri ho peka dènge èu, na, dhèu unu lamatua sèra hud'i ra mamuri tasa mera mia ku. baku bhèlu, peka na, lamatua èèna, ama lamatua dhu mamuri. dhèu unu na nuka sèmi èmu dhu dènge era padhèdi, aa dènge agarii talora dhu èra. èmu sèmi èèna ka dhu titu èra, sama sèmi dhèu unu lamatua dhu kèpe pa'èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tare'a, aa rèngu bisa bara ho pakako dènge be'a.

source_text: there's no question about it: the revealed truth about god is amazing! he was made known to us in human form, he was vindicated by the spirit, seen by angels, declared to the nations, trusted in by the world, and taken up in glory!
target_text: lamatua pasabhoka le rahasia dhu kapai nèti lalèka èdhi. kapua na sèmi ne'e ka: kristus èèna, ca dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka. aa kristus èèna mai le asa rai-haha ne, pake rupa dhèu rai-haha sèmi èdhi. roh lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i sakasii, peka na, yesus èèna, nuka kristus. aa ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra rèdhi na kahèi. ama lamatua dhu ded'e nèti le asa sorga, ka nedhe padedha-dedha ne. lii lolo na pale-lème le suku-suku ètu rai-haha ne. ètu mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i parcaya le nèngu. kapua lalèka èdhi sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: however, the spirit very clearly explains that in the last times some will abandon their trust in god, and will listen to deceptive spirits and beliefs that come from demons.
target_text: te ngaa ne'e ne, roh ama lamatua dhu peka paled'a le, na, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani cahag'e patalale eele ngaa dhu èdhi parcaya. ho lasi madhutu roh-roh dhu sala aa dhu leko-monya, aa lasi madhutu lii holo-nori nidhu bhelu sèra.

source_text: these hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared,
target_text: dhèu dhu mai nori sèmi sèra, padhai lii leo, tao leo. dhèu sèra mema dhèu dhu kapod'e-kabèli! dhèu sèra sa, d'ara iiki ra dhu bèdhu le.

source_text: tell people to not marry and not to eat certain foods made by god that should be accepted with thanks by those who trust and know the truth.
target_text: ra aj'a dhèu, baku paleo èmu. aa ra aj'a dhèu luri rupa-rupa nganga'a. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao nganga'a-nganginu sèra, ho ladhe dhèu parcaya ra'a, rèngu manèngi makasi mi nèngu. te rèngu re'a mia dhu lèke.

source_text: everything created by god is good, and nothing should be rejected but should be received with thanks,
target_text: ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua tao sèra, tare'a-re'a be'a. de baku luri rupa-rupa. dhèu hud'i sèmi rare aa'i-aa'i sèra dènge manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: since it is made sacred by the word of god and by prayer.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi sèra ka pamèu si.

source_text: if you point out these things to the brothers and sisters you will be a good minister of christ jesus. you gain strength by trusting in the truth, and in the good teaching you've followed.
target_text: timotius! pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, èu j'aj'i dhèu sab'a dhu be'a nèti yesus kristus. lii holo-nori ama lamatua sèra ka dhu tao èu parcaya ne, aa hia me'a mèu, mia ka lii holo-nori dhu lèke. èu kèpe pa'èra-èra le lii holo-nori lamatua sèra! sèra nuka sèmi nganga'a dhu pa'èra ngi'u èu.

source_text: reject what is irreligious, and old wives' tales. make sure your exercise is spiritual-
target_text: baku core eele lod'o iia d'ara dènge palolo omo koso dhu lèke boe dènge dad'èi ama lamatua. baku pusi-pahae dènge lii lolo bhèni heka dhu nèti laluri rupa-rupa. be'a risi pa'èra taruu ngi'u dènge d'ara èu pabe'a-be'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: for while physical exercise is useful to some extent, spiritual exercise is much more useful. for it has promise for the present life, and for the life to come.
target_text: olaraga pa'èra ngi'u na, be'a. masi ka babe'a na ciki oo'e di. te ngaa pa'èra ngi'u dènge d'ara ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra, babe'a na ae seli eele. babe'a na mesa boe mamuri ètu rai-haha deo ne'e di, te ngaa mamuri lèpa limuri kahèi.

source_text: you can trust this saying that should be accepted by everyone.
target_text: lii se'e se, lèke tare'a-re'a! de tèke paie mi d'ara, ho baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: the reason we work and do the best we can is because our hope is in the living god. he is the savior of all people, especially of those who trust in him.
target_text: èdhi tao era maena mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri. nèngu na ka dhu hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i, risi-risi mi èdhi dhu parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi sab'a dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: this is what you should teach. tell everyone to follow your instructions.
target_text: nori lii se'e aa'i-aa'i. aa pua dhèu sèra ho madhutu lii holo-nori sèra.

source_text: don't let anyone look down on you because you are young. be an example to those who trust in god-in the way you speak, the kind of life you live, in love, in trust, and in purity.
target_text: baku soro tèka dhèu sèra pahae boe èu, lula èu ana ngèru era. èu hud'i j'aj'i conto hia dhèu parcaya sèra, nèti lii padhai èu, nèti kakako èu, nèti d'ara sasue èu mi dedha dhèu, nèti parcaya èu mi yesus kristus, dènge mamuri èu dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: until i get there, make sure you read the scriptures to the church, and encourage them by your speaking and teaching.
target_text: ètu d'ara miu tatae mamai ja'a, baku bhèlu baca lii holo-nori lamatua hia mi dhèu parcaya sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, aa nori si paie-iie.

source_text: don't neglect the gracious gift you have that was given to you by prophetic inspiration when the church elders laid their hands on you.
target_text: pake pabe'a-be'a karunya dhu lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu, dhu èu sèmi lod'o kètu-kètu juma'at sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha kètu èu. lod'o èèna, rèngu peka lii moa lamatua kahèi lula-nèti j'ara mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu. de baku soro tèke karunya dhu èu abhu èèna.

source_text: think carefully about these things, and dedicate yourself completely to them so that everyone can see the progress you're making.
target_text: pakako dènge maj'èni j'ara sèra. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi mamuri dènge sab'a-la'a èu asa be'a.

source_text: mind what you're doing and what you're teaching. keep going with all of this, because as you do so you'll save both yourself and those who listen to you.
target_text: j'aga sèna ka èu mamuri dènge mola. aa j'aga sèna ka èu loe boe aj'a dhu lèke j'ara. ladhe èu pa'èra dènge j'ara sèra, pe lamatua bhoke j'ara hia èu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai èu, sèna ka miu pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: don't rebuke a man who is older than you. instead, encourage him as if he were your father. treat younger men as brothers,
target_text: baku tao lii sakaa dènge dhèu mone dhu heka risi nèti èu. te ngaa dènge lii mako, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ama mu. aa mi dhèu dhu ngèru risi, pa'èra d'ara si, tao nuka sèmi ari mu.

source_text: older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, with the highest standards of decency.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu bhèni dhu heka risi sèra. padhai lii dènge rèngu, nuka sèmi èu padhai lii dènge ina mu. aa ladhe padhai lii dènge ana bhèni ngèru, tao si nuka sèmi ana hèni èu. d'ara èu hud'i mola dènge si.

source_text: help widows who don't have a family. for the christian responsibility of a widow's children or grandchildren is to do their duty for their own family, and repay their parents by helping them out. this is what pleases god. now a real widow, having no family, alone and without support, puts her hope in god and prays for help night and day.
target_text: dhèu sarani hud'i soru-bara bhèni balu dhu dènge heka a'ari sèna ka ladhe-leru si. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu ana-èpu era, na, rèngu ka dhu hud'i ladhe-leru ne. aj'a si, sèna ka re'a b'ala sasue ina ra dhu rèngu abhu sèra. dènge sèmi èèna ka, rèngu sab'a hia ama lamatua, ho pakarej'e d'ara na. te ngaa bhèni balu dhu tare'a-re'a mamuri mesa di, nèngu dènge boe ca dhèu sa dhu ladhe-leru ne. nèngu dhoka maena mi ama lamatua di. mèu-mèda na manèngi sasue ama lamatua. dhèu sarani hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu sèmi sèra sa.

source_text: but a widow who concentrates on pleasing herself is already dead, even though she's still physically alive.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni balu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri na karej'e-karae di, masi ka na mamuri era, te ngaa dènge heka kab'ua, sama sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: give people these instructions so that they will be above criticism.
target_text: pasanèd'e j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i mi dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka dhèu leo baku pa'ele iie kolongara rèngu.

source_text: but those who don't look after their relatives, especially their own family, have denied their beliefs, and are worse than those who don't believe.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu ro'o boe ladhe-leru a'ari na, risi-risi hari isi èmu na, èèna sama sèmi nèngu pèci eele lalèka nèngu mi lamatua. nèngu bhelu risi nèti dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: only widows over sixty who have been faithful to their husbands should be put on the list.
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e bhèni balu ho soru-bara kètu juma'at, j'ara na sèmi ne'e ka: umur nèngu bisa boe kura nèti 60 tèu; uru na nèngu satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di;

source_text: the widow should have a reputation for doing good. did she bring up children properly? has she been hospitable? has she washed the feet of church members? has she helped those who were in trouble? has she really tried to do good in every way?
target_text: dhèu re'a, na, nèngu ca dhèu dhu tema tao babe'a mi dhèu; dhu ladhe-leru ana-ana na dènge be'a; dhu bhoke tèke kacui-aai ho leru dhèu leo; dhu soru-bara dhèu parcaya sèra ètu d'ara sasab'a, masi ka dhu samaa èèna ka; dhu d'èi soru dhèu ètu d'ara sasusa; aa dhu bhori mema ho soru-bara ètu madha j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: don't take on widows who are younger, because when their physical desires make them want to remarry they abandon their dedication to christ.
target_text: baku pili bhèni balu dhu ngèru era, ho sab'a ètu d'ara juma'at. te mage dhoka cèu ètu d'ara na, ho neo hari leo-èmu. ladhe sèmi èèna, rèngu se abhu heka lod'o dhu taleo, ho lalau dhèu sarani dènge be'a.

source_text: in this they are guilty of breaking their previous commitment.
target_text: te ladhe lod'o dhu rèngu pake hia juma'at èèna kura, èci èèna ka dènge rèngu pa'ele iie lii pajaji rèngu ètu katanga madha lamatua. èèna na, dhèu pasala si.

source_text: they also get used to a lazy life, just visiting each other in their homes. not only lazy, but they gossip and meddle, talking about things they shouldn't.
target_text: mage dhoka rèngu bai-eed'a, aa maso-kalua èmu dhèu, padhai-kaked'u pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. aa dhu karehe risi eele hari, rèngu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhèu leo, dènge padhai dhu lèke boe.

source_text: so my best advice is that younger widows marry and have children and take care of the home. that way there's no opportunity for criticism from the enemy.
target_text: be'a risi eele, bhèni balu dhu ngèru era leo hari èmu, sèna ka rara iisi, aa ladhe-leru d'ara èmu rèngu. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu dhu pamusu dènge èdhi abhu boe j'ara ho pa'ele iie kolongara èdhi.

source_text: however, some have already gone the way of satan.
target_text: abhu bhèni balu ngèru cahag'e dhu kako sala j'ara. rèngu se madhutu j'ara dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: any christian woman who has widows in the family should help them, so that the church is not burdened with the responsibility, and can help those widows who are truly in need.
target_text: ladhe abhu bhèni dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu a'ari ra j'aj'i le bhèni balu, na, bhèni ne hud'i ladhe-leru ku bhèni balu èèna. baku soro tèke hia juma'at ladhe-leru. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna juma'at bisa ladhe-leru bhèni balu dhu leo, dhu tare'a-re'a dènge heka a'ari.

source_text: elders who direct the church well should be seen as doubly valuable, particularly those who work in speaking the word and in teaching.
target_text: dhèu dhu ladhe-leru juma'at dènge be'a, miu hud'i pakab'ua risi ne, aa b'ae gaji dènge be'a. risi-risi rèngu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara kateme, ho lole pataraa lii holo-nori lamatua, aa aj'a j'ara mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: as scripture says, don't muzzle the ox when it's threshing out the grain. also, the worker deserves to be paid.
target_text: te dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, ladhe pake sapi j'èli puru are nèti huri, mage mi kape hèb'a na kahèi, sèna ka bisa na'a. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, cee ka dhu sab'a, na, nèngu hud'i abhu gaji ku.

source_text: don't entertain any accusation against an elder unless two or three witnesses support it.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu galaa kètu juma'at, baku sad'i sèmi mere di! hud'i abhu ku dua do tèlu sakasii dhu lii èci, heka mi sèmi mere ho parisa ne.

source_text: censure those who sin in front of everyone as a warning to others as well.
target_text: ladhe miu kai ne, te ngaa na mamuri taruu madhutu d'ara sasala èèna, kai hari ne ètu madha juma'at. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, dhèu leo bani boe madhutu tatao èèna.

source_text: before god and christ jesus, and the holy angels, i instruct you to follow these instructions without bias. don't do anything from an attitude of favoritism.
target_text: pakako aa'i atora se'e mi juma'at dhu hag'e boe, aa baku bia cabèka. ja'a pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi d'ara kacui-aai èu, ètu katanga madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus. ana pajuu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ètu sorga, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi!

source_text: don't be in a hurry to lay hands on anyone; and don't get involved in the sins of others. keep yourself pure.
target_text: baku pamèri ded'e dhèu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. ladhe uuru ku paie-iie ne. te ladhe miu ded'e sad'i ngara di, hèia dhèu ne tao sala, na, miu pasae sasala èèna kahèi, lula tatao na. j'aga paie ngi'u èu sèna ka mamuri mola taruu.

source_text: don't just drink water, but use a little bit of wine because of your bad stomach-you're sick so often!
target_text: ja'a tadèngi èu kabake pèd'a taruu. be'a risi nèti deo ne'e, èu pab'ali èi dènge anggor ciki tao sèmi èi na'i. baku minu dhoka èi iia di.

source_text: the sins of some people are really obvious, and they are clearly guilty, but the sins of others are not seen until later.
target_text: ladhe paie-iie! abhu sasala dhèu dhu cèu mema. rèngu d'ai mèka madha hakim, te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a le èèna. te ngaa abhu dhèu leo kahèi dhu nèbhu-nèbhu ku, heka sasala ra cèu kèna.

source_text: similarly some good works are obvious, and even those that are hidden won't be for long.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu tao be'a sèra. abhu mema dhu led'a. te ngaa cahag'e pahuni-pahuni tao dhu be'a. te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, nèbhu-nèbhu cèu asa li'u kahèi. bisa boe pahuni tatao dhu be'a.

source_text: all who are bound under slavery should consider their masters worthy of respect, so that god's name and christian beliefs won't be defamed.
target_text: abhu lamatua dhu ènu na parcaya lamatua yesus. rèngu hud'i pakab'ua lamatua ra, sèna ka dhèu leo abhu boe j'ara ho padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, aa pamud'e dènge lii aj'a-nori èdhi.

source_text: slaves who have christian masters should not disrespect them because they are brothers. instead they should serve them even better, because those who are benefiting from their service are fellow-believers they should love. teach these instructions, and encourage people to follow them.
target_text: abhu ènu dhu lamatua na parcaya le lamatua yesus. ènu ne bisa boe pahaha lamatua na, lula lamatua na dhu parcaya lamatua yesus. masi ka tasamia èèna ka, rèngu hud'i lalau ku pabe'a risi hari lamatua ra, lula rèngu dènge rèngu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dhèu parcaya dhu hud'i mamuri pasue ku. timotius! aj'a aa'i-aa'i se, aa pa'èra d'ara dhèu sarani sèra, sèna ka tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: those who teach different beliefs, and don't listen to good counsel, particularly the words of our lord jesus christ and the true teachings of god,
target_text: lii aj'a-nori èdhi dhu lèke èèna, j'aj'i kapua nèti d'ara mamuri èdhi dhu pakarej'e d'ara lamatua. te ngaa dhèu dhu nori leo nèti lii aj'a se'e, dhèu sèra dhu core eele le lii lamatua yesus kristus dhu lèke.

source_text: are arrogant and don't understand anything. they're obsessed with speculation and philosophical debates which only lead to jealousy, arguments, malicious gossip and evil suspicions-
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, padedha iisi, te ngaa goa. papèd'a rèngu ka d'èi dhoka tenge lii langu, aa pab'ala d'ara lii. j'ara se'e se ka dhu tao dhèu ho: tèka d'ara, patao-palaha, pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu leo, aa pangee dhu lèke boe mi dhèu leo.

source_text: the constant arguing of people whose minds are totally corrupt and who have lost the truth, thinking that they can profit financially from religion…
target_text: dhèu sèmi se'e, loe boe patao-palaha. ngangee ra karehe bia. re'a heka mia ka dhu be'a. rèngu ngee, ladhe rèngu maj'èni dènge j'ara-j'ara agama, rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu kaja-su'i.

source_text: but knowing and following god is so incredibly satisfying!
target_text: mema, agama bisa hia a'oto mi dhèu. te mamuri dènge lamatua èèna ka dhu hia dhèu karej'e nèti ngaa dhu rèngu unu. èèna, heka agama dhu lèke kèna.

source_text: for we didn't bring anything into the world, and we can't take anything out with us either.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! lod'o rara iisi èdhi, èdhi tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa asa rai-haha ne. aa ladhe lod'o madhe, tèti boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa kahèi nèti rai-haha ne.

source_text: but if we have food and clothes then that's enough for us.
target_text: de sad'i dènge nganga'a, mèdha-papake sèra sa nia le!

source_text: those who are determined to become rich fall into the trap of temptation, following many foolish and damaging impulses.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu neo kaja, mud'a titu kèna lèke dadugu-rariu rupa-rupa, aa lèke sasii g'ana-kariu, lula rèngu pangee dhoka mèdha-panyau di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pa'ele iie mamuri rèngu.

source_text: for the desire to be rich leads to many kinds of evil results. some of those who longed for this have turned away from the truth, and have hurt themselves, experiencing a lot of pain.
target_text: te sue doi-dhari, èèna j'aj'i mi amo nèti rupa-rupa bhabhelu. abhu dhèu cahag'e magèle dhoka doi-dhari di, toke ra pakaj'èu nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke. hèia rèngu mesa ra pa'ele iie mamuri ra.

source_text: but you as a man of god should run away from such things. you should seek to do what is right, practice true religion, and trust in god. aim to love, to be patient, and gentle.
target_text: timotius! èu ne, dhèu unu ama lamatua. de pakaj'èu iisi nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i. mamuri mola-mèci. mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. parcaya taruu mi yesus kristus. sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. mamuri d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: fight the good fight as you trust in god. hold on tightly to the eternal life to which you were called. this is what you promised to do in front of many witnesses.
target_text: sab'a pa'èra-èra dènge d'ara kateme, sèna ka pakako lii holo-nori aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi parcaya. lamatua paroa le èu, ho abhu mamuri taa-taa. de liku pa'èra-èra mamuri èèna, baku patalale eele. aa èu dhu peka le ètu madha dhèu ae, lula-nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus.

source_text: my charge to you before god the life-giver, and before christ jesus who testified to the good news before pontius pilate, is to follow faithfully what you've been told so you will be above criticism until our lord jesus christ appears.
target_text: de nèti deo ne'e, ja'a manèngi èu pa'èki lii pajaji sèmi ne'e: tao madhutu lii paredha aa'i-aa'i nèti lamatua yesus. baku sisu èci sa hèi, sèna ka dhèu baku rèdhi sasala èu. tao madhutu aa'i-aa'i ra dènge mola-mola toke lod'o mamai hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha ama lamatua. nèngu ka dhu hia le samanga mi dhu mamuri aa'i-aa'i ra. ja'a manèngi kahèi èu jaji sèmi èèna ètu madha yesus kristus. nèngu dhu peka paled'a le, lula-nèti ngi'u nèngu, ètu madha gubernur pontius pilatus.

source_text: at the right time jesus will be revealed-he who is the blessed and only sovereign, the king of kings, and lord of lords.
target_text: lamatua yesus dhu kapai risi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u koasa! nèngu èèna, dhèu aae kapai nèti dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ra. aa nèngu èèna, lamatua kapai nèti lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra. ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua paled'a aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: he is the only one who is immortal, and lives in unapproachable light. no one has seen him or can see him-honor and eternal power is his! amen.
target_text: dhoka nèngu mesa na di, dhu madhe boe. nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa dhu dhèu rai-haha taha boe laladhe. abhu boe dhèu èci sa ladhe rèdhi ne. lii-lii pakab'ua dhodhoka mi nèngu di! koasa aa'i-aa'i, ètu kacui-aai na, toke d'ai mia-mia! d'ai sange ne'e ka! tare'a!

source_text: warn those who are rich in the present world not to become proud. tell them not to place their trust in wealth that is so insecure but in god who so freely gives us everything for our enjoyment.
target_text: peka mi dhèu kaja ètu rai-haha ne, ho rèngu baku padedha iisi, aa baku dhoka maena mèdha-panyau rèngu di. te mèdha-panyau sèra, bèli-camèd'a èla aa'i. de dhu lèke ka, maena dhoka mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri di. te nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi èdhi ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka èdhi mamuri dènge karej'e.

source_text: tell them to do good, and to become rich in doing good things, ready to share what they have, and to be generous.
target_text: peka dènge ra, ho pake kakaja sèra sèna ka tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a. rèngu hud'i bhoke kacui-aai ho soru-bara dhèu leo, aa d'èi pala-bagi mèngi-nale dhu rèngu abhu nèti lamatua.

source_text: in this way they store up treasure that will provide a solid basis for the future, so that they can take hold of true life.
target_text: hèia ra pakaboko mèdha-panyau ho j'aj'i mi kapua dhu èra, hia mamuri ra bèli-camèd'a. ka rèngu unu mamuri dhu dènge kab'ua.

source_text: timothy, take care of what's been given to you. don't pay any attention to pointless chatter and arguments based on so-called knowledge.
target_text: timotius! j'aga paie aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua pangèd'u le mi èu. baku lamu padhai lii dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. baku padhai lii kaj'alu dhu pakab'ua boe ama lamatua. sanèd'e, ee! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ‘mamèu' rèngu sèra dhu hèb'a hua. baku lamu pab'ala lii padhai dènge ra.

source_text: some who promote these ideas have wandered away from their trust in god. may grace be with you.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e lèka lii aj'a-nori dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, toke ra sero eele nèti parcaya ra dhu lèke mi ama lamatua. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èu dènge angalai mu si aa'i-aa'i ra. saloom, paulus

source_text: this letter comes from paul, an apostle of christ jesus chosen by god, sent to tell about the promise of real life that is in christ jesus. i'm sending it to you timothy, my dear son. may you have grace, mercy, and peace from god the father and christ jesus our lord.
target_text: timotius dhu be'a! sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus, dhu ama lamatua mesa na hag'e nare j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ra pua ja'a ho laku lole nèti mamuri dhu lèke, dhu lamatua moa le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. timotius! èu dhu j'aj'i le sèmi ana ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sue èu, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, aa hia èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i'm always thinking of you and i'm so thankful to god, whom i serve as my ancestors did, with a clear conscience. i never forget to mention you in my prayers.
target_text: mèu-mèda ja'a sabaj'a hia èu. ja'a manèngi taruu makasi mi ama lamatua, lula èu madhutu taruu ne. èu me'a! ja'a sab'a hia nèngu dènge d'ara mola-mèci, èci èèna ka dhu bèi-baki èdhi sèra sab'a hia ne.

source_text: i remember how you cried, and i so want to see you! that would make me really happy.
target_text: ja'a sanèd'e lod'o èdhi pacèri uru èèna, èu pahaa èi madha. nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo titu kèna paraga hari dènge èu, sèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e.

source_text: i keep in mind your sincere trust in god, the same trust that your grandmother lois and mother eunice also had-and i know that same trust continues in you.
target_text: ja'a ngee kèdhi uru èèna, lod'o èu heka parcaya tare'a lamatua yesus. parcaya sèmi èèna na dhu amo le ètu d'ara bèi mu luisa dènge ina mu yunike. aa ja'a ke'a mèu, na, parcaya sèmi èèna muri le ètu d'ara èu kahèi.

source_text: that's why i want to remind you to revitalize god's gracious gift to you which you received when i placed my hands on you.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o dhu ja'a bane ai ètu kètu èu aa sabaj'a hia èu, lod'o èèna kahèi lamatua hia karunya mi èu, sèna ka èu bisa sab'a hia ne. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pakaroo hari karunya èu dhu nuka sèmi ai dhu oe madhe sa.

source_text: god didn't give us a spirit that makes us fearful, but a spirit of power and love and good sense.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua tao boe èdhi j'aj'i dhèu madha'u. te ngaa na tao, sèna ka èdhi j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara èra, dhu te'a pasue, aa te'a taha tare d'ara.

source_text: so don't be ashamed to tell others about our lord, or be ashamed of me. instead be ready to share in suffering for the good news as god gives you strength.
target_text: de baku makae peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lamatua èdhi. aa baku makae lula ja'a ne ana bèdho. te ja'a maso bui lula ja'a pakako sasab'a na. de ladhe lamu lole lii lolo be'a, èu hud'i pa'èra ku iisi, ho dui j'aj'èra nuka sèmi ji'i dui. ladhe èu paraga dènge j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, èèna na lamatua pa'èra d'ara èu.

source_text: he is the one who has saved us and called us to live a holy life-not through what we do, but by god's own plan and through his grace. he gave this grace to us in christ jesus before the beginning of time, and is now revealed in the appearing of our savior christ jesus. he destroyed death, making life and immortality brilliantly clear through the good news.
target_text: lula lamatua ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. aa na hag'e nare èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci. na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, lula na sue èdhi, masi ka èdhi tao boe ngaa-ngaa ho nia sèmi babe'a na. lod'o lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa pama'ète nare le ho hia yesus kristus mai, sèna ka na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pala mamuri hia èdhi. ka yesus kristus mai le, aa bhoke paled'a ngaa dhu uru èèna ama lamatua nelu tao, aa pad'elo d'ara hua iia nèngu mi èdhi. na palaho le koasa mamadhe! ne'e ka dhu j'aj'i lii lolo be'a! de cee dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, madhe heka taa-taa, te ngaa mamuri manèro toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: i was appointed speaker, apostle, and teacher of this good news.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua ded'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, sèna ka ja'a lole lii lolo be'a na, aa aj'a-nori dhèu ètu mia-mia.

source_text: that's also the reason i'm suffering all this, but i'm not ashamed, because i know whom i've trusted. i'm confident that he can look after what i've entrusted to him until the day he returns.
target_text: sèra sa ka dhu paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa ja'a makae boe! lula ja'a ke'a le cee ka dhu ja'a parcaya, nuka lamatua yesus. aa ja'a ke'a kahèi, peka na, nèngu ka dhu pangèd'u sasab'a ne'e mi adhe-aai ja'a, nèngu ka dhu bisa j'aga sasab'a ne'e, aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra ja'a sèna ka pakako sasab'a ne'e, toke nèngu mai hari.

source_text: you should follow the model of good advice that you learned from me, with an attitude of trust and love in christ jesus.
target_text: de madhutu ka, j'ara mamuri nèti a'aj'a dhu lèke dhu ja'a pad'elo le dènge èu. ladhe èu parcaya taruu, aa sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna, ne'e peka na, èu j'aj'i le èci dènge yesus kristus.

source_text: guard the truth that was entrusted to you through the holy spirit who lives in us.
target_text: ama lamatua pangèd'u le ètu d'ara adhe-aai èu kakaja èci dhu kab'ua, nuka a'aj'a dhu lèke. de ladhe-leru pabe'a kakaja èèna! pake roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu ètu d'ara èdhi, sèna ka hud'i laa na pa'èra èu ho ladhe-leru kakaja èèna paie-iie.

source_text: you already know that everyone from asia has abandoned me, including phygelus and hermogenes.
target_text: ele boe èu tadèngi le, na, figelus, hermogenes dènge dhèu leo nèti propensi asia sèra, pusi-pahae heka ja'a.

source_text: may the lord be kind to the family of onesiphorus, because he often took care of me and wasn't embarrassed about me being in prison. when he was in rome, he took the trouble to search for me, and he found me. may the lord grant him his blessing in the day of judgment. timothy, you're very much aware of how much onesiphorus did for me when he was in ephesus.
target_text: te ngaa onesiforus leko-leo nèti rèngu. na pakaj'èu boe nèti ja'a. èu mesa mu me'a, lod'o ja'a ètu kota epesus era, nèngu ka dhu ladhe-leru ja'a. limuri ne, na pea ètu kota roma ne'e. ropa na d'ai ne'e, na patangi-tenge ja'a ètu mia-mia. ka na abhu ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne. te ngaa na makae boe. na mai taruu ngad'o ja'a ho pa'èra d'ara ja'a. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi onesiforus dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i ra. ladhe lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu rai-haha, ja'a sanao ho lamatua pama'ète dhu be'a hia mi onesiforus si.

source_text: so then, my son, grow strong in the grace of christ jesus.
target_text: ana timotius dhu ja'a sue! yesus kristus d'ara hua iia titu kèna. limuri ne, èu èci le dènge nèngu. na pa'èra èu. de èu me'a dhoka sèmi more di!

source_text: take what you heard me say in front of many witnesses and share it with those who are trustworthy, who then can teach others as well.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a aj'a le èu ètu madha dhèu ae lula-nèti j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. de limuri ne ja'a manèngi èu, ho aa'i-aa'i dhu èu tadèngi nèti ja'a, lamu aj'a hari hia dhèu dhu èu bisa lèka si. dhèu sèra hud'i bisa lasi aj'a hari sèmi èèna kahèi mi dhèu leo.

source_text: suffer together with me like a good soldier of christ jesus.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, nuka sèmi sordad'u yesus kristus. de èdhi pasae j'aj'èra sèmi nèngu kahèi. lula èu ne sordad'u dhu be'a, èu hud'i pasae more ku pala unu mu.

source_text: a soldier on active duty doesn't get caught up in the business of everyday life. he wants to please the one who enlisted him.
target_text: sordad'u dhu pakako sasab'a bisa boe sab'a pab'ali dènge sasab'a dhu leo. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, nèngu ne'a pakarej'e d'ara komedhaa na.

source_text: similarly athletes who compete in the games don't win a prize if they don't keep to the rules.
target_text: tare conto leo sèmi olaraga. ladhe madhutu lomba, hud'i madhutu ku atora na. te ladhe aad'o, na, kalua! bisa boe abhu juara. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe neo pakako sasab'a lamatua, madhutu ku atora na.

source_text: the farmer that does all the hard work should be the first to benefit from the crop.
target_text: ladhe kahèi dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe. na sab'a dènge tèku rui na ètu d'ara oka na. de nèngu ka dhu uru tèka abhu hua-hela.

source_text: think about what i'm telling you. the lord will help you to understand all this.
target_text: pangee paie-iie conto sèra. pe ama lamatua hia me'a mèu j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: focus your mind on jesus christ, a descendant of david, who was raised from the dead. this is my good news,
target_text: pangee pabe'a-be'a mi yesus kristus. nèngu èèna ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. na madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri ne. èèna ka j'aj'i lii lolo be'a dhu ja'a laku peka-padhai ètu mia-mia.

source_text: and i'm suffering imprisonment because of it as if i were a criminal-but the word of god is not imprisoned.
target_text: lula ja'a lole lii lolo be'a, èèna ka ja'a j'èra sèmi ne'e ne. risi-risi hari ra èki-karadhe ja'a dènge rate, tao ja'a sèmi dhèu bhelu-katub'a sa. te ngaa rèngu taha rare boe lii lolo be'a ama lamatua.

source_text: despite all this i'm willing to keep on going for the sake of god's people so that they may gain the salvation of christ jesus that is eternal glory.
target_text: de ja'a sadia pasae rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. sad'i dhèu unu lamatua dhu na hag'e nare sèra abhu mamuri. pe ama lamatua ded'e si padedha-dedha, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: this is a trustworthy saying: if we died with him, we will also live with him;
target_text: aa lii se'e mema lèke tare'a: ladhe èdhi mangaku, na, kristus madhe ho gati èdhi, èci èèna ka èdhi madhe tèke eele mamuri dhui, hèia èdhi kahèi mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: if we keep going, we will also reign with him; if we deny him, he will also deny us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, èdhi tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pasili ne, nèngu pasili èdhi kahèi.

source_text: if we are not trustworthy, he is still trustworthy, for he cannot be untrue to himself.
target_text: masi ka d'ara èdhi satia boe, te ngaa nèngu satia taa-taa, lula nèngu bisa boe leko-monya. ngaa dhu na peka, èèna ka dhu na tao.

source_text: this is what you should remind people about, telling them before god that they shouldn't have meaningless arguments over words. to do this only harms those who listen.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu baku bhèlu j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra. kai si dènge kolongara ama lamatua, ho ra loe eele ka nèti pa'uji lii padhai lii. te aa'i-aa'i sèra guna boe ngaa-ngaa. dhodhoka pa'ele iie ngangee nèti dhèu dhu nanene.

source_text: make sure you work hard so you can present yourself to god and gain his approval. be a worker that doesn't need to be embarrassed, using the word of truth correctly.
target_text: tenge j'ara dhu be'a, sèna ka tao iisi èu nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a dhu nia abhu koa nèti ama lamatua. dhèu sèmi èèna parluu boe makae, lula nèngu èèna sab'a sasab'a na dènge be'a. èu hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu aj'a dènge mola lii holo-nori lamatua mi dhèu, aa baku dènge koe-kapengo. lula lii holo-nori na, mola!

source_text: avoid pointless chatter because people who do this are heading away from god.
target_text: pakaj'èu nèti lii padhue dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, aa nèti lii padhai dhu pakab'ua boe lamatua. te sèra sa dhoka tao dhèu asa bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: their teachings are as destructive as gangrene that destroys healthy flesh. hymenaeus and philetus are like this.
target_text: lii padhai dhu bhelu-katub'a sèra paj'ala sèmi èi papèd'a kangker. lii padhai himeneus dènge filetus sèmi sèra ka!

source_text: they have deviated from the truth by saying that the resurrection has already happened, which has ruined some people's trust in god.
target_text: dua ra aj'a sala, peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri aa'i hari le. te ngaa èèna lèke boe! dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu se piku eele nèti ngaa dhu lèke. ngaa dhu rèngu aj'a se'e, pa'ele iie parcaya nèti dhèu cahag'e.

source_text: but god's solid, trustworthy foundation stone stands firm, with this inscription, the lord knows those who belong to him, and everyone who calls on the name of the lord should stay away from all that is evil.
target_text: te ngaa kapua dhu ama lamatua padhèdi nare èèna, kalau-karèto boe. ètu kapua èèna, dhu suri peka na, lamatua tadhe mèu dhèu unu na, aa, dhèu cee dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, hud'i pakaj'èu ku nèti bhelu-katub'a. kapua èèna, dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: a stately home doesn't just have cups and bowls made of gold and silver. it also has ones made from wood and clay. some are made for special use; others for more commonplace functions. so if you get rid of what is evil, you will become a cup or bowl that is holy and special, useful to the lord, ready to do all that's good.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu dhèu kaja, abhu rupa-rupa mèdha-panyau. abhu dhu tao nèti hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi. te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu tao nèti aj'u dènge rai kalili. mèdha dhu kab'ua, lamatua èmu na d'èi pake ètu d'ara iia-aala. te ngaa mèdha dhu biasa sèra, lamatua èmu makae pake ètu madha dhèu. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu rai-haha. ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge mèdha-panyau dhu kab'ua sèra. lamatua èmu d'èi pake ne, lula nèngu dènge gaguna sèna ka tao rupa-rupa sasab'a dhu be'a.

source_text: run away from anything that fires up the desires of youth. run after what is right and trustworthy, run after love and peace along with those who are true and pure christians.
target_text: ana ngèru sèra manahu malai lula madhutu dad'èi ra. te ngaa èu, timotius, hud'i j'aga ngi'u mu paie-iie, ho baku madhutu dad'èi d'ara sèmi èèna. tenge j'ara ho tao dhu be'a taruu. parcaya taruu lamatua. mamuri pasue aa padame dènge dhèu leo. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu mamuri dènge d'ara mola-mèci, rèngu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara dhu be'a. de èu, timotius, hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi rèngu sèra!

source_text: avoid foolish and childish debates, for you know they only lead to fights.
target_text: ja'a pasanèd'e hari èu ca tèka! baku lamu soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. te sèra sa dhodhoka tao dhèu ho patao-palaha di.

source_text: for the lord's minister must not fight, but be kind to everyone, able to teach, patient,
target_text: dhèu dhu sab'a hia lamatua nia boe j'aj'i dhèu dhu tenge lii langu, sina ma? te ngaa rèngu sèra hud'i d'ara be'a dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, dhu d'èlu-mèu aj'a-nori dhèu, dhu taha rare d'ara ropa paraga dènge dhèu dhu tema tenge lii langu.

source_text: gently correcting opponents. perhaps god may help them to come to repent and to understand the truth.
target_text: rèngu hud'i holo paie-iie dhèu dhu palab'a sèra. dènge sèmi èèna, ele boe lamatua hia si ele-ho'a, hèia ra sèmi rare ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: in this way they may come to their senses and escape the devil's trap. for he has captured them and made them do whatever he wants.
target_text: hèia ra mase'a, ka ra rai nèti kacui-aai dhèu aae nidhu, dhu uru èèna èki si ho madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: be aware that there will be troubled times in the last days.
target_text: timotius! ladhe dètu dènge lod'o èle rai-haha ne, j'aj'èra na ae titu kèna. ja'a peka mema dènge èu sèmi èèna.

source_text: people will love themselves and love money. they will be boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, and without god in their lives.
target_text: dhèu dhoka sue ngi'u ra, aa manga'a doi-dhari. rèngu padedha iisi, aa d'èi pahaha dhèu leo, d'èi pakarehe kolongara lamatua, d'èi boe nanene ina-ama ra, re'a boe manèngi makasi, kètu hadhu, d'èi boe madha j'ara lamatua,

source_text: heartless and unforgiving, they'll commit slander and have no self-control. brutal people who hate what's good,
target_text: re'a boe sue dhèu, d'èi boe mamuri padame, d'èi pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu, taha rare boe iisi ra, bhelu-katub'a dhu risi eele, d'èi boe dhu be'a,

source_text: they will betray others and be totally thoughtless. they are absurdly full of themselves, living so much for pleasure that they don't care about loving god.
target_text: d'èi pahie mone aanga-angalai ra, ngangee bab'a, aa tao ngi'u ra d'èlu-mèu risi, madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara risi nèti dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: they may give an outward impression of being religious, but they don't actually believe it works. stay away from these people!
target_text: rèngu tao iisi ra dhèu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa dhu mola-mèu lao. koasa lamatua abhu boe ètu d'ara ra. baku padètu dènge dhèu sèmi sèra kahèi!

source_text: they're the kind of people that slip into homes and take control of vulnerable women who are burdened down by the guilt of sin and distracted by all kinds of desires.
target_text: rèngu maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu dènge rèhu mare, ho lasi kakèj'i d'ara dhèu bhèni dhu èra boe, aa mud'a lèke god'a. dhèu bhèni sèmi sèra sa, mamuri ètu d'ara sasala-sasigo dhu udhu sobhu-sobhu, aa madhutu dhoka rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ra.

source_text: these women are always trying to learn but they're never able to understand the truth!
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi mese hiu mai nori j'ara dhu hiu, na, rèngu madhutu rii. te ngaa re'a boe hag'e mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia dhu sale.

source_text: just like jannes and jambres opposed moses, these teachers also oppose the truth. they are people with corrupted minds whose supposed trust in god is a lie.
target_text: èu sanèd'e era lii lolo yanes dènge yamres, si? lod'o èèna, dua ra palab'a dènge musa. mese taa limuri se'e, tatao ra èci èèna ka. rèngu palab'a dènge lii holo-nori dhu be'a. ngangee ra ele iie le, aa parcaya rèngu lèke boe.

source_text: but they won't get far. their stupidity will be obvious to everyone, just like that of jannes and jambres.
target_text: mese dhu lèke boe sèmi sèra sa, bisa boe taha rare nèbhu. nèbhu-nèbhu dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a gagoa rèngu! nuka sèmi uru èèna dhèu re'a kapod'e-kabèli lula-nèti yanes dènge yamres.

source_text: but you know all about my teaching and behavior, and my aim in life. you know my trust in god and my love. you know what i've had to endure-
target_text: timotius! èu me'a aa'i le mamuri ja'a. èu me'a aa'i ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a. èu me'a j'ara mamuri ja'a. èu me'a d'ara dad'èi ja'a. èu me'a ngaa dhu ja'a parcaya. èu mèdhi unu mu le, ja'a taha kore d'ara, aa sasue ja'a mi dhèu. aa èu me'a tasamia ja'a taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra dènge be'a.

source_text: how i've been persecuted and what i've suffered. you know what happened to me at antioch, at iconium, and at lystra-the troubles i had and how the lord rescued me from all of them.
target_text: èu me'a kahèi ra hake-paparu ja'a, aa dui rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. ja'a abhu j'aj'èra sèmi èèna ètu kota antiokia, ikonium, dènge listra. te ngaa ama lamatua patalale eele ja'a nèti j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: of course it's true that everyone who wants to live a life devoted to god in christ jesus will experience persecution,
target_text: mema dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus, aa neo mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, tatu dhèu paj'èra rèngu.

source_text: while wicked people and frauds will do well, going from bad to worse, deceiving others and deceiving themselves too.
target_text: ngaa hari, dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra, asa tabha bhelu. rèngu kapod'e-kabhèli ho pamanahu dhèu leo, te ngaa rèngu sèra lèke kapod'e kahèi.

source_text: but you must hold onto the things you've learned and are convinced are true. you know who taught you.
target_text: te ngaa èu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori dhu èu abhu le. aa ngaa dhu èu parcaya èèna, madhutu taruu. te èèna ka dhu lèke! èu me'a mèu cee ka dhu aj'a aa'i-aa'i sèra mi èu! èu bisa lèka si!

source_text: from your childhood you've known the holy scriptures which can give you understanding for salvation by trusting in christ jesus.
target_text: karèi nèti èu ana iiki era, èu abhu a'aj'a le isi nèti sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua. nèti sasuri se'e, èu me'a rahasia mamuri dhu lèke, dhu tao èu me'a mèu j'ara mamuri. nèti èèna ka, èu parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: all scripture inspired by god is useful for teaching, for confronting what is wrong, for setting us straight, and for telling us what is right.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu ra suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, mema ama lamatua ka dhu uri ho dhèu suri sèra. gaguna sasuri èèna, nuka: aj'a dhèu ngaa dhu lèke, pad'elo sasala dhèu, ère hari dhèu asa j'ara dhu mola, aa nori dhèu ho bèli-bèli mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: this is how god provides a thorough preparation for those who work for him to accomplish all that's good.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, sasuri mola-mèci èèna bisa tao pamèci dhèu unu lamatua sèra, sèna ka rèngu re'a sasab'a dhu be'a aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: this is what i instruct you to do before god and christ jesus who will judge the living and the dead when he comes to establish his kingdom. speak god's word whether it is convenient or not, tell people where they're going wrong, warn them, encourage them. do this with a great deal of patient teaching.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a yesus kristus mai hari asa rai-haha ne, ho nèd'u paredha nuka sèmi dhèu aae. masi ka dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhèu dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i ra lasi asa katanga madha na, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu ra èci-èci. nèti èèna ka, ètu madha ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus, ja'a manèngi mi èu ho lamu peka-padhai dènge dhèu-dhèu, lii holo-nori ama lamatua. èu pa'èra taruu! baku pangee, na, lod'o dhu be'a, do aad'o. pad'elo sasala dhèu, te ngaa kai si pabe'a-be'a dènge lii mako. pa'èra d'ara dhèu pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: for the time is coming when people won't bother to listen to true teaching. instead they will be curious to listen to something different, and will surround themselves with teachers who'll tell them what they want to hear.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a, dhèu ro'o heka nanene lii holo-nori dhu lèke. pe ra kaboko rare mese-mese dhu d'èlu-mèu padhue-padhai madhutu dad'èi ra, sèna ka pabe'a ro'a dhilu ra.

source_text: they will stop listening to the truth and wander off following myths.
target_text: ra hutu dhilu ra ho tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke. te ngaa pasa dhilu ra, ho nanene lii lolo nanuku dhu leko-monya sèra!

source_text: you need to keep your wits about you at all times. put up with troubles, do the work of sharing the good news, fulfill your ministry.
target_text: masi ka tasamia èèna ka, èu hud'i taha d'ara. pa'èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. lamu lole lii lolo be'a, sèna ka dhèu sèmi rare yesus kristus. soru-bara dhèu dènge d'ara kateme, toke pa'èle sasab'a. baku dènge d'ara cabèka.

source_text: for i'm about to be sacrificed-the time of my death is approaching.
target_text: baku pusi dènge ngi'u ja'a ne, te lod'o mamadhe ja'a dètu le. èci èèna ka dènge galaa dhu isi na oe èle kèna.

source_text: i have fought the good fight, i have finished the race, i have kept my trust in god.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a segi le ètu d'ara pa'uji èèna dènge be'a. ja'a rai d'ai le lane. ja'a madhutu taruu le yesus kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: now there's a prize reserved for me-the crown for a life lived according to what is good and right. the lord who is the judge that always does what's right, will give that to me on that day. and not just to me, but to everyone who longs for his coming.
target_text: de ne'e ne, di èci ka dhu ja'a tatae. nuka piala juara dhu lamatua tao tèke le hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola. lamatua èdhi èèna, nuka dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola. dhu ne'a boe bia cabèka. ladhe d'ai ka lod'o na, na pangèd'u mi ja'a piala juara èèna. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne, aa dhu mate mamai na, rèngu sèra abhu piala sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: please try to come to me as soon as you can.
target_text: timotius! mai ka lai-lai ngad'o ja'a!

source_text: demas has abandoned me because he loves the things of this world more, and has gone to thessalonica. crescens has gone to galatia, and titus to dalmatia.
target_text: te limuri ne ja'a kaliu bia. krekes la'e le asa propensi galati. aa titus la'e le asa rai dalmatia. aa demas sue risi j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe ètu rai-haha ne, la'e le sa kota tesalonika.

source_text: only luke is here with me. bring mark with you, because he can help me with my work.
target_text: dhodhoka lukas di dhu pea dènge ja'a ètu ne'e. tenge more markus sèna ka dua mi mai palere-lere. te nèngu èèna bisa ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e.

source_text: i sent tychicus to ephesus.
target_text: ja'a hia le tikikus la'e asa kota epesus.

source_text: when you come please bring the cloak i left behind with carpus in troas-and the books, especially the parchments.
target_text: ladhe èu mai, baku bhèlu mèti kodho pana ja'a dhu tèke eele ètu èmu karpus ètu kota troas. aa baku bhèlu mèti dènge sasuri ja'a sèra, risi-risi dhu ja'a suri ètu ka'uri badha.

source_text: alexander the coppersmith caused me a lot of trouble-may god judge him for what he did.
target_text: aleksander, tuka tabaga èèna, tao bhelu dhu ciki boe mi dedha ja'a. hud'i nèngu sène, te bèli-camèd'a, lamatua ka dhu b'ala ne, sèmi dhu nèngu tao mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: you watch out for him too, because he was very much against what we were saying.
target_text: èu hud'i mage-mage ku dènge dhèu èèna, lula nèngu na d'èi palab'a lii-lii dhu èdhi aj'a-nori.

source_text: when it came to my first defense, no one stood up for me-everyone abandoned me. may they not be blamed for this.
target_text: lod'o hiu-hiu ja'a titu ètu madha hakim ho siri iisi ja'a, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re ja'a. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra kako tèke eele ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! pe lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra.

source_text: but the lord stood by me and gave me strength so that i could declare the whole of the message so that all the foreigners could hear it. i was rescued out of the lion's mouth!
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ja'a. na pa'èra ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka-padhai lii lolo be'a na dhu pakura boe ciki sa. ja'a lolo sèmi èèna ka mi dhèu yahudi boe, ho ra nanene lii lolo be'a. aa pakaj'èu le nèti mamadhe-mamopo.

source_text: the lord will rescue me from all the evil things done against me, and will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. his is the glory forever and ever. amen.
target_text: aa èèna na ama lamatua pakaj'èu ja'a nèti bhabhelu-katub'a aa'i-aa'i ra. aa lere nèti ja'a dènge sod'a-mole laku asa sorga. ètu era nèi, nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha. lamatua èèna, kapai seli eele! ja'a koa-kio ded'e padedha-dedha ne, dhu ma'ète boe! tare'a sèmi èèna.

source_text: my greetings to prisca and aquila, and to onesiphorus's family.
target_text: baku bhelu mèti lii maho'o ja'a mi ina priskila dènge dhèu èmu na akila. sèmi èèna kahèi, mi a'ari onesiforus.

source_text: erastus stayed on in corinth. i left trophimus behind in miletus because he was sick.
target_text: erastus pea ètu kota korintus. ca hari ni, ja'a tèke eele trofimus ètu kota miletus, lula na pèd'a aae.

source_text: please try to come before winter. eubulus sends his best wishes-and pudens, linus, claudia, and all the brothers and sisters too.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka lod'o d'ai mèka hèru pacuhi, èu dhu d'ai le ne'e. angalai ètu se'e se, nuka: ebolus, pudes, linus dènge ina klaudia pa'adhu lii maho'o hia miu. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge a'ari dhèu kristen dhu leo sèra.

source_text: the lord be with you. may his grace be with you all.
target_text: ja'a sanao sèna ka ama lamatua sama-sama dènge èu taruu. sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: this letter comes from paul, servant of god and an apostle of jesus christ. i'm sent to build up the trust of god's chosen people and to share the knowledge of the truth that leads to lives lived for god. this gives them the hope of eternal life that god who cannot lie promised ages ago, but which at the proper time he revealed through his word in the message which i was entrusted to give, following the command of god our savior. this letter is sent to titus, my true son through the trust in god we share in common. may you have grace and peace from god the father and christ jesus our savior.
target_text: ana titus dhu be'a! sasuri ne'e nèti ja'a, paulus, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua, aa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. na pua ja'a sèna ka pa'èra parcaya dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra. na pua ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara mola kahèi, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu unu ama lamatua re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a rèngu mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, te ngaa na moa mema, bèli-camèd'a dhèu unu na mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. nèngu ne'a boe leko-monya. d'ai lod'o na, ka ama lamatua peka paled'a, na, nèngu saku eele sasala-sigo dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. aa na paredha ja'a ho laku peka lii lolo be'a hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. titus! èu ne nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a sa, lula èu dènge ja'a ne sama-sama parcaya kristus. de ja'a sabaj'a mi ama lamatua dènge yesus kristus dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, sèna ka ra pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi èu, ho èu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: the reason i left you in crete was for you to organize what was still needed and to appoint elders in every town, as i told you.
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a pama'ète kore le, ho èu pea ètu pulu kreta, sèna ka uri pèri-pèri j'ara dhu èdhi parluu era ètu èèna. aa hud'i laa èu ded'e dhèu dhu re'a lalau-lalo'o juma'at ètu d'ara rae-rae. baku bhèlu atora dhu ja'a peka le dènge èu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at. peka na:

source_text: an elder must have a good reputation, the husband of one wife, and have children who believe and who are not accused of being wild or disobedient.
target_text: ladhe neo ded'e dhèu ho j'aj'i kètu juma'at, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku dènge boe sasala. nèngu hud'i satia dènge dhèu èmu na ca dhèu di. ana-ana na parcaya kahèi yesus kristus. mage dhoka dhèu peka, na, rèngu sèra ana-ana dhu tenge patao-palaha di, aa palab'a dènge dhèu.

source_text: as a leader for god, a head elder must have a good reputation and not be arrogant. he should not have a quick temper nor get drunk; he shouldn't be violent or greedy for money.
target_text: lula kètu juma'at sèra pakako sasab'a lamatua, de rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge mola, aa dènge kolongara hua iia. baku ded'e dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi; dhu nasa malai, d'èi mahu, dhu d'èi pagama, aa dhu manga'a doi-dhari.

source_text: he should be hospitable, someone who loves what's good and does what's right. he should be living a life for god, self-controlled,
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at sèra hud'i d'èi sèmi rare dhèu asa d'ara èmu ra. dhu d'èi j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu taha rare d'ara, dhu bia boe cabèka, dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhu re'a taha rare ngi'u.

source_text: and must be devoted to the trustworthy message as it's taught. in this way he can encourage others through correct teaching, and be able to convince those who disagree.
target_text: rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku lii holo-nori ama lamatua, dhu uru èèna èdhi nori si. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu pad'elo j'ara lamatua dhu mola hia dhèu leo, aa bisa pamola lii lolo dhu lèke boe j'ara sèra.

source_text: for there are many rebels around who talk a lot of deceptive nonsense, especially from the circumcision group.
target_text: te abhu dhèu ae dhu d'èi palab'a a'aj'a dhu lèke. abhu dhu peka-padhai dènge boe kolo-kapua. aa abhu kahèi dhu d'èi kapod'e-kabèli. risi-risi dhèu yahudi dhu peka, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo abhu mamuri hud'i suna ku.

source_text: their talking must stop, these people who throw whole families into turmoil, teaching things that aren't right for the sake of making money.
target_text: ra pake a'aj'a rèngu dhu sala ho nuni rèti a'ari èdhi pakaj'èu nèti lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke. rèngu sèra d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari dènge j'ara kapod'e-kabèli di! kai dhèu sèmi sèra sa, sèna ka ra loe nèti aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke boe.

source_text: as someone of their own people, a prophet, has stated, cretans are always liars, evil beasts who are lazy, greedy people.
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu èci nèti pulu kreta, dhu tema padhai pake lii hini, lole dhèu nèngu unu na, aku nèngu na, dhèu pulu kreta d'èi dhoka padhai lii hèb'a hua di, dhu manga'a, nuka sèmi badha hui dhu re'a boe atora, aa bai-eed'a mèje adhe!

source_text: this is a true statement! consequently give them a good telling-off so that they can have a healthy trust in god,
target_text: mamuri dhèu sèra mema sèmi èèna ka! de èu hud'i lamu ère more hari dhèu dhu lèke kapod'e-kabèli sèra, ho pa'èra hari parcaya ra mi lamatua.

source_text: not paying attention to jewish myths and human commandments from those who deviate from the truth.
target_text: èle èèna, ra nanene ia ka nanuku nèti dhèu yahudi sèra, aa rèngu hud'i ae eele ku nèti lii paredha dhèu-dhèu dhu tule eele lii holo-nori dhu lèke.

source_text: to those who have clean minds everything is clean, but to those who are corrupt and refuse to trust in god, nothing is clean-both their minds and their consciences are corrupt.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! bagi dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa'i-aa'i mola-mèci. te ngaa bagi dhu d'ara kaj'alu aa dhu parcaya boe lamatua, abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu mola-mèci. lula d'ara dènge ngangee rèngu dhu kaj'alu mema le.

source_text: they claim to know god, but they prove this is false by what they do. they are detestable and disobedient, worthless for doing anything good.
target_text: rèngu mangaku tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa mamuri ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ne. rèngu padhai lii leo, tao leo. rèngu mema tare'a-re'a dhèu karehe di! rèngu ro'o boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku maena dhèu sèmi sèra re'a tao dhu be'a!

source_text: you, however, must teach what is consistent with healthy beliefs.
target_text: te ngaa èu ne, titus, baku j'aj'i sèmi rèngu kahèi! èu hud'i pa'èra d'ara dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke.

source_text: older men shouldn't drink; they should be respectable and sensible, with a healthy trust in god, loving and patient.
target_text: peka dènge ama-ama dhèu heka sèra ho mamuri madhutu atora, j'aga paie kolongara, aa taha rare d'ara. rèngu hud'i kèpe pa'èra aa taha taruu madhutu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu lèke. aa rèngu hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: similarly older women ought to behave in a way that shows they live their lives for god. they shouldn't destroy people's reputations by what they say, and they shouldn't be addicted to wine.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ina-ina dhu heka sèra. peka dènge ra j'aga paie kakako dènge lii padhai ra, aa mamuri taruu madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku padhai-kakoli kolongara dhèu. baku j'aj'i ènu dhua ara-dhua pèd'u. te ngaa rèngu hud'i aj'a dhèu, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge mola.

source_text: they should be teachers of what's good, teaching the young wives to love their husbands and their children.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, rèngu j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi ina-ina dhu ngèru era, sèna ka ra sue dhèu èmu-kamali dènge ana-ana ra.

source_text: they are to be sensible and pure, working in their homes, doing good and listening to what their husbands tell them. in this way the word of god will not be spoken about badly.
target_text: rèngu hud'i aj'a kahèi dhèu ho ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara, mola-mèci, re'a lalau d'ara èmu, re'a pahae dhèu èmu ra, aa d'èi nanene lii dhèu èmu ra. ladhe mamuri rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa heka padhai lii pahaha lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: likewise tell the young men to be sensible.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, holo mone ngèru sèra, sèna ka ra mamuri dènge taha rare d'ara.

source_text: you should set an example of doing good in all areas of life: show integrity and seriousness in what you teach,
target_text: titus! èu ne hud'i mamuri dènge be'a ku, ho bisa j'aj'i dhèu pad'elo j'ara mi dhèu leo. sad'i èu tao ngaa èci sa, sab'a dènge be'a, sama sèmi dhu èu aj'a dhèu sèra. ladhe èu aj'a ngaa sa èci, na, tao madhutu ngaa dhu èu aj'a sèra. mage pamud'e dènge sasab'a èu.

source_text: sharing healthy beliefs that can't be criticized. in this way those who are opposed will be ashamed of themselves and won't have anything bad to say about us.
target_text: ladhe èu nori dhèu, pake lii holo-nori dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu abhu boe j'ara ho pamanahu èu. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu-dhèu dhu lab'a èdhi ra'e makae, lula rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho segi èdhi.

source_text: tell servants to always obey their masters. they should try to please them and not talk back to them.
target_text: aj'a ènu sèra ho ra nanene lamatua rèngu ètu j'ara ngaa èèna ka, aa pakarej'e d'ara lamatua ra. baku ra pab'ala lii padhai dènge lamatua ra.

source_text: they shouldn't steal things for themselves, but show they are completely trustworthy so that they may rightly represent the truth about god our savior in every way.
target_text: rèngu baku mana'u mèdha-panyau lamatua ra. rèngu hud'i pad'elo ku dhu peka, na, lamatua ra bisa parcaya rèngu tare'a-re'a. rèngu sèra hud'i j'aj'i dhèu dhu be'a aa satia. ladhe dhèu leo neo pakasame mamuri ènu rèngu dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi aj'a, tatu ra dhaa, peka na, lii a'aj'a èdhi be'a titu kèna. te a'aj'a èdhi se'e, madhutu j'ara-j'ara ama lamatua dhu hia le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: for god's grace has been revealed, bringing salvation to everyone.
target_text: te ama lamatua pad'elo le babe'a d'ara na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, aa bhoke j'ara ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: it teaches us to reject a godless way of life with the desires of this world. instead we should live thoughtful, self-controlled lives that are right before god in the present world
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mamuri dhu pamèci boe, aa dad'èi dhu karehe, ti core eele si. èdhi mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, hud'i te'a taha tare d'ara, mamuri dènge mola-mèci, aa satia dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: as we look for the wonderful hope of the glorious appearing of our great god and savior jesus christ.
target_text: limuri ne èdhi sanao-maena mamai hari yesus kristus dhu kapai risi eele! èèna j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. nèngu èèna, lamatua èdhi dhu kapai risi dhu pala-bagi le mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: he gave himself for us, so that he could set us free from all our wickedness, and to make us clean for him-a people who belong to him, keen to do good.
target_text: nèngu hia le ngi'u aae na j'aj'i mi korban, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka tao èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na dhu mamuri mola-mèci, dhu d'èi dhoka tao j'ara hua iia di.

source_text: this is what you should be teaching. you have the authority to encourage and to correct as necessary. don't let anyone look down on you.
target_text: de titus, aj'a aa'i-aa'i se mi dhèu sarani sèra. pa'èra d'ara si, sèna ka madhutu a'aj'a sèra. dhèu cee dhu tao sala, na, pad'elo j'ara be'a hia ne. dhèu bisa boe pahaha èu, lula èu dènge hak ho tao paie rèngu.

source_text: remind them to follow what rulers tell them to do, and to obey authorities. they should always be ready to do what is good.
target_text: pasanèd'e dhèu sarani sèra, ho nanene dhèu paredha aa dhèu-dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. rèngu hud'i madhutu ku atora sèra. aa rèngu hud'i pa'èra tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: they should not speak badly about anyone, and they should not be argumentative. tell them to show gentleness and kindness to everyone.
target_text: baku lasi padhai pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. baku d'èi pasibha d'ara lii. be'a risi, mamuri mola, dènge d'ara hua iia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for there was a time when we too were foolish and disobedient. we were deceived and slaves to various desires and pleasures. we lived wicked lives full of jealousy, hateful people hating one another.
target_text: te uru èèna, lod'o èdhi tadhe mèka lamatua yesus, èdhi te'a boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dènge mud'a lèke tipu. èdhi to'o boe nanene dhèu leo. èdhi dhoka mamuri madhutu d'ara bhelu di, ka èki ngi'u èdhi dènge rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ti. èdhi d'ara karehe dènge dhèu leo. èdhi mamuri dhoka dènge jeluus. èdhi d'èi tèka d'ara mi dhèu leo, hèia ra kab'èli tèka d'ara dènge èdhi.

source_text: but when the goodness and love of god our savior was revealed, he saved us,
target_text: masi ka mamuri èdhi ne ele iie le, te ngaa ama lamatua dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, pad'elo le sasue dènge d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èdhi.

source_text: not because of anything good that we've done, but because of his mercy. he did this through the cleansing of rebirth and renewal of the holy spirit,
target_text: na hia èdhi mamuri lula boe nèti tatao èdhi dhu be'a, te ngaa lula sasue na mi èdhi. nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi sèra pake roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pahiu mamuri èdhi, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi.

source_text: which he poured out on us abundantly through jesus christ our savior.
target_text: lula yesus kristus madhe le ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala sèra, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua hia dènge boe too-lane roh na dhu mola-mèci mi èdhi.

source_text: now that we are set right by his grace we have become heirs having the hope of eternal life.
target_text: lula d'ara hua iia yesus, ka na pabe'a pa'èci èdhi dènge ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana na. hèia èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. se'e se j'aj'i mi pusaka èdhi!

source_text: you can trust what i'm saying, and i want you to emphasize these instructions so that those who trust in god will think seriously about them and continue to do good. they are excellent and helpful for everyone.
target_text: dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a ne, dènge kab'ua hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, èu hud'i pasanèd'e dhèu ho madhutu lii aj'a dhu mola. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, loe boe tenge j'ara sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: avoid pointless discussions, and obsessions about ancestry. don't get into arguments, and avoid fights over the jewish laws-they're useless and don't help at all.
target_text: baku soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu leko-monya, nuka sèmi: pasibha d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, patao iia d'ara dènge dhèu leo, patula-pajuku nèti j'aj'aj'i mia dhu dedha risi, aa patao nèti atora ad'a yahudi. tao ngaa? sèra sa aa'i-aa'i, èci sa gaguna na aad'o. pèci eele lod'o iia d'ara!

source_text: warn someone who is divisive once, and then again-after that don't pay them any attention,
target_text: lamu holo dhèu dhu tema pamae juma'at sèra. ladhe nèngu tao taruu, kai ne. aa ladhe na loe boe, soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: realizing that they're perverse and sinful and have condemned themselves.
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, ngangee na mola heka. nèti tatao unu na ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a mèu sasala na.

source_text: as soon as i send artemas or tychicus to you, try and come to me at nicopolis because i'm planning to spend the winter there.
target_text: ja'a neo hia artemas do tikikus, dhiu paraga dènge èu asa pulu kreta. ladhe na d'ai, èu tenge j'ara sèna ka mai lai-lai paraga dènge ja'a ètu kota nikopolis. te ja'a neo pea ètu nèi d'ara hèru pacuhi ne.

source_text: do all you can to help zenas the lawyer and apollos on their way so that they have everything they need.
target_text: èu tadhe le dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu hukum, ngara na senas, aa angalai na apolos, do? ra neo lasi asa era kaj'èu. de mu bara si, sèna ka ra baku kura ngaa-ngaa ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: may our people learn the habit of doing good in providing for the daily needs of others. they need to be productive!
target_text: te dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus baku madhèdi iia d'ara di. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a, aa bara dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a parluu. dènge sèmi èèna, mamuri ra dènge kab'ua.

source_text: everyone here with me sends their greetings. give our best wishes to those who love us, those who trust in god. may grace be with you all.
target_text: titus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e pa'adhu lii maho'o hia èu. aa hia kahèi mi angalai ji'i dhu sama-sama parcaya lamatua yesus. ja'a sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: this letter is sent from paul, prisoner of jesus christ, and from our brother timothy, to philemon, our good friend and co-worker;
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. angalai ja'a, timotius, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèna ka èu me'a, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne, lula ja'a peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, pilmon, dhu ji'i sue, aa dhu j'aj'i angalai ètu d'ara sasab'a;

source_text: to our sister apphia, to archippus who fights alongside us, and to your house church.
target_text: hia ina apfia, dhu ji'i tadhe nuka sèmi ana hèni ji'i; hia arkipus, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a ne'e; dènge hia juma'at dhu tema sabaj'a sama-sama ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: may you have grace and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi dedha miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: i always thank my god for you, remembering you in my prayers,
target_text: pilmon! lod'o-lod'o dhu ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula mamuri èu.

source_text: because i hear of your trust in the lord jesus and your love for all believers.
target_text: te ja'a tadèngi ae le nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus, dènge sasue èu mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya.

source_text: i pray that you will put the generous nature of your trust in god into action as you recognize all the good things we share in christ.
target_text: lula lalèka èu, èu bisa mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu parcaya dhu leo sèra. ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ho ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a miu èci dènge èci, miu bisa me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu èdhi bisa tao hia lamatua yesus.

source_text: your love, my dear brother, has brought me much happiness and encouragement. you have really inspired those of us who believe!
target_text: sasue èu èèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ja'a, aa pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. aa sasue èu èèna ka, pa'èra kahèi d'ara dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: that's why even though i'm brave enough in christ to order you to do your duty, i would rather ask you this favor out of love. old paul, now also a prisoner of christ jesus,
target_text: a'a, ee! ja'a parluu ciki, sèmi ne'e: ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dènge hak kahèi ho paredha èu, sèna ka tao j'ara ne'e. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe tao paredha di, dhoka neo manèngi èu bantu di, nuka sèmi dhèu heka dhu to'a mi dedha èu. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho lula madhutu yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka ja'a bani manèngi èu soru-bara ja'a, lula ja'a ke'a sasue èu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: is appealing to you on behalf of onesimus who became my adopted son during my imprisonment.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pad'elo sasue èu mi ana ja'a, onesimus. nèngu èèna, nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, te nèngu parcaya yesus nèti sasab'a ja'a, ropa ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne.

source_text: in the past he was of no use to you, but now he's useful to both you and me!
target_text: ja'a ke'a, onesimus ne, ènu èu dhu rai nèti èu. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna nèngu dhu laku boe ètu katanga madha èu. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a parcaya nèngu nèti gaguna ae-ae hia èdhi dua ti.

source_text: i send him to you with my fondest wishes.
target_text: ja'a sue ne titu kèna. te ngaa hud'i laa, ja'a pua na lèpa hari asa èu.

source_text: i'd have preferred to keep him here with me so that he could have helped me as you would have done while i am in chains for telling the good news.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, na, ja'a taha onesimus sèna ka gati èu, ho nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e. te ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho ne. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, lula peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus.

source_text: but i decided not to do anything without your permission. i didn't want you to be forced to do good, but to do so willingly.
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe sèna ka èu sad'i madhutu di, ladhe èu rasa dhèu laka-seti èu. dad'èi ja'a, na, èu tao dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi èu unu mu. de ladhe èu mo'o mèka sèmi dènge be'a lii manèngi ja'a, na, ja'a ko'o boe tao ngaa ciki sa mi onesimus ne, lula dhu hak dhoka èu di.

source_text: maybe you lost him for a while so that you could have him back forever!
target_text: ele boe èu pangee sèmi ne'e: lamatua soro tèke onesimus ele nèti èu d'ara ciki oo'e ne, sèna ka na mai hari ho pea taruu dènge èu.
