target_text: abhu dhu pamakae dènge pahahe miu ètu madha dhèu ae. abhu kahèi dhu ra tao sèmi èèna mi angalai miu, dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: you showed your sympathy for those in prison, and took it cheerfully when your possessions were confiscated, knowing that you have something better coming that will truly last.
target_text: miu rasa kasia aa pad'elo d'ara be'a mi dhèu dhu ra pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho. ladhe dhèu mana'u rèti mèdha-panyau miu, miu mau-mau sène, lula miu me'a, na, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu dhu be'a risi, dhu dhèu bisa heka mana'u rare.

source_text: so don't lose your confidence in god-it will be richly rewarded.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu. te èèna na lamatua b'ala hia miu, ae-ae.

source_text: you need to be patient so that having done what god wants, you'll receive what he has promised.
target_text: de taha taruu! te ladhe miu tao madhutu aa'i dad'èi lamatua, èèna na miu abhu aa'i dhu na jaji le hia miu.

source_text: in just a little while he will come, as he said-he won't delay.
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri le lula-nèti dhèu dhu neo mai, peka na, baku paroe d'ara, te nèbhu boe, dhèu dhu neo mai èèna, cèu, aa na pamate heka.

source_text: those who do what is right will live by trusting in god, and if they draw back from their commitment, i won't be pleased with them.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'ara mola, èèna na nèngu abhu mamuri, lula na parcaya ja'a. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pakaj'èu nèti ja'a, d'ara ja'a karej'e boe.

source_text: but we're not the kind of people who draw back and end up being lost. we are those who trust in god to save us.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi, dhèu dhu pakaj'èu boe nèti ama lamatua. te dhèu dhu pakaj'èu nèti lamatua, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti nèngu. te ngaa èdhi dhèu dhu parcaya ama lamatua. ka nèngu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi, ho mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: now our trust in god is the guarantee of what we hope for, the evidence of what we can't see.
target_text: ladhe èdhi parcaya ama lamatua, sasoa na, èdhi lèka tare'a-re'a nèngu taruu. te ladhe na moa le hia èdhi j'ara èci, èdhi te'a, na, tatu na tao madhutu lii pajaji nèngu èèna. masi ka èdhi abhu mèka ngaa-ngaa, èdhi parcaya ne taruu.

source_text: people who lived long ago trusted god and this is what gained them god's approval.
target_text: abhu bèi-baki èdhi dhu parcaya sèmi èèna kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a.

source_text: through our trust in god we understand that the whole universe was created by god's command, that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
target_text: rai-haha dènge liru dhu èdhi ladhe tèdhi ne, èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua ka paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa na tao boe nèti mèdha dhu j'aj'i le, dhu dhèu bisa rèdhi. aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i se, j'aj'i nèti lii padhai na di.

source_text: by trusting him abel offered god a better sacrifice than cain, and as a result god identified him as someone who lived right. god showed this by accepting his offering. even though abel has been dead for a long time, he still speaks to us through what he did.
target_text: habel parcaya ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, nèngu nèti mèdha persembahan dhu be'a risi nèti a'a na kaen. ama lamatua sèmi nare habel dènge mèdha persembahan na, lula d'ara na mola. de masi ka na madhe nèbhu le, te ngaa èdhi bisa tare conto nèti nèngu, lula lalèka na.

source_text: by trusting god enoch was taken to heaven so he didn't experience death. he couldn't be found on earth because god took him to heaven. before this happened he was known as someone god was pleased with.
target_text: henok parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua nedhe nèti ne asa sorga, sèna ka baku madhe. dhèu patangi-tenge ne, te ngaa rage boe, lula lamatua dhu paca'e le. lamatua sèmi nare ne dènge be'a, te lamatua dhu peka, na, henok ne, dhèu dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: you can't expect god to be pleased with you if you don't trust him! anyone who comes to god must believe that god exists, and that he rewards those who are searching for him.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e a'ari! dhu lèke ka, ama lamatua sèmi nare boe dhèu dhu parcaya boe nèngu. te dhèu dhu neo la'e asa madha ama lamatua hud'i parcaya, peka na, lamatua dhu mema-mema. aa nèngu hud'i parcaya kahèi, peka na, lamatua soru nare dhèu dhu patangi-tenge ne.

source_text: noah trusted god, and was warned by him about things that had never happened before. because noah paid serious attention to what god said, he constructed an ark to save his family. by trusting god, noah showed that the world was wrong, and received the reward of being set right by god.
target_text: noh parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, noh parcaya lamatua ropa lamatua peka mema dènge ne, noh! sanèd'e, ee! èèna na ja'a palaho eele rai-haha ne, pake èi aae lala dhu dhèu rai-haha ne rèdhi mèka ca tèka sa. masi ka noh paraga nèdhi mèka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu nanene ka tao madhutu lii lamatua, hèia na tao kapa, sèna ka nèngu dènge isi èmu na abhu sod'a. lula lalèka na, ka lamatua cap ne dhèu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu lèka boe sèra, lamatua hia si hahuku dhu bia.

source_text: through trusting god abraham obeyed when god called him to go to the land god was going to give him. he left, not knowing where he was going.
target_text: abraham parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua paroa ne, peka na, abraham! kalua nèti rai èta-èsu èu ne, ho lamu asa era dhu pe ja'a pad'elo dènge mu. te rai èèna, bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi pusaka ana-èpu èu. tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, abraham tao madhutu, masi ka nèngu ne'a boe la'e asa era mia.

source_text: trusting in god he lived in the promised land-but as a foreigner, living in tents, together with isaac and jacob who shared with him in inheriting the same promise.
target_text: ropa abraham d'ai era èèna, na patitu paleo, ho pea nuka sèmi dhèu tao mai ètu rai èèna dhu lamatua pajaji le dènge ne. ka ana na isak dènge èpu na yakob pea ètu èèna, te lamatua dhu padhadha le hia rai ne j'aj'i pusaka rèngu.

source_text: for abraham was looking forward to a city built on foundations that last, with god as its builder and maker.
target_text: na sanao, sèna ka nèngu pea ètu kota cue dhu saraga titu kèna. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu gambar ho pakèd'i kota ne.

source_text: by her trust in god even sarah herself was given the ability to conceive a child though she was too old, because she trusted god who had made the promise.
target_text: dhèu èmu abraham, ngara na sara, parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. masi ka nara iisi nèdhi mèka, aa dhu heka bhora le, te ngaa lamatua tao ne j'aj'i bèi-baki nèti dhèu ca nau-ca nadha. te nèngu parcaya, na, tatu ama lamatua tao madhutu ngaa dhu na jaji le.

source_text: that is why the descendants of abraham who was as good as dead! became as numerous as the stars of heaven, as countless as the sand of the sea shore.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, masi ka nèngu heka bhora le, nèngu bisa nara iisi era, ka abhu ana-èpu ae-ae, toke ige rare boe. te dhèu se ae, nuka sèmi hua-hètu ètu dedha-liru, aa sèmi salae nebhe dhasi.

source_text: they all died still trusting in god. though they didn't receive the things god promised, they were still looking for them as it were from a distance and welcomed them, acknowledging that on this earth they were foreigners, people just passing through.
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge yakob parcaya taruu ama lamatua, toke madhe. te ngaa rèngu dhae abhu mèka rai dhu lamatua pajaji èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu ma'ète boe sanao dènge d'ara karej'e, te rèngu rèdhi le nèti kaj'èu. te rèngu dhu mangaku, na, rèngu se dhèu leo rai kara dhu pea manubha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: people who say such things make it clear that they're looking for a country of their own.
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe dhèu peka sèmi èèna, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu d'èi titu kèna abhu rai cue dhu j'aj'i unu rèngu.

source_text: for if they cared about the country they'd left behind, they could have returned.
target_text: ladhe rai dhu bèi-baki èdhi d'èi, nuka rai èta-èsu abraham, na, tatu rèngu bisa lèpa hari asa era nèi, lod'o mia èèna ka.

source_text: but they're looking for a better country instead, a heavenly country. that is why god isn't disappointed with them, and is happy to be called their god, for he has built a city for them.
target_text: te ngaa rai èta-èsu dhu rèngu d'èi titu kèna, nuka rai èta-èsu dhu saraga bia ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. te na pamèci nare le kota cue hia si ètu sorga.

source_text: abraham trusted god when he was tested and offered isaac to god. abraham, who had accepted god's promises, was still ready to offer to god his only son, even though he'd been told, it's through isaac that your descendants will be counted.
target_text: parcaya abraham hali boe nèti ama lamatua, ropa lamatua uji parcaya na. nèti èèna ka, na tao madhutu paredha lamatua, ho saraka ana na isak j'aj'i korban. aa te ngaa uru èèna, lamatua dhu moa le, lula-nèti ana ne, peka na, nèti ana mu isak ne, bèli-camèd'a èu abhu ana-èpu udhu sobhu-sobhu, toke ra j'aj'i suku dhu kapai titu kèna.

source_text: abraham had thought it through and decided that god could bring isaac back to life from the dead. in a sense that's what did happen-abraham received isaac back from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa abraham pangee le, na, ama lamatua dhu dènge koasa, ho pamamuri hari dhèu madhe. mema, èèna ka dhu lèke, te lod'o èèna, sama sèmi nèngu abhu hari ana na j'aj'i le mi korban.

source_text: trusting in god, isaac blessed jacob and esau in regard to what the future would bring.
target_text: isak parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, na manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana na, yakob dènge esau.

source_text: trusting in god, jacob as he was dying blessed each of joseph's sons, and worshiped god, leaning on his staff.
target_text: yakob parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. nèti èèna ka, lod'o nèngu oe madhe, pakaseti kèd'i titu dènge kabodho kabhuku dènge kèpe tatea na, pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua. hèia manèngi ho lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi èpu na, ana nèti yusuf.

source_text: trusting in god, joseph too, when his own death approached, spoke about the exodus of the israelites, and gave instructions about what to do with his bones.
target_text: yusuf parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lod'o na oe madhe, nèngu parcaya, na, ama lamatua pe lere nèti dhèu na, dhèu isra'el sèra, kalua nèti rai masir. nèti èèna ka, na moa tèke mi rèngu, ho rèti rui na ropa rèngu tèke eele rai masir.

source_text: trusting in god, moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born. they recognized he was a special child. they weren't afraid to go against what the king had commanded.
target_text: ina-ama musa parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lod'o ina na nara iisi ne, ra pahuni ne toke d'ai tèlu hèru kateme, lula ra ladhe na mone iia. aa ra madha'u boe dhèu aae masir, masi ka paredha le dhèu, peka na, pamadhe aa'i ana-ana mone ibrani dhu rara iisi hiu!

source_text: trusting in god, moses, when he grew up, refused to be known as the adopted son of pharaoh's daughter.
target_text: ropa musa kapai mai, na parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. te uru èèna, ana bhèni dhèu aae masir, dhu ded'e nare le nèngu sèna ka j'aj'i mi ana na. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa musa d'èi boe ladhe dhèu pangee, na, nèngu ne a'ari nèti dhèu aae masir.

source_text: instead he chose to share in the sufferings of god's people rather than to enjoy the temporary pleasures of sin.
target_text: te na pangee, na, be'a risi nèngu mamuri j'èra sama-sama dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra. sad'i nèngu baku mamuri karej'e dènge j'ara bhelu-katub'a, dhu dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di.

source_text: he counted the rejection he experienced from following christ to be of far greater value than the wealth of egypt-because he was focused on the reward to come.
target_text: nèngu soro tèke dhèu pahahe ne, lula nèngu sanao-maena taruu mi kristus, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji le neo hia na mai. nèngu taha sèmi èèna, lula ne'a, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua bagi hia ne hadia dhu be'a risi nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i ètu rai masir.

source_text: trusting in god, he left egypt and wasn't scared of pharaoh's anger-he kept going with his eyes fixed on the invisible god.
target_text: musa parcaya ama lamatua kahèi, lod'o na manèngi isin nèti dhèu aae masir, ho lere nèti bèi-baki èdhi kalua nèti rai masir. masi ka dhèu aae nasa titu kèna, te ngaa musa madha'u boe dènge ne. musa lèka taruu ama lamatua, masi ka tèdhi boe senu-salao na, te ngaa nuka sèmi musa dhu nèdhi.

source_text: trusting in god he observed the passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroying angel would not touch the israelites.
target_text: musa parcaya lamatua kahèi, ropa rèngu pa'èra neo kalua nèti rai masir. te nèngu madhutu mèno paredha lamatua, aa pua bèi-baki èdhi tao paska hiu-hiu, dènge roro kahib'i-kalèbho, sèna ka tao badha korban. hèia rare raa kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, sèna ka tao tadha mi babèdho èmu ra. mèda èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga puru mai pamadhe ana uuru aa'i-aa'i ètu rai masir. te ngaa na pamadhe boe ana uuru ètu èmu dhèu isra'el, lula ladhe nèdhi raa dhu ra pici ètu babèdho èmu.

source_text: trusting in god the israelites crossed the red sea as if it were dry land. when the egyptians attempted to do the same they were drowned.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi kalua nèti rai masir, rèngu parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. lula lalèka ra, ka lamatua cèri eele èi dhasi mi dua ètu dhasi mea, sèna ka rèngu kako asa cabèka dènge be'a, ètu dedha rai mango. te ngaa sordad'u masir dhu bata si sèra, madhe aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, ropa neo pège asa cabèka.

source_text: trusting in god, the israelites marched around the walls of jericho for seven days, and the walls fell down.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi maso asa rai kana'an, rèngu parcaya ama lamatua kahèi. te rèngu madhutu paredha na, dènge kako rai-reo re li'u tembok ètu kota jeriko, toke pidhu lod'o kateme. ka tembok ne guri laho mae-mae.

source_text: trusting in god, rahab the prostitute didn't die with those who rejected god, because she had welcomed the israelite spies in peace.
target_text: lod'o èèna, rahab ètu kota èèna kahèi. uru èèna, nèngu j'aj'i bhèni kajeo. lula na parcaya ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka na sèmi nare mata-mata dhèu isra'el, aa palu'u si ètu d'ara èmu na. hèia lamatua pamadhe aa'i dhèu jeriko, lula ro'o boe nanene nèngu. te ngaa lamatua hia mamuri mi rahab, lula na lèka ne.

source_text: what other examples should i give? i don't have time to talk about gideon, barak, samson, jephthah; about david, samuel, and the prophets.
target_text: ja'a bisa padhai lii madhera hari era, j'ara-j'ara dhèu leo dhu parcaya ama lamatua. te ngaa ja'a abhu boe lod'o taleo, ho lole toke lutu, lula-nèti gideon, barak, simson, yefta, daud, samuel, dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo sèra.

source_text: because of their trust in god they conquered kingdoms, did what was good and right, received god's promises, shut the mouths of lions,
target_text: rèngu se aa'i-aa'i ra parcaya ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu segi dhèu aae-dhèu aae. abhu dhu pakako paredha dènge d'ara mola, ho sarii dhèu dhu sala boe, aa huku dhèu dhu sala. abhu dhu sèmi rare ngaa dhu lamatua jaji le. aa abhu kahèi segi badha singa.

source_text: put out blazing fires, escaped being killed by the sword, were weak but made strong, did mighty deeds in war, and routed enemy armies.
target_text: abhu dhu pamadhe ai dhu heo robhe-robhe. abhu dhu ama lamatua ère nare si nèti dhèu dhu neo pamadhe si pake samala. abhu dhu roe, te ngaa ama lamatua pa'èra si. abhu dhu lamatua tao si ho èra aae ètu d'ara pamusu, toke musu rai.

source_text: women were given their dead family members back through resurrection. others were tortured, refusing to compromise and be pardoned, because they wanted to be part of a better resurrection.
target_text: abhu kahèi ina-ina dhu paraga hari dènge dhèu rèngu dhu ama lamatua pamamuri hari si nèti mamadhe ra. te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra, lula parcaya ama lamatua. rèngu d'èi risi madhe, sèna ka baku tèke eele parcaya rèngu mi ama lamatua. te rèngu pa'èci taruu dènge ne. de rèngu dhu sanao-maena, na, bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo ded'e ra, sèna ka abhu mamuri dhu be'a risi hari ètu sorga.

source_text: yet others suffered insults and whippings; they were put in chains and imprisoned.
target_text: abhu dhu pa-aape si, aa abhu dhu lèke gama. abhu dhu leo dhu lèke ngapi haga ra dènge ngangapi ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: some were stoned, cut in pieces, tempted, killed by the sword. some dressed in sheepskins and goatskins: destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.
target_text: abhu dhu madhe, lula lèke pèci dènge hadhu. abhu dhu roro pamadhe si, pake raroro. abhu dhu dhèu pare pamadhe si pake samala. abhu dhu mamuri dènge boe unu, toke ra pake ka'uri badha, lula abhu dhèu dhu paj'èra dènge pasusa si, toke babèga eele si,

source_text: the world was not worthy to have such people who wandered in the deserts and mountains, living in caves and holes in the ground.
target_text: ka rai lasi asa pad'a sod'a, ledhe-ledhe, d'ara loe, dènge asa d'ara ro'a rai. ra tao dhèu se'e dhu laku-laku boe, aa babège-lalèta si asa era dhu karehe. aa te ngaa lalèka ra èra titu kèna, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne nia boe pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi se'e se.

source_text: all of these people, even though they had god's approval, didn't receive what god had promised.
target_text: lamatua koa dhèu sèmi se'e se, lula ra parcaya ne. te ngaa toke ra madhe, rèngu abhu mèka ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha tèka.

source_text: god has given us something even better, so that they can't be complete without us.
target_text: lamatua neo tao madhutu lii padhadha na dènge j'ara dhu be'a risi. lula na d'èi, sèna ka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne: nuka èdhi tadhe mèu le kristus, dènge rèngu dhu madhe uuru sèra.

source_text: for that reason, since we are surrounded by such a great crowd of people who gave evidence of their trust in god, let's get rid of everything that holds us back, the seductive sins that trip us up, and let's keep on running the race placed before us.
target_text: de tasamia dènge èdhi dhu mamuri lod'o limuri ne? èdhi cakaraa dhèu dhu madhutu pa'uji rai. bèi-baki èdhi dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra nuka sèmi dhèu dhu titu lingu rare èdhi, ho pa'èra d'ara èdhi. te ngaa èdhi dhu pa'èki dènge sasala era, sèra sa ka dhu pabia haga èdhi ka rai tara boe. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i core eele ku sasala sèra aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka èdhi bisa rai èra. te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu pili èdhi, ho madhutu pa'uji rai ne, de èdhi hud'i taha ku, sèna ka rai taruu toke d'ai lane.

source_text: we should keep on looking to jesus, the one who begins and completes our trust in god. because of the joy ahead of him jesus endured the cross, disregarding its shame, and sat down at the right hand of god's throne.
target_text: aa èdhi hud'i rai, mage piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa ladhe dhoka asa yesus di. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, ho èdhi bisa parcaya ama lamatua. aa èèna na nèngu soru-bara èdhi, sèna ka èdhi parcaya taruu toke èle. sanèd'e, do aad'o? lod'o yesus dui j'aj'èra ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, dhèu pahahe ne, te ngaa na taha taruu, lii boe-ugu boe. te ne'a, na, j'aj'èra na èle kèna, ka d'ara na j'aj'i karae. èèna ka dhu lèke. te na madhe, hèia ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne, èle ka na nedhe pamadhèdi kristus ètu baboa g'ana na, ho paredha sama-sama dènge ne.

source_text: think about jesus who endured such hostility from sinful people so you don't grow tired and become discouraged.
target_text: masi ka dhèu paj'èra bia ne, te ngaa na taha taruu. de miu baku bhèlu dènge j'aj'èra yesus, sèna ka miu bisa taha mere, aa baku roe.

source_text: your resistance so far hasn't cost you blood as you fight against sin.
target_text: miu lab'a le j'ara bhabhelu-katub'a, te ngaa lalab'a miu èra mèka, toke raa miu suti. tare'a si!

source_text: have you forgotten god's appeal to you when he reasons with you as his children? he says, my child, don't treat the lord's discipline lightly, and don't give up when he corrects you either.
target_text: ele boe miu bhèlu lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu na peka le dènge miu, nuka sèmi ca dhèu ama padhai lii dènge ana na, peka na, ana, ee! ladhe ama èdhi dhu huku ho aj'a èu, sèna ka èu mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, èu baku pamud'e! aa ladhe na kai ho aj'a èu, na, èu baku paroe d'ara.

source_text: the lord disciplines everyone he loves, and he punishes everyone he welcomes as his child.
target_text: te ama èdhi kai ho aj'a dhèu dhu na sue. mema dhèu-dhèu dhu na sèmi nare j'aj'i ana na, nèngu kai ho aj'a si.

source_text: be patient as you experience god's discipline because he is treating you as his children. what child doesn't experience a father's discipline?
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua kai ho aj'a miu sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke, na, taha taruu aa sèmi mere. na tao sèmi èèna, lula miu j'aj'i le ana na. te ama aa'i-aa'i hud'i kai ho aj'a ana na, toke ana na bisa mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: if you are not disciplined which everyone has experienced, then you are illegitimate and not true children.
target_text: te ladhe ama lamatua kai boe ho aj'a miu sama sèmi ana na dhu leo sèra, sasoa na, miu se ana nèngu boe.

source_text: for if we respected our earthly fathers who disciplined us, shouldn't we even more be subject to the discipline of our spiritual father which leads to life?
target_text: èdhi tema pakab'ua ama matana èdhi ètu rai-haha ne, lula na kai ho aj'a-nori ti, lod'o èdhi dhu ana iiki era. dhu lèke na kèna. te ngaa dhu be'a risi hari, èdhi hud'i nanene ku ama lamatua dènge be'a, lula nèngu ne, ama èdhi ètu sorga, aa na kai ho aj'a-nori èdhi, sèna ka èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara na dhu lèke.

source_text: they disciplined us for a short while as they thought appropriate, but god does so for our benefit in order that we can share his holy character.
target_text: ama matana èdhi kai ho aj'a èdhi, dhoka d'ara ciki oo'e di, madhutu ngaa dhu na ngee na be'a. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu ne'a risi, ngaa dhu èdhi parluu te'a. nèti èèna ka, na kai ho aj'a èdhi, sèna ka mamuri mola-mèci sama sèmi nèngu.

source_text: when it happens, all discipline seems painful and not something to be happy about. but later on it produces peace in those who have been trained in this way so that they do what is good and right.
target_text: mema èdhi d'èi boe ladhe abhu lii kai. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, d'ara èdhi j'aj'i mau, lula te'a tare le mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: so strengthen your feeble hands, and your weak knees! make straight paths to walk on, so that those who are crippled won't lose their way, but will be healed.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! pa'èra kacui-aai miu dhu roe, aa pasamaa haga miu dhu bia. baku rai piku g'ana-kariu, te ngaa rai mola taruu, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara rèngu dhu roe-bhilu ho bisa rai taruu. miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara miu, sèna ka taha taruu ètu d'ara parcaya mi kristus.

source_text: do your best to live in peace with everybody, and look for holiness-if you don't have this you won't see the lord.
target_text: a'ari dhu parcaya kristus! miu hud'i pa'èra ngi'u mi, sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci. aa baku loe tenge j'ara ho mamuri mola-mèci. te dhèu dhu mola-mèci boe, bisa boe rèdhi ama lamatua.

source_text: make sure that none of you lack god's grace, in case some cause of bitterness arises to give trouble and end up corrupting many of you.
target_text: pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci, sèna ka mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu rai, toke rasa heka d'ara hua iia ama lamatua. aa j'aga paie ho baku soro tèke ladhe abhu dhu papèd'a d'ara ètu talora aae miu. te èèna nuka sèmi raco dhu pa'ele iie dhèu ae.

source_text: make sure there's nobody who is sexually immoral, or irreligious, like esau was. he sold his birthright for a single meal.
target_text: mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu. aa mage-mage aa j'aga ho baku abhu dhèu nèti miu dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, nuka sèmi esau. esau ne, ana uuru isak. ca lod'o, esau lèpa dènge kabake manganga. na manèngi nganga'a ca pega nèti ari na yakob, ho b'ae pake hak ana uuru.

source_text: you remember that even when he wanted to receive the blessing later on he was refused. even though he really tried, and cried hard, esau couldn't change what he had done.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, nèbhu boe ka, esau manyasa. te ropa isak neo manèngi lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ana uuru na esau, te ngaa bisa heka, lula esau dhu hia iia d'ara le hak ana uuru na. nèti èèna ka, masi ka na tangi roma iisi, tasamia èèna ka, nèngu bisa heka abhu ngaa dhu uru èèna nèngu core eele.

source_text: you haven't arrived at a physical mountain that can be touched, that burned with fire, to a stormy place of black darkness,
target_text: sèmi ne'e a'ari! èdhi bisa lati le asa madha ama lamatua, madhutu j'ara hiu dhu na bhoke nare le hia èdhi. te ngaa uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi bisa mèka sèmi èèna. te lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge rèngu, rèngu padètu dènge ledhe sinai. ètu dedha ledhe ne, abhu ai dhu heo. abhu ngèlu aae kahèi. aa maroga saguru nare ledhe ne, ka dhèu se madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: where the sound of a trumpet and a voice speaking was heard-and those who heard the voice begged never to hear it speak to them again.
target_text: rèngu tadèngi lii tiu tèbhe kahèi, hèia lii dhu mèdhu aae nèti lamatua kalua nèti ledhe ne. ropa tadèngi lii lamatua, hèia asa ra madha'u, toke ra manèngi musa, peka na, ira ii! ji'i bisa heka taha dènge lii nèi!

source_text: for they couldn't take what they were told to do, such as, even if a farm animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death.
target_text: rèngu mema bisa boe taha, lula ngaa dhu lamatua paredha èèna, bia titu kèna. te na peka, na, ca dhèu sa bisa boe j'èli ledhe ne! masi ka dhèu, do badha! te dhèu cee dhu j'èli ledhe ne, hud'i lèke pèci toke madhe.

source_text: the sight was so terrifying that moses himself said, i'm so scared i'm shaking!
target_text: ngaa dhu rèngu ladhe rèdhi ètu ledhe ne, mema pamadha'u tare'a, toke musa karèbha kahèi.

source_text: but you have arrived at mount zion, the city of the living god, heavenly jerusalem, with its thousands and thousands of angels.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, j'ara asa lamatua bhoke tèke le, aa èdhi bisa patoo madha padhai lii dènge ne. limuri ne, èdhi lati asa ledhe cue, ngara na sion. ètu era ne'e, abhu kota yerusalem. kota yerusalem ne, ètu boe rai-haha ne, te ngaa kota yerusalem hiu ètu sorga, era pea ama lamatua. ètu nèi, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua ae-ae, toke riho-riho, dhu loe boe tao pesta.

source_text: you have come to the church of the firstborn whose names are written down in heaven, to god, the judge of everyone, and to those good people whose lives are complete.
target_text: ètu kota nèi kahèi, j'aj'i le era pakaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. te ama lamatua dhu tao nare le daftar, ho suri ngara ra èci-èci ètu sorga. ètu era nèi kahèi, ama lamatua neo parisa aa tai-dadoo mamuri dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ètu nèi kahèi, pakaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna ama lamatua sèmi nare si dènge be'a, lula ra parcaya ne. ètu nèi, rèngu j'aj'i kateme ètu madha lamatua.

source_text: you have come to jesus, who shares with us the new agreed relationship, to the sprinkled blood that means more than that of abel.
target_text: aa yesus kahèi ètu era nèi, dhu j'aj'i mi kalete hia ama lamatua dènge dhèu rai-haha. yesus madhe, pasuti raa na, sèna ka ama lamatua bisa pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge èdhi. nèti èèna ka, raa yesus ne, cuhi d'ara ama lamatua. te ngaa raa yesus leko-leo nèti raa habel ètu d'ara sasuri lii lolo dhu uru tèka. te lod'o kain pamadhe habel, raa habel dhu suti èèna, papana d'ara ama lamatua, toke na huku kain.

source_text: make sure you don't reject the one who is speaking! if they didn't escape when they rejected god on earth, it is even more certain that we won't escape if we turn away from god who warns us from heaven!
target_text: pasa dhilu pabe'a-be'a, ho nanene ngaa dhu ama lamatua neo peka dènge miu. baku tao sèmi bèi-baki èdhi dhu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai musa, lod'o na j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua ètu rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka lamatua huku si. ngaa hari dènge èdhi se! ladhe èdhi to'o boe nanene lii na nèti sorga, tatu nèngu huku èdhi bia risi eele!

source_text: back then god's voice shook the earth, but his promise is now: one more time i'm going to shake not only the earth, but heaven too.
target_text: lod'o bèi-baki èdhi titu ètu ledhe sinai, lii lamatua dhu mèdhu èèna, tao rai opo. limuri ne na moa, na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tao ne opo ca tèka hari. mesa boe rai di opo, te ngaa liru opo kahèi.

source_text: this expression, one more time, indicates that all creation that is shaken is removed so that everything that is not shaken may remain.
target_text: lod'o lamatua peka, na, nèngu neo tao opo aa'i-aa'i ca tèka hari, sasoa na, lamatua neo pagaged'o aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha ne, toke abhu dhu bisa boe taha. ele aa'i si. te dhu taha di, nuka dhu pea taruu.

source_text: since we're receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have a gracious attitude, so we can serve god in a way that pleases him, with reverence and respect.
target_text: ama lamatua nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. èèna bisa boe laho. ngaa-ngaa tao boe! lula na neo sèmi nare, na, miu maso j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na ètu nèi. de mai ho èdhi manèngi makasi mi nèngu, pahaha iisi mi nèngu, aa ded'e padedha-dedha ne, lula dadedha na.

source_text: for our god is a fire that consumes.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi baku pamud'e kahèi, lula nanasa ama lamatua nuka sèmi ai dhu na'e pakèpu aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: may love for each other as brothers and sisters always continue!
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu pèri-pèri j'ara dhu ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu. baku bhèlu pasue taruu a'ari dhèu parcaya.

source_text: don't forget to show love for strangers too, because by doing so some have welcomed angels without knowing it.
target_text: baku bhèlu bhoke d'ara sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu dhu miu tadhe boe asa d'ara èmu mi. te abhu pèri-pèri a'ari dhu sèmi rare dhèu, te ngaa re'a boe, na, dhèu sèra, ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: remember those who are locked up in prison as if you were imprisoned with them. remember those who are mistreated as if you were physically suffering with them.
target_text: baku bhèlu tao ai-hèb'a mi dhèu ètu d'ara bui, te ra kèpa si lula ra parcaya kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i soru-bara si, nuka sèmi miu ka dhu ra kèpe rare. aa mage bhèlu soru-bara dhèu dhu lèke j'aj'èra nèti dhèu. lalau si pabe'a-be'a, nuka sèmi miu mesa mi ka dhu abhu j'aj'èra èèna.

source_text: everyone should honor marriage. husbands and wives should be faithful to each other. god will judge adulterers.
target_text: paleo èmu èèna, mola-mèci. te ngaa mage paleo èmu dhu mola-mèci ne, j'aj'i mi kaj'alu. te tatu ama lamatua huku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: don't love money; be content with what you have. god himself has said, i'll never let you down; i'll never give up on you.
target_text: baku manga'a doi-dhari. te ngaa miu hud'i mamuri nèti ngaa dhu miu abhu, te èèna d'ai le. ama lamatua dhu peka le, na, ja'a bhèlu boe miu. ja'a soro tèke boe miu.

source_text: that's why we can confidently say, the lord is the one who helps me, so i won't be afraid. what can anyone do to me?
target_text: de pa'èra d'ara miu, nuka sèmi dhu ra suri, na, lula lamatua ja'a neo soru-bara ja'a, nèti èèna ka, ja'a madha'u boe. te abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa cèri eele ja'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: remember your leaders who explained god's word to you. look again at the results of their lives, and imitate their trust in god.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhèu-dhèu dhu uru sèra aj'a-nori miu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. pajiko paie-iie j'ara mamuri ra, aa madhutu lalèka ra. te, dhu rèngu parcaya, nuka:

source_text: jesus christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
target_text: yesus kristus ub'a nèdhi boe. nèti uru, doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e, nèngu hali boe.

source_text: don't get distracted by different kinds of strange teachings. it's good for the mind to be convinced by grace, not by laws concerning what we eat. those who followed such laws didn't gain anything.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku madhutu rii nèti a'aj'a dhu sala. ama lamatua tao pa'èra le d'ara miu, lula na pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na dènge miu. lula boe nèti miu madhutu atora nganga'a-nganginu dhu guna boe.

source_text: we have an altar that those priests of the tabernacle have no right to eat from.
target_text: uru-uru sèra, ètu madha paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, abhu mei èci dhu era tèka badha korban. ama agama ka dhu lalau ètu sèra, dhu dènge hak ra'a sisi dhu sisa nèti dedha mei ne. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi dhu dènge le mei leo. aa ama agama rupa dhui dènge boe hak ra'a ètu mei èèna.

source_text: the carcasses of the animals, whose blood is carried by the high priest into the most holy place as an offering for sin, are burned outside the camp.
target_text: uru èèna, tèu mai-tèu mai kètu kapai risi agama nèti raa badha korban, sèna ka tèke asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, lamatua pabhèlu eele sasala ra. èle na, pasae rèti badha ne lasi tunu asa li'u rae.

source_text: in the same way jesus also died outside the city gate so that he could make god's people holy through his own blood.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge yesus. nèngu j'aj'i korban kahèi, sèna ka ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala dhèu rai-haha. aa lod'o j'aj'èra na èèna, ra nuni rèti ne kahèi, ho pamadhe ne asa li'u kota yerusalem.

source_text: so let us go out to him, outside the camp, experiencing and sharing in his shame.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mai ka èdhi lati asa yesus, ho parcaya ne taruu. masi ka dhèu pahahe èdhi, èdhi hud'i pa'èra sèmi tare ne, nuka sèmi yesus.

source_text: for we don't have a permanent city to live in here; we're looking for the home that is still to come.
target_text: te èdhi dhoka manubha taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa èdhi sanao-maena, sèna ka pea ètu kota hiu cue ètu sorga toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: so let us through jesus always offer a sacrifice of praise to god-this means speaking well of god, declaring his character.
target_text: lula yesus j'aj'i le korban pala èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi parluu heka tèti badha korban asa ama lamatua. te ngaa abhu mèdha korban dhu leo era, dhu èdhi hud'i tèti ku hia ne, nuka, koa-kio dhu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara na.

source_text: and don't forget to do what is good, and to share with others what you have, for god is pleased when you make such sacrifices.
target_text: aa mage bhèlu tao j'ara be'a hia dhèu leo. ladhe ra parluu ngaa, lami soru-bara si. te sèra sa, j'aj'i nuka sèmi mèdha persembahan dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: follow your leaders, and do what they tell you, for they are watching out for you and are accountable. act in such a way that they can do this happily-and not with sadness, for that wouldn't help you!
target_text: miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uri miu. te dhèu se'e ka dhu j'aga miu mèda-mèu ètu d'ara mamuri miu dènge ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lapor ku sasab'a rèngu asa ama lamatua. de nanene paie si, sèna ka ra bisa sab'a aa lapor dènge d'ara karej'e. mage dhoka ra peka dènge d'ara dhu laho mae-mae, lula miu tèke eele j'ara mamuri yesus kristus. te ladhe sèmi èèna, na, miu oto boe.

source_text: please pray for us. we're convinced we have acted in good conscience, always wanting to do what's good and right in every situation.
target_text: sabaj'a taruu hia ji'i. te d'ara ji'i mema mola, aa ji'i neo tao j'ara be'a taruu.

source_text: i really want you to pray hard so that i can come back to see you soon.
target_text: aa be'a risi hari, sabaj'a sèna ka ja'a bisa lèpa malai asa miu.

source_text: now may the god of peace who raised our lord jesus, the great shepherd of the sheep, from the dead, with the blood of an eternal agreement- may he provide you with all that is good so you can do his will. may he work in us, doing everything that pleases him, through jesus christ-glory to him forever and ever. amen.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pamau d'ara èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka na soru-bara miu, ho miu bisa madhutu aa'i dad'èi na. ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho na soru-bara èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, sèna ka te'a pakarej'e d'ara na. te ama lamatua pake le raa yesus kristus dhu suti èèna, sèna ka pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge èdhi. lii pajaji ne j'aj'i taruu toke d'ai mia-mia. ka ama lamatua pamamuri hari kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de yesus ka dhu ladhe-leru èdhi limuri ne, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a risi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ded'e kolongara na padedha-dedha, aa koa-kio ne taa-taa! èèna ka dhu lèke.

source_text: i want to encourage you, brothers and sisters, to pay attention to what i've written to you in this short letter.
target_text: a'ari pasue! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu sèmi mere lii holo ja'a ne dènge d'ara kateme. te sasuri ne bab'a iiki di.

source_text: you should know that timothy has been set free. if he gets here soon, i will come with him to see you.
target_text: abhu lii lolo dhu ja'a neo miu aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, nuka: a'ari èdhi timotius dhu kalua le nèti d'ara bui. ladhe na mai malai paraga dènge ja'a, èèna na ji'i dua mi palere-lere dhiu asa miu.

source_text: give my greetings to all your leaders, and to all the believers there. the believers here in italy send their greetings.
target_text: ja'a pa'adhu lii maho'o hia kètu miu sèra, aa lii maho'o hia miu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus kristus. a'ari nèti propensi italia hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: may god's grace be with all of you. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na dènge miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka!

source_text: this letter comes from james, servant of god and of the lord jesus christ. it is sent to the twelve tribes scattered abroad. best wishes to you!
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, yakobis. ja'a ne'e ana pua-paleha nèti ama lamatua dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a tao sasuri ne'e hia miu dhèu yahudi dhu pea ètu kabarai dhèu, dhu d'èi madhutu lamatua yesus.

source_text: my friends, choose to stay happy even when all kinds of troubles come your way,
target_text: a'ari! ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: ladhe miu abhu rupa-rupa j'aj'èra, na, baku paroe d'ara. sèmi mere dènge d'ara karej'e, te bèli-camèd'a abhu babe'a.

source_text: because you know that endurance comes from dealing with challenges to your trust in god.
target_text: te èdhi te'a, na, ladhe miu pa'èra-èra ètu d'ara j'aj'èra sèmi èèna, aa pakaj'èu le nèti dadugu, aa miu parcaya lamatua era, èèna ka dhu asa tabha pa'èra d'ara miu, ladhe mi paraga hari dènge dadugu dhu leo.

source_text: let your endurance become as strong as possible, so that you will be completely mature, without any shortcomings.
target_text: baku hari kabodho nèti j'aj'èra. te ngaa miu hud'i taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra, toke miu abhu mamèci, aa kura boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa.

source_text: if any of you need wisdom, ask god, who gives generously to everyone without holding back.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu re'a mèka j'ara kalua nèti j'aj'èra, miu bisa pakarèi mi lamatua dhu ne'a aa'i ngaa-ngaa. nèngu ka dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara kalua hia miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara dènge d'ara karej'e, aa dhu ne'a boe nasa, ladhe miu manèngi.

source_text: but when you ask, remember to trust in god-don't have any doubts. someone who doubts is like the crashing waves of the sea, tossed about and driven by the wind.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe manèngi mi nèngu, na, baku dènge d'ara kacanga. miu hud'i parcaya tare'a ku, na, nèngu bisa hia ngaa dhu miu manèngi. te ladhe dhèu manèngi dènge d'ara kacanga, èèna na nuka sèmi laka dhasi dhu pahaka la'e-mai ladhe lèke ngèlu.

source_text: nobody like that should think they'll get anything from the lord- their minds think every which way, and they're unstable in whatever they do.
target_text: dhèu dhu parcaya kalili boe sèmi èèna, èra boe ètu d'ara j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra. baku maena, na, nèngu abhu ngaa-ngaa nèti lamatua.

source_text: believers who are born poor should take pride in the high position they've been given,
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, nèngu hud'i pakarej'e d'ara na, lula ama lamatua ded'e le nèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: while the rich should boast in the humble position they now have, since they will fade away like flowers in the field. for the sun rises along with the blistering wind and scorches the grass. the flowers fall and their beauty is marred. everything the rich achieve will fade in just the same way.
target_text: aa dhèu kaja dhu parcaya le lamatua yesus, nèngu hud'i karèj'e kahèi, lula lamatua aj'a ne sèna ka baku padedha iisi. limuri ne nèngu ne'a, na, bèli-camèd'a mèdha-panyau na ele aa'i mèu-mèu, nuka sèmi hela bunga dhu saraga, te ngaa ladhe lèke lod'o pana, na kamale eele. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu kaja sèra. masi ka rèngu bhute dènge urusan ra, te ngaa rèngu ele kahèi.

source_text: happy is anyone who patiently endures temptation, for when they've proved that they are trustworthy, they will receive the crown of life which god promises to those who love him.
target_text: lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara dadugu-rariu. hèia na sèmi nare bab'ae rui-j'aj'èra na, nuka mamuri dhu lamatua padhadha le ho pala-bagi mi dhèu dhu sue ne. èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu segi ètu pa'uji olaraga dhu abhu solo juara.

source_text: nobody should say when they're tempted, i'm being tempted by god. for god is not tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, aa neo ad'u-ue madha j'ara dhu sala, baku peka, na, ama lamatua ka dhu sèku ja'a. te ama lamatua neo boe tao sala. aa na sèku nèdhi boe dhèu, sèna ka tao sala.

source_text: temptations come from our own evil desires that lead us astray and entrap us.
target_text: te sasala mai nèti d'ara dhèu. ropa d'ara na neo ad'u-ue j'ara karehe, hèia na kapod'e kahadhu na, sèna ka tao j'ara kaj'alu.

source_text: such desires lead to sin, and sin, when it's fully developed, causes death.
target_text: hèia na tao madhutu ngangee na dhu kaj'alu èèna. d'ai lod'o limuri, ama lamatua huku pamadhe dhèu dhu tao bhabhelu.

source_text: my dear friends, don't be deceived.
target_text: a'ari pasue! baku lèke tipu nèti j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: all that's good, every perfect gift, is from above, and comes down from the father who made heaven's lights. unlike them he doesn't change-he doesn't vary or cause shadows.
target_text: j'ara karehe sèra mai boe nèti lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ka dhu pala-bagi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i, dènge ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu. aa'i-aa'i ra pea boe kalili mi ca'era ètu dedha-liru, aa tao mamaho ra dhu ub'a-ub'a. dhoka ama lamatua di dhu ub'a boe.

source_text: he chose to give us new life through the word of truth, so that out of all his creation we would be very special to him.
target_text: dad'èi lamatua hia mi èdhi sèmi ne'e: na hia mi èdhi lii holo-nori na dhu lèke. aa na pake lii holo-nori na ho hia èdhi mamuri. nèti ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, na hag'e nare le èdhi j'aj'i mi hua-hela dhu uru tèka.

source_text: remember this, my dear friends: everyone should be quick to listen but slow to speak, and slow to get angry,
target_text: a'ari pasue! sanèd'e, ee! dhu be'a èèna sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu baku padhai lii leli di. be'a risi, ropa dhèu leo peka dhu be'a, nèngu pasa dhilu ho nanene uuru ku! aa dhèu baku nasa malai.

source_text: because human anger doesn't reflect the good character of god.
target_text: te ladhe dènge nasa, dhèu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: so get rid of all that's filthy and evil. humbly accept the word that's been implanted within you-for this is what can save you.
target_text: de miu hud'i tunu eele ku sasala mi aa'i-aa'i, sèmi dhèu dhu ko'o pamèu oka-tedhe, ka ra tunu maruru sèra. aa miu hud'i sèmi dènge pahaha iisi mi lii holo-nori lamatua. lii holo-nori sèra, nuka sèmi hini dhu sèle ètu d'ara miu. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a lamatua saku eele sasala mi, aa na sèmi nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: but do what the word says-don't just listen to it and delude yourselves.
target_text: ladhe miu me'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, miu hud'i tao madhutu. baku dhoka nanene di! ladhe miu d'èi dhoka nanene di, te ngaa tao madhutu boe, miu kapod'e-kabèli ngi'u miu unu mi.

source_text: if you just listen to the word, and don't act on it, it's like staring at your own face in a mirror. you see yourself, but then you leave, and immediately forget what you looked like.
target_text: ladhe dhèu tadèngi le lii holo-nori èèna, te ngaa madhutu boe, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu lee rèhu na ètu d'ara tèru. ropa na hari kabodho nèti tèru, nèngu bhèlu eele dènge ka, rèhu na.

source_text: but if you look to the perfect law of freedom and follow it, not as someone who just listens and then forgets, but as someone who acts on it-then you will be blessed in what you do.
target_text: te ngaa miu baku loe parisa paie-iie lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu tesa, dhu bisa pakaj'èu dhèu nèti koasa sasala ra. pe lamatua hia mèngi-nale mi ngaa-ngaa dhu miu tao, sad'i miu nanene, aa tao madhutu lii-lii sèra. baku maso dhoka re dhilu kariu, aa kalua re dhilu g'ana!

source_text: if you think you're religious, but don't control what you say, you deceive yourself-your religion is pointless.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ngee, nèngu maj'èni ètu d'ara agama, te ngaa ne'a boe j'aga hèb'a na, nèngu monya ngi'u nèngu unu na. agama nèngu parcuma.

source_text: in the eyes of our god and father, religion that's pure and genuine is to visit orphans and widows in their suffering, and to keep yourself from being contaminated by the world.
target_text: te ngaa agama dhu lèke, nuka dhu dènge boe kaj'alu. èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. agama dhu lèke èèna, tao d'ara dhèu d'èi soru-bara bhèni balu dènge ana lalu. dhèu dhu dènge agama sèmi sèra, hia boe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne dadugu rèngu asa j'ara karehe.

source_text: my friends, as trusting believers in our glorious lord jesus christ, you must not show favoritism.
target_text: a'ari! tasamia ka miu peka, na, miu parcaya yesus kristus, kètu èdhi dhu kapai èèna, ladhe miu patema hag'e rèhu dhèu? baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: imagine that a man comes into your synagogue wearing gold rings and fine clothes, and then a poor man comes in dressed in rags.
target_text: sèmi abhu dhèu dua dhu lasi asa d'ara èmu sabaj'a miu. ca dhèu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e dènge kadheli hualaa pènu kacui-aai na. ca dhèu hari pake kodho kaj'alu.

source_text: if you pay special attention to the well-dressed man, and say, please sit here in a seat of honor, while you say to the poor man, stand over there, or sit on the floor by my feet,
target_text: hèia miu bhute lami soru dhèu dhu pake mèdha-papake kale'e èèna, ho hia ne madhèdi ètu era be'a re madha. te ngaa dhu pake mèdha-papake kaj'alu èèna, miu pua ne, peka na, lamu titu sa kabodho nèi, ee! do aad'o na, madhèdi ètu rai ne!

source_text: haven't you discriminated and judged with bad motives?
target_text: dènge j'ara miu laladhe rèhu dhèu sèmi èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii dhu bia cabèka. èèna mai nèti ngangee karehe dhu uli miu.

source_text: listen, my dear friends: didn't god choose those who the world considers poor to be rich in their trust in him, and to inherit the kingdom he promised to those who love him?
target_text: a'ari pasue! ama lamatua hag'e nare le dhèu unu aad'o ètu rai-haha ne'e, sèna ka ra parcaya pa'èra mi nèngu. masi ka rèngu dhu dènge boe unu, te ngaa d'ara ra kaja. aa na hag'e si, ho ra abhu unu kahèi ètu d'ara paredha ama lamatua, dhu na pajaji hia mi dhèu-dhèu dhu sue ne.

source_text: but you've treated the poor shamefully. isn't it the rich who oppress you and drag you before the courts?
target_text: te ngaa dènge miu ladhe rèhu dhèu sèmi èèna, miu pahaha le dhèu unu aad'o sèra. te ngaa rèngu tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu karehe mi dedha miu. bhèlu le, do? dhèu kaja sèra ka dhu jajuku mi la'e-mai. aa rèngu sèra ka dhu tenge j'ara ho nuni pa'oro miu asa era pama'ète lii langu. rèngu abhu dhu kee, aa miu abhu sota na.

source_text: don't they insult the honorable name of the one who called you and to whom you belong?
target_text: miu se, dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu kaja sèra ka dhu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara lamatua yesus! nga tao ka miu lami pahaha iisi mi rèngu?

source_text: if you really observe the royal law of scripture: you shall love your neighbor as yourself, then you do well.
target_text: heka lèke kèna, ladhe miu tao madhutu atora èci dhu dedha risi, dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. atora ne dhu suri le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: but if you show favoritism, you're sinning. the law convicts you as guilty of breaking it.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pili madhutu rèhu dhèu, aa mere d'ara dhèu kaja di, miu sisu le atora èèna. madhutu atora lamatua, miu sala le.

source_text: someone who observes everything in the law but fails in just one part is guilty of breaking it all.
target_text: dhèu dhu tao madhutu aa'i atora ama lamatua, te ngaa sisu atora èci di, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu sisu aa'i atora lamatua.

source_text: god told you not to commit adultery, and he also told you not to kill. so if you don't commit adultery, but you do kill, you've become a law-breaker.
target_text: lamatua hia le atora dhu peka, na, miu bhèni-mone baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali miu. aa na hia atora dhu leo kahèi, peka na, baku pamadhe dhèu. de ladhe miu tao boe j'ara karehe, te ngaa miu pamadhe dhèu, èci èèna ka, miu sisu le atora lamatua.

source_text: you should speak and act as people who will be judged by the law of freedom.
target_text: de ladhe miu neo padhai lii, ho neo tao madha j'ara èci, miu hud'i sanèd'e sèmi ne'e ku: pe ama lamatua ka dhu pama'ète, na, èdhi madhutu atora na ho sue dhèu leo, do aad'o. lula atora èèna ka dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti hahuku lamatua.

source_text: anyone who doesn't show mercy will be judged without mercy. yet mercy wins out over judgment!
target_text: te lamatua pusi-pahae boe dhèu dhu sue boe dhèu leo. te ngaa ladhe miu sue dhèu leo, tatu lamatua pahae miu kahèi. miu baku madha'u ladhe abhu hahuku nèti lamatua, lula na ige nare le sèra aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: my friends, what's the good of someone saying they trust in god when they don't do what's good and right? can such trust save them?
target_text: a'ari! ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa ho pad'elo parcaya na, èèna dènge boe guna ngaa-ngaa. parcaya sèmi èèna, bisa boe hia nèngu mamuri.

source_text: if a brother or sister doesn't have clothes, or food for the day,
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu sarani ca dhèu dhu dènge boe mèdha-papake do nganga'a dhu na'a bèli-bèli,

source_text: and you say to them, blessings on you! stay warm and have a good meal! and you don't provide what they need to survive, what's the good of that?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhoka dènge lii padhai lii di, peka na, kako paie-iie, oo! hud'i laa lamatua hia èu berkat! mage lèke lai ngèlu toke pèd'a! baku madhe manganga! guna ngaa padhai lii sèmi èèna, ladhe tao boe ngaa èci sa ho soru-bara si?

source_text: by itself even your trust-based faith in god is dead and worthless if you don't actually do what's good and right.
target_text: de d'ai mèka ladhe peka, èu parcaya di! dènge parcaya di, aa dhu palèke boe dènge tatao, èèna peka mèka, na, ‘parcaya'. te tatao sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi parcaya dhu madhe le, dhu gaguna na aad'o ciki sa.

source_text: someone may argue, you have your trust in god; i have my good deeds. well, show me your trust in god without good deeds, and i will show you my trust in god by my good deeds!
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu tao lii langu, peka na, sad'i dhèu parcaya dhoka lamatua di, parluu heka tao j'ara dhu be'a. dhèu leo dhu tadhe boe lamatua, re'a tao j'ara dhu be'a kahèi. te ngaa j'ara nèngu sèmi ne'e: tadha nèti parcaya èu èèna, nuka tatao èu dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe èu tao boe dhu be'a, ja'a kèdhi boe tadha nèti parcaya èu ne. ja'a bisa pad'elo parcaya ja'a, dènge j'ara ad'u-ue dhu be'a.

source_text: you believe that god is one god? that's great-but demons believe in god too, and they're scared of him!
target_text: èu madhutu a'aj'a dhu peka, na, ama lamatua èèna, dhoka nèngu di. dhu leo aad'o. be'a kahèi! te ngaa nidhu sèra be'a risi nèti èu, lula rèngu parcaya sèmi èèna kahèi, toke ra karèbha. de baku ngee, na, te'a dènge dhoka kahadhu di, d'ai le èèna. dhae!

source_text: you foolish people! don't you know that trust in god without doing what's right is worthless?
target_text: goa, ee! de me'a mèu le, si? parcaya dhu pad'elo boe dènge tatao be'a, gaguna na aad'o kahèi.

source_text: wasn't our father abraham made right by what he did-by offering his son isaac on the altar?
target_text: tare conto nèti abraham. uru èèna, na sab'a madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua paredha ne, ho nèti ana na isak, sèna ka tao asa dedha mei sogo-tagu ho j'aj'i mi korban. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua peka na, abraham tao le dhu lèke.

source_text: you notice that his trust in god worked together with what he did, and through what he did his trust in god was made complete.
target_text: abraham parcaya ama lamatua, ka na sèmi nare paredha èèna, hèia na tao madhutu. de èdhi te'a, na, nèngu lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua, lula na tao madhutu lii paredha èèna.

source_text: in this way scripture was fulfilled: abraham trusted god, and this was considered as him doing right, and he was called the friend of god.
target_text: de se'e se j'aj'i sèmi dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, dhu peka na, abraham parcaya ama lamatua, hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare nèngu ho j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola. aa dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abraham èèna, angalai lamatua.

source_text: you see that people are made right by what they do, and not just by trusting god.
target_text: me'a mèu le, si? èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare dhèu, ladhe parcaya na mi lamatua dhu tao nèngu d'èi sab'a madha j'ara hua iia. te ngaa ladhe dhoka parcaya di, d'ai mèka.

source_text: in the same way, wasn't rahab the prostitute made right by what she did when she looked after the messengers and then sent them away by a different road?
target_text: conto leo, nuka rahab, dhu uru èèna bhèni kajeo. lod'o dhèu kota jeriko tenge neo pamadhe dhèu mata-mata nèti isra'el, rahab ka pahuni si. hèia na pua si rai asa li'u re j'ara leo, sèna ka dhèu jeriko baku kèpe rare si. hèia lamatua sèmi nare ne, nuka sèmi dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola, lula na tao dhu be'a.

source_text: just as the body is dead without the spirit, trust in god is dead if you don't do what's right.
target_text: parcaya dhu nèti boe hua-hela, èci èèna ka dènge ngi'u dhu dènge boe a'ae. sasoa na, madhe. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu peka, na, nèngu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa tao boe ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a, sèra dhu leko-monya! èèna peka mèka, na, parcaya dhu mamuri.

source_text: my friends, not many of you should become teachers, because you know that we who teach will have a heavier responsibility in the judgment.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! abhu dhèu ae dhu neo aj'a-nori dhèu parcaya sèra. be'a kahèi! te ngaa sanèd'e paie-iie, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua parisa toke lutu dhèu dhu aj'a dhèu parcaya sèra. de dhèu baku sad'i aj'a di.

source_text: all of us make mistakes in many ways. anyone who doesn't make mistakes in what they say is truly a good person who can keep the whole body under control.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ae ka padhai lii sala. te ngaa dhèu dhu taha nare hèb'a na, ho baku padhai leli, ne'a kahèi uri mamuri na.

source_text: we put bridles into the mouths of horses so that they'll obey us, and we can direct them wherever we want.
target_text: tare conto sèmi jara. èdhi te'a uri jara dhu kapai ho madhutu dad'èi èdhi, dhoka dènge ère rarapa na.

source_text: look at ships as well: even though they're very big and are driven along by strong winds, they're steered by a very small rudder in the direction the pilot wants to go.
target_text: conto leo hari, nuka kapa. ngèlu mèdhu tiu kapa aae madhutu dad'èi na. te ngaa uli dhu ana iiki-iiki bisa pod'e kad'uru kapa ne madhutu dad'èi juraga.

source_text: in just the same way the tongue is a very small part of the body, but it makes great boasts! think how a big forest can be set on fire by a very small flame!
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge he'o èdhi. masi ka he'o ana iiki, te ngaa tatao na kapai titu kèna! èèna nuka sèmi he'o ai dhu ana iiki te ngaa bisa tunu eele j'ami dhu kapai aae.

source_text: and the tongue is a fire! the tongue is a world of evil among the parts of the body. it disgraces all you are as a person, and can burn down the whole of your life, since it is set on fire by gehenna.
target_text: hèb'a ne nuka sèmi he'o ai. re hèb'a, èdhi bisa pa'ele iie madha j'ara ae-ae. hèb'a èdhi bisa pa'ele iie kateme mamuri èdhi. bhelu-katub'a ae-ae ètu rai-haha ne, mai nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu. aa dhèu aae nidhu pake hèb'a dhèu ho pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: people have tamed all kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures,
target_text: dhèu pamau rare rupa-rupa badha hui, badha dhu rod'o re rai, manu-bhui, dènge i'a ètu d'ara dhasi.

source_text: but no one can tame the tongue-it's an evil thing, hard to control, full of deadly poison.
target_text: te ngaa abhu mèka ca dhèu sa dhu pamau rare he'o na. te he'o ne, mèdha dhu bhelu, dhu uri tare boe. nèngu èci èèna ka dènge raco dhu lale lème d'ara ngi'u, toke pamadhe dhèu.

source_text: we use the same tongue to bless our lord and father, as well as to curse people who are made in god's image- blessings and curses come from the same mouth! friends, it shouldn't be this way!
target_text: dènge hèb'a èèna ka, dhèu koa-kio, aa dhèu padhèd'a. se'e se, lèke boe! èdhi pake hèb'a ho koa-kio ama lamatua. aa dènge hèb'a èèna kahèi, èdhi padhèd'a aapa dhèu dhu lamatua paj'aj'i madhutu rupa na. tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna?

source_text: does a spring send both sweet and bitter water out of the same opening?
target_text: abhu ètu mia èi ca madha, bisa kalua èi nèta dènge èi sèro.

source_text: my friends, a fig tree can't produce olives, and a vine can't produce figs, any more than a salt water spring can produce fresh water!
target_text: bisa boe, sina ma, nèti kanana kalua hua dhimu? aa tarae sina bisa kalua hua anggor? te aj'u ladhe hua na, hua madhutu rupa ra. èci èèna ka, èdhi bisa boe dhui èi nèta nèti dano èi sèro.

source_text: who among you has wisdom and understanding? let their good lives demonstrate what they do-doing what is right with wise kindness and consideration.
target_text: dhèu dhu ngangee madhera, aa ne'a j'ara dhu madhutu dad'èi lamatua, baku padedha iisi. te ne'a, mamèu na mai nèti lamatua. hud'i laa nèngu pad'elo mamèu na dènge j'ara mamuri dhu mola.

source_text: but if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast about it and don't lie against the truth. this kind of wisdom doesn't come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, and demonic.
target_text: baku padedha iisi, peka na, èu dhèu dhu dènge ngangee madhera, ladhe èu tèka d'ara era ho pabèbhe dhèu leo. èci èèna ka èu ne, dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te mamuri sèmi èèna, peka boe, ‘ngangee madhera'. tatao nuka sèmi, tèka d'ara, d'èi pabèbha dhèu, sèra sa mai boe nèti ama lamatua. èèna na tatao dhèu rai-haha. sèra sa lèke mi dhèu dhu soro boe mamuri ra mi ama lamatua. tatao sèra madhutu dad'èi nidhu.

source_text: wherever there is jealousy and selfish ambition you'll also find confusion and all kinds of evil practices.
target_text: te ladhe tèka d'ara aa d'èi pabèbha dhèu, tatu abhu kahèi patao-palaha dènge rupa-rupa bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: however, wisdom that comes from above is first of all pure, and it also brings peace. it is kind and open to reason. it is full of mercy and produces good things. it is genuine and not hypocritical.
target_text: te ngaa ngangee madhera dhu mai nèti ama lamatua, nuka: dhu tao èdhi mamuri mola, pamau d'ara èdhi, d'èi pa'uru dhèu, taha tare d'ara, dènge lii mako. hua-hela nèti ngangee madhera èèna, nuka: tao èdhi d'ara hua iia, d'èi soru-bara dhèu, bia boe cabèka, aa kapod'e-kabèli boe dhèu leo.

source_text: those who sow peace will harvest the peace of what is truly good and right.
target_text: dhèu dhu uri padame, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu babe'a. j'ara èèna nuka sèmi dhèu dhu sèle hini, ho nèbhu-nèbhu na puu hua dhu be'a.

source_text: where do the fights and quarrels you're having come from? aren't they due to the sensual passions that are in conflict within you?
target_text: miu loe boe patao-palaha aa pagama èci dènge èci. tasamia ka sèmi èèna? èèna, lula ètu talora aae miu abhu dhèu dhu dhoka tenge j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: you burn with desire, but don't get what you want. you kill for what you lust after, but don't get what you're looking for. you argue and you fight, but you don't get anything, because you don't pray for it.
target_text: miu neo ae le abhu mèdha èci, te ngaa ai d'ai boe. hèia mi tèke d'ara, patao-palaha, dènge pagama, toke mangingi boe pamadhe dhèu. lula miu sabaj'a boe, aa manèngi boe nèti lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu abhu boe.

source_text: you pray, but don't receive anything, because you ask with a wrong motive, wanting to spend what you'd receive on your selfish pleasures.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu sabaj'a toke padhe aj'u-hadhu, miu abhu boe ngaa dhu miu manèngi, lula manèngi madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu di.

source_text: you adulterous people! don't you realize that friendship with the world is hatred towards god? those who want to be friends of the world make themselves enemies of god.
target_text: mema miu satia boe! miu nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali dhu èci pusi-pahae boe èci, aa tao j'ara makae di. ladhe miu pa'angalai dènge dad'èi rai-haha, miu pamusu dènge ama lamatua. j'ara èèna la'e sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: do you think scripture doesn't mean what it says: that the spirit that he put in us is very jealous?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, lamatua hia le roh na ètu d'ara èdhi. aa madhutu dad'èi roh, èdhi madhutu ne taa-taa. te ama lamatua ne d'ara kura kahèi.

source_text: but god gives us even more grace, as scripture says: god is against those who are arrogant, but gives grace to those who are humble.
target_text: ngaa hari, ama lamatua neo hia tabha hari babe'a d'ara na. ka sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi ra, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi ra.

source_text: so place yourself under god's direction. confront the devil, and he will run away from you.
target_text: de soro iisi mi asa adhe-aai ama lamatua, sèna ka madhutu dad'èi na. miu baku madhutu dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. lab'a ne pa'èra-èra; baku golo. dènge sèmi èèna, na rai tèke eele miu.

source_text: come close to god and he will come close to you. wash your hands, you sinners. purify your way of thinking, you people with divided loyalties. show some remorse, cry and weep! turn your laughter into mourning, and your joy to sadness.
target_text: tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci dènge ama lamatua. ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu padètu-dètu dènge miu kahèi. wee, miu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara kaj'alu sèra! miu hud'i pamola ku j'ara mamuri miu. aa miu dhu d'ara kajari sèra! miu hud'i kako mola-mola madhutu lamatua, aa baku piku hari g'ana do kariu. nèbhu nare sange ne'e, miu mamuri karae dènge pasoa-pasoka di. de hua iia, ae eele ka! miu me'a le, na, d'ara miu kajari lula sasala-sasigo miu sèra. be'a risi miu ele-ho'a aa tangi dènge d'ara manyasa.

source_text: be humble before the lord and he will lift you up.
target_text: ladhe tare'a-re'a miu me'a, na, miu dhu nia boe ètu katanga madha ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na ded'e nare miu, sèna ka j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu nia ètu madha na.

source_text: friends, don't speak badly of one another. anyone who criticizes a fellow-believer and condemns them, criticizes and condemns the law. if you condemn the law you're not someone who keeps the law, because you're sitting in judgment of it.
target_text: a'ari! baku padhai pakarehe kolongara èci dènge èci. te ladhe miu padhai le sèmi èèna, aa d'èi pèci sasala nèti èci asa èci, miu lab'a le atora nèti lamatua dhu peka na, èu hud'i sue ku a'ari èu, nuka sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. aa ladhe miu madhutu boe atora ne, miu ded'e iisi mi dedha risi nèti atora ama lamatua.

source_text: there's only one lawgiver and judge-the one who can either save or destroy you-so who are you to judge your neighbor?
target_text: dhodhoka lamatua mesa na dhu tao atora èèna, dhu dènge hak ho pama'ète lii langu èdhi. dhoka nèngu di mesa na dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hia mamuri mi èdhi, do huku pamadhe ti. miu dènge boe hak ho pama'ète lii langu dhèu, do padhai pakarehe kolongara dhèu.

source_text: come on now! -you people who say, either today or tomorrow we'll go to such-and-such a city, spend a year in business there, and make a profit.
target_text: sèmi ne'e! madhutu iia-iia na, miu me'a le ho baku peka na, deo ne'e, do bèli, ji'i neo la'a sa kota nèi! ji'i neo pea mi era nèi pe d'ai ca tèu sa. aa ji'i neo d'aga sèna ka abhu ku leto d'ai ciki sa.

source_text: you have no idea what will happen tomorrow! what's your life like? it's just a mist that appears for a little while, and then is gone.
target_text: èu me'a ngaa dhu j'aj'i lod'o bèli? dhèu èci sa re'a boe tasamia mamuri na. mamuri èdhi dhèu ne nuka sèmi sèb'u dhu tèdhi dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e èèna, kaca'a laa ele.

source_text: what you should say is, if it's the lord's will, we'll live like this and plan to do that.
target_text: be'a risi miu peka na, ladhe lamatua sue, na, ji'i mamuri madhera. aa ladhe lamatua d'èi, hud'i laa ji'i tao ne'e.

source_text: but right now you're caught up in your vain ideas. all this boasting is evil.
target_text: te ladhe peka boe sèmi èèna, miu dhodhoka padedha iisi di. èci èèna ka dènge miu bhèlu eele lamatua ètu d'ara nanelu miu sèra. èèna sala kapai titu kèna!

source_text: for it is a sin if you know to do what's right but don't do it.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! dhèu dhu re'a le ngaa dhu lèke, te ngaa tao boe madhutu, èci èèna ka dènge nèngu tao sala le.

source_text: come on, you rich people! you should weep and wail for all the problems that are coming your way! your wealth is ruined, and your clothes have been eaten by moths. your gold and your silver are corroded, and this corrosion will be evidence against you, eating away your flesh like fire. you hoarded up your wealth in these last days. look, the wages of your farm workers that you cheated are crying out against you-the cries of the farm workers have reached the ears of the lord almighty. you've enjoyed a life of luxury here on earth, full of self-indulgent pleasure, fattening yourselves up for the day of slaughter! you have condemned and killed the innocent who didn't even resist you.
target_text: miu dhèu kaja sèra, sanèd'e, ee! pasa dhilu ho nanene paie-iie! dhèu sab'a hia miu toke èi kabhèsu hae, te ngaa miu taha mere gaji ra. limuri ne rui-j'aj'èra ra pa'oo-parodha dhu peka nèti kapod'e-kabèli miu. tatu ama lamatua dhu kapai risi eele èèna, tadèngi le lii roma iisi dhèu sab'a sèra. sasab'a miu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka tao pagaa ngi'u miu mesa mi, ka mamuri mi ha'a-ha'a, hèti-hèti. limuri ne miu nuka sèmi sapi kab'oi dhu neo lèke roro. miu huku dènge pamadhe le dhèu be'a sèra, dhu re'a boe siri iisi ra ètu madha miu. miu dhèu kaja sèra! tangi ka laa! pe miu pasae mere rupa-rupa j'aj'èra. mèdha-panyau miu, ele iia kèna. aa mèdha-papake miu dhu be'a sèra, ana ca ngèpi na'e aa'i si. hualaa iia dènge hualaa pudhi miu sèra, dènge heka kab'ua. aa bèli-camèd'a hualaa miu sèra ra'e hari miu, sèmi ai na'e aj'u mango. rai-haha oe èle kèna, te ngaa tasamia ka miu kabhèsu lutu pakaboko taruu mèdha dhu madhe sèra? mèdha-panyau miu unu mi ka dhu j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu me'a boe mia ka dhu dènge kab'ua ètu madha lamatua!

source_text: friends, be patient as you wait for the lord's return. think of the farmer waiting patiently for the earth's precious harvest as it grows with the early and later rains.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i taha d'ara ku, tatae mamai hari lamatua. ladhe ku laa dhèu sab'a oka-tedhe, dhu tatae hèru puu-g'ètu. èj'i hua hiu, na sèle hini. mate hari èj'i limuri, ho na pamangèru ana nganga'a sèra. nèbhu-nèbhu ku heka hua kèna. d'ai lod'o puu-g'ètu, dhèu ne la'e puu.

source_text: you need to be patient too. stay strong for the lord's return is near.
target_text: miu hud'i taha d'ara sèmi èèna kahèi. pa'èra ngi'u, te nèbhu heka lamatua mai!

source_text: my friends, don't complain about each other, so you won't be judged. look, the judge is standing right at the door!
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! baku ka'uu-kamuki èci dènge èci. ka'uu-kamuki taruu, pe lamatua ka dhu huku èu! ladhe ka, te ama hakim ètu dedha nèi, titu le ètu madha miu.

source_text: take the prophets as an example, my friends-see how they spoke in the lord's name as they suffered and waited patiently.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! madhutu conto nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra. masi ka rèngu paraga dènge susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa rèngu taha taruu ètu d'ara sasusa.

source_text: notice that we say that those who endure are blessed. you've heard about the patience of job, and you've seen how the lord brought this to a positive conclusion-for the lord is full of compassion and mercy.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu taha ètu d'ara sasusa, èdhi d'èi padedha ngara dhèu ne. nuka sèmi ayub. masi ka na abhu susa rupa-rupa, te ngaa na kalau-karèto boe. hèia lamatua sue ne, ka na ator aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a hia ayub. lamatua tao sèmi èèna, lula d'ara na hua iia, pènu dènge sasue.

source_text: above all, my friends, don't swear. not by heaven, not by earth, and not by any other kind of oath. just let your yes be yes, and your no be no, so you won't fall under condemnation.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! dhu be'a risi miu baku j'oka subha. ladhe neo peka, oo, na, dhaa la oo. aa ladhe peka aad'o na, dhaa la aad'o. sèmi èèna, d'ai le! baku parisi dènge j'oka subha dhu ale ngara dhèu madhe ètu rai-haha ne. ngaa hari pasubha dènge kolongara lamatua dhu mamuri ètu dedha-liru. gaguna na aad'o dènge pasubha rupa-rupa. de ladhe taruu sèmi èèna, miu pasae mere huku, lula lii subha sèra.

source_text: are any of you suffering? you should pray. are some of you cheerful? you should sing songs of praise.
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu sasusa, be'a risi na sabaj'a. aa dhu ètu d'ara karej'e, be'a risi na sod'a koa-kio lamatua.

source_text: are any of you sick? you should call for the church elders and have them pray over you, and anoint you with oil in the lord's name.
target_text: ladhe ètu talora miu abhu dhu pèd'a, be'a risi paroa ina-ama juma'at. manèngi sèna ka ra pasuti èi lèngi mi dhèu pèd'a ne, aa sabaj'a pake kolongara lamatua, ho hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne.

source_text: such a prayer, trusting in god, will heal those who are sick, and the lord will make them well. if they've committed sins, they will be forgiven.
target_text: aa ladhe miu sabaj'a dènge lèka tare'a-re'a lamatua hia dhèu pèd'a, èèna na lamatua puri-pa'èle ne. aa ladhe na tao sala, pe lamatua saku eele sasala na sèra.

source_text: admit the wrongs you've done to each other, and pray for one another so that you'll be healed. earnest prayer from those who live right is very effective.
target_text: ladhe nèti talora miu abhu dhu manahu asa d'ara sasala, na, miu mangaku sasala èci dènge èci. dènge j'ara èèna, miu èci sabaj'a hia èci, sèna ka miu j'aj'i be'a. dhèu dhu d'ara na mola-mèci, lii manèngi na pènu dènge koasa, aa nèti babe'a.

source_text: elijah was a man who had the same human nature as we do. he prayed earnestly that it wouldn't rain, and it didn't rain on the earth for three and a half years.
target_text: tare conto nuka sèmi elia. nèngu ne dhèu rai-haha cakaraa èdhi kahèi. te ngaa ropa na sabaj'a, manèngi èj'i mai boe, ka èj'i puru heka toke tèlu tèu dènge ca èta.

source_text: he prayed again-heaven sent rain and the earth gave its harvest.
target_text: hèia na sabaj'a hari ho èj'i mai, hèia èj'i mai dènge. j'u'u mangèru bidhu-bidhu, aa oka-tedhe hia hari isi rai.

source_text: my friends, if any one of you strays from the truth and someone brings you back,
target_text: a'ari sèra! ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu bèbhe asa d'ara sasala, ka rai eele nèti j'ara dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhèu dhu pamako ho na lèpa hari asa j'ara dhu mola nèti lamatua, èèna na be'a!

source_text: let them know that whoever rescues a sinner from the error of their ways will save them from death, and will gain forgiveness for many sins.
target_text: sanèd'e ne'e paie-iie! ladhe miu soru-bara dhèu dhu tao sala, hèia na lèpa hari asa lamatua ka na tao heka sala, miu se pasod'a le dhèu èèna, hèia na mamuri taa-taa dènge lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e ka, lamatua saku eele aa'i sasala na. d'ai sange ne'e ka! nèti ja'a, yakobis

source_text: this letter comes from peter, apostle of jesus christ, and is sent to god's chosen people: exiles scattered throughout the provinces of pontus, galatia, cappadocia, asia, and bithynia. you were chosen by god the father in his wisdom, made holy by the spirit, so that you might obey jesus christ and be sprinkled with his blood. may you have grace and peace more and more!
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, petrus, dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne'e hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le. nuka miu dhu mamuri pahag'a palème era ètu propensi pontus, propensi galati, propensi kapadokia, propensi asia, dènge propensi bitinia. a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua hag'e nare mema le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. roh na ka dhu pamèu miu j'aj'i mola-mèci hia nèngu, sèna ka miu bisa tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu yesus kristus hia miu. aa ladhe miu madhutu aa'i paredha na sèra, èèna nuka sèmi lamatua pici miu dènge raa yesus, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na dhu mola-mèci hia nèngu. ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu, ho mamuri miu asa tabha dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: praise god, the father of our lord jesus christ! through his great mercy we have been born again and given a living hope through the resurrection of jesus christ from the dead.
target_text: koa-kio hia aa'i mi ama lamatua! nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. lula d'ara lamatua hua iia titu kèna, nèti èèna ka nèngu kasia èdhi seli eele. yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa na mamuri hari. de ladhe kristus pamamuri èdhi, na hia èdhi mamuri hiu, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi parcaya taruu kristus, lula èdhi sanao dènge èra, bèli-camèd'a nèngu ladhe-leru èdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: this inheritance is eternal, it never spoils or fades, and it is kept safe in heaven for you.
target_text: sama sèmi èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ladhe ca dhèu ama madhe, tatu nèngu tèke eele mèdha-panyau na hia ana niki na. sèmi èèna kahèi, yesus dhu tèke le pusaka hia èdhi ètu sorga. te ngaa pusaka se dhu ele iie boe, laho boe, aa ele boe.

source_text: through your trust in him, god will protect you by his power until salvation arrives-the salvation that is ready to be revealed at the last day.
target_text: miu parcaya, na, ama lamatua dènge koasa ho soru-bara miu. na piara dènge madhenga miu, sèna ka baku abhu dhu palaho miu. aa ladhe èle ka rai-haha ne, na neo pad'elo dènge j'ara tasamia nèngu hia miu mamuri.

source_text: so be glad about this, even though you may be sad for a short while as you endure various trials.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, d'ara miu karej'e, masi ka limuri ne miu rasa bia lula miu sili mere boe rupa-rupa sasusa.

source_text: these prove that your trust in god is genuine, just as fire is used to prove if gold is genuine-even though that too can be destroyed-and your faith is more valuable than gold! in this way your trust in god will be recognized and you will receive praise, glory, and honor when jesus christ appears.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke èdhi paraga dènge dadugu-rariu, sèna ka na sèku neo ne'a mèu parcaya èdhi mi nèngu. ladhe èdhi taha ètu d'ara dadugu ne, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, parcaya èdhi lèke aa èra. èdhi bisa pakasame dènge hualaa. èdhi hud'i tunu pamèu hualaa ètu d'ara ai karoo, sèna ka ai na'e aa'i kaj'alu na, heka èdhi abhu hualaa isi adhu kèna. aa te ngaa, madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, lalèka èdhi kab'ua risi nèti hualaa. de ladhe parcaya èdhi taha ètu d'ara dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a ropa yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri èdhi, hèia na pad'elo kolo-karisi èdhi, aa na pakab'ua èdhi kahèi.

source_text: you love him even though you have never seen him. though you cannot see him now, you trust in him and you're filled with wonderful, indescribable happiness.
target_text: masi ka miu ladhe mèdhi mèka yesus, te ngaa miu sue ne. masi ka limuri ne miu mèdhi mèka nèngu, te ngaa miu parcaya ne. miu karej'e risi eele, masi ka abhu boe lii dhu pamèci, dhu bisa peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti d'ara karej'e miu.

source_text: your reward for trusting in him is that you will be saved!
target_text: lula miu parcaya ne, ka upa miu, nuka ama lamatua patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu.

source_text: it was this salvation that the prophets searched for and investigated when they spoke of the grace that was prepared for you.
target_text: dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, pakanucu ho neo re'a mèu, j'ara tasa mera mia lamatua patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala ra. dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra dhu peka tèke le j'ara-j'ara lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu, lula nèngu dhu pa'èra mema le, sèna ka na hia miu mamuri.

source_text: they tried to find out when and how this would take place, for the spirit of christ inside them spoke clearly about christ's sufferings and glory to come.
target_text: roh kristus dhu sab'a ètu d'ara rèngu, sèna ka peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a kristus hud'i pasae ku sasusa, aa dènge j'ara tasamia nèngu dui j'aj'èra. ladhe èle aa'i ku se'e, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu rèti lii padhai sèra neo re'a lod'o mia madha j'ara se'e j'aj'i.

source_text: it was explained to them that they were not doing this for themselves, but for you-since what they spoke about you've now learned from those who shared the good news with you by the holy spirit that heaven sent. even the angels are eager to find out about all this!
target_text: ka roh kristus èèna peka dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai se kahèi, na, rèngu rèdhi boe, te ngaa miu ka dhu mèdhi j'ara se j'aj'i. aa miu tadèngi j'ara se kahèi, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci nèti sorga pua le dhèu leo ho lole dènge miu lii lolo be'a lamatua. aa te ngaa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga neo rèdhi j'ara se'e se kahèi.

source_text: make sure your minds are in gear. be clear-headed. fix your hope exclusively on the grace you'll be given when jesus is revealed.
