target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra sèna ka me'a mèu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i. j'aga paie-iie sèna ka ngangee miu mola. bori pa'èra ho parcaya taruu yesus kristus toke na lèpa hari mai. lula lod'o èèna, ama lamatua neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: live like children who do what they're told. don't allow yourselves to be shaped by your former sinful desires when you didn't know any better.
target_text: miu hud'i nanene paie-iie ku ama lamatua, sama sèmi ana-ana nanene lii ina-ama ra. uru èèna, miu me'a iia mèka j'ara mamuri lamatua dhu mola. te ngaa limuri ne me'a mèu le. de baku mamuri madhutu dad'èi miu dhu neo tao bhabhelu. te èèna, j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui.

source_text: now you need to be holy in everything you do, just as the one who called you is holy.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne miu hud'i mamuri mola-mèci. te ama lamatua èèna, mola-mèci. nèngu ka dhu paroa nare miu ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, mamuri miu kateme aae hud'i mola-mèci ku.

source_text: as scripture says, you are to be holy, for i am holy.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula ja'a ne mola-mèci.

source_text: since you call him father, and recognize he judges everyone impartially based on what they do, take your time here on earth seriously, respecting him.
target_text: miu d'èi padhai lii dènge ama lamatua nuka sèmi ama miu. nèngu dhèu pama'ète lii langu kahèi, dhu parisa mamuri dhèu èci-èci. te ngaa nèngu baka-leo nèti dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu leo sèra. te na pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, dhu dènge boe koe-kapengo. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i j'aga paie ku mamuri miu. te miu nuka sèmi dhèu tao-mai dhu dhoka manubha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: you already know that you were not set free from your pointless way of living that you inherited from your forefathers by things that don't have lasting value, like silver or gold.
target_text: miu me'a kahèi, na, kristus ka dhu tihe pama'ète le miu nèti mamuri miu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua. j'ara mamuri rupa sèmi sèra ka dhu miu sèmi mere nèti bèi-baki miu, nuka sèmi pusaka. te ngaa sanèd'e, te kristus sui nare le miu, b'ae boe pake doi pudhi do hualaa dhu ele bèli-camèd'a.

source_text: you were set free by the costly blood of christ, who was like a lamb with no flaw or defect.
target_text: te ngaa na b'ae-baj'a pake raa nèngu unu na. ne'e ne, kab'ua titu kèna! nèngu madhe nuka sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu ad'u-ue nèdhi boe sasala, dhu ra roro ne tao j'aj'i korban.

source_text: he was chosen before the world was created, but he was revealed in these last days for your benefit.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu ne'a aa'i le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na kristus tao. te ngaa uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae patadhe mèka kristus mi dhèu rai-haha. limuri ku, heka nèngu pad'elo kristus sèna ka j'aj'i berkat hia miu.

source_text: through him you trust in god who raised him from the dead, and glorified him, so that you could have confidence and hope in god.
target_text: lula tatao kristus, ka miu bisa parcaya ama lamatua. te nèngu pamamuri hari kristus, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha. ama lamatua ad'u-ue j'ara sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu parcaya ne, aa sanao ho na tao madhutu ngaa dhu nèngu padhadha tèke.

source_text: now that you've dedicated yourselves by following the truth, love each other sincerely like a true family.
target_text: miu tao madhutu j'ara dhu lèke. de limuri ne miu bisa sab'a pa'èra-èra hia lamatua. j'ara èèna ka tao miu pasue dènge d'ara kateme mi a'ari miu dhu parcaya sèra. sasue miu hud'i asa tabha èra, lula d'ara miu mola-mèci.

source_text: you've been born again, not the product of a mortal seed, but immortal, through the living, eternal word of god.
target_text: miu limuri ne, abhu le mamuri hiu. te ngaa mamuri hiu ne, mai boe nèti ina-ama miu dhu bèli-camèd'a madhe ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa miu abhu nèti ama èdhi ètu sorga dhu madhe boe. mamuri hiu unu mi ne, miu abhu re lii holo-nori ama lamatua. lii holo-nori nèngu ne, nèti mamuri dhu lèke, aa taha taruu.

source_text: for: all people are like grass, and all their glory like wildflowers. the grass withers and the flowers fall.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi j'u'u, do hela-bunga. te saraga ra taha nèbhu boe. j'u'u kamale dhae-dhae. hela-bunga kabhui eele kahèi. nèbhu boe madhe, hèia ela aa'i si.

source_text: but the word of the lord remains forever. this word is the good news that was explained to you.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori lamatua èdhi, taha taruu, dhu bisa boe ele. lii holo-nori lamatua èèna, nuka lii lolo be'a dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu.

source_text: so give up all the evil things that you do: all your dishonesty, hypocrisy, and jealousy, all the ways you speak badly about others.
target_text: de miu baku tao bhabhelu èci sa. baku padhai-kakoli do kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. baku padhai lii leo tao leo. baku tèka d'ara ladhe mamuri dhèu leo risi èu. baku pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu. core eele tatao se'e se!

source_text: you should become like newborn babies who only want pure spiritual milk, so you can grow in salvation
target_text: ana rara iisi hiu d'èi dhoka èi susu ina ra. sèmi èèna kahèi d'ara miu hud'i d'èi dhoka me'a mèu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ne'e ne ka dhu asa pa'èra parcaya miu nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu juu noo-noo j'aj'i kapai, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: now you've tasted how good the lord really is.
target_text: te miu dhu rasa mèdhi le d'ara hua iia lamatua èdhi.

source_text: as you come to him-the living stone that people rejected as useless, but is chosen by god and precious to him-
target_text: pa'èki ngi'u miu dènge kristus. te nèngu nuka sèmi hadhu cue dhu mamuri. tuka hadhu core eele ne, lula ra ngee, na, hadhu ne guna boe. te ngaa madhutu ngangee ama lamatua, na, hadhu ne kab'ua titu kèna, hèia na pili nare ne, tao mi hadhu padhèdi dhu kab'ua risi eele.

source_text: you also become like living stones, being built into a spiritual house. you are a holy priesthood that offers spiritual sacrifices that god welcomes through jesus christ.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki ku dènge kristus, sèna ka ama lamatua pake miu kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, miu sama sèmi hadhu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare ho patitu èmu hia roh na. miu nuka sèmi hadhu dhu mamuri kahèi, sama sèmi kristus. miu èci èèna ka dènge ama agama sèra, dhu mamuri mola-mèci hia mi ama lamatua. èèna nuka sèmi miu mèti mèdha korban hia ne. mèdha korban dhu miu mèti ne pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula yesus kristus madhe le hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: as scripture says, see! i'm setting in zion its main cornerstone, specially-chosen and valuable. whoever trusts in him will not be disappointed.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, peka na, ladhe ku laa! te ja'a padhèdi le hadhu uuru, ètu kota yerusalem ne'e, dhu ra pangare, na, ‘kota sion'. ja'a pili kore hadhu ne kahèi. madhutu ja'a, nèngu kab'ua bia. de dhèu dhu parcaya ne, bèli-camèd'a ra'e boe makae.

source_text: he is very valuable to you who do trust. but for those who don't, the stone the builders rejected that became the main cornerstone
target_text: hadhu ne, nuka yesus. ka nèngu kab'ua titu kèna bagi mi dhèu dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa bagi mi dhèu dhu parcaya boe yesus kristus, sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua suri, peka na, hadhu dhu tuka sèra core eele, limuri ne j'aj'i le hadhu uuru, dhu kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: is the stone that trips you up and the rock that makes you fall. people stumble over this message because they refuse to accept it-which for them is entirely predictable.
target_text: abhu dhu suri kahèi, peka na, abhu hadhu dhu pakadhunu dhèu. abhu hadhu dhu pabèbhe dhèu. rèngu bèbha lula ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. te ama lamatua dhu ator mema le, sèna ka ra bèbha.

source_text: in complete contrast, you are a specially-chosen family, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people belonging to god. consequently you can reveal the wonderful things he's done, calling you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
target_text: te ngaa miu aad'o sèmi èèna. te miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e unu na. miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu. miu sama sèmi ama agama dhu ladhe-leru dhèu aae. miu èci èèna kahèi dènge dhèu ca suku dhu mamuri mola-mèci hia mi ama lamatua. miu j'aj'i sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu bisa lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu na pala-bagi hia miu. te lamatua pua le miu ho tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a, sèna ka mamuri madhutu j'ara dhu be'a. se'e se nuka sèmi miu kalua nèti d'ara maroga, ho mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na dhu be'a risi eele.

source_text: in the past you were nobodies, but now you are god's people. in the past you hadn't received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
target_text: uru èèna, miu sama sèmi ca suku dhu dènge boe kolongara. te ngaa limuri ne miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. uru èèna, miu pahae boe rasa kasia lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, miu sèmi mere le.

source_text: my friends, i'm pleading with you as foreigners and strangers in this world not to give in to physical desires that are in conflict with what is spiritual.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu dhoka mai manubha ètu rai-haha ne. te miu nuka sèmi dhèu tao-mai dhu mamuri ètu dedha rai dhèu. nèti èèna ka, ja'a loe boe manèngi sèna ka miu baku mamuri sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. te ètu d'ara miu nuka sèmi pamusu sa. d'ara dhu neo tao karehe lab'a dènge d'ara dhu neo tao be'a. de baku soro tèke d'ara neo tao karehe èèna segi miu. te ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, na, miu laho mae-mae!

source_text: be sure to act appropriately when you're with non-christians, so even if they accuse you of doing wrong, they will see the good things you do and glorify god when he comes.
target_text: j'aga paie, sèna ka miu mamuri mola ètu madha dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, ladhe ra galaa leli miu, na, dhu rèngu rèdhi, dhoka babe'a miu di. hèia ropa yesus kristus lèpa hari mai, rèngu unu ra ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua, lula tatao miu dhu be'a sèra.

source_text: obey human authority for the lord's sake, whether it is the king as the highest authority,
target_text: dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka miu nanene dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha. nuka sèmi: nanene mi dhèu aae, te nèngu ka ama paredha dedha.

source_text: or governors that god appoints to punish those who do evil and to commend those who do good.
target_text: nanene mi gubernur, te dhèu aae ka dhu pua ne, ho huku dhèu dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, aa na koa-kad'iri dhèu dhu tao j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: by doing what is good and right god wants you to silence the ignorant accusations of foolish people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi miu tao dhu lèke, sèna ka dhèu goa dhu re'a boe ngaa-ngaa sèra, abhu boe j'ara ho galaa miu.

source_text: yes, you are free people! so don't use your freedom as a cover-up for evil, but live as god's servants.
target_text: masi ka miu dhèu bebas dhu dènge hak sèna ka madhutu dad'èi d'ara mi, te ngaa miu baku tao leli hak ne ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu. pake hak ne sèna ka sab'a hia ama lamatua, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: respect everyone. show your love to the community of believers. have reverence for god. respect the king.
target_text: miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i. miu hud'i sue ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya kristus. miu hud'i mamuri dhu lèke ètu madha lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu miu. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha.

source_text: if you are a servant then submit to your master-not just those who are good and kind, but those who are harsh masters as well.
target_text: ana pua-paleha sèra! nanene paie-iie lamatua miu sèra, aa pakab'ua si. mage nanene dhoka lamatua dhu d'ara be'a aa lii mako di. masi ka lamatua miu bhelu titu kèna, te ngaa miu hud'i nanene paie ne kahèi.

source_text: for this is what grace is: to endure life's pain and unfair suffering, keeping your focus on god.
target_text: ladhe nèti miu abhu huku dhu lèke boe j'ara nèti lamatua miu masi ka miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa, aa ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara sasusa èèna, lula miu ngee mèdhi dad'èi lamatua, pe ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: however, there's no credit when you're punished for doing something wrong. but if you suffer for doing what is good and right, and you put up with it, then god's grace is with you.
target_text: ladhe sèmi miu tao sala, hèia abhu gama, na, a'oto na ngaa, ladhe miu taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra èèna? abhu boe, si? te ngaa ladhe miu abhu susa lula tao dhu be'a, hèia miu taha mere d'ara, na, lamatua ladhe-leru miu.

source_text: in fact this is what you were called to do, because christ suffered for you and gave you an example, so you should follow in his footsteps.
target_text: te kristus neo kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri mola, masi ka miu abhu susa. te nèngu dui j'aj'èra kahèi pala èdhi. dènge sèmi èèna, nèngu j'aj'i mi conto, sèna ka èdhi madhutu ne, èci èèna ka èdhi madhutu kab'a-j'èla na.

source_text: he never sinned, he never lied;
target_text: sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na, nèngu tao nèdhi boe sala. abhu boe lii kapod'e-kabèli kalua nèti hèb'a na.

source_text: and when he was badly treated, he didn't retaliate. when he suffered, he didn't threaten to take revenge. he simply placed himself in the hands of the one who always judges rightly.
target_text: lod'o ra padhai lii pa-aape ne, nèngu bhoka boe hèb'a. ropa dhèu pasusa nèngu, na b'ala boe. te ngaa na soro ngi'u na asa d'ara adhe-aai ama lamatua. te ne'a, na, ama lamatua èèna dhèu pama'ète lii langu dhu mola.

source_text: he took the consequences of our sins on himself in his body on the cross, so that we could die to sin and live rightly. by his wounds you are healed.
target_text: kristus ka dhu pasae nare sasala èdhi ropa madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. na ad'u-ue j'ara ne, ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala, sèna ka èdhi mamuri ia ka dènge tao sasala. ka limuri ne èdhi mamuri heka tao sasala, dhoka mamuri dènge tao dhu lèke di. te nèngu gati èdhi, sèna ka pasae nare hahuku èdhi. hahuku ne'e ka dhu panu'a nèngu toke madhe. te nu'a dhu pamadhe yesus èèna ka puri-pa'èle miu.

source_text: at one time you were like sheep who had lost their way, but now you've returned to the shepherd-the one who watches over you.
target_text: te miu nuka sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu uru èèna sigo eele nèti j'ara. te ngaa limuri ne miu lèpa hari le asa j'ara lamatua dhu mola. te nèngu ka dhu madhenga dènge kab'oi miu, nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu j'aga dènge ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho na sèra.

source_text: wives, accept your husbands' authority in the same way, so that if some husbands refuse to accept the word, they may still be won over without words by the way you behave,
target_text: bhèni aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! deo na ja'a peka, na, èdhi hud'i nanene paie-iie ku dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. de miu hud'i nanene ku dhèu èmu miu. sanèd'e, te abhu dhèu mone cahag'e dhu leo le èmu, ro'o boe tao madhutu lii holo-nori lamatua. masi ka rèngu ro'o boe nanene lii padhai miu, te ngaa èèna na, rèngu neo parcaya lamatua, lula rèdhi j'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: recognizing your pure and reverent behavior.
target_text: te rèngu rèdhi miu sab'a aa'i-aa'i dènge d'ara mola-mèci aa mamuri dhu pakab'ua ama lamatua.

source_text: don't focus on outward attractiveness-hairstyles, gold jewelry, or fashionable clothes-
target_text: bhèni dhu bhèni iia, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu tèdhi nèti li'u. nuka sèmi: sageri kètu madhutu rupa-rupa mod'e, do, pake mèdha hualaa dhu risi eele, do, pake mèdha-papake dhu kab'ua aae dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: instead let it come from within, the lasting attractiveness of a gentle and peaceful spirit on the inside. that's what god values.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tao bhèni iia dhu lèke, nuka: d'ara dhu tèdhi boe nèti li'u. conto sèmi: d'ara hua iia, dènge lii mako. te bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu taha taruu, masi ka toke d'ai heka bhora. madhutu a'abhu lamatua, bhèni iia sèmi èèna ka dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: this is how holy women of the past who put their confidence in god made themselves beautiful, yielding to their husbands,
target_text: te uru-uru sèra, dhèu bhèni dhu d'ara mola-mèci, dhu parcaya ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bhèni iia. rèngu nanene aa madhutu dhèu èmu ra dènge be'a.

source_text: like sarah who obeyed abraham, and called him lord. you are her daughters if you do what's good and right and are not intimidated.
target_text: tare conto nèti sara. nèngu nanene mi dhèu èmu na abraham. nèngu soro iisi na, sèna ka dhèu èmu na ator nèngu. miu bhèni aa'i-aa'i hud'i madhutu ku j'ara nèti sara ne. ladhe miu tao dhu lèke, na, miu madha'u boe.

source_text: husbands, in just the same way, be considerate to your wives as you live together with them. though she may not be as strong as you are, you should honor her since she will inherit equally with you god's gift of life. make sure to do this so nothing will get in the way of your prayers.
target_text: mone aa'i-aa'i dhu leo le èmu! mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu. ngee paie-iie ngaa dhu be'a hia mi nèngu, aa tao madhutu. pakab'ua ne ètu j'ara aa'i-aa'i, lula a'èra bhèni sama boe dènge a'èra dhèu mone. te miu sama-sama abhu pusaka dhu ama lamatua neo hia miu. nuka, mamuri hiu dhu lamatua hia miu nèti d'ara hua iia na. te ngaa miu mone dhu ngara na dhèu èmu-kamali, hud'i mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu miu, sèna ka ladhe miu dua mi sabaj'a d'ara èci manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti lamatua, na, lamatua nanene lii manèngi miu.

source_text: finally, you should all have the same attitude. be sympathetic and love each other. be compassionate, and humble.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a pab'ab'e lii holo ja'a aa'i-aa'i sèra sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i mamuri ku d'ara èci. ladhe ca dhèu abhu susa do karej'e, na, miu dhu leo hud'i rasa sèmi èèna kahèi. sue dhèu dhu parcaya kristus. pad'elo d'ara hua iia èci dènge èci. baku padedha iisi, te miu hud'i pahaha iisi ku.

source_text: don't pay back evil for evil, or retaliate when you're abused, instead you should give a blessing-because that's what you were called to do, so you could gain a blessing yourself.
target_text: baku b'ala bhabhelu dènge bhabhelu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii padhèto dènge miu, baku b'ala kahèi. te ngaa manèngi sèna ka lamatua hia dhu be'a mi nèngu. te lamatua dhu paroa nare le miu j'aj'i mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka miu bisa sèmi mere dhu hua iia nèti nèngu.

source_text: remember: those who want to love life, and to see good days, must refrain from speaking evil, and not tell lies.
target_text: te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, dhèu dhu tenge mamuri be'a, aa dhu tenge mamuri madhera, dhèu èèna hud'i j'aga hèb'a na sèna ka baku ore leli, aa baku pakapod'e d'ara lii.

source_text: turn away from evil and do good; search for peace-run after it!
target_text: nèngu hud'i ele-ho'a, sèna ka tao heka bhelu, te ngaa tao dhu lèke di. nèngu hud'i patema mamuri padame dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, aa tenge j'ara ho pabe'a taruu dènge ra.

source_text: for god sees those who do right, and he hears their prayers, but he opposes those who do evil.
target_text: te lamatua èdhi dhu haduli dhèu dhu mamuri mola. aa nèngu kahèi neo nanene lii manèngi-mangaj'i rèngu. te ngaa lamatua èdhi loe boe lab'a dhèu dhu ad'u-ue taruu bhabhelu-katub'a.

source_text: who will harm you if you're keen to do good?
target_text: ladhe miu d'èi tao dhu lèke, cee ka dhu neo paj'èra hari miu? abhu boe, si?

source_text: for even if you suffer for doing what's right, you're still better off. don't be scared over what people threaten, don't worry about it;
target_text: te ngaa masi ka miu tao dhu lèke, hèia abhu dhu pasusa miu, miu oto. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe kristus j'aj'i madha'u lula madha j'ara èci, na, miu baku madhutu ho madha'u sèmi èèna. ngangee miu baku kahèlu, aa d'ara miu baku susa èci èèna ka dènge rèngu.

source_text: just keep your mind focused on christ as lord. always be ready to explain to anyone who asks you the reason for the hope that you have. do this in a gentle and respectful way.
target_text: pamau d'ara miu, lula miu dhu ded'e le kristus ètu d'ara miu ho j'aj'i lamatua miu dhu mola-mèci. ladhe sèmi dhèu manèngi sèna ka miu lole parcaya miu aa sanao-maena miu, dhu peka na, bèli-camèd'a kristus tao aa'i j'aj'i mi be'a, na, miu hud'i pa'èra ku ho dhaa lii karèi rèngu sèra.

source_text: make sure your conscience is clear, so that if anyone makes accusations against you, they will be embarrassed for speaking badly about the good way you live your life in christ.
target_text: te ngaa miu hud'i dhaa ku nèti d'ara dhu hua iia, aa pakab'ua si, sèna ka re'a, na, miu tao dhu lèke mai nèti d'ara dhu mola. masi ka miu tao dhu be'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa tatu abhu dhu padhai lii neo pamanahu miu, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. de ladhe miu tao taruu dhu be'a, na, rèngu dhu pa-aape miu èèna na ra'e makae.

source_text: it's certainly better to suffer for doing good if that's what god wants, than to suffer for doing wrong!
target_text: ladhe èèna palèke dènge dad'èi lamatua, na, baku bhèlu, te be'a risi miu abhu j'aj'èra nèti tao j'ara dhu lèke; baku nèti miu ad'u-ue j'ara karehe.

source_text: jesus died because of sins, once and for all, the one who is completely true and good and right died for those who are bad, so that he could bring you to god. he was put to death in the body, but he came to life in the spirit.
target_text: te kristus madhe ca tèka di, lula èdhi dhèu rai-haha tao sala. nèngu dhu mamuri mola, madhe le pala èdhi dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèngu madhe sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èdhi kahèi, dhèu pamadhe ne, te ngaa roh lamatua pamamuri hari ne.

source_text: he went to speak to those imprisoned
target_text: roh èèna kahèi lere nèti nèngu la'e aj'a-nori mi roh-roh dhu lèke bèdho ètu era èci, nuka sèmi d'ara bui.

source_text: that refused to believe, when god patiently waited in the time of noah while the ark was being built. only a few-in fact eight people-were saved through water.
target_text: roh se, nuka samanga nèti dhèu dhu uru-uru sèra ro'o boe nanene lamatua. lod'o èèna, noh tao kapa aae cue. lamatua tatae sèna ka neo nèdhi dhèu sèra tao madhutu dad'èi na, te ngaa rèngu pusi-pahae boe. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhoka dhèu aru di, dhu mamuri nèti èi aae lala.

source_text: this water symbolizes baptism that now saves you, not by washing off dirt from your body, but as a positive response to god that comes from a clear conscience. it is the resurrection of jesus christ that makes your salvation possible.
target_text: èi aae lala ne j'aj'i conto, nuka sèmi lod'o sarani miu. sarani ne j'aj'i tadha, peka na, lamatua patabuli eele miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu, lula kristus mamuri hari le. lod'o sarani miu, ra padiu boe miu, ho pamèu ngi'u mi. te dhu lèke ka, nuka, miu padhadha mi lamatua, ho neo tao pamèu d'ara miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na, miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: having ascended to heaven, he stands at god's right hand, with angels, authorities, and powers placed under his control.
target_text: limuri ne, yesus lèpa hari le asa sorga. ètu nèi, na madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, re baboa g'ana ama lamatua. ka ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga, koasa aa'i-aa'i, dènge dhu rèd'u koasa, hud'i nanene ku kristus.

source_text: since christ suffered physically, you must prepare yourselves with the same attitude he had-for those who suffer physically have turned away from sin.
target_text: kristus èèna, dhèu rai-haha èci èèna ka dènge èdhi. lula nèngu abhu le j'aj'èra ae-ae, miu hud'i pa'èra dui sasusa sama sèmi nèngu kahèi. te ngaa sanèd'e, te dhèu dhu abhu susa lula pa'èki dènge kristus, nèngu pama'ète nare le ho ad'u-ue heka sasala.

source_text: you will not live the rest of your lives following human desires, but doing what god wants.
target_text: masi ka nèngu mamuri era ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa nèngu mamuri heka ètu d'ara sasala sama sèmi dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: in the past you've spent enough time following the ways of the world: immorality, sexual indulgence, drunken orgies, partying, binge drinking, and revolting idol-worship.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ae le ka dhu miu bisa pake ho ad'u-ue bhabhelu ngaa èèna ka, sama sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua. nuka sèmi: rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. tao j'ara makae. tao bhabhelu madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rinu mahu. rèngu tao pesta liar. rèngu tao pesta j'ara makae rupa-rupa. ra sogo-tagu nidhu dènge j'ara dhu pamamuru iisi èdhi.

source_text: people think it's strange that you don't join them anymore in this wild and excessive lifestyle, so they curse at you. but they will have to explain what they've done to the one who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
target_text: rèngu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara miu, lula rèngu re'a boe, nga tao ka miu tao boe madhutu bhabhelu sèmi rèngu dhu seli-kolane èèna.

source_text: that's why the good news was shared with those who've already died-
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, bèli-camèd'a rèngu hud'i lasi ku asa madha ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i dhèu pama'ète lii langu. rèngu hud'i lole dènge ama lamatua nga tao ka rèngu mamuri ètu d'ara bhelu-katub'a sèmi sèra. baku bhèlu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i bèli-camèd'a hud'i lasi ku asa madha nèngu. dhèu dhu mamuri era, do dhu madhe le, aa'i-aa'i hud'i lasi ku asa madha lamatua.

source_text: so that although they were rightly judged as far as being sinful human beings is concerned, they could live in the spirit as far as god is concerned.
target_text: lèke tare'a! ama lamatua neo parisa dhèu dhu madhe le, nuka sèmi dhu nèngu parisa dhèu rai-haha leo sèra. te nèngu neo ne'a j'ara mamuri rèngu uru sèra. nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e le peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua mi dedha rèngu, sèna ka rèngu kahèi bisa abhu mamuri dhu lèke ho tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: everything is coming to an end! so think clearly and stay alert when you pray.
target_text: lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe dètu ae le. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pajiko paie-iie dènge d'ara dhu mau, sèna ka lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi miu.

source_text: most of all, you should love one another very deeply, for love covers many of the wrong things people do.
target_text: dhu lèke ka, miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu èci dènge èci. te masi ka dhèu leo tao sasala ae-ae, te ngaa miu bisa pa'angalai era dènge ne, lula miu sue ne.

source_text: show hospitality to one another, and don't complain.
target_text: pakabhèle ai sèna ka sèmi mere dhèu tao-mai ho manubha ètu d'ara èmu miu. te ngaa sanèd'e, baku sèmi mere si dènge d'ara ka'uu-kamuki.

source_text: whatever gift you've been given, share it with others among you, as people who wisely demonstrate god's grace in all its different forms.
target_text: èdhi dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i abhu le karunya nèti lamatua. de èdhi hud'i pake karunya ne ho lalau-lalo'o a'ari dhèu parcaya. haduli aa pake pabe'a-be'a karunya èèna, te èèna ka dhu dènge guna hia mi lamatua.

source_text: anyone who speaks should do so as though god is speaking through them. anyone who wants to help others should do so through the strength that god gives, so that in everything god may be glorified through jesus christ. may glory and power be his forever and ever. amen.
target_text: nuka sèmi: ladhe abhu karunya aj'a-nori dhèu, na, sanèd'e te miu hud'i lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua. ladhe abhu karunya ho ladhe-leru dhèu, na, sab'a pake a'èra dhu lamatua pala-bagi mi miu. dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i tadhe, na, miu dhèu unu yesus kristus. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. te nèngu èèna, kapai titu kèna! aa koasa nèd'u paredha na dhu dènge boe too-lane! lèke tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: my friends, don't be alarmed at the ordeals of fire you're having, as if these were unexpected.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! mage malaa ladhe paraga dènge dadugu-rariu dhu bia. te èèna neo uji parcaya miu. baku pangee, na, dhoka èu di dhu abhu dadugu-rariu sèmi èèna.

source_text: be happy to the extent that you share in christ's suffering, because when he appears in his glory, you will be incredibly happy!
target_text: te ngaa d'ara miu bisa karej'e-karae, lula miu abhu j'aj'èra sama sèmi kristus dhu abhu j'aj'èra kahèi. dènge j'ara ne, èèna na d'ara miu asa karej'e-karae ropa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi dadedha kristus.

source_text: if you are cursed in christ's name, you're blessed, for god's glorious spirit rests on you.
target_text: ropa dhèu pahahe miu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus, miu oto, lula dadedha roh lamatua pa'èra miu.

source_text: if you suffer, it should not be as a murderer, or a thief, or a criminal, or as a gossip-
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu abhu j'aj'èra, na, baku lula miu pamadhe dhèu, do, dhèu mana'u, dhèu bhelu-katub'a, do, dhèu dhu d'èi soro iisi asa lii langu dhèu.

source_text: but if it's as a christian, then you don't need to be ashamed. instead praise god that you're called by that name!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu pasae j'aj'èra lula j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, nèngu baku makae. hua iia risi rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua, lula rèngu j'aj'i dhèu kristen.

source_text: for the time of judgment has come-and it begins with the house of god. if it begins with us, what will be the end of those who reject god's good news?
target_text: lod'o d'ai le ho dhèu lasi asa madha ama lamatua. na parisa uuru mamuri dhèu-dhèu unu na. de pangee paie-iie! ladhe na mulai nèti èdhi dhèu kristen, na, tasa mera mia dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe sèmi lii lolo be'a na? tatu hahuku rèngu bia risi hari!

source_text: if it's hard for those who live right to be saved, what will happen to sinners, those who oppose god?
target_text: te abhu dhu suri ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, na, ladhe dhèu dhu mamuri mola oe abhu boe mamuri sa hèi, tasamia hari dènge rèngu dhu ro'o boe pahae lamatua? aa tasamia hari dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala?

source_text: so then those who suffer according to the will of god, the trustworthy creator, should make sure they are doing good.
target_text: de ladhe ama lamatua soro tèke dhèu unu na abhu susa madhutu dad'èi lamatua, na, rèngu bisa lèka, peka na, èèna na nèngu j'aga si kahèi. te nèngu ka paj'aj'i si. nèngu kahèi tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka le. lula nèngu j'aga si sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka rèngu bisa tao taruu j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: i want to encourage the elders among you. i'm also an elder, a witness to christ's sufferings, and i will share in the glory that is to come.
target_text: ja'a ne, ca dhèu kètu kahèi. uru èèna, lod'o kristus pasae j'aj'èra na, ja'a kèdhi unu ku dènge musi madha ja'a. aa bèli-camèd'a ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i laladhe rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, ja'a kahèi neo kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. de ja'a neo holo kètu juma'at dhu leo sèra, na:

source_text: look after god's flock you have been given to care for, watching over it not because you're forced to, but gladly, as god wants you to. do this willingly, not looking to make a profit from it.
target_text: miu nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu ladhe-leru kahib'i-kalèbho ra. de miu hud'i leru paie-iie dhèu dhu lamatua pangèd'u asa miu. uri si paie-iie. mage miu ladhe-leru si, lula dhoka sasab'a miu di, te ngaa lula miu d'èi tao sèmi èèna. uli si madhutu dad'èi lamatua. baku d'èi tenge oto, te ngaa sab'a dènge karej'e ho soru-bara dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: don't be arrogant, lording it over those who have been put in your care, but be an example to the flock.
target_text: baku paredha leli, ho pabia dhèu dhu lamatua hia miu ladhe-leru si. te ngaa miu hud'i j'aj'i conto dhu be'a, dhu bisa paj'uj'u j'ara hia rèngu.

source_text: when the chief shepherd appears, you will receive a glorious crown that will never fade.
target_text: yesus, nuka sèmi kètu nèti dhèu madhenga badha. bèli-camèd'a ladhe na lèpa hari mai, ama lamatua neo b'ae rui-j'aj'èra miu, lula miu uri dhèu miu dènge be'a. upa ne, bisa boe ele iie, te ngaa taha taa-taa d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: young people, do what the elders tell you. indeed all of you should serve one another in humility, because god is against the proud, but favors the humble.
target_text: ana ngèru aa'i-aa'i! miu kahèi hud'i nanene ku kètu juma'at sèra. miu aa'i-aa'i mi baku padedha iisi. te ètu sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, lamatua lab'a dhèu dhu padedha iisi, te ngaa nèngu d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu dhu pahaha iisi.

source_text: humble yourself before god's powerful hand so that he will lift you up at the appropriate time.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i sanèd'e ku koasa lamatua, sèna ka miu baku pamone-pabhèni. hèia ropa d'ai lod'o na, lamatua koa-kad'iri miu.

source_text: surrender all your worries to him, because he cares for you.
target_text: pataleo d'ara miu, sèna ka lamatua uri j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu tao miu madha'u. te nèngu ka dhu haduli miu.

source_text: be responsible, and stay alert. the devil, your enemy, is prowling around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.
target_text: mage-mage! pake ngangee madhera. aa j'aga paie-iie, te musu èdhi, nuka dhèu aae nidhu, neo palaho miu. neo dhèle aa'i miu, nuka sèmi singa dhu manganga, dhu patangi-tenge badha neo na'a.

source_text: stand firm against him, trusting in god. remember that your fellow-believers around the world are going through similar troubles.
target_text: te ngaa baku madha'u. miu hud'i lab'a dhèu aae nidhu èèna. miu hud'i pa'èra lalèka miu mi lamatua kahèi. te miu me'a le, na, a'ari miu dhèu parcaya buli mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, abhu sasusa sama sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: after you have suffered for a little while, the god of all grace who called you into his eternal glory in christ, will himself restore you, support you, strengthen you, and give you a solid foundation.
target_text: te ngaa sanèd'e, te ama lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi kahèi. nèngu ka dhu paroa le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula miu sèmi mere le kristus. nèti èèna ka, nèngu neo ded'e miu padedha-dedha, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri taruu dènge nèngu. te ngaa ladhe miu abhu le j'aj'èra dhoka ètu d'ara ciki oo'e di ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua neo pabe'a hari miu. na neo pa'èra miu, aa tao miu bisa taha. nèngu pamadhèdi miu kahèi mi dedha fanderen dhu èra.

source_text: to him be power forever and ever! amen.
target_text: ji'i manèngi sèna ka lamatua nèd'u koasa aa'i-aa'i toke d'ai mia-mia. lèke tare'a!

source_text: with the help of silvanus, whom i consider a trustworthy brother, i send this letter to you. in these few words i've written i want to encourage you and testify that this is the true grace of god. stand firm in god's grace!
target_text: silas ka dhu soru-bara ja'a ho suri sasuri dhu bab'a ne. nèngu ne, a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya, aa ai g'ana ja'a. ja'a holo-nori miu sèna ka miu taha pa'èra, te lamatua d'èi pad'elo d'ara hua iia na taruu mi èdhi. de miu hud'i èra ku, sèna ka baku hari kabodho.

source_text: the believers here in babylon, chosen together with you, send their greetings to you, as does mark, my son.
target_text: dhèu parcaya dhu pakaboko ètu kota babel hia miu lii maho'o. ama lamatua hag'e nare le rèngu, sama sèmi na pili miu. ana ja'a markus pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: greet each other with a kiss of love. peace to all of you who are in christ.
target_text: ladhe miu paraga, na, pa'uu èci dènge èci ho pad'elo pasue miu. ja'a d'èi ladhe miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu parcaya kristus bisa mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. saloom, petrus

source_text: this letter comes from simon peter, a servant and apostle of jesus christ, to those who share with us the same priceless trust in our god and savior jesus christ, the one who is truly good and right.
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, simon petrus. ja'a j'aj'i ana pua-paleha yesus kristus. ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na kahèi, dhu na pua laku asa mia-mia ho lole dènge dhèu lula-nèti nèngu. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, dhu parcaya le yesus kristus. lula d'ara mola ama lamatua, ka na bhoke j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus kahèi, sama sèmi ji'i. parcaya ne kab'ua titu kèna hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. kristus èèna j'aj'i ama lamatua èdhi, aa nèngu kahèi j'aj'i dhèu dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo.

source_text: may you have ever more grace and peace as you grow in the knowledge of god and of jesus our lord.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu tadhe mèu ama lamatua, aa tadhe kètu èdhi, yesus, dènge be'a. hud'i laa sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu bisa mamuri dènge dame aa mera-milu èci dènge èci.

source_text: through his divine power we have been given everything that's important to live a god-centered life. this comes through knowing him who called us to himself by his own glory and goodness. in this way he's given us wonderful, priceless promises.
target_text: yesus dhu dènge koasa èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus papala èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti ngaa-ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèngu tao sèmi èèna, lula èdhi tadhe mèu ne. aa na paroa èdhi ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na, lula d'ara hua iia dènge dadedha na.

source_text: through these promises you can share in the divine nature, being rid of the corruption caused by this world's evil desires.
target_text: yesus hia le èdhi j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia. te uru èèna, na padhadha tèke le ho neo hia j'ara se'e. lii padhadha na, aa'i-aa'i be'a titu kèna. yesus hia aa'i mèu-mèu se'e mi èdhi, sèna ka d'ara èdhi bisa sama sèmi d'ara lamatua. aa èdhi bisa lehe tare j'ara-j'ara karehe dhu dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi ad'u-ue, lula rèngu mamuri d'èi dhoka tao madhutu dad'èi unu ra, aa dhu taha rare boe d'ara ra.

source_text: for this same reason, do everything you can! add to your trust in god, goodness; add to goodness, knowledge;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu pa'èra tao j'ara dhu be'a. mema miu parcaya le yesus, te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka. sab'a taruu j'ara dhu be'a. tadhe lamatua dènge be'a risi hari.

source_text: add to knowledge, self-control; add to self-control, patience; add to patience, reverence;
target_text: te ngaa mage d'ai dhoka sange èèna di. patema mamuri ho taha mere d'ara. te ngaa sèra dhae d'ai mèka kahèi. lod'o-lod'o miu abhu sasusa, na, miu hud'i pa'èra d'ara ho baku hari kabodho. te ngaa tao parisi hari nèti èèna. tao aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: add to reverence, affection for fellow-believers, add to affection for fellow-believers, love.
target_text: te ngaa mage dhoka d'ai sange èèna di. pad'elo sasue mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra. te ngaa èèna dhae d'ai mèka kahèi. te miu hud'i mamuri pasue taruu.

source_text: the more you have these qualities, the more they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: ladhe mamuri miu sèmi sèra ka, aa j'ara dhu be'a asa tabha taruu, na, sèra sa hia miu asa tadhe mèu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te j'ara dhu be'a ele boe iia d'ara, aa core eele boe lod'o kahèi. te j'ara be'a se'e ka dhu tao d'ara miu ho me'a mèu nèngu.

source_text: for anyone who doesn't have such qualities is short-sighted, or blind. they forget that they've been cleansed from their past sins.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu d'èi boe tao sèmi sèra, sasoa na, ngangee nèngu bab'a. nèngu nèdhi boe ngaa ètu madha nèngu, nuka sèmi dhèu bèdhu. te lamatua dhu saku eele le sasala na, sèna ka d'ara nèngu bisa mola-mèci. te ngaa dhèu ne bhèlu eele!

source_text: so, brothers and sisters, be all the more determined to make sure you are truly called and chosen. if you do this, you won't ever fall.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu limuri ne hud'i bori dhari asa pa'èra. lamatua hag'e nare le miu j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ka miu lami asa madha na. de miu hud'i pad'elo ku, na, miu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na. ladhe j'ara dhu ja'a peka se tabha taruu ètu mamuri miu, na, miu manahu boe.

source_text: you will receive a tremendous welcome into the eternal kingdom of our lord and savior jesus christ.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, ama lamatua bagi hia miu j'ara èci dhu kapai titu kèna. nuka na bhoke pataleo j'ara, dènge pangèd'u miu hak, ho sèmi mere yesus kristus j'aj'i dhèu aae miu, sèna ka miu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia dènge ne. te yesus kristus ne, kètu èdhi. aa nèngu kahèi, dhèu dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: that's why i always remind you about these things, even though you know them already, and you stand firm in the truth that you possess.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a peka deo sa, aa miu taha pa'èra, lula miu parcaya ngaa dhu lèke. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ja'a loe boe pasanèd'e miu pahari-pahari, sèna ka miu baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: but i still think it's a good idea to encourage you by giving you reminders while i live.
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe ladhe miu pabhèlu eele j'ara sèra. ja'a d'èi pasanèd'e miu taruu, sèna ka miu pajiko taruu j'ara se'e se, ètu d'ara kahadhu miu. te lod'o ja'a mamuri ètu rai-haha ne era, mema sala boe ladhe ja'a loe boe pasanèd'e j'ara se'e mi miu.

source_text: i know the time when i shall leave this life will be coming soon- our lord jesus christ has made this clear to me.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a madhe, sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus peka le dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a le.

source_text: i will do my best so that when i'm gone you will always be able to remember these things.
target_text: masi ka bèli-camèd'a ja'a madhe, te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a tenge j'ara ho miu sanèd'e taruu j'ara se'e.

source_text: we didn't follow made-up myths when we told you about the coming in power of our lord jesus christ-we saw his majesty for ourselves.
target_text: ca hari na, ja'a dènge angalai ja'a lole le dènge miu, lula-nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ji'i peka kahèi, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe kristus lèpa hari mai, mamai nèngu èèna dènge koasa dhu kapai titu kèna. lèke, si? dhu ji'i lolo se, nanuku boe. lula ji'i lole dhoka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi dènge musi madha ji'i unu mi! nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a, na, dadedha yesus kristus ne nuka sèmi dhèu aae kapai sa.

source_text: he received honor and glory from god the father when the voice of majestic glory spoke to him and announced, this is my son, the one i love, and who truly pleases me. we ourselves heard this voice speak from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
target_text: ca tèka, ji'i sama-sama dènge yesus ètu ledhe mola-mèci lamatua. hèia ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu peka lula-nèti dadedha yesus ne. te lod'o èèna, ji'i tadèngi lii dhu be'a titu kèna mai nèti dedha-liru, peka na, ne'e ne, ana pasue ja'a. nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: we also have the confirming word of prophecy that's absolutely trustworthy, and you will benefit from paying close attention to it. it's like a lamp that shines in a dark place until the day dawns, and the morning star shines to illuminate your minds.
target_text: èèna ka dhu tao ji'i asa lèka èra lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu uru sèra ji'i abhu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. de hua iia risi miu tao madhutu lii moa dhèu se'e! te lii moa rèngu sèra, nuka sèmi labhu èci dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga. de miu hud'i nanene paie-iie ku lii moa se, toke d'ai yesus mai hari. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu asa tabha me'a mèu. te èèna na nuka sèmi miu mèdhi uuru ku hua-hètu aae dhimu, hèia lod'o heka rea kèna ho pasaraa aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: most of all you should realize that no prophecy of scripture is a matter for interpretation based on the whims of an individual,
target_text: sanèd'e, te dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema le j'ara ae-ae. te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu rèngu peka-padhai se nèti boe dad'èi rèngu.

source_text: for no prophecy originated in human ideas, but prophets spoke for god as they were moved by the holy spirit.
target_text: lula ngaa dhu rèngu suri se, mai boe nèti ngaa dhu rèngu neo padhai lii. te ngaa mai nèti ama lamatua, madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci na pad'elo dènge rèngu.

source_text: but just as there were false prophets among the people then, there will be false teachers among you. they subtly introduce false and destructive teachings, even denying the lord who redeemed them, quickly bringing destruction on themselves.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu isra'el cahag'e peka na, rèngu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa te ngaa rèngu se kapod'e-kabèli di. pe miu paraga dènge dhèu sèmi sèra ètu talora aae miu. te abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, rèngu aj'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua, te ngaa ra leko-monya di. rèngu aj'a pahuni-pahuni ngangee rèngu dhu karehe. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa pamaso a'aj'a rèngu dhu koe-kapengo sèra. ladhe miu nanene lii aj'a-nori rèngu, bèli-camèd'a miu abhu calaka. rèngu pasili, peka na, lamatua yesus èèna, lamatua rèngu boe. aa te ngaa, yesus ka dhu sui nare rèngu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. lula tatao rèngu sèmi ne'e ne ka, nèbhu boe rèngu unu ra laho malai.

source_text: many will follow their immoral perversions, and because of them people will condemn the way of truth.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèli-camèd'a abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu madhutu rèngu, aa tao leli dhu re'a heka makae. bèli-camèd'a dhèu pakarehe a'aj'a dhu lèke, lula tatao rèngu.

source_text: they will greedily exploit you with false tales. however, they are already condemned: their sentence has been hanging over them for a long time, and their destruction won't be postponed.
target_text: mese dhu kapod'e-kabèli sèra manga'a-dèu ngara. rèngu ad'u-ue rupa-rupa lii padhai, sèna ka tipu rare doi-dhari miu. te ngaa baku bhèlu, te ama lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu dhu pasaruru nèdhi boe musi madha. karèi nèti uru ka, nèngu pa'èra mema le ho huku si. bèli-camèd'a ra laho aa'i.

source_text: for god didn't even spare the angels when they sinned. he threw them into tartarus, holding them in dark pits ready for judgment.
target_text: conto sèmi, uru èèna, abhu ana pajuu ama lamatua cahag'e ètu sorga dhu tao sala. te ngaa lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu soro tèke boe si. na pèci si asa d'ara naraka, aa bèdho si ètu d'ara ro'a maroga dhu marèma aae. rèngu pea taha ètu èèna toke d'ai lod'o lasi asa madha ama lamatua.

source_text: god didn't spare the ancient world either, but he protected noah who told people about the god who did right. he was one of the eight who were saved when god sent a flood upon a world of evil people.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu mamuri uru-uru sèra. tèu èèna, rèngu ad'u-ue bhelu-katub'a dènge pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. te ngaa lamatua dhu ator le dhèu na èci dhu d'ara mola, ngara na noh, pad'elo j'ara sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mola. te ngaa ro'o boe nanene ne kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua hia èi aae lala, ka palaho aa'i dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe ne. te ngaa lamatua hia mamuri dhoka noh dènge isi èmu na. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra aru dhèu.

source_text: god condemned the cities of sodom and gomorrah to total destruction, burning them to ash, as an example of what will happen to those who live evil lives.
target_text: ca tèka hari, dhèu uru-uru sèra ètu kota sodom dènge kota gomora, mamuri dhoka ad'u-ue bhabhelu-katub'a. hèia ama lamatua huku si. nèngu labhu pakèpu aa'i si j'aj'i ahu, ka dhèu ètu sèra madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. se'e se j'aj'i mi conto hia mi dhèu leo dhu d'èi mamuri ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a dènge dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua. rèngu bisa re'a mema le mamadhe-mamopo ra, ladhe ele boe ho'a.

source_text: but god rescued lot because he was a good man, sickened by the disgusting immorality of his neighbors.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu ca dhèu ngara na lot, dhu mamuri mola. nèngu roca le dènge tatao dhu seli-kolane nèti dhèu bhelu se'e, dhu ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua. ka ama lamatua pakaj'èu lot nèti era èèna.

source_text: lot lived among them, but he did what was good and right. he saw and heard what they did day after day, and their wickedness tormented him.
target_text: lot ne ca dhèu dhu d'èi tao dhu lèke, te ngaa na pea ètu talora aae dhèu sodom. bèli-bèli èèna, lot nèdhi aa tadèngi kahèi rèngu sisu atora ama lamatua. se'e se ka dhu pasusa d'ara lot.

source_text: as you can see, the lord is able to rescue from their troubles those who respect him, and to keep the wicked until the day of judgment when their punishment is completed.
target_text: conto sèra sa pad'elo, peka na, ama lamatua ne'a j'ara hia mamuri mi dhèu dhu d'èi nanene nèngu, ka na pakaj'èu si nèti rupa-rupa dadugu-rariu. nèngu ne'a pamanahu hahuku dhu bia kahèi mi dhèu dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. aa lamatua tao j'ara se'e toke d'ai lod'o na pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: this is especially so for those who follow their corrupt human desires, and contemptuously disregard authority. arrogant and proud, they're not even afraid to defame heavenly beings.
target_text: hahuku dhu bia èèna, lèke risi-risi mi dhèu dhu d'èi dhoka mamuri kaj'alu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara ra. rèngu ro'o boe nanene ca dhèu sa, aa pahahe dhèu dhu rèd'u koasa. tatu ama lamatua huku si. de mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra bani titu kèna, aa padedha iisi seli eele. rèngu ro'o boe pakab'ua aa madha'u boe padhai lii pa'ele iie kolongara ama lamatua dènge ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: angels, on the other hand, even though they are stronger and more powerful, don't disparage them before the lord.
target_text: madhutu mola-mola na, ana pajuu lamatua ètu sorga sèra èra risi nèti rèngu mese-mese kapod'e-kabèli se. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana-ana pajuu se padhai lii pa'ele iie boe kolongara mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra ètu madha lamatua rèngu. aa ra pèci boe sasala asa mese sèra kahèi.

source_text: these people are like mindless beasts, produced like farm animals to be captured and slaughtered. they condemn things they don't know anything about, and just like animals they will be destroyed.
target_text: te ngaa mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra re'a dhoka padhai lii pa'ele iie j'ara-j'ara dhu rèngu mesa ra re'a boe. te rèngu èci èèna ka dènge badha dhu dènge boe ngangee na! be'a risi, kèpe ho palaho eele si! te kalua aapa rèngu, sèmi èèna ka. tatu bèli-camèd'a rèngu laho aa'i, lula tatao rèngu dhu karehe sèra.

source_text: they will be paid back in harm for the harm they have done. their idea of fun is to commit their evil lusts in broad daylight. they are stains and blemishes on your community. they enjoy their deceptive pleasures even while they eat together with you.
target_text: rèngu paj'èra ae le dhèu. pe, ama lamatua pasusa rèngu kahèi, lula tatao rèngu dhu lèke boe sèra. rèngu d'èi dhoka tao pesta liar. ladhe re mèu, rèngu d'èi tao leli kahèi, sèna ka dhèu bisa rèdhi bhabhelu rèngu. rèngu re'a boe makae, ka pa'ele iie kolongara miu. ladhe rèngu ra'a pesta sama-sama dènge miu, rèngu d'èi dhoka neo tao madhutu bhabhelu ra.

source_text: they're always on the lookout for adulterous relationships-they just can't stop sinning. they seduce the vulnerable; they have trained themselves in greed; they are offspring under a curse.
target_text: musi madha ra seru lee, ho patangi-tenge dhèu bhèni dhu neo karihu kaj'alu dènge rèngu. mamuri rèngu dhoka bhelu-katub'a di. rèngu tenge dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe mi lamatua, ka pamako si, sèna ka pa'èci dènge rèngu ho tao bhabhelu. rèngu manga'a, aa re'a boe roca. tatu ama lamatua huku si!

source_text: they have abandoned the right path and have gone astray, following the way of balaam, the son of beor, who loved to be paid for doing evil. but he was rebuked for his evil actions-a dumb donkey spoke with a human voice and stopped the prophet's foolishness!
target_text: mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra, uru èèna, rèngu dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mola, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka ra sero eele j'ara. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu sèra nuka sèmi balaam, ana bosor. nèngu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua. te ngaa nèngu d'èi dhoka tenge doi-dhari di, nèti èèna ka na tao j'ara dhu lèke boe. ca tèka, balaam manya'e badha keled'ei. keled'ei dhu bisa boe padhai lii. te ngaa lod'o èèna, lamatua hia keled'ei ne padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu! ka keled'ei ne kai balaam, lula bhabhelu na. dad'èi keled'ei ne, sèna ka balaam ae eele ka nèti tatao na dhu koe-kapengo, nuka sèmi dhèu huj'u sa.

source_text: people like these are springs without water, mists blown away by the wind. they are destined for blackest darkness-forever.
target_text: mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra, èci èèna ka dènge madha èi dhu guna boe, lula mèti eele. rèngu cakaraa kahèi dènge bhuru dhu guna boe, lula lai ngèlu tiu eele. ama lamatua tao tèke le era dhu maroga aatu-aatu èci, sèna ka taha si.

source_text: inflated with their own nonsense, they appeal to sensual desires, luring back into immorality those who have only just escaped from those who live in error.
target_text: te rèngu padhai lii hèb'a-hua dhu dènge boe sasoa. rèngu dadugu dhèu, sèna ka madhutu tao j'ara dhu lèke-lèke boe. rèngu d'èi pamako dhèu dhu heka lèpa hari asa j'ara mola, sèna ka tao hari j'ara karehe.

source_text: they promise them freedom, even though they themselves are slaves to depravity. you are a slave to whatever conquers you.
target_text: dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se padhadha, peka na, ladhe miu nanene ji'i, na, miu neo tao ngaa èèna ka madhutu dad'èi miu, na, tao laa! te ngaa dhèu dhu peka sèmi sèra sa, sama sèmi ènu dhu bisa boe pakaj'èu iisi ra nèti bhelu-katub'a. te dhèu dhu soro tèke j'ara èci ator nèngu, nèngu j'aj'i le ènu ètu j'ara èèna.

source_text: if people manage to escape from the evil influence of the world by knowing the lord and savior jesus christ, and then get tangled up in sin again and are defeated, they are worse off than they were in the first place.
target_text: ladhe neo pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu ètu rai-haha dhu pakaj'alu èdhi, na, èdhi hud'i tadhe dènge be'a ku kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu pakaj'èu nèti nèngu, hèia pa'èki hari dènge bhabhelu sama sèmi uru sèra, èèna nuka sèmi bhabhelu sèra ka dhu ator rèngu. d'ai lod'o limuri, rèngu asa tabha j'èra!

source_text: it would have been better not to have known the right way of truth, than to have known it and then turn away from the sacred instructions they'd been given.
target_text: be'a risi, ladhe dhèu re'a rèdhi mèka j'ara mola. te ladhe dhèu re'a le j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, te ngaa ra pakaj'èu iisi ra, ka tao boe madhutu j'ara dhu be'a dènge dhu mola, dhu ama lamatua paredha le mi èdhi, èèna be'a boe.

source_text: this proverb has come true for them: the dog has returned to its own vomit, and the washed pig has gone back to rolling in the mud.
target_text: abhu lii tate'a dhu palèke dènge mese kapod'e-kabèli se, dhu peka na, ladhe busa mèdhu, na'e hari mèdhu na. dhu leo hari peka na, masi ka padiu tare le hahi ci'u, te ngaa la'e hari loli èi lobho.

source_text: my friends, this is my second letter to you. in both of them i've tried to stir you up and remind you to think clearly with pure minds.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ne'e ne, sasuri ka dua kèna nèti ja'a dhu ja'a pa'adhu hia miu. ètu d'ara sasuri dua se, ja'a pasanèd'e le miu ho bisa pangee j'ara-j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: remember the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets, and what the lord and savior commanded through your apostles.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie lii lolo nèti dhèu mola-mèci dhu rèti lii padhai lamatua uru-uru sèra. sanèd'e kahèi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus. pangee paie ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha mi rèngu ho peka mi miu. te nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala mi!

source_text: above all you should know that derisive people will come in the last days, full of mockery and following their own evil desires.
target_text: sanèd'e sèmi ne'e: d'ara lod'o èle rai-haha sèra, abhu le dhèu dhu padhèto d'ara lii, dhu tao leli madhutu dad'èi ra. rèngu padhai lii pa'ele iie aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke.

source_text: so what happened to this coming he promised? they ask. right from the time our ancestors died, everything's continued as it always has, ever since creation began.
target_text: dhèu se, peka na, baku pusi-pahae! yesus padhadha, na, nèngu neo mai hari, do? ladhe sèmi èèna, nèngu buli mia? te karèi nèti bèi-baki èdhi madhe, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne, ngaa-ngaa èci sa dhu ub'a boe. ngaa aa'i-aa'i sama sèmi uru-uru sèra, karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha.

source_text: but they deliberately ignore the fact that by god's command the heavens were created long ago. the earth came into existence from the water, and was surrounded by water. it was through water that the world that then existed was destroyed-through being flooded by water. but by means of that same divine command the heavens and the earth that now exist are reserved for destruction by fire at the day of judgment when the wicked will be destroyed.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca j'ara dhu dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se ro'o boe sanèd'e. nuka, karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua dhoka padhai lii di, ka liru j'aj'i dènge. ka na paj'aj'i èi. hèia na hag'e èi nèti rai-dedha, ka rai-dedha cèu nèti d'ara èi. ladhe lamatua padhai lii sèmi mia, na, j'aj'i dènge sèmi èèna ka. nèbhu ae ku, lod'o noh mamuri era, ama lamatua pake èi aae lala ho palaho aa'i mèu-mèu dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua dhu peka tèke le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a na tao ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha ne. limuri ne lamatua tatae era, te ngaa ropa d'ai lod'o èèna, tatu na neo tunu pakèpu aa'i si. te lamatua bèli-camèd'a papuru hahuku, sèna ka palaho dhèu dhu pusi-pahae boe nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu kapod'e-kabèli se ro'o boe re'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua tatu tao madhutu ngaa dhu na peka sèra.

source_text: however, my friends, don't forget this one thing: that for the lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years is like a day.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! baku bhèlu j'ara ne'e. lamatua èdhi ige boe lod'o sama sèmi dhu èdhi ige. te madhutu nèngu, na, ca lod'o bisa sama sèmi ca riho tèu. aa ca riho tèu bisa nuka ca lod'o doko di.

source_text: the lord is not delaying the fulfillment of his promise, as some define delay, but he is being very patient with you. he doesn't want anyone to be lost, but everyone to come and repent.
target_text: ladhe lamatua èdhi pajaji neo tao ngaa èci sa, na tao pamèci dènge lod'o na, aa pamata boe. abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pangee, na, nèngu sab'a nena di. madhutu iia-iia na, sèmi boe èèna! te na taha d'ara, ho tatae d'ai ku lod'o na. dad'èi lamatua èdhi, ho dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele-ho'a ku, sèna ka tèke eele sasala-sasigo ra, hèia lèpa madhutu nèngu. te d'ara na la'e boe, ladhe dhèu pacèri nèti nèngu.

source_text: however, the day of the lord will come, unexpectedly like a thief. the heavens will explode with a thunderous roar, and the elements will be destroyed as they are burned up. the earth and everything in it will vanish.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lèpa hari mai, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a mema. te mamai na dènge sahèka, nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u maso asa d'ara èmu. lod'o èèna, aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru kèpu aa'i mèu-mèu, nuka madha lod'o, liru dènge hua-hètu. aa'i-aa'i ra ele! sèmi èèna kahèi, rai-haha ne dènge isi na aa'i-aa'i. kèpu eele!

source_text: since everything is going to be destroyed in this way, what kind of people should you be? you should be living lives that are pure, dedicated to god,
target_text: de ladhe aa'i-aa'i kèpu ladhu ai sèmi èèna, na, mamuri miu hud'i sèmi ngaa sa? miu hud'i pa'èra-èra mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. miu hud'i mamuri mola-mèci!

source_text: waiting expectantly and being eager for the coming of the day of god. that day the heavens will catch fire and be destroyed, and the elements will melt in the heat.
target_text: miu hud'i tatae mamai lamatua kahèi. de miu hud'i pa'èra taruu, sèna ka lod'o èèna j'aj'i malai risi hari. lod'o èèna, liru kèpu ladhu ai kahèi. aa ngaa aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru kèpu toke roe eele aa'i si.

source_text: but as for us, we are looking for new heavens and a new earth that god has promised where everything is good and right.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, abhu liru rupa hiu dènge rai-haha rupa hiu. ama lamatua dhu moa tèke le sèmi èèna ka. j'ara se'e se ka dhu èdhi mate tae-tae. ètu era nèi abhu dhoka dhèu dhu mamuri mola di.

source_text: so, my friends, since you're anticipating these things, make sure you'll be found pure and blameless, and at peace with god.
target_text: de a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o miu tatae j'ara se'e se era, miu hud'i bori pa'èra dhari ho j'aj'i dhèu be'a madhutu a'abhu ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala asa miu. pa'èra sèna ka mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: remember that it is our lord's patience that gives the opportunity for salvation. that's what our dear brother paul was explaining to you in all his letters with the wisdom given to him by god.
target_text: te lamatua èdhi taha d'ara, ho nèngu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo miu. a'ari èdhi paulus suri nèdhi le hia miu madha j'ara ae-ae dhu sama hua, si? lamatua ka dhu hia ne mamèu sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka nèngu suri madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: he spoke about these things, though some of what he wrote is certainly hard to understand. some ignorant and unbalanced people have twisted what he wrote to their own loss-just as they do other scriptures.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o dhu paulus suri sasuri, na peka kahèi j'ara se'e se. nèti sasuri na, abhu kahèi dhu èdhi te'a tare mèka sasoa na. abhu kahèi dhèu dhu pakapod'e asa j'ara leo nèti naneo paulus. dhèu se'e kahèi pakapod'e j'ara-j'ara dhu leo nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci lamatua. dhèu sèra, nuka dhèu bai-eed'a dhu ro'o boe pakanucu lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, aa rèngu dhèu dhu parcaya èra boe. dhèu sèmi se'e se, bèli-camèd'a laho unu ra.

source_text: my friends, since you already know this, make sure that these errors of the wicked don't lead you astray, and you don't fall from your firm position.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le j'ara mamuri nèti mese kapod'e-kabèli sèra. de baku pamud'e! te rèngu d'èi boe nanene atora èci sa. rèngu neo cob'a ho kapod'e miu nèti j'ara dhu mola. te ngaa baku soro tèke si segi miu. miu hud'i pakadhii ku lalèka miu.

source_text: may you grow in the grace and in the knowledge of our lord and savior jesus christ. may he have glory, both now and forever! amen.
target_text: be'a risi parcaya miu asa tabha èra. te miu me'a le kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. nèngu neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu. aa nèngu neo miu tadhe ne be'a risi hari kahèi. ja'a d'èi ladhe dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus nèti doe ne'e toke d'ai mia-mia la'e! saloom, petrus

source_text: this letter is about the word of life which existed from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our very own eyes and gazed upon, and which our hands have touched.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne, lula-nèti lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri. lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri ne, abhu mema le karèi nèti rai-haha j'aj'i. ne'e ne, ja'a dènge angalai ja'a ladhe ngèdhi le nèngu dènge musi madha ji'i. ji'i tadèngi le lii na dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i. aa ji'i g'ag'e ngèdhi le nèngu dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi. ji'i ladhe ngèdhi ne sèmi èèna ka,

source_text: this life was revealed to us; we saw it and give evidence about it. we are telling you about the one who is eternal life, who was with the father, and who was revealed to us.
target_text: lula na cèu mai ètu talora aae ji'i. uru èèna, nèngu pea dènge ama na, te ngaa limuri ne na pad'elo le ngi'u aae nèngu mi ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i bani lole dènge miu tasa mera mia dhèu rai-haha bisa abhu mamuri mola dhu dènge boe too-lane. te nèngu ne lii holo-nori dhu hia mamuri.

source_text: what we have seen and heard we are now explaining to you, so that you may also share in this friendship together with us-this friendship that is with the father, and with his son jesus christ.
target_text: ji'i neo peka dènge miu, aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i ngèdhi le aa aa'i-aa'i dhu ji'i tadèngi le, sèna ka miu dènge ji'i sama-sama bisa mamuri d'ara èci. te èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu pa'èki le dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na dhu nèngu pua mai, nuka yesus kristus.

source_text: we're writing to tell you about this in order to make our happiness complete.
target_text: de ji'i suri sasuri ne, sèna ka pamaho'o d'ara miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara ji'i asa tabha karej'e kahèi.

source_text: this is the message we received from him and that we declare to you: god is light, and there is absolutely no darkness in him at all.
target_text: a'aj'a dhu yesus lole dènge ji'i, èèna ka dhu limuri ne ji'i neo peka dènge miu. sèmi ne'e: ama lamatua be'a seli eele. bhabhelu-katub'a ciki sa abhu boe ètu nèngu. te nèngu ne nuka sèmi saraa dhu heo lo'a-lo'a, dhu pab'ali boe dènge maroga ciki sa.

source_text: if we claim to share this friendship with him and yet go on living in darkness, we're lying, and not living in the truth.
target_text: ladhe èdhi padhai lii, peka na, èdhi mamuri d'ara èci dènge lamatua, aa te ngaa èdhi mamuri tao bhelu era, na, èèna sama sèmi èdhi mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te èdhi padhai lii kapod'e-kabèli aa mamuri madhutu boe j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: but if we are living in the light, as he is in the light, then we share in this friendship with one another, and the blood of jesus, his son, makes us clean from every sin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi mamuri madhutu j'ara mola, èdhi èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa mamuri d'ara èci. aa d'ara èdhi mola-mèci, lula mamadhe yesus kristus, ana ama lamatua, aa raa nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi.

source_text: if we claim to be sinless we only fool ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi padhai lii, peka na, èdhi tao boe sala, èèna j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èdhi tipu ngi'u èdhi unu ti, aa te'a boe mia ka dhu lèke.

source_text: but if we confess our sins, he is trustworthy and right so that he can forgive us our sins and make us clean from all that is not right in us.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi mangaku sasala èdhi, tatu ama lamatua dhu d'ara mola, saku eele sasala èdhi madhutu lii pajaji na, aa na pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: if we claim we haven't sinned, we turn him into a liar, and his word is not in us.
target_text: ladhe èdhi peka, na, èdhi tao tèdhi boe sasala, sasoa na, èdhi tao ama lamatua dhèu leko-monya! te nèngu ka dhu peka tèke, na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu manahu asa d'ara sasala-sasigo. aa ladhe lii padhai èdhi sèmi èèna, tadha na, lii holo-nori nèngu abhu boe ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: my dear children, i'm writing this to you so you shouldn't sin. but if anybody should happen to sin, we have someone who defends us before the father-jesus christ, who is truly good and right.
target_text: ana pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a suri se'e aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka miu mamuri dènge tao ia ka sasala. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tao sala, èèna na abhu kahèi dhu sarii èdhi ètu madha ama lamatua. dhu sarii èdhi èèna, nuka yesus kristus, dhèu mola-mèci dhu ama lamatua pua mai le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: through him our sins are forgiven-and not only our sins, but those of the whole world.
target_text: nèngu madhe j'aj'i korban pala èdhi, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. madha j'ara ne hia boe mi èdhi mesa ti di, te ngaa hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne kahèi.

source_text: we can be sure that we do know him if we follow his commands.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, èdhi tadhe mèu ama lamatua ladhe èdhi madhutu paredha nèngu.

source_text: anyone who says, i know him, but doesn't do what he says, is a liar. they don't have the truth.
target_text: dhèu bisa peka, na, ja'a tadhe ama lamatua. te ngaa ladhe nèngu madhutu boe paredha lamatua, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, na, nèngu dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu padhai lii leo tao leo.

source_text: but those who follow god's word have his love totally fill their minds. this is how we know that we live in him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu tao madhutu paredha lamatua, èèna j'aj'i tadha, peka na, sasue nèngu mi lamatua èèna, dhu lèke tare'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi te'a, na, èdhi dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: whoever claims to be living in him should behave like jesus.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mamuri pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, sasoa na, nèngu hud'i mamuri ku sama sèmi yesus kristus.

source_text: my friends, i'm not writing to you giving some new commandment, but an old commandment you've had from the beginning. this old commandment is one you have already heard.
target_text: ana pasue aa'i-aa'i! lii paredha dhu ja'a suri hia miu ne, j'ara hiu boe. te paredha ne dhu suri le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori lamatua dhu miu tadèngi le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: but in a sense i am giving you a new commandment. its truth is revealed in jesus and in you, for the darkness is coming to an end and the true light is already shining.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu j'ara hiu dhu ja'a neo suri lula-nèti paredha lamatua. lii paredha ne, j'aj'i le dènge be'a ètu d'ara mamuri yesus. aa paredha ne mulai sab'a le ètu d'ara miu, lula maroga ètu d'ara miu mulai ele, aa saraa dhu tare'a èèna, pasaraa le ètu d'ara mamuri miu.

source_text: those who say they live in the light but hate a fellow christian still have the darkness inside them.
target_text: dhèu bisa padhai lii, peka na, ja'a mamuri ètu d'ara saraa. te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, sasoa na, nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga era.

source_text: those who love their fellow christians live in the light, and don't cause others to sin.
target_text: lula dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa, nèngu hud'i pasue ku dènge a'ari na, aa abhu boe bhabhelu-katub'a ètu d'ara na dhu pamanahu nèngu.

source_text: those who hate a fellow christian are in darkness. they stumble around in the dark, not knowing where they're going because the darkness has blinded them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tèka d'ara dènge a'ari na, èèna j'aj'i tadha, na, nèngu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu gogo ai lae-lae, lula maroga pabèdhu le musi madha na.

source_text: dear friends, i'm writing to you children, for your sins have been forgiven through the name of jesus.
target_text: ana-ana! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula kristus madhe le gati miu, hèia ama lamatua saku eele le sasala miu.

source_text: i'm writing to you fathers, for you know him who has existed from the beginning. i'm writing to you young people, for you have defeated the evil one.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu heka! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe yesus kristus, dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka. ana-ana ngèru! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu lab'a le bhabhelu-katub'a, toke segi.

source_text: i write to you little children, for you know the father. i write to you fathers, for you know him who has existed from the beginning. i write to you young people, for you are strong. the word of god lives in you, and you have defeated the evil one.
target_text: ana-ana! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe ama lamatua. dhèu-dhèu heka! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tadhe yesus kristus, dhu abhu mema le karèi nèti uru ka. ana-ana ngèru! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu, lula miu tèka le lii holo-nori ètu d'ara miu, toke miu j'aj'i èra, aa miu lab'a le bhabhelu-katub'a, toke miu segi.

source_text: don't be in love with the world, and don't long for the things of this world. if you love the world, you won't have the father's love in you.
target_text: miu baku sue dad'èi rai-haha, dènge mèdha-panyau na. te dhèu dhu sue rai-haha, bisa boe sue ama lamatua.

source_text: for all the things of this world-our sinful desires, wanting everything we see, boasting about what we've accomplished in life- these things don't come from the father but from the world.
target_text: madha j'ara dhu abhu ètu rai-haha ne, pa'èki boe dènge ama lamatua. nuka sèmi, dhèu dhu mamuri pakarej'e dhoka ngi'u na; dhèu manga'a; aa dhèu dhu d'èi padedha iisi lula kakaja-sasu'i na. j'ara sèmi se'e se mai boe nèti ama lamatua, te ngaa mai dhoka nèti rai-haha di.

source_text: the world and its evil desires are coming to an end, but those who do the will of god will live forever.
target_text: aa te ngaa rai-haha ne bèli-camèd'a ele, palere-lere dènge ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu neo unu. te ngaa dhèu dhu d'èi madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, dhèu ne ele boe, te nèngu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: dear friends, this is the last hour. as you've heard, the antichrist is coming. many antichrists have already come. this is how we know this is the last hour.
target_text: ana-ana! lod'o-lod'o èle rai-haha ne oe d'ai kèna. miu tadèngi le, peka na, dhèu dhu lab'a kristus, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai. madhutu iia-iia na, rèngu mai le. te ètu mia-mia, abhu le dhu lab'a kristus. se'e se j'aj'i mi tadha, na, lod'o-lod'o èle rai-haha ne dètu ae le.

source_text: they left us, but they didn't belong with us, for if they did, they would have remained with us. when they left they showed that none of them belonged with us.
target_text: dhèu palab'a sèra cèu nèti talora aae èdhi. te ngaa rèngu se dhèu èdhi boe. te, ladhe rèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èdhi, tatu ra tèke eele boe èdhi, te ngaa ra taha taruu dènge èdhi. aa te ngaa rèngu rai aa'i le nèti èdhi. de lèke tare'a, rèngu se dhèu èdhi boe, si?

source_text: but you have been anointed with the holy spirit's blessing, and all of you know what's true.
target_text: te ngaa miu sama boe sèmi rèngu. te miu dhu sèmi mere le roh nèti dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua. aa nèngu soru-bara le miu, sèna ka me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: i'm not writing because you don't know the truth, but because you do know it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
target_text: miu pangee, na, ja'a suri sasuri ne'e, lula ja'a pangee, na, miu me'a boe ngaa dhu lèke, do? aad'o! te miu me'a mèu le mia ka dhu lèke, aa mia ka dhu leko-monya.

source_text: who is the liar? -anyone who denies that jesus is the christ. the antichrist is anyone who denies the father and the son.
target_text: madhutu mola-mola na, abhu le ètu rai-haha ne dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. tasamia sèna ka èdhi tadhe si? rèngu sèra, nuka dhèu dhu padhai lii, peka na, yesus èèna kristus boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, yesus èèna, dhèu mola-mèci boe, dhu lamatua pajaji tèke hia mai. dhèu dhu padhai lii sèmi sèra palab'a dènge kristus, te rèngu tule eele ama lamatua dènge ana na.

source_text: anyone that denies the son does not have the father; anyone who acknowledges the son has the father too.
target_text: dhèu dhu tule eele ana ama lamatua, rèngu tule eele ama na kahèi. te ngaa ladhe dhèu mangaku ana ama lamatua, sasoa na, dhèu sèra j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua.

source_text: as for you, make sure what you heard from the beginning continues to live in you. if what you heard from the beginning lives in you, you will also live in the son and in the father.
target_text: de miu hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra ngaa dhu miu tadèngi mere le karèi nèti uru sèra. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ama lamatua, aa dènge ana na kahèi.

source_text: eternal life-this is what he has promised us!
target_text: aa nèngu unu na ka dhu padhadha le dènge èdhi, peka na, pe èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne.

source_text: i'm writing this to warn you against those who want to lead you astray.
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne, sèna ka miu tadhe dhèu dhu neo leko-monya miu.

source_text: but the anointing you received from him means the spirit lives in you, and you don't need to be taught by anyone. the spirit's anointing teaches you about everything. it is the truth and not a lie. so live in christ, just as you've been taught!
target_text: miu sèmi mere le roh mola-mèci lamatua, aa miu mamuri pa'èki le dènge nèngu kahèi. de miu parluu heka dhèu leo aj'a-nori hari miu. te roh lamatua nia le, lula nèngu ka dhu bisa aj'a aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. roh ne kapod'e-kabèli boe, sèmi dhèu leko-monya sèra. de kèpe pa'èra-èra mi ngaa dhu nèngu nori le, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci taruu dènge kristus.

source_text: now, my dear friends, continue to live in christ, so that when he appears, we can be confident and not feel ashamed before him at his coming.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge kristus. sèna ka ropa na mai hari, miu madha'u boe, aa dènge boe d'ara makae lami titu ètu madha na.

source_text: if you know he is good and right, then you also know that everyone who does what is right has been born of god.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le, na, nèngu tao dhoka ngaa dhu lèke, nèti èèna ka bisa me'a kahèi, peka na, dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ladhe tao ngaa dhu lèke, rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: look at the amazing kind of love the father has for us! this is why we can be called god's children-for that's who we are! the reason why the people of this world don't recognize us as god's children is because they don't recognize him.
target_text: miu pajiko sèku sasue ama ètu sorga mi dedha èdhi! te sasue na kapai titu kèna, toke na ded'e nare èdhi j'aj'i ana-ana nèngu. lèke si! te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi rai-haha, re'a boe, na, èdhi se cee, lula rèngu tadhe boe ama lamatua.

source_text: my friends, we are already god's children; however what we shall become hasn't been revealed just yet. but we do know that when he appears, we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he really is.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! èdhi j'aj'i le ana-ana ama lamatua, te ngaa te'a tare mèka, bèli-camèd'a èdhi j'aj'i sèmi ngaa sa. dhu te'a, sèmi ne'e ka: bèli-camèd'a ropa kristus mai hari, èdhi j'aj'i sama sèmi nèngu kahèi, lula èdhi ladhe tèdhi nèngu iia-iia.

source_text: all those who have this hope in them make sure they are pure, just as he is pure.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tatae mamai kristus, tatu ra pamèu mamuri rèngu, sèna ka mamuri ra mola-mèci sama sèmi kristus.

source_text: all those who sin are lawless, because sin is lawlessness.
target_text: sasala aa'i-aa'i ra ka dhu sisu paredha lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao sala, sisu paredha ama lamatua aa palab'a dènge ne.

source_text: but of course you know that jesus came to take away sins, and that there is no sin in him.
target_text: miu me'a le, peka na, kristus j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sèna ka saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. nèngu bisa tao j'ara èèna, lula nèngu mesa na tao nèdhi boe sasala.

source_text: all those who live in him don't go on sinning; all those who keep on sinning haven't seen him and haven't known him.
target_text: de dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge ne, mamuri heka dènge tao sala. te ngaa ladhe dhèu loe boe ad'u-ue sasala, sasoa na, nèngu tadhe boe aa pa'èki boe dènge kristus.

source_text: dear friends, don't let anyone fool you: those who do what is right are right, in the same way as jesus is right.
target_text: ana-ana pasue! baku lèke tipu. te dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, nèngu dhèu d'ara mola èci èèna ka dènge kristus.

source_text: those who sin are of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. that's the reason why the son of god came-to destroy what the devil has done.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri ad'u-ue sasala, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae nidhu ne, baki nèti bhabhelu-katub'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka. nèti èèna ka, ana ama lamatua mai ho dhedhe palaho bhabhelu nèti dhèu aae nidhu.

source_text: all those who are born of god don't keep on sinning, for god's nature lives in them. they can't keep on sinning because they are born of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i le ana lamatua mamuri heka tao sala, lula lamatua dhu pea le ètu d'ara nèngu. nèngu bisa heka ad'u-ue sasala taruu, lula j'aj'aj'i na nèti lamatua.
