source_text: he was given the ability to make great boasts and speak blasphemies, and he was also given the authority to do this for forty-two months.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke badha bhelu ne, sèna ka na padedha iisi na, aa padhai lii pakarehe lamatua. hia ne ijin kahèi, ho nèd'u paredha toke d'ai tèlu tèu dènge ca èta nuka 42 èpa nguru dua hèru.

source_text: as soon as he opened his mouth he spoke blasphemies against god, insulting his character, his sanctuary, and those who live in heaven.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, na padhai lii pamanahu kolongara ama lamatua, dènge pakarehe kolongara dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua dhu pea ètu sorga.

source_text: the beast was given power to attack believers and defeat them, and he was also given authority over every people, tribe, language, and nation.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke ne kahèi, ho pamusu lab'a dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua, toke na segi. na abhu koasa kahèi, sèna ka paredha suku aa'i-aa'i, udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, lii aa'i-aa'i, aa kabarai aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: everybody living on earth will worship him, those whose names had not been written in the book of life-the book of life that belongs to the lamb slain from the beginning of the world.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sogo-tagu badha bhelu èèna, nuka rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ngara ra suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. uru èèna dhèu pamadhe ana kalèbho èèna, te ngaa lamatua pamamuri hari ne. lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu dhu suri nare le ngara-ngara nèti dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra ètu d'ara sasuri na. dhu peka na, pe rèngu sèra ka dhu unu mamuri taa-taa, toke d'ai mia-mia dènge nèngu.

source_text: if you have ears, listen!
target_text: nanene paie-iie!

source_text: anyone who has to go into captivity will go into captivity; anyone who has to die by the sword will die by the sword. this demonstrates the patient endurance and confidence in god of the believers.
target_text: ladhe lamatua pama'ète nare le, dhèu cee ka dhu hud'i lèke kèpe, pe ra kèpe rare ne. aa ladhe lamatua pama'ète nare le, dhèu cee ka dhu hud'i madhe ku dènge samala, pe ra pamadhe nèngu pake samala kahèi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua baku hari kabodho, te èèna hia ra tebho ho madhutu taruu dènge parcaya na taa-taa!

source_text: then i saw another beast, rising up from the earth. he had two horns like a lamb, but he spoke like a dragon.
target_text: èle, hèia ja'a kèdhi badha bhelu dhu leo ci'u, bhodho nèti rai-haha. tadhu na dua, nuka sèmi tadhu kahib'i-kalèbho. lii na nuka sèmi lii mege naga.

source_text: he imposed the same authority as the first beast on his behalf, and made the earth and those who live there worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
target_text: nèngu nèti lii padhai lamatua na, nuka badha bhelu dhu uru èèna, dhu lèke pare ka oe madhe. na abhu koasa nèti lamatua na, sèna ka na laka-seti dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i ho sogo-tagu lamatua na.

source_text: he performed great miracles, even bringing fire down from heaven to earth while people watched.
target_text: nèngu tao tadha-tadha malaa dhu kapai kahèi, toke na bisa papuru ai nèti dedha-liru, ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: he deceived those who live on the earth by the miracles he performed on behalf of the beast, ordering the people that they should make an image for the beast who had received the fatal sword wound but came back to life.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, ka badha bhelu ka dua ne, pake koasa nèti lamatua na, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu rai-haha. na paredha dhèu ho tao mèdha sogo-tagu cue, rupa na nuka sèmi lamatua na, sèna ka ra pakab'ua lamatua na, dhu uru èèna dhèu pare ne, ka oe madhe.

source_text: he was permitted to breathe life into the image of the beast so that it could speak, ordering anyone who did not worship it put to death.
target_text: ama lamatua soro tèke kahèi, badha dhu kapod'e-kabèli ne, ho na hia a'ae, sèna ka pamamuri mèdha sogo-tagu ne. nèti èèna ka, mèdha sogo-tagu ne bisa padhai lii, ho pua pamadhe dhèu dhu ro'o boe pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: he made everyone, whether weak or powerful, rich or poor, free or slave, receive a mark on their right hand or on their foreheads.
target_text: badha dhu kapod'e-kabèli ne laka-seti dhèu kahèi, sèna ka tao tadha mi ai g'ana ra, do mi katangarèi ra. dhèu aa'i-aa'i, nuka ana iiki-dhèu kapai, dhèu kaja-dhèu unu aad'o, dhèu ènu, do dhèu mardeka, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra hud'i abhu ku cap èèna.

source_text: nobody was permitted to buy or sell except those who had the mark, which was the name of the beast or the number of his name.
target_text: te ladhe aad'o, dhèu sèra bisa boe pahia do pahèli ngaa-ngaa. ètu d'ara cap ne, dhu suri ngara badha bhelu ka èci, dènge nomer na.

source_text: wisdom is needed here. whoever has understanding should calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. his number is 666.
target_text: de hud'i pangee paie-iie! dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu bisa re'a sasoa nèti nomer èèna. nuka 666 èna ngasu èna nguru èna, dhu paj'uj'u mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: i looked, and saw the lamb standing on mount zion. with him were 144, 000 who had his name, and the name of his father, written on their foreheads.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a boti kètu, kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho dhu titu ètu kolo ledhe iiki èci. ngara na ledhe sion. na titu dènge dhèu na 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara ana kalèbho, dènge ngara ama na.

source_text: i heard a voice from heaven that sounded like rushing water and loud thunder and many harps being played.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru. lii ne kadèru sèmi lii bèbhe naha dhasi kapai, aa dou sèmi lii d'oro. te ngaa lii ne culi be'a titu kèna, nuka sèmi dhèu ae dhu karihu sasadhu.

source_text: they sang a new song in front of the throne and the four living creatures and the elders. nobody could learn the song except the 144, 000, those who had been redeemed from the earth.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu se, dhu titu tangare asa madha ama lamatua, dènge badha aae èpa ngi'u dhu reo rare kadera paredha lamatua, aa dènge katua-katua sèra. dhèu ae-ae se sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci. lii sod'a ne, dhodhoka rèngu di dhu re'a, dhèu leo aad'o. te rèngu dhu pabe'a le dènge lamatua, lula lamatua pake raa ana na, ho sui si nèti sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: they have not become morally impure by sinning with women; spiritually they are virgins. they follow the lamb wherever he goes. they were redeemed from humankind as the firstfruits to god and the lamb.
target_text: mamuri rèngu mola-mèci le, nuka sèmi mone kalora iisi dhu pa'èci nèdhi mèka dènge dhèu bhèni. rèngu parai eele boe dènge ana kalèbho èèna, sad'i asa era mia èèna ka, lula ama lamatua sui le rèngu pake raa ana na, sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. rèngu èci èèna ka dènge hua hela dhu uru tèka nèti d'ara oka hia mi lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: they speak no lies; they are without fault.
target_text: rèngu dhu re'a boe padhai lii leko-monya, lula d'ara ra mola.

source_text: then i saw another angel flying in mid-heaven. he had the eternal good news to announce to those who lived on the earth, to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua ca dhèu hari mai nèti sorga. ana pajuu ne dhu lela dedha titu kèna, ho rodhe palème lii lolo be'a lamatua, dhu ma'ète boe ciki sa. na lela palème era, ho peka dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti lii aa'i-aa'i, dènge negara aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: he cried out in a loud voice, give god reverence and glory, for the time of his judgment has come. worship the one who made heaven and earth and sea and springs of water.
target_text: na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, miu hud'i pakab'ua ku ama lamatua! miu hud'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na dhu dedha risi eele! lula lod'o na d'ai le, ho lamatua parisa lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i madhutu tatao ra. koa-kio ne! ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula nèngu ka paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha. aa nèti paredha na, ka dhasi dènge madha èi j'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: a second angel followed, calling out, babylon the great has collapsed into ruins! she made all the nations drink the wine of her sexual immorality that brings god's furious opposition.
target_text: ropa padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, dhu mai madhutu ana pajuu dhu mai uru èèna. na lii, aku nèngu na, laho eele le! laho mae-mae le! kota babel dhu kapai na, laho le! kota dhu bhelu èèna, guri eele le pamera dènge rai. uru èèna, kota ne, nuka sèmi bhèni kajeo dhu laka-seti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne ho rinu mahu, aa madhutu dad'èi na, ka ad'u-ue j'ara makae. te ngaa limuri ne kota ne, pasae nare le pala na nèti nanasa lamatua.

source_text: a third angel followed the first two, and cried out in a loud voice, if anyone worships the beast and his image and receives a mark on their forehead or on their hand,
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai madhutu ana pajuu ka dua deo na. na pa'oo-parodha, peka na, mata unu mi! dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do abhu cap ètu katangarèi, do ètu kacui-aai, pe rèngu pasae rare nanasa lamatua!

source_text: they will also drink of the wine of god's furious opposition that is poured undiluted into the cup of his anger, and they will suffer anguish in fire and burning sulfur before the holy angels and the lamb.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a lamatua mesa na sabhori mai nanasa na mi dedha rèngu, nuka sèmi na panginu si èi uuru nèti èi anggor pèd'u. èèna na core si asa d'ara èi nasu dhu heo robhe-robhe dhu loe boe ciki sa. ana pajuu na nèti sorga sèra, aa ana kalèbho èèna kahèi ladhe rèdhi j'ara ne'e.

source_text: the smoke of their anguish ascends for ever and ever. they don't have any relief day or night, those who worship the beast and his image and who receive the mark of his name.
target_text: peka ka laa, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu badha bhelu dènge mèdha sogo-tagu na, do rèngu dhu lèke le cap na, pe dui rare j'aj'èra taa-taa. sèb'u nèti j'aj'èra rèngu bhodho mai loe boe mèu-mèda.

source_text: this means the believers must patiently endure, keeping god's commandments and trusting in jesus. then i heard a voice from heaven that told me, write this down! blessed are the dead who die in the lord from now on. yes, says the spirit, because they can rest from their troubles. what they have accomplished will speak for them.
target_text: de se'e se, sasoa na, dhèu unu ama lamatua, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie lii paredha na, aa parcaya taruu mi yesus, aa baku hari kabodho. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri ku sèmi ne'e: karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, ladhe ra madhe, rèngu abhu oto. hèia roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhaa, peka na, tare'a! bèli-camèd'a rèngu sèra oto tare'a-re'a! lula rèngu j'èra le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa ra taha ho madhutu taruu lamatua. de èèna na, lamatua b'ala j'aj'èra rèngu, ka rèngu mamuri j'èra heka ètu sorga.

source_text: i looked and i saw a white cloud. sitting on the cloud was someone that looked like the son of man, wearing a golden crown on his head and holding a sharp sickle in his hand.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a padoa kètu. kaca'a laa, kèdhi ra'i-liru dhu pudhi lao-lao, aa ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha na. dhèu ne, oe sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake dènge solo juara dhu tao nèti hualaa, aa nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci.

source_text: another angel came out of the temple and shouted in a loud voice to the one sitting on the cloud, take your sickle and start reaping, for it is harvest-time, and earth's harvest is ripe.
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu èci hari nèti sorga, kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. na rodhe dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, pake hela èu èèna ho lamu puu-g'ètu ka! te d'ai le hèru pakaboko isi rai.

source_text: the one sitting on the cloud swung his sickle towards the earth, and reaped earth's harvest.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru ne, kèpe nare hela na, ka na la'e puu-g'ètu. hèia na oru kaboko isi rai nèti rai-haha.

source_text: another angel came out of the temple in heaven. he also had a sharp sickle.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo hari ca dhèu kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. nèngu nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci, ho neo g'ètu hua aj'u.

source_text: he was followed by an angel coming from the altar that was in charge of the fire, who called in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, take your sharp sickle and harvest the bunches of grapes from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu dhu leo hari èci kalua nèti era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. sasab'a ana pajuu ne, nuka j'aga ai ètu era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. na pa'oo pua ana pajuu dhu nèd'u hela pare j'u'u deo na, aku nèngu na, pake ka hela èu èèna, ho lamu ka g'ètu hua aj'u ètu rai-haha! te ètu nèi, hua anggor dhu madhasa aa'i le.

source_text: the angel swung his sickle on the earth and harvested the grapes from the vine, and threw them into the great winepress of god's judgment.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne kèpe nare ka hela pare j'u'u na la'e asa rai-haha, ho na g'ètu hua anggor, j'ue dènge ii kateme. hèia na pamaso hua anggor se asa d'ara bak pacèli anggor. ka ra j'èli marèu anggor se, sèna ka rare èi. j'èli marèu hua anggor ètu d'ara bak pacèli ne, sasoa na, nanasa lamatua.

source_text: they were trampled in the winepress outside the city. blood flowed out of the winepress to the height of a horse's bridle, and to a distance of 1, 600 stadia.
target_text: bak pacèli ne ètu li'u kota. ropa ra j'èli marèu anggor se, hèia raa kalua ae-ae. raa ne hae sama sèmi loko cue, dhu madhera na tèlu ngasu kilo, aa marèma na d'ai ca meter ca èta.

source_text: then i saw another amazing, important sign in heaven. seven angels held the seven last plagues which complete god's judgment.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi tadha èci ètu dedha-liru, dhu kapai titu kèna, toke ja'a malaa bia. abhu ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, èci-èci ka dènge koasa ra, ho hia calaka kapai asa rai-haha. pidhu calaka se, nuka j'aj'èra dhu limuri tèka. ladhe j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ka, d'ara ama lamatua pacuhi, ka nasa heka dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: i saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire. standing beside the sea of glass were those who had defeated the beast and his image and the number of his name. they had harps given to them by god
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi dhasi dhu ha'a-ha'a, nuka sèmi tèru dhu pab'ali dènge ai. ja'a kèdhi kahèi dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sebhe dhasi èèna. dhèu se'e ka dhu madhutu boe badha bhelu èèna, aa ra sogo-tagu boe mèdha sogo-tagu na, aa dhu sèmi boe cap na hèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe dènge mèdha lii sod'a èci nuka sèmi sasadhu, dhu ra abhu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: and they sang the song of moses, the servant of god, and the song of the lamb: what you have done is tremendous and marvelous, lord god, the all-powerful one. your ways are right and true, king of the nations.
target_text: ka ra sod'a lii sod'a èci dhu musa suri. musa ne, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua uru-uru sèra. dhèu se'e se sod'a kahèi lii sod'a èci dhu koa-kio yesus. te uru èèna, dhèu pamadhe ne, sama sèmi dhèu roro pamadhe ana kalèbho ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, sèna ka pamaringi d'ara na. dhèu se sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula koasa lamatua kapai risi eele. dènge a'èra na kapai titu kèna. lamatua ka dhu nèd'u le paredha mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae mi udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. tatao lamatua mola sèmi isi pupu. sasab'a lamatua be'a seli eele! j'ara lamatua mèu rèd'e-rèd'e. mamuri lamatua lèke mola-mola!

source_text: who would not be in awe of you, lord? who would not glorify your name? for only you are holy. all nations will come and worship you because you have demonstrated by your actions that you do what is right!
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio babe'a lamatua. lula lamatua mesa na dhu mola-mèci. aa lamatua mesa na di, dènge boe sasala. pe suku aa'i-aa'i mai pahaha iisi mi lamatua. pe udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i mai manèngi makasi mi lamatua. lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a rèdhi le tatao lamatua dhu be'a. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a le mamola d'ara lamatua.

source_text: after this i looked and the temple of the tent of witness was opened.
target_text: ropa dhèu se èle sod'a, ja'a kèdhi kama luri mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua ètu sorga, dènge bhèla bhabhiri dhu bhoke pataleo tèke.

source_text: out of the temple came the seven angels who held the seven plagues, wearing clean, white linen clothes and golden sashes on their chests.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti dènge pidhu calaka sèra. rèngu kalua mai nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. rèngu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e pudhi mèu, aa pake salalu dhu tao nèti poe dènge pai.

source_text: one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the judgment of god, who lives for ever and ever.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi badha aae èci nèti èpa ngi'u sèra ètu sebhe kadera paredha lamatua, dhu papala pidhu bokor hualaa mi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu sèra. pidhu bokor se, èci-èci ka dhu isi ra hahuku nèti ama lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. te na pa'èra le, ho sabhori nanasa na asa rai-haha.

source_text: the temple was filled with smoke that came from the glory of god and from his power. nobody was able to enter the temple until the seven plagues that came from the seven angels were over.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ne pènu dènge sèb'u dhu bodho mai nèti dadedha dènge koasa ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa maso asa era èèna. ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se hud'i sabhori pa'èle ku pidhu calaka asa rai-haha ne, heka dhèu bisa maso asa era èèna kèna.

source_text: then i heard a loud voice coming from the temple telling the seven angels, go and pour out the seven bowls of god's judgment on the earth.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii parodha èci kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se, na, lami ka! nedhe mèti ka bokor se'e, ho bhori ka nanasa lamatua asa rai-haha.

source_text: so the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and terrible, painful sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana pajuu ka èci la'e bhori isi bokor na asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, papèd'a-tarègu lèke dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru sèra abhu cap nèti badha bhelu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu sogo-tagu mèdha sogo-tagu na. rèngu se lèke èi papèd'a hisu huu dhu rarii titu kèna.

source_text: the second poured out his bowl on the sea, and it became like the blood of a corpse and everything living in the sea died.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka dua la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara dhasi. kaca'a laa, èi ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa dhu hèu mau, cakaraa hèu raa dhèu madhe. ka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara dhasi madhe aa'i si.

source_text: the third poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and the water turned into blood.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka tèlu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara loko dènge madha èi. ka èi aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i raa.

source_text: i heard the angel who had power over the waters declare, you are truly right, you who are and was, the holy one, as this judgment demonstrates.

source_text: never again will the light of a lamp shine in you. never again will the voices of bridegroom and bride be heard in you. your traders led the world. through your witchcraft all the nations were deceived.

source_text: this is the first resurrection. the rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years had ended. blessed and holy are those who take part in the first resurrection! the second death has no power over them. they will be priests of god, and of christ, and they will reign with him for one thousand years.
target_text: dènge sèmi ne'e, rèngu se'e ka dhu uru j'ara ama lamatua pamamuri hari si nèti mamadhe. de rèngu oto titu kèna, te rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua. ra core boe si asa era j'aj'èra èèna, ka ra abhu boe mamadhe ka dua. te rèngu se nuka sèmi ama agama dhu bèli-camèd'a lalau-lalo'o ama lamatua dènge kristus. aa rèngu rèd'u paredha kahèi bera-bera dènge kristus toke d'ai ca riho tèu. te ngaa dhèu madhe dhu leo sèra, hud'i mate ku d'ai ca riho tèu, heka ama lamatua pamamuri hari si kèna.

source_text: once the thousand years are over, satan will be set free from his prison,

source_text: and will go out to deceive the nations, symbolized by gog and magog, to gather them together for battle from the four corners of the world. their number is as uncountable as sand on the seashore.

source_text: they marched over the earth on a broad front and encircled the camp of the believers, the beloved city. but fire rained down from heaven and burned them up.
target_text: hèia sordad'u gog dènge magog kako lasi kaj'èu d'ai rae-rae ètu d'ara rai-haha. ka ra reo rare kota lamatua dènge dhèu dhu na sue sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua papuru ai nèti dedha-liru ka na'a pakèpu aa'i sordad'u se'e.

source_text: the devil, who had deceived them, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur where the beast and the false prophet had also been thrown, and they will suffer in anguish day and night for ever and ever.
target_text: ka dhèu unu lamatua sèra kèpe rare dhèu aae nidhu dhu kapod'e nare le dhèu ae. hèia ra core ne asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu, dhu heo na loe boe. èèna na, ra bèdho tèke ne sama-sama dènge badha bhelu, aa dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai kapod'e-kabèli èèna. ètu era ne'e, rèngu abhu j'aj'èra loe boe mèu-mèda toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: then i saw a large white throne with the one who sits on it. heaven and earth vanished, and they were never seen again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi kadera paredha pudhi aae cue. aa ama lamatua ka dhu madhèdi ètu kadera èèna. cag'ag'a laa, rai-haha dènge liru, rai pakaj'èu ka ele aa'i si toke tèdhi heka senu-salao sa hèi.

source_text: i saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and the books were opened. another book, the book of life, was opened and the dead were judged based on what was written in the books about what they had done.
target_text: ka ladhe kèdhi dhèu dhu madhe sèra. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ana iiki-dhèu kapai, titu tangara asa kadera paredha. hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga mai, ka bhoke sasuri-sasuri dhu suri tatao aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu rai-haha ad'u-ue. ka ra bhoke hari sasuri leo èci, dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu bèli-camèd'a mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua. hèia na pama'ète lii langu nèti dhèu madhe, madhutu ngaa dhu rèngu èci-èci ad'u-ue, nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri sèra.

source_text: the sea handed over the dead in it, and death and hades handed over the dead that were in them, and everyone was judged according to what they had done.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe sèra mai titu patangara dènge kadera paredha èèna. rèngu se aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe le ètu rai-dedha dènge ètu d'ara dhasi. hèia ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu rèngu èci-èci, madhutu tatao ra.

source_text: then death and hades were thrown into the lake of fire. the lake of fire is the second death.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua pèci eele mamadhe asa d'ara dhasi ai. aa na core eele kahèi era pea samanga dhèu madhe asa d'ara dhasi ai. te dhasi ai ne, era mamadhe ka dua.

source_text: anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
target_text: dhèu dhu ngara ra suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, lèke core kahèi asa d'ara dhasi ai. te sasuri èèna, nuka dhu suri ngara-ngara dhèu dhu mamuri dènge ama lamatua taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: then i saw a new heaven and a new earth. the first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and the sea no longer existed.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi liru dènge rai-haha rupa hiu, te liru dènge rai-haha dhu dhui ele aa'i le. dhasi aad'o heka kahèi.

source_text: i saw the holy city, new jerusalem, descending from god out of heaven, prepared like a bride made beautiful for her husband.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi kota mola-mèci unu ama lamatua, nuka yerusalem hiu, puru mai nèti sorga. kota ne, dhu pa'èra mema, sama sèmi bhèni dhu neo leo-èmu hiu, dhu lalau nare le iisi, ho la'e soru mone dhu neo j'aj'i dhèu èmu na.

source_text: i heard a loud voice from the throne say, now god's home is with human beings and he will live with them. they will be his people. god himself will be with them as their god.
target_text: ka ja'a tadèngi lii dhu kapai èci mai nèti kadera paredha ne, peka na, ladhe paie-iie! karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, èmu ama lamatua ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha. karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, lamatua mamuri pa'èci dènge dhèu unu na. te nèngu j'aj'i le ama lamatua ra. aa rèngu j'aj'i le ana-ana na. bèli-camèd'a nèngu bera-bera dènge ra. aa na palere-lere dènge rèngu taa-taa.

source_text: he will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death will never happen again. there will be no mourning or crying or pain ever again for the former world no longer exists.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a na seka pamango èi madha aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka rèngu roma iisi heka. lula ètu era èèna, abhu heka papèd'a-tarègu. aa ètu era èèna, abhu heka mamadhe. ngaa-ngaa dhu uru èèna rèti sasusa, aad'o heka èci sa. ngaa-ngaa dhu uru èèna rèti j'aj'èra, ele aa'i si le.

source_text: the one who sits on the throne said, i am making everything new! he told me, write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.
target_text: hèia nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha èèna, peka na, ladhe paie-iie, te ja'a tao pahiu aa'i le. ka na padhai lii hari dènge ja'a, peka na, suri ka! dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ja'a ne, te aa'i-aa'i se mema lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: then he said to me, everything's done! i am the alpha and omega, the beginning and the end. to anyone who is thirsty i will give the free gift of water from the spring of the water of life.
target_text: ka na peka hari dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a pajaji sèra, j'aj'i aa'i le. te ja'a ne, alpa toke omega, aa ja'a ne, a toke z, aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru ka, toke d'ai èle. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu koko-kamango, pe ja'a hia ra rinu iia-iia d'ara, nèti madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu, sèna ka dhèu sèra bisa mamuri dènge tare'a.

source_text: those who are victorious will inherit all these things, and i will be their god and they shall be my children.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu taha madhutu j'ara lamatua dhu mola, bèli-camèd'a rèngu unu mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i ra. pe ja'a j'aj'i ama lamatua ra, aa rèngu j'aj'i ana-ana ja'a.

source_text: but anyone who is a coward, who doesn't trust me, who does disgusting things, who is a murderer, who is sexually immoral, who practices witchcraft, who worships idols, who tells lies-their chosen place is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. this is the second death.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu dhu èèna na lèke core si, asa d'ara dhasi ai èi nasu dhu heo na ma'ète boe ciki sa. nuka sèmi: dhèu dhu madha'u leli, dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi lamatua yesus, dhèu d'ara kaj'alu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, dhèu pamadhe dhèu, dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu suagi, aa dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. bèli-camèd'a rèngu aa'i-aa'i lèke pèci asa d'ara dhasi ai, dhu ra peka na, ‘era mamadhe ka dua. '

source_text: one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls containing the seven last plagues came and spoke to me. he told me, come with me. i will show you the bride, the lamb's wife.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ca dhèu nèti ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, dhu uru èèna rèd'u bokor dhu isi dènge nanasa lamatua. na mai paraga dènge ja'a, ka na lii, peka na, mai ku sa ne'e! te ja'a neo pad'elo dènge èu bhèni dhu neo kab'i dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: he took me in the spirit to the top of a very high mountain. there he showed me the holy city jerusalem descending from god out of heaven,
target_text: hèia ja'a abhu roh lamatua, ka ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga mai nedhe nèti ja'a asa kolo ledhe dhu dedha aae èci. nèti era ne'e, na pad'elo ja'a kota yerusalem, nuka kota ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu puru mai nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: shining with the glory of god's presence. the light sparkled like that from a gemstone, a jasper, clear and bright.
target_text: kota ne saraga titu kèna! abhu saraa dhu kalua nèti dadedha ama lamatua sèmi hadhu intan dhu kale'e, toke kota aa'i-aa'i heo lo'a-lo'a.

source_text: the city wall was high and thick, with twelve gates guarded by twelve angels. on the gates were inscribed the names of the twelve tribes of israel.
target_text: abhu tedhe dhu dedha aae oke nare kota ne, dènge canguru dua babèdho. abhu kahèi canguru dua ana pajuu nèti sorga dhu madhenge babèdho kapai se. ètu canguru dua babèdho se, dhu suri ngara-ngara nèti canguru dua udhu-rasa isra'el.

source_text: there were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
target_text: tèlu babèdho tangara asa dhimu. tèlu tangara asa haa. tèlu tangara asa badae. aa tèlu hari tangara asa balèu.

source_text: the city wall had twelve foundations, and inscribed on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the lamb.
target_text: tedhe ne dhu patitu ètu canguru dua hadhu fanderen dhu kapai. ètu hadhu se èci-èci dhu suri ngara nèti canguru dua dhèu pajuu-paleha ana kalèbho dhu lalau-lalo'o ne ètu rai-haha.

source_text: the angel who spoke to me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu padhai lii dènge ja'a, kèpe nare tatea a'uku nèti hualaa èci, ho neo uku kota ne dènge hèb'a babèdho kapai, aa dènge tedhe na.

source_text: the city was square. the length was the same as the width. he measured the city with the rod, it was 12, 000 furlongs. the length, width, and height were all the same.
target_text: na uku uru tedhe kota. madhera, bhabhèla dènge katitu na, èci èèna ka. nuka, aa'i-aa'i ra, 2. dua riho dua ngasu dua nguru kilometer.

source_text: he measured the wall and it was 144 cubits thick in human measurements that the angel was using.
target_text: hèia na uku ma'aa tedhe, madhutu a'uku dhèu rai-haha. ma'aa na, èna nguru lèmi meter.

source_text: the wall was built out of jasper. the city was made of pure gold that looked like glass.
target_text: tedhe ne, tao nèti hadhu kale'e, ngara na yaspis. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe dènge pai, dhu mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru.

source_text: the foundations of the city wall were decorated with all kinds of gemstones. the first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
target_text: canguru dua hadhu fanderen sèra, tao nèti rupa-rupa hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua. fanderen ka èci, tao nèti hadhu yaspis, dhu mangèru kale'e. ka dua, nèti hadhu nilam dhu kale'e mangèru bhidhu-bhidhu. ka tèlu, tao nèti hadhu mirah dhu mea kale'e. ka èpa, tao nèti hadhu samrud, dhu mangèru kale'e.

source_text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth, chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
target_text: ka lèmi, tao nèti hadhu unam dhu pakatanga dènge karara mea sanama pudhi. ka èna, dhu tao nèti hadhu sardius, dhu mea kale'e. ka pidhu, tao nèti ratna cempaka dhu karara hualaa. ka aru, dhu tao nèti hadhu beril, dhu kale'e mangèru aae. ka ceo, tao nèti hadhu krisolit, dhu karara moce-moce. ka canguru, tao nèti hadhu krisopras dhu mangèru mud'a. ka canguru èci, tao nèti hadhu lasuardi, dhu mangèru dhasi. aa ka canguru dua, tao nèti hadhu kecubung, dhu kale'e mea sanama mangèru.

source_text: the twelve gates were made of pearl, each one made from a single pearl. the main street was made of pure gold, clear like glass.
target_text: aa babèdho kapai canguru dua bua sèra, tao nèti canguru bua mutiara. babèdho èci tao nèti mutiara cue. j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne, tao nèti poe-pai dhu kale'e sèmi tèru.

source_text: i did not see a temple there, because the lord god the all-powerful one, and the lamb, they are its temple.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a kèdhi boe èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara kota ne. lula ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi dènge ana kalèbho pea taa-taa ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti èèna ka, dhèu pahaha iisi mema mi rèngu.

source_text: the city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it because the glory of god provides its light-the lamb is its lamp.
target_text: kota èèna, parluu boe madha lod'o dènge hèru ho pasaraa ne, lula saraa ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa ne. aa ana kalèbho ne j'aj'i nuka sèmi labhu dhu heo.

source_text: the nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into the city.
target_text: dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, èèna na kako lasi mai ètu d'ara saraa èèna. dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti rai-haha, rèti kakaja-sasu'i ra asa nèi kahèi.

source_text: the gates of the city will never be shut during the day and there will be no night there.
target_text: ètu era nèi, abhu boe mèda. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe bèdho hèb'a tedhe.

source_text: the nations' honor and glory will be brought into the city.
target_text: pe asa d'ara kota ne, dhèu rèti aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a kahèi, dènge hormat aa'i-aa'i nèti rai-rai ètu rai-haha.

source_text: nothing unclean will ever enter into it, or anyone who worships idols, or who is a liar-only those who are written in the lamb's book of life.
target_text: te ngaa dhu bisa boe maso asa nèi, nuka aa'i-aa'i dhu karehe, nuka sèmi: dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae, dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. dhu bisa maso, nuka rèngu dhu ngara ra abhu ètu d'ara sasuri ana kalèbho. rèngu se'e ka dhu mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: the angel showed me the river of water of life, crystal-clear, flowing out of the throne of god and of the lamb,
target_text: èle ka ana pajuu nèti sorga pad'elo dènge ja'a loko èci, dhu èi ne nèti mamuri. èi ne mèu aadha-aadha nuka sèmi tèru. na hae mai nèti kadera paredha ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho.

source_text: right in the middle of the main street of the city. on both sides of the river was the tree of life, producing twelve crops of fruit, one every month. the leaves of the tree were used to heal people from all nations.
target_text: hèia hae la'e asa talora aae j'ara oka-hoo ètu d'ara kota ne. nèti sebhe-sebhe loko ne, abhu aj'u dhu hua na nèti mamuri. aj'u ne d'ara ca tèu, hua canguru dua hari; ca hèru, ca tèka. rèu na bisa j'aj'i èi na'i ho puri-pa'èle suku-suku ètu rai-haha nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: there will no longer be any curse. the throne of god and of the lamb will be there in the city, and his servants will worship him.
target_text: te ngaa rèngu dhu ama lamatua tule eele aa dhoo si, abhu boe ètu d'ara kota ne. dhu ètu ne'e, nuka ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha, aa dènge ana pua-paleha ra dhu pahaha iisi mi rèngu.

source_text: they will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu ama lamatua. ètu katangarèi dhèu se'e, dhu suri ngara lamatua.

source_text: there will be no more night, and they will not need the light of a lamp, or the light of the sun, because the lord god will give them light. they shall reign for ever and ever.
target_text: mèda abhu boe ètu kota ne'e. de dhèu unu lamatua parluu boe madha lod'o, do labhu, lula ama lamatua ka dhu pasaraa kota ne. bèli-camèd'a rèngu sama-sama rèd'u paredha toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: the angel told me, these words are trustworthy and true. the lord god, who gave his spirit to the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants what is about to happen.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne peka dènge ja'a, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka kore dènge èu se'e, lèke tare'a-re'a. dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya lii ja'a se. uru èèna, ama lamatua pake roh na ho peka-padhai lii holo-nori na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga ho lole mi dhèu unu na, lula-nèti j'ara aa'i-aa'i se dhu nèbhu heka hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: i am coming soon! blessed are those who obey the prophetic words of this book.
target_text: hèia yesus padhai lii, peka na, sanèd'e paie-iie! nèbhu heka, te ja'a neo mai. ètu d'ara sasuri ne, dhu suri aa'i mèu-mèu le, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu isi sasuri ne, pe rèngu abhu a'oto.

source_text: i am john who heard and saw all this. when i heard and saw them, i fell down at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things to worship him.
target_text: dhu suri sasuri ne, nuka ja'a, yohanis. aa'i-aa'i se ja'a nanene dènge ro'a dhilu ja'a, aa kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a. ropa tadèngi kore, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho pahaha iisi ètu madha ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, dhu pad'elo le aa'i-aa'i se mi ja'a.

source_text: he told me, don't do that! i am one of god's servants just as you are, together with your brothers the prophets, and those who obey the words of this book. worship god!
target_text: te ngaa na kai ja'a, peka na, ee! èu baku tao sèmi èèna! èu dhodhoka pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua di! baku mi ja'a ne. te ja'a ne ènu lamatua kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge èu dènge a'ari èu dhu j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na, aa dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i ra dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e.

source_text: then he told me, don't seal up the words of prophecy of this book and keep them secret, for the time is near.
target_text: èu baku pahuni isi sasuri ne dènge dhèu leo. te nèbhu heka, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, hud'i j'aj'i ku.

source_text: whoever doesn't do what is right, let them stay that way. whoever is impure, let them stay that way. whoever does what is right, let them stay that way. whoever is holy, let them stay that way.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ad'u-ue bhabhelu, na, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao kaj'alu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri mola-mèci, hud'i laa ra mamuri mola taruu. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tao karehe, hud'i rèngu sène ra tao bhelu taruu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu tao be'a, hud'i laa ra tao taruu dhu be'a.

source_text: i am coming soon, and i am bringing my reward to give to everybody based on what they've done.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lii hari, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e paie! te nèbhu heka, ja'a dhiu. pe ja'a b'ala hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i, madhutu ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue.

source_text: i am the alpha and omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
target_text: ja'a ne, alpa toke omega. ja'a ne, a toke z. aa'i-aa'i j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a, karèi nèti uru, toke d'ai èle.

source_text: blessed are those who wash their robes so that they have the right to the tree of life, and can enter into the city through the gates.
target_text: dhèu dhu rase pamèu le mèdha-papake ra, rèngu ka dhu oto. te rèngu ka abhu hak ho maso re babèdho kapai dhu la'e asa d'ara kota ne. dhèu dhu mamuri mola, rèngu ka dhu oto. te bèli-camèd'a rèngu abhu ijin ho ra'a hua dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: those outside the city are dogs, those who practice witchcraft, those who are sexually immoral, those who murder, those who worship idols, and all those who love and invent lies.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo bisa boe maso asa era èèna. dhèu dhu unu boe lamatua, bisa boe pea ètu era èèna. nuka rèngu dhu parcaya boe lamatua, dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, tuka sogo-tagu, tuka pamadhe dhèu, tuka suagi, dènge rèngu dhu leko-monya. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa boe ara asa d'ara. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pea dhoka mi li'u di.

source_text: i, jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony to share with the churches. i am both the root and the descendant of david, the bright morning star.
target_text: ja'a ne, yesus. ja'a ka dhu paleha ana pajuu ja'a nèti sorga, ho bhoke j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka pe miu lami lole peka lii pajaji ja'a se'e mi pidhu juma'at sèra. ja'a ne, ana-èpu dhèu aae daud. ja'a ne, dhèu aae dhu kèd'u paredha. saraa nèti ja'a heo lo'a-lo'a, nuka sèmi hua-hètu oe mèu. saraa nèti ja'a madèka titu kèna, nuka sèmi hua-hètu èèna.

source_text: the spirit and the bride say, come. whoever hears this, say, come. whoever is thirsty, come, and whoever wants to, freely drink of the water of life.
target_text: roh ama lamatua mai paroa, peka na, mai asa ne'e! bhèni dhu neo kab'i paroa kahèi, peka na, mai ka! aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi peka kahèi, mai ka! dhèu cee dhu koko-kamango, mai ho minu! dhèu cee dhu neo ninu èi dhu nèti mamuri, mai mere ka! dhèu bisa rare èi ne dhu iia-iia d'ara. dhèu bisa rinu èi ne dhu b'ae boe.

source_text: i solemnly declare to everyone who hears the prophetic words of this book that if anyone adds to them then god will add to them the plagues described in this book.
target_text: ja'a, yohanis, pasanèd'e dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na tadèngi ngaa dhu ama lamatua bhoke mema hia ja'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu patabha hari ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara sasuri ne, èèna na ama lamatua pabie hari hahuku na mi nèngu dènge pidhu calaka sèra dhu na dutu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: if anyone takes away the prophetic words of this book, god will take away their share of the tree of life and of the holy city that are described in this book.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhu pakura hari isi sasuri ne, pe ama lamatua tao eele hak nèngu, sèna ka bisa boe maso asa d'ara kota dhu mola-mèci, aa bisa boe na'a hua aj'u dhu hia dhèu mamuri taa-taa.

source_text: he who confirms all this says, yes, i am coming soon. amen, come, lord jesus.
target_text: yesus mesa na ka dhu bhoke j'ara aa'i-aa'i sèra. na moa le, peka na, tare'a-re'a sèmi èèna! nèbhu heka, ja'a neo dhiu. de mai ka, lamatua yesus!

source_text: may the grace of the lord jesus be with the believers. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i. lèke tare'a sèmi èèna! amin! nèti ja'a, yohanis
